japanese: 1.過去への干渉
english: 1. Interference with the Past

japanese: 7月7日
english: July 7

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
お姉ちゃんがフラッとどっか行くんは、
いつものことやけど……
english: My sister wandering off somewhere on a whim is nothing new, but...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
なんで今日に限って、
そのいつも通りをするかな。
english: Why did she have to do that today of all days?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
今日は僕らの誕生日やのに……。
もう！　絶対忘れてるわ！
english: It's our birthday today... Jeez! I bet she completely forgot!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: お姉ちゃーん！
english: Sis!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
ゴクッ、ゴクッ……。
お姉ちゃん飲みもん持ってんのかな？
どっかに倒れてたらどないしょ。
english: *Gulp, gulp...* I wonder if Sis brought anything to drink? What if she collapsed somewhere?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
夢中になったら息すんの
忘れるような人やからな……。
english: She's the type of person who forgets to breathe when she's focused on something...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、この先にハイネの気配がする。
english: Shinpei, I sense Haine's presence ahead.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハイネの……。
english: Haine's…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
このままやと竜之介さんがハイネと
会うてまうッ！
english: At this rate, Ryunosuke is going to run into Haine!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まずい……竜之介さん！！
そっちは危険だ！
english: This is bad... Ryunosuke!! It's dangerous that way!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さん、戻って！！
english: Ryunosuke, come back!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
お姉ちゃんの友達ってどんな人なんかな。
てか、なんでこんな所で会うてんのやろ。
english: I wonder what kind of person Sis's friend is. Or rather, why are they meeting in a place like this?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ダメだ、聞こえないのか……！？）
english: (Damn it, can he not hear me...?!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: もしかして、友達って男の人とか……。
english: Maybe this friend is a guy...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
いやいや、お姉ちゃんに限ってそれは無いわ。
うん、無いわ。
english: No, no, knowing Sis, there's no way. Yeah, definitely not.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
アカン……！
ハイネの方に向かってる！
english: Oh no...! He's heading right for Haine!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くそっ、このままだと鉢合わせにっ！
english: Damn it, at this rate they'll run right into each other!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 戻るんだ、竜之介さん！
english: Go back, Ryunosuke!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: うーん、お姉ちゃん、どこにおるんやろ。
english: Hmm, where could Sis be?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さん行くなっ！
english: Don't go, Ryunosuke!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: あっちの方かな……。
english: Maybe that way…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さんっ！！！！
english: Ryunosuke!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平……。
english: Shinpei…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さんっ！　そっちはダメだっ！　行くな！
english: Ryunosuke! That's dangerous! Don't go!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: おらんなぁ。
english: She's not here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 行くなっ！　殺されるっ！！
english: Don't go! You'll be killed!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: え？　なんなん、今の……。
english: Huh? What was that…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァハァ……ウシオ、何かあったのか？
english: *Pant, pant*... Ushio, did something happen?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: わからん……。
english: I don't know…

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
空耳なんか……？
殺されるて聞こえた気がしたんやけど……。
english: Was I hearing things...? I could've sworn I heard someone say I'd be killed...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平！
もしかしたら<color=#GF_TIPS_083>声が届いた</color>んちゃう？
english: Shinpei! Maybe your <color=#GF_TIPS_083>voice reached him</color>!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （過去に関与できた？）
english: (I was able to interfere with the past?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なんでだ？）
english: (Why?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、今はそんなことを考えてる時間は無い！
　竜之介さんをハイネから遠ざけないと！）
english: (No, there's no time to think about that right now! I need to keep Ryunosuke away from Haine!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さん、この先は危険なんです！
english: Ryunosuke, it's dangerous up ahead!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だから戻ってください！！
早くここから離れて！！
english: So please go back!! Get away from here quickly!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
気のせい……か。
蝉の声聞きすぎて耳がおかしなって
しもたんかも。
english: Just my imagination... huh. Listening to all these cicadas must have messed with my hearing.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ちゃうッ！
気のせいちゃうねんッ！！
english: No! It wasn't your imagination!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さん！！
english: Ryunosuke!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あかん……やっぱり聞こえてへん……。
english: It's no use... He really can't hear us...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: さっきはたしかに届いたのに……！
english: But it definitely reached him just a moment ago...!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ハァ、ウゥ……。
english: *Pant*, *groan*...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: えっ？　ま、また誰かの声？
english: Huh? S-Someone else's voice?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
赤い……着物？
誰や……！？
english: A red... kimono? Who is that...?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハイネ……！
english: Haine…

speaker: Heine
japanese: ハァ、ハァ……。
english: *Pant, pant*...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
まさか……
お姉ちゃんが言うてた『友達』？
english: Is this the "friend" Sis told us about?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: さっきの声ももしかしてこの子が……？
english: Was that voice from earlier this girl too...?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ……ねぇ。
english: …Hey.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さん、アカン！！
english: Ryunosuke, don't!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ハァ……ハッ、ハァ……。
english: *Pant*... *pant, pant*...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
大丈夫？
あの……気分でも悪いん？
english: Are you okay? Um... are you feeling sick?

speaker: Heine
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……、い、嫌じゃ……！
english: *Pant... pant...* N-No...!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
えっ？
ど、どないし――
english: Huh? Wh-What's wro—

speaker: Heine
japanese: もう嫌じゃああああッ！！！
english: I don't want to do this anymore!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 危ないっ！！
english: Look out!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 痛っっ……急になんなん……。
english: Ow... What was that for all of a sudden...?

speaker: Heine
japanese: フゥ……フゥ……。
english: *Wheeze... wheeze*...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: なんや、この子……正気の目やない……。
english: What's with this kid... Those aren't the eyes of someone sane...

speaker: Heine
japanese: フゥ……フゥ……。
english: *Wheeze... wheeze*...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
と、とりあえず落ち着こ？
着物泥だらけやん。
お母さんに怒られてしまうで。
english: L-Let's just calm down, okay? Your kimono is covered in mud. Your mom's gonna be mad at you.

speaker: Heine
japanese: フゥ……フゥ……。
english: *Wheeze... wheeze*...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
一人で立てる？
立てやんなら手ェ貸すから、ほら離れよ？
english: Can you stand by yourself? If not, I'll lend you a hand, so come on, let go.

speaker: Heine
japanese: お腹……空いた……。
english: I'm... hungry...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: え？　何？
english: Huh? What?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
お腹空いたんは……嫌じゃ……。
嫌なんじゃぁぁぁぁぁぁ！！
english: I hate... being hungry... I hate it!!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: うああああああぁぁっ！！？
english: Ahhhhhhhhhh!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さんッ！！
english: Ryunosuke!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: フゥ……フゥ……！！
english: *Wheeze... wheeze*...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 痛ッ……！！　な、なんやおまえッ！！
english: Ow...!! Wh-What's your problem?!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 離せッ！　離せえェェェェッ！！
english: Let go!! Let go!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: うぅぅぅぅ～～～～！！
english: Grrrrrr...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: うああああああああああっっっっ！！
english: Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhh!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さん早く逃げて！！
english: Ryunosuke, run away quickly!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: うぅぅぅぅ～～～～！！
english: Grrrrrr...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: うあああっ！　離して！！　離してや！！
english: Aaaah! Let go!! Let me go!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: うぐぅぅぅぅ～～～～！！
english: Grrrrrr...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
うがああああああああ！！
誰か！　誰か！　助けて！！
english:
Ahhhhhhhh!!!
Someone! Anyone! Help!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平なんとかせんと！
english: Shinpei, we have to do something!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
わかってる！
でも、どうしようもっ……。
english: I know! But there's nothing we can do...!

speaker: Heine
japanese: うぐぅぅぅぅ～～～～！！
english: Grrrrrr...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: い、い、いい加減にせえやっ！
english: K-K-Knock it off!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ぎゃッ！！
english: Gyah!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ハイネが竜之介さんから離れた！
english: Haine let go of Ryunosuke!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 痛っ……ぐっ……うぅぅぅぅっ！！
english: Ow... Guh... Uuugh...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さん、逃げて！！
english: Ryunosuke, run!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: うぅぅぅぅ～～～～！！
english: Grrrrrr...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: な、なんなんやっ、この子……。
english: Wh-What the hell is with this kid...?

speaker: Heine
japanese: 食餌が逃げんなや……。
english: Food shouldn't run away...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: し、食事？
english: Food?

speaker: Heine
japanese: うぅぅぅぅ～～～～！！
english: Grrrrrr...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
あかん、この子普通やない。
今は、逃げんと……。
english: This is bad, this kid isn't normal. Right now, I have to run...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ハァ、ハァ……うぐッ！
english: *Pant, pant*... Ugh!

speaker: Heine
japanese: もっと……もっとじゃ……。
english: More… more…

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
く、来んな……！
こっち来んなって！
english: S-Stay away...! I said stay away from me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ダメだ！
足からの出血がひどい……！
english: This is bad! His legs are bleeding terribly...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
早よ助けやんと！
慎平、いったん変身解くで！
english: We have to help him quickly! Shinpei, I'm undoing the transformation for now!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 何するつもりや！
english: What are you doing?!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: こんのォ！！
english: Take this!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
アカン！
攻撃がすり抜けてまう……！
english: It's no use! My attacks are going right through...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: でも……動きは止まった……。
english: But... her movements stopped...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（攻撃が届かなくても、
　ハイネは気配を感じてるのか……？）
english: (Even if the attacks don't hit, is Haine sensing their presence...?)

speaker: Heine
japanese: フゥ……フゥ……！！
english: *Wheeze... wheeze*...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（動きを一瞬止める事はできたけど、
　それだけじゃ……！）
english: (We managed to stop her for a second, but that's not enough...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（フカンしろ……！
　今のオレたちにできることは……）
english: (Take a bird's-eye view...! What can we do right now...)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
ハァ……ハァ……！
誰かっ……お姉、ちゃんっ……！
english: *Pant, pant*...! Someone... Onee-chan...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そうだ、南雲先生……！）
english: (That's right, Nagumo-sensei...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生は竜之介さんが殺された
　真実を知っていた）
english: (Nagumo-sensei knew the truth about how Ryunosuke was killed.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もし先生がその光景を自分の目で
　目撃したんだとしたら、まさに今この時、
　先生はここへ向かってるはず……）
english: (If she witnessed that scene with her own eyes, then right at this very moment, she should be heading this way...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （先生はきっとこの近くにいる！）
english: (She must be nearby!)

speaker: Heine
japanese: もっと……もっとじゃ……！
english: More... more...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: うッ……わァァァッ！？
english: Ugh... Waaah?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ウシオ！
ハイネの動きを少しでも鈍らせてくれ！
english: Ushio! Try to slow Haine down, even just a little!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: その間にオレは南雲先生を呼んでくる！
english: I'll go call for Nagumo-sensei in the meantime!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 止める言うても、私の攻撃あたらんし！
english: You say that, but my attacks don't even hit her!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
確信はできないけど、
ハイネはウシオの攻撃の気配を感じてる
みたいなんや！
english: I can't be certain, but it seems Haine can sense your attacks!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: そうなんか？
english: Really?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 説明してる時間も考えてる時間もない！
english: We don't have time to explain or think!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
わかった！
やれることはやってみる！
english: Got it! I'll do what I can!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （きっと……きっとこの近くにいるはずだ！）
english: (I'm sure... she must be nearby!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どこですかッ！？　南雲先生ッ！！
english: Where are you?! Nagumo-sensei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いたら返事してください！！
english: Answer me if you're here!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さんが危ないんです！！
english: Ryunosuke is in danger!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 南雲先生ッ！！
english: Nagumo-sensei!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 誰かそこにおるんか！？
english: Is someone there?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレの声が……聞こえた！？
english: You... heard my voice?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生、急いでください！
竜之介さんがハイネに襲われて……！
english: Nagumo-sensei, please hurry! Ryunosuke is being attacked by Haine...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 空耳か……？
english: Just hearing things...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
空耳じゃありません！
先生、こっちです！
早くこっちへッ！
english: You're not hearing things! Nagumo-sensei, over here! Hurry this way!

speaker: Heine
japanese: 嫌じゃ……！
english: I don't want to...!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ひだるいんはもう嫌じゃあああ！
english: I don't want to be hungry anymore!!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: うあ！！
english: Gah!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 竜之介さん、しっかりしィ！
english: Ryunosuke-san, hang in there!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 竜之介！？
english: Ryunosuke?!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……。
english: *Pant... pant*...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: お、ねえ……ちゃん……！
english: O-Onee-chan...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
竜之……介？
なんや、その血……。
english: Ryuno...suke? What's with all that blood...?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: お姉ちゃん……逃げて……。
english: Onee-chan... run...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
これは……どういう状況なん？
なんでこんなことに……
english: What... is going on here? Why did this happen...?

speaker: Heine
japanese: ひ……ひづる……？
english: Hi... Hizuru...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハイネ……？
english: Haine...?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: アカン、その化物に近づいたら危ない！
english: Don't, it's dangerous to get close to that monster!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ばけ……もの？
ハイネが？
english: Mon...ster? Haine is?

speaker: Heine
japanese: ひづる……ひづる……。
english: Hizuru... Hizuru...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ハイネ……これは……
キミがやったんか……？
english: Haine... did you... do this...?

speaker: Heine
japanese: ち、違う……！　わ、わしじゃ……！
english: N-No...! I-It wasn't...!

speaker: Heine
japanese: わしじゃない！！
english: It wasn't me!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハイネ……なんで……。
english: Haine... why...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生逃げて！
このままじゃ先生まで殺されます！
english: Nagumo-sensei, run! At this rate, you'll be killed too!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 殺される？
english: Killed?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 早く竜之介さんを連れて逃げてください！
english: Hurry up and get Ryunosuke out of there!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: お姉、ちゃん……。
english: Onee-chan...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 竜之介、立てるんか！？
english: Ryunosuke, can you stand?!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: な、なん……とか。
english: B-Bare...ly.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ひづる……違う……。
違うんじゃ……。
english: Hizuru... no... It wasn't me...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハイネ……。
english: Haine...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
つかまれ、竜之介。
早くこっから離れるんや！
english: Hold on to me, Ryunosuke. We need to get out of here fast!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: う、うん……！
english: Y-Yeah...!

speaker: Heine
english: Ah...

speaker: Heine
japanese: 違う……違うんじゃ……。
english: No... it wasn't me...

speaker: Heine
japanese: ひづる……。
english: Hizuru...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハイネの様子がおかしい。
　何か訴えようとしているような……）
english: (Haine is acting strange. It's like she's trying to say something...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （でも今は竜之介さんの事が心配だ）
english: (But right now, I'm more worried about Ryunosuke-san.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ウシオ、オレたちも行くぞ。

なるほどな。
そういうことやったら――

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?

ほれっ！
こないしたらええやいしょ！

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?

やった！
根津さんが影を羽交い締めにした！

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?

ホンマや！
これでもう動けやん！

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?

japanese: グギ……ギギッ！！

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: コラッ、暴れんな！
english: Hey, stop thrashing around!

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ひづるさん！
今のうちに影を！
english: Hizuru-san! Get the shadow while you can!

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ああ、わかってる！

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
猟師、
そのまま押さえとけ！
それと――
english: Hunter, keep it pinned down! And—

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: これ貸してもらうで！

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)

おい！
人のナイフ抜いて何する気ィや！

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?

japanese: こうするんや！

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
ど、どういうこっちゃ？
あの化物弾け飛びよったぞ。
english: Wh-What does this mean? That monster just burst apart.

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: あいつ、影が弱点やったんです。
english: Its shadow was its weakness.

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
いや、もしかしたら弱点というより、
影そのものが本体である可能性も……。
english: No, rather than a weakness, there's a possibility that the shadow itself is its main body…

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: わけわからん……。
english: I don't get it at all…

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
とにかく助かりました。
ありがとうございます。
english: Anyway, you saved us. Thank you.

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
別に礼やらいらん。
こっちこそおまえの助言がのうたら
危ないとこやった。
english: No need for thanks. I would've been in a bad spot myself without your advice.

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
それより……なんであいつの弱点が
影やとわかった？
english: More importantly… how did you know its weakness was its shadow?

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そうですね……。
藁にもすがった結果です。
english: Let's see… It was the result of grasping at straws.

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: ワラ？
english: Straws?

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ふっ……。
english: Heh…

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Nagumo-sensei…)

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)

思いの外、
頼りになる藁だったようです。
english: It seems it was a surprisingly reliable straw.

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（気のせいかな？
　今、先生と目が合ったような……）
english: (Is it just my imagination? I feel like Nagumo-sensei and I just made eye contact…)

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Ushio
japanese:
よかったなァ、
ひづるさんらの助けになれたみたいで。
english: That's great, it looks like we were able to help Hizuru and Ryunosuke out.

chapter: 3. Will a Demon or a Snake Appear?
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、まだ油断はできないけどな。
english: Yeah, though we still can't let our guard down.

japanese: 4.誕生日おめでとう
english: 4. Happy Birthday

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
もう一匹の姿は見えやんな。
でも楽観できる状況やない。
急いで下山したほうがよさそうや。
english: I don't see the other one around. But this isn't a situation we can be optimistic about. We should hurry and get down the mountain.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
猟師、すみませんが、
一緒に山を下りてもらえませんか？
english: Hunter, I'm sorry to ask, but could you come down the mountain with us?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
弟がひどい怪我で、
少しでも助けがほしいんです。
english: My brother is badly injured, and I need all the help I can get.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: ホンマにひどい怪我やな……。
english: That really is a terrible injury…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
すぐに病院連れてったるから、
少しの間だけ辛抱せェ。
english: I'll get you to a hospital right away, so just hang in there a little longer.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ありがとうございます。
english: Thank you.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
……良かったな、竜之介。
ほな、そろそろ行こか。
english: …Thank goodness, Ryunosuke. Well, let's get going.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: う、うん……。
english: Y-Yeah…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ゆっくりでええ。
ほら、私の肩使い。
english: Take it slow. Here, lean on my shoulder.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: あ、ありがと……。
english: Th-Thanks…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: フラフラやな……。
english: You're really unsteady on your feet…

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: へ、平気やから。
english: I-I'm fine.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
……わかった。
無理そうやったら、すぐ言うんやで。
english: …Alright. If it's too much, tell me right away.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ……うん。
english: …Yeah.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
あの……猟師さん、でええんかな？
助けてくれて、ありがとう……。
english: Um… Mr. Hunter, was it? Thank you for saving us…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
根津や。
礼なんぞ後でええ。
今は自分の体だけ心配しとれ。
english: It's Nezu. Save your thanks for later. For now, just focus on your own body.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ……はい。
english: …Okay.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （竜之介さん……）
english: (Ryunosuke-san...)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
――ちゅうことは、
坊主はさっきの化物にやられたんやのうて、
別のヤツにやられたんか。
english: —So that means the boy wasn't attacked by the monster from just now, but by something else?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: その、赤い着物を着たヤツによォ。
english: By that one wearing the red kimono.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: そうです。
english: That's right.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （赤い着物の化物か……）
english: (A monster in a red kimono…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生はまだ竜之介さんのことで
　混乱してるだろうし）
english: (Nagumo-sensei is probably still confused about Ryunosuke's situation, so…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それ以上のことは、
　まだ何も言えないだろうな）
english: (She probably can't say anything more than that right now.)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: はぁ……はぁ……。
english: *Pant… pant…*

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 竜之介さん……かなり苦しそうや。
english: Ryunosuke-san… looks like he's in a lot of pain.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……血を流しすぎたんだ。
english: …He's lost too much blood.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: お姉ちゃん……。
english: Onee-chan…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: なんなん、竜之介？
english: What is it, Ryunosuke?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 僕……もう少し、ここで休んでくわ。
english: I'm… gonna rest here a little longer.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: お姉ちゃんらは……先行っといてや。
english: You guys… go on ahead.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: なにアホなこと言い出すん！？
english: What kind of stupid thing are you saying?!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: でも……。
english: But…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
ほれ……立ちよら。
儂が背負うちゃる。
english: Here… stand up. I'll carry you on my back.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
い、いえ……
ほんまに、もういいですから――
english: N-No… I'm really fine, so—

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: うぐぁッ！！！！
english: Ugaah!!!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
そない激しく痛みよるんか。
ちょっと体見せてみよら。
english: Is it hurting that badly? Let me take a look at your body.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: ……この手当は？
english: …Who did this first aid?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 私がやりました。
english: I did.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
止血すんには緩い。
やり直すで。
english: It's too loose to stop the bleeding. I'm redoing it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……お願いします。
english: …Please do.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
またおかしなモンに見つからんよう
辺りを警戒しとってくれ。
english: Keep an eye on the surroundings so we don't get spotted by any more weird things.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
わかりました。
竜之介を頼みます。
english: Understood. Please take care of Ryunosuke.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ぐッ……うぁッ……！
english: Guh… Aagh…!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
我慢せえ。
痛むやろうがきつう締めやんと
止血にならん。
english: Endure it. I know it hurts, but it won't stop the bleeding unless I tie it tight.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 竜之介さん、大丈夫やろか。
english: I wonder if Ryunosuke-san will be okay.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 正直……なんともいえん。
english: Honestly… it's hard to say.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生、さっきからずっと
　何か考え込んでるけど――）
english: (Nagumo-sensei has been deep in thought about something for a while now, but—)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 藁、まだ近くにおる？
english: Straw, are you still nearby?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレたちのことか？）
english: (Is she talking to us?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
まあ、どっちでもええ。
今から色々と整理するから、
おるんなら聞いとって。
english: Well, either is fine. I'm going to sort through some things now, so if you're there, listen.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
私は竜之介を安全かつ迅速に
町まで連れていってやりたい。
english: I want to get Ryunosuke to town safely and as quickly as possible.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: でも……何をどうしたら――
english: But… what should I do—

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: なあ、どないしたらええ！？
english: Hey, what should I do?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
何でもええ！
弟のためになることやったら、
どんなことでも教えてほしい！
english: Anything is fine! If it's something that will help my brother, please tell me!

japanese: 「わかりません」
english: "I don't know."

japanese: 「できる限りサポートします」
english: "I'll support you as much as I can."

japanese: 「とにかく急いでください」
english: "Please just hurry."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それは……オレにも……
わかりません。
english: That… I don't know… either.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
わからんのは……
竜之介の今後の容態も含めてか？
english: You don't know… including Ryunosuke's future condition?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
できる限りサポートします。
今オレに言えるのは、それだけです。
english: I'll support you as much as I can. That's all I can say right now.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: あくまでも……『できる限り』なん？
english: Only… 'as much as you can'?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今は……とにかく急いでください。
english: Right now… please just hurry.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
町まで……病院まで逃げ切れば、
連中はもう追ってこないと思います。
english: If you escape to the town… to the hospital, I don't think they'll chase you anymore.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
もし無事病院まで逃げ切れたとして……。
竜之介は助かるん？
english: Assuming we make it safely to the hospital… will Ryunosuke be saved?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いえ……そこまでは――
english: No… I don't know that much—

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: わからん、か。
english: You don't know, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え、ええ……。
english: Y-Yeah…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: そうか……。
english: I see…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ありがとう。
今ので少しわかった気ィする。
english: Thank you. I feel like I understand a bit better now.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
キミ……いや、キミらには、
答えられる情報とそうでない情報が
ありそうやな。
english: You… no, you guys seem to have information you can give answers to, and information you can't.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
キミら二人組やろ？
聞こえてくる声は大半が男の声やけど、
時折女の声もまじってる。
english: There's two of you, right? Most of the voices I hear are male, but occasionally there's a female voice mixed in.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
キミらは常に私らのそばにおるけど、
どういうわけか姿は見えやん。
english: You're always by our side, but for some reason, we can't see you.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
でも、私らのことはちゃんと見とって、
声で情報を届けてくれるんやろ？
english: But you're watching us properly, and delivering information to us through your voices, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: は……はい、そうです。
english: Y-Yes, that's right.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そのことに気づいたきっかけは、
ハイネのことや。
english: What made me realize that was Haine.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
竜之介も私も、キミらの警告を受け、
結果的に逃げることができた。
english: Both Ryunosuke and I received your warnings, and as a result, we were able to escape.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ハイネがあんな風になるて……
私ですら予想できやんかったのに。
english: Even I couldn't have predicted… that Haine would turn out like that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生……。
english: Nagumo-sensei…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
それにキミらは私と竜之介のことも……
いや、それだけやない。
english: And you guys know about me and Ryunosuke… no, not just that.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
根津という猟師のことも、
知らなかったわけではないみたいや。
english: It seems you weren't completely unaware of the hunter named Nezu, either.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
しかしキミらは神じゃない。
知ってて教えられることもあれば、
そうじゃないこともある。
english: But you're not gods. There are things you know and can tell us, and things you can't.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: キミらは……タイムトラベラーか？
english: Are you guys… time travelers?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そう考えると、私らに「殺される」と
警告してきた意図、タイミングにも
納得がいくんよ。
english: If I think about it like that, the intention and timing of your warning that we would be "killed" makes perfect sense.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
……まず、竜之介が殺される未来がある。
キミらはそこから来た。
そうとちゃう？
english: …First, there's a future where Ryunosuke is killed. You came from there. Isn't that right?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そしてキミらは、
そんな未来を回避させるべく「声だけ」で
過去に干渉し――
english: And you guys interfered with the past using "only your voices" to avoid that future—

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 果たして私らは、あの局面を生き延びた。
english: And sure enough, we survived that situation.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
でも、こっから先は過去にはありえんかった
世界の出来事や。
english: But from here on out, these are events that couldn't have existed in the past.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
この先はキミらにも予想できやんやろうし、
声だけでサポートすることにも限界を
感じ始めてるんと違う？
english: You probably can't predict what will happen from here, and you're starting to feel the limits of supporting us with just your voices, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……その通りです。
english: …That's exactly right.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
すごいな……この頃から
今のひづるさんにそっくりや。
english: Wow… even back then, she was exactly like the current Hizuru-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、さすがの<color=#GF_TIPS_105>推理力</color>だ。
english: Yeah, her <color=#GF_TIPS_105>deductive reasoning</color> is as sharp as ever.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
あの場で弟が殺されずにすんだことは
感謝してる。
ありがとう……。
english: I'm grateful that my brother didn't die back there. Thank you…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生……。
english: Nagumo-sensei…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
けど、過去への干渉が未来へ
どんな影響を与えるかは誰にもわからん。
良いこともあれば――
english: But no one knows what kind of impact interfering with the past will have on the future. While there might be good things—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh…?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: おい、止血終わったぞ。
english: Hey, I'm done stopping the bleeding.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: はぁ……はぁ……。
english: *Pant… pant…*

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ありがとうございます。
でも、この竜之介の様子は……。
english: Thank you. But Ryunosuke's condition is…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 竜之介さん！？
english: Ryunosuke-san?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（かなり衰弱してる！
　ここから病院まで……間に合うのか！？）
english: (He's severely weakened! From here to the hospital… will we make it in time?!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 竜之介……。
english: Ryunosuke…

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: お姉ちゃん……僕な……。
english: Onee-chan… I…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 無理にしゃべらんでええ。
english: You don't have to force yourself to talk.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
お姉ちゃんに……
謝りたいこと、あんねん。
english: There's something… I want to apologize to you for, Onee-chan.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: なんやの……こんな時に。
english: What is it… at a time like this.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: こんな時やから……や。
english: It's because… it's a time like this.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
友達ができたって聞いた時……
からかって……ごめん。
english: When I heard you made a friend… I made fun of you… I'm sorry.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
あと……小説のノート……
勝手に見てしもて……ごめん。
english: Also… I looked at your novel notebook… without permission… I'm sorry.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: おまえ……なんで今そんなこと……。
english: You… why are you bringing that up now…

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
あとは……先週……
勝手に辞書借りてって、ごめん。
english: And… last week… I borrowed your dictionary without asking… I'm sorry.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: あと……。
english: Also…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
もうええ。
もうええから……。
english: That's enough. That's enough, so…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: そんなに元気なら先を急ぐで。
english: If you've got that much energy, we're hurrying on.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
ちょっと待って……。
まだ一番大事なこと……言えてやん。
english: Wait a second… I still haven't said… the most important thing.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 一番大事なこと？
english: The most important thing?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
お姉ちゃん……
誕生日……おめでとう。
english: Onee-chan… Happy birthday…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
english: Ah…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そうやったな。
ありがとう。
でも、そういうことやったら……
english: That's right. Thank you. But if that's the case…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 誕生日おめでとう、竜之介。
english: Happy birthday, Ryunosuke.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: うん……ありがとう。
english: Yeah… thank you.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: これであいこやな。
english: Now we're even.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ふふ、そうや……な……。
english: Hehe, I guess… we are…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: りゅ、竜之介……？
english: Ryu… Ryunosuke…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 竜之介ッ！！！
english: Ryunosuke!!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
気ィ失ってしもてるだけや。
でも、このままやと……。
english: He's just lost consciousness. But if he stays like this…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
嫌や……。
そんなん絶対嫌や。
english: No… I absolutely don't want that.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
そんなら、やれることをやるだけや。
この坊主は儂が背負ちゃる。
病院まで急ぐで。
english: Then we just have to do what we can. I'll carry the boy. We're hurrying to the hospital.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: はい……！
english: Yes…!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
誕生日を……
弟の命日になんかさせへん。
english: I won't let… our birthday become my brother's death anniversary.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生……。
english: Nagumo-sensei…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生はまだ諦めてない。
もちろんオレだって！
english: Nagumo-sensei hasn't given up yet. And of course, neither have I!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん、私もや！
english: Yeah, me neither!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ウシオ、先回りして病院までのルートに
危険がないか確認するぞ！
english: Ushio, let's go ahead and check if the route to the hospital is safe!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん！
english: Yeah!

japanese: 5.食餌
english: 5. Feeding

japanese: 7月7日

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうだ……？
english: How is it…?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うーん……。
english: Hmm…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うん、問題あらへん。
このまま進んでも大丈夫そう。
english: Yeah, no problems. It looks like it'll be fine to keep going this way.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: よし、じゃあ先生たちもこっちへ。
english: Alright, then let's get Nagumo-sensei and the others over here.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
おい、藁。
進んでもええんか？
english: Hey, Straw. Is it okay to keep going?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やっぱり全ての言葉を伝えることは
　難しいな……）
english: (I guess it really is hard to convey everything we say…)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ――待って！！
english: —Wait!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なにかがえらいスピードで、
こっちへ迫ってきとる！
english: Something's coming at us really fast!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: まさか……この気配って！？
english: Could it be… this presence is...?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハ、ハイネか！？
english: H-Haine?!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うん……！
さっきまでなんも気配なかったのに、
あっちゅう間に追いついてきよった！
english: Yeah…! There was no presence at all until just a second ago, but she caught up in a flash!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
でも、まだこっちの正確な位置までは
把握できてやんみたい。
english: But it seems she hasn't figured out our exact position yet.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうか……！
なんとかやり過ごしたいな……。
english: I see…! I hope we can somehow let her pass by…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生、注意してください！
後ろからハイネが迫ってきてます！
english: Nagumo-sensei, be careful! Haine is approaching from behind!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ハイネ？
ハイネがどうかしたんか？
english: Haine? What about Haine?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ですからっ！
後ろからハイネが迫ってきてます！
english: That's what I'm saying! Haine is approaching from behind!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: うしろ……後方か？
english: Behind… from the rear?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ハイネ、後ろ……。
ハイネが後方から来てるんか……。
english: Haine, behind… Haine is coming from behind us…?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
誰と話しちゃあるんじゃ。
また例の藁か？
english: Who are you talking to? Is it that 'straw' again?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
藁が言うには、あの子が……
ハイネが迫ってきてるって……。
english: Straw says that girl… Haine is approaching…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: ハイネ……誰や、そら？
english: Haine… who's that?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
赤い着物を着た……。
僕の足をこんな風にしたヤツです。
english: A girl in a red kimono… She's the one who did this to my legs.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
赤い着物？
なんやおまえ、これ人間にやられたんか？
english: A red kimono? What, were you attacked by a human?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: はい……。
english: Yes…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
にわかには信じれやんぞ……。
坊主の傷を見たが、人間程度にやられてできる
傷跡やないやしょ。
english: That's hard to believe… I saw the boy's wounds, and those aren't the kind of marks a human could make.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: はい……。
english: I know…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
どう考えても野犬の類に
食い千切られたようにしか見えやんかった。
english: No matter how you look at it, it just looks like he was torn apart by some kind of wild dog.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: でも……事実なんです……。
english: But… it's the truth…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
竜之介、もうええから黙っとき。
今は体力を少しでも温存せんと。
english: Ryunosuke, that's enough, so stay quiet. Right now you need to conserve whatever strength you have left.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: はぁはぁ……そうだね。
english: *Pant, pant*… You're right.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、ハイネが近い！
english: Shinpei, Haine is close!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生、ハイネがすぐ近くまで来ています！
隠れてください！
english: Nagumo-sensei, Haine is right nearby! Please hide!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: かくれて？　隠れろ言うんか？
english: Hide? Are you telling us to hide?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: なんじゃ、藁か？
english: What is it, Straw?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
おそらくハイネが近くにいます。
とりあえず一旦、隠れま――
english: Haine is probably nearby. For now, let's hid—

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
！？
ハイネが来る！
english: !? Haine's coming!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: は、速い……。
english: S-She's fast…

speaker: Heine
japanese: いた……ひづる……いた……。
english: Found you… Hizuru… found you…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
な、なんや今のスピードは……。
人間離れしとるどころのもんやないで。
english: Wh-What was that speed…? That's way beyond just being superhuman.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハ、ハイネ……。
english: H-Haine…

speaker: Heine
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……ひ、ひィづ……。
english: *Pant… pant…* H-Hizu…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: 背格好は子供やが――
english: Her build is that of a child, but—

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
あの人間離れした動きやったら、
坊主の足にあんだけの深手負わせたいうんも
納得出来る話や。
english: With those superhuman movements, it makes sense that she could inflict such deep wounds on the boy's legs.

speaker: Heine
japanese: ハァ、フゥ……ハ、フー……。
english: *Pant, wheeze… pant, wheeze…*

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……ハイネ。
english: …Haine.

speaker: Heine
japanese: フゥ……フゥ……。
english: *Wheeze… wheeze…*

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: なんで……竜之介を襲ったんや。
english: Why… did you attack Ryunosuke?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ちゃ……ちゃう……。
あれは……わしじゃ……。
english: N-No… That wasn't… me…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
でも私は見たんや……。
ハイネが竜之介を襲ってたとこ。
english: But I saw it… You attacking Ryunosuke.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
なんで……？
なんでなん！？
english: Why…? Why?!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
わか、らん……。
わか……らん……のじゃ。
english: I don't… know… I don't… know…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 何か……様子おかしない？
english: Doesn't she… seem a bit strange?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: Y-Yeah…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
なんでわからんの？
理由もなしに、竜之介を襲ったんか？
english: What do you mean you don't know? Did you attack Ryunosuke for no reason?

speaker: Heine
japanese: ちゃ、ちゃう……！！
english: N-No…!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
さがれ！
それ以上近づくんやない！
english: Get back! Don't come any closer!

speaker: Heine
japanese: 邪魔じゃ！！
english: You're in the way!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: ぬおッ！？
english: Nuo?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 根津さん！！
english: Nezu-san!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 根津さん、肩から血ィ出とる！
english: Nezu-san's shoulder is bleeding!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: はぁはぁ……大丈夫……ですか？
english: *Pant, pant*… Are you… okay?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: ああ、これくらい……どないもない。
english: Yeah, this is… nothing.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
坊主……危険が迫ったら坊主を背負って、
一気に病院へ向かうで。
english: Boy… If danger approaches, I'll carry you on my back and we'll head straight for the hospital.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: は、はい……。
english: Y-Yes…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（竜之介さんがこんな状態である以上……
　今ハイネを下手に刺激したらダメだ）
english: (With Ryunosuke in this condition… we can't afford to carelessly provoke Haine right now.)

speaker: Heine
japanese: ハァ、ハァ……！
english: *Pant, pant*…!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハイネ……。
english: Haine…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（フカンしろ！
　このままじゃ竜之介さんだけじゃなく
　先生や根津さんまで危ない）
english: (Take a bird's-eye view! At this rate, not just Ryunosuke, but Nagumo-sensei and Nezu-san will be in danger too.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でもこの距離じゃ、
　逃げてもすぐ追いつかれてしまう）
english: (But at this distance, even if they run, she'll catch up to them immediately.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
どうにかしてハイネの動きを
止めることができればいいけど……。
english: If we could just find some way to stop Haine's movements…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: また私が攻撃してみよか？
english: Should I try attacking again?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや……それはやめとこう。
下手に刺激するだけかもしれないし。
english: No… let's not. We might just end up provoking her.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうだ！
先生に声が届くのならハイネにも
届くかもしれない！
english: That's it! If Nagumo-sensei can hear us, maybe Haine can too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんとか声で時間を稼ぐんや！
english: We have to somehow buy time with our voices!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
それしかなさそうやな。
うん、やってみよ！
english: Looks like that's our only option. Yeah, let's try it!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ひ……づる……うぐッ……！
english: Hi… zuru… Ugh…!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ガァァァァァッ！！！
english: Gaaaaaah!!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
何ぼさっとしとる！
そいつから離れんかい！
english: What are you standing around for?! Get away from that thing!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
english: Ah…?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生を食おうとした！？
english: She tried to eat Nagumo-sensei?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハイネ！
ほんまにそれでええんかッ！？
english: Haine! Are you really okay with this?!

speaker: Heine
japanese: 誰かおるんか……。
english: Is someone there…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
この場で飢えを満たすんが、
ほんまにおまえの望むことなんか！？
english: Is satisfying your hunger right here really what you want?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ひづるさんは友達なんやろ！
english: Hizuru-san is your friend, right?!

speaker: Heine
japanese: とも……だち……。
english: Frien… d…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
届いてる……！
オレらの声がハイネに届いてるぞ！
english: It's reaching her…! Our voices are reaching Haine!

speaker: Heine
japanese: でも……は、腹が減ってもたら……。
english: But… when I… get hungry…

speaker: Heine
japanese: わしは……自分が……！
english: I… myself…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
アアアアッ、わからん！
もう、なんもかんもわからん！！
english: Aaaaah, I don't know! I don't know anything anymore!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: でも腹が減るんは……！
english: But being hungry is…!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ひだるいんはもう嫌なんじゃァァァッ！！
english: I hate being hungry!! Aaaaaah!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もうこれ以上は無理だ！
ひづるさん、早く逃げて！
english: This is impossible! Hizuru-san, hurry up and run!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: お姉ちゃん！！
english: Onee-chan!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: え……竜之介？
english: Eh… Ryunosuke?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 間に、合った……。
english: I made it… in time…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: お、おまえ……！
english: Y-You…!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: おまえ、何しとるん！？
english: What are you doing?!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 食べて……ええよ。
english: You can… eat me.

speaker: Heine
japanese: アカン……もう……アカン！
english: I can't… anymore… I can't!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ガァァァッ！！
english: Gaaaaah!!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: う、あぁぁぁッ！！
english: U-Aaaaah!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 竜之介ェェェッ！！
english: Ryunosukeeee!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: なんで……なんでなんッ！？
english: Why… why?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
誕生日やのに……
なんでこんなことに……！
english: It's our birthday… Why did this have to happen…!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 僕は……ええんよ……。
english: I'm… fine…

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
もう……無理やった。
だからこうして……うッ！
english: I couldn't… go on anyway. That's why… Ugh!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 竜之介っ！
english: Ryunosuke!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ブハッ……逃げて、お姉ちゃん……。
english: *Cough*… Run, Onee-chan…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: そんなことできるわけないやろ！
english: There's no way I can do that!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
儂も同意見や。
こんな小娘、
抑えつけるくらいワケないで。
english: I agree. It'll be a piece of cake to hold down a little girl like this.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
見ましたよね、この子の動きを？
普通じゃないんです……！
english: You saw how she moves, right? She's not normal…!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
確かに……。
さっき戦った影と同じいう
可能性もあるか。
english: True… There's a possibility she's the same as the shadow we fought earlier.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
根津さん……お願いします。
お姉ちゃんにまでなんかあったら……。
english: Nezu-san… Please. If something happens to my sister too…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
なに言うてるん！
竜之介を置いてけるワケないやろ！
english: What are you saying! There's no way I can leave you behind, Ryunosuke!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 根津さんっ！
english: Nezu-san!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
わかった。
あとは任せとけ。
english: Understood. Leave the rest to me.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……えっ？
english: …Huh?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
下ろして！
下ろしてやァッ！！
english: Put me down! Put me down!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
大人しくせえ！
全員やられて、
坊主の気持ち台無しにしたいんか！？
english: Be quiet! Do you want us all to get killed and ruin the boy's sacrifice?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
竜之介ッ！
竜之介ェェェッ！
english: Ryunosuke! Ryunosukeeee!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
バイバイ……。
お姉……ちゃ……ん……。
english: Bye-bye… Onee-chan…

speaker: Heine
japanese: うぐ……むぐ……！
english: Ugu… Mugu…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さん……。
english: Ryunosuke-san…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: こんなん、ひどすぎるわ……。
english: This is just… too cruel…

speaker: Heine
japanese: ふぐッ、うぐゥゥ……。
english: Fugu… Uguu…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 泣きながら……食べてる？
english: She's crying… while she eats?

speaker: Heine
japanese: や……やってもた……。
english: I… I did it…

speaker: Heine
japanese: ひ、ひづるの、弟……。
english: H-Hizuru's… brother…

speaker: Heine
japanese: ううッ……！
english: Uuuh…!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ウァァァァァッ！！！
english: Waaaaaaah!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんで……なんで、こうなるんや……。
english: Why… why did it turn out like this…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
結局オレは無力なんか。
なんも変えられやんのか……。
english: Am I just powerless in the end? Can I not change anything…?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
こら、慎平！
泣いてる場合やないやろ！
english: Hey, Shinpei! This is no time to be crying!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ウシオ……。
english: Ushio…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私らが無力やなんてこと絶対あらへん！
弱気になったら、なんもかも終わってまうで！
english: There's no way we're powerless! If you lose your nerve, it's all over!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうやな……おまえの言う通りや。
english: Yeah… you're right.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: まだ記憶は終わってない。
english: The memory isn't over yet.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレらが見なアカンこと、
確認せなアカンことが、
まだ残ってるかもしれやん。
english: There might still be things we need to see, things we need to confirm.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん、先生と根津さんのあと追おら。
english: Yeah, let's go after Nagumo-sensei and Nezu-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
竜之介さんがくれたこの時間で、
ひづるさんと根津さんの行く末を
ちゃんと見届けないとな。
english: With the time Ryunosuke-san bought us, I need to properly see things through for Hizuru-san and Nezu-san.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: せやな……行こ、慎平。
english: Yeah… Let's go, Shinpei.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……。
english: Yeah…

japanese: 6.私はすべてを受け入れる
english: 6. I Will Accept Everything

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あっ、おったで！
ひづるさんと根津さん！
english: Ah, there they are! Hizuru-san and Nezu-san!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ。
もう少しで町に出られそうだな。
english: Yeah. It looks like they'll make it out to the town soon.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
はぁ、はぁ……。
こない走ったんは久しぶりやしょ。
english: *Pant, pant*… It's been a while since I ran like this.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: しかも、こないな娘担いでよォ。
english: Especially while carrying a girl like this.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
大変やったかもしれんけど……
礼は言えやん。
english: It might have been tough… but I'm not going to thank you.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
礼やら別にいらん。
儂は坊主の心意気を無駄にしたなかった
だけやしよォ。
english: I don't need your thanks. I just didn't want the boy's resolve to go to waste, that's all.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: 納得できとらんようやな。
english: You don't seem convinced.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……私は、どうしたらええ？
english: …What should I do?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
決まっちゃある、
麓はもうすぐや。
このまま町まで降りたらええ。
english: It's obvious. The foot of the mountain is just ahead. Just keep heading down to the town.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ほんまに……それでええと思てる？
english: Do you really… think that's okay?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: 何が言いたいねや。
english: What are you trying to say?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
こんな結末しかないん？
もっと、なんとかできやんかったん？
english: Is this the only possible ending? Couldn't we have done something more?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 竜之介が犠牲になる必要あったん？
english: Did Ryunosuke have to be sacrificed?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
私にもっと力があったら、
事態を打開できる知識があったら、
竜之介を助けられたかもしれやん。
english: If I had more power, if I had the knowledge to overcome this situation, maybe I could have saved Ryunosuke.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
それに……
ハイネのことかて……。
english: And… Haine too…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生……。
english: Nagumo-sensei…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そんなこと言うたら……
私らかて……。
english: If you say that… then we…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （過去は変えられないものなのだろうか……）
english: (Can the past really not be changed…?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレたちは結末を知っていた。
　それなのに竜之介さんを助けることは……）
english: (We knew the ending. And yet we still couldn't save Ryunosuke-san…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（むしろ、中途半端に干渉したことで、
　余計に先生を苦しめてしまったのかも）
english: (If anything, maybe our half-baked interference only made Nagumo-sensei suffer more.)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: あんなァ――
english: Look—

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
少し黙ってて……。
考えをまとめてるとこや。
english: Just be quiet for a bit… I'm trying to gather my thoughts.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: ふん。勝手にせェ。
english: Hmph. Suit yourself.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
……藁。
いるんやろ？
english: …Straw. You're there, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ええ……ここに。
english: Yes… I'm here.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
キミがホンマにタイムトラベラーなら、
私を導いてくれへん？
english: If you're really a time traveler, won't you guide me?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 最善の未来に。
english: To the best possible future.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ホンマに私は……このまま町へ戻ってええんか？
竜之介とハイネを置き去りにしたまま。
english: Is it really okay for me… to just go back to town like this? Leaving Ryunosuke and Haine behind.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
それが竜之介の望みなんは、
わかってる……。
english: I know that's what Ryunosuke wanted…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
でも、この結末はキミらの知ってた結末か？
こんな形で終わりにしてええんか？
english: But is this the ending you guys knew? Is it okay to end it like this?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
もっと悪い未来を引き寄せることになったり
せんやろか？
english: Couldn't this end up bringing about an even worse future?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ひづるさん……。
english: Hizuru-san…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
まだ耳に残ってるんよ。
竜之介の最期の言葉、
それに……ハイネの苦痛の声が。
english: They're still echoing in my ears. Ryunosuke's last words, and… Haine's cries of pain.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
竜之介の思いは無駄にしたない。
でも、少しでもいい未来にできる可能性が
あるんやったら……
english: I don't want Ryunosuke's feelings to go to waste. But if there's even a slight chance of making a better future…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
私はもう迷わへん。
なあ藁、私はどうすればええ？
english: I won't hesitate anymore. Tell me, Straw, what should I do?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平……どないする？
english: Shinpei… what do we do?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （簡単に答えられる質問じゃない）
english: (It's not a question I can easily answer.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生にとっての最善の未来……
　それっていったいどんな未来なんだ？）
english: (The best possible future for Nagumo-sensei… What kind of future is that, exactly?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（竜之介さんが助かることはもうないだろう。
　そしてこの出来事をきっかけに、
　先生と根津さんは影と関わって……）
english: (Ryunosuke-san can't be saved anymore. And because of this incident, Nagumo-sensei and Nezu-san will get involved with the shadows…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （１４年後、この島で再び影と戦うことになる）
english: (And 14 years later, they'll end up fighting the shadows again on this island.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ここでハイネを倒せば……
そんな未来を回避できるのかも。
english: If we defeat Haine here… maybe we can avoid that future.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ちょ……慎平。
今、ハイネを倒す言うた？
english: Wait… Shinpei. Did you just say defeat Haine?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、理由はよくわからないけど……
ハイネは竜之介さんを襲ったことを悔やんで、
混乱しているようにも見える。
english: Yeah, I don't know the exact reason, but… Haine seems to be regretting attacking Ryunosuke-san, and looks confused.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんにせよ、ハイネを倒すのなら、
ハイネが混乱している今がチャンスだ。
english: Either way, if we're going to defeat Haine, now is our chance while she's confused.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そうかもしれんけど……
私らじゃハイネは倒せやん。
english: That might be true, but… we can't defeat Haine.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
結局ひづるさんと根津さんを、
またハイネのとこへ向かわせることに
なってまうかもしれんのやで？
english: In the end, we might just end up sending Hizuru-san and Nezu-san right back to Haine, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そんなんわかってる。
それに、そんなことしたらオレたちの未来が、
どうなってしまうのかもわからん。
english: I know that. Besides, if we do that, there's no telling what will happen to our own future.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だから、慎重に考えんと……。
english: That's why we need to think carefully…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 藁、まだ結論が出せやんのか。
english: Straw, have you still not reached a conclusion?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え、ええ……。
english: Y-Yeah…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
約束する。
キミの導きで動いた結果がどうなっても、
私はすべて受け入れる。
english: I promise. No matter what happens as a result of following your guidance, I will accept everything.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
だから頼む。
私を導いてほしい。
english: So please. I want you to guide me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生……そこまでオレたちのことを
　信頼してくれてるのか）
english: (Nagumo-sensei… do you really trust us that much?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どこからともなく現れて、
　口出ししかできないオレたちを……）
english: (Us, who just appeared out of nowhere and can only offer words…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こんなオレの判断を心から必要と
　してくれるほどに）
english: (To the point where you genuinely need my judgment this much…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （だったらオレは――）
english: (If that's the case, then I'll—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 南雲先生……。
english: Nagumo-sensei…

japanese: 「生き延びることを考えてください」
english: "Please focus on surviving."

japanese: 「ハイネを倒しましょう」
english: "Let's defeat Haine."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今は生き延びることを考えてください。
犠牲になった竜之介さんのためにも。
english: Right now, please focus on surviving. For the sake of Ryunosuke-san, who sacrificed himself.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それがきっと、
最善の未来に向かう選択です。
english: I'm sure that's the choice that will lead to the best possible future.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: そうか……。
english: I see…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（たとえ今がハイネを倒す
　絶好の機会だとしても）
english: (Even if right now is the perfect opportunity to defeat Haine…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハイネを確実に倒せるプランがない）
english: (We don't have a plan to defeat her for sure.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なにより、先生をこれ以上
　危険な目に遭わせるわけにはいかない）
english: (More than anything, I can't put Nagumo-sensei in any more danger.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハイネを倒しましょう。
english: Let's defeat Haine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今のハイネはもう先生の友達だった
ハイネではありません。
english: The Haine right now is no longer the Haine who was your friend, Nagumo-sensei.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それに……オレたちの知る未来では、
ハイネによってこの島全体が
悲劇に包まれることになるんです。
english: Besides… in the future we know, Haine will bring tragedy to this entire island.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ですから――
english: Therefore—

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
今のうちにその原因を絶て……
そういうことか。
english: Cut off the cause while we still can… Is that what you mean?

japanese: 8.ハイネの右目
english: 8. Haine's Right Eye

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
竜之介の思いを無駄にせず、
悲しみを乗り越えて未来へ。
english: Don't let Ryunosuke's feelings go to waste, overcome your sorrow, and head towards the future.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: それが最善の未来なんか。
english: So that's the best possible future.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 少なくともオレはそう思います。
english: At the very least, that's what I think.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 普通やな。
english: How ordinary.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ？　ふ、普通って……？
english: Huh? O-Ordinary…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
キミの答えはわかった。
もう聞きたいことはあらへん。
english: I understand your answer. I have nothing else to ask.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: もう話はすんだんか？
english: Are you done talking?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
待たせてしもたな。
ほな行こか。
english: Sorry to keep you waiting. Let's get going.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: お、おう……。
english: O-Oh…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （「普通」って言葉が気になるけど……）
english: (The word "ordinary" is bothering me, but…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生はさっきの回答で、
　納得してくれてるんだろうか？）
english: (I wonder if Nagumo-sensei is really satisfied with my answer just now?)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
町に出たら皆に化物のこと
しらせんとな。
あとは駐在所にも連絡入れとくか。
english: Once we get to town, we need to let everyone know about the monsters. Then I'll contact the police box too.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
あの化物のこと考えたら、
山に入る人数は多いほうがええやしょ。
english: Considering those monsters, it's probably better to have more people go into the mountains.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
本土から猟友会呼んで……
いや、警察のがええか？
english: Call the hunting club from the mainland… No, maybe the police would be better?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: おい、聞いとんのんか？
english: Hey, are you listening?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ああ、あの化物が今まで
目撃されとらんことを考えると、ヤツらは人目を
避ける傾向にあるんかもしれん。
english: Yeah, considering those monsters haven't been spotted until now, they might have a tendency to avoid people.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
あ、ああ。
そうかもしれんな……。
english: Y-Yeah. That might be true…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ひづるさん……、
何か変やない？
english: Hizuru-san… isn't something strange?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……さっきまでとは、
なんとなく違ってるような――
english: Yeah… she somehow feels different from before—

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 藁、すまないな。
english: Straw, I'm sorry.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ？　な、なにが……？
english: Huh? A-About what…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
やっぱり私は……
自分の手で未来を切り拓きたい。
english: I think I really… want to carve out my own future with my own hands.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: たとえ後悔するかもしれなくとも。
english: Even if I might end up regretting it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生……。
english: Nagumo-sensei…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: これ、借してもらうで。
english: I'll be borrowing this.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
なァ！？
また人のナイフを勝手に抜きよって！
そんなもん持って、どうするつもりじゃ！
english: What?! You pulled out someone else's knife again! What do you plan to do with that?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: やっぱり私は戻らなアカン。
english: I really have to go back.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
あなたは予定通り病院へ行けばいい。
ハイネにやられた傷……
かなり痛むんやろ？
english: You should go to the hospital as planned. The wound from Haine… it must be hurting a lot, right?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
アホか！
なんで儂一人だけ――
english: Are you an idiot?! Why would I be the only one—

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: 待てッ！　行ったらアカン！
english: Wait! You can't go!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: 戻って……ぐッ！？
english: Come back… Guh!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
根津さん、肩の怪我、
そんなにひどかったんか……。
english: Nezu-san, was your shoulder injury really that bad…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
根津さんのことも心配やけど、
今は先生や！
english: I'm worried about Nezu-san too, but right now we have to focus on Nagumo-sensei!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 追いかけるぞ、ウシオ！
english: We're going after her, Ushio!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: う、うん！
english: Y-Yeah!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……こっちや。
english: …This way.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ひづるさん、まるでハイネの気配が
わかるみたいや……！
english: Hizuru-san, it's like she can sense Haine's presence…!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: まっすぐハイネんとこへ向かってる！
english: She's heading straight for Haine!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生、危険です！
戻ってください！
english: Nagumo-sensei, it's dangerous! Please come back!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生……根津さんのナイフは、
　服の中にでも隠してるのか？）
english: (Nagumo-sensei… is she hiding Nezu-san's knife in her clothes?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もし先生があのナイフでハイネを
　狙っているのだとしたら……）
english: (If Nagumo-sensei is planning to use that knife on Haine…)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ここや。
この先で竜之介がハイネに……。
english: Here. This is where Ryunosuke was… by Haine.

speaker: リュウノスケ（ハイネ）
english: Ah…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 竜之介……いや、違う。
english: Ryunosuke… no, wait.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 残念やけど本物の竜之介は、もう……。
english: Unfortunately, the real Ryunosuke is already…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: やっぱりハイネなんか。
english: So it is you, Haine.

speaker: Heine
japanese: あ……ああ……ひづる……。
english: Ah… ah… Hizuru…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そんなこともできたんやな……。
さっき蛇になって襲ってきた化物と一緒や。
english: So you could do that too… Just like the monster that turned into a snake and attacked us earlier.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ひづるさん！
それ以上ハイネに近づいたらアカン！
english: Hizuru-san! You can't get any closer to Haine!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 南雲先生！！
english: Nagumo-sensei!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
藁か……。
やっぱり追ってきてたんやな。
english: Straw, huh… So you did follow me.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
でも、黙って見ててほしい。
これはハイネと私の問題や。
english: But I want you to just watch quietly. This is a problem between Haine and me.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 今はハイネと二人で話をしたい。
english: Right now, I want to talk to Haine alone.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: せ、先生……。
english: M-Nagumo-sensei…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ハイネ……。
おまえは竜之介を殺した。
english: Haine… You killed Ryunosuke.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: そして……食ったんや。
english: And… you ate him.

speaker: Heine
japanese: ああ、う、あああああ……。
english: Ah, ugh, aaaaaah…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
えらい苦しそうやな。
竜之介をこんな無残な姿にした
張本人やのに……。
english: You look like you're in a lot of pain. Even though you're the one who put Ryunosuke in such a cruel state…

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ちゃ、ちゃう……！
ちゃうゥゥゥ！
english: N-No…! Noooo!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: なんで泣くん？
english: Why are you crying?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
わか……わからん……！
でも、わしは、こんな……！
english: I don't… I don't know…! But, I… like this…!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
もう、泣かんでや……。
落ち着いて話しよか。
english: Stop crying already… Let's calm down and talk.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
うう……わしじゃ……
わしじゃない……！
english: Uuuh… It was me… It wasn't me…!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ほな誰がやったんや？
english: Then who did it?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 一人しか、おらんやろ。
english: There's only one person it could be, right?

speaker: Heine
japanese: でも……でっ、でもっ！
english: But… b-but!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ハイネと違たらよかったのになぁ。
せやったら、どんなに……。
english: I wish it wasn't you, Haine. If it wasn't, then how much…

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ううっ、ひっく……！
ひ、ひづる……わしは……！
english: Uuuh, *hic*…! H-Hizuru… I…!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ハイネの本心はどうなん？
私の弟はただの食いもんにしか見えんかった？
それとも……
english: What are your true feelings, Haine? Did you only see my brother as food? Or…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 私の弟とも友達になりたかった？
english: Did you want to be friends with my brother?

speaker: Heine
japanese: ……とも……だち。
english: …friends.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 意地の悪い質問やったな……。
english: That was a cruel question.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
うぅ、なんで……
なんでこんなことにッ！？
english: Ugh... why... Why did this happen!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ハイネは大事な友達やった！
でも竜之介かて大事やった……。
english: Haine was a precious friend! But Ryunosuke was precious to me too...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 大事な弟やったんや！！
english: He was my precious little brother!!

speaker: Heine
english: H-Hizuru...

speaker: Heine
japanese: う、うう、ううううう……。
english: U-Ugh... uuuuuugh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんだ？
　ハイネの体が……）
english:
(What's going on?
Haine's body…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
様子がおかしい！
先生、離れて！
english: Something's wrong! Sensei, get away!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Heine
japanese: うあああああああッ！！！！
english: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハイネ！？
english: Haine!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: うッ……！
english: Ugh…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: い……今のは、一体？
english: W-what was that?!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ハイネから弾け飛んだ何かが……。
english: Something flew out of Haine!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ひづるさんの体ん中に入ってもた！
english: It went inside Hizuru-san's body!

speaker: Heine
english:
…it hurts…
It hurts… it hurts…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（何かが先生の体の中へ入ると同時に、
　別の何かが地面に……）
english: (At the same time something entered Sensei's body, something else fell to the ground...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あれは……）
english: (That's…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （目！？　ハイネの右目か！！）
english: (An eye!? Haine's right eye?!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あれ……も……もしかして……。
english: That… that's… maybe…

speaker: Heine
japanese: 痛いィィィィッ！！
english: It huuuuuurts!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ハァッ……ハァッ……。
english: *Pant*... *pant*...

speaker: Heine
japanese: ……おまえか？
english: ...Was it you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （睨まれた！？）
english: (She glared at me?!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （まさかオレが見えてるんかッ！？）
english: (Don't tell me… she can see me?!)

speaker: Heine
japanese:
おまえの……！
おまえのせいかァァァァッ！！
english: Your...! Is this your faaaaault?!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: じ、自分の右目、握り潰しよった！？
english: Sh-she crushed her own right eye!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ど、どうなってるんだ……？
english: W-what's going on here…?

speaker: Heine
japanese: い……痛い……痛い……。
english: I… it hurts… it hurts…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハイネが自分の影に沈んでく……）
english: (Haine is sinking into her own shadow...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハイネ……？
english: Haine…?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ハイネの気配は……
完全に消えてしもてる。
english:
Haine's presence…
Has completely disappeared.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの様子だと、
もう戻ってこないのでは？
english: From the looks of it, she might not be coming back.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
キミがそう言うなら、
そうなんやろな……。
english:
If you say so,
Then that's probably the case.

speaker: Stray Shadow B
japanese: スンスン、ア……ア。
english: Sniff… a… a.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: さっきいた化物の片割れ！？
english: The other half of that monster from earlier!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ごめん、慎平ッ！
ハイネの気配に紛れて気づかんかった！
english:
I'm sorry, Shinpei!
I didn't notice because it was hiding in Haine's presence!

speaker: Stray Shadow B
english: A… a… a!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: こっち来る！！
english: It's coming this way!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生、根津さんのナイフで
あいつの影を！
english: Sensei, use Nezu-san's knife to cut its shadow!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そうしたいのは、
やまやまやけど……。
english: I'd like to, but…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あっ……！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ナイフがあんなに遠くに！）
english: (The knife is so far away!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（さっきハイネを抱きしめた時に
　落としてしまったのか！？）
english: (It must have fallen when I hugged Haine earlier!)

speaker: Stray Shadow B
japanese: アアアアアアア！！
english: Aaaaaa!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 南雲先生、逃げて！！！！
english: Nagumo-sensei, run!!!

speaker: ??? (リュウノスケ)
japanese: オ……ネエ……チャン……。
english: O... nee... chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: What?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生が、消えた！？
english: Sensei disappeared?!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、上や！！
english: Shinpei, look up!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、あんなに高くまで！？
english: Ah, that high up?!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: なんちゅうジャンプ力や！
english: What a jump!

speaker: Stray Shadow B
japanese: ア？
english: Huh?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese:
お姉ちゃん……。
戻ってきて……もたんやな……。
english: Onee-chan... You came back, huh...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese: 逃げて……言うたのに……。
english: Even though I told you... to run...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……いる。ひづるさんの中に！
english: ...He's there. Inside Hizuru-san!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese:
たまには……
僕の言うことも……聞いてほしわ。
english: I wish you'd listen to me... once in a while.

speaker: Stray Shadow B
japanese: アアアアアアアッ！！
english: Aaaaaaah!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese: でも……お姉ちゃんらしいわ。
english: But... that's just like you, Onee-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あっさり、影を倒した。
english: He easily defeated the shadow.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
空を飛ぶような跳躍。
そしてナイフを拾い上げてから攻撃を
終えるまでのあの素早さ……
english: A jump that looked like flying. And the speed from picking up the knife until the attack was finished...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あれって……。
english: That…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 私と同じ……影の身体能力……！！
english: The same as me... A shadow's physical abilities...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
どういうことなんや！？
なんで急にあんな風に……！
english:
What's going on?!
Why all of a sudden…!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ハイネがはじけて……
竜之介さんのデータがひづるさんの中に入った！
english: Haine burst... and Ryunosuke-san's data entered Hizuru-san!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
じゃあ今……
先生を動かしているのは……
english: Then right now... the one moving Sensei is...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 影のリュウノスケ！？
english: Shadow Ryunosuke?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese: これで……もう大丈夫かな……。
english: With this... I guess it's safe now...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese: ごめん……お姉ちゃん……。
english: Sorry... Onee-chan...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese: 勝手に……体使てしもて……。
english: For using your body... without permission...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
english: --Hah?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……うっ！
english: *Pant*... *pant*... ugh!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生！？
english: Sensei?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
大声出さんで……。
少し疲れたから……寝転んだだけや。
english: Don't shout... I'm just a little tired... so I lay down.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だ、大丈夫ですか？
english: Are you okay?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
今、何が起きたんか……
キミらの見たままを教えてほしい。
english: What just happened right now... I want you to tell me exactly what you saw.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
えーっと、かいつまんで言うたら、
竜之介さんのデータがひづるさんの
中に入って……。
english: Umm, to put it simply, Ryunosuke-san's data entered Hizuru-san's body...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ものすごい身体能力で、
影……化物を倒してもたんです。
english: And with incredible physical abilities, he defeated the shadow... the monster.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: やっぱり……そうやったんか。
english: I knew it... so that's what happened.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
竜之介が私の中に入って、
化物を倒した……。
english: Ryunosuke entered me, and defeated the monster...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ふっ、まるでファンタジー小説や。
english: Heh, it's just like a fantasy novel.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
家族に起こった悲劇をきっかけに、
強大な力を得て未知の生物と戦う……。
さしずめ私の属性は狩人か。
english: Triggered by a tragedy that befell their family, they gain immense power and fight unknown creatures... I suppose my class would be a hunter.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
今はまだ冒頭シーンから、
ほんの数ページ進んだところや。
english: Right now, we're only a few pages past the opening scene.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 戦いはまだ……これからなんやろな。
english: The real battle... is yet to come.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ひづるさん、まるで影と戦う未来を
わかっとるみたい。
english: Hizuru-san, it's almost like you know you'll be fighting shadows in the future.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ああ。
english: ...Yeah.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
私が『始まり』を
生み出してしもたんかも……。
english: Maybe I'm the one who created the 'beginning'...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生……。
english: Sensei...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
「とにかく生き延びる」、
そんなキミの言葉に従っといたら、
良かったんかなァ。
english: Just survive.' Maybe it would have been better if I had just followed your words.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それは……なんとも……。
english: That's... hard to say...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: でも、助かった。
english: But, you saved me.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ありがとう。
ずっと……私の近くにいてくれて。
english: Thank you. For staying... close to me all this time.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: とても心強かった。
english: It was very reassuring.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生……。
english: Sensei...

japanese: 「やっぱり竜之介さんのことは残念」
english: It's really a pity about Ryunosuke.

japanese: 「その言葉に救われました」
english: I was saved by those words.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
やっぱり竜之介さんのことは
残念でなりません……。
english: It's really a pity about Ryunosuke-san...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ありがとうございます……。
その言葉に救われました。
english: Thank you… I was saved by those words.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……先生？
english: ...Sensei?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私らの声、全然届いてやんみたい。
さっきまで届いとったのに。
english: It seems our voices aren't reaching her at all. Even though they were just a moment ago.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もしかしたら、
この記憶が終わりに近づいてて、
干渉しづらくなってるんかも。
english: Maybe this memory is nearing its end, making it harder to interfere.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも……それやと、
前に過去を見た時とちょっと違うな。
english: But... if that's the case, it's a little different from when I saw the past before.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
前の時は「終わりや」思たら、
すぐ時間を戻ってたんやけど……。
english: Before, the moment I thought 'it's over', I immediately went back in time...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: これって、過去に干渉しすぎたせいなのか？
english: Is this because I interfered too much with the past?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: し、慎平……。
english: S-Shinpei…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうした、ウシオ？
english: What's wrong, Ushio?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: わ、私の体が……。
english: M-My body is...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: What!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんだ！？
　ウシオの体が消えてく！！）
english: (What!? Ushio's body is disappearing!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
もしかしたら、
あの時ハイ……が……右目……。
english: Maybe... that time Hai... ne... right eye...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おい……ウシオ？
english: Hey… Ushio?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 右目をつぶし……せい……も！
english: Crushing her right eye... might be... the cause...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ウシオッ！
ウシオォォォォッ！
english: Ushio! Ushioooooo!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……右目？
english: …Right eye?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （さっき、ハイネは自分の右目を潰していた）
english: (Just now, Haine crushed her own right eye.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そういえば……前に先生が言っていた……）
english: (Come to think of it... Sensei mentioned before...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレが時間をループできるのは、
　ハイネの右目をプリントされたからだと）
english: (That the reason I can loop time is because Haine's right eye was printed onto me.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （という、ことは……）
english: (That means…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレにはもう、
　時間をループする力がなくなっ――）
english: (I no longer have... the power to loop time--)

japanese: 7.時の狭間
english: 7. The Space Between Time

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ええ、少なくともオレは、
それが最善だと思っています……。
english:
Yeah, at least I think
that's the best option…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生はオレに判断を委ねるって
　言ってるけど……）
english: (Sensei says she'll leave the decision to me, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（たぶん本心では、
　「あの場所に戻って決着をつけたい」
　そう思っているはずだ）
english: (But deep down, she must be thinking, 'I want to go back to that place and settle this'.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だったら今のオレがやるべきことは、
　先生の背中を押してやること……）
english: (If so, then what I should do now is give Sensei the push she needs...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そしてその結末を――）
english: (And see this through to the end--)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
わかった。
キミがそう言ってくれるのなら、
私は迷わずそうしようと思う。
english:
I see.
If you say so, I'll do it without hesitation.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ただ、疑問がないわけでもない。
english: However, it's not like I don't have any questions.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
さっきキミが言っとった
『島全体を包む悲劇』というのは、
いったい――
english: That 'tragedy enveloping the whole island' you mentioned earlier... What exactly is--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
いや、やめとこ。
今はあの場所へ戻って決着つけることだけ
考えとくわ。
english: No, never mind. Right now, I'll just focus on going back to that place and settling things.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それがいいと思います。
でも正直、危険です。
english:
That's probably best.
But honestly, it's dangerous.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 相当の覚悟が必要だと思います。
english: It'll take a lot of resolve, I think.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（うまくいく可能性は……
　かなり低いだろう）
english:
(The chances of it working…
are pretty low.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 覚悟はもうできてる。
english: I've already made up my mind.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっき根津さんのナイフで影を刺して、
化物を倒しましたよね？
english: Earlier, you stabbed the shadow with Nezu-san's knife and defeated the monster, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
同じようにハイネの影に致命傷を
与えることができれば、
ハイネを倒すことができるはずです。
english: If you can deal a fatal wound to Haine's shadow in the same way, you should be able to defeat Haine.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
english: The shadow…

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ひづる。
影も……。
english:
Hizuru.
The shadow too…

speaker: Heine
japanese: わ……わしの影も……撫でてくれ……。
english: P-Please... stroke my shadow too...

speaker: Heine
japanese: ええから。
english: Just do it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……こう？
english: …Like this?

speaker: Heine
english: Nn... mhm...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
あったかいのう……
ひづるの手ェ……。
english: It's so warm... Hizuru's hand...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 影でわかるん？
english: You can feel it through your shadow?

speaker: Heine
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そっか。
さっきの化物と同じなんか……。
english:
I see.
It's the same as that monster earlier…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平、たぶんハイネは、
まださっきの場所におると思う。
english:
Shinpei, I think Haine's still
at that place from earlier.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それじゃあ行きましょうか……。
ハイネのもとへ。
english:
Then let's go…
to Haine's place.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ああ――。
english: Yeah--

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: 藁と、何話してたんや？
english: What were you talking about with the straw man?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
いろんなことや。
例えば、その肩の怪我……
早く処置したほうがええとか。
english:
Various things.
