For example, that injury on your shoulder…
you should get it treated soon.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
あァ？
この程度、なんてことあらへん。
english:
Huh?
It's not a big deal.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そうは見えやんよ。
その傷、結構深そうやし。
english:
It doesn't look like it.
That wound looks pretty deep.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: 心配いらんちゅうに。
english: Don't worry about it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
いや、ここで少し休憩にしよ。
手伝えやんで悪いけど、
応急処置だけでもすませといて。
english: No, let's take a short break here. Sorry I can't help, but at least get some first aid done.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
まだ逃げ切れたとは限らん。
これでも頼りにしてんねやから言う通りに
してくれへん？
english: We can't be sure we've escaped yet. I'm relying on you, so could you please do as I say?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: あァ……わかったわい。
english: Gah... fine.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 良かった……。
english: Thank goodness...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
応急処置の間、
藁と一緒に周囲を警戒してくる。
だから――
english: While you do first aid, I'll keep watch with the straw man. So--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: このナイフ借りてくで。
english: I'm borrowing this knife.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
しゃあないな……。
持ってけ。
english:
Well… okay.
Take it.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
できるだけ早よ終わらすさけ、
あんまり遠くへ行かんとけよ。
english: I'll finish this up as quickly as I can, so don't go too far.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ああ……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （元の時代の根津さんやったら……）
english: (If it were the Nezu-san from our time...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こんなふうに騙して引き返すなんて
　できなかったんだろうな）
english: (I probably wouldn't have been able to trick him and turn back like this.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっきまでのオレは、
どうやって先生や竜之介さんを助けるか
ばかり考えてたけど。
english: Until just now, I was only thinking about how to save Sensei and Ryunosuke-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それだけじゃダメなんだ。
何も変えられへん。
english:
But that's not enough.
It won't change anything.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレは、先生がハイネと決着つけることが、
最善の未来に続く選択肢やって考えてる。
english: I believe that Sensei settling things with Haine is the choice that leads to the best future.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ああ、わかってる。
せやからひづるさんも慎平も、
とっくに覚悟決めてるもんな。
english: Yeah, I know. That's why both Hizuru-san and you have already made up your minds.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
もちろん私も腹くくっちゃある！
最後まで暴れまくるで！
english: Of course I'm prepared too! I'm gonna go wild until the very end!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、思い切りやってやろう。
english: Yeah, let's give it our all.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ひづるさん……ハイネのおる場所は、
このまままっすぐや。
english: Hizuru-san... the place Haine is at is straight ahead.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ああ……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: おった……。ハイネや。
english: There she is... Haine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ウシオ、ここからは
ハイネに気づかれんように……。
english:
Ushio, from here on,
don't let Haine notice us…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
非常事態以外、
オレらは声をあげんほうがええ。
english:
Unless it's an emergency,
it's better not to make noise.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん、わかった。
english: Yeah, I got it.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ひっ、ひっく……。
わからん……なんでじゃ……。
english: *Hic*... *hic*... I don't understand... why...

speaker: Heine
japanese: なんでわしは……ひっく……。
english: Why did I... *hic*...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: りゅ……竜之介……。
english: Ry- Ryunosuke…

speaker: Heine
japanese: ……ひづる！？
english: …Hizuru!?

speaker: Heine
english: Ah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （先生が動揺するんも無理はない……）
english: (It's no wonder Sensei is shaken up...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（食い散らかされた肉親の無残な姿を
　目の前にしたら誰だって……！）
english: (Anyone would be, seeing the gruesome, half-eaten remains of their own family member right in front of them...!)

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ひづる……！
ちゃう、ちゃうんじゃ！
english: Hizuru...! No, it wasn't me!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
わしじゃ、ない……！
気づいたら……こんな……！
english: It wasn't... me...! When I came to... it was like this...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハイネ……。
english: Haine…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハイネはまだ混乱してる。
　隙をつくなら絶好の機会や）
english: (She's still confused. This is the perfect opportunity to strike.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、ここからや。
　このあとハイネにどう近づいて――）
english: (But it all starts from here. How should we approach Haine now--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（えっ！？
　先生が無造作に近寄って……）
english: (Wha!? Sensei is just casually walking up to her...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハイネに寄り添った……？）
english: (She's cuddling up to Haine...?)

speaker: Heine
japanese: ……ひづる！？
english: …Hizuru!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 前にもあったな……こんなこと。
english: This happened before too... didn't it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
泣きじゃくってるハイネの頭撫でて
慰めたったな……。
english: You were sobbing, and I comforted you by stroking your head...

speaker: Heine
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 影を撫でてやるんが一番ええんやろ。
english: It's best if I stroke your shadow, right?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……こうやって。
english: …Like this.

speaker: Heine
english: Nn...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: どうや？
english: How's that?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ひづるの手ェ……
あいかわらず、あったかいな……。
english: Hizuru's hand... is warm, just like always...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……そうか。
english: …I see.

speaker: Heine
japanese: ひづる……すまんかった……。
english: Hizuru… I'm sorry…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハイネ……。
english: Haine…

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ひづるの……弟のこと……
悪かった思てる……！
english: About your... brother... I really am sorry...!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
でも、ちゃうんじゃ……！
わしかて、あんなこと……！
english: But, it wasn't me...! Even I... doing something like that...!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ほんまは……
した……なかった……。
english: I really... didn't want... to do it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ひづるさん……
　迷い始めてるのか？）
english: (Hizuru-san... is she starting to waver?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
たしかに……
ハイネやなかったんかもしれん。
english: It's true... maybe it wasn't you, Haine.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
本能が理性を上回る……
そういうこともあるやろな。
english: Instinct overpowering reason... I suppose that can happen.

speaker: Heine
japanese: う、うん……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （また……ハイネの影を撫で始めた）
english: (She started stroking Haine's shadow again...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
竜之介のこと……
私も辛かったけど……。
english: About Ryunosuke... It was painful for me too, but...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハイネだって辛かったんやな。
english: It must have been painful for you too, Haine.

speaker: Heine
japanese: う……うんッ……。
english: Y... Yeah...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: でも、竜之介はもっと辛かったはずや。
english: But Ryunosuke must have suffered more.

speaker: Heine
japanese: ……ひづる？
english: …Hizuru?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハイネの影を貫いた！）
english: (She pierced Haine's shadow!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
辛かったやろ、ハイネ。
お別れや……私が終わらせちゃる。
english: It was painful, wasn't it, Haine. This is goodbye... I'll end it for you.

speaker: Heine
japanese: なんじゃ……これ？
english: What is this?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: え……なんで無傷……？
english: Huh... why is she unharmed...?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
アカン！
ひづるさん、逃げて！
english: Oh no! Hizuru-san, run!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 影が形を変えてナイフを避けたんです！
english: The shadow changed shape and dodged the knife!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんでや！？
　ハイネは完全に油断してたはずやのに！）
english: (Why!? She should have had her guard completely down!)

speaker: Heine
japanese:
終わらせるちゅうたな。
わしの影を刺して……。
english:
You said you'd end it.
You stabbed my shadow…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 言うたで……。
english: I said I would.

speaker: Heine
japanese: ひづる……わしを殺そ思たんか？
english: Hizuru... did you try to kill me?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生、逃げてッ！
english: Sensei, run!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
殺そうとしたんか！？
わしを！！
english:
You were going to kill me!?
Me!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ああ、その通りや……。
english: Yeah, that's right...

speaker: Heine
japanese: あああああああああああ！！！
english: Ahhhhhhhhhh!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
逃げてッ！
逃げてくださいッ！
english:
Run!
Please run!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ひづるさんッ！
english: Hizuru-san!!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
友達ッ！
友達やなかったんかッ！！
english: Friends! Weren't we friends!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: わしはッ！　わしはァァァッ！！

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
好きにしたらええ。
騙して近づいてまで殺そうとしたんや。
english: Do as you like. I deceived you to get close, just so I could kill you.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 失敗したら殺されて当然やろ……。
english: Since I failed, it's only natural that I'd be killed...

speaker: Heine
japanese: うゥゥゥゥゥうゥゥうゥッ……。
english: Uuuuuuuuuugh...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
やめんかァッ！
ひづるさんから離れろッ！！
english: Stop it! Get away from Hizuru-san!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
アカンッ！
やっぱり当たりよらんッ！！
english: Dammit! My attacks really aren't hitting!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: フゥ、フゥ……フゥ！！
english: *Pant*, *pant*... *pant*!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （何か、何かないんかッ！？）
english: (Isn't there something, anything I can do!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （どないかしてハイネを――）
english: (I have to do something about Haine--)

speaker: Heine
japanese: お別れや。
english: Goodbye.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: がはッ！！
english: Gah!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
い、嫌や……！
こんなん嫌やァァァァッ！！
english: N-No...! I don't want this!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生ッ！
先生ェェェェッ！！
english: Sensei! Senseiiiii!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、目が……！
english: Shinpei, your eyes…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ！？
english: Huh?!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あれ？
私の体……なんか……
english: Huh? My body... feels kind of...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ウシオ！？
english: Ushio?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ウシオ……どこ行ったんや！？
ウシオッ！
english:
Ushio… where did you go!?
Ushio!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（腕時計に戻ったわけでもない。
　ウシオが消えた！？）
english: (It's not like she returned to the watch. Ushio disappeared!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あれから――）
english: (Since then--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あれからずっと、フカンして考えてる）
english: (Since then, I've been taking a bird's-eye view and thinking...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（時間ループの力――ハイネの目の力は、
　１４年前に何かのきっかけで、
　オレに引き継がれることになった）
english: (The power to loop time-- Haine's eye's power, was passed down to me 14 years ago due to some trigger.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でもオレが過去に干渉したことで
　その未来は失われ、
　オレはもう時間をループできなくなった）
english: (But because I interfered with the past, that future was lost, and I can no longer loop time.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （たぶん、そんなとこなんだろう）
english: (That's probably how it is.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレはもう過去の記憶を辿ることも、
　現代に戻ることもできない）
english: (I can no longer trace back past memories, nor can I return to the present.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ここは……のような場所なのだろうか）
english: (I wonder... what kind of place this is.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今はただ、こうして……）
english: (For now, all I can do is...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （時の狭間を彷徨うことしかできない）
english: (wander through the space between time.)

japanese: 9.もうひとつの結末
english: 9. Another Ending

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

japanese: 8月20日
english: August 20

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 今日で日都ヶ島ともお別れやな。
english: Today marks my farewell to Hitogashima.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
（あれからの日々は、
　長かったような短かったような……）
english:
(The days since then felt
both long and short…)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
（少なくとも私の生活が
　一変してしもたことはたしかや）
english: (At the very least, it's certain that my life has completely changed.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
（あれ以来、藁の声は聞こえない。
　未来に帰ったんやろか？）
english: (Since then, I haven't heard the straw man's voice. I wonder if he returned to the future?)

speaker: 男の声（根津銀次郎）
japanese: 行くんやな。
english: You're leaving, huh?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 根津……。
english: Nezu…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
呼び捨ては止めんかい。
なんぼ言うてもわからんやっちゃな。
english: Stop calling me without an honorific. No matter how many times I say it, you just don't get it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 気にせんといて。
english: Don't mind it.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: 気にするわ！
english: I do mind!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
ふん……まあええわい。
行き先はどこや。
english:
Hmph… well, okay.
Where are you going?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
東京へ引っ越すことになったわ。
父が東京にあてがあるらしい。
english: We're moving to Tokyo. My father apparently has some connections there.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
東京か。
遠いのォ。
english:
Tokyo, huh?
It's so far away.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
両親が言うんよ……。
この島にいるのはもう辛いてな。
english: My parents said... it's too painful for them to stay on this island anymore.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
そらしかたないやしょ。
そう言うおまえはどうなんじゃ。
english:
There's nothing you can do about it.
What about you, though?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: おまえも、そうやないんか？
english: Aren't you the same?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
私自身にそんな感情はあらへん。
どっちか言うたら……。
english:
I don't have such feelings myself.
Rather…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
竜之介をこの島におらせたない、
そんなとこや。
english: I don't want to leave Ryunosuke on this island. That's more like it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: まだ、あの話が信じられへんみたいやな。
english: It seems you still can't believe that story.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
しゃあないやろ。
あまりにも突飛な話やさけよォ。
english:
There's nothing to be done.
It's such an absurd story.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そうやな。
亡くなった故人を「心の中にいる」と
表現することは多々あるけど……。
english:
You're right.
It's common to say that the deceased
live on in one's heart…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
比喩表現でもなんでもなく、
実際に亡くなった人間が体の中におるやなんて、
にわかに信じられへんやろな。
english: But for a dead person to actually be inside your body, not as a metaphor or anything... it's hard to believe right away, isn't it.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
けどこの島には、
あり得へんことがあるっちゅうんは、
実際に見てよう知っとる。
english: But I know full well from seeing it myself that impossible things exist on this island.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: そうか……。
english: I see...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
このまま、あの化物を野放しにはできん。
儂はこの島で、あの化物を狩り続けるで。
english:
I can't leave that monster unchecked.
I'll keep hunting that monster on this island.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 化物相手でも、猟師らしい思考やな。
english: Even against a monster, you have a hunter's mindset.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
倒し方はもうわかっちゃあるさけな。
あんなもんにのさばられてたまるかい。
english:
I already know how to defeat it.
How could I let something like that get the better of me?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
そのうちヤツらの習性や有効な攻撃、
それに武器なんかもわかってくるはずや。
english:
Eventually, I'll figure out their habits,
effective attacks,
and even their weapons.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: 早々にくたばらんかったら、の話やがな。
english: That is, if I don't kick the bucket early on.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そうか……。
でもこの先、頻繁にヤツらと遭遇する
ことはあらへんと思う。
english: I see... But I don't think you'll encounter them very frequently from now on.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: そら、なんでや？
english: Why do you say that?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
連中はずいぶん昔からこの島にいる
可能性が高い。
english: There's a high chance they've been on this island since a long time ago.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
それなのに広く知られずにいたということは、
これまでずっと目立たないよう、
派手な活動を控えてきたんやろな。
english:
Yet they've remained unknown to most,
so they've probably been avoiding attention
and refraining from flashy activities.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
せやから、誰も彼も無差別に襲うなんてことは、
めったにしやんのやろ。
english: That's why they probably rarely attack just anyone indiscriminately.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
この島は狭い。
人が一人行方不明になっただけで大事や。
すぐに事件として周知されてまう。
english: This island is small. Even one person going missing is a huge deal. It would immediately be known as an incident.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
だからこそ化物は大っぴらに
活動してこんかった。
それはあのハイネかて同じや。
english: That's exactly why the monsters haven't acted openly. And that goes for Haine too.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
だからこそ、人を避けてた。
だからこそ、人に飢えてたんや。
english: That's why she avoided people. And that's why she was starving for them.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: なるほどな……。
english: I see…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
根津が相手する化物は、
飢えた肉食獣より厄介な連中や。
気ィつけてな。
english: The monsters you'll be facing, Nezu, are more troublesome than starving carnivores. Be careful.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
心配せんでも、
おまえのような無茶はせん。
english: Don't worry, I won't do anything reckless like you did.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
暇ができたら手紙出すわ。
メールや電話より手紙のがええやろ。
english: I'll send you a letter when I have free time. Letters are better than emails or phone calls, right?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そっちも気が向いたら、
手紙で猟の成果でも教えてや。
english:
If you feel like it, you can also tell me
about your hunting results via letter.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: 知ってどないすんや？
english: What're you gonna do knowing that?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
あれだけのことがあった相手や。
情報だけでも集めときたいて思ても
不思議やないやろ。
english: They're an opponent who caused all that. It's not strange to want to at least gather information on them, is it?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
ふん……。
まあ、気が向いたらな。
english: Hmph... Well, if I feel like it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ああ、助かる。
あの日のこと、ハイネのこと……
まだまだわからんことが多すぎるからな。
english: Yeah, that helps. About that day, about Haine... There's still way too much I don't understand.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
そろそろ行かな。
両親を待たせてるんよ。
english:
I should go now.
My parents are waiting.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: もう、戻ってくるんやないぞ。
english: Don't ever come back, you hear?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ああ、この物語が、
そうさせてくれるならな。
english: Yeah, if this story lets me.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: またワケのわからんこと言いよって。
english: You're spouting nonsense again.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: それじゃあ、お別れや。
english: Well then, this is goodbye.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
あの日、助けてくれてありがとう。
きっとこの先も、私はこの出会いに
感謝し続けると思う。
english: Thank you for saving me that day. I'm sure I'll continue to be grateful for our meeting for the rest of my life.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
……ふん、おまえが言うと、
なんぞ裏がありそうやで。
english: ...Hmph, when you say it, it sounds like there's some ulterior motive.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
失礼やな。
まあ、そのくらいに受け取ってもろたほうが、
こっちも気ィ楽やけどな。
english: How rude. Well, it's easier for me if you just take it like that, though.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
それじゃ、
今度こそほんまのサヨナラや。
english:
Then, this time for real,
it's goodbye.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: ああ、達者でな。
english: Yeah, take care.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
（見送りに来てくれた朝子が、
　泣きながらずっと手を振ってくれてる……）
english: (Asako came to see me off, and she's been waving her hand while crying...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: （根津は……もうおらんか）
english: (Nezu is... already gone, huh.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
日都ヶ島……
だんだん小さなっていきよる。
english: Hitogashima... It's getting smaller and smaller.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
（ここから先は自分自身で
　未来を切り拓いていくんや）
english: (From here on, I'll have to carve out my own future.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
（そうして歩んでいく道のりが、
　いつかまた……）
english:
(And the path I walk from now on
will one day…)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: （あの島へと繋がってくんやろな）
english: (connect back to that island, I suppose.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
（そう……。
　望むと望まざるにかかわらず）
english: (Yes... Regardless of whether I want it or not.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
さよならハイネ。
次会うた時は……
english:
Goodbye, Haine.
Next time we meet…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 正々堂々勝負できたらええな。
english: It'd be nice if we could have a fair and square fight.

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_ROOTCLEAR_HDR>ｒｏｕｔｅ：南方ひづる</color>】を入手しました。
english: KEY TIPS[<color=#GF_KEY_ROOTCLEAR_HDR>route: Hizuru Minakata</color>] has been acquired.

japanese: 7月22日
english: July 22

japanese: 3周目
english: Third Loop

japanese: 1.同級生
english: 1. Classmates

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
連絡？
普通にしてくれて構わないけど。
english: Contact you? I don't mind if you just do it normally.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そうじゃなくて……。
えっと……れ、連絡は、しばらくできないかもって。
english: That's not it... Umm... I-I might not be able to contact you for a while.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうなの？
english: Is that so?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ちょっと忙しくて……。
english: I'm a bit busy…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうなんだ、じゃあオレからも連絡はしない方が――
english: I see, then I shouldn't contact you either--

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 網代くんからは送ってくれて大丈夫です！
english: It's okay if you message me, Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？　でも忙しいって……。
english: Huh? But you said you were busy…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: それは、その、なんて言うか……。
english: That's… how do I say it…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そうか小弓場さん、潮のことを気にして……）
english: (Oh right, Kaori-san is worried about Ushio...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ありがとう。
じゃあ、色々落ち着いたら連絡するから。
english:
Thank you.
When things settle down, I'll contact you.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Hey!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
おかえり慎ちゃん！！
長旅お疲れさまあああああッ！？
english: Welcome back, Shin-chan!! You must be exhausted from the long triiiiiiip!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ウソだろ……？）
english: (No way…?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（<color=#GF_TIPS_058>デジャヴ</color>って、
　こういうのを言うんだろうか）
english: (Is this what they call... <color=#GF_TIPS_058>deja vu</color>?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あッ？
english: Ah?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪ッ！？
english: Mio!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: キャ！
english: Eek!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪ッ！
大丈夫かァッ！？
english:
Mio!
Are you okay!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……ブクブクブクブク。
english: ...Blub blub blub blub.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ――ぷはッ！
english: --Pah!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ、あははは……！
ごめん慎ちゃん、びっくりさして……！
english: A-Ahahaha...! Sorry Shin-chan, for surprising you...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……何やってんの？
english: …What are you doing?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ちょ、ちょっと汗かいたから……
水浴びしょか思て！！
english: I-I just got a little sweaty... so I thought I'd take a dip!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 元気そうでなによりかよ……。
english: I'm just glad you seem energetic...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（さっき飛び込んだ時の澪……。
　パンツのガラまで同じやった）
english: (When Mio jumped in earlier... Even the pattern on her panties was the same.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、ちゃんとブレーキかけたんか？
english: Mio, did you actually apply the brakes?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんでやろ……。
ちゃんとかけたつもりなんやけど、
止まらんかった。
english: I wonder why... I thought I applied them properly, but I didn't stop.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ブレーキがかからんかったて……
　自転車の故障なんか？）
english:
(If the brakes didn't work…
Was it a bicycle malfunction?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（自転車の<color=#GF_TIPS_089>ブレーキワイヤー</color>が切れてる？
　どうりでかからんわけや……）
english: (The bicycle's <color=#GF_TIPS_089>brake wire</color> is snapped? No wonder they didn't work...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（自然に切れた感じじゃない。
　一体誰がこんなことを……）
english:
(It doesn't look like it broke naturally.
Who in the world did this…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （とにかく先に澪を引き上げるか）
english: (Anyway, I should pull Mio up first.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ほら、上がってこい。
手貸すから。
english: Here, come on up. I'll lend you a hand.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……ありがと。
english: …Thanks.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: やっぱりしょっぱいな……海。
english: It really is salty... the sea.

japanese: 2.細工されたブレーキ
english: 2. Tampered Brakes

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
大丈夫……？
ケガがなさそうで良かったね。
english: Are you okay...? I'm glad you don't seem hurt.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: え？　ええっと……はい！
english: Huh? Uh, yeah!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、こっちの人は……？
english: Shin-chan, who is this...?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
こんにちは。
私、小弓場かおりです。
english:
Hello.
I'm Kaori Koyuba.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: お久しぶり、でいいのかな？
english: It's been a while, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 小弓場さん……？
english: Koyuba-san...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえ、忘れてるだろ。
english: You forgot, didn't you?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
わ、忘れてへんって！
今、思い出すから……！
english: I-I didn't forget! I'll remember it right now...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そういうのを世間一般的には、
忘れてるって言うんだよ。
english: That's what people usually call "forgetting."

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
仕方ないよ。
小舟さんとは学年が違ったし。
english: It can't be helped. Kofune-san and I were in different grades.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 学年が違う……。
english: Different grades…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あっ！　もしかして、
お姉ちゃんと同級生やった、
小弓場さん？
english: Ah! Could it be... Onee-chan's classmate, Koyuba-san?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
良かったァ。
覚えててくれたんだ。
english: Thank goodness. You remembered me.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 覚えてます！　名前は！
english: I remember! Your name!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 名前は……か。
english: Just her name... huh.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
すみません。
小っちゃい頃の記憶やから、
あまりハッキリとは……。
english: Sorry. It's a memory from when I was little, so it's not very clear...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ううん、大丈夫！
こっちこそ気を遣わせてごめんなさい。
english: No, it's fine! I'm the one who should apologize for making you worry.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
って言うか、おまえ、
そのびしょ濡れの制服どうするんだ。
english:
Anyway, what are you going to do
with that soaked uniform?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
家に帰ったら
替えの制服あるから大丈夫。
english: I have a spare uniform at home, so it's fine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: じゃあ、いったん家に戻るか。
english: Then let's head home.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
というわけなんで、小弓場さん。
オレたち行くから。
english: So anyway, Koyuba-san. We'll be going now.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
バタバタしてもて、ごめんなさい。
それじゃあ。
english: Sorry for all the commotion. Well then.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あっ、小舟さん。
english: Ah, Kofune-san.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっと……
落ち着いた頃にご挨拶に伺っていいですか？
english: Umm... Would it be okay if I came to pay my respects once things have settled down?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ……。
はい、お姉ちゃんも喜ぶと思います。
english: Ah... Yes, I think Onee-chan would be happy too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: それじゃあ網代くん、また。
english: Well then, Ajiro-kun, see you later.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、それじゃ。
english: Yeah, see you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: よし……オレたちも行くか。
english: Alright… let's go.

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Hmm…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なに考え込んでるんだ？
english: What's on your mind?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
いや……小弓場さんの顔、
どっかで見たことあるような？
english: No... I just feel like I've seen Koyuba-san's face somewhere before?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そりゃあ小さい頃とはいえ、
同じ学校に通ってたんだからな。
english: Well, even if it was when you were little, you guys did go to the same school.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それはそうなんやけど……
もっと最近……。
english:
That's true, but…
More recently…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ようわからんけど、とりあえず帰ろや。
アランが待ってるやろし。
english:
I don't get it, but let's go back first.
Alain's waiting, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
せやな。
うん、帰ろ帰ろ！
english:
Right.
Yeah, let's go back!

japanese: 3.既視感
english: 3. Deja Vu

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お父さん！
慎ちゃん帰って来たよー！
english: Dad! Shin-chan is back!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ただいま。
english: I'm home.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
おお……慎平っ……！
背ェ伸びたなァ……。
english:
Wow… Shinpei…
You've grown so much…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: アランはちょっと痩せたね……。
english: Alain, you've gotten a bit thinner...

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
積もる話はあとや……。
潮と会ったってくれ。
english: We can catch up later... Go see Ushio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やっぱり同じだ。
　さっきのフェリーの時も、
　澪の自転車の時も……）
english: (It really is the same. On the ferry earlier, and with Mio's bicycle too...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （みんな夢と同じ動き、同じ会話……）
english: (Everyone's moving and talking the same way as in my dream…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（デジャヴだとか、正夢だとか、
　そういうレベルじゃない）
english: (This isn't just deja vu or a prophetic dream... It's not on that level.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレは７月２２日を……）
english: (I'm reliving July 22nd...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （もう一度くり返してる……）
english: (all over again...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（このままずっと同じことが
　くり返されるのなら……）
english: (If the exact same things keep repeating like this...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あの影が実在する……。
　そういうことにならないか？）
english: (Doesn't that mean... that shadow really exists?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……影を見たものは死ぬ）
english: (...Those who see the shadow will die.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まさか潮は影に殺されたんか！？
　そして澪も……）
english: (Was Ushio killed by a shadow!? And Mio too...)

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: ……慎平？
english: ...Shinpei?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ！？　な、なに？
english: Huh!? W-What?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
大丈夫？
顔色真っ青やで……。
english: Are you okay? Your face is completely pale...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ、そうか……？
english: I-Is it...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ゴメン……
ちょっと外の風に当たって来る……。
english: Sorry... I'm gonna go get some fresh air...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（海に落ちた澪の自転車は、
　ブレーキが壊れていた……）
english: (The bicycle Mio fell into the sea with... its brakes were broken...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ブレーキのワイヤーに、
　切れ込みを入れたような跡があったよな）
english: (There was a mark on the brake wire like it had been cut, wasn't there.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もしもあれが誰かを……
　澪を殺すための細工だとしたら）
english: (What if that was a trap meant to kill someone... meant to kill Mio?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あかん……なにがなんやら……。
　フカンらできやんわ、こんなんっ！）
english: (Dammit... I don't understand any of this... I can't take a bird's-eye view of this!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （吐きそうや……）
english: (I feel like I'm gonna throw up...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いま、家のほうから
　何か聞こえたような……？）
english: (Did I just hear something coming from the house...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪……！？
　なんであいつ制服なんか……）
english: (Mio...!? Why is she wearing her uniform...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（凸村さんが倒れて……！
　まさか――）
english: (Totsumura-san is collapsed...! Don't tell me--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪が……
　凸村さんを刺した！？）
english: (Mio... stabbed Totsumura-san!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あいつ澪じゃない！！）
english: (That's not Mio!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (It's a shadow...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こっ、この光は……！？）
english: (Th-This light is...!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（な……なんだよあれ……
　影が起き上がって……！！）
english: (Wh... what is that... The shadow is getting up...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (A shadow...!?)

speaker: Totsumura
japanese: よっこいしょういち。
english: Heave-ho.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（凸村さんが……
　凸村さんに消された！？）
english: (Totsumura-san... was erased by Totsumura-san!?)

speaker: Mio
japanese: あなたは今から駐在の凸村哲です。
english: From now on, you are the local police officer, Tetsu Totsumura.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
フム……。
あー、オレは凸村哲……３４歳……。
english: Hmm... Ah, I am Tetsu Totsumura... 34 years old...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あ……ありえへん……！）
english: (Th... that's impossible...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （これって現実なん――）
english: (Is this reality--)

speaker: 女の子の声（かおり）
japanese: うわ！？
english: Whoa!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あ、あれは……）
english: (Th-That's...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
なに……？
今のって、なんだったの！？
english: What...? What was that just now!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （小弓場さん！）
english: (Koyuba-san!)

speaker: Mio
english: ...Who?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まずいッ！
　あいつらに見つかった……！）
english: (This is bad! They spotted us...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん！　逃げろ！！
english: Koyuba-san! Run!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎……ちゃん？
english: Shin... chan?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっ……？
あ、網代く――
english: Huh...? A-Ajiro-ku--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さんッ！！！
english: Koyuba-san!!!

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
アカンやん、慎平くん。
いつからここにおったん？
english: That's no good, Shinpei-kun. Since when were you here?

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
はい、捕獲完了じょ。
澪ちゃ～ん、こっちも頼むわ。
english: Alright, capture complete. Mio-cha~n, take care of this one too.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
人使い荒ない？
自分でやればええのに。
english: Aren't you working me too hard? You should just do it yourself.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐっ、くあ……！
english: Guh, gah...!

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
盗み聞きはアカンでェ慎平く～ん。
そら死刑じょ！
english: Eavesdropping is a no-no, Shinpei-ku~n. That's a death sentence!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この血……オレの……？
　すげー赤い）
english: (This blood... is mine...? It's so red.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（って、死ぬやん……。
　こんなん……）
english: (But I'm... dying...! Like this...)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
あっちの子はオカアサンとこ連れてく。
カワイイ女の子やし、喜ぶかも。
english: I'll take that girl to Mother. She's a cute girl, so she might be happy.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese: ほな、そうしよか。
english: Alright, let's do that.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese: よっこい……しょういち！
english: Heave... ho!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
やめろ……。
小弓場さんを……おいて、いけ。
english: Stop... Leave... Koyuba-san... alone.

speaker: Mio
japanese: じゃあね。慎ちゃん。
english: See ya. Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なんだ……コレ……）
english: (What is... this...)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 慎平……。
english: Shinpei...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だっ……誰や！？
english: Wh... Who is it!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 気を……けて……に……る……。
english: Be... careful... of...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんて！？
よう聞こえへんっ……！
english: What!? I can't hear you...!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 澪のこと……。
english: About Mio...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 守っちゃってね……。
english: Protect her, okay...

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_KAO_MAKIKOMI>かおりが巻き込まれ……</color>】を入手しました。
english: KEY TIPS [<color=#GF_KEY_KAO_MAKIKOMI>Kaori Gets Involved...</color>] acquired.

japanese: 4周目
english: 4th Loop

japanese: 4.オレにできることは
english: 4. What I Can Do

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァッ、ハァッ、ハァ……。
english: *Pant*, *pant*, *pant*...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うッ……。
english: Ugh…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （また……戻った？）
english: (Again… I'm back?)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くん！
大丈夫！？
english: Ajiro-kun! Are you okay!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん……。
english: Koyuba-san...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ど、どうしたの？
具合悪そうだけど……。
english: Wh-What's wrong? You look like you're not feeling well...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （小弓場さん、港……）
english: (Koyuba-san, the harbor...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうか、小弓場さんに声をかけられて、
　たしか連絡先を交換しようって……）
english: (Right, Koyuba-san called out to me, and we were going to exchange contact info...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それで……登録したんだ。
　お互いに……）
english: (And then... we registered them. With each other...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: よかった……。
english: Thank goodness...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（とにかく小弓場さんはまだ生きてる……。
　それがなによりの救いだ）
english: (Anyway, Koyuba-san is still alive... That's the biggest relief.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、このままだとまた同じ過去を
　繰り返すことになる）
english: (But at this rate, I'll just repeat the same past all over again.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（落ち着け、フカンしろ。
　オレがこれから、なにをするべきか考えるんだ）
english: (Calm down, take a bird's-eye view. I need to think about what I should do from now on.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あの悪夢のような夜を回避するために……！）
english: (To avoid that nightmare-like night…!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……小弓場さん！
english: ...Koyuba-san!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
はい！？
……な、なにかな？
english:
Yes!?
W-what is it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん。
島にいる間、どこに泊まる予定なの？
english: Koyuba-san. Where are you planning to stay while on the island?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: えっ？　島の旅館だけど……？
english: Huh? An inn on the island, but...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
どこの旅館なんだ！？
教えてくれ！
english: Which inn is it!? Tell me!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ちょ、ちょっと待って！
どうしたのいきなり？
english:
W-wait a second!
Why the sudden question?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あっ……ご、ごめん。
english: Ah… I'm sorry.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ううん。
別にいいんだけど……。
english: No. It's fine, but...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっとね、普通の宿だよ？
ほら、<color=#GF_TIPS_041>パンフレット</color>。
役場の人が用意してくれて……。
english: Umm, it's just a normal inn, you know? Look, the <color=#GF_TIPS_041>brochure</color>. The people at the town hall prepared it for me...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（役場？　どうして役場の人が……。
　いや、とにかくそんなことより！）
english:
(The town hall? Why would they…
Anyway, that's not important…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
よく聞いて、小弓場さん。
夜は絶対に外を出歩いちゃダメだ！
english: Listen carefully, Koyuba-san. You absolutely must not go out at night!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: えっ……どうして？
english: Huh… why?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そ、それは……今、島内で不審者が
うろついてるらしくてさ。
english: Th-That's because... apparently there's a suspicious person wandering around the island right now.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: そうなの！？
english: Really!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、なにかあってからじゃ遅い。
だから外には出ない方がいい。
english:
Yeah, it'll be too late if something happens.
So it's better not to go out.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、うん、わかった。
気をつけるよ。
english:
O-okay, I get it.
I'll be careful.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（本気で信じてくれてるかは、
　わからないけど、
　これで今夜はどうにか……）
english: (I don't know if she really believes me, but with this, she should be okay for tonight...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あの……ありがとう、網代くん。
english: Um... thank you, Ajiro-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私、島に戻ったのは久しぶりだから、
いろいろ不安だったの。
english: It's been a while since I came back to the island, so I was anxious about a lot of things.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
だから網代くんが心配してくれて、
ほんと嬉しかったし……
安心できたよ。
english: So I was really happy that Ajiro-kun worried about me... I feel relieved.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: A-Ah...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
不審者か……怖いね。
うん、夜は出歩かないようにする。
english:
A suspicious person… That's scary.
Yeah, I won't go out at night.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よかった……。
　これなら上手くいきそうだ）
english: (Thank goodness... This looks like it'll work out.)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: でも、あまり心配しすぎないでね？
english: But don't worry too much, okay?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
いざとなったら、
これが私を守ってくれるから
大丈夫！
english: If push comes to shove, this will protect me, so I'll be fine!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それって……。
english: That…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くん覚えてるかな？
ほら、私が昔から好きだったキャラクターの
<color=#GF_KEY_KEYHOLDER>キーホルダー</color>！
english: Do you remember, Ajiro-kun? Look, it's a <color=#GF_KEY_KEYHOLDER>keychain</color> of the character I've liked since I was little!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、久しぶりに見た！
まだ持ってたんだ？
english:
Ah, I haven't seen it in a while!
You still have it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、それが「守ってくれる」って、
どういう――
english: But, what do you mean by 'it will protect you'--

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Heeeeey!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
おかえり慎ちゃん！！
長旅お疲れさまあああああッ！？
english: Welcome back, Shin-chan!! You must be exhausted from the long triiiiiiip!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （また、この光景……！）
english: (Again, this scene…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そういえばあの時……
　潮の声が聞こえた気がする）
english: (Come to think of it, back then... I felt like I heard Ushio's voice.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あれが潮の願いなら、
　今オレがやるべきことは――）
english: (If that was Ushio's wish, then what I need to do right now is--)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ブ、ブレーキが利かへん！！
english: Th-The brakes aren't working!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪ッ、任せとけ！
オレが自転車を止めてやる！
english:
Mio! Leave it to me!
I'll stop the bike!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あッ！
english: Ah!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐはァッ！！！
english: Guhah!!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん！！
english: Shin-chan!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 網代くん！！
english: Ajiro-kun!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ヤバ……。
　オレ、泳げやんのやった……）
english:
(Oh no…
I can't swim…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まずい……。
　い、意識……が……）
english: (This is bad... M-My consciousness... is...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃんッ！
english: Shin-chan!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 網代くん！
english: Ajiro-kun!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん！
english: Shin-chan!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くん！
しっかりして！
english: Ajiro-kun! Pull yourself together!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん！
english: Shin-chan!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 網代くんっ！
english: Ajiro-kun!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ……澪と、小弓場さん？
english: Ah... Mio, and Koyuba-san?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （二人とも服が濡れてる……）
english: (Both of their clothes are wet...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレを助けるため……
　海に飛び込んでくれたのか）
english: (Did they jump into the sea... to save me?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
良かった。
気ィついたんやね。
english: Thank goodness. You're awake.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
二人とも、ごめんな。
オレのために……。
english: Both of you, I'm sorry. Because of me...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ううん、無事で安心したよ。
english: No, I'm just glad you're safe.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なにやってんだ、オレ……）
english: (What am I doing…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （助けるつもりが助けられて……）
english: (I meant to save her, but ended up being saved...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こんなことじゃダメなんだ！
　こんなことでは……）
english: (This is no good! If things stay like this...)

japanese: 5.まるでアイドルみたい
english: 5. Like an Idol

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ふう……。
english: Phew…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （いくらか落ち着いたな……）
english: (I've calmed down a bit...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、入ってええ？
english: Shin-chan, can I come in?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、大丈夫。
english: Yeah, it's fine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もう支度済んだんか？
早いな。
english:
Already ready?
You're quick.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
水泳部やもん。
着替えたりするんは慣れちゃある。
タオルは足りたん？
english: I'm in the swim club, after all. I'm used to changing clothes. Did you have enough towels?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、収納の中に残していったんが
あったからな。
english: Yeah, there were some left in the closet.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
２年も放置しとったタオルって、
臭いんとちゃう？
english: Wouldn't towels that have been left for two years smell bad?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はは……まあ、ちょっとだけな。
english: Haha... well, just a little.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんは大丈夫、
脱衣所にはタオルと乾かした服を
置いといたし……。
english: You're fine, Shin-chan, I left a towel and some dried clothes in the changing room...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃんがシャワー浴びて支度整えたら、
すぐ出られるようにしとこか。
english: Once Kaori-chan finishes her shower and gets ready, we should be able to leave right away.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、そうだな。
english: Yeah, that's right.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それはそうと……
結構強引にウチへ連れてきてしもたけど、
かおりちゃん、迷惑やなかったかな？
english: By the way... I kind of forced her to come to our place, but I wonder if Kaori-chan found it annoying?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ウチ寄ってってください！
english: Please come to my place!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ずぶ濡れのまま
宿に行かせられやん。
english: I can't let you go to the inn completely soaked.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、ううん、大丈夫だよ。
歩いてるうちに乾くだろうし。
english: U-uh, it's okay. I'll dry on the way.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もとは自転車でヘマしてしもた私のせいです！
お願いですから、
ウチでシャワー浴びてってください。
english: It's my fault for messing up on my bike in the first place! Please, just take a shower at our place.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: でも、今日はお姉さんの……。
english: But today's your sister's…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ……聞いてたんですね。
english: Ah… you heard, huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
大丈夫ですよ、ここで一人帰らせたら、
それこそお姉ちゃんに怒られますから。
english: It's fine. If I let you go back alone from here, Onee-chan would definitely get mad at me.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
english: Ah…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
どのみち私と慎ちゃんも一旦家に帰らなアカンし、
小弓場さんも一緒にどうですか？
english: Either way, Shin-chan and I have to go home first too, so how about you come with us, Koyuba-san?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん……じゃあ、お言葉に甘えちゃおうかな。
english: Yeah… I'll take you up on that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そうと決まれば急ぎましょう、小弓場さん。
english: Now that it's decided, let's hurry, Koyuba-san.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そうだ、小舟さん。
私のことはかおりでいいよ。
english: Oh, right, Kofune-san. You can just call me Kaori.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっと……かおりちゃん？
english: Uh… Kaori-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いきなりちゃん付けは失礼だろ。
english: Calling her "chan" all of a sudden is rude.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そ、そうやな。
english: R-Right.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ううん、いいよ。
そのほうが私も話しやすいし、それになんか嬉しい。
english:
No, it's okay.
It's easier to talk like that, and it feels nice.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: じゃあ、私のことも澪ちゃんって呼んでください。
english: Then call me Mio-chan too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 澪ちゃん……うん、わかった。
english: Mio-chan… yeah, I got it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まあ大丈夫だろ。
本人も助かるって言ってたし。
english:
Well, it's fine.
She said she was grateful too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
最初あれだけ断ってたのは、
ただ遠慮してただけなんちゃうかな。
english: I think she was just being polite when she refused so much at first.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……ふーん、ならええけど。
english: …Well, that's fine then.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
久しぶりにあった相手やのに、
かおりちゃんのことよう理解してんねんな。
english: Even though you haven't seen her in a while, you sure seem to understand Kaori-chan pretty well.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……な、なんて？
english: Huh… what?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ううん？
なんでもあらへん。
english:
Huh?
Nothing at all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それにしても……
　澪を助けるつもりが逆に助けられるなんてな。
　澪にも小弓場さんにも申し訳ないよ）
english: (Still... I meant to save Mio, but ended up being saved instead. I feel bad for both Mio and Koyuba-san.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、こうして小弓場さんとの
　時間ができたのは良かったのかも）
english: (But maybe it's a good thing I got to spend some time with Koyuba-san like this.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（さっきは夜中一人で出歩かないようにって
　注意したけど……）
english: (Earlier I warned her not to walk around alone at night, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そもそもなぜ一人で歩いてたのかとか、
　もう少し情報が得られるかもしれない）
english: (Maybe I can get a little more information, like why she was walking alone in the first place.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、なに考えてるん？
もしかして、かおりちゃんのこと？
english: Shin-chan, what are you thinking about? Could it be about Kaori-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
えっ？
なんでわかったんだ？
english: Huh? How did you know?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うわ、やらしィ。
english: Whoa, what a pervert.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: は？　なんでなん？
english: What? Why?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
だってかおりちゃん、
今シャワー浴びてるとこやで？
どんな想像してたん？
english: Because Kaori-chan is taking a shower right now, you know? What kind of things were you imagining?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ、そんなこと考えとったんちゃうわ！
english: I-I wasn't thinking about anything like that!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
まさか慎ちゃん……
東京から一緒に帰ってきたんや
ないやろな？
english: Shin-chan, don't tell me... you two didn't come back from Tokyo together, did you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……どういう意味だよ？
english: What do you mean?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ホンマはさっき再会したんやのうて、
もう東京におった時から親密な仲やったとか……。
english: Like, you didn't actually just reunite earlier, but you were already close back in Tokyo...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんでそうなるんだよ。
船が一緒やったんは、ただの偶然や。
english: Why would you think that? Us being on the same boat was just a coincidence.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
じゃあなんで、かおりちゃんは
慎ちゃんが泳げやんこと知ってたん？
english: Then why did Kaori-chan know that Shin-chan couldn't swim?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh…?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんが海に落ちた後、
かおりちゃん言うてたで。
english: After Shin-chan fell into the sea, Kaori-chan said something.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 「網代くん、泳げるようになったのかと思った」て。
english: I thought Ajiro-kun had learned how to swim.'

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そういえば、そんなこと言ってたような……？
english: Now that you mention it, she did say that…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
小学校の時に一緒やっただけの子が、
泳げるとか泳げやんとか、
そんなに覚えてやんと思うけど。
english: I don't think someone you were only with in elementary school would remember whether you could swim or not.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: まあ……確かに……。
english: Well… that's true…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ほら、やっぱり知り合いなんや！
english: See! You two know each other!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だから誤解だって！
english: It's a misunderstanding!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも、色々おかしいんやもん。
慎ちゃん、久しぶりの再会やったはずやのに、
懐かしいとかそんな感じ全然ないし。
english: But it's just so weird. Shin-chan, you were supposed to be reuniting after a long time, but you didn't seem nostalgic or anything at all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（う……まあ再会はすでに１回、
　経験してしまってるからなあ……）
english: (Ugh... well, I've already experienced reuniting with her once before...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それにあの顔、
やっぱりどっかで見た気が……。
english: Plus that face… I feel like I've seen it somewhere…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 澪ちゃーん、シャワーありがとう。
english: Mio-cha~n, thanks for the shower.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あれ？　澪ちゃん？
english: Huh? Mio-chan?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ、こっちです！
english: Over here!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、いたいた。
網代くんも。
english: Ah, there you are. Ajiro-kun too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Ah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Huh…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さん……、
　最初会った時もそう思ったけど）
english: (Koyuba-san... I thought so when we first met too, but)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（身支度整えたばかりだからかな？
　さらに綺麗に見えるような……）
english: (Is it because she just finished getting ready? She looks even more beautiful...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あっ、そうだ！
服、大丈夫でした？
ちゃんと乾いてたらいいんですけど。
english:
Oh! Right!
Are your clothes okay?
I hope they dried properly.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、大丈夫だったよ。
タオルとかドライヤーもありがとう。
おかげでサッパリした～。
english:
Yeah, they're fine.
Thanks for the towel and hairdryer.
I feel refreshed~

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それなら良かったです。
安心しました。
english:
That's good.
I'm relieved.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ちょっと慎ちゃん……！
なんで顔赤なってるんよ！？
english: Hey, Shin-chan...! Why is your face red!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや、そういう澪だって、
赤くなってるぞ？
english: Well, you're turning red too, Mio.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
だ、だって……改めて見たら、
ホンマかわいいっていうか……
english: B-Because... looking at her again, she's really cute, or rather...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: まるでアイドルみたいな――
english: Like an idol…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……アイドル？
english: …An idol?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ど、どうしたの澪ちゃん？
私の顔に何かついてる？
english: Wh-What's wrong, Mio-chan? Is there something on my face?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あっ、あああーッ！！
english: Ah! Oh no!!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: えッ！？
english: Huh?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
どうしたんや、澪？
いきなり大声出すなよ。
english: What's wrong, Mio? Don't just shout all of a sudden.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ちょ、ちょっと待っとって！！
english: W-Wait right there!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なんだ、あいつ……？）
english: (What's with her…?)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ど、どうしたのかな？
english: W-what's going on?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さあ？
自分の部屋に行ったみたいだけど。
english:
I don't know.
She went to her room, I think.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まあ、すぐに戻ってくるだろうから、
ゆっくりしてて。
english: Well, she'll probably be back soon, so just relax.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、あの、もしかしてここって、
網代くんの部屋？
english: U-Um, could this be... Ajiro-kun's room?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうだよ。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うっ、ううっ！
english: U-uh! Uhh!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ど、どうしたの？
急に顔をこわばらせて。
english: Wh-What's wrong? Your face suddenly got stiff.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: なんでもないです。
english: It's nothing.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうは見えないんだけど……顔も赤いし。
english: It doesn't look like nothing... Your face is red, too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もしかして風邪引いちゃったかな？
english: Maybe you caught a cold?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、あ、あ、これは違うの！
english: A-ah, no! That's not it!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そ、その、網代くんの部屋にいるってわかったら、
なんだか緊張しちゃって。
english: W-Well, when I realized I was in Ajiro-kun's room, I got kind of nervous.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そんな気にしないで。
english: Don't worry about it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレの私物はほとんど東京に運んじゃったから
もう空き部屋みたいな感じだし。
english: I moved most of my personal belongings to Tokyo, so it's basically like an empty room now.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ううん、そんなことないと……思うな。
english: No, I don't think... that's true.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんで？
english: Why?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 部屋、綺麗に掃除してあるでしょ？
english: The room has been cleaned up nicely, hasn't it?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
きっと、ここは網代くんの居場所だからって、
普段から大切にしてた人がいるんじゃないかな。
english: I'm sure someone has been taking good care of it because it's Ajiro-kun's place.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なるほど……。
english: I see…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あっ、ごめんね。
ジロジロ見ちゃって。
english:
Ah, sorry.
I was staring.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あ……今のこの感じ、
　少し昔の面影があるかも）
english: (Ah... this feeling right now, it kind of reminds me of how she used to be.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、こうして人となりは思い出せても、
　一緒に遊んだ記憶はほとんどないんだよなァ）
english: (But even though I can remember her personality like this, I have almost no memories of playing together.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ここに来たことがないってことは、
　潮とも、お互いの家に遊びに行くような
　間柄じゃなかったんだろうし……）
english: (Since she's never been here before, she and Ushio probably weren't close enough to visit each other's houses either...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あっ、そうだ。
さっきは助けてくれてありがとう。
english:
Oh, right.
Thanks for helping me earlier.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う……ううん、気にしないで。
咄嗟に体が動いちゃっただけだから。
english: N-No, don't worry about it. My body just moved on its own.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くんもそうでしょ？
泳げないのに、海に落ちかけた
澪ちゃんを助けるなんて。
english: You were the same, weren't you, Ajiro-kun? Jumping in to save Mio-chan when she fell into the sea, even though you can't swim.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 泳げない……。
english: I can't swim…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そのことなんだけどさ……
オレが泳げないなんてこと、
よく覚えてたね？
english: About that... You sure remembered that I couldn't swim, huh?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ……それは……。
english: Ah… that's…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
覚えてるかな？
昔、網代くんが海中遺跡の本を読んでた時に、
「日都ヶ島にもあるかな？」って話になって……。
english: Do you remember? A long time ago, when Ajiro-kun was reading a book about underwater ruins, we talked about whether there might be some on Hitogashima too...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私が「潜って探しに行ってみたら？」って言ったら
網代くん「泳げないから無理」って。
english: When I said, 'Why don't you try diving and looking for them?', Ajiro-kun said, 'I can't swim, so that's impossible.'

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くんが泳げないことを知らないで、
無神経なこと言っちゃったなって……
すごく後悔したことがあったの。
english: I didn't know Ajiro-kun couldn't swim, and I felt like I said something really insensitive... I regretted it a lot.

japanese: 「覚えてないな……」
english: "I don't remember…"

japanese: 「言われてみると……」
english: Now that you mention it...'

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そんなことがあったんだ？
覚えてないな……。
english: Did that really happen? I don't remember...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、無神経な発言とは全然思わないよ。
覚えてなかったってことは、
当時のオレも気にならなかったんだろうし。
english: But I don't think it was an insensitive comment at all. The fact that I didn't remember means I probably didn't mind it back then either.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ありがとう。
ちょっとホッとした。
english:
Thank you.
I feel a bit relieved.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 言われてみると……。
english: Now that you mention it...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……思い出した？
english: …Did you remember?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うん……そう、そうだ！
それでオレが「行くなら潜水艦とかかな」って。
english: Yeah... right, that's it! And then I said, 'If I go, I'd probably need a submarine or something.'

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
english: Eh…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あれ、違った？
そう言ったと思うんだけどなァ。
english:
Wait, was that wrong?
I thought I said that.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: そ、そうだったのかな……？
english: W-Was that how it went...?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
たぶん、その時の私、
無神経なこと言っちゃったって、
そればかり考えてたから……。
english: Probably, at that time, I was so caught up in the fact that I said something insensitive that it was all I could think about...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、だから覚えてないんだ。
english: Ah, so that's why you don't remember.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うん……たぶん。
english: Y-Yeah... probably.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そんなに気にすることなかったのに。
無神経なこと言われたなんて、
当時も今も全然思ってないし。
english: You really didn't need to worry about it so much. I didn't think it was an insensitive comment back then, and I certainly don't think so now.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そ、そっか……。
あいかわらず、優しいね。
english: I-I see... You're as kind as ever.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なるほど、そういうことだったのか）
english: (Oh, I see, that's what it was about.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それなのに澪のヤツ、
　変な勘違いしやがって……）
english: (And yet Mio went and had some weird misunderstanding...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
やっと見つけた！
これや、これ！
english:
I finally found it!
This one, this one!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
雑誌？
それがどうかしたのか？
english:
A magazine?
What's so special about that?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あっ……ちょ、ちょっと待って澪ちゃん！
english: Ah... w-wait a minute, Mio-chan!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: これ！　ほらかおりちゃん！！
english: This! Look, Kaori-chan!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Eh…?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
english: Ah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えええええッ！？
english: Eeeeh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なっ、なんで雑誌の表紙に、
小弓場さんが！？
english: Wh-Why is Koyuba-san on the cover of a magazine!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
これ、かおりちゃんですよね？
ソックリさんやないですよね！？
english: This is you, right, Kaori-chan? It's not just a look-alike, right!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ええと……あの……。
english: Umm... well...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、それは私で間違いないです。
english: Yes, it's definitely me.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
<color=#GF_TIPS_122>やっぱり、アイドルの小弓場かおりちゃん</color>や！
ずっと「見たことある」て思てたんです！
english: <color=#GF_TIPS_122>I knew it, it's the idol Kaori Koyuba-chan!</color> I kept thinking I'd 'seen her somewhere before'!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: げ、芸能人だったの！？
english: Y-You're a celebrity!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんなん、慎ちゃん。
全然わからんかったん？
english: What's with you, Shin-chan. You didn't realize at all?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえだってすぐには
気づけやんかったやろ。
english: You didn't realize right away either, did you?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: だって私、アイドルに疎いし。
english: Well, I'm not really familiar with idols.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それはオレも一緒だ。
english: I'm the same.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ……！
もしかして知らんふりしといた方が
良かったですか！？
english: Ah...! Maybe it would have been better if I pretended not to know!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ううん、気づいてもらえたのは
素直に嬉しいよ。
english: No, I'm honestly happy that you noticed.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ただ……お仕事のこと話すと、
説明しないといけないことが
いろいろ出てきちゃうかなって……。
english: It's just... if I talk about my job, there are a lot of things I'd have to explain, so I thought...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
それに、この島に今来ていることは、
まだ内緒にしておかないといけないから。
english: Besides, I still have to keep it a secret that I'm currently on this island.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そういえば小弓場さん、
　宿泊先は役場が用意してるって言ってたな）
english: (Come to think of it, Koyuba-san mentioned that the town hall prepared her accommodation.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もしかして、島に戻ってきたのは
アイドル絡みの仕事で？
english: So you came back to the island because of your idol work?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、そんな感じ。
english: Yeah, something like that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そないなこと聞いたらアカンで、慎ちゃん。
守秘義務っちゅうもんがあるんやからな。
english: You shouldn't ask things like that, Shin-chan. She has a duty of confidentiality, you know.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえ、そんな言葉どこで覚えたんや。
english: Where did you even learn that word?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ねえねえ、かおりちゃん。
なんかアイドルらしいことやってみて
もらえませんか？
english: Hey, hey, Kaori-chan. Could you try doing something idol-like for us?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ええ！？　アイドルらしいこと！？
english: Eh!?! Something idol-like!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえ、なかなかぶっ込むな……。
english: You really don't hold back, do you...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
だって、アイドルの人と話せる機会ら
滅多にあらへんし。
english: Well, it's not every day you get the chance to talk to an idol.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: え、ええっと……。
english: U-Umm...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん、コイツの無茶振りに無理して
付き合う必要無いよ。
english: Koyuba-san, you don't have to force yourself to go along with her unreasonable requests.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ううん、大丈夫、頑張る！
english: No, it's okay. I'll do my best!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （これがプロ意識ってやつか……）
english: (So this is what they call professionalism...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
……んっんー。
じゃあ、いきます。
english: ...Ahem. Alright, here I go.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あなたの心にかおリンリン。
かおリンこと、小弓場かおりです。
english: Ringing right into your heart. I'm Kaori Koyuba, also known as Kaorin.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今回は、日都ヶ島の夏祭りで
シークレットソロライブをするために
来ました～～～～。
english: This time, I've come to Hitogashima's summer festival to perform a secret solo live show~~~~.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……って感じです。
english: ...Something like that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うわァ～……！
ほんまもんのアイドルやァ～！
なあ、慎ちゃん？
english: Whoa~...! She's a real live idol~! Right, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お、おう……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うぅ……恥ずかしい。
english: Uu… I'm so embarrassed.

japanese: 6.守るべき人
english: 6. The One to Protect

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あの後、オレと澪は小弓場さんと別れ、
　葬儀場に向かった）
english: (After that, Mio and I parted ways with Koyuba-san, and headed to the funeral hall.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（三度目の葬儀……
　やっぱりアランや参列者の言動は、
　オレの知ってる２２日のものと同じだった）
english: (The third funeral... As expected, the words and actions of Alain and the attendees were exactly the same as the 22nd I know.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ、慎ちゃん。
ここにおったんやな。
english: Ah, Shin-chan. So this is where you were.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、うん。
どうした？　オレに用事か？
english:
Yeah, yeah.
What's up? You need something?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お父さんが、式も一段落したから
慎ちゃんと一緒に休んでこいって。
english: Dad said that since the ceremony has settled down, I should go take a break with Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうか。
english: I see.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それにしても、かおりちゃんのこと
驚いてしもたわ。
english: Still, I was really surprised about Kaori-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
え？
あ、ああ、そうだな。
english: Huh? A-Ah, yeah, I guess so.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 今頃旅館なんかな？
english: I wonder if she's at the inn by now?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっきスマホ見たら
「無事着きました」ってメールが届いてた。
english: When I checked my phone earlier, I had a message saying 'I arrived safely'.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: いつの間にか連絡先交換しちゃあるし……。
english: You exchanged contact info before I even noticed...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今頃、ライブの打ち合わせしてんじゃないか？
商工会の人と宿で待ち合わせしてるって
言ってたし。
english: She's probably having a meeting about the live show right now, isn't she? She said she was meeting up with the Chamber of Commerce people at the inn.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ああ、せやったね。
english: Ah, right.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まさか同級生が、
人気アイドルになってるなんてなァ……。
english: To think a classmate would become a popular idol...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんもかおりちゃんのこと知ったら、
びっくりしたやろなァ。
english: If Onee-chan found out about Kaori-chan, I bet she'd be surprised too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
大好きなお祭りで
同級生がライブやるなんて聞いたら、
最前列で見たがったんやない？
english: If she heard that her classmate was doing a live show at the festival she loves so much, she'd definitely want to watch from the front row, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はは、そうやな。
「早よ祭りの日にならんかな～」って
毎日のように言ってたかもな。
english: Haha, yeah. She'd probably be saying 'I can't wait for the festival~' almost every day.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うんうん、目に浮かぶわァ。
english: Yeah, I can picture it.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃんも、
お祭りめっちゃ楽しみにしとったな。
english: Kaori-chan was really looking forward to the festival too, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
それじゃあ……はい。
これが、<color=#GF_TIPS_066>ライブ案内</color>のチラシ。
english: Well then... here. This is the flyer with the <color=#GF_TIPS_066>live show info</color>.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ありがとう。
english: Thanks.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あと、グッズも良かったら……どうぞ。
これ持ってライブに来てくれたら嬉しいです。
english: Also, if you'd like... here's some merch. I'd be happy if you brought it with you to the live show.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ありがとうございます。
絶対、観にいきます！
english:
Thank you!
I'll definitely go!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（「トークショー＆ライブのご案内」……
　トークショーもあるのか）
english: ('Talk Show & Live Info'... There's a talk show too?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あっ、慎ちゃん大変や！
このこと、お父さんにも言わんと！
english: Ah, Shin-chan, this is a big deal! We have to tell Dad about this!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんで？
english: Why?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんでって……
かおりちゃん目当てのファンが
ようけ来るんやろ？
english: What do you mean, 'why'... There's gonna be a ton of fans coming just to see Kaori-chan, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほな店の食材なんかも
ようけ用意しとかんと、足りんように
なってしまうかもしれやんやん。
english: Then we have to prepare a lot of ingredients for the restaurant too, or we might run out.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あっ、それは大丈夫だと思うよ？
english: Ah, I think that'll be fine.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今回のライブ、場所については
シークレットなんだ。
english: The location for this live show is a secret.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
でも、私も商工会の人達も、
たくさんの人に観てもらいたいって
思っててね。
english: But both the Chamber of Commerce people and I want a lot of people to watch it.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ライブはネット配信で
誰でも見られるようにするつもりなの。
english:
We're planning to stream it online 
so anyone can watch.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: わあ、絶対ファンの人ら喜びますよ！
english: Wow, the fans will be so happy!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、いろんな人に日都ヶ島の祭りを知ってもらう、
いいきっかけにもなるんじゃないか？
english: Yeah, wouldn't it be a good opportunity for lots of people to learn about Hitogashima's festival?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、今回はそういう町おこしも兼ねてるの。
english: Yeah, it's also part of the town revitalization.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
本当は、シークレットにしない方が
大勢の人が集まってくれると思うんだけど……。
english: Honestly, I think we'd get a bigger crowd if we didn't make it a secret, but...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あー……あまりにもようけ人が来てしもたら、
島の人だけやと対応しきれやんかも。
english: Ah... if too many people came, the islanders might not be able to handle it on their own.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん……。
だからシークレットでってことになったんだ。
english: Yeah... That's why we decided to keep it a secret.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でもこんな小さな島のお祭りで、
ようライブやる気になれましたね？
english: But what made you want to do a live show at such a small island festival?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
無理をしてでもやりたいって、
私が事務所にお願いしたんだ。
english: I begged my agency to let me do it, even if it was unreasonable.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: へえ、そうなんだ？
english: Oh, really?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
アイドルになった今だから、
日都ヶ島の役に立てることもあるんだって。
english: I felt that because I'm an idol now, there might be things I can do to help Hitogashima.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私はこの島に育てられたから……
こういう形で恩返しできることが嬉しいの。
english: I was raised on this island... so I'm happy to be able to give back in this way.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの時は小弓場さんの気持ちが、
よく伝わってきたよ。
english: Back then, Koyuba-san's feelings really came across to me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
本気で島に恩返ししたい、
そんな意気込みが感じられたし。
english: I could really feel her determination to earnestly give back to the island.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん……ホンマにこの島のこと、
大切に思うてくれてたんやろなァ。
english: Yeah… She really must care about this island.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……だよな。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だからこそ、彼女を
　見殺しにするわけにはいかない）
english: (That's why I can't just let her die.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あの夜を繰り返しちゃいけないんだ）
english: (I can't let that night repeat.)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 澪のこと……守っちゃってね……。
english: Protect Mio... okay...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん？
english: Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮に託された……澪）
english: (Mio... entrusted to me by Ushio.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そして、島を想って帰省した
　同級生の小弓場さん）
english: (And our classmate, Koyuba-san, who returned home out of love for the island.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（再会したばかりでも、
　彼女だって大切な友人の一人だ）
english: (Even if we only just reunited, she's still one of my precious friends.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （それなら……守ってあげないとな）
english: (If so... I have to protect her.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（フカンしろ。
　オレがすべきことは……）
english: (Take a bird's-eye view. What I need to do is...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（とにかく今日を生きのびること。
　そして……）
english: (First of all, survive today. And then...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（できるだけ大勢の人たちを、
　影から守ることだ）
english: (Protect as many people as possible from the Shadows.)

japanese: 7.こゆばチャンネル①
english: 7. Koyuba Channel ①

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: は、はい、小弓場です！
english: Y-Yes, this is Koyuba!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、小弓場さん。
ごめんな、こんな夜中に。
english: Ah, Koyuba-san. Sorry for calling so late at night.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ううん、気にしないで！
english: No, don't worry!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうしたの？　何か慌ててるみたいだけど。
english: What's wrong? You seem flustered.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
え、えっと、網代くんから電話が来るなんて
思ってなかったから緊張しちゃって……。
english: U-Um, I wasn't expecting a call from Ajiro-kun, so I got a little nervous...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これくらいで緊張してて、
　よくアイドルなんて出来るな……）
english: (If she gets nervous over something like this, how does she even manage to be an idol...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、もう大丈夫、落ち着いた。
english: Yeah, I'm fine now. I've calmed down.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今、少し時間大丈夫？
english: Do you have time right now?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ごめんなさい。あんまり長くは話せないんだ。
これから、やることがあって。
english: I'm sorry. I can't talk for very long. I have something to do right after this.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
え……？
まさか、これからどこかに出かけるとか？
english: Huh...? Don't tell me you're going out somewhere now?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、違うの！
少し仕事が残ってて……
部屋で、その準備をするだけ。
english: Ah, no! I just have a little work left... I'm just going to prepare for it in my room.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そっか。
こんな遅くまで大変だね。
english: I see. Must be tough working so late.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ううん……。
やりたくてやってることだから。
english:
No…
I'm doing this because I want to.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
本当に心配しなくて大丈夫だよ？
網代くんに言われた通り、暗くなってからは
外に出ないようにしてるから。
english: You really don't need to worry, okay? Just like Ajiro-kun told me, I'm making sure not to go out after dark.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ありがとう。
それなら良かった。
english:
Thank you.
That's good then.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
本当は、ＳＮＳ用の写真を撮りに行こうかなァ
なんて思ってたんだけどね。
星空とか――
english: Actually, I was thinking about going to take some photos for social media. Like the starry sky or--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あッ、それは……！
english: Ah, that's…!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、わかってる。
ちょっとそう思っただけで、
外に出るつもりはないよ。
english:
Yeah, I know.
I was just thinking about it,
but I'm not going out.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ごめんね。
そこまで焦っちゃうとは思わなくて。
english: Sorry. I didn't think you'd panic that much.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あはは……こっちこそ、ごめん。
どうしても、気になって。
english: Ahaha... sorry about that. I just couldn't help but worry.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ありがとう。
絶対、外には出ないから安心してね。
english:
Thank you.
I definitely won't go out, so please rest easy.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、うん。
english: Ah, yeah.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、そろそろ……。
english: Ah, it's about time…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
忙しいとこ悪かったね。
それじゃ、また。
english: Sorry for bothering you when you're busy. Well then, see ya.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、おやすみなさい。
english: Yeah, goodnight.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （よし、次は……）
english: (Alright, next…)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ハイこちら正義の味方ァ！
english: Hey, this is the Hero of Justice!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もしもし、凸村さん？
english: Hello? Totsumura-san?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あァ慎平くん！
なんやの。オレ読書中で忙しいんやけど。
english: Ah, Shinpei-kun! What is it? I'm busy reading.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 読書って……何読んでるんです？
english: Reading… What are you reading?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
んん？　今月のゲームプレイボーイや。
かおりちゃんのグラビア載ってるさけ……。
english: Hm? This month's Weekly Playboy. It's got a gravure spread of Kaori-chan in it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
えっ！！
そ、そうでしたか……。
english: Eh!! I-I see...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（本物が島にいるって知ったら、
　めちゃくちゃびっくりするだろうな……）
english: (If he knew the real one was on the island, he'd be completely blown away...)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
で？　用事はなんや。
雑談するために電話したんとちゃうやろな？
english: So? What do you want? You didn't just call to chat, did you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、ええっと……！
実は港のほうで乱闘騒ぎが起こってて。
english: Ah, umm...! Actually, there's a brawl happening down at the harbor.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
……な、何やてェ！？
乱闘騒ぎィ！！？
english: ...Wh-What did you say!? A brawl!!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
わかった、すぐに行く！
慎平くんも気ィつけてや！
english: Got it, I'm heading there right away! You be careful too, Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……お願いしますっ！
english: ...I'm counting on you!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ふう……。
english: Phew…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これで大丈夫か？
　凸村さんに関しては、そうだと思いたい……）
english: (Is this okay? I'd like to think so, as far as Totsumura-san goes...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ヤバイかな？
ウソの通報してまったけど……。
english: ...Is this bad? I made a fake report, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でもこれで、凸村さんはここに来ないから
助かる筈だ。
english: But with this, Totsumura-san won't come here, so he should be saved.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （窓には明日、こっちから連絡すると伝えてある）
english: (I already told Sou I'd contact him tomorrow.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あとは要らないアプリや写真なんかを消して。
　ストレージを稼ぐ……）
english: (Now I just need to delete unnecessary apps and photos. To free up storage space...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（万が一着信がないように機内モード。
　フル充電。モバイルバッテリーにもつないでおく）
english: (Airplane mode, just in case a call comes in. Fully charged. And I'll connect it to a mobile battery.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （幸い、あいつが来る時間はわかってる）
english: (Luckily, I know what time she'll come.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（見つからないように、スマホを植木に隠して、
　録画開始）
english: (Hide the smartphone in the potted plant so she doesn't find it, and start recording.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪の影を撮影して、証拠をおさえてやる……！！）
english: (I'll film Mio's Shadow and get the evidence...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あとは……どんなに気分が悪くても
　外の空気を吸いに行ったり絶対にしない。
　そしたら大丈夫だ…………）
english: (After that... no matter how sick I feel, I absolutely won't go outside for fresh air. Then it'll be fine...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （次は何をすればいい……フカンしろ……！）
english: (What should I do next... take a bird's-eye view...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そういえば澪は……部屋にいるのか？）
english: (Oh right, Mio… is she in her room?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （風呂に入ってるのか）
english: (Is she taking a bath?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪！
いるよな……？
english:
Mio!
You're there, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
んー？
どうしたん？　慎ちゃん。
english: Hmm? What's wrong, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや、いるならいいんだ。
ちゃんと肩まで浸かれよ？
english: No, if you're there, that's fine. Make sure you soak up to your shoulders, okay?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
う、うん……。
言われやんでもそうするけど。
english: Y-Yeah... I was going to do that even if you didn't tell me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……澪は無事だ）
english: (…Mio is safe)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（できる限りの対策は講じたけど……
　気は抜かないようにしよう）
english: (I've taken as many countermeasures as possible... But I shouldn't let my guard down.)

japanese: 小弓場　かおり
english: Kaori Koyuba

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: マイク入ってるかな？
english: Is the mic on?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
……大丈夫？
ありがとうっ。
english: ...Is it okay? Thanks.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: それじゃ、はじめるよ～？
english: Well then, let's start~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: みんな、こんばんわ～～～！
english: Good evening, everyone~~~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
小弓場かおりの『<color=#GF_TIPS_088>こゆばチャンネル</color>』！
今夜もちょっとだけ夜ふかしして、
私と一緒におしゃべりしましょう！
english: It's Kaori Koyuba's '<color=#GF_TIPS_088>Koyuba Channel</color>'! Let's stay up a little late again tonight and chat together!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
は～い、よろしく～！
たくさんのお返事コメント
ありがとね～！
english: Yeees, thanks for having me~! Thanks for all the reply comments~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
コメント、できる限り応えていくから、
たくさん送ってくれたら嬉しいで～す。
english: I'll try to answer as many comments as I can, so I'd be happy if you sent a lot~.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ところで、みんな。
今日の配信、いつもとちょっと違うんだけど
何が違うかわかるかな？
english:
By the way, everyone.
Tonight's stream is a bit different from usual,
do you know what's different?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……そう、配信してる場所！
english: …That's right, the location!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今私は、とある場所に来ていま～す。
いったいどこでしょう？
english: Right now, I'm at a certain place~. Where could it be?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
コメントで当てちゃう人いるかなァ？
どれどれ～？
english: I wonder if anyone can guess in the comments? Let's see~

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふふ、そうです。
「旅館の部屋」です！
どこにある旅館でしょ～？
english: Hehe, that's right. It's an 'inn room'! I wonder where this inn is~?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
……鋭い！　海の近くなんだよね。
となると日本海？　太平洋？
それとも瀬戸内海かな？
english: ...Sharp! It is near the sea. So, the Sea of Japan? The Pacific Ocean? Or maybe the Seto Inland Sea?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっ、早く答えを言えって？
もーっ、せっかちさんがいるぞ。
english: Eh, you want me to just say the answer already? Jeez, we have some impatient people here.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
じゃあ正解言っちゃおうかな。
答えは……。
english: Then maybe I'll just give the correct answer. The answer is...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……ヒミツです。
english: …A secret.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
わ～～～ッ、ごめんなさい！
ホント「え～～ッ！」だよね！
english: Waaaah, I'm sorry! I know, right, 'Eeeeh!'?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
実は私、ここで、
とある計画を進めてるの。
english:
Actually, I'm here to
carry out a certain plan.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
詳細はまだヒミツなんだけど、
絶対このチャンネルでみんなに報告するから、
もう少しだけ待っててね！
english: The details are still a secret, but I'll definitely announce it to everyone on this channel, so please wait just a little longer!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっ、「ＰＶ数稼ぐ気か」って？
う～ん、そういうわけじゃないけど……。
english: Eh, 'Are you just trying to get more views?' Hmm, that's not really it, but...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ふふ、ちょっと狙ってるかも。
english: Haha, maybe a little.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ここでやることは
リスナーのみんなにはもちろん、
たくさんの人に観てもらいたいんだ。
english: What I'm doing here, I want my listeners to see it, of course, but I also want as many people as possible to see it.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
なので皆さん！
チャンネル公式ＳＮＳの拡散や
応援コメント、バンバンお願いしま～す！
english: So everyone! Please share the channel's official social media and send lots of supportive comments!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: えっ、もうしてくれてる？
english: Eh, you already did?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ……ホントだ！
ＰＶ数といいねの数がどんどん上がってる！
english: Ah... you really did! The views and likes are going up and up!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
わ～～～ッ！
みんな、ありがとう！
english:
Wahhh~!
Thank you all!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
期待に応えられるように頑張るね！
続報、お楽しみに～！
english:
I'll do my best to meet your expectations!
Stay tuned for updates~!

japanese: 8.かおりの頼み事
english: 8. Kaori's Request
