japanese: 7月23日
english: July 23rd

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（昨日のスマホ……。
　録画の結果は、どうだ？）
english: (The smartphone from yesterday... How did the recording turn out?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（頼む……できるなら、
　何も映ってないでくれ……）
english: (Please... if possible, let there be nothing on it...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
くっそ……。
バッチリ写っとるやんけ……
あのニセモノの動画……。
english: Dammit... It's perfectly clear... The video of that fake...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……撮れてしまった以上、
　このまま見過ごすわけにはいかないか）
english: (...Now that I've recorded it, I can't just ignore it.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、ちょっとこれ見てくれ。
english: Mio, take a look at this for a second.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: スマホ？　なになに？
english: A smartphone? What is it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 昨日の夜撮った動画なんやけど。
english: It's a video I took last night.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 昨日の夜？　なに撮ったん？
english: Last night? What did you film?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 観ればわかるから。
english: You'll understand when you watch it.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: な、なんなん一体……？
english: Wh-What in the world...?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
え……これ……誰……！？
わ……私なん！？
english: Eh... who... is this...!? I-Is it me!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
昨日の夜て嘘やろ？
だって私、昨日の夜は制服着て
外になんか出てやんし。
english: You're lying about it being last night, right? Because I didn't go outside in my uniform last night.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
昨日の夜に撮ったんはホンマや。
でも、ここに映ってるんは澪やない。
english:
It really was last night.
But the person in the video isn't Mio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
この時間、
おまえは風呂に入ってたからな。
english: At this time, you were taking a bath.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ほな、これって……。
english: Then… what is this…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なァ……影の病って知ってるな？
english: Hey... you know about the Shadow Sickness, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 影の病って、じゃあ、これ！
english: The Shadow Sickness... then, this is...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
正直……バカげてると思うよ。
でも実際、見てしもたらな……。
english: Honestly... I think it's ridiculous too. But when you actually see it...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 見たって、何を？
english: See what?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレな。
影が人を……コピーする所を見たんや。
english: I saw it. I saw a Shadow... copying a person.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: コピー……？
english: Copying…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あァ。
あれは、写し取ってた……。
影が人間の姿になっていくのを見た。
english: Yeah. It was copying them... I saw a Shadow turning into a human.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪！！
おまえ、しばらくオレから離れんな！
english: Mio!! Don't leave my side for a while!

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Eh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影がどんなヤツらなんかは、
ようわからん。
english: I don't really know what kind of guys the Shadows are.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、人に化けてコソコソしとるあたり、
人目につく所で襲って来たりはせえへんはずや。
english: But since they disguise themselves as humans and sneak around, they probably won't attack in places where they'd be seen.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
一人になるんは危険すぎる。
しばらくは一緒に行動しよう。
english:
Being alone is too dangerous.
Let's stick together for a while.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
う……うん、わかった。
慎ちゃんの言うとおりにする。
english: Y-Yeah, okay. I'll do what you say, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、そうしてくれ。
english: Yeah, do that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんのスマホ鳴っとるで。
電話ちゃう？
english: Shin-chan, your phone is ringing. Isn't it a call?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、小弓場さんからみたいや。
english: Ah, it looks like it's from Koyuba-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ちょっと電話に出てくるわ。
english: I'm gonna go answer this.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: むぅ……。
english: Mmm…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんや、その目……。
english: What's with that look?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私に離れるな言うたん、
慎ちゃんとちゃうかった？
english: Weren't you the one who told me not to leave your side, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
自分の部屋に行って話すだけや。
外に出るわけやない。
english:
I'm just going to my room to talk.
I won't be going out.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: まあ、別にええけど……。
english: Well, it's fine by me…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もしもし？
english: Hello?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
お、お、おはよう網代くん、小弓場です。
今……大丈夫ですか？
english: G-G-Good morning Ajiro-kun, this is Koyuba. Is now... a good time?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、大丈夫。
昨日は、忙しいとこ電話してごめん。
english:
Ah, I'm fine.
I'm sorry for calling you yesterday when you were busy.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ううん、平気。
わ、私、網代くんとお話できて……。
english: No, it's fine. I-I was able to talk with Ajiro-kun...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん？
english: Huh?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、う、う、うう～……。
english: U-U-U-Uu~...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: こ、小弓場さん、どうした？
english: K-Koyuba-san, what's wrong?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: なんでもないです……。
english: It's nothing…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そ、そう？
それでオレに何か用事？
english: I-Is that so? So, did you need something from me?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、ちょっと相談があって。
english: Yeah, I had something I wanted to ask you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 相談？　なんだろ。
english: Ask me? What is it?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
明日のトークショーの中で、
日都ヶ島の名所について話すコーナーが
あるんだけど……。
english: In tomorrow's talk show, there's a segment where I talk about Hitogashima's famous spots...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
それに向けて、久しぶりに
島内をじっくり散策しておきたいなって
思ってるんだ。
english: To prepare for that, I was thinking I'd like to take my time and explore the island for the first time in a while.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: でもそれをするには外に出ないといけないし……。
english: But to do that, I need to go outside…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: できれば一人では出歩いて欲しくないかな……。
english: If possible, I'd rather you didn't walk around alone...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、それで……できれば、なんだけど、
網代くんに案内役をお願いできないかなって。
english: Yeah, so... if possible, I was wondering if I could ask Ajiro-kun to be my guide.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それって、一緒に名所を回って、
軽く説明するって感じ？
english: So, like, going around the famous spots together and giving a brief explanation?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 説明はサラっとでいいんだけど……。
english: Just a quick explanation would be fine…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そういうのってオレなんかより、
商工会の人に頼んだ方が良くないか？
english: Wouldn't it be better to ask someone from the Chamber of Commerce for something like that, rather than me?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
できれば名所と言われる場所について、
島の人たちの生の声をインタビューして
回りたいの。
english: If possible, I'd like to go around and interview the islanders to get their raw opinions on the places considered famous spots.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
その場合、商工会の人よりも島の人と
同じ目線に立てる網代くんが一緒にいてくれた方が、
みんなも話しやすいと思って。
english: In that case, I thought it would be easier for everyone to talk if Ajiro-kun, who can stand on the same level as the islanders, was with me rather than someone from the Chamber of Commerce.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: う～ん、そんなもんかな……？
english: Hmm, is that how it works...?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ダメ、かな？
english: Is it not okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや、絶対ダメってわけじゃないけど……。
english: No, it's not like it's absolutely out of the question, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どうしよう？
　これから小早川さん家に行っていろいろと
　確認しようと思ってたんだけど……）
english: (What should I do? I was planning to go to Kobayakawa-san's house now to check on a few things, but...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あのぉ……実は、もう迎えにきてたりして。
english: Umm... actually, I'm already here to pick you up.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Eh…!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （迎えにって……まさか、もう家の近くに！？）
english: (They came to pick me up... could it be they're already nearby!?)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: や、やっほー、来ちゃいました……。
english: Y-yeah, I'm here...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ホンマにおった……。
english: You really are here...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃん、
慎ちゃんに会いに来たん？
english: Kaori-chan, did you come to see Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: み、澪、いつの間に！？
english: M-Mio, when did you get here!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
てか、人の部屋へ勝手に
入ってくんなって。
english: I mean, don't just barge into someone's room.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 偶然通りかかっただけやし。
english: I just happened to be passing by.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
人の部屋の中を
偶然通りかかるとかあるかよ。
english: You don't just happen to pass by inside someone's room.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そんなこともうどうでもええねん。
それよりかおりちゃん、
なんの用でここへ？
english: Whatever, that doesn't matter. Anyway, Kaori-chan, what brings you here?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、なんかトークショーのネタ集めで、
島ん中を案内して欲しいんやて。
english: Ah, she wants me to show her around the island to gather material for her talk show.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そんなことまでするんや？
アイドルも大変なんやね。
english: You have to do all that? Being an idol is tough, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（彼女は一度、影に殺されている。
　昨日は無事に回避できたからといって
　安心していいわけじゃない）
english: (She was killed by a Shadow once. Just because we avoided it yesterday doesn't mean we can let our guard down.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そういうわけやから、
オレちょっと小弓場さんに島を案内してくる
つもりやけど……。
english: So because of that, I was planning to show Koyuba-san around the island...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪も一緒に行かへんか？
english: Do you want to come with us, Mio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ、私も行ってええの？
english: Eh, is it okay if I come too?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっき言っただろ。
しばらくは一緒に行動しよって。
english: Didn't I just say we should stick together for a while?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あっ、そっか。
english: Ah, right.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほな、準備してくる！
ちょっと待っててな！
english: Then I'll go get ready! Wait for me a bit!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なるべく急ぎでな。
english: Try to hurry.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: は～～い！
english: Okaaay!

japanese: 9.島の散策
english: 9. Island Stroll

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん、お待たせ。
english: Koyuba-san, sorry to keep you waiting.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: すみません、準備に手間取ってしもて。
english: I'm sorry, getting ready took a little longer than expected.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ううん、気にしないで。
急に来ちゃった私が悪いんだから。
english: No, don't worry about it. It's my fault for showing up so suddenly.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや、本当に急でびっくりしたよ。
english: Yeah, I was really surprised by how sudden it was.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ご、ごめんなさい。
ちょっと、お願いしたいことも
あったから……。
english: I-I'm sorry. There was actually something I wanted to ask before we go...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お願いしたいこと、ですか？
english: Something you wanted to ask?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
本当は落ち着いてからって思ってたんだけど、
私、お祭りが終わったらすぐに東京に戻らないと
いけないし……。
english: I originally thought I should wait until things settled down, but I have to go back to Tokyo right after the festival...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私の勝手な都合で
本当にごめんなさいなんだけど――
english: I'm really sorry for being so selfish, but...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
お父さんのアランさんにご挨拶と、
あと潮さんに……。
english: I wanted to say hello to Alain-san, and also... to Ushio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あっ、うん、ありがとう。
アランはもう店にいるから行ってみようか。
english: Ah, yeah, thanks. Alain's already at the cafe, so let's go see him.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おはよう、アラン。
english: Good morning, Alain.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
おはよう。
澪も一緒やけどどっか出かけるんか？
english: Good morning. You're heading out somewhere with Mio?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、そうなんやけど……。
english: Ah, yeah, but...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あの、おはようございます。
english: Um, good morning.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああ、おはよう。
慎平か澪の知り合いさんかいな？
english: Ah, good morning. A friend of Shinpei or Mio's?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、この子は、
オレや潮と同じ小学校やった小弓場さん。
７年ぶりで島に帰ってきてるんよ。
english: Ah, this is Koyuba-san. She went to the same elementary school as me and Ushio. She's back on the island for the first time in seven years.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
お店の準備中でお忙しいところ、
すみません。
小弓場かおりといいます。
english: I'm sorry for disturbing you while you're busy getting ready. My name is Kaori Koyuba.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああ、小弓場さんとこの！
これはこれはご丁寧にどうも。
english: Ah, the Koyuba family's! Well, well, thank you for the polite greeting.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
私は父親のアラン。
この洋食コフネの店主や。
english: I'm her father, Alain. I'm the owner of this Cafe Kofune.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
はい、覚えてます！
この島に住んでた頃、
両親と食べに来ていましたので！
english: Yes, I remember! When I lived on this island, my parents and I used to come eat here!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ハハ、せやったなァ。
私もよう覚えちゃあるでよ。
english: Haha, that's right. I remember that well too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
本当ですか！
嬉しい……。
english: Really?! I'm so happy...

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: 澪、今から三人で出かけるんか？
english: Mio, are the three of you heading out now?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん、そうなんやけど、
その前にかおりちゃんがお姉ちゃんに……。
english: Yeah, but before that, Kaori-chan wanted to see Sis...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あの……潮さんにお線香を
あげさせてもらいたくて。
構いませんか？
english: Um... I wanted to offer some incense to Ushio-san. Is that alright?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああ、もちろん。
潮も喜びよるやいしょ。
english: Ah, of course. Ushio will be happy too.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: 澪、案内したってくれるか。
english: Mio, can you show her the way?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ありがとう。
お邪魔します。
english: Thank you. Excuse me.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
小弓場さんとこの子……
えらいべっぴんさんになったなァ。
english: That Koyuba girl... She's grown into quite the beauty.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 東京でアイドル活動してるらしいわ。
english: Apparently she's working as an idol in Tokyo.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
へえ、そうなんか！？
そらすごいな。
english: Oh, is that so?! That's amazing.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今日は島の名所を見て回る案内役を
頼まれたんよ。
このあと澪と一緒に行ってくる。
english: She asked me to be her guide to show her around the island's famous spots. I'll be heading out with Mio after this.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああ、行ってきィ。
店のことは気にしやんでええから。
english: Ah, have fun. You don't need to worry about the cafe.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ありがとう。
あっ、でもその前に、アランに話を聞きたいかも。
english: Thanks. Ah, but before we go, we might want to talk to you, Alain.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: 話？　なんの話や？
english: Talk? About what?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん、祭りのトークショーで
日都ヶ島のプレゼンするんだって。
english: Koyuba-san is doing a presentation on Hitogashima at a talk show during the festival.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
その関係で、これから島の名所を巡るつもり。
行く先々で島の人にも話を聞いてくるよ。
english: Because of that, we're going to tour the island's famous spots. She'll be asking the locals for stories wherever we go.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
そ、それで、まずはここから
話聞こちゅうわけかいな！？
english: S-So, you're starting by hearing a story from me?!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
えらいこっちゃ……。
なに話したらええねん！？
english: Oh boy... What should I even talk about?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
生の声が聞きたい言うてたから、
気楽に答えたらええんちゃうかな。
english: She said she wants to hear raw opinions, so just answering casually should be fine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（きっと小弓場さんは、
　どうしても潮にお線香を
　あげたかったんだろうな……）
english: (I'm sure Koyuba-san really wanted to offer incense to Ushio...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（本当にいい子だな……。
　だからこそ、悲惨な目に遭うのだけは
　回避させてあげないと）
english: (She's really a good kid... That's exactly why I have to at least prevent her from meeting a tragic fate.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（アランから話を聞いたあと、
　小弓場さんの希望を聞きながらいくつか
　名所を巡っているんだけど……）
english: (After hearing Alain's stories, we visited a few famous spots based on Koyuba-san's requests...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
へえ、そんな絶景を独り占めできちゃう
スポットがあるんですか？
い～な～！
english: Wow, there's a spot where you can have such a beautiful view all to yourself? That's amazing!

speaker: 地元の女性
japanese:
せやろ？
他の人にはナイショやで！
english: Right? Keep it a secret from everyone else!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ありがとうございます！
やっぱり地元の人しか知らない穴場って
結構あるんですね。
english: Thank you! I guess there really are quite a few hidden spots that only the locals know about.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: メモメモ……。
english: Jotting this down...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そういうお話が聞きたかったんです。
声をかけさせてもらって正解でした。
english: That's exactly the kind of story I wanted to hear. I'm glad I reached out to you.

speaker: 地元の女性
japanese:
うふふ……。
またいつでも声かけてなァ。
english: Hehehe... Feel free to talk to me anytime.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
はい！
ありがとうございました！
english: Yes! Thank you very much!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんか……。
english: Somehow...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
……あ、すみませ～ん！
ちょっとお話聞かせてもらって
いいですか～？
english: ...Ah, excuse me! Do you mind if I ask you a few questions?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私の知ってる昔のかおりちゃんとは、
ちょっと違うんやな……。
english: She's a bit different from the Kaori-chan I used to know...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、アイドルモードってやつだろ。
english: Yeah, that's her \"idol mode.\"

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
実は今、この島のことをもっと知りたくて
地元の方々にいろいろとお話を
聞いて回ってるんですけど――
english: Actually, I want to learn more about this island right now, so I've been going around asking the locals various things--

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも……何かすごない？
めっちゃ精力的って言うか……。
english: But... isn't she amazing? She's super energetic, or rather...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、ああ……。
オレ、ついてくる必要あったのかな？
english: Y-Yeah... Did I really need to tag along?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
まあ今んとこ、
私らの出る幕はなさそやね……。
english: Well, for now, it doesn't look like there's any room for us to step in...

speaker: 男の声（凸村哲）
japanese: あっ、慎平くん！
english: Ah, Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うわ！？
english: Whoa!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
なんや昨日の通報はッ！？
まるっきりウソやったやないか！
english: What was with that report yesterday!? It was a complete lie, wasn't it!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、あれは……！
english: A-About that...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
哲さん、こんにちは！
また油売ってるんですか？
english: Tetsu-san, hello! Are you slacking off again?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
笑顔で辛辣なこと言わんといてェな。
今はちゃんと仕事しとんねん。
巡回なん、見てわからん？
english: Don't say such harsh things with a smile. I'm working properly right now. Can't you tell I'm on patrol?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
へえ、哲さんが暑い中巡回に出るやて
珍しいですね。
何かあったんですか？
english: Huh, Tetsu-san going on patrol in this heat is pretty rare. Did something happen?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ああ、それがな。
さっき汐見のおばちゃんから
通報があってよォ――
english: Ah, about that. I just got a report from Shiomi-san--

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くん、澪ちゃん！
お待たせ。
english: Shinpei-kun, Mio-chan! Sorry to keep you waiting.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
なんや、
澪ちゃんと二人やなかったんか。
english: What, you weren't just here with Mio-chan?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あっ、こんにちは。
駐在さんですか？
english: Ah, hello. Are you the local police officer?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ああ、せやで。
この島の正義の味方……ってアレ？
english: Ah, that's right. I'm this island's Hero of Justice... wait, huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
この人は、凸村さん。
自称正義の味方の駐在さん。
english: This is Totsumura-san. The local police officer who calls himself a Hero of Justice.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 凸村さん……うん、覚えた。
english: Totsumura-san... yeah, I remember.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
初めまして凸村さん。
小弓場といいます。
english: Nice to meet you, Totsumura-san. I'm Koyuba.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: よろしくお願いしますね！
english: It's a pleasure to meet you!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: アイドルモードや。
english: Idol mode.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、黙っとけ……。
english: Mio, keep quiet...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃん、
いろいろ聞けたみたいやね。
english: Kaori-chan, looks like you were able to ask a lot of things.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん！
ばっちりメモも取っておいたよ。
english: Yeah! I made sure to take perfect notes.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、なら良かった。
english: Ah, that's good then.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それよか哲さん、
かおりちゃんが挨拶したのに黙ったままて、
失礼なんちゃいます？
english: More importantly, Totsumura-san, Kaori-chan greeted you but you're just standing there silently. Isn't that rude?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: こ、ここ……こここここここ……。
english: K-K-Koy... Koyukoyukoyu...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、どないしよ。
哲さん壊れてもた。
english: Shin-chan, what should we do? Totsumura-san broke.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あの、凸村さん？
english: Um, Totsumura-san?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
こ、小弓場って、
もしかして小弓場かおりちゃんッ！？
english: K-Koyuba, you mean, could it be Kaori Koyuba-chan!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、はい。
もしかして知ってくれてました？
english: Ah, yes. Did you happen to know me?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
知ってるもなんも、
めっちゃファンやし！！
english: Know you? I'm a massive fan!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ほほほ本物やァ！！
なんで超人気アイドルが、
こないなとこに……！？
english: I-I-It's the real deal!! Why is a super popular idol in a place like this...!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
実は私、日都ヶ島出身で……
今は里帰り中なんです。
english: Actually, I'm from Hitogashima... and I'm currently visiting my hometown.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
久しぶりに帰った島のことをもっと知りたくて、
同級生の網代くんに案内してもらってるところ
だったんです。
english: I wanted to learn more about the island since it's been a while, so I was just having my classmate Shinpei-kun show me around.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ひ、日都ヶ島出身……？
慎平くんの同級生……？
english: F-From Hitogashima...? Shinpei-kun's classmate...?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
マ、マジかいな……！
これはチャンスやでェ！！
english: A-Are you serious...! This is my chance!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: よッ……ほッ、とりゃッ……！
english: Yo... ho, hiyah...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （い、いきなり身なりを整え出した！？）
english: (W-Why is he suddenly fixing his appearance!?)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 初めまして、小弓場かおりちゃん。
english: Nice to meet you, Kaori Koyuba-chan.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
この島で唯一の警官……もとい、
正義の味方、凸村哲です。
以後、お見知りおきを。
english: I am the only police officer on this island... or rather, the Hero of Justice, Tetsu Totsumura. A pleasure to make your acquaintance.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふふ、よろしくお願いします。
正義の味方さん。
english: Hehe, nice to meet you, Hero of Justice.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
故郷の島が凸村さんのような
正義の味方に守られてると知って、
とても安心しました。
english: Knowing that my hometown island is protected by a Hero of Justice like you, Totsumura-san, makes me feel very relieved.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ぬァははは～ん！
なんちゅうありがたいお言葉！
english: Nwahahaha~n! What incredibly kind words!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
任せとってください！
正義の味方、この凸村がいれば、
この島は安泰です！
english: Leave it to me! As long as this Totsumura, the Hero of Justice, is here, this island is safe and sound!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 何か、動きがクネクネしとる。
english: His movements are all squirmy.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: カッコつけてるつもりなんやろな……。
english: He's probably trying to look cool...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
かおりちゃんの活躍、
よォ見させてもろてます！
english: I've been closely following all your activities, Kaori-chan!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
テレビはもちろん、雑誌、ラジオに
インターネット……！
至るところで大注目やないですか！
english: TV of course, but also magazines, radio, and the internet...! You're getting massive attention everywhere!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: わぁ、嬉しいです！
english: Wow, I'm so happy!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あっ、せや！
サイン！
サインをこのメモ帳に！
english: Ah, that's right! An autograph! Please sign this notepad!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: それ、仕事用のメモ帳やないですか？
english: Isn't that your notepad for work?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
澪ちゃん、よう覚えとき。
仕事より大切なモンやて、
世の中には山ほどあるんやで。
english: Mio-chan, remember this well. There are mountains of things in this world that are far more important than work.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そんなドヤ顔で言われても……。
english: Even if you say that with such a smug look...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
お話できて良かったです、凸村さん。
インタビューまでさせてもらっちゃって……
ありがとうございました。
english: It was great talking to you, Totsumura-san. Thank you so much for letting me interview you...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
こっちこそありがとうやしょ！
夢のような体験させてもろたさけよ！
サイン、家宝にしますわ！
english: No, thank YOU! You gave me a dream-like experience! I'll make this autograph a family heirloom!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ほな、自分はこれで！
english: Well then, I'll be taking my leave!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: はい、お仕事頑張ってください！
english: Yes, good luck with your work!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さんがあんな風に
　ファンサービスしてる姿をみると、
　やっぱりアイドルなんだって実感するな）
english: (Seeing Koyuba-san do fan service like that, it really hits me that she's an actual idol.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どちらかというと引っ込み思案だった
　昔の小弓場さんとは、まるで別人だ）
english: (She's like a completely different person from the rather introverted Koyuba-san she used to be.)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うぅ……胃が……。
english: U-Ugh... my stomach...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 次はどこに案内しちゃろかな？
english: Where should we guide you to next?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ……澪、ちょっと待って。
喉渇いたし、ここらで休憩にしよか。
english: Ah... Mio, hold on a sec. I'm thirsty, let's take a break around here.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ……？

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ……そうやね！
english: Ah... right!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ずっと外におったし、
そろそろ水分補給しやんとな。
ね、かおりちゃん。
english: We've been outside this whole time, we should probably hydrate soon. Right, Kaori-chan?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うん、賛成。
english: Y-Yeah, I agree.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレ、そこの自販機で買ってくるよ。
二人はなにがいい？
english: I'll go buy something from that vending machine. What do you two want?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ……付き合ってもらってるんだし、
私が買うよ。
english: Ah... since you're keeping me company, I'll buy them.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いいっていいって。
english: It's fine, it's fine.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私サッパリするヤツ。
english: Something refreshing for me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ざっくりやなァ。
小弓場さんは？
english: That's pretty vague. What about you, Koyuba-san?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、えっと……
じゃあ、アイスティーで。
english: Ah, um... Then, iced tea for me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
了解。
それじゃあっちの日陰で待っといて。
english: Got it. Then wait for me in the shade over there.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: は～い。
english: Okaaay.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （小弓場さん、少し疲れたみたいだな）
english: (Koyuba-san seems a bit tired...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（てか、さっき胃が……
　って言ってたような……）
english: (I mean, I think I heard her say her stomach... earlier...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もしかして、
　こうやって人と接するのが苦手なのか？）
english: (Could it be, she's actually not good at interacting with people like this?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、そんなのアイドルで
　慣れてるだろうし……）
english: (No, she's an idol so she should be used to it...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はい、お待たせ。
english: Here, sorry for the wait.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ありがとう、網代くん。
english: Thank you, Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: いただきまーす。
english: Thanks for the drink~.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん、またメモってたの？
english: Koyuba-san, you were taking notes again?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、凸村さんから聞けたお話、
忘れないうちに書き留めておこうと思って。
english: Yeah, I figured I should write down what I heard from Totsumura-san before I forget.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃんって真面目なんやね。
ほんま感心するわァ。
english: You're so diligent, Kaori-chan. I'm honestly impressed.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ううん、そんなことないよ。
english: No, it's nothing like that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そんなことあるって。
慎ちゃんもそう思うやろ？
english: It definitely is. Shin-chan, you think so too, right?

japanese: オレもそう思う
english: I think so too.

japanese: どうメモ取ってるの？
english: How do you take your notes?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、オレもそう思う。
english: Yeah, I think so too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: そ、そんな、網代くんまで……。
english: W-Wow, even you, Shinpei-kun...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トークショーがあると言っても、
もっとざっくりとした知識だけで
いいはずなのにさ。
english: Even though you have a talk show, just having some general knowledge should be enough.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そこまでちゃんとまとめてるなんて、
ほんとえらいと思うよ。
english: To organize it all so properly, I really think that's impressive.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
褒められるようなことじゃないよ。
私、メモでもとってなきゃ、
覚えてられないから……。
english: It's nothing to be praised for. If I don't take notes, I just can't remember things...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それを面倒とも思わず、
ちゃんとやってるんだよね？
やっぱりえらいよ。
english: And you're doing it properly without finding it a hassle, right? That's definitely impressive.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そ……そうかな？
ありがとう。
english: Y... you think so? Thank you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さんって、
どんなふうにメモ取ってるの？
english: How do you take your notes, Koyuba-san?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: えっ……み、見てみる？
english: Eh... y-you want to see?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん、できれば。
english: Yeah, if possible.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ、私も見てみたいです！
english: Ah, I want to see too!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
いいけど……。
あまり期待しないでね？
english: Sure, but... don't expect too much, okay?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
はい、どうぞ。
ほら……こんなふうにして、聞いたことを
そのまま<color=#GF_TIPS_073>メモ</color>してるだけなの。
english: Here you go. See... I just <color=#GF_TIPS_073>note</color> down what I hear exactly as it is.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うわ、めっちゃ綺麗！
english: Wow, it's super neat!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、それにすごくわかりやすい。
english: Yeah, and it's really easy to understand.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そういえば小学校の時もノートが綺麗だって、
　先生に褒められてたような……）
english: (Come to think of it, I feel like the teacher praised her notes back in elementary school too...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
このメモを元に、
トークショーで島のいいところを
たくさん紹介して……。
english: Based on these notes, I'm going to introduce all the great things about the island at the talk show...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
大好きな日都ヶ島を
みんなにも好きになってもらいたいの。
english: I want everyone to come to love my favorite Hitogashima too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ほんと、ありがたい話だよな。
english: That's really something to be grateful for.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あれ？　このメモ帳って……？
english: Huh? This notepad...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
前に見せてくれたキーホルダーと
同じキャラクターのヤツじゃない？
english: Isn't this character the same one as the keychain you showed me before?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、そうなの。
他にもブックカバーとかカード入れとか……
見かけるとつい買っちゃうんだよね。
english: Yeah, that's right. I also have a book cover and a card case... I end up buying them whenever I see them.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 昔から好きだったもんな。
english: You've liked that since a long time ago, huh.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
覚えててくれたんだ！？
……嬉しいな。
english: You remembered!? ...I'm glad.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: むぅ……。
english: Muu...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さん……昔とは違ったように見えるけど、
　やっぱり根っこの部分は変わってないんだな）
english: (Koyuba-san... she might seem different from before, but her core really hasn't changed.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（人と話すのはそんなに得意じゃないのに、
　それでも頑張って
　島の情報を集めてたのか……）
english: (Even though she's not that good at talking to people, she still worked hard to gather information about the island...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しばらく休憩した後、
　オレ達はまた島内のいろんな場所を回って
　インタビューを繰り返し……）
english: (After resting for a while, we went around to various other places on the island and continued our interviews...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （最後に、日都神社へとやってきていた）
english: (Finally, we arrived at Hitogashima Shrine.)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
やっぱり、日都ヶ島といえば
ヒルコ様だよね。
english: After all, when you think of Hitogashima, you think of Hiruko-sama.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん、夏祭りやるんもここやし。
english: Yeah, the summer festival is held here too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（本当は、２３日にここへ来るのは
　避けたいところだったけどな……）
english: (To be honest, I really wanted to avoid coming here on the 23rd...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、時間はあの時より遅い。
　それに今回は、小早川さん一家のことを
　澪はまだ知らない）
english: (But it's later than it was back then. Plus, this time, Mio doesn't know about the Kobayakawa family yet.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もししおりちゃんの影を見かけても、
　すぐに追いかけるようなことは、
　おそらくない……と思う）
english: (Even if she sees Shiori-chan's shadow, she probably won't chase after it immediately... I think.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（何かが起こったとしても、深追いしたり
　人気のないところに行ったりしなければ、
　きっと大丈夫だ）
english: (Even if something happens, as long as we don't chase too far or go anywhere deserted, we should be fine.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今回は小弓場さんもいる……。
　気を引き締めていこう）
english: (Plus, Koyuba-san is with us this time... I need to stay on my guard.)

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
やあ、こんにちは。
なんだか意外な組み合わせやね。
english: Oh, hello there. What an unexpected combination.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 雁切さん、こんにちは。
english: Hello, Karikiri-san.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
こんにちは。
昨日はありがとうございました！
english: Hello. Thank you so much for yesterday!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ、昨日？
english: Eh, yesterday?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ライブの打ち合わせに、
雁切さんも参加してくれてたの。
english: Karikiri-san also participated in the meeting for the live show.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、そうだったんだ。
english: Ah, is that so.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 私は途中参加やったけどね。
english: I only joined halfway through, though.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
まあ、ライブも祭りと同様、
この日都神社で行われるってことで、
宮司の私も呼ばれたんよ。
english: Well, since the live show is being held here at Hitogashima Shrine just like the festival, I was called in as the head priest.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なるほど、
この神社の責任者ですからね。
english: I see, since you're the one in charge of this shrine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だとすると……その打ち合わせには、
　葬儀の後で駆けつけたってことか）
english: (If that's the case... does that mean he rushed to that meeting right after the funeral?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも、よう考えたら、
神社でライブって大丈夫なんですか？
english: But now that I think about it, is it really okay to hold a live show at a shrine?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
平気平気。
神様はそんなに心狭ないから。
english: It's fine, it's fine. The gods aren't that narrow-minded.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
それに、こういうんは
楽しんだもん勝ちやからね。
english: Besides, for things like this, the ones who have fun win.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 雁切さんらしい考え方やなァ。
english: That's a very Karikiri-san way of thinking.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
そもそも彼女をライブに呼ぼうと
商工会の皆さんに提案したのは、
私なんですよ。
english: To begin with, I was actually the one who proposed inviting her for a live show to everyone at the Chamber of Commerce.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？
english: Eh?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ほら、私って大学時代、
東京におったやないですか？
english: You see, back in my college days, I was in Tokyo, right?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ある時、とあるプロダクションに所属するアイドルが、
大勢のファンに囲まれながら野外でパフォーマンスする
姿を見たことがあるんですけどね。
english: One time, I saw an idol belonging to a certain production agency performing outdoors while surrounded by a huge crowd of fans.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
知ってます？
あの神と呼ばれる人が総合プロデューサーの！
english: Do you know it? The one where that man called "God" is the general producer!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あの感動が忘れられなくて、
島に戻ってからもそこのプロダクションに所属する
アイドルはチェックし続けてたんですよ。
english: I couldn't forget how moved I was, so even after returning to the island, I kept checking up on the idols belonging to that agency.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
それで、小弓場かおりさんという素晴らしい
アイドルの存在を知りまして、人気の高さはもちろん、
この島出身と知り、これはぜひ島に来て欲しいと――
english: That's when I learned of a wonderful idol named Kaori Koyuba-san. Seeing her immense popularity, and finding out she was from this island, I thought we absolutely had to invite her here--

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
か、かおりちゃん！！
雁切さんに、お願いしたいことがあるんやろ！？
english: K-Kaori-chan!! You had something you wanted to ask Karikiri-san, right!?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
えっ、そうなんですか？
なんでしょう？
english: Oh, is that so? What might it be?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
は、はい！
実は……この日都神社にまつわる話を
聞かせてもらいたいんです。
english: Y-Yes! Actually... I was hoping you could tell me some stories related to Hitogashima Shrine.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
トークショーで話題のひとつにでも
できればと思いまして。
english: I thought it could serve as one of the topics for the talk show.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
もちろん、ええですとも。
なにからお話すればいいですかね？
english: Of course, that's perfectly fine. Where should I start?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、はい、それでは――
english: Ah, yes, well then--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪、ナイス！
　危うく長話に付き合わされる
　ところだった……）
english: (Nice one, Mio! We were dangerously close to being dragged into a really long story...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ありがとうございました。
いろんなお話が聞けて楽しかったです。
english: Thank you very much. It was fun getting to hear so many different stories.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
興味津々で聞いてくれて
話してるこっちも楽しかったですよ。
english: You listened with such deep interest, it was fun for me to talk about it too.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
やはり、あなたを商工会に紹介した私は、
間違ってなかったようです。
english: It seems I wasn't wrong to introduce you to the Chamber of Commerce after all.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: そう言ってもらえると嬉しいです！
english: I'm so happy to hear you say that!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: そうだ、昨夜の配信良かったですよ。
english: Oh right, your stream last night was wonderful.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃん、
昨日の夜なんか配信してたんですか？
english: Kaori-chan, did you do some kind of stream last night?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、私個人の生配信チャンネルなんだけど、
昨日は泊まってる部屋から
今回のライブに向けた配信をしたの。
english: Yeah, it's on my personal live streaming channel, but yesterday I did a stream from my room about the upcoming live show.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そういえば、祭り当日のライブも
ネット配信するって言ってたっけ。
english: Come to think of it, you did mention that the live show on the day of the festival would be streamed online too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、そうなの。
english: Yeah, that's right.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
シークレットライブ直前にＵＲＬを告知する
予定になってるんだけど、それだと見逃す人も
出てくるかと思って。
english: I'm planning to announce the URL right before the secret live show, but I thought some people might end up missing it.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
だから、私の生配信チャンネルで、
「これからイベントあるよ」っていうのを
少しずつ匂わせてるの。
english: So, on my live streaming channel, I've been slowly dropping hints like "there's an event coming up soon."

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
もちろん、日都ヶ島でやるっていうのは
秘密にしてね。
english: Of course, the fact that it's on Hitogashima is kept a secret.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
へえ、面白いな。
ファンの期待も高まりそうだね。
english: Oh, that's interesting. It'll probably build up the fans' anticipation too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、今ならもう、
日都ヶ島で開催されるって言っても
いいんじゃないかな？
english: But at this point, wouldn't it be fine to just announce that it's being held on Hitogashima?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
祭りはもう明日だし、
このタイミングなら島に来るファンだって、
そこまで多くはならないと思うけど。
english: The festival is already tomorrow, so even if fans try to come to the island at this timing, I don't think there would be that many.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ハァ……慎ちゃん、
全然わかってへんねんな。
english: Haa... Shin-chan, you really don't get it at all, do you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……？

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
アイドルのファンを甘くみたらアカン！
好きなアイドルのためやったら、
どんな手段使ても島に来てまうんやで！
english: You can't underestimate idol fans! If it's for the idol they love, they'll use any means necessary to get to the island!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ、ええっ？
english: E-Eh?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
本当に甘すぎますよ、慎平くん。
日都神社に大勢の人が押し寄せてきて、
大事故に繋がりかねないというのに。
english: You really are too naive, Shinpei-kun. If a massive crowd of people were to surge into Hitogashima Shrine, it could easily lead to a major accident.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ、そんなにすごいんですか？
english: I-Is it really that crazy?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
当然でしょう。
小弓場さんはただのアイドルやない。
有名人気アイドルなんですからね。
english: Of course it is. Koyuba-san isn't just any idol. She's a famous, highly popular idol.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
噂によれば、昨日あった生配信の情報だけで、
日都ヶ島だと特定したファンもいたようで。
english: According to rumors, there were even fans who managed to pinpoint that it was Hitogashima using only the information from last night's live stream.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: あれ、知らんかったんですか？
english: Oh, you didn't know?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
今朝方、所属事務所がやってる
公式ＳＮＳのコメント欄に、
そんなことが書かれてたそうですよ。
english: Apparently, something like that was written in the comment section of your agency's official SNS account this morning.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ほ、本当ですかっ……！？
すみません、まさか特定されるだなんて！
english: I-Is that true...!? I'm so sorry, I never imagined they'd figure it out!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
気にせんといてください。
来るとしてもごく一部でしょう。
当日のライブ、楽しみにしてますよ。
english: Please don't worry about it. Even if they do come, it'll likely only be a small fraction. I'm looking forward to the live show on the day.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: は……はい。
english: Y... Yes.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんか……ライブって
思った以上に大変そうなんだな。
english: Man... doing a live show seems a lot tougher than I thought.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
もっと時間があれば、
やりようもあったと思うけど……。
english: If we had more time, I think there would've been ways to handle it, but...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今回は急なオファーだったから、
事務所のスタッフさんも島の人達も
完璧な準備とまでは……ね。
english: Since this was such a sudden offer, neither the agency staff nor the islanders could prepare perfectly... you know?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
スタッフさんも明日にならないと
島まで来れないし。
english: Plus, the staff won't be able to make it to the island until tomorrow.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そんな状況だったのか……。
english: So that was the situation...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、こんなの初めて。
english: Yeah, this is a first for me.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
でも、迂闊だったな。
日都ヶ島なら絶対バレないと思ってた。
english: But I was careless. I thought they'd never figure out it was Hitogashima.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
配信では部屋と窓の外が
ちょっと映っただけだったんだろ？
english: In the stream, it only showed a bit of your room and outside the window, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それで特定できるって、
それはもう、そのファンの人が
すごすぎるってだけだよ。
english: If they could figure it out from just that, then that fan is just way too incredible.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あまり気にすることないって。
english: You really shouldn't worry about it too much.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: そう、かな……。
english: You think so...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今はライブのことだけ考なよ。
オレも澪も、楽しみにしてるからさ。
english: For now, just focus on the live show. Mio and I are both really looking forward to it.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん……ありがとう。
なんだか元気が出たよ。
english: Yeah... thank you. I feel a bit more energized now.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: むぅ……。
english: Muu...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おい、澪。
なんでそんなに離れて歩いてんだ？
こっち来いよ。
english: Hey, Mio. Why are you walking so far away? Come over here.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
別にええやん。
二人の邪魔しやんようにしてんねん。
english: It's fine. I'm just making sure I don't get in your way.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はぁ？
なんて言うてるか聞こえやん。
english: Huh? I couldn't hear what you said.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もうええ！
なんでもあらへん！
english: I said it's fine! It's nothing!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ったく。
english: ...Jeez.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんでもなくないやろ。
いつ影が来よるかわからんのやから、
オレから離れやんでくれ。
english: It's not nothing. We don't know when a Shadow might show up, so don't wander away from me.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
わ……わかったから、
もうちょっと離れてくれやん？
english: I-I get it, so... could you step back a little bit?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ。
english: A-Ah.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……ふふ。
english: ...Hehe.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
さっきの二人のやりとりを見て、
ちょっと懐かしい気持ちになっちゃった。
english: Watching you two interact just now made me feel a bit nostalgic.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どういうこと？
english: What do you mean?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
小さい澪ちゃんがみんなの輪から外れると、
網代くんが澪ちゃんに駆け寄って、
こっちに来いって手を引いてくの。
english: Whenever little Mio-chan would wander away from the group, Shinpei-kun would run over to her and pull her by the hand, telling her to come back.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 今もあまり変わってないなァと思って。
english: I was just thinking how it hasn't really changed.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そ、そんな昔のこと、
良う覚えてますね……。
english: Y-You remember something from that long ago so well...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、良く覚えてるよ。
えーっと、他には……。
english: Yeah, I remember it well. Let's see, what else...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そうそう、小学生の頃、
たまたま網代くんや小舟さんたちと一緒に
下校することがあったんだけどね。
english: Oh right, back in elementary school, there was a time I happened to walk home together with Shinpei-kun and Kofune-san.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
その時、前を歩く澪ちゃんが
急に転んじゃって。
english: At that time, Mio-chan was walking in front and suddenly tripped and fell.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ、私が？
english: Eh, I did?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
で、それを見た網代くんと小舟さんが、
どっちが早く澪ちゃんを抱き起こせるか
競い合っちゃって。
english: And seeing that, Shinpei-kun and Kofune-san started competing to see who could help Mio-chan up faster.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
それが終わると次は、
どっちが澪ちゃんを家までおんぶしていくかで、
また二人がぶつかり始めたの。
english: Once that was settled, the two of them started clashing again over who would get to give Mio-chan a piggyback ride home.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: それで……どうなったんですか？
english: And then... what happened?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
結局、澪ちゃんがおんぶを嫌がって、
澪ちゃんを真ん中に三人手を繋いで
帰ってったよ。
english: In the end, Mio-chan didn't want a piggyback ride, so we walked home holding hands with Mio-chan in the middle.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ、そんなことあったっけ？
english: D-Did that really happen?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ、ありそうやけど……
全然覚えてへん。
english: T-That does sound like something that could've happened... But I don't remember it at all.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふふ……なんだか不思議だね。
私だけ覚えてる思い出があるなんて。
english: Hehe... it's kind of strange. To think I'm the only one who remembers that.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
日都ヶ島にいたあの頃は……
目に映るものすべてが、
キラキラして見えたから。
english: Back when I was on Hitogashima... Everything reflected in my eyes looked so sparkling and bright.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私ね、この島に戻ってきた時、
そのキラキラが私の中に戻ってきた
気がしたの。
english: You know, when I came back to this island, I felt like that sparkle returned to me.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そして思ったんだ。
やっぱりこの島はとても素敵で……。
english: And then I thought to myself. This island really is wonderful...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私はそんなこの島が、
とても好きなんだなァって。
english: And I really, really love this island.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
だから、こうして島を巡りながら、
何気ない時間を過ごせるのが、
すごく嬉しい。
english: That's why, being able to spend this casual time touring the island like this makes me incredibly happy.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うん……その気持ちは、
オレらにも十分伝わってるよ。
english: Yeah... those feelings of yours have definitely reached us too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほんまに、かおりちゃんは
日都ヶ島が好きなんやね。
english: You really do love Hitogashima, Kaori-chan.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、だからこそ、
明日のイベントは必ず成功させたいの。
english: Yeah, and that's exactly why I want to make tomorrow's event a definite success.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……私も、手伝う。
english: ...I'll help too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: えっ？
english: Eh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私も、ライブのお手伝いします！
english: I'll help out with the live show too!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なにができるかわからんけど、
なんでもやりますから、
気にしやんと使ってください！
english: I don't know what I can do, but I'll do anything, so please don't hesitate to put me to work!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、嬉しいけど……
どうしたの突然？
english: I-I'm happy to hear that, but... why so suddenly?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
今の話を聞いたら……
なんだか黙ってられなくなって。
english: After hearing what you just said... I just couldn't stay quiet.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 澪ちゃん……。
english: Mio-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪だけじゃない。
オレも同じ気持ちだよ。
english: It's not just Mio. I feel the same way.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なにか手伝えることがあったら、
言ってほしい。
english: If there's anything we can do to help, just let us know.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そうそう！
力になるから！
english: Yeah, exactly! We'll lend you a hand!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
二人とも……。
ありがとう！！
english: You two... Thank you!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今日は付き合ってくれて、
ありがとう。
english: Thanks for keeping me company today.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: すごく楽しかったです！
english: It was super fun!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 帰り道、気をつけてね。
english: Be careful on your way back.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
さよーならー！
また明日ー！
english: Byeee! See you tomorrow!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああー！
また明日なー！
english: Yeah! See you tomorrow!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
さ、明日のライブのためにも
今日は早めに帰ろか。
english: Well, let's head home early today to prepare for tomorrow's live show.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、それにしても、
ライブのリハーサルを見るなんて
初めてだな。
english: Yeah. Still, this was my first time seeing a live rehearsal.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
一般人がそうそうお目に
かかれるモンやないと思うし、
ええ思い出になりそうやね。
english: It's not something ordinary people get to see very often, so it'll probably make for a good memory.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 思い出か……。
english: A memory, huh...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: どうかしたん？
english: Did something happen?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや……。
さっきの澪が転んだ話だとかさ。
english: No... Just thinking about that story of you falling earlier.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん、
オレが覚えてやんようなことでも
よく覚えてるんだよな。
english: Koyuba-san really remembers things well, even the stuff I've completely forgotten.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
やっぱりかおりちゃんて、
慎ちゃんのこと……。
english: As I thought, Kaori-chan really does... have feelings for Shin-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……？

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そっか……
そんな昔から……。
english: I see... Since that long ago...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だからなんだよ？
言いたいことがあったらハッキリ言えって。
english: What is it? If you have something to say, just say it clearly.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんでもないって！
ホンマ鈍いんやから……。
english: I said it's nothing! You're seriously so dense...

japanese: 10.こゆばチャンネル②
english: 10. Koyuba Channel ②

japanese: 小弓場　かおり
english: Kaori Koyuba

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: みんな～～～！
english: Everyone~~~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: こんばんわ～～～！
english: Good evening~~~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
小弓場かおりの『こゆばチャンネル』！
今夜もまた、昨日と同じ場所から
お送りしていま～す。
english: It's Kaori Koyuba's "Koyuba Channel"! Tonight, I'll be broadcasting from the same place as yesterday again~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
みんな、今日もコメント
じゃんじゃん送ってくださ――
english: Everyone, please send in lots of comments again today--

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
……って、すごいよ～！
もうこんなにたくさんのコメントが！
みんな、ありがと～！
english: ...Whoa, amazing~! There are already so many comments! Thank you all so much~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
「だからそこはどこなの！？」
やっぱり気になるよねェ。
english: "So where exactly is that!?" I knew you guys would be curious.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
「焦らされすぎてもうムリ」？
そんなこと言わないで～っ！
どうか最後までお付き合いください！
english: "You're teasing us too much, I can't take it"? Don't say that~! Please stick with me until the end!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふふ、みんなが私の計画を楽しみに
してくれているみたいで、
と～っても嬉しいです。
english: Hehe, it seems everyone's looking forward to my plan, and that makes me so~ happy.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
本当はまだまだこうして
おしゃべりしていたいんだけど……
english: I'd really love to keep chatting like this for a while longer, but...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
これ以上みんなを待たせちゃ、
ダメだよね？
english: Making everyone wait any longer than this would be bad, right?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あはは、やっぱり「ダメ」の嵐だ～。
わかりました、観念します！
english: Ahaha, a storm of "it's bad" as expected~. I get it, I surrender!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: コホン、それでは……。
english: *Ahem*, well then...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
発表しま～す！
なんと私、小弓場かおりは……！
english: I'll announce it~! Believe it or not, I, Kaori Koyuba...!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
明日７月２４日に、
ソロライブ＆トークショーを
開催することになりました！
english: Will be holding a solo live show & talk show tomorrow, July 24th!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
その一部始終を、
ネットでみんなに生配信しちゃいま～す！
english: And I'll be live-streaming the entire thing for everyone on the internet~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
わ～、すご～い！
みんな、お祝いコメントありがとう！
english: Wow~, amazing~! Thank you all for the congratulatory comments!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
シークレットライブだから
開催場所はやっぱりヒミツなんだけど、
ぜひ、みんなも一緒に盛り上がってね！
english: Since it's a secret live show, the venue is still a secret, of course, but please join in and get hyped with me~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ん～、あれれれ？
「オレは現地で見るけどな」って？
english: Hmm~, wait a second? "I'll be watching it in person though"?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ちょっと、今コメントした人！
正解でも不正解でも、
答えは黙っててくださいね！
english: Hey, the person who just commented that! Whether you're right or wrong, please keep the answer to yourself!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
場合によってはライブが
開催できなくなるかもしれないので、
ご協力お願いします！
english: Depending on the situation, the live show might have to be canceled, so please cooperate with me!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
準備の段階から、
色々大変なこともありましたけど……。
english: From the preparation stage onwards, there were a lot of difficult moments, but...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
みんなにどうしても見てもらいたかったんです。
私の大好きな、この場所を。
english: I really wanted everyone to see it. This place that I love so much.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
当日はトークショーで
ここの良いところをたくさん紹介するから、
みんなも好きになってくれると嬉しいな。
english: During the talk show, I'll introduce a lot of great things about this place, so I'd be happy if everyone comes to love it too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
……あっ、応援コメントいっぱ～い。
みんな、ありがとう！
元気出る～！
english: ...Ah, so many supportive comments~! Thank you, everyone! It gives me energy~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ちゃんとお返事したいところだけど、
明日に備えてそろそろ寝ないと。
english: I'd love to reply to all of you properly, but I should go to sleep soon to prepare for tomorrow.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今日はみんなも早めに寝てね？
明日、元気なみんなと盛り上がれるのを
楽しみにしてるよ～。
english: Everyone, please go to bed early today too, okay? I'm looking forward to getting hyped up with all of you tomorrow~.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
……というわけで！
次回はライブ＆トークショー生配信で
お会いしましょう！
english: ...And with that! Let's meet again next time during the live show & talk show stream!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
『こゆばチャンネル』でした！
おやすみなさい！
english: This was "Koyuba Channel"! Good night!

japanese: 11.押し寄せたファン
english: 11. Fans Rushing In

japanese: 7月24日
english: July 24

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
澪、Ａランチ２つや。
持ってってくれ。
english: Mio, two A Lunches. Take them out.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うんっ！
次はＣランチ４つお願い！
english: Got it! Next, four C Lunches please!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: お、おお。
english: O-Oh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ありがとうございました！
english: Thank you very much!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今日は手加減なしの大繁盛だな……）
english: (It's a full-blown rush today with no holding back...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: *Yawn*...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ちょっと慎ちゃん。
店ん中で大あくびせんといて。
english: Hey, Shin-chan. Don't yawn so widely inside the cafe.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お客さんに見られたら、
どないするん？
english: What if the customers see you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: う……ごめん。
english: Ugh... sorry.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あんまり寝てやんの？
早よ寝よ言うてたやん。
english: Did you not sleep much? I told you to go to bed early.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうしたいのは山々やったんやけど、
いつ澪の影が来るかわからんしな……。
english: I really wanted to, but we don't know when Mio's shadow might show up...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もしかして……
それで起きててくれたん？
english: Could it be... you stayed up because of that?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: まあな。
english: Pretty much.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……体壊すで。
あんま無理せんでよ？
english: ...You'll ruin your health. Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私もちゃんと、
気ィつけとくから。
english: I'll make sure to be careful too.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
Ｃランチ４つ、できたで！
持ってって。
english: Four C Lunches, ready! Take them out.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はーい！
english: Coming!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんか今日は、観光客の人が多ない？
english: Aren't there a lot of tourists today?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
せやな……ここまで多いんは、
初めてかもしれやんな。
english: Yeah... this might be the first time it's ever been this crowded.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
夏祭りの時期は観光客がよう来てくれるけど、
今年は飛び抜けて多い気がするでよ。
english: Tourists usually come around the time of the summer festival, but it feels like there's an exceptionally large number this year.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
いや～～、
あっついのォ～～。
english: Man~~ it's so hot~~.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
――って、なんじゃこら！？
めっちゃ混んどる！
english: --Wait, what the heck!? It's super crowded!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
哲さん、いらっしゃい。
カウンターが空いてますよ。
english: Tetsu-san, welcome. The counter is open.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ありがとう、澪ちゃん。
いつものヤツ頼むわ……。
english: Thanks, Mio-chan. I'll have the usual...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お父さ～ん、
Ｂランチ、エビフライ追加で
ライス中盛りお願い。
english: Daaad~ One B Lunch, add fried shrimp, and a medium serving of rice.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
english: Haaah~~~~...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんか、えらい疲れてません？
english: You look incredibly tired.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
もう大変なんよ、今日！
朝から観光客がドッと押し寄せて
きちゃあるんよ！
english: It's been a nightmare today! Tourists have been pouring in non-stop since this morning!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
この時期は毎年、
役場の人らと観光客の増加には
備えちゃあるんやけど……。
english: Every year around this time, me and the folks at the town hall prepare for the increase in tourists, but...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
今年は例年の比やないでよ！
もう、忙しいのなんの……！
english: This year is nothing compared to normal years! Jeez, it's so busy...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん、それってもしかして……。
english: Totsumura-san, that's probably...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ああ、もう見当はついちゃある。
いつもより多い観光客の正体は十中八九……
english: Yeah, I already have a pretty good idea. The true identity of these extra tourists is, nine times out of ten...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: かおりちゃんのファンや！
english: Kaori-chan's fans!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: やっぱり……。
english: I figured...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 雁切さんが言うてた通りやな。
english: Just like Karikiri-san said.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ――っと、メール？
english: --Hm, an email?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: もしかして、かおりちゃん？
english: Could it be from Kaori-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、そうみたい。
えーっと……。
english: Yeah, seems like it. Let's see...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんの連絡やったん？
english: What did it say?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今日のリハーサル、
中止になったって。
english: Today's rehearsal has been canceled.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: え……そうなん？
english: Eh... really?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
大勢のファンが駆けつけてて、
うかつに外へ出れやんらしい。
english: A huge crowd of fans rushed over, so apparently she can't easily go outside.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほな今回は、
リハーサルなしで本番なんか。
大丈夫なんかなァ……。
english: So this time, it's straight to the actual performance without a rehearsal. I wonder if it'll be okay...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（さっきのメールからすると……
　小弓場さん相当落ち込んでるだろうな）
english: (Judging from this email... Koyuba-san is probably feeling really down.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
客も引いてきたことやし……
澪、オレちょっと小弓場さんに
電話してくる。
english: The crowd of customers is thinning out too... Mio, I'm gonna go give Koyuba-san a quick call.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ、それやったら、
私が応援しとったってかおりちゃんに
伝えてな。
english: Ah, if you're doing that, tell Kaori-chan that I'm cheering for her.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、了解。
english: Yeah, got it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もしもし、小弓場さん？
english: Hello, Koyuba-san?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ……網代くん？
english: Ah... Shinpei-kun?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
メール見たよ。
今日のライブ大丈夫なの？
english: I saw your email. Is today's live show going to be okay?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
心配してくれてありがとう。
それが、ちょっと困ったことに
なってて……。
english: Thanks for worrying about me. Actually, things have gotten a bit troublesome...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なにかあったの？
english: Did something happen?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
シークレットライブの開催場所が
日都ヶ島のことだけじゃなくて、
私が泊まってる旅館……
english: It's not just that the secret live show's venue is Hitogashima, but even the inn I'm staying at...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
それも部屋番号まで
特定されちゃったみたいで……。
english: It seems they even figured out my room number...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ええ！？
english: Eh!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今、雁切さんのご厚意で日都神社の
社務所でお世話になってるの。
ライブまではここでじっとしてるつもり。
english: Right now, thanks to Karikiri-san's kindness, I'm staying at the shrine office of Hitogashima Shrine. I'm planning to stay put here until the live show.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうなんだ……。
english: I see...

japanese: 「神社なら安心だね」
english: "Since it's a shrine, it's safe."

japanese: 「防犯グッズは大事だよ」
english: "Security items are important."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
神社なら安心だね。
ライブステージまですぐ移動できるし。
english: Since it's a shrine, it's safe. Plus you can move to the live stage right away.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん。
雁切さんもいろいろ話してくれて、
楽しいよ。
english: Yeah. Karikiri-san has been talking to me about all sorts of things, so it's been fun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あー……。
あの人話長くない？
english: Ah... Doesn't that guy talk for way too long?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふふふ……そうかも。
でも面白い人だよね、雁切さん。
english: Hehehe... maybe so. But he's an interesting person, Karikiri-san.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
普段は東京の話なんかを
一緒にできる人がいないらしくて、
けっこう盛り上がっちゃった。
english: It seems he usually doesn't have anyone he can talk to about Tokyo with, so we ended up having a pretty lively conversation.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そっか……。
まあ楽しめてるなら何よりだよ。
english: I see... Well, as long as you're enjoying yourself, that's what matters.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、あまり長すぎるようなら
適当に切り上げなよ？
あの人、怒ったりしないからさ。
english: But if the conversation drags on too long, feel free to cut it short, okay? He's not the type to get angry over that.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふふ、わかった。
もし辛くなったらそうするね。
english: Hehe, got it. If it gets tough, I'll do that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
防犯グッズは大事だよ。
神社ならたぶん大丈夫だと思うけど、
準備だけはしておくといいかも。
english: Security items are important. Since it's a shrine, I think it'll probably be fine, but it might be best to at least have them ready.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、そのことなら心配ないよ。
english: Yeah, you don't need to worry about that.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
実はマネージャーさんの方針で、
普段からライブ中は防犯グッズを
身に着けるようにしてるから。
english: Actually, due to my manager's policy, I always make sure to carry security items on me during live shows anyway.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
へえ、そうなんだ？
それなら安心かもね。
english: Oh, is that so? Then that's reassuring.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふふ、なんだか網代くんも、
マネージャーさんみたい。
english: Hehe, somehow Shinpei-kun, you're sounding a lot like my manager.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
でも……今日はごめんね。
せっかく網代くんと澪ちゃんにリハーサルを
見てもらおうと思ってたのに。
english: But... I'm sorry about today. I really wanted to let you and Mio-chan watch the rehearsal.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ううん、小弓場さんのせいじゃないよ。
english: No, it's not your fault, Koyuba-san.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: でも、楽しみにしてくれてたし……。
english: But you were looking forward to it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
大丈夫。
オレも澪も小弓場さんの力になりたいって
気持ちは変わってないしね。
english: It's okay. Mio and I still haven't changed our minds about wanting to help you.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
english: Eh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なにがあっても応援してるし、
ライブだって観にいくよ。
だから絶対に負けないでね。
english: No matter what happens, we're cheering for you, and we're definitely going to watch the live show. So please, absolutely do not give up.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
どれだけ想定外のことがあっても、
小弓場さんが目指したライブってものを
この島で実現させてよ。
english: No matter how many unexpected things happen, make the live show you aimed for a reality on this island.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、そうだよね……
そのために帰ってきたんだから。
english: Yeah, you're right... That's exactly why I came back.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私……やり遂げてみせる。
見ててね、網代くん。
english: I... I'll see it through. Watch me, Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、楽しみにしてる。
それはともかく、せっかく時間ができたんだから、
本番までゆっくりしとくといいよ。
english: Yeah, I'm looking forward to it. Anyway, since you suddenly have some free time, you should take it easy until the actual performance.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん……そうする。
english: Yeah... I will.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
電話ありがとう……。
網代くんの声が聞けてよかった。
それじゃ、また後で！
english: Thank you for calling... I'm really glad I got to hear your voice. Well then, see you later!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、また後で。
english: Yeah, see you later.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まさか、いきなり部屋まで
　特定されるなんてなァ……）
english: (To think they'd even manage to pinpoint her room right away...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、観光客が増えるのは、
　悪いことばかりじゃない）
english: (But an increase in tourists isn't entirely a bad thing.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（島にいる人が多くなればなるほど、
　影は人目を避けにくくなって、
　ヤツらの行動が制限されることになる）
english: (The more people there are on the island, the harder it becomes for the Shadows to avoid people's eyes, which will end up restricting their movements.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （油断は禁物だけど……）
english: (Though I still can't let my guard down...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さんのライブが成功して、
　みんなで夏祭りの思い出を作れたらいいな）
english: (I hope Koyuba-san's live show is a success, and we can all make some great summer festival memories together.)

japanese: 12.日都夏祭り
english: 12. Hitogashima Summer Festival

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
みんな～～～～っ！
こんばんは～～～～～っ！！
english: Everyone~~~~! Good evening~~~~~!!

speaker: Fans
japanese: こんばんは～～～～～～っ！！！
english: Good evening~~~~~~!!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: んぎぃ、慎ちゃん待って～。
english: Ngh, Shin-chan, wait up~.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だ、大丈夫か、澪！？
english: A-Are you okay, Mio!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （人が多すぎて身動きが取りづらい……！）
english: (There are so many people, it's hard to even move...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ファンの人たちだけじゃなく、
　島民もかなり集まってるみたいだ）
english: (It looks like it's not just the fans, but quite a lot of the islanders have gathered too.)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
うおお……えらい人混みやん！
ステージから結構距離あるっちゅうのに！
english: Whoa... what a massive crowd! And we're still quite a distance from the stage too!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
私らの前も後ろも人だらけや。
こないなことになるの、
日都ヶ島史上初めてなんやない？
english: It's completely packed with people in front of and behind us. Isn't this the first time something like this has ever happened in Hitogashima's history?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今日は花火大会の花火をバックに、
私のソロ曲やグループの曲をみんなに
お届けするね！
english: Today, with the fireworks display in the background, I'll be performing my solo songs and group songs for all of you!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
花火の時間までもうちょっとあるので、
その間、私が大好きな日都ヶ島のことを
みんなに紹介しようと思います！
english: There's still a little time until the fireworks start, so in the meantime, I'd like to introduce everyone to my beloved Hitogashima!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: どうか、最後までお付き合いください。
english: Please stick with me until the very end.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、気分が悪くなった人は係の人を
呼んでくださいね！
水分補給も忘れずにお願いします！
english: Ah, if anyone starts feeling unwell, please call one of the staff members! And please don't forget to stay hydrated!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さん、さすがはプロだな。
　この状況に少しは戸惑ってるはずなのに、
　表情には一切出してない）
english: (Koyuba-san really is a pro. She must be at least a little bewildered by this situation, but she's not showing it on her face at all.)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なあ慎平！
知り合い権限で特等席用意してもらうとか
できやんかったんか？
english: Hey Shinpei! Couldn't you have used your acquaintance privileges to get us some special seats?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アホか。
そんなことできるわけないやろ。
english: Are you an idiot? There's no way I could do that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪、<color=#GF_TIPS_030>トキちゃん</color>、
二人はオレと窓の間におってくれ。
オレらが壁になるから。
english: Mio, <color=#GF_TIPS_030>Toki-chan</color>, you two stay between me and Sou. We'll act as a wall.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おお、任しとけ。
english: Oh, leave it to me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今日は浴衣なんやから、
特に気をつけとかんとな。
english: Since you're wearing a yukata today, we have to be especially careful.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: う、うん……ありがとう。
english: Y-Yeah... thank you.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
せっかくの澪の浴衣姿なので、
他の人たちに乱されたくない……
そういうことですか？
english: Since it's Mio's special yukata appearance, you don't want her to be messed with by other people... Is that what you mean?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ちょ……ちょっと、トキコ！？
english: W-Wait a second, Tokiko!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まあ……そんな感じかな。
浴衣着るの初めてや言うてたのに、
嫌な思い出になってほしないし。
english: Well... something like that. She said it's her first time wearing a yukata, so I don't want it to turn into a bad memory.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
だ、大丈夫……。
ちゃんと気ィつけるから……。
english: I-I'm fine... I'll make sure to be careful...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、それはそうと――
english: Ah, by the way--

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
以上が、この日都夏祭りの歴史です。
まずは現地以外の人に聞いてみようかな。
御神輿見た人～～！
english: And that concludes the history of the Hitogashima Summer Festival. First, I think I'll ask the people who aren't locals. Who here has seen the mikoshi~~!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あははは、
なんだか現地の人も返事してるような？
english: Ahahaha, it seems like the locals are answering too?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、ちゃんと見えてるか？
english: Mio, can you see properly?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
う、うん……。
見えることは見えるんやけど、
人の隙間からやっとって感じ。
english: Y-Yeah... I can see her, but it's more like I'm barely catching glimpses through the gaps between people.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ほとんどの観客が、
澪ちゃんやトキコより背ェ高いもんな。
english: Almost all of the audience members are taller than Mio-chan and Tokiko, after all.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
はい、ネット配信のチャンネル
繋いどいたで。
よう見えん時は、スマホを見とけばええよ。
english: Here, I've connected to the live stream channel. If you can't see well, just watch it on the smartphone.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ありがとう、トキコ！
english: Thank you, Tokiko!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うわっ……これ見てみ！
視聴者数が、えらい数になってるわ！
english: Whoa... look at this! The viewer count is insane!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: へえ、ほんまやね。
english: Wow, you're right.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: わっ、眩しっ……！
english: Whoa, so bright...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: カメラのフラッシュか？
english: Are those camera flashes?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
カメラのフラッシュって……
これ全部そうなんか？
えらいこっちゃでホンマ。
english: Camera flashes... Are all of these flashes? This is seriously crazy.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
写真とか動画撮ってる人もおるね。
自分のチャンネルで配信しちゃある人も
おるみたいやで。
english: There are people taking photos and videos too. It seems like some people are even live-streaming it on their own channels.

speaker: Streamer
japanese:
うおおおおお！
かおりちゃ～～～ん！
english: Uwaaaahhhh! Kaori-cha~~~n!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ホントだ……。
ファンの人なんだろうけど、
非公式なのに、けっこう見られてるな。
english: It's true... They're probably fans, but even though it's unofficial, it's getting a lot of views.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
まさに人気絶頂のアイドルって感じやな。
この島出身なんて、信じられん。
english: She really feels like an idol at the peak of her popularity. I can hardly believe she's from this island.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さんが島にいた頃のこと、
窓はあまり覚えてないのか？
english: Do you really not remember much from when Koyuba-san was on the island, Sou?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ、接点はあったと思うんやけど、
ほとんど覚えてやん。
english: Ah, I think we interacted a bit, but I honestly don't remember much.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まあ、大人しい子だったもんな。
そんな子がアイドルとして成功して、
生まれ故郷の島でライブを開くなんて……。
english: Well, she was a pretty quiet kid back then. To think a kid like that would succeed as an idol and hold a live show on her home island...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ホンマすごいと思うわ。
english: I really think it's amazing.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: せやなァ。
english: Yeah, no kidding.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私な、ホンマは今日、
お祭りなんか楽しんでええんやろかって
今さらながらに悩んでたんよ。
english: You know, I was actually worrying until just now about whether it was really okay for me to be enjoying the festival today.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんが亡くなって、
まだそんなに経ってやんのにって。
english: It hasn't even been that long since Sis passed away, after all.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも、あんだけ島のために頑張ってた
かおりちゃんのこと思い出すと……。
english: But when I think about Kaori-chan, who's been working so hard for the island...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんが生きとったら、
「早よ行け！　迷てる場合か！」って
怒られてまうやろなって。
english: If Sis were alive, she'd probably get mad at me and say, "Hurry up and go! This isn't the time to hesitate!"

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: だから……私……。

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Mio...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ！
潮がおったら絶対我先に参加して、
盛り上がっとったやろな！
english: Yeah! If Ushio were here, she'd definitely be the first to join in and get completely hyped up!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
もしかしたら、
今もどっかから見てるんちゃうか？
english: Who knows, maybe she's watching from somewhere right now?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん、そんな気ィする！
お姉ちゃんのことやから、
めっちゃ楽しんでるやろな。
english: Yeah, I feel like she is! Knowing Sis, she's probably having an absolute blast.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ああ、そうだな。
english: ...Yeah, you're right.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あっ、花火！
english: Ah, fireworks!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……ってことは！
english: ...Which means!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
時間だね！
それじゃ１曲目いきますよー！
english: It's time! Well then, here goes the first song!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、始まるよ！
english: Shin-chan, it's starting!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ、なんだかドキドキするな。
english: A-Ah, my heart's pounding.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私も！
english: Mine too!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: みんな、準備はいい～！？
english: Is everyone ready~!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、みんな準備いいみたいだね！
english: Yeah, looks like everyone is ready!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おォ！？
今の、オレに向かって
微笑んだんとちゃうか！？
english: Whoa!? Didn't she just smile right at me!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
たしかに微笑んどったけど、
お兄ちゃんに向けてってのは、
自意識過剰や。
english: She was definitely smiling, but assuming it was directed at you is just being overly self-conscious, brother.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はは……。
english: Haha...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: それじゃ、聞いてください！
english: Well then, please listen!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （想定外のこともあったけど……）
english: (There were some unexpected turns, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（このまま無事にお祭りが終われば、
　町おこし成功だな）
english: (If the festival ends safely like this, then the town revitalization is a success.)

speaker: 女性の声（女性客Ａ）
japanese: キャアァァァァァーッ！！！！
english: Kyaaaaaaaah!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (...A scream!?)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: なっ……なんなの、アレッ！？
english: Wh... what is THAT!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ど、どないなっとんねや！？
english: W-What's going on!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
かおりさんの視線は……
境内の奥に向けられてるみたいやけど。
english: Kaori-san's gaze... It looks like it's directed toward the back of the shrine grounds.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ああ……ああ……。
english: Ah... ah...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
逃げてッ！！
みんな早くここから逃げてください！！
english: Run!! Everyone, hurry and get away from here!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: か、かおりちゃん！？
english: K-Kaori-chan!?

speaker: 女性客Ａ
japanese:
ひいィィッ！！
たっ、助けてぇぇぇぇ！
english: Hiiieee!! H-Help meeeeee!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: みんなぁっ！　逃げてぇ！！
english: Everyone! Run!!

speaker: 男性客Ａ
japanese: ぎぃやぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！
english: Gyaaaaaaaaah!

speaker: 女性客Ｂ
japanese:
ひいいいいいいいっ！
ぎゃああぁぁぁっ！
english: Hiiiiiiiiiieee! Gyaaaaaaaah!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
な、なにが起きてんのや！
ここからやと良く見えやんぞ！？
english: W-What's happening! I can't see well from here!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（後方の人達が、バタバタと倒れていく……
　その向こうにいるのは――）
english: (The people in the back are collapsing one after another... And standing beyond them is--)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ほ～ら、早く逃げないと大変なことに
なりますよォ。
english: Myy~, if you don't run away quickly, things are going to get terrible.

speaker: 女性客Ｂ
japanese: あ……あああ……。
english: A... aaah...

speaker: 女性客Ｂ
japanese: きゃァァァァァッ！！
english: Kyaaaaaaah!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: こ～んな風にねェ。
english: Juuust like this.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんだ、あいつは！
　四本腕の化物……影なんか！？）
english: (What the hell is that guy! A four-armed monster... a Shadow!?)

speaker: ファンＡ（女性）
japanese:
ね、ねえ……あれ、
ライブの演出かなんか、だよね……？
english: H-Hey... that's... part of the live performance or something, right...?

speaker: ファンＢ（男性）
japanese: あー……やっぱおまえもそう思う？
english: Ah... so you think so too?

speaker: Streamer
japanese:
これは凄い演出だぞ！
全世界のファンにも見てもらわなきゃな！
english: This is an incredible performance! I have to show this to fans all over the world!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: し、慎ちゃん、これって……。
english: S-Shin-chan, is this...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まずいぞ……！
あの四本腕の影を演出と勘違いしてる！！
english: This is bad...! They're mistaking that four-armed Shadow for a performance!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （どういうことだ……！？）
english: (What is the meaning of this...!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影は人目を避けるってのは、
　オレの思い違いだったのか！？）
english: (Was my assumption that Shadows avoid people's eyes completely wrong!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓！　ここは危険だ！
澪とトキちゃんを連れて逃げてくれ！
english: Sou! It's dangerous here! Take Mio and Toki-chan and run!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 慎平は一緒に逃げやんのか！？
english: Aren't you running with us, Shinpei!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレは小弓場さんを助けにいく！
おまえらは参道あたりまで逃げとってくれ！
オレも後で向かうから！
english: I'm going to save Koyuba-san! You guys run towards the shrine approach! I'll head there later too!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
お、おお、わかった！
行くで、澪ちゃん、トキコ！
english: O-Oh, got it! Let's go, Mio-chan, Tokiko!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: でも、慎ちゃんが……！
english: But Shin-chan...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレもあとで必ず合流する！
澪は先に逃げといてくれ！
english: I'll definitely meet up with you later! Mio, you need to run first!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: で、でも……。
english: B-But...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: Mio...

speaker: Streamer
japanese:
うおおお、すげー！
めっちゃリアル！
english: Uwaaah, awesome! It's super realistic!

speaker: Streamer
japanese:
どいてどいて！
ドアップで撮ってＰＶ稼がなくちゃ！
english: Move, move! I gotta get a close-up to rack up those views!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おい、やめろ！
行くな！
english: Hey, stop! Don't go!

speaker: Streamer
japanese:
見てくれ、みんな！
かおりちゃんのライブで、
まさかのサプライズ演出だ！
english: Look at this, everyone! It's an unbelievable surprise performance at Kaori-chan's live show!

speaker: Streamer
japanese:
ほら、すげーっしょ！？
リアル事件現場みたいじゃない！？
マジで良くできてるよね！
english: See? Isn't it amazing!? Doesn't it look like a real crime scene!? It's seriously well-made!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
かっこいいでしょ？
もっと近くで見ていいですよ。
english: Isn't it cool? You can come closer and get a better look, you know.

speaker: Streamer
japanese:
えっ、いいの！？
ラッキー！
english: Eh, really!? Lucky!

speaker: Streamer
japanese: ……げふッ！？

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
どうです？
もうすぐ死んでしまう気分は？
english: How is it? The feeling of being about to die?

speaker: Streamer
japanese:
なにコレ……血？
えっ、なんで……ゴボッ！
english: What's this... blood? Eh, why... *Gurgle*!

speaker: ファンＡ（女性）
japanese: えッ……？

speaker: ファンＡ（女性）
japanese: ぎゃああああああああ！！
english: Gyaaaaaaaaaah!!

speaker: ファンＢ（男性）
japanese:
うわあああっ……！？
に、逃げろおォォォォ！！！
english: Uwaaaaah...!? R-Runnnn!!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
みんな一斉に気がつきましたね。
目の前で起きてることは演出なんかでなく、
現実だってことに。
english: Everyone realized it all at once. That what's happening right in front of them isn't a performance, but reality.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: マズイで、慎平。
english: This is bad, Shinpei.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……逃げ惑う人々で、
身動きが取れんように――
english: Yeah... with people running around in a panic, we won't be able to move--

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: これはこれは……。
english: Well, well...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
すごいですねえ。
ただ母の食餌を増やすだけのつもりやったのに、
こんな面白い光景が見られるなんて。
english: This is amazing. I only intended to increase Mother's meals, but to think I'd get to see such an interesting spectacle.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今……『食餌』って言ったんか？
　まさか、影は人を……）
english: (Did he just say... "meals"? Don't tell me, the Shadows are...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あいつ、一体なんなんだ！？）
english: (What the hell is that guy!?)

speaker: ファンＣ（女性）
japanese: ちょっと押さないでよォッ！
english: Hey, don't push me!

speaker: ファンＤ（男性）
japanese:
立ち止まるなって！
殺されちまうだろがァッ！
english: Don't stop moving! You're gonna get us killed!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ほう……これはこれは。
人というのは面白いものですね。
english: Hoh... well, well. Humans truly are fascinating creatures.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ただ逃げ惑ってるのかと思えば、
この期に及んで私にカメラを向ける人が
増えるなんてねェ。
