english: Just when I thought they were merely fleeing in panic, to think the number of people pointing cameras at me would actually increase at a time like this.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
なにかの記念でしょうか？
まあ理由なんかどうだっていいです。
english: Is it to commemorate something? Well, the reason doesn't matter anyway.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
おや、なんか光ってる思たら……
さっきの人のカメラ、
まだ回ってたんですね。
english: Oh, I thought something was glowing... That person's camera from earlier is still recording, I see.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ふっ……ははははははははは！
すごい量のコメントだ。
海外の人までいらっしゃるようで。
english: Hah... hahahahahahaha! What an incredible amount of comments. It seems we even have people from overseas watching.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
「よくできてる」？
「ＣＧがすごい」？
english: "It's so well-made"? "The CG is amazing"?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ああ、まだ私の姿が作りもんやと
思ってる人もいるんですね。
english: Ah, so there are still people who think my appearance is fake.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
まあ、どう思おうが構いませんよ。
真実なんて、終わりの前になんの意味も
持ちませんから。
english: Well, it doesn't matter what you think. The truth has absolutely no meaning before the end, after all.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
さてと……次の犠牲者になりたい方は
いらっしゃいますか？
english: Now then... is there anyone who would like to be the next victim?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
今なら自分の最期を全世界に配信して
もらえるチャンスですよ？
english: Right now is your chance to have your final moments broadcast to the entire world, you know?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
さあ、みんなでこのエンディングを
楽しみましょう。
english: Come now, let us all enjoy this ending together.

speaker: ファンＤ（男性）
japanese: 邪魔だよッ！！
english: You're in the way!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: --Whoa!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （わずかながら人の流れが……！）
english: (The flow of people is slight, but...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今なら小弓場さんのところまで
　行けるかも……！）
english: (I might be able to reach Koyuba-san right now...!)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: きゃあッ！！
english: Kyaa!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん！？
english: Koyuba-san!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪の影……！
　いつの間にステージまで！？）
english: (Mio's shadow...! When did she get to the stage!?)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
み……澪ちゃん、どうしたのっ！？
そ、そんな怖いもの、しまってっ？
english: M... Mio-chan, what's wrong!? P-Put away that scary thing...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
あんたの役目はもう終わりや。
お疲れさん。
english: Your role is over now. Thanks for your hard work.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: い、いやッ……！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: やめろ！！
english: Stop!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 網代くん！？
english: Shinpei-kun!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん、早くこっちへ！
english: Koyuba-san, hurry over here!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うん！
english: Y-Yeah!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん、ひどない？
いきなり突き飛ばさんといてよ。
english: Shin-chan, isn't that a bit mean? Don't just shove me out of nowhere.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんとか小弓場さんだけでも
　逃がさないと……！）
english: (I have to at least get Koyuba-san out of here somehow...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも武器になるようなものは、
　なにも……）
english: (But I don't have anything that could be used as a weapon...)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: よいしょ……っと。
english: Heave... ho.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ひっ！！
english: Hii!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こ、こいつ！
　一気にここまで跳んできたのか！？）
english: (T-This guy! He jumped all the way here in one go!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ヤバい……はさまれたッ！）
english: (Crap... we're sandwiched!)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
やりますねェ。
さながらプリンセスを守るナイトって
ところですか。
english: Not bad. You're just like a knight protecting a princess.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なにしに来たんですか……？
ここは私一人で十分やと思いますけど。
english: What did you come here for...? I think I'm perfectly capable of handling this alone.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
いやァ、さっきまでいろんな人が、
今日の光景を世界に発信してくれとったん
ですけどね。
english: Well, until just a moment ago, all sorts of people were broadcasting today's spectacle to the world.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
そういえばここにも配信カメラが
あったこと思い出しまして……
ああ、これやこれや。
english: That reminded me there was a live stream camera set up over here too... Ah, this is it, this is it.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: どれどれ？
english: Let's see?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ああ、もうカメラは止まってますね。
モニターには<color=#GF_TIPS_098>ニュース速報</color>のみですか。
english: Ah, the camera is already stopped. Is it just the <color=#GF_TIPS_098>news flash</color> on the monitor?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
かおりちゃんの生配信なら、
もっと大勢の人に見てもらえると
思ったんですが……。
english: I thought Kaori-chan's live stream would be seen by a lot more people, but...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
まあ、別にどうだっていいですね。
これだけの食餌を行えば、
母の力はますます揺るぎないものとなる。
english: Well, it doesn't really matter. With this many meals, Mother's power will become even more unshakeable.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
私が目指す中でも一番愉快な
エンディングになる可能性が出てきました。
english: This has the potential to become the most amusing ending I've aimed for yet.

speaker: Mio
japanese: もういいですか？
english: Are you done?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
フフ、ミオちゃんはせっかちですね。
では先程の続きといきましょう。
english: Hehe, you're quite impatient, Mio-chan. Well then, let's pick up where we left off.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
プリンセスとナイト。
どちらを先にするかミオちゃんから
リクエストあります？
english: The princess and the knight. Do you have a request for which one goes first, Mio-chan?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 私は別にどっちでも……。
english: I don't really care either way...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ただ、プリンセスとナイトって
言い方やめてもらえます？
なんか腹立つんで。
english: But could you stop calling them princess and knight? It's kind of pissing me off.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: ははははは、これは失礼。
english: Hahahahaha, my apologies.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
な、なんでこんなことに？
ひどすぎるよォ……。
english: W-Why is this happening? This is too cruel...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（考えろ、考えるんだ……！
　ここから彼女を逃がす方法を！）
english: (Think, think...! A way to let her escape from here!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……小弓場さん、怖いだろうけど、
いつでも走り出せるようにしておいて。
english: ...Koyuba-san, I know it's scary, but be ready to run at any moment.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ……うん！
english: A... alright!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おい、おまえら一体なにを企んでる！？
こんなことしてなんの得があるんだよ！？
english: Hey, what the hell are you guys planning!? What do you gain by doing all this!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なあ、そのくらい教えてくれても
いいんじゃないのか！？
english: Hey, you could at least tell me that much, couldn't you!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
そうやって時間稼ぎしながら
打開策を考えてるんやろ？
english: You're just trying to buy time while you think of a way out, right?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
どうにもならんかったら、
自分が囮になってでも、
その人逃がすつもりなんやろな。
english: And if nothing works out, you're planning to act as a decoy to let that person escape, aren't you?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃんらしいわ。
english: That's very like you, Shin-chan.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なんでそこまでして、
その子かばうん？
english: Why are you going so far to protect that girl?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ていうか誰なん？
やけに親しそうやけど。
english: Actually, who even is she? You seem awfully close.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: こ、この人は……。
english: T-This person is...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
やっぱりもうええ。
すぐに二人とも消してまうから。
english: Actually, never mind. I'm just going to erase both of you right now anyway.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ど……どうして？
english: W... Why?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
お願い……！
元の澪ちゃんに戻って！
english: Please...! Go back to the normal Mio-chan!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
おやおや、なんだか面白いことに
なってますねェ？
english: My, my, things have taken quite an interesting turn, haven't they?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
こういう状況なら、
ここはミオちゃん一人に
任せましょうか。
english: In a situation like this, perhaps I should leave things here to Mio-chan.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: 私は観客狩りに戻りますね。
english: I'll return to hunting the audience.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
やめてください！
これ以上、誰も殺さないで！
english: Please stop! Don't kill anyone else!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん、
前に出ちゃダメだ！
english: Koyuba-san, don't step forward!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: で、でも……！
english: B-But...!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
あ、そうそう。
ありがとうございます、
かおりちゃん。
english: Ah, that's right. Thank you, Kaori-chan.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
私が今最高の気分なのは、
あなたがたくさん人を集めてくれた
おかげです。
english: The reason I'm in such a fantastic mood right now is all thanks to you gathering so many people for me.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: そんな……。
english: No...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
母も喜んでいることでしょう。
それでは。
english: I'm sure Mother will be delighted as well. Well then.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（軽くジャンプしただけで、
　あんなに……！）
english: (With just a light jump, he went that far...!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: ねえ、慎ちゃん。
english: Hey, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……えっ？

speaker: Mio
japanese:
さっきから不思議やったんやけど、
影のこと、お姉ちゃんから聞いてたん？
english: I've been wondering this for a while now, but did you hear about the Shadows from Sis?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
でも……お姉ちゃんから聞いた、
それだけやとおかしいか。
english: But... if you only heard it from Sis, it still feels strange.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なんか、いろんなことを
まるで最初から知っとったって
感じやもんなァ。
english: It feels like you've known about all sorts of things right from the very beginning.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なあ、慎ちゃん。
なんでなん？
english: Say, Shin-chan. Why is that?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ループのことを
　勘づかれるのはまずい……）
english: (It's bad if she figures out about the loops...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それでも、
　できるだけ会話を長引かせて……）
english: (Even so, I need to drag this conversation out as long as possible...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
理由を教えたら……、
おまえらのことも教えてくれるんか？
english: If I tell you the reason... will you tell me about yourselves?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なんで私らのことやて聞きたがるん？
死んでしもたら、
知ってても意味あらへんのに。
english: Why do you want to know about us so badly? Once you're dead, knowing won't mean anything anyway.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうとは限らんと思うで？
なあ、小弓場さん。
english: I don't think that's necessarily true. Hey, Koyuba-san.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、うん……。
english: A-Ah, yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん……、
武器になりそうなものは？
english: Koyuba-san... Do you have anything that could be used as a weapon?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: これぐらいしか……。
english: I only have this...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: これは……？
english: This is...?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
このキーホルダー、
催涙スプレーが仕込んであるの。
english: This keychain has pepper spray hidden inside it.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
キャップを取った本体は催涙スプレー、
キャップの方は防犯ブザーとして使える
ようになってる……。
english: If you take the cap off, the main body is pepper spray, and the cap itself functions as a security alarm...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: わかった……。
english: I see...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でもスプレーを使うには、
　かなり影に近づく必要があるし……）
english: (But to use the spray, I have to get pretty close to the Shadow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そもそも催涙スプレーが、
　影に効果があるのかどうかも……）
english: (And I don't even know if pepper spray will work on a Shadow in the first place...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （でも、今はもう――）
english: (But, right now--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それ、貸してもらっていい？
english: Can I borrow that?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、好きに使って……。
english: Yeah, use it however you need...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ありがとう。
english: Thanks.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今はもうこれに頼るしかない！）
english: (Right now, I have no choice but to rely on this!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: なにコソコソしてるん？
english: What are you whispering about?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや……別に？
english: No... nothing?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
はァ、もうええ。
慎ちゃんがなに知っとるかなんて、
もうどうでもええわ。
english: Haa, whatever. I don't care what you know anymore, Shin-chan.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 二人とも覚悟してな。
english: Prepare yourselves, both of you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや……ちょっと待て！
english: No... wait a second!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こうなったらもう
　ウソでもなんでもいい！）
english: (If it's come to this, I don't care if it's a lie or what!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレは前からおまえのこと
知っとったで！
澪をコピーしたその時からな！
english: I've known about you for a long time! Ever since the moment you copied Mio!

speaker: Mio
japanese: ふっ、ふふふ……。
english: Pfft, fufufu...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なっ……なにがおかしいッ！
english: Wh... what's so funny!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
顔見てすぐわかったで。
慎ちゃん、ウソついてるやろ？
english: I could tell just by looking at your face. Shin-chan, you're lying, aren't you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ダメだ……。
　これじゃ逃げられない！）
english: (Dammit... I can't escape like this!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……今だッ！！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （この隙に……！）
english: (In this opening...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん、走って！
english: Koyuba-san, run!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: で、でも、網代くんの前……。
english: B-But, in front of you, Shinpei-kun...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ、前って――
english: Eh, in front of me...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うわッ！？
english: Whoa!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
アホやなァ、慎ちゃん……。
あんなモン投げたぐらいで、
どうにかなる思たん？
english: You're an idiot, Shin-chan... Did you really think throwing something like that would do anything?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ダメだ……。
　これじゃ逃げられない！）
english: (Dammit... I can't escape like this!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （よし……今だ！！）
english: (Alright... now!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それっ！！
english: Take this!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん？
今、なにを投げ――
english: Shin-chan? What did you just throw--

speaker: Mio
japanese: な、なんなん、この音？
english: Wh-What is this sound?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今だッ！
小弓場さん、走って！！
english: Now! Koyuba-san, run!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: は、はい！！
english: Y-Yes!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: あっ……！

speaker: Mio
japanese: 逃がさへんよ。
english: I won't let you escape.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや、逃げ切ってみせる！
english: No, I'll make sure we escape!

speaker: Mio
japanese: な～んかおかしいなァ。
english: Some~thing's weird.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 奥の手でもありそうな……。
english: It feels like you'd have a trump card or something...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （よし、次は……！）
english: (Alright, next is...!)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なにコレ？
ようわからんけど、これが奥の手なん？
english: What's this? I don't really get it, but is this your trump card?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あッ……！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（な、ないッ！？
　手に持ってたはずの催涙スプレーが……！）
english: (I-It's gone!? The pepper spray I was holding in my hand is...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （まさか……奪われたのか！？）
english: (Don't tell me... she snatched it!?)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
甘いで、慎ちゃん。
奥の手やったら最後の最後まで、
ちゃんと隠しとかな。
english: You're too naive, Shin-chan. If it's your trump card, you have to keep it hidden properly until the very end.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ああッ、もう！
やかましなァ！
english: Aah, jeez! So annoying!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Guh...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ダメだ……。
　これじゃ逃げられない！）
english: (Dammit... I can't escape like this!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 食らえ！！
english: Eat this!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: うッ……な、なにコレ！？
english: Ugh... wh-what is this!?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 目……目が開けられやん！
english: My... my eyes won't open!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （よし、効いてる！）
english: (Alright, it's working!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: もォッ、ホンマ最悪！
english: Ugh, this is seriously the worst!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今のうちに、
　急いで小弓場さんに追いつこう！）
english: (While I have the chance, I need to hurry and catch up to Koyuba-san!)

japanese: 14.身を挺して
english: 14. Risking Everything

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃんはその女を助けたくて、
しかたないみたいやな。
english: It seems Shin-chan just wants to save that woman no matter what.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
それやったら、やっぱりそっちの女から
殺したった方が面白そうや。
english: In that case, it really does seem more fun to kill that woman first.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （もう四の五の言ってられない！）
english: (I can't afford to complain anymore!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん、逃げろ！！
english: Koyuba-san, run!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: で、でも……！
english: B-But...!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
へえ、こういうときは躊躇しやんと、
私に抱きつけるんや？
english: Heh, so in a situation like this, instead of hesitating, you're going to cling to me?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
でもなァ、
こんな力任せに抱きつかれたかて、
嬉しくもなんともないで？
english: But you know, even if you cling to me with all your strength like this, it doesn't make me happy at all, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんとでも言えッ！
english: Say whatever you want!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どれだけ無様でも、
　小弓場さんだけは助けてみせる！）
english: (No matter how pathetic I look, I'll save Koyuba-san!)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん……
いいかげん邪魔やで？
english: Shin-chan... you're really in the way, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐあッ……！！
english: Gwah...!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: ほら、もう逃げられやんよ？
english: See, you can't run away anymore, can you?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ……い、嫌ッ！！
english: Ah... n-no!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
待……て……！
やらせ、へんぞ！
english: Wai... t...! I won't... let you!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なんなん、もう。
離して。
english: Jeez, what is it now. Let go.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 絶対、離さん……ぞ！
english: I'm absolutely... not letting go!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
しつこすぎるで、慎ちゃん。
そんなに、あの子が大事なん？
english: You're way too persistent, Shin-chan. Is that girl really that important to you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、大事や……！
english: Yeah, she is...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さんは、この島のために
必死で頑張ってたんやぞ！？
english: Koyuba-san was trying so desperately hard for the sake of this island, you know!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それやのに……！
それやのに、おまえらが！
english: And yet...! And yet, you guys...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これ以上、
彼女を傷つけさせてたまるかよ！
english: I won't let you hurt her any more than this!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
もうええ。
もうなにも言わんといて。
english: Enough already. Don't say anything else.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐはっ！！
english: Guhah!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
そこでおとなしく寝っ転がっとき。
今からあの女殺すから。
english: Just lie down quietly right there. I'm going to kill that woman now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: や、やめろ……！
english: S-Stop...!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あっ……。
english: Ah...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
足が震えて動けやんかったん？
せっかく慎ちゃんがあれだけ必死に
頑張ってくれたのになァ。
english: Your legs are shaking so much you couldn't move? Even though Shin-chan tried so desperately to protect you.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ご、ごめんね、網代くん……。
english: I-I'm sorry, Shinpei-kun...

speaker: Mio
japanese: ほな、覚悟してな。
english: Well then, prepare yourself.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: きゃあッ！！
english: Kyaa!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: やらせるかァ！
english: Like hell I'll let you!

speaker: Mio
japanese: いったァ……！
english: Ouch...!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なにコレ、石？
ほんま往生際悪いなァ。
english: What's this, a rock? You really don't know when to give up, do you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ぐはッ！！
english: ...Guhah!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 網代くんッ！！
english: Shinpei-kun!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
たぶん、今のが致命傷やな。
結局死んでしもたら誰も守れやんやん。
english: That was probably a fatal wound just now. In the end, if you die, you can't protect anyone.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: U... guh...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: いや……！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ごほ、ごふっ……！
english: *Cough*, *hack*...!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
いやあああああ！！
網代くん！
english: Nooooooo!! Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
澪ちゃん、離して！
網代くんが死んじゃう！
english: Mio-chan, let go of him! Shinpei-kun is going to die!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃんが命懸けで守ろうとした子や。
慎ちゃんが死ぬまでは、
生かしといたるわ。
english: You're the girl Shin-chan risked his life to protect. I'll let you live until Shin-chan dies.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やめろ……！
　小弓場さんに手を出すな……！）
english: (Stop...! Don't lay a hand on Koyuba-san...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（くそ………
　もう何も見えなくなって……）
english: (Dammit... I can't see anything anymore...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （この光景は……？）
english: (This scene is...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレ……また……）
english: (Am I... again...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （フカンしてるのか――）
english: (Taking a bird's-eye view...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Wh... at is this...!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （文字通りの死屍累々……）
english: (A literal mountain of corpses...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そ、窓……？
それにトキちゃん……！
english: S-Sou...? And Toki-chan...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さんに……み、澪までッ！？
english: Koyuba-san... E-Even Mio...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、あああ……！
english: A-Aaaaaah...!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
最後の食餌です。
存分にお召し上がりください……。
english: This is the final meal. Please enjoy it to your heart's content...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（境内いっぱいに
　巨大な影が広がって……）
english: (A giant Shadow is spreading all over the shrine grounds...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （死体の山を飲み込んだ！？）
english: (It swallowed the mountain of corpses!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そんな……い、一瞬で……！）
english: (No way... i-in an instant...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うああああああああッ！！！
english: Uwaaaaaaaaaaaahhhh!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （巨大な影が島中に広がってく……）
english: (The giant Shadow is spreading across the whole island...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （な、なんだ……あの赤い光？）
english: (Wh-What is... that red light?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （女の子！？）
english: (A girl!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今……目が合っ――）
english: (Just now... our eyes met--)

speaker: 赤い着物の少女（ハイネ）
speaker_ja: 赤い着物の少女（ハイネ）
japanese: そうかその目、おまんが……！
english: I see, that eye, you...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こっちに向かって来る！？）
english: (She's coming this way!?)

speaker: 赤い着物の少女（ハイネ）
speaker_ja: 赤い着物の少女（ハイネ）
japanese: 逃がさんぞ！
english: I won't let you escape!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （な、なんなんだ！？）
english: (Wh-What the hell is she!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この感じ……
　また、時間が戻るのか！？）
english: (This feeling... Is time going to rewind again!?)

speaker: 赤い着物の少女（ハイネ）
speaker_ja: 赤い着物の少女（ハイネ）
japanese: 見失うたか……
english: Did I lose him...

speaker: 赤い着物の少女（ハイネ）
speaker_ja: 赤い着物の少女（ハイネ）
japanese:
まあええ。
いずれまた網にかかるじゃろ。
english: Well, whatever. He'll get caught in the net again eventually.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （体中に悪寒が走る……）
english: (A chill runs through my entire body...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あの子は一体――）
english: (Who on earth was that girl--)

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_SANGEKI>惨劇の夜</color>】を入手しました。
english: Obtained Key TIPS: [<color=#GF_KEY_SANGEKI>the Night of the Tragedy</color>].

japanese: 13.特等席
english: 13. Premium Seat

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……よし、追いついた！）
english: (...Alright, I caught up!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん！
english: Koyuba-san!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: きゃあああっ！？
english: Kyaaaah!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
落ちついて！
オレだよオレ！
english: Calm down! It's me, it's me!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
english: Ah...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ……網代、くん？
ごめんなさい、私……。
english: A... Shinpei-kun? I'm sorry, I...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
気にしなくていいよ。
あれだけのことがあったんだからさ。
english: Don't worry about it. It's only natural after what just happened.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
さっきは……
助けてくれてありがとう。
english: Earlier... Thank you for saving me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あれは小弓場さんのおかげだよ。
あの防犯グッズがなかったら
どうなってたか……。
english: That was all thanks to you, Koyuba-san. If you hadn't had that security alarm, who knows what would have happened...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、ただ隙を作って逃げただけだから、
この後も警戒が必要だよ。
english: But we only managed to create an opening and run away, so we still need to stay on our guard.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: なんで、澪ちゃんが……。
english: Why... Mio-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、ああ……あれは違う。
澪じゃないんだ。
english: A-Ah... that wasn't her. That wasn't Mio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
詳しくはあとで説明するけど、
あれは澪に化けた人ならざるものなんだ。
本物の澪じゃないよ。
english: I'll explain the details later, but that was a monster disguised as Mio. It wasn't the real Mio.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そ、そうなの？
でも……網代くんが言うなら、
そうなんだろうね。
english: I-Is that so? But... if you say so, Shinpei-kun, then it must be true.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
よかった……。
ずっと頭が混乱してたの。
english: Thank goodness... My head has been in total chaos this whole time.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あんなに応援してくれてたのに、
なんでだろうって……。
english: She was cheering for me so much, so why... I just didn't understand...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
でも、どうして！？
どうしてこんなことになったの！？
english: But why!? Why did something like this have to happen!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私はただ……
大勢の人にこの島を知ってもらいたい、
好きになってもらいたいって……。
english: I just... wanted a lot of people to know about this island, and to come to love it...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
その一心でやってきたのに……
それが結局大勢の人を死なせる結果に……。
english: That's all I was trying to do... But in the end, it resulted in so many people dying...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 私が……私がライブなんてしたから！
english: It's because... because I held a live show!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私……ファンや島の人たちに、
どう償えば……。
english: How... how am I supposed to atone to the fans and the people of the island...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: You're wrong!!!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: えっ……？

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さんは、なんも悪ない！
悪いのは、なんもかんもめちゃくちゃにした、
あの化物どもや！
english: You didn't do anything wrong, Koyuba-san! The ones at fault are those monsters who ruined absolutely everything!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: でも……。
english: But...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
大好きな島のためを想ってやったことを、
誰も責めたりしない！
english: No one is going to blame you for doing something out of love for the island!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だから、そんなふうに言わないでよ……。
応援しとったオレらまで……悲しなってまう。
english: So please, don't talk like that... It makes us, the people who were cheering for you... feel sad too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、ううっ……！
english: U-Uuh...!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、ありが……とう、網代……くん……！
english: Th-Thank... you, Shinpei... kun...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
とにかく今はできるだけ早く、
先に逃げた窓や澪たちと合流しよう。
english: Anyway, for now we need to hurry and meet up with Sou and Mio who ran ahead.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
みんなと合流できたら港に行って……
少しでも安全なところまで逃げようか。
english: Once we meet up with everyone, let's head to the harbor... And try to escape to somewhere at least a little safer.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うんっ……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あれからしばらく経ったけど……）
english: (It's been a while since then, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やつらが追っかけてくる
　気配はないな……）
english: (There's no sign of them chasing after us...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん、
足場悪いけど頑張って。
english: Koyuba-san, the footing is bad, but hang in there.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……うん。
english: ...Yeah.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
もし私が負担になるようなら……、
遠慮なく見捨ててくれていいからね。
english: If I end up becoming a burden... don't hesitate to leave me behind, okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
大丈夫。
何があっても見捨てたりなんか
しないから。
english: It's fine. No matter what happens, I won't ever abandon you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さん……気力が、
　落ちてしまってるみたいだな）
english: (Koyuba-san... It seems she's lost her spirit.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、あれは……！
english: A-Ah, that's...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（っ！
　あそこでキョロキョロしてるのって……！）
english: (! That guy looking around over there is...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓、無事だったか！
english: Sou, you're safe!

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
おう、この通りや！
かおりちゃん助けられたんやな。
english: Yeah, as you can see! You managed to save Kaori-chan, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん、
こいつのこと覚えてる？
english: Koyuba-san, do you remember him?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、うん。
菱形医院の菱形窓くん、だよね？
網代くんの友達の。
english: Y-Yeah. Sou Hishigata-kun from Hishigata Clinic, right? Shinpei-kun's friend.

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
御名答！
さすがかおりちゃんやな！
english: Spot on! As expected of Kaori-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓、澪とトキちゃんは？
english: Sou, what about Mio and Toki-chan?

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
ああ。
二人なら先にいったで。
english: Ah. Those two went on ahead.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先にって……
二人だけで行かせたのか！？
english: Ahead...? You let them go on their own!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
すぐにあとを追わなきゃ！
行こう、小弓場さん！
english: We have to go after them immediately! Let's go, Koyuba-san!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese: そうやな、急がんと。
english: Yeah, we better hurry.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、うあ……。
english: A-Aa...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん、どうかした？
english: Koyuba-san, what's wrong?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、あ、あ、網代……くん……。
english: A-A-A-Shinpei... kun...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さっ……な、なんだこれ……。
english: Koyuba-sa... wh-what is this...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さんの背中に何かが……
　これって、斧か？）
english: (There's something in Koyuba-san's back... Is this... an axe?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だ、誰がやったんだ。
ここにはオレと窓しか……。
english: Wh-Who did this. It's only me and Sou here...

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese: そうやな、オレと慎平しかおらんなぁ。
english: Yeah, it's just me and you here, Shinpei.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もしかして……おまえがやったのか？
english: Don't tell me... you did this?

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese: そういうこっちゃ。
english: That's exactly right.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ま、まさか澪やトキちゃんも！？
english: D-Don't tell me, Mio and Toki-chan too!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
ああ、もう先に逝ってもたで。
せやから慎平も、
早よ追っかけてやらんとなァ。
english: Yeah, they already passed on ahead. So you'd better hurry up and chase after them too, Shinpei.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえ、窓の影……か！
english: You're... Sou's Shadow!

speaker: Sou
japanese: 今さら気ィついても遅いわ。
english: A bit late to realize that now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: う……うああ……。
english: U... uwaa...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うあああああああああああ！！
english: Uwaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

speaker: Sou
japanese: おらァ！！
english: Oraa!!

speaker: Sou
japanese:
慎平、おまえの武器は頭の回転やろ。
力任せに突っ込んできよっても、
まったく怖ないわ。
english: Shinpei, your weapon is your quick wits. If you just charge at me relying on brute strength, it's not scary at all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: く、うううッ！！
english: K-Kuhhh!!

speaker: Sou
japanese: ほな、そろそろ観念してもらおか。
english: Well then, it's about time you give up.

speaker: 不気味な声（シデ）
japanese: ……あれェ？
english: ...Huh?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
もう終わってしもたんですか？
慎平くん捕獲大作戦。
english: Are you already finished? With the great Shinpei-kun capture operation.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お、おまえは……！
english: Y-You're...!

speaker: Sou
japanese:
こいつ力はそないないさけ、
あとは斧で頭カチ割ったらしまいですわ。
english: This guy doesn't have much strength anyway, so I'll just split his head open with this axe and be done with it.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
もう少しくらい足掻いてくれると
思ってたんですがねェ。
english: I thought he'd put up a bit more of a struggle, but...

speaker: Sou
japanese:
そろそろ逝こか、慎平。
向こうでみんなによろしゅうな。
english: Time to pass on, Shinpei. Say hi to everyone on the other side for me.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: ……ちょっと待ってください。
english: ...Please wait a moment.

speaker: Sou
japanese:
は、はァ。
どないしたんです？
english: H-Huh? What is it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（な……なんだ？
　オレの顔のぞき込んで……）
english: (Wh... what? He's peering into my face...)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
キミの……その右目……。
なぜキミが持ってる？
english: Your... right eye... Why do you have that?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
なるほど……
それがあれば確かに可能かも
しれません。
english: I see... With that, it might indeed be possible.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: あなた……やり直せるんですね？
english: You... can start over, can't you?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: 殺してしまわなくて良かった。
english: I'm glad I didn't kill you.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ソウくん、予定変更です。
彼を拘束して境内まで運んでください。
english: Sou-kun, change of plans. Restrain him and carry him to the shrine grounds.

speaker: Sou
japanese: はい。
english: Yes.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オ、オレをどうするつもりや……！
english: Wh-What are you planning to do to me...!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: キミには特等席で見せてあげますよ。
english: I'm going to let you watch from a premium seat.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: この世界の終わりをね。
english: The end of this world.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 頼む、誰か……！
english: Please, someone...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 誰かオレを殺してくれ……！
english: Someone kill me...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレなら、やり直せる！
やり直せるんだ……！
english: I can start over! I can start all over again...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だから誰か！
誰かオレを殺してくれェェェッ！！
english: So please, someone! Someone kill meeeeee!!

japanese: 15.狂い出した歯車
english: 15. Out-of-Control Gears

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
どのみち私と慎ちゃんも一旦家に帰らなアカンし、
小弓場さんも一緒にどうですか？
english: Shin-chan and I have to go home for a bit anyway, so how about you come with us, Koyuba-san?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん……じゃあ、お言葉に甘えちゃおうかな。
english: Yeah... then I think I'll take you up on that offer.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
……あれ？
網代くん……？
english: ...Huh? Shinpei-kun...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……。
english: Hah... hah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (I... came back...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
どうしたの？
なんだか、顔色が――
english: What's wrong? You look really pale--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うぷッ。
english: Urp.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ゲェェェッ……。
english: Blerghh...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: しっ……慎ちゃん！？
english: Sh-Shin-chan!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 網代くん、大丈夫！？
english: Shinpei-kun, are you okay!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……。
english: Hah... hah...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
海に落ちて海水飲んでしもたん！？
ヘンなとこ打ったりしてへん！？
english: Did you swallow seawater when you fell in!? Did you hit your head or something!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: まだ辛いなら背中さすろうか？
english: If you still feel sick, should I rub your back?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪……小弓場さん……）
english: (Mio... Koyuba-san...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （二人とも生きてる！）
english: (They're both alive!)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: し、慎ちゃん……？
english: Sh-Shin-chan...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 良かっ……た……。
english: Thank... god...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、大丈夫や……。
ちょっとフェリーで酔ったんかも。
english: Ah, I'm fine... I probably just got seasick on the ferry.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そうなん？
フェリー下りて結構経つけど。
english: Really? It's been quite a while since you got off the ferry, though.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くん、水飲む？
このペットボトル、まだ口開けてないから。
english: Shinpei-kun, do you want some water? I haven't opened this bottle yet.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、ありがたくもらっとき。
english: Shin-chan, you should gratefully accept it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: A-Ah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（はぁはぁ、落ち着け。
　まずは状況を整理するんだ……）
english: (Hah, hah, calm down. First, I need to sort out the situation...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（一度目はフェリーの上。
　二度目は上陸直後。
　そして今回――三度目は、澪と会った後……）
english: (The first time was on the ferry. The second time was right after landing. And this time--the third time, is after meeting Mio...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（時間がループした際の『スタート地点』が
　徐々に遅くなってきている……）
english: (The 'starting point' when time loops is gradually getting pushed back...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そしてスタート地点より前に起きた出来事は、
　確定した『事実』になるらしい）
english: (And the events that occurred before the starting point seem to become established 'facts'.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（つまりオレが海に落ちないようにする術は、
　もうないってことだ）
english: (In other words, there's no way for me to avoid falling into the sea anymore.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（次にループした時のスタート地点は、
　たぶん今回よりもさらに遅い時間になるはず……）
english: (The starting point for the next loop will probably be even later than this time...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ん～っ……こうして島を歩くと、
帰ってきたって実感するな～！
english: Mmm... walking around the island like this really makes me feel like I've come home~!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
小弓場さんは、
何年ぶりの帰省なんですか？
english: Koyuba-san, how many years has it been since you last visited?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
小学五年生の時に引っ越したから……
７年ぶりかな？
english: I moved away when I was in fifth grade, so... About 7 years?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（このままなにもしないでいれば、
　小弓場さんのライブ中に……）
english: (If I just sit back and do nothing, during Koyuba-san's live show...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あの惨劇が繰り返されてしまう）
english: (That tragedy will repeat itself.)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
すごいですねえ。
ただ母の食餌を増やすだけのつもりやったのに、
こんな面白い光景が見られるなんて。
english: This is amazing. I only intended to increase Mother's meals, but to think I'd get to see such an interesting spectacle.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（母というのは……影の親玉？
　あれだけ大勢の人を生贄のようにして、
　なにをするつもりだ？）
english: (Who is 'Mother'...? The boss of the Shadows? What are they planning to do by using so many people like sacrifices?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そもそもあの惨劇を止めるため、
　オレになにができる？）
english: (To begin with, what can I even do to stop that tragedy?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（祭りの中止をお願いして、
　みんなに島から逃げるように言うとか？）
english: (Should I ask them to cancel the festival and tell everyone to escape the island?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でもそれが現実的だとは思えないし、
　あいつらにバレてしまえば、
　計画を早められるおそれもある……）
english: (But I don't think that's realistic, and if those guys find out, they might just accelerate their plans...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お休みの日とか、
渋谷へ行ったりするんですか？
english: On your days off, do you go to places like Shibuya?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
たまに行くけど、
そんなに多くはないかなァ。
どっちかっていうと、神保町とか。
english: I go sometimes, but not that often, I guess. If anything, I go to Jimbocho.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やっぱり最終的に目指すところは
　根本的な解決……
　つまり影の親玉を倒すことだ）
english: (In the end, my ultimate goal is a fundamental solution... Which means defeating the boss of the Shadows.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも影の親玉の正体もわからない現状では、
　どうにも動きようがない）
english: (But with the boss's identity currently unknown, there's no way for me to make a move.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今できることと言えば、
　できるだけこの島に人が集まらないように
　働きかけることくらいか……）
english: (The only thing I can do right now is try to work things so that as few people as possible gather on this island...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん、このあと商工会の人と
打ち合わせがあるんだよね！？
english: Koyuba-san, you have a meeting with the Chamber of Commerce after this, right!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっ、そうだけど……。
どうして網代くんがそのことを？
english: Eh, yeah, I do, but... How did you know that, Shinpei-kun?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（祭りにあれだけの人が集まったのは、
　小弓場さんが自分のチャンネルでライブのことを
　話したからだ）
english: (The reason so many people gathered at the festival was because Koyuba-san talked about the live show on her own channel.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（打ち合わせでライブの告知方法が決まる前に、
　配信を中止させられれば……）
english: (If I can get her to cancel the stream before the meeting decides how to announce the live show...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
もしかして……
私の仕事のこと気づいてた？
english: Don't tell me... Did you notice what my job is?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ、どういうこと？
english: Eh, what do you mean?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うーん……隠しててもしょうがないかな。
すぐにバレちゃうだろうし。
えっとね――
english: Hmm... I guess there's no point in hiding it. It'll probably be found out soon anyway. Umm, you see--

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
えええええッ！？
小弓場さんって、あのアイドルの
かおりちゃんやったん！？
english: Eeeehhhhh!? Koyuba-san, you're THAT idol, Kaori-chan!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、うん。
実はそうなんだ。
english: Y-Yeah. Actually, I am.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うわァ、感激や！
ほんまもんのかおりちゃんやん！
english: Wow, I'm so moved! You're the real Kaori-chan!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今回この島に帰省したのは、
お祭りの日にシークレットライブとトークショーを
やることになったからなの。
english:
I came back to the island
because I'm doing a secret live stream and talk show
on the festival day.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん、そのイベントなんだけど、
できれば今からでも――
english: Koyuba-san, about that event, if possible, right now...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや、ご、ごめん！
ちょっと待ってね！
english:
No, sorry!
Wait a second!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（突然「中止しろ」なんて言ったら、
　小弓場さんを混乱させた上に……）
english: (Suddenly telling her to cancel it would just confuse Koyuba-san, and...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （彼女を傷つけてしまう可能性がある……）
english: (it might even end up hurting her...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
え～っと……このあとの打ち合わせって、
欠席したりできないの？
english:
Um… about the meeting after this…
Can't you skip it?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……どうして？
english: …Why?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ライブのこと気づいたの、
実は大物アイドルが日都ヶ島でライブするって噂を
ネットで読んだからなんだ。
english: I noticed the live because I actually read a rumor online that a big idol was going to do a live on Hitogashima.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
しかも小弓場さん狙いのストーカーが、
その島に前乗りしてるっていう書き込みも
あったらしくてさ。
english: Also, there were posts saying that a stalker targeting Koyuba-san had already arrived on the island.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そんなところに小弓場さんみたいな
アイドルが来るなんて危ないよ。
english: It's dangerous for an idol like Koyuba-san to come to a place like this.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
だったら……
どうしろって言うの？
english: Then... what are you telling me to do?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうだ……今日は打ち合わせには
参加しないで、一旦フェリーで本土まで
戻ったらどうかな？
english: Right... how about you don't participate in the meeting today, and go back to the mainland by ferry for now?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そんなことできないよ。
大事な打ち合わせなんだよ？
english:
I can't do that.
It's an important meeting.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
で、でも、
小弓場さんの身の安全が……！
english: B-But... Koyuba-san's safety...!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くんが私のことを
心配してくれているのはわかるけど、
やっぱり無理だよ。
english: I know Ajiro-kun is worried about me, but it's still impossible.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
それに……早めに島に来て、
打ち合わせしたいって言ったのは
私なの。
english: Besides... I was the one who asked to come to the island early and have a meeting.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
故郷の空気を感じてから話をしたい……
そう言って予定を組んでもらったのに、
私からキャンセルできないよ。
english: I wanted to talk after feeling the air of my hometown... I had them set up the schedule because I said that, so I can't be the one to cancel it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
じゃ、じゃあ、打ち合わせが終わったら、
一旦本土に戻って、
祭り当日にまた来るとか！
english: Th-Then, after the meeting is over, go back to the mainland for now, and come back on the day of the festival!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: そんなの無理だよ……。
english: That's impossible…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん……。
あんまり無理ばっか言うたら、
かおりちゃん困らすだけやで？
english: Shin-chan... If you keep asking for the impossible, you're just going to trouble Kaori-chan, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だけど……！
english: But…!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くん、何度言われても無理。
プロとしてそれはできないよ。
english: Ajiro-kun, no matter how many times you ask, it's impossible. As a professional, I can't do that.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私は今回……やっと大好きな島のために
なにかできると思って帰ってきたの。
english: This time... I finally came back thinking I could do something for the island I love so much.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
多少の危険や無理をしてでも、
やり遂げたいと思ってる。
english: Even if it means facing some danger or pushing myself, I want to see this through.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それは、わかってるけど――
english: I know that, but…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ううん、ちっともわかってない。
english: No, you don't understand at all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh…!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私の気持ち……
簡単にわかるなんて言わないで……！
english:
My feelings…
Don't say you can understand them easily!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: こ、小弓場さん……。
english: K-Koyuba-san...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうだった……
　ここでのオレはまだ小弓場さんと
　再会したばかり）
english: (That's right... Here, I've only just reunited with Koyuba-san)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そんなオレが小弓場さんの気持ちを
　わかると言っても……）
english: (Even if someone like me says I understand Koyuba-san's feelings...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くんには、
応援してほしかったんだけどな。
english: I wanted Ajiro-kun to support me, though.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
澪ちゃん。
私、やっぱり宿に戻るよ。
english: Mio-chan. I'm going to go back to the inn after all.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
えっ！？
で、でも……！
english: Huh!? B-But...!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
せっかく気を遣ってくれたのに……
ごめんなさい！
english: Even though you went out of your way to care for me... I'm sorry!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
待って、小弓場さん！
部屋からの配信は絶対やめてくれ！
english: Wait, Koyuba-san! Absolutely do not stream from your room!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
本当にごめん！
でも危険なのは本当なんだ！
english: I'm really sorry! But the danger is real!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
島にいる間は、
部屋から出ないでくれ！
english:
While you're on the island,
don't leave your room!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃん、
行ってもた……。
english: Kaori-chan... she left...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレの声、届いたかな……）
english: (Did my voice reach her…?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほんまどないしたん？
慎ちゃん、なんか変やで？
english: What's really going on? Shin-chan, you're acting weird.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
な、なんでもないよ……。
本気で心配してるだけや。
english: I-It's nothing... I'm just seriously worried about her.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さんには、
　あとで電話して謝るとして……）
english: (I'll call Koyuba-san later and apologize to her, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（できれば、その時に改めて
　配信中止についてお願いしてみよう）
english: (If possible, I'll try asking her again to cancel the stream at that time.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あの惨劇を食い止めるためなら……
　どんなことでもやってやる！）
english: (If it means stopping that tragedy... I'll do whatever it takes!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（葬儀会場……。
　ここには、あの人がいるはずだ）
english:
(The funeral hall…
That person should be there.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 雁切さん！
english: Karikiri-san!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ああ、慎平くん。
今日は色々ありがとう。
english: Ah, Shinpei-kun. Thanks for everything today.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
こちらこそ、
ありがとうございました。
english: Thank you as well.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの……雁切さん、
このあと、商工会と小弓場かおりさんの
打ち合わせに合流しますよね？
english: Um... Karikiri-san, you're joining the meeting with the Chamber of Commerce and Koyuba Kaori after this, right?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
このあとって……いやいや、
ちょっと待ってください。
english: After this... no, no, please wait a minute.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
慎平くん、なんでそのこと
知ってるんです？
english: Shinpei-kun, why do you know about that?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
えっ？
あ、ああ、それは……。
english: Huh? Ah, well, that's...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、そうだ。
実は港で小弓場さんと会ったんです。
彼女は小学生の頃の同級生で……。
english: Ah, right. I actually met Koyuba-san at the port. She's my classmate from elementary school...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あ～なるほどォ。
それで事情を聞いてたんですか。
なら、隠す必要ありませんね。
english: Ah~ I see. So you heard the circumstances from her. Then there's no need to hide it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 雁切さん、ひとつお願いがあるんですけど。
english: Karikiri-san, I have a request.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: なんでしょう？
english: What is it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今日の打ち合わせで、
イベントの告知方法なんかも話し合われると
思うんですけど……。
english: I think things like how to announce the event will be discussed at today's meeting, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さんのチャンネル配信は、
しないで欲しいんです。
english: I want you to make sure Koyuba-san doesn't stream on her channel.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ええ……？
english: Eh…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
このままだとこの島でとんでもないことが
起きてしまうんです。
ですから……お願いします！
english: If things stay like this, something terrible is going to happen on this island. So... please!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
そんなこと言われてもねェ……。
商工会さんと小弓場さんの事務所側の
意向もありますし。
english: Well, even if you say that... There are the intentions of the Chamber of Commerce and Koyuba-san's agency to consider.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ、そこをなんとか……！
english: P-Please, you have to do something...!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
いやいや、ちょっと待ってください。
そんなに言われても困りますって。
english: No, no, please wait a minute. It puts me in a tough spot when you say it like that.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
だいたいとんでもないことって、
一体なにが起きるんです？
english: What kind of terrible thing are you talking about? What on earth is going to happen?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それは……詳しくは言えないですけど、
小弓場さんの配信を利用して、
悪事を働こうとしている連中がいるんです！
english: That's... I can't go into details, but there are people trying to use Koyuba-san's stream to do something bad!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: その情報はどこから？
english: Where did that information come from?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それは……ネットの書き込みで……。
english: That's... from posts online...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: その書き込み、見せてもらえます？
english: Can you show me those posts?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あっ……。
english: Ah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
すみません、適当に検索して
見つけた書き込みだったので……
今すぐには見せられません。
english: Sorry, I just found the posts by randomly searching, so... I can't show them to you right now.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
……そうですか。
でもそれやと打ち合わせで議題に出すのも
難しいでしょう。
english: ...I see. But with just that, it would be difficult to bring it up as an agenda item at the meeting.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ、そんな……！
english: N-No way...!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
だいたい慎平くん、
どうして配信のことまで知ってるんです？
english: Anyway, Shinpei-kun, how do you even know about the stream?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
それって、このあとの打ち合わせで
初めて話し合うことやのに、
よう知ってましたね。
english: That's something we're supposed to discuss for the first time at the meeting after this, yet you knew about it well.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ、それは……。
english: Th-That's...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
……まあ、落ち着いてください。
潮ちゃんのこともあって、
混乱してるんやないですか？
english: ...Well, please calm down. Aren't you just confused because of what happened with Ushio-chan?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
今日はもうゆっくり休んで、
あとのことは私らに任せてください。
english: Just take a good rest today, and leave the rest to us.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Y... yes...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: みんな、こんばんわ～～～！
english: Good evening, everyone~~~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
小弓場かおりの『こゆばチャンネル』！
今夜もちょっとだけ夜ふかしして、
私と一緒におしゃべりしましょう！
english: It's Kaori Koyuba's 'Koyuba Channel'! Let's stay up a little late again tonight and chat together!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くそっ、配信が始まってしもた……。
english: Damn, the stream has started…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あれから商工会にも掛け合ってみたけど、
　結局うまくいかなかった）
english: (I tried negotiating with the Chamber of Commerce after that, but it didn't work out in the end.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さんにも何度か電話やメールで
　連絡してみたけど……）
english: (I tried contacting Koyuba-san several times by phone and email, but...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今私は、とある場所に来ていま～す。
いったいどこでしょう？
english: I'm currently at a certain place~. Where could it be?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まったく応答してくれなかった。
　もう愛想尽かされてしまったのかも……）
english: (She didn't respond at all. Maybe she's completely lost patience with me...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっ、早く答えを言えって？
もーっ、せっかちさんがいるぞ。
english: Huh? You want me to give the answer quickly? Jeez, someone's impatient.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
じゃあ正解言っちゃおうかな。
答えは……。
english: Then I guess I'll reveal the correct answer. The answer is...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba (Kaori)
japanese: 和歌山県の日都ヶ島でーす！
english: It's Hitogashima Island in Wakayama Prefecture!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……えっ？
english: …Huh?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
発表しま～す！
なんと私、小弓場かおりは……！
english: Announcement time~! Believe it or not, I, Kaori Koyuba...!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
７月２４日、ここ日都ヶ島で、
ソロライブ＆トークショーを
開催することになりました！
english: On July 24th, I'll be holding a solo live & talk show right here on Hitogashima!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なっ……場所を明かした！？
english: Wh... she revealed the location!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: い、一体どうなってんだ！？
english: Wh-What the hell is going on!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
前回の経験では、最後まで
ライブの開催場所は明かされなかった
はずなのに……！
english: Based on my past experience, the live venue wasn't supposed to be revealed until the very end...!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba (Kaori)
japanese:
ほんとは今回の生配信ライブ、
シークレットライブの予定だったんだけど……。
english: Actually, this live stream was supposed to be a secret live, but...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba (Kaori)
japanese:
私の強い希望で、ちゃんと事前告知する形に
変更させてもらいました！
english: Due to my strong request, we changed it so that it's properly announced in advance!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なぜ変わった……？
　オレが小弓場さんを怒らせたからか？）
english: (Why did it change...? Is it because I made Koyuba-san angry?)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba (Kaori)
japanese:
そんなわけで開催場所の告知が
直前になっちゃってゴメンね～。
english: Because of that, sorry the venue announcement is so last minute~.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba (Kaori)
japanese:
ライブは明後日の予定だから、
現地で参加できる人は
限られちゃうかもね……。
english: The live is scheduled for the day after tomorrow, so the number of people who can attend in person might be limited...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba (Kaori)
japanese:
えっ？
「オレ、現地行くよ！」って？
嬉しい～！
english: Huh? "I'm going to be there!" you say? I'm so happy~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba (Kaori)
japanese:
日都ヶ島は私の生まれ故郷で……
とっても大好きな場所なの！
english: Hitogashima is my hometown... It's a place I love very much!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba (Kaori)
japanese:
だから……よかったらみんなも、
遊びに来てくれると嬉しいですっ。
english: So... if you'd like, I'd be happy if you all came to visit.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（すごいコメントの数だ……。
　このままだと前回以上の人たちが、
　島に押し寄せてくるかもしれない）
english: (That's an insane number of comments... At this rate, even more people than last time might flood the island.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ダメだ……何とかしないと！）
english: (This is bad... I have to do something!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 「日都ヶ島には行くな、パニックになるぞ！」。
english: "Don't go to Hitogashima, there will be a panic!"

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（みんな、頼む！
　このコメントを見て考え直してくれ！！）
english: (Everyone, please! Look at this comment and reconsider!!)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
……というわけで！
次回はライブ＆トークショー生配信で
お会いしましょう！
english: ...And so! See you next time at the live & talk show stream!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
『こゆばチャンネル』でした！
おやすみなさい！
english: This has been the 'Koyuba Channel'! Good night!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（くそ、他のコメントに流されて、
　誰もオレのコメントに気づかない……）
english: (Damn it, it got buried by other comments, and no one noticed my comment...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そもそも、こんなこと信じる奴なんて……）
english: (In the first place, who would even believe something like this...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、諦めちゃダメだ！
　どうにかして、みんなに伝えてやる！）
english: (No, I can't give up! I'll find some way to tell everyone!)

japanese: 16.網代くんがいたから
english: 16. Because Ajiro-kun Was There

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
あの右目があれば……
確かに可能かもしれませんね。
english: If you have that right eye... It certainly might be possible.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: 時を遡ってやり直すことも……。
english: To go back in time and redo things...

japanese: 7月24日
english: July 24

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あれから二日経った。
　なんとか島に来る人を阻止できないかと
　頑張ってはみたけど……）
english: (Two days have passed since then. I tried my best to see if I could somehow stop people from coming to the island, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なにも成果が上がらないどころか、
　結局来島者は、前回よりも増えてしまった）
english: (Far from getting any results, the number of visitors ended up increasing even more than last time.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうしてなにもできないまま……
　オレは夏祭りの日を迎えたのだった）
english: (And so, unable to do anything... I welcomed the day of the summer festival.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
いつも来てるところやし、
送ってくれやんでも良かったのに。
english: We come here all the time, so you didn't have to walk me here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
例年より祭りの観光客が多いんや。
気をつけるに越したことないやろ。
english: There are more tourists for the festival than usual. You can never be too careful.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それより……ごめんな。
祭りに行くなとか言うて。
english: More importantly... I'm sorry. For telling you not to go to the festival.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ううん、別にええよ。
english: No, it's fine.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんがおらんのに、
私だけお祭りに行こうとは
思っとらんかったし。
english: Since Onee-chan isn't here, I wasn't thinking of going to the festival by myself anyway.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それにトキコも、
「それなら家で一緒に遊ぼう」て
言うてくれたしな。
english: Besides, Tokiko also said, "Then let's hang out at home together."

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
まあ、窓くんはあんまり納得いってやん
みたいやったけど。
english: Well, Sou-kun didn't seem too convinced about it, though.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
明日になったらちゃんと話すよ。
窓、澪、それにトキちゃんにも。
english: I'll talk to you properly tomorrow. To Sou, Mio, and Toki-chan too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
約束やで。
ほな、またな。
english:
It's a promise.
See you later.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、トキちゃんと窓によろしく。
english: Yeah, give my regards to Toki-chan and Sou.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（身近な人を祭りに行かせない……
　これだけのことしかできないけど）
english: (Not letting the people close to me go to the festival... That's all I can do, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪や窓たちをあんな惨劇のさなかに
　放り込むくらいなら、
　こうした方がよっぽどマシだ）
english: (Compared to throwing Mio and Sou and the others into the middle of that tragedy, this is much better.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、まだ終わってない。
　今日のイベントを中止できなかった以上、
　人々の犠牲を回避するにはもう……）
english: (But it's not over yet. Since I couldn't cancel today's event, the only way left to avoid casualties is...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （影の親玉を倒すしかない！）
english: (To defeat the boss of the Shadows!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（花火が上がるまでは少し時間がある。
　まだ騒ぎは起こっていないな）
english: (There's still a little time before the fireworks go off. No commotion has started yet.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Phew…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（覚悟を決めてきたものの……
　武器と呼べるモンは包丁一本だけか）
english: (Even though I've prepared myself for this... The only thing I can call a weapon is a single kitchen knife, huh.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あの人間離れした身体能力を持った影相手に、
　なんとも心もとないもんやな）
english: (Against a Shadow with such inhuman physical abilities, it's not very reassuring.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（けど……どうせ死ぬにしたって、
　せめて一矢は報いたい）
english: (But... even if I'm going to die anyway, I want to at least get one hit in.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そして……次のループでは必ず！）
english: (And... in the next loop, for sure!)

speaker: ファン（女性）
japanese: ぎゃああああああああ！！
english: Gyaaaaaahhh!!

speaker: ファン（男性）
japanese:
うわあああっ……！？
に、逃げろおォォォォ！！！
english: Uwaaaah...!?!? R-Run awayyy!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
悲鳴……？
もう虐殺が始まってるのか！？
english:
A scream…?
Has the massacre already started!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なぜだ！？
まだ花火もライブも始まって
ないってのに！
english: Why!? The fireworks and the live haven't even started yet!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （とにかく、行くしかない！！）
english: (Anyway, I just have to go!!)

speaker: Fans
japanese: うあああああああ！！
english: Uwaaaaaahhh!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（観客を襲う四本腕……
　折り重なっていく死体……）
english: (The Four-Armed Shadow attacking the audience... The bodies piling up...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （違っているのは――）
english: (What's different is...)

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）
japanese: ……くっ、外してしもた！
english: ...Damn, I missed!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あれは……フェリーで乗り合わせた？）
english: (Is that... the woman from the ferry?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんであの人がここに……
　まさか、あの四本腕と戦ってるんか！？）
english: (Why is she here...? Is she actually fighting that Four-Armed Shadow!?)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
いやァ、何事もなく終えられるとは
思ってませんでしたが……。
english: Well, I didn't think we'd be able to finish without any incidents, but...

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……。
english: *Pant... pant...*

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
もうそろそろ死んでもらえません？
このあとも、いろいろやることが
山積みなもんで。
english: Could you please just die already? I still have a mountain of things to do after this.

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）
japanese: ……くッ！
english: ...Guh!

speaker: 消えていく影
japanese: ギャッ！？
english: Gah!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まさか……！
　あの人、銃で影を倒してる！？）
english: (No way...! She's defeating the Shadows with a gun!?)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
いい腕してますね。
でもいくら雑魚を消しても意味はありません。
english: You've got good aim. But no matter how many small fry you eliminate, it's meaningless.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
元を断たねば影なんて、
いくらでも増やせますからね。
english: If you don't cut off the source, I can multiply the Shadows as much as I want.

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）
japanese: ぐッ……！
english: Guh...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ah...

speaker: 女の子の声（カオリ）
japanese: 網代くん！！
english: Ajiro-kun!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さんッ！？
english: Koyuba-san!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
無事だったんだ！
良かった……。
english:
You're safe!
Thank goodness…

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ひづる)
japanese: 違う、そいつは……！
english: No, that's...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐ、ああッ！！
english: Guh, aah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（な、なんだ！？
　足に激痛がっ！！）
english: (Wh-What!? An intense pain in my leg!!)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba (Kaori)
japanese:
私、人刺すの初めてなんだけど、
結構簡単なんだね。
english: This is my first time stabbing someone, but it's actually pretty easy.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ウソ、だろッ……！
　小弓場さんに……刺された！？）
english: (You've gotta be kidding me...! Koyuba-san... stabbed me!?)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba (Kaori)
japanese: うふふ……。
english: Ufufu...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえ……影だったのかッ！？
english: You... were a Shadow!?

speaker: Kaori
japanese: ねえ、網代くん？
english: Hey, Ajiro-kun?

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
私ね、ちゃ～んと網代くんの言うことを
守ろうとしたんだよ。
english: You know, I really did try to follow what Ajiro-kun told me.

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
生配信も中止して、
ライブも中止にしたいってね。
english: I wanted to cancel the live stream, and cancel the live performance too.

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
アイドルの仕事も、島の町おこしも
本当に大事だったのに……。
english: Even though my idol work and the town revitalization were really important...

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
でも、そんなことしたら
大事な食餌が集まらなくなって、
オカアサンが困っちゃうじゃない？
english: But if I did that, the important food wouldn't gather, and Mother would be troubled, wouldn't she?

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
だから……
ふふ、本物のかおりは消しちゃった。
english: So... hehe, I got rid of the real Kaori.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレのせいだ……
　オレのせいで小弓場さんの運命が変わって……）
english: (It's my fault... My actions changed Koyuba-san's fate...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さんにオレの言葉は届いていた。
　配信もしなくて済むように、
　動いてくれていたんだ……）
english: (My words had reached Koyuba-san. She was acting so she wouldn't have to stream...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、そうすれば、
　できるだけ人を集めたいという影の目的を
　阻害することになってしまう）
english: (But doing that would interfere with the Shadows' goal of gathering as many people as possible.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （だから影は、小弓場さんを影にして……）
english: (That's why the Shadows turned Koyuba-san into a Shadow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
くそッ！！
全部オレのせいやないかッ！！
english: Damn it!! It's all my fault!!

speaker: Mio's Voice
japanese: かわいそうやね、慎ちゃん。
english: You're so pitiful, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Mio's Shadow...)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 三日間、あんなに頑張ったのになァ。
english: Even though you worked so hard for three days.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Eh...

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
頑張ってる網代くんのこと、
みんなでずっと見てたんだよ。
english: We've all been watching you work so hard this whole time, Ajiro-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ、ずっと……！？
english: Eh, this whole time...!?

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
私に何度も連絡くれてたよね？
履歴に網代くんの名前が増えてくの、
嬉しかったなァ。
english: You contacted me so many times, didn't you? I was so happy seeing Ajiro-kun's name filling up my call history.

speaker: Kaori
japanese: ふふ、なんの意味もないのにね。
english: Hehe, even though it was all meaningless.

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ひづる)
japanese:
なぜ……そこまで彼に、こだわる。
ただの……島民だろう……。
english: Why... are you so fixated on him? He's just... an islander...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あの人、まだ生きて……）
english: (That person is still alive…)

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
それはですね、
オカアサンの脅威になるかもしれないものを、
網代くんが持ってるとわかったからです。
english: That's because I found out that Ajiro-kun has something that might be a threat to Mother.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 脅威になるもの……？
english: Something that could be a threat...?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
でもオカアサン、
もう慎ちゃんに興味ないみたい。
english: But Mother doesn't seem interested in Shin-chan anymore.

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
うん、結局網代くんを殺さず生かしておけば、
時間をループさせることもできなくなるもんね。
english: Yeah, in the end, if we keep Ajiro-kun alive instead of killing him, he won't be able to loop time anymore, right?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
そういうこと。
もう脅威でもなんでもないんよ。
english: Exactly. You're not a threat or anything anymore.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ループのことが……バレてる！？）
english: (They know about the loop!?)

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
というワケで！
網代くんはそこで大人しくしててね！
english: So with that said! Ajiro-kun, just stay quiet right there!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
この傷と出血やったら、
すぐ死ぬってことはないと思うけど、
無理したらわからんで？
english: With this wound and bleeding, I don't think you'll die right away, but if you push yourself, who knows?

speaker: Mio
japanese: せやからアホみたいに動かんといてな。
english: So don't go moving around like an idiot.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （動きを封じられた……）
english: (My movements are sealed...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どうあってもオレを生かして……
　ループを封じるつもりか……）
english: (They're going to keep me alive no matter what... to seal off the loop...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くそォ、このままじゃ……！
english: Damn it, at this rate...!

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ひづる)
japanese: そうか……キミが……。
english: I see... so you're the one...

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ひづる)
japanese:
キミを、もっと……
早く捜し出せていれば……。
english: If only I had... found you sooner...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お、お願いです！
その銃でオレを殺してください！
english: P-Please! Kill me with that gun!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレは死んでも、やり直せるんです！
早く撃ってください！
english: Even if I die, I can start over! Please shoot me, hurry!

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ひづる)
japanese:
『ループ』とは……
そういうことだったのか……。
english: So that's what... the "loop" meant...

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ひづる)
japanese: もしキミが……またやり直せたのなら……。
english: If you... are able to start over again...

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ひづる)
japanese:
私に、キミの名を名乗りたまえ……。
必ず……助け……。
english: Give me... your name... I will definitely... help...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ah...

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
残念だったね、網代くん。
あの人、もう引き金を引く力も
残ってなかったみたい。
english: That's too bad, Ajiro-kun. It seems she didn't even have the strength left to pull the trigger anymore.

speaker: Mio
japanese: もう観念するしかないみたいやね。
english: Looks like you have no choice but to give up.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （もう無理だ……）
english: (It's no use...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今度こそ、お終いだ……）
english: (This time, it really is over...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （また、この光景だ……）
english: (This sight again...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （夥しい数の死体の山）
english: (A mountain of countless corpses.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （島を飲み込んでいく巨大な影）
english: (A giant shadow swallowing the island.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （大切なものが、すべて飲み込まれていく）
english: (Everything precious to me, being swallowed up.)

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
これでオカアサンは力を取り戻せます。
みなさんのおかげです。
english: With this, Mother can regain her power. It's all thanks to everyone.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さんの顔で、
そんなこと言うなよ……。
english: Don't say that... with Koyuba-san's face...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あの子は、この島を愛してたんだぞ！
english: She loved this island!

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
知ってるよ。
だって、私は小弓場かおりだもの。
english: I know. Because I am Koyuba Kaori.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
違うッ！
彼女がこんな結果を望むはずない！
english: You're wrong! There's no way she would have wanted this outcome!

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
そうかなァ？
私が好きだった島が消えてなくなる
わけじゃないし。
english: Is that so? It's not like the island I loved is going to disappear.

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
私が島やここでの思い出をなによりも
大切にしてきたのは……。
english: The reason I've treasured the island and my memories here more than anything else is...

speaker: Kaori
japanese: 網代くんがいたからなんだけどな。
english: Because Ajiro-kun was here, you know.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Eh…?

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
そろそろ私たちの番だね。
ほら、もうすぐだよ。
english: It's almost our turn. Look, it's almost here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （巨大な影がオレたちの足元まで……）
english: (The giant shadow has reached our feet...)

japanese: 17.一緒に終わりを
english: 17. An End Together

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんだ……ここ？
english: What is... this place?

speaker: Kaori
japanese: それが……私にもわからないの。
english: That's... I don't know either.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （小弓場さん……？）
english: (Koyuba-san…?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （いや……その影か）
english: (No... her Shadow?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （声はするけど……姿は見えない……）
english: (I hear a voice... but I can't see her...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（自分が死んでるのか、生きてるのか……
　それすらも、よくわからない）
english: (Am I dead, or am I alive... I don't even know that much.)

speaker: Kaori
japanese: 網代くん、私の声……聞こえてる？
english: Ajiro-kun, can you... hear my voice?

speaker: Kaori
japanese: ねえってば。
english: I said, hey.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、聞こえてるよ。
english: Yeah, I can hear you.

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
私もここがなんなのか……
本当にわからないんだけど。
english: I also... really don't know what this place is.

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
たぶん……もうすぐ、
なにもかも消えてなくなる、
そんな気がする。
english: Maybe... I have a feeling that soon, everything is going to disappear.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんとなくオレも……
　そんな気がしていた）
english: (For some reason... I also had that feeling.)

speaker: Kaori
japanese: 網代くんは本当によく頑張ったよ。
english: You really did your best, Ajiro-kun.

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
でも、どんなに頑張っても、
どうしようもないこと……
叶わないことがあったってだけ。
english: But no matter how hard you tried, there were just some things that couldn't be helped... things that couldn't come true.

speaker: Kaori
japanese: 私が諦めたみたいにね。
english: Just like how I gave up.

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
キーホルダー……
ライブに持っていくようにって
メッセージくれたよね。
english: The keychain... You sent me a message telling me to bring it to the live, right?

speaker: Kaori
japanese:
小さい頃好きだった、
このキャラクターのグッズ……
今でもずっと持ち歩いてたんだよ。
english: This merchandise of the character I liked when I was little... I've been carrying it around with me all this time.

speaker: Kaori
japanese: 楽しかったあの頃を思い出せるから。
english: Because it lets me remember those fun times.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （本当に、彼女が話しているみたいだ）
english: (It really seems like she's the one speaking.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも……だからといって、
　もうなんの意味もない……）
english: (But... even so, it doesn't mean anything anymore...)

speaker: Kaori
japanese: 好きだよ、網代くん。
english: I love you, Ajiro-kun.

speaker: Kaori
japanese: 二人一緒に……終わりを迎えようね。
english: Let's meet our end... together.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレは一体……
　なにをしようとしていたのか……）
english: (What on earth was I... trying to do...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今となってはもう――）
english: (At this point, it's already...)

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_ROOTCLEAR_KAO>ｒｏｕｔｅ：小弓場かおり</color>】を入手しました。
english: Key TIPS[<color=#GF_KEY_ROOTCLEAR_KAO>route: Kaori Koyuba</color>] obtained.

japanese: 7月24日
english: July 24th

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
慎平さんって
澪のことどう思てるんですか？
english: Shinpei-san, what do you think of Mio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ちょっ……！
何聞いてんのトキコ！！
english: W-Wait...! What are you asking, Tokiko!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ど、どうって……
そりゃあ…………。
english:
…W-what do you mean…
Well, I guess…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もちろん大事に思てるけど。
english: Of course I care about her.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 家族として。
english: As family.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 家族ですかァ～～～～。
english: Family, huh~~~.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
コラッ！
もうトキコ！！
ヘンな事聞かんといてーっ！！
english: Hey! Jeez, Tokiko!! Don't ask weird things!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ゴッホン！
慎平……！
english: *Ahem!* Shinpei...!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
さっき親父から連絡あってな。
花火のあと御海送りの儀式すんでからやったら、
雁切さん体空くそうやて！
english: I just got a call from my dad. He said Karikiri-san will be free after the fireworks and the Umi-okuri ceremony are over!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: よし……そしたらそれまでは――
english: Okay… then until then--

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: どうした慎平！
english: What's wrong, Shinpei!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……い、今あそこに……！
english: ...J-Just now, over there...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あの後ろ姿……潮？）
english: (That figure from behind... Ushio?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そんなはずは……。
　見間違いやとは思うけど……）
english: (That can't be... I'm sure I just imagined it, but...)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
境内の方、上がりません？
あそこから花火よく見えますから。
english: Why don't we go up to the shrine grounds? You can see the fireworks well from there.

japanese: 後ろ姿が気にかかる
english: That figure from behind is bothering me

japanese: 見間違いだろう
english: I probably just imagined it

japanese: 1.ライブステージ
english: 1. Live Stage

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……見間違いだ。
　あいつがここにいるわけがない）
english: (...I just imagined it. There's no way she'd be here.)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おい、慎平？
english: Hey, Shinpei?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ、いや……。
english: Ah, yeah, no...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（きっと、さっきのは……
　潮との約束を守れなかった後悔が
　見せた幻なんだ）
english: (That just now must have been... an illusion shown to me by the regret of not being able to keep my promise to Ushio.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、どないしたん？
うわの空やない？
english: Shin-chan, what's wrong? You're spacing out, aren't you?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 澪のこと……守っちゃってね……。
english: I… I'll protect Mio…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Ushio…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（わかってる。
　澪のことは任せとけ……）
english:
(I know.
Leave Mio to me…)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
どないしたん？
さっきから黙ったままやけど。
english: What's wrong? You've been quiet for a while now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……なんでもない。
english: ...It's nothing.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
なんでもないって言う割には、
澪の浴衣姿じっくり眺めてましたよね。
english: For saying it's nothing, you were staring pretty intently at Mio in her yukata.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はっ！？　ち、ちゃうって！
english: Huh!? N-No, I wasn't!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
さっ、さっきから何なんトキコ！？
ちょっと言うてることおかしない？
english: Wh-What's with you, Tokiko!? Aren't you saying some weird things?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
そう？　こんな機会そうそうないし、
聞けることは聞いたろと思て。
english: Really? We don't get chances like this often, so I thought I'd ask what I can while I can.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……えっ？
english: …Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 聞けることって……。
english: What you can ask...?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ゴッホンッ！
english: *Ahem!*

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そんなことより、
もたもたしとると花火始まってまうで。
english: More importantly, if we keep dawdling, the fireworks will start.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そ、そうやな！
境内へ急ごか。
english: Y-Yeah! Let's hurry to the shrine grounds.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……トキコ。
浴衣、変な風になったりしてやん？
帯がほどけてるとかない？
english: ...Tokiko. Does my yukata look weird or anything? Is the obi coming undone?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
大丈夫。
慎平さんにじっくり見られても
問題あらへん。
english: It's fine. There's no problem even if Shinpei-san stares at you intently.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そ、そややないから！！
english: Th-That's not what I meant!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おー、ぎょうさんおるわ。
みんな花火目当てなんやろか？
english: Oh, there's a ton of people. Are they all here for the fireworks?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
今年はそうでもないらしよ。
ほら、あっこ。
english: It seems that's not the case this year. Look, over there.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あれは……？
english: What is that…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小さなステージの上で、
　マイクを持った女の子が手を振ってる？）
english: (A girl with a microphone is waving on top of a small stage?)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なんや周りにいる連中、元気やなぁ。
テンションめちゃくちゃ高いぞ。
english: The people around there sure are energetic. Their excitement is through the roof.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: まるでアイドルのライブやな。
english: It's just like an idol's live performance.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なーに言うてんの！
『まるで』やのうて、ほんまもんのアイドルや！
english: What are you talking about! Not "just like," she's a real idol!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ、そ、そうなん？
english: Huh, r-really?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お祭りでライブしてもらうために
本土から呼んだそうです。
なんか有名なグループのメンバーだとか。
english: Apparently they called her from the mainland to do a live at the festival. She's a member of some famous group or something.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もー！　トキコはクールやな。
あの小弓場かおりちゃんが来てくれてるんやで？
english: Jeez! You're so cool about it, Tokiko. The Koyuba Kaori-chan came all the way here, you know?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: なにっ、小弓場かおり！？
english: What, Koyuba Kaori!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ、小弓場かおり！？
english: Huh, Koyuba Kaori!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほらな？
これが普通の反応や。
english: See? This is the normal reaction.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、いや、オレは……。
english: Ah, no, I just...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
小弓場かおりのライブって、
なんでそない大事なこと
祭りのポスターに載ってやんのや！？
english: A live by Koyuba Kaori? Why isn't something that important on the festival poster!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: シークレットライブみたいなもんとちゃう？
english: Isn't it like a secret live?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
せやけど、いかにもファンっぽい連中が
集まっちゃあるで？
地元民すら知らされてやんのによ！
english: But there's a bunch of people who look exactly like fans gathered around, right? Even though not even the locals were told about it!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ああ、ネットで情報が拡散されたのかも。
english: Yeah, maybe the information spread online.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
そんなに有名なアイドルなんだったら、
追いかけてる人達のネットワークとかもあるだろうし。
english: If she's that famous of an idol, there's probably a network of people following her around.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場かおりって……
　港で会った小弓場さん、だよな？）
english: (Koyuba Kaori... That's the Koyuba-san I met at the port, right?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （まさかあの小弓場さんが……アイドル？）
english: (Don't tell me that Koyuba-san is... an idol?)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
みんな～～～～っ！
こんばんは～～～～～っ！！
english: Everyone~~~~! Good evening~~~~~!!

speaker: Fans
japanese: こんばんは～～～～～～っ！！！
english: Good evening~~~~~~!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（間違いない、この声は小弓場さんだ。
　……港で会った時とはかなり印象が違うけど）
english: (No mistake, this voice is Koyuba-san. ...Even though her impression is quite different from when I met her at the port.)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おお……。
ファンの連中、訓練されたみたいに声が揃ってるな。
english: Whoa... The fans' voices are perfectly in sync, like they've been trained.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ホンマやね～。
english: You're right~.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私の歌で、お祭りをもっともっと
盛り上げたいと思いまーす！
みんなも力を貸してねー！
english: I want to make the festival even more exciting with my singing! Everyone, lend me your strength!

speaker: Fans
japanese: いえええええい～～～～～～っ！！！
english: Yeeeaaaaah~~~~~~!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おっ、撮影ＯＫなんか！
オレらも撮っとこやァ、慎平！
english: Oh, photography is okay!? Let's take some too, Shinpei!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いやオレは別に……。
english: No, I don't really need to...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: お兄ちゃん、あの人のファンだったの？
english: Onii-chan, were you a fan of hers?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
いや、別にファンいうわけやないけど、
せっかくやから撮っとこ思て。
english: No, I'm not really a fan or anything, but I figured I'd take one since it's a good opportunity.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （みんなスマホを構えて夢中だな……）
english: (Everyone is completely absorbed, holding up their smartphones...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: わっ、眩しっ……！
english: Whoa, that's bright...!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ホンマやな。
さっきからカメラのフラッシュが凄いわ。
あの人、えらい人気なんやね。
english: It really is. The camera flashes have been crazy for a while now. She must be super popular.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おっし撮れたで！
おお、結構ええやん！
english: Alright, I got it! Oh, it looks pretty good!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 見せて見せて！
english: Show me, show me!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
わあ、ホンマ可愛いなァ。
さすがアイドルや。
めっちゃキラキラしちゃある。
english: Wow, she really is cute. As expected of an idol. She's super sparkly.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
こんなん、
みんなが好きになってまうわけや。
english: It makes sense why everyone falls for her like this.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: い、いやオレはちゃうし！
english: N-No, I'm not!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
やっぱ消しとくわ。
なんちゅうたか知らんけど、
こういうんも権利やらあるんやろ？
english: I think I'll delete it after all. I don't know what it's called, but there are rights and stuff for this kind of thing, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 肖像権か？
