english: Portrait rights?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そう、それや！
english: Yeah, that's it!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
でも撮影ＯＫみたいやしええんやない？
ネットに上げたらダメかもしれやんけど。
english: But it seems like photography is okay, so isn't it fine? Though it might be bad to upload it to the internet.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ええんや！
オレには必要ない！
english:
It's fine!
I don't need it!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えー、もったいない。
english: Eh, what a waste.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: お兄ちゃん……。
english: Onii-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ああ……。
　そうか、窓のやつ）
english: (Ah... I see, Sou...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: それじゃ１曲目！　いきますよー！
english: Alright then, the first song! Here we go!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うわあー！
すごいすごい！　本物や！
かおりちゃんが動いて歌ってる～！！
english: Wow! Amazing, amazing! It's the real deal! Kaori-chan is moving and singing~!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ははは、何言ってんねん。
そりゃそうやろ、本物やで？
english: Hahaha, what are you saying? Of course she is, she's the real thing, you know?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: もー、慎ちゃん！
english: Jeez, Shin-chan!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おーおー、ファンも盛り上がっとるわ。
english: Oh wow, the fans are getting really hyped up too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影が人前で襲ってこないのなら、
　賑やかな場所のほうが安全……
　そう思って来てみたけど）
english: (If the Shadows don't attack in front of people, then a lively place is safer... I came here thinking that, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こんなライブまで開催されてるなんて、
　さらに好都合だ）
english: (With a live like this being held, it's even more convenient.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こうして御海送りまで過ごして、
　その後で雁切さんに会って……）
english: (If I spend the time until the Umi-okuri like this, and then meet Karikiri-san afterwards...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ、花火上がったで！
english: Ah, the fireworks went off!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
花火をバックにライブか！
最高やな！
english: A live with fireworks in the background! That's the best!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、賑やかでええな。
english: Yeah, it's nice and lively.

speaker: 女性の声（女性客Ａ）
japanese: キャアァァァァァーッ！！！！
english: KYYAAAAAAH!!!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 今、何か聞こえやんかった？
english: Did you hear something just now?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 悲鳴……だったような……。
english: It sounded... like a scream...

speaker: 女性客
japanese:
ひいィィッ！！
たっ、助けてぇぇぇぇ！
english: Hiiiieee!! H-Help meeeee!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: な、なんやァッ！？
english: Wh-What the hell!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: みんなぁっ！　逃げてぇ！！
english: Everyone! Run away!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ？　ええ？　なに？
english: Huh? Eh? What?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 逃げてって……。
english: Run away, she says...

speaker: 男性客
japanese: ぎぃやぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！
english: Giyyaaaaaaah!!

speaker: 女性客
japanese:
ひいいいいいいいっ！
ぎゃああぁぁぁっ！
english: Hiiiiiiieeee!! Gyaaaaaahhh!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 逃げてぇぇぇ！！
english: Run awayyyy!!

speaker: Fans
japanese: うわああぁぁぁっ！
english: Uwaaaaaahhh!!

speaker: 女性客
japanese: ひいいいいいいいっ！
english: Hiiiiiieeee!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うわっ！？
english: Uwah!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あかん！
　パニックになった人たちが殺到してきて、
　自由に動けやん……！）
english: (This is bad! The panicked crowd is rushing in, and I can't move freely...!)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 慎平！　どこや！？
english: Shinpei! Where are you!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ここや！　ここにおる！
english: Here! I'm here!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お兄ちゃん、どこ！？
人が邪魔やっ！！
english: Onii-chan, where are you!? People are in the way!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪は……！
澪はどこやッ！？
english:
Mio…!
Where is Mio!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私はここ！
english: I'm here!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんはどこなん！？
声しか聞こえやん！
english:
Shin-chan, where are you!?
I can only hear your voice!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪！　トキちゃん！
流れに逆ろうたら危険や！
english: Mio! Toki-chan! It's dangerous to go against the flow of the crowd!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
上手く流れに乗って外へ出といてくれ！
参道のとこで落ち合おや！
english: Ride the flow and get out of here! Let's meet up at the shrine approach!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: わかったーッ！
english: Got it!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: はいっ！
english: Yes!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓もそれでええな！
english: You good with that too, Sou!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ、そんでええッ！
ほなまた後でな！
english: Yeah, that works! See you later then!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああッ！
english: Yeah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（窓はともかく、
　澪やトキちゃんは大丈夫なんか！？）
english: (Sou is one thing, but are Mio and Toki-chan going to be okay!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ここで転んだらシャレにならないぞ）
english: (It won't be a laughing matter if I trip here.)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: きゃああああッ！！
english: Kyaaaaah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今の……小弓場さん！？
　舞台にいたから逃げ遅れたのか！？）
english: (Was that... Koyuba-san just now!? Did she get left behind because she was on stage!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（その気になれば一番に逃げ出せたはず。
　それなのに、みんなのために……！）
english: (If she wanted to, she could have been the first to escape. And yet, for everyone's sake...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん、今行くからッ！
english: Koyuba-san, I'm coming right now!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: か、影ッ！？
english: S-Shadow!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（腕が四本……。
　なんなんだ、この影……！）
english: (Four arms... What the hell is this Shadow...!)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
活気があっていい夜ですね。
これこそ最後の日に相応しい。
english: What a nice, lively night. This is truly fitting for the final day.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あっ！？
english: Ah!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（な、なんだ、これ……。
　境内に……人がゴロゴロ転がって……）
english: (Wh-What is this... People are lying all over the shrine grounds...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こいつが、やったのか……？）
english: (Did this guy... do this...?)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ですが、誰かさんの邪魔がなければ、
もっと楽にできたはずなんですよ。
ねえ、そこのお嬢さん。
english: However, if it weren't for someone's interference, I could have done this much more easily. Isn't that right, miss?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
english: A-Aah...!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
自分だけさっさと逃げれば良かったのに、
わざわざファンを先に逃がすなんてねえ？
おかげで手間が増えましたよ。
english: You should have just run away by yourself, but going out of your way to let your fans escape first? Thanks to you, I had to put in extra effort.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、網代くんッ！
助けてッ！
english: A-Ajiro-kun! Help me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん！？
english: Koyuba-san!?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: これ以上の邪魔はさせませんよ。
english: I won't let you interfere any further.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さんを離せッ！
english: Let go of Koyuba-san!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なんの音や！？）
english: (What's that sound!?)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
おや、よく見えませんか？
これは失礼、じっくり見てください。
english: Oh, can you not see well? My apologies, please take a good look.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ah…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（境内の地面に、黒い影が広がって……。
　それに触れると……）
english: (A black shadow is spreading across the shrine grounds... And when people touch it...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（人が、消える……？
　影に飲まれたみたいに……）
english: (People are... disappearing...? Like they're being swallowed by the shadow...)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: そうそう、離せと言いましたね。
english: Ah yes, you told me to let go, didn't you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……あかん。
　地面の影がもう足元までそこまで来てる。
　今、小弓場さんが影に触ったら……）
english: (...This is bad. The shadow on the ground has already reached her feet. If Koyuba-san touches the shadow now...)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
いいでしょう。
はい、さようなら。
english: Very well. Yes, goodbye.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さんッ！！
english: Koyuba-san!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: えっ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: A-Aah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （な、なんなんだ、これ……）
english: (Wh-What the hell is this...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（何が起こってる……？
　無理だ、理解できない……）
english: (What's happening...? It's impossible, I can't comprehend this...)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 澪のこと……守っちゃってね……。
english: I'll protect Mio…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうや、澪……。
　澪を……守るんや……！）
english: (That's right, Mio... I have to... protect Mio...!)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: ……おや？

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: キミの右目……もしや？
english: Your right eye… could it be?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ごめん、小弓場さん！！）
english: (I'm sorry, Koyuba-san!!)

japanese: 2.澪との合流
english: 2. Meeting Up with Mio

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァッ……、ハァッ……！
english: *Pant... pant...!*

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァッ……！
english: *Pant...!*

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この辺りにいるはず。
　澪、澪はどこに……！？）
english: (She should be around here. Mio, where are you...!?)

speaker: 女の子の声（小舟澪（ミオ））
speaker_ja: 女の子の声（小舟澪（ミオ））
japanese: 慎ちゃん……？
english: Shin-chan…?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃんッ！！
english: Shin-chan!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪ッ！
english: Mio!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
無事で良かった！
一人で待ってたんか？
english: Thank goodness you're safe! Were you waiting here alone?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
うん、参道で落ち合う言うてたから……
ずっとここで待っとった……。
english: Yeah, you said we'd meet up at the shrine approach... so I've been waiting here the whole time...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、ほんまに無事で良かった。
境内の方は……。
english: But I'm really glad you're safe. How are things at the shrine grounds...?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
せや、さっきのアレ！
アレって一体なんなんッ！？
english: Oh right, that thing from earlier! What the heck was that!?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
あんなに大勢の……
大勢の島の人らが……。
english: So many... So many of the islanders...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪もあの光景を見たんだな……）
english: (So Mio saw that sight too...)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん……。
なんなん、これ……。
english: Shin-chan... What's going on...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: わからん……。
english: I don't know…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
けど、大丈夫や。
こっから先はオレがついてる。
english: But it's going to be okay. I'm with you from here on out.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: うん……！
english: Yeah...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ところで、澪……。
english: By the way, Mio…

japanese: 窓のことを聞く
english: Ask about Sou

japanese: 朱鷺子のことを聞く
english: Ask about Tokiko

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓は見てへんのか？
english: You haven't seen Sou?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
窓くんとはすぐ合流できて、
ここまで一緒に逃げたんよ。
english: I met up with Sou-kun right away, and we escaped here together.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
でも、はぐれたトキコんことが、
気になってたみたいで。
english: But it seemed like he was worried about Tokiko, since we got separated from her.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
せやから、私のことはええから
トキコを探してきてって、
そう言うたんよ。
english: So I told him not to worry about me and to go look for Tokiko.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: トキちゃんは一緒やなかったんか？
english: Toki-chan wasn't with you?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
トキコは……
しばらく私の近くで声がしとったんやけど。
english: Tokiko was... I could hear her voice near me for a while, but...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
人に流されていくうち、
どこ行ったかわからんようになってしもて。
english: While we were being swept away by the crowd, I lost track of where she went.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
せやから一緒におった窓くんに、
トキコ探しに出てもろたんよ。
english: So I had Sou-kun, who was with me, go out to look for Tokiko.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……そうか。
english: …I see.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
トキコと合流できたら連絡が来るはずやけど。
それまで、ここで待っとく？
english: He should contact us once he meets up with Tokiko. Should we wait here until then?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんや、この感覚……！？
english: What is this sensation...!?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
し、慎ちゃん！
境内の方から影が迫ってきよる！
english: Sh-Shin-chan! The shadow is closing in from the shrine grounds!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こ、ここまで広がってきてるのか！）
english: (It's spread this far already!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
とにかく神社から離れるぞ！
澪、走れるか？
english: Anyway, we need to get away from the shrine! Mio, can you run?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: だ、大丈夫！
english: Y-Yeah!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
よし！
行くぞ……！
english: Alright! Let's go...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハァ、ハァ……。
澪、平気か？
english: *Pant, pant*... Mio, are you alright?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
うん、まだ平気や。
水泳で鍛えちゃあるし。
english: Yeah, I'm still fine. I've built up my stamina from swimming.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃんこそ、大丈夫なん？
english: Are you okay yourself, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だ、大丈夫や。
english: Y-Yeah, I'm fine.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: なあ……なんか変やない？
english: Hey... isn't something weird?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ああ、静かすぎるな。
english: ...Yeah, it's too quiet.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（見た目はいつも通り、人気のないの通りだ。
　けど夏祭りの日に『いつも通り』なんは不自然や）
english: (It looks like the usual deserted street. But it's unnatural for it to be "as usual" on the day of the summer festival.)

speaker: 地元民（男）
japanese: 助けてくれェッ！
english: Somebody help meee!

speaker: 地元民（男）
japanese: 影がぁ！　影が追っかけてきよるぅ！
english: A Shadow! A Shadow is chasing me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こ、ここまで影が……！？）
english: (Th-The Shadow has reached here...!?)

speaker: 地元民（男）
japanese: た、助けッ――
english: H-Help--

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 消えてしもた……。
english: He disappeared...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪、走るぞ！
ここも危険や！
english: Mio, run! It's dangerous here too!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: わ、わかった！
english: O-Okay!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （くそっ……どこか安全な場所は……！？）
english: (Damn it... where is a safe place...!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァ、ハァ……。
english: *Pant, pant*...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: し、慎ちゃん、どこまで行くん？
english: Sh-Shin-chan, how far are we going?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……どこまで行けばいいんだ？）
english: (...How far do we need to go?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そもそもあの影から逃げるなんて、
　できるのか？）
english: (Is it even possible to escape from that Shadow in the first place?)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
ねえ、ねえ、いったん落ち着かん？
このあたりには影もおらんみたいやし。
english: Hey, hey, let's calm down for a second, okay? It doesn't seem like there are any Shadows around here.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
あ、もしかしたら神社とここの間にある
川が越えられやんのかも！
english: Ah, maybe they can't cross the river between the shrine and here!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 可能性はあるか……。
english: It's a possibility...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あとは影が伸びる距離か、
　飲み込む人の数に限界があるのかもしれない）
english: (Otherwise, maybe there's a limit to how far the shadow can extend, or the number of people it can swallow.)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
窓くんから連絡あらへんな。
トキコ、見つからんのやろか？
english: We haven't heard from Sou-kun. I wonder if he couldn't find Tokiko?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
出来ればすぐにでも合流したい。
こっちから連絡してみよう。
english: I'd like to meet up with them as soon as possible. Let's try contacting them from our end.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレは窓にかけるから、
澪はトキちゃんにかけてみてくれ。
english: I'll call Sou, so Mio, you try calling Toki-chan.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: わかった。
english: Got it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……出やんな。
english: ...He's not answering.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: こっちもや……。
english: Same here...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（出たくても出られない状況なのか……
　それとも、まさか……）
english: (Are they in a situation where they can't answer even if they want to... Or, could it be...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （い、いや、何を想像してるんだオレは！）
english: (N-No, what am I imagining!)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃん？
english: Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
二人とも移動中なんかもしれやん。
後でかけ直してみよか。
english: They might both be on the move. Let's try calling again later.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
ねえ、これからどうするん？
あの影にまた追いつかれたら……。
english: Hey, what are we going to do now? If that Shadow catches up to us again...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうやな……。
一番に思いつく解決策は、島から出ることか。
english: Let's see... The first solution that comes to mind is getting off the island.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: じゃあ、<color=#GF_TIPS_051>港</color>に行ってフェリー？
english: Then, we go to the <color=#GF_TIPS_051>port</color> and take the ferry?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あの影から逃げ出した住民らが、
　港に殺到してる可能性もある）
english: (There's a possibility that the residents who escaped from that Shadow are rushing to the port.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（夏祭りに来た観光客、あと……
　小弓場さんのライブに来てたファンもいる。
　いつも以上に人が多くなってるよな）
english: (There are the tourists who came for the summer festival, and... the fans who came to Koyuba-san's live too. There are way more people than usual.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今、島にいる全員が逃げることを考えるだろうし、
とてもじゃないけどフェリーには乗り切れない。
english: Everyone on the island is probably thinking about escaping right now, so there's absolutely no way everyone can fit on the ferry.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: せやね……。
english: You're right...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 島を出るべきか、身を潜めるべきか――
english: Should we leave the island, or should we hide...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: どっちがええんやろ？
english: I wonder which is better?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
よし、ひとまずコフネに戻ろか。
アランのことも心配や。
english: Alright, let's head back to Kofune for now. I'm worried about Alain too.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
せや！　お父さん！
逃げるにしても、お父さんも一緒やないと！
english: Right! Dad! Even if we run away, we have to bring Dad with us!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
帰ったらアランに事情を説明して、
この先のこと考えよか。
english: When we get back, we'll explain the situation to Alain, and think about what to do from there.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん、急ごう！
お父さんが心配。
english: Shin-chan, let's hurry! I'm worried about Dad.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今、電話で連絡してみるか？
english: Should we try calling him right now?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
あ、せやな。
かけてみるわ。
english: Ah, good idea. I'll try calling him.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 出やんのか？
english: Is he not answering?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: う、うん……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
もしかしたら店の片付けとか、
明日の仕込みとかしてて、
電話に気がつかへんのかも。
english: Maybe he's cleaning up the shop or prepping for tomorrow, and didn't notice the phone.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、そっか。
english: Ah, I see.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
お祭り、今年はかおりちゃんのライブもあるのに、
仕込みがあるから言うて店に戻って……。
english: Even though there's Kaori-chan's live at the festival this year, he said he had prep work to do and went back to the shop...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
明日もいつも通りに店開けるためやて、
言うとったのに……。
english: Even though he said it was to open the shop as usual tomorrow...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ……これからどうなるん？
english: ...What's going to happen from now on?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレだって、ついさっきまで、このまま明日を
　迎えられるんじゃないかと思ってた）
english: (Even I thought we could just welcome tomorrow like normal until just a little while ago.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（甘かった。
　人がたくさんいれば
　影が襲ってこないだろうと油断して……）
english: (I was naive. I let my guard down, thinking the Shadows wouldn't attack if there were a lot of people around...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （小弓場さんも……影に飲まれて……）
english: (And Koyuba-san too... was swallowed by the Shadow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレが死ねば、
　またループしてやり直せるかも！）
english: (If I die, maybe I can loop and start over!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、ちょっと待て。
　ループが発生したとしても、
　望んだ時間に飛ぶわけじゃない）
english: (No, wait a minute. Even if a loop occurs, it doesn't mean I'll jump to the time I want.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（一度目はここへ来るフェリーの中、
　二度目は澪が迎えに来る港だった。
　次は祭りが始まってからって可能性だってある）
english: (The first time was on the ferry coming here, and the second time was at the port when Mio came to pick me up. There's a possibility that the next time will be after the festival has started.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それ以前に、確実にループできるのか？
　オレが気づけていない発生条件があって、
　今はそれを満たしてないかもしれない）
english: (Before that, can I even loop for sure? There might be trigger conditions I haven't noticed, and I might not be fulfilling them right now.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ダメだ……。
　命を懸けるにはまだ<color=#GF_TIPS_117>情報が少なすぎる</color>）
english: (It's no good... I still have <color=#GF_TIPS_117>too little information</color> to risk my life.)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん、大丈夫？
顔が真っ青やで。
english: Shin-chan, are you okay? Your face is pale.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、ああ……大丈夫。
なんでもない。
english: Ah, yeah... I'm fine. It's nothing.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もしオレが死んでもループが発生せんかったら、
　澪を守ってやれやんくなってまう）
english: (If I die and a loop doesn't happen, I won't be able to protect Mio anymore.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレは潮から澪を託されてる。
　軽はずみなことはできやん）
english: (I was entrusted with Mio by Ushio. I can't do anything reckless.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ループの可能性については、
　一旦、脇へ置いておこう）
english: (I'll set the possibility of looping aside for now.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（本当にどうしようもなくなった時……
　ループはそこですがる最後の手段だ）
english: (When there's truly nothing else I can do... The loop is the last resort I'll cling to.)

japanese: 3.暗い道のり
english: 3. A Dark Path

speaker: 男の声（観光客（モブ影））
japanese: すみませーん！
english: Excuse me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: この先……誰かおるな。
english: Up ahead... there's someone there.

speaker: 男の声（観光客（モブ影））
japanese:
誰か、いませんかー？
変なヤツに襲われちゃってケガしてるんですー！
english: Is anyone there!? I was attacked by a weirdo and I'm hurt!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
あの人も神社におったんかも。
ケガしとるなら助けた方が――
english: They might have been at the shrine too. If they're hurt, we should help--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: シッ！！
english: Shh!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、隠れるぞ……！
english: Mio, hide…!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: えっ？　う、うん！
english: Huh? Uh, yeah!

speaker: 男の声（観光客（モブ影））
japanese:
誰かー！
誰かいませんかー！
english: Someone! Is anyone there!?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: なんで隠れるん？
english: Why are we hiding?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もし、あの人が影に襲われてケガしたんなら、
あまりにも恐怖や悲壮感がなさすぎる。
english: If that person was attacked by a Shadow and got hurt, they're lacking way too much fear and desperation.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
english: Ah…

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
確かに、そうかもしれんけど。
ホンマにケガして困ってるんかも……。
english: That might be true, but... They could also really be hurt and in trouble...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪の言うこともわかる。
　けど、下手に首を突っ込んで
　澪を危険にさらしたくない）
english: (I understand what Mio is saying. But I don't want to carelessly stick my neck out and put Mio in danger.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……冷静になれ。
　オレにできることは限られてる。
　そして今優先すべきは澪なんや）
english: (...Calm down. What I can do is limited. And right now, my priority is Mio.)

speaker: 男の声（観光客（モブ影））
japanese: チッ……。
english: Tch…

speaker: 男の声（観光客（モブ影））
japanese:
無駄足だったな。
マジで誰もいないのかよ。
english: What a waste of time. Is there seriously no one here?

speaker: 男の声（観光客（モブ影））
japanese:
誰も逃がしゃしねーぞ。
一人残らずオカアサンに食べて
もらうんだからな。
english: No one's getting away. I'm gonna have Mother eat every last one of you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （『オカアサン』？）
english: ("Mother"?)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃん、今の……。
english: Shin-chan, that just now...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうやら隠れて正解やったみたいやな。
english: Looks like hiding was the right call.

speaker: 男の声（観光客（モブ影））
japanese:
仕方ない。
他のとこを回るか。
english: Can't be helped. I'll check somewhere else.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ……行ってしもた。
english: ...They left.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
島のあちこちにああいうヤツがいるとしたら、
用心に越したことはない。
english: If there are guys like that all over the island, you can never be too careful.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: できるだけ身を隠しながらコフネまで戻るぞ。
english: We'll head back to Kofune while hiding ourselves as much as possible.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それと……アランと合流したら、
すぐに港へ向かってフェリーで島を出よう。
english: Also... once we meet up with Alain, let's head to the port immediately and leave the island by ferry.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: やっぱり、そうするんがええんかな？
english: I guess that really is the best thing to do?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
このまま島におっても、
いつかは見つかってまう。
english: Even if we stay on the island like this, we'll be found eventually.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あいつらの目的も正体もわからない以上、
有効な対策も立てられない。
english: As long as we don't know their purpose or true identity, we can't come up with any effective countermeasures.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だったら今できる最善策は、
日都ヶ島から離れることや。
english: Then the best plan right now is to leave Hitogashima.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
でも、トキコや窓くんは？
このまま合流できやんかったら……？
english: But what about Tokiko and Sou-kun? What if we can't meet up with them...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あの二人なら大丈夫――
english: Those two will be fine--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今はそう信じるしかない。
english: For now, we just have to believe that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
とにかくまずはアランや。
行くぞ、澪。
english: Anyway, first is Alain. Let's go, Mio.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: うん、急ご！
english: Yeah, let's hurry!

japanese: 4.帰宅
english: 4. Returning Home

japanese: 7月24日
english: July 24th

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: はぁ……無事に帰ってこれた……。
english: *Sigh*... We made it back safely...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ここへ戻ってくるまで、
　人の気配はほとんどなかった）
english: (Until we got back here, there was almost no sign of anyone.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （影と思しき声は聞こえてきたけど……）
english: (Though we did hear voices that seemed to be Shadows...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まさか、このあたりの人たちは、
　もうみんな影にされてる）
english: (Could it be that the people around here have already all been turned into Shadows...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……なんてことはないよな？）
english: (...That can't be it, right?)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: お父さん、ただいま！
english: Dad, I'm home!

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
ああ、おかえり。
随分早いけど、
祭りはどうやったんや？
english: Ah, welcome back. You're quite early, how was the festival?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: それどころやないんよ！
english: We don't have time for that!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アラン、無事やったんやな！
よかった……。
english: Alain, you're safe! Thank goodness...

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
無事？　なんの話や？
何かあったんか？
english:
Safe? What are you talking about?
Did something happen?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: お父さん、外の騒ぎなんも知らんの！？
english: Dad, you don't know anything about the commotion outside!?

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
いや、店の片付けやら明日の仕込みやら
やっとったから、
外のことはようわからんわ。
english: No, I was busy cleaning up the shop and prepping for tomorrow, so I don't really know what's going on outside.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: そんな悠長なこと言うてる場合やないんよ！
english: This is no time to be saying such carefree things!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この様子からして、
　少なくともこの近くで大きな騒ぎは起こってない。
　そう考えてもよさそうやな）
english: (Judging from this, at the very least, there hasn't been a major commotion nearby. It's probably safe to assume that.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なんにせよアランが無事で本当に良かった……）
english: (In any case, I'm really glad Alain is safe...)

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
慎平、騒ぎってなんや？
祭りで事故でも起きたんか？
english: Shinpei, what's this commotion? Did an accident happen at the festival or something?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……アラン。
かいつまんで話すから、
落ち着いて聞いてな。
english: ...Alain. I'll give you the short version, so stay calm and listen.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: あ、ああ。
english: Y-Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ――というわけなんや。
english: --And that's the situation.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
つまり、その……なんやろ。
よう理解できやんかったけども。
english: In other words, well... how do I put it. I didn't really understand it, but.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
恐ろしい化物が島中におるから、
島の外に逃げなアカンってことなんか？
english: There are terrifying monsters all over the island, so we have to escape off the island?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: うん、それであっとる！
english: Yeah, that's right!

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
せやけど……
そないな話、にわかには信じられやんで。
english: But still... I can't just suddenly believe a story like that.

japanese: 「冗談なんかじゃないんだ！」
english: "It's not a joke!"

japanese: 「無理矢理でも連れてくで」
english: "I'll take you with us even by force."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
冗談なんかじゃないんだ！
ほんまのこと言うてるんや！
english:
It's not a joke!
I'm telling the truth!

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
いや、慎平がそないな嘘言うわけあらへんし、
たぶんホンマなんやと思てるけど。
english: Well, there's no way Shinpei would tell a lie like that, so I do think it's probably true.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: あんまりにも大きな……いや、悲惨な話やさけよ。
english: It's just too big of a... no, too tragic of a story.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
まさかこの島でそないなことが
起きちゃあるやなんてなァ……。
english: To think something like that is happening on this island...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
無理矢理でも連れてくで。
時間あらへんのや。
english: I'll take you with us even by force. We don't have time.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 後からでも、話はできるからな。
english: We can talk about it later.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃん、本気で言うちゃある？
english: Shin-chan, are you serious?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
本気だよ。
アランかて後でわかってくれるはずや。
english: I'm serious. Even Alain should understand later.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
わかった。
慎平がそこまで言うんやさけ、
ホンマに緊急事態なんやろ。
english: I understand. If Shinpei is going that far, it really must be an emergency.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なら、すぐに準備してくれ！
フェリーの最終便に乗るんや！
english: Then please get ready right away! We're taking the last ferry!

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: まあ、そない慌てやんで。
english: Well, don't panic so much.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
とりあえず、みんな１回落ち着こか。
温かいモンでも飲んでな。
english: Let's all just calm down for a second. Have something warm to drink.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アラン！！
さっきの話聞いてなかったんか！？
今は急がなアカンって何度も――
english: Alain!! Did you not hear what I just said!? I've told you over and over that we need to hurry--

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: 今日の最終便はまだ先やろ？
english: The last ferry today isn't for a while, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: あっ、そっか！
english: Oh, right!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん、今日はお祭りやん。
フェリーもいつもよりぎょうさん出てるで。
english: Shin-chan, today's the festival. There are a lot more ferries running than usual.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Oh!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんで忘れてたんや……。
　今日は祭りがあるから観光客向けの
　<color=#GF_TIPS_116>臨時ダイヤ</color>だった！）
english: (Why did I forget... Because of the festival today, there's a <color=#GF_TIPS_116>temporary schedule</color> for tourists!)

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
いつもやったら急がなアカンけど、
今日の最終便までやったら、
もうしばらく時間あるでよ。
english: Normally we'd have to hurry, but we still have some time before today's last ferry.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
えらい目に遭うて気が動転してもてたんやな。
まあひとまず落ち着き。
english: You must be upset after going through something so terrible. Well, just calm down for now.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
外には化物がうろうろしよるんやろ？
慌てて行動してたら見つかってまうで。
english: There are monsters wandering around outside, right? If we act in a panic, we'll get found.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それは……そうかもしれやんけど、
もしフェリーに乗り遅れたら……！
english: That... might be true, but if we miss the ferry...!

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
その気持ちはようわかる。
でも「急いては事を仕損じる」や。
とりあえず落ち着こか。
english: I understand how you feel. But "haste makes waste." Let's calm down for now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: まあ……アランがそこまで言うなら。
english: Well... if Alain insists.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
ハハハ！
いつも冷静な慎平がこない焦ってるん、
初めて見たかもしれやんなァ。
english: Hahaha! This might be the first time I've seen the usually calm Shinpei so flustered.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
のんきなもんやな、アランは。
でも、おかげで冷静になれたわ。
english: You're so carefree, Alain. But thanks to that, I was able to calm down.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓らからの連絡を待ちながら、
しばらくここで休もか。
english: Let's rest here for a while as we wait to hear from Sou and the others.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: うん、私もそれでええよ。
english: Yeah, I'm fine with that.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
ほな改めてラストオーダーや。
二人ともなに飲む？
english: Then, let's take your last order again. What do you two want to drink?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？　飲み物って、本気やったん？
english: Huh? You were serious about the drinks?

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
当然やろ。
温かい飲み物は一番心にも効くもんや。
english: Of course. A warm drink is the best thing for the soul.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: じゃあ、私はミルクティー。
english: Then I'll have milk tea.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: ほな、牛乳と砂糖ありったけ入れちゃる。
english: Alright, I'll put in as much milk and sugar as I can.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: 慎平はどうする？
english: What about you, Shinpei?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっと、コーヒーで。
english: Um, I'll have coffee.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
わかった。
とっておきの豆を使っちゃる。
english: Got it. I'll use my special beans.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: そんなんあったん？
english: You had something like that?

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
いつもの豆や。
いつでもとっておきを出しとるんよ。
english: It's the usual beans. I always serve my special ones.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 物は言いようやな。
english: It's all in how you say it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ようやく……ほんの少しだけ、
　余裕を取り戻せたような気がする。
　アランのおかげだ）
english: (Finally... I feel like I've regained just a little bit of composure. It's thanks to Alain.)

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: どうや、落ち着けたか？
english: How is it, have you calmed down?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん、ありがとうアラン。
english: Yeah, thanks, Alain.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
連絡きやんね。
……トキコからも窓くんからも。
english: No messages. ...From Tokiko or from Sou-kun.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: あの二人とはぐれてもたんか？
english: Did you get separated from those two?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
うん……。
逃げる時、人が多てめちゃくちゃに
なってしもたから。
english: Yeah... When we were running away, there were so many people and it got super chaotic.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん、トキコらもここに来るよう
メールで連絡しとくわ。
english: Shin-chan, I'll email Tokiko and the others telling them to come here too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや、フェリーで脱出するつもりだから、
港に向かうように伝えた方がいい。
english: No, since we're planning to escape by ferry, it's better to tell them to head to the port.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ここよりも港に近いところにいたら、
無駄な移動になってまうし。
english: If they're closer to the port than here, coming here would just be unnecessary travel.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: あ、そっか。
english: Ah, right.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
港で合流か、
いっそ本土で合流でもええしな。
english: We can meet up at the port, or even just meet up on the mainland.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: さて、ほな移動を始める前にトイレいっとくわ。
english: Alright, I'll go to the restroom before we start moving.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: お父さん、この状況で悠長やなァ。
english: Dad, you're so laid back in this situation.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はは……。
english: Haha…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレのスマホも……着信ないな。
english: My phone hasn't gotten any calls either...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （どこにおるんや、窓、トキちゃん……）
english: (Where are you guys, Sou, Toki-chan...)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ……ねえ、慎ちゃん。
english: …Hey, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんや？
english: What?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 私ら、一体どうなるんやろ？
english: What on earth is going to happen to us?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
また誰かが、
お姉ちゃんみたいになるんはもう嫌や。
english: I don't want anyone else to end up like Onee-chan again.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
無事でおるんかな。
トキコも……窓くんも……。
english: I wonder if they're safe. Tokiko... and Sou-kun...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: もしかしたらもう……。
english: Maybe they're already…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、考えすぎや。
english: Mio, you're overthinking.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
あ……ごめん。
こんなこと言うたらアカンな。
english: Ah... sorry. I shouldn't be saying things like that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
大丈夫や。
澪のことはオレが守っちゃる。
english: It'll be okay. I'll protect you, Mio.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ……ありがと。
english: ...Thanks.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
あの、慎ちゃん。
ちょっと……変なこと聞いてええ？
english: Um, Shin-chan. Can I... ask you something weird?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 変なこと？
english: Something weird?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ええっと、着替えてきてもええかな？
english: Um, is it okay if I go change clothes?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 着替えって……。
english: Change clothes...?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
この格好、めっちゃ走りにくいんよ。
普通の服のほうがええと思って。
english: This outfit is really hard to run in. I figured regular clothes would be better.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、確かにそうやろな。
english: Ah, yeah, I guess so.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: けど、なんでわざわざオレに聞くんや？
english: But why go out of your way to ask me?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: だって……。
english: Because…

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃん、この浴衣姿気に入っちゃあると思て。
english: I thought you liked this yukata, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …What!?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
ちゃうかった？
祭りの時、いつもよりじーっと見とった気が
したんやけど。
english: Was I wrong? I felt like you were staring at me more than usual during the festival, though.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そ、そうやったか？
特に意識して見てたってことは
ないと思うけど……。
english: W-Was I? I don't think I was consciously staring or anything, but...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
ご、ごめん、変なこと言うてもた！
ささっと着替えてくるわ！
english: S-Sorry, I said something weird! I'll go change real quick!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そんなに見てたかな……）
english: (Was I really staring that much...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんか手持ち無沙汰やな。
　コップ、片付けとくか）
english: (I feel kind of restless. Maybe I should clean up the cups.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ここから逃げるにしても、
　そのままにしとくのもな……）
english: (Even if we're escaping from here, it doesn't feel right to just leave them...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …What!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （キッチンの床に……人の形の黒いシミが……）
english: (On the kitchen floor... a black stain in the shape of a person...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 嘘、だろ……。
english: You've gotta be kidding me...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、嘘なんかじゃない。
　見間違えだと思いたいが、間違いない！）
english: (No, it's not a joke. I want to believe my eyes are playing tricks on me, but there's no mistake!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （これは、影が人をコピーした時に残る跡！）
english: (This is the mark left behind when a Shadow copies a person!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ここで影にコピーされたとすれば……
　一人しか考えられない）
english: (If someone was copied by a Shadow here... There's only one person it could be.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くそっ……！
english: Damn it...!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ひゃっ！？　だ、誰！？
english: Eek!? Wh-Who is it!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレや。
澪、もう着替えたか？
english:
It's me.
Mio, have you changed yet?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: まだやけど……。
english: Not yet, but...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん、何かあったん？
そんな怖い顔して。
english: Shin-chan, did something happen? You have such a scary look on your face.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
シッ……大きな声出すな。
すぐにここを出るで。
english: Shh... don't speak so loudly. We're getting out of here right now.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
えっ、なんで？
急にどないしたん？
english: Huh, why? What's with the sudden change?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっきのアランは影やった。
このままここにおったら危険や。
english: The Alain from earlier was a Shadow. It's dangerous if we stay here.

japanese: 5.潜む場所を探して
english: 5. Searching for a Hiding Place

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ここまでくれば大丈夫か……）
english: (We should be okay if we've made it this far...)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
ねえ慎ちゃん！
さっきの話ってホンマなん！？
english: Hey Shin-chan! Was what you said earlier really true!?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ホンマに……お父さんが影になってしもたん？
english: Did Dad... really turn into a Shadow?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
さっきまで話してたの、
お父さんとしか思えやんかったのに。
english: Even though we were just talking to him, and I couldn't think of him as anyone but Dad.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 影は、人の姿を写し取れるんや。
english: Shadows can copy a person's appearance.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの人型の黒いシミは、
影が人をコピーして消した跡で間違いない。
english: That human-shaped black stain is undoubtedly the mark left behind when a Shadow copies a person and erases them.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そして……あの家で
コピーされる可能性がある人物は、
アランだけなんや。
english: And... the only person in that house who could have been copied is Alain.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ……そんな。
english: ...No way.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （アラン……）
english: (Alain…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……澪、動けるか？
english: …Mio, can you move?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
とにかく港まで行ってみよう。
フェリーがもう来てるかもしれん。
english: Anyway, let's head to the port. The ferry might already be there.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
トキコと窓くんかて、
港まで来てるかもしれやん。
english: Tokiko and Sou-kun might have come to the port too.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ううん、絶対来てるはずや！
english: No, they definitely must be here!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、行こう！
english: Yeah, let's go!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: フェリーは……おらんな。
english: The ferry… isn't here.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
フェリーもやけど、
人かて一人もおらんで……。
english: Not just the ferry, there isn't a single person here either...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: トキコ……窓くん……。
english: Tokiko... Sou-kun...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（さすがに生存者全員が
　この前に出たフェリーに乗れたとは思えない）
english: (I really doubt all the survivors could have fit on the ferry that left before this.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （それなのに……）
english: (And yet...)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
あ、そや！
フェリーが来るまでどっかに
隠れてるかもしれやんで？
english: Oh, right! They might be hiding somewhere until the ferry comes!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ここにおったら目立つしな。
english: We'd stand out if we stayed here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だめだ……。
　どうしても悪い考えが頭をよぎる）
english: (It's no good... Bad thoughts keep crossing my mind no matter what.)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃん？
english: Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪の言う通りだな。
こんな目立つところにいたら、
襲ってくださいって言ってるようなもんだ。
english: You're right, Mio. Staying in such a conspicuous place is basically asking to be attacked.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレたちも、
フェリーの時間まで身を隠そう。
english: We should hide ourselves too, until it's time for the ferry.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
できるだけ神社から離れとって、
人が住んでる家以外で今のオレらが
隠れられそうな場所……。
english: A place as far from the shrine as possible, that isn't a residential house, where we can hide right now...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 灯台は？
english: How about the lighthouse?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 流石に遠すぎるやろ。
english: That's way too far.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ううーん、じゃあ学校？
english: Hmmm, then the school?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうか、学校か！
english: I see, the school!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（学校には今誰もおらんはずや。
　隠れられそうな場所も多い！）
english: (There shouldn't be anyone at the school right now. And there are plenty of places to hide!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
よし、決まりやな。
行こう。
english: Alright, it's decided then. Let's go.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
なァ、慎ちゃん。
トキコに電話かけてみてくれやん？
english: Hey, Shin-chan. Can you try calling Tokiko?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
自分でかけたいんやけど、
気ィついたらもう充電切れとって。
english: I want to call her myself, but before I knew it, my battery had died.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、わかった。
english: Ah, got it.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: やっぱり、繋がらん？
english: Is it still not connecting?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……。
何度かけても繋がらない。
english: Yeah... No matter how many times I call, it won't connect.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トキちゃんだけじゃなく、
窓にもかけてみてるんやけど……。
english: I'm trying to call Sou too, not just Toki-chan, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アカン。
やっぱり出やん。
english: No good. He's not answering either.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 二人の携帯も充電切れてしもてるんかも。
english: Maybe both of their phones ran out of battery too.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
あ、もしかして家に戻ったりしてやんかな？
そうすれば充電もできるし。
english: Oh, do you think maybe they went back home? They could charge their phones that way.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうか、そういう可能性もあるな。
english: I see, that is a possibility.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレらも一度は家に戻った。
　窓たちも同じことを考えるかもしれない）
english: (We went back home once too. Sou and the others might have thought to do the same.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（予定通り学校へ向かうか？
　それとも窓の家に……）
english: (Should we head to the school as planned? Or to Sou's house...)

japanese: 菱形医院に向かう
english: Head to Hishigata Clinic

japanese: 学校に向かう
english: Head to the school

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうだな。
菱形医院へ行ってみよう。
english: Good point. Let's go check Hishigata Clinic.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……反応がないな。
english: …No response.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: でも電気はついてるで。
english: But the lights are on.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なあ、澪。
菱形先生は祭りに行ったんかな？
english: Hey, Mio. Did Hishigata-sensei go to the festival?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
多分、行かんかったと思う。
島でお医者様は先生だけやから
忙しいみたいやし。
english: I don't think he did. Since he's the only doctor on the island, it seems he's quite busy.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうだよな……。
english: Yeah, makes sense...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それなのに呼び鈴を押しても
　反応がないってことは……）
english: (And yet, there's no response even when we ring the doorbell...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（アランと同じように、
　影にされてしまったのかも）
english: (He might have been turned into a Shadow, just like Alain.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そんなところへ窓たちが
　戻ってきてしまったって可能性も
　否定できない……）
english: (And I can't deny the possibility that Sou and the others might have returned to a place like this...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、もし菱形先生の影がいるのなら、
　ここへ出てこないか？
　そうして言葉巧みにオレらを……）
english: (No, if Hishigata-sensei's Shadow is here, wouldn't it come out? And then skillfully trick us with words...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……あかん。
　考えれば考えるほど、悪い方へ向かってまう）
english: (...This is bad. The more I think about it, the more my thoughts head in a bad direction.)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃん、どうしよう？
english: Shin-chan, what should we do?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 心残りやけど、ここは諦めて学校に向かおう。
english: It's a shame, but let's give up on this place and head to the school.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: うん、わかった。
english: Yeah, I understand.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや、やめとこ。
予定通り学校へ向かおう。
english:
No, let's not.
Let's go to the school as planned.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの二人が家に戻ってる確証がない以上、
危険を犯すことになってしまう。
それだけは避けたいんや。
english: Since we have no proof that those two returned home, it would mean taking a risk. I want to avoid that at least.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see…

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
わかった。
ほな学校まで急ご？
english: I understand. Then let's hurry to the school.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ごめんな、澪。
english: Sorry, Mio.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
ううん、ええんよ。
慎ちゃんかて窓くんが心配なん
我慢しちゃあるんやもん。
english: No, it's fine. I know you're holding back even though you're worried about Sou-kun too, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おっと、学校に向かうこと、
窓にメールしておこう。
english: Oh right, I should email Sou and tell him we're heading to the school.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
「オレと澪はこれから学校に向かう。
　合流が無理なら、
　最終のフェリーで島を出よう」
english: "Mio and I are heading to the school now. If we can't meet up, let's leave the island on the final ferry."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（窓……。
　返事してくれたらええけど……）
english: (Sou... I hope he replies, but...)

japanese: 6.身を寄せあって
english: 6. Drawing Close

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: ……静かやな。
english: ...It's quiet.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: まだトキコから連絡あらへん？
english: Still no message from Tokiko?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: ああ、なんも連絡はきてないな。
english: Yeah, no messages have come in at all.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そうなんか。
english: Is that so.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
フェリーの時間まで、あと少しの辛抱や。
それまでゆっくり休んどいたらええ。
english: Just a little more patience until the ferry's time. You should just rest and take it easy until then.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ねえ、慎ちゃん。
東京やとどんなことして遊んでるん？
english:
Hey, Shin-chan.
What do you do for fun in Tokyo?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: は？
english: Huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
やっぱり田舎とはちごてるん？
学校帰りに、オシャレなカフェに行ったりとか。
english: I guess it's different from the countryside? Like going to stylish cafes on the way home from school.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: おまえな……そんなん今聞いてどないすんねん。
english: You know... what's the point of asking that now?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 別に、ちょっと気になっただけ。
english: Nothing, I was just a little curious.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
フェリーまでまだ時間あるし、
余計なことしやんと静かにしてた方がいい。
english: There's still time until the ferry, so it's better to stay quiet and not do anything unnecessary.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
もし影が近くにおったら、
オレらの居場所を教えてまうことになるからな。
english: If a Shadow is nearby, we'd end up giving away our location.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん……わかってる。
english: Yeah... I know.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも……静かにしてるばっかりやと、
つい、変なこと考えてまう。
english: But... if I just stay quiet, I end up thinking about weird things.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
頭の中が……考えたくもないことで
押しつぶされそうな感覚になるんよ……。
english: It feels like my mind is going to be crushed... by things I don't even want to think about...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
ごめん、ちょっと言い過ぎた。
澪の気持ちも考えやんと……
不安になって当然やのにな。
english: Sorry, I said a bit too much. I didn't consider your feelings, Mio... It's only natural you'd be anxious.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
ほな、気が済むまで話そか。
あんまり大声で騒がんかったら大丈夫やろ。
english: Alright, let's talk until you feel better. As long as we don't make too much noise, it should be fine.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん。
じゃあ、何の話しよか？
english:
Yeah.
So, what should we talk about?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
そうやなァ……。
まずはさっきの話やけど。
english: Let's see... First, about what you asked earlier.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: 澪、ホンマに東京に興味あるんやな。
english: Mio, you really are interested in Tokyo, aren't you.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
悪いけど、澪が期待するような話は、
あんまりできやんかも。
オシャレなカフェとか、オレには縁ないし。
english: Sorry, but I might not be able to tell you the kind of stories you're expecting. I have nothing to do with things like stylish cafes.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私が聞きたかったんは、
そういうことやなくて……。
english: What I wanted to ask about wasn't that sort of thing...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: じゃあ、どういうことなん？
english: Then, what is it?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: その……。
english: Um…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ずっと、慎ちゃんに聞きたかったことが
あんねやけど。
english: There's something I've wanted to ask you for a long time, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: ああ、言うてみ？
english: Yeah, let's hear it.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃんって……東京で彼女、できたん？
english: Shin-chan… Did you get a girlfriend in Tokyo?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: いっ……いきなりなに言い出すねん！？
english: Wh... what are you saying all of a sudden!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そない驚かんでもええやん……。
english: You don't have to be so surprised...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
あ、ああ、ごめん……。
いきなりとんでもないこと聞いてくるから。
english: Ah, yeah, sorry... You just asked something crazy out of nowhere.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
で、どうなん？
東京にきれいな彼女とかおるん？
english: So, how about it? Do you have a pretty girlfriend in Tokyo?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
そんなんおるように見えるか？
オレに彼女とかできるわけないやろ。
english: Do I look like I have one? There's no way I could get a girlfriend.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そんなことあらへん。
慎ちゃんがその気になったら絶対モテるで？
english: That's not true. If you put your mind to it, Shin-chan, you'd definitely be popular.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: 買いかぶりすぎやろ……。
english: You're overestimating me...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも、それやったら慎ちゃん、
学校出たらこっち戻ってこれるんやね。
english: But if that's the case, Shin-chan, you can come back here after you graduate.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
おいてきぼりにして泣かせてしまう相手、
東京にはおらんのやもんな？
english: Since there's no one in Tokyo you'd leave behind and make cry, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
あんなァ……。
さっきからなんの話してんねん。
english: Hey... What are you talking about?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんがこっち帰ってきて、
コフネ継いでくれたらええのにって話。
english: I'm saying it would be great if you came back here and took over Kofune, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
english: Eh...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そしたら私も、ずっと手伝うし。
english: If you did, I'd help out all the time too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もちろん、慎ちゃんが
東京でいいお店に就職できたら、
そっち優先でええけど。
english: Of course, if you can get a job at a good restaurant in Tokyo, Shin-chan, you can prioritize that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: けど……いつかは戻ってきてくれると嬉しい。
english: But... I'd be happy if you came back someday.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
し、慎ちゃん、体育館に入るなんて久しぶりやろ？
どう？
english: Sh-Shin-chan, it's been a while since you've been in the gym, right? How is it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
どうって言われてもな。
変わってない、くらいしか思わんけど。
english: Even if you ask me how it is... I just think it hasn't changed much.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
ああ……。
学校で思い出した。
english: Ah... Being at school reminded me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
澪、覚えてるか？
小弓場さんていうオレと潮の
クラスメイトだった女の子。
english: Mio, do you remember? A girl named Koyuba-san who was in the same class as me and Ushio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
たしかオレが小５の時、
東京に転校した子ォなんやけど。
english: I think she transferred to Tokyo when I was in 5th grade.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ん……。
なんとなく覚えてる。
えーと……おとなしい子やっけ。
english: Hmm... I kind of remember. Um... she was a quiet girl, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
そう、その子や。
フルネームは小弓場かおりなんやけど――
english: Yeah, that's her. Her full name is Koyuba Kaori, but--

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
小弓場かおり！？
もしかして、かおりちゃん！？
english: Koyuba Kaori!? You don't mean... Kaori-chan!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: シィー、声が大きいて。
english: Shhh, your voice is too loud.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ごめん！
で、でも、ホンマに？
あのアイドルのかおりちゃんなん？
english: Sorry! B-But, really? That idol, Kaori-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
そうらしい。
驚きの事実やろ？
english: Seems like it. Surprising, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん、ホンマにびっくりや。
english: Yeah, I'm really surprised.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
東京ってすっごいとこやねんな。
島におった時は、あんな大人しそうやったのに。
english: Tokyo is an amazing place, huh. She seemed so quiet when she was on the island.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
いや、別に東京に越したってだけで、
アイドルになれたワケじゃないやろ。
english: Well, it's not like just moving to Tokyo made her an idol.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: 彼女なりに努力した結果や。
english: It's the result of her own hard work.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
な、なんなん？
慎ちゃん、やけにかおりちゃんの肩持つけど、
もしかして……
english: Wh-What's the deal? You're really taking Kaori-chan's side, Shin-chan, could it be...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: なに？
english: What?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ああッ！
やっぱりそうなん！？
english: Ah! I knew it!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
アイドルになった自分の彼女と一緒に
東京から帰ってきたん！？
english: You came back from Tokyo together with your idol girlfriend!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
な、なに言いだすねん！
オレかて再会したのは一昨日や！
english: Wh-What are you saying! I only just reunited with her the day before yesterday!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
あ……やってもた。
今の声、かなり大きかったか。
english: Ah... oops. My voice was pretty loud just now, wasn't it.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ふふっ、せやね。
english: Hehe, yeah.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……かおりちゃん、
上手く逃げられたかな？
english: ...I wonder if Kaori-chan managed to escape okay?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ホンマかわいそうや。
せっかく地元まで来てくれたのに、
大変なことになってしもて……。
english: I really feel sorry for her. She came all the way back to her hometown, and this terrible thing had to happen...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
大丈夫。
きっと大丈夫や。
english: She's fine. I'm sure she's fine.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それにしても、アイドルかァ。
この島の同世代から有名人が出るやて、
何か不思議な気分や。
english: Still, an idol, huh. It's a weird feeling to have a celebrity come from our generation on this island.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もしお姉ちゃんも東京出とったら、
有名人になれてたかもしれやんな。
english: If Onee-chan had gone to Tokyo too, she might have been able to become a celebrity.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: え……潮が、か？
english: Eh... Ushio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんもそう思うやろ？
だってお姉ちゃん、あんなキレイなんやで？
english: You think so too, right, Shin-chan? I mean, Onee-chan was so pretty, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
どうやろな……。
でも、たとえ潮がアイドルになっても。
english: I wonder about that... But even if Ushio became an idol.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
気に入らんお偉いさんに歯向かって、
すぐ辞めさせられるんちゃうか？
english: She'd probably talk back to some big shot she didn't like and get fired right away, wouldn't she?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あはは、たしかに。
目に浮かぶわ。
english: Ahaha, that's true. I can picture it now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: やろ？
english: Right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
はぁ……こうやって話すんの、
なんか久しぶりやな。
めっちゃ懐かしい感じ。
english: *Sigh*... It feels like it's been a while since we talked like this. It's super nostalgic.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
こんな風にもっと……
どうでもええこと三人で話したかった。
english: I wanted to talk more like this... about pointless things, just the three of us.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃん、
なんでここにおらんのやろ……。
english: Onee-chan... Why isn't she here...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんで……なんで私らだけなんかな。
english: Why… why is it just us?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: ああ……なんでかな。
english: Yeah... I wonder why.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あー、アカンアカン！
すぐ弱気になってまうわ！
english: Ah, no, no! I'm getting weak-hearted right away!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんやったら、絶対弱気になんかなってへん。
もっと前向きに突き進んでるはずや！
english: If it were Onee-chan, she'd never be weak-hearted. She'd definitely be pushing forward more positively!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
しばらくは、
「お姉ちゃんやったらどうするか」って
考えて行動してみよかな。
english: For a while, maybe I'll try to act by thinking, "What would Onee-chan do?"

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
潮やったら、か。
たしかに、どんどん前に進んでいけそうやな。
english: If it were Ushio, huh. Yeah, it feels like we could keep moving forward.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
どんな化物に向かっても、
跳び蹴りかましそうやし。
english: No matter what kind of monster she faced, she'd probably hit it with a flying kick.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: と、跳び蹴りは無理かも。
english: A-A flying kick might be impossible.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: そこまで真似せんでええやろ。
english: You don't have to copy her that far.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
とにかくあと少しの辛抱や。
絶対に生きて島を出るで。
english: Anyway, just a little more patience. We're definitely going to leave this island alive.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うんッ！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
english: --What!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
どないしたん、これ！？
いきなり真っ暗になってもたけど……。
english: What happened!? It suddenly went pitch black...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: ……て、停電か？
english: ...A p-power outage?

japanese: 7.停電
english: 7. Power Outage

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: アカン……真っ暗で何も見えやん。
english: This is bad... it's pitch black, I can't see anything.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: し、慎ちゃん、近くにおる？
english: Sh-Shin-chan, are you nearby?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
安心しろ。
ここにおる。
english: Don't worry. I'm right here.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: なんで急に明かり消えたん？
english: Why did the lights go out all of a sudden?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: わからん……。
english: I don't know…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（誰かが照明をオフにしたのか、
　それとも……停電か？）
english: (Did someone turn off the lights, or is it... a power outage?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （とりあえず今は、澪と離れないようにしないと）
english: (For now, I need to make sure I don't get separated from Mio.)

japanese: 澪と手を繋ぐ
english: Hold Mio's hand

japanese: 澪に声をかけて安心させる
english: Speak to Mio to calm her down

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪、手ェ繋いどこか。
こんな状況で離れ離れになったら
大変やからな。
english: Mio, let's hold hands. It'll be a disaster if we get separated in this situation.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
あっ、そうやね！
ほな……はい。
english: Ah, you're right! Then... here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 何があっても離すなよ。
english: Don't let go, no matter what happens.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
うん。
絶対離さんよ。
english: Yeah. I definitely won't let go.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、大丈夫か？
english: Mio, are you okay?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
大丈夫……やけど。
真っ暗なんは嫌やな……。
english: I'm okay... but. I really don't like it being pitch black...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
とりあえず、目が慣れるまでは
じっとしとこか。
english: For now, let's stay still until our eyes adjust.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そのうち多少は見えるようになるやろ。
english: We should be able to see a little bit eventually.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
ふふ……慎ちゃん、冷静やな。
ホンマ頼りになるわ。
english: Hehe... you're so calm, Shin-chan. You're really reliable.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ようやく目が慣れてきた……）
english: (My eyes are finally getting used to the dark…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （しかしさっきの停電の原因はなんなんだ？）
english: (But what was the cause of that power outage just now?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （非常灯まで落ちるなんてよっぽどなことだぞ）
english: (For even the emergency lights to go out, it must be something major.)

speaker: 女性の声（人渕先生）
japanese:
ちょっとー？
誰かおるの？
english: Heeeey? Is someone there?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: この声……ぶっちー？
english: That voice… Butchi?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、たぶん……。
でも大きな声は出すなよ。
影って可能性もあるからな。
english: Yeah, probably... But don't raise your voice. There's a possibility it's a Shadow.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（人渕先生――通称<color=#GF_TIPS_032>ぶっちー</color>。
　オレたち……いや、島の子供たち、
　みんなの先生だ）
english: (Hitobuchi-sensei--commonly known as <color=#GF_TIPS_032>Butchi</color>. She's our... no, all the island kids' teacher.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （声を聴くのは何年ぶりだろう）
english: (How many years has it been since I last heard her voice?)

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese:
夜は立入禁止よ！
誰かいるなら出てきなさい？
english: It's off-limits at night! If someone's there, come out right now!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: どうする、慎ちゃん？
english: What do we do, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ここは神社や港から離れてる。
　ぶっちーがまだ影にされていない可能性も
　十分あるけど……）
english: (This place is far from the shrine and the port. There's a good chance Butchi hasn't been turned into a Shadow yet, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （用心するに越したことはないな）
english: (You can never be too careful.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あのぶっちーが影じゃないって確証がない以上、
接触するのは避けたい。
english: Since we have no proof that that Butchi isn't a Shadow, I want to avoid making contact.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どこかに隠れてやり過ごそか。
english: Let's hide somewhere and let her pass.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（教室の後ろのロッカー。
　あの中なら……）
english: (The lockers at the back of the classroom. If we go in there...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、教室のロッカーの中に隠れるで。
english: Mio, we're hiding in the lockers in the classroom.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
えっ！？
ロッカーって……。
english: Eh!? In the lockers...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 早よ！
english: Hurry!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
ちょ、ちょっと慎ちゃん？
この中……めっちゃせまない？
english: W-Wait, Shin-chan? Isn't it... super cramped in here?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あまり動くなって。
少しの間だけ我慢してくれ。
english: I said don't move too much. Just bear with it for a little while.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
あっ、扉開いてしもた。
早よ閉めな……。
english: Ah, the door opened. I have to close it quickly...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや、閉めんでええ。
音で気づかれてまう。
english: No, leave it open. She'll notice the sound.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そのまま息を潜めとけ。
english: Just hold your breath and stay still.

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese:
誰かいるのはわかってるのよ。
早く出てらっしゃい。
english: I know someone is there. Come out quickly.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （かなり近づいてきたな……）
english: (She's gotten pretty close...)

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese: ここかしら。
english: Is it here?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こっちに気づかず通り過ぎてくれたら
　いいんだけど……）
english: (It would be great if she just passed by without noticing us, but...)

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese: あら？
english: Oh?

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese:
おかしいわぁ。
なんでロッカーがちょっと開いてるん？
english: How strange. Why is the locker slightly open?

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese: 見ィつけた……。
english: Found you...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うっ……！
english: Ugh…!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ヒッ！？
english: Eek!?

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese: あらァ、慎平くんやない。
english: Oh my, if it isn't Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese: 澪ちゃんも一緒なの？
english: Is Mio-chan with you too?

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese:
先生、出てきなさい言うたでしょう？
アカンやないの。
こんな所に隠れてェ。
english: I told you to come out, didn't I? That's no good. Hiding in a place like this.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くっ……！
english: Guh...!

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese: あがっ！？
english: Agah!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今やッ！　外に出ろ！
english: Now! Get out!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃん！
english: Shin-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いいから早く逃げろ！
english: Never mind that, just run!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: う、うん！
english: Y-Yeah!

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese: あいたたた……。
english: Ouch, ouch, ow...

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese:
久しぶりやいうのに、悪いことばかりして。
慎平くん、いつからそない乱暴な子になったん？
english: It's been so long, yet you're only doing bad things. Since when did you become such a violent kid, Shinpei-kun?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（このぶっちーがニセモノかどうか確証が持てない以上、
　本人への攻撃は避けたいけど……）
english: (Since I can't be certain whether this Butchi is a fake or not, I want to avoid attacking the real person, but...)

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese: ほら、怒らんからこっち来ィ。
english: Come on, I won't get mad, so come here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ともかく、足止めせな！）
english: (Anyway, I have to stall her!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うわァァァァッ！
english: Uwaaaaah!

speaker: Hitobuchi-sensei (Bucchi)
japanese: アアアアアアアッ！！
english: Aaaaaaaaah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ！？
english: Huh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ロッカーを床に叩きつけただけやのに、
　なんであんなに苦しんでるんだ？）
english: (I just slammed the locker onto the floor, so why is she suffering so much?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、そんなこと考えてる場合じゃない！
　早よ逃げなッ！）
english: (No, this is no time to be thinking about that! I have to run, quick!)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん！
よかった、無事やったんや。
english: Shin-chan! Thank goodness, you're safe.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: あのぶっちー、影やったん？
english: Was that Butchi a Shadow?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
わからん。
でもあのぶっちーが影やとしたら本物はもう……。
english: I don't know. But if that Butchi was a Shadow, then the real one is already...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そろそろ時間や。
このまま港へ向かうで。
english:
It's about time.
Let's head to the harbor.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
あ、待って。
誰か走ってる音がせん？
english: Ah, wait. Do you hear someone running?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……遠ざかってくな。
オレたちには気づいてないらしい。
english: ...They're moving away. Seems they didn't notice us.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （影だったのか、他に生存者がいたのか……）
english: (Was it a Shadow, or was it another survivor...?)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: もしかして、トキコと窓くん？
english: Maybe it's Tokiko and Sou?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
かもしれやんけど……
それを確かめるんは危険や。
english: It might be... But it's dangerous to go check.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今は港へ向かうことを優先させるで。
メールも送っとるし、
無事なら港で落ち合えるはずや。
english: For now, let's prioritize heading to the harbor. I sent them a message, so if they're safe, we should be able to meet up there.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 誰とも会わへんね。
english: We haven't run into anyone, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうやな……。
もうすぐフェリーが来る時間やのに。
english: Yeah... Even though it's almost time for the ferry to arrive.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ……さっきのぶっちー、怖かったわ。
english: ...Butchi was scary earlier.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
でも、ぶっちーなら、
夜中に学校に忍び込んだ生徒相手に
あれくらい怒っても不思議やないな。
english: But knowing Butchi, it wouldn't be strange for her to get that mad at students sneaking into the school at night.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
次に会う時があったら謝らなアカンな。
あの時は勝手に学校入ってごめんなさいって。
english: If we see her again, I'll have to apologize. Tell her I'm sorry for sneaking into the school without permission.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
うん。
ちゃんと謝ったら許してくれると思う。
そんな先生やったもん、ぶっちーは。
english: Yeah. I think she'll forgive you if you apologize properly. That's the kind of teacher Butchi was.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……。
怒ったらめっちゃ怖いけど、
ホンマ優しかったもんな。
english: Yeah... She was super scary when she got mad, but she was really kind.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: きっと、許してくれるわ……。
english: I'm sure she'll forgive us...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
誰かおる！
澪、気をつけ――
english: Someone's here! Mio, watch out--

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
おォ！
二人とも！
english: Oh! You two!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: アラン！？
english: Alain!?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: お父さん……。
english: Dad…

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
こんなところにおったんやな。
トイレから戻ったら誰もおらんで、
びっくりしてもたわ。
english: So this is where you were. When I got back from the restroom, no one was there, so I was really surprised.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
もうじきフェリーが出るらしで。
ほら、一緒に港まで行こら。
english: Sounds like the ferry is leaving soon. Come on, let's head to the harbor together.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: 慎平、なんで黙っちゃあるんなよ？
english: Why are you so quiet, Shinpei?

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
いくら待っても帰って来やせんから心配してたんやで。
ほら、早よ――
english: I was worried since you didn't come back no matter how long I waited. Come on, hurry up--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もう、やめてくれ。
english: Stop it already.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレの大事な人の姿と声で
これ以上オレを惑わさんでくれ。
english: Don't confuse me any further using the appearance and voice of someone I care about.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影は人間をコピーして、その人そっくりに
なるだけやなくて……コピー元の人を殺して、
その人に成り代わるんや。
english: Shadows don't just copy humans and look exactly like them... They kill the original person and take their place.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: 慎平……何を言っとるんや？
english: Shinpei… what are you talking about?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 家の中に、影がコピー元の人間を消した痕跡があった。
english: Inside the house, there were traces that a Shadow had erased the original person.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの黒い人の形をしたシミは……
おまえが本物のアランを消した時の
跡なんとちゃうか？
english: That black, human-shaped stain... Isn't that the mark left behind when you erased the real Alain?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえの正体はわかってるんや！
ニセモンがアランを騙らんでくれ！
english: I know what you really are! Don't you dare pretend to be Alain, you fake!

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
なるほどなァ。
あのシミは、そういうことやったんか。
english: I see. So that's what that stain was.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
止まれ！
それ以上、近づくな！
english:
Stop!
Don't come any closer!

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
わかった、わかった。
もう近寄ったりしやんから、話だけでも聞いたってや。
english: Okay, okay. I won't come any closer, so just hear me out.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、オレの後ろに隠れてろ。
english: Mio, hide behind me.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: 話、聞いてくれるんやな。
english: You're going to hear me out, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: ほな、最初から順番に話していこか。
english: Well then, let's go over it in order from the beginning.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
あれは、
おまえたちが来るちょっと前やった。
english: That was... just a little before you guys arrived.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
店の前を掃除しとったら、
家の中から何かが争い合うとるような音が
聞こえてきよってな。
english: I was cleaning up in front of the store, when I heard what sounded like a struggle coming from inside the house.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
恐る恐る家ん中に入ったんやが、
次の瞬間えらい眩しい光が見えてよォ。
慌てて部屋ん中に駆け込んだら……
english: I cautiously went inside, and the next moment I saw this incredibly bright light. When I rushed into the room in a panic...

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
開けっ放しの窓から飛び出してった人の気配と、
あの妙な黒いシミが床にあったんや。
english: I sensed someone jumping out the open window, and that weird black stain was on the floor.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……それで？
english: ...And then?

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: つまり、こういう風に考えられやんか？
english: In other words, couldn't you think of it like this?

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
うちに忍び込んだ空き巣が、
その空き巣を追ってきた影に襲われて
消されてしもた……ってな。
english: A burglar sneaked into our place, was attacked by a Shadow that had been chasing them, and was erased...

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
慎平が見つけたんは、
その空き巣が消された跡やったちゅうワケよ。
english: So what Shinpei found were the traces of that burglar being erased.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そんな話、信じられるか！
english: You expect me to believe that!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
その話が本当だったとして、
その影はどこに行ったんや！？
どうしてアランは何もされなかった！？
english: Assuming that story is true, where did that Shadow go?! Why wasn't Alain harmed?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だいたい空き巣の話なんか、
一切してなかったってのに！
english: Besides, you never mentioned anything about a burglar at all!

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
ああ、せやったな……。
でもあの時は影のことは知らなんだし、
黒いシミも意味わからんかった。
english: Ah, right... But back then I didn't know about the Shadows, and I didn't understand what the black stain meant either.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
それに下手にそないな話して、
おまえらを心配させたなかったでよォ。
english: Plus, I didn't want to tell you a story like that and make you guys worry unnecessarily.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
でもさっきの慎平の説明で、
ようやく事の真相を理解できたんや。
english: But thanks to Shinpei's explanation just now, I finally understand the truth of the matter.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
まあ、疑わしいっちゅうんは理解できる。
せやから改めて言うちゃるわ。
english: Well, I understand why you'd be suspicious. So I'll say it again.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: 慎平、私が正真正銘本物のアランや。
english: Shinpei, I am the genuine, real Alain.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃん……。
english: Shin-chan…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （状況を考えれば、こいつは確実に影のアランだ）
english: (Considering the situation, this is definitely Shadow Alain.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも万が一、
　オレの見当違いだったとしたら――）
english: (But if by some chance, I'm wrong about this--)

speaker: Island Broadcast
japanese:
お報せします。
まもなく、本日最終の本土行きフェリーが港に到着します。
english: Attention. The final ferry of the day bound for the mainland will soon arrive at the port.

speaker: Island Broadcast
japanese: 次の便は明日の朝までお待ちいただく可能性がございます。
english: You may have to wait until tomorrow morning for the next ferry.

speaker: Island Broadcast
japanese:
本日中に本土への渡航をご希望の方は、
港までお越しください。
english: Those who wish to travel to the mainland today, please proceed to the port.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
慎平。
この際、私を信じられやんでも構わん。
english: Shinpei. At this point, I don't mind if you can't trust me.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
でもこれ以上大事な家族を失いたないんや。
ほれ、早よ港へ行こら！
english: But I don't want to lose any more precious family members. Come on, let's hurry to the port!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん。
私、お父さんを信じたい。
english: Shin-chan. I want to believe Dad.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Mio…

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: だってあの人、私らのこと全然襲おうとしやんやん。
english: I mean, he hasn't tried to attack us at all.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
それってやっぱり、
本物のお父さんやからと違う？
english: Doesn't that mean he really is our real dad?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 澪のこと……守っちゃってね……。
english: Take good care of Mio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮……オレは……
　オレはどうするべきなんだ？）
english: (Ushio... I... What should I do?)

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
一緒に行くんが無理やったら、
港で待ち合わせてもええやいしょ。
english: If it's impossible for us to go together, we can just meet up at the port.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
なあ、慎ちゃん。
お父さんと一緒に行こ？
english: Hey, Shin-chan. Let's go with Dad, okay?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 私は三人一緒がええ。
english: I want the three of us to be together.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: ありがとう、澪。
english: Thank you, Mio.

japanese: 9.疑心暗鬼
english: 9. Paranoia

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、行っちゃダメだ。
english: Mio, don't go.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃん……。
english: Shin-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪がアランを信じたい気持ちはわかる。
でもオレは……。
english: I understand that you want to believe Alain. But I...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 本物と確信できる人以外、澪に近づけたくない。
english: I don't want anyone near you unless I'm absolutely sure they're the real deal.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先に行っててくれアラン。
オレと澪は後から行く。
english: Go on ahead, Alain. Mio and I will follow later.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: ……そうか。
english: …I see.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: すまん……。
english: I'm sorry...

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
ええんや、私を疑ってもかまわん。
ただ……。
english: It's fine, I don't mind if you doubt me. Just...

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
二人とも絶対無事でおること。
これだけは約束してくれ。
english: Make sure the two of you stay safe. Just promise me that.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: お父さん……。
english: Dad…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、約束する。
english: Yeah, I promise.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: ほな、また後でな。
english: Alright, see you later.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: アランも気をつけてな。
english: You take care too, Alain.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ごめんな、澪。
オレにはあれが本物のアランやとは、
どうしても信じられやんかった。
english: I'm sorry, Mio. I just couldn't bring myself to believe that was the real Alain.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あのアランの言う通り、
本当にコフネに押し入った空き巣と、
それを襲った影がいたとしても……
english: Even if what that Alain said was true, and there really was a burglar who broke into Kofune and a Shadow that attacked them...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
店にいたアランを無視して
去っていったのは不自然やと思う。
english: I think it's unnatural that they would just ignore the Alain who was in the store and leave.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それにオレらを探すんなら、まずはオレか澪、
どっちかのスマホに電話すればええやろ。
english: Besides, if he was looking for us, he should have just called either my smartphone or yours first.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレのところにアランからの着信は一度もない。
澪はどうなん？
english: I haven't had a single call from Alain. What about you, Mio?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 私も……あらへんな。
english: I haven't... either.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……少しでも疑わしい点があるなら、
オレは、本物だと判断するつもりはない。
english: ...If there's even the slightest thing to be suspicious of, I have no intention of judging him to be the real deal.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もしオレの判断が間違ってたら……
english: If my judgment is wrong...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうやな、そんときは全力で謝るわ。
疑ってしもた人全員にな。
english: Yeah, in that case I'll apologize with everything I have. To everyone I ended up doubting.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: そういうことやったら、私も確認しとくけど。
english: If that's the case, let me just confirm something too.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
まさか慎ちゃんが影って……
そんなことないやんな？
english: You're not a Shadow, are you, Shin-chan...? That's not possible, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレが……影かって？
english: Me... a Shadow?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
ごめん……。
私、ひどいこと言うてるね。
english: I'm sorry... I'm saying some terrible things, aren't I.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
こんなに助けてもろてて、
優しい言葉もかけてもろてるのに。
english: Even after you've helped me so much, and said such kind things to me.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
でも、あのお父さんが影かもしれやん言われたら、
何を信じてええんか、わからんくなって。
