english: But after being told that Dad might be a Shadow, I don't know what to believe anymore.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 今、私の目の前におる慎ちゃんは……
english: The Shin-chan in front of me right now is...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
影やないよな？
信じてええやんな？
english: You're not a Shadow, right? I can trust you, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、信じてええで。
オレは本物の網代慎平や。
english: Yeah, you can trust me. I'm the real Shinpei Ajiro.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
うん……信じる。
ごめんね、慎ちゃん。
english: Yeah... I believe you. I'm sorry, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
謝らんでええ。
さあ、港に行こか。
english: You don't have to apologize. Come on, let's head to the harbor.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
うん、行こ。
トキコらと会えたらええな。
english: Yeah, let's go. I hope we can meet up with Tokiko and the others.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（港へ向かう間、いろいろと考えを整理しておこう。
　最悪の事態に陥った場合のことも考えておくんや）
english: (I should organize my thoughts while we head to the harbor. I need to think about what to do in the worst-case scenario too.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（想像したくはないけど、
　もしも窓やトキちゃん、それに……
　澪まで失ってしまうことがあれば）
english: (I don't want to imagine it, but if I were to lose Sou, Tokiko, and even... Mio...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうなってしまったら、
　『あれ』を試してみるしかない）
english: (If that happens, I'll have no choice but to try "that".)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（本当に戻れる確証なんかない。
　でも……）
english: (I have no proof that I can really go back. But...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なにもひとつ守ることもできず
　絶望の淵に落ちるくらいなら、
　もう『あれ』しかない）
english: (If I'm going to fall into the depths of despair without being able to protect a single thing, then "that" is my only option.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まあ、みんなを失うような事態になってるときは、
　オレも相当危険な状況やろうけど）
english: (Well, if it comes to a situation where I've lost everyone, I'd probably be in a pretty dangerous situation myself.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……どんな形であれ、
　澪だけはオレが守り切ったる）
english: (...No matter what it takes, I will protect Mio to the end.)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん？
考え事してるん？
english: Shin-chan? Are you thinking about something?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ああ。
これからどうするか、ちょっとな。
english: ...Yeah. Just a bit about what we should do next.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: たまには私のこと考えたりしやんのかな。
english: I wonder if you ever think about me sometimes.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ？　なんや？
english: Huh? What?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
な、なんでもない！
それより急ご！
english: N-Nothing! More importantly, let's hurry!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
フェリーに間に合わんくなったら
元も子もないやん！
english: If we don't make it to the ferry in time, it'll all be for nothing!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ちょ、ちょっと待てって！
澪、オレから離れたらアカン！
english: H-Hey, wait a sec! Mio, you can't wander away from me!

japanese: 8.港へ
english: 8. To the Harbor

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: 慎平は、まだ私のこと疑っとるようやな。
english: Shinpei still seems to doubt me, huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん……残念やけど。
english: Yeah... it's a shame, though.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: そうか……。
english: I see...

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃん、なんでなん！？
english: Shin-chan, why!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （アランの話には、どうにも不自然な点があった）
english: (There was just something unnatural about Alain's story.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪がアランを信じたい気持ちはわかるし、
　できることならオレも信じたい）
english: (I understand that Mio wants to believe Alain, and if possible, I'd like to believe him too.)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃん！
english: Shin-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でもその選択の結果が
　澪を危険にさらす未来に繋がるのなら、
　オレは喜んで悪者になる）
english: (But if the result of that choice leads to a future where Mio is put in danger, then I'll gladly play the bad guy.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪を守る……それが潮の願いなんや）
english: (Protect Mio... That was Ushio's wish.)

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese: なんにせよ、今は島から逃げるんが最優先や。
english: At any rate, escaping the island is our top priority right now.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
私は先に行っとくで。
慎平はその方がええやろ。
english: I'll go on ahead. Shinpei would probably prefer that.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
なんで慎ちゃん、
お父さんのこと信じられやんの？
english: Why can't you believe in Dad, Shin-chan?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
待って、お父さん！
一緒に行く！
english: Wait, Dad! I'll go with you!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おい、澪！
離れたらアカンて！
english: Hey, Mio! I said don't wander off!

speaker: Island Broadcast
japanese:
繰り返しお報せいたします。
ただいま、日都神社方面を中心に
原因不明の災害が発生しております。
english: We repeat. Currently, a disaster of unknown cause has occurred, centered around Hitogashima Shrine.

speaker: Island Broadcast
japanese:
本土への避難を希望する方は、
到着しております臨時便フェリーに
ご乗船ください。
english: Those who wish to evacuate to the mainland, please board the temporary ferry that has arrived.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
ハァ、ハァ……。
間に合うたみたいやな。
english: *Pant, pant*... Looks like we made it in time.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
なんなんコレ？
どこにこんだけ人がおったん？
english: What is this? Where were all these people?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: さっき来た時は誰もいなかったのに……。
english: There wasn't anyone here when we came earlier...

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
みんな、島のあちこちで
息を殺して隠れてたんやろな。
english: Everyone must have been hiding with bated breath all over the island.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
このあとも臨時便があるみたい。
このぶんなら全員脱出できそうやね。
english: Looks like there will be more temporary ferries after this. At this rate, everyone should be able to evacuate.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese: 澪！　慎平さん！
english: Mio! Shinpei-san!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: トキコ！？
english: Tokiko!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓も無事やったんか！
english: Sou, you're safe too!

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese: そっちこそ無事でよかったわ！
english: I'm glad you're safe too!

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
心配しとったんやで？
電話かけても繋がらんしよォ！
english: We were worried, you know! I tried calling but it wouldn't connect!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
えっ……？
ちょっと待て、電話！？
english: Huh...? Wait a sec, you called!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それはこっちの台詞や！
そっちだって電話には出やんし、
メールの返信もくれやんかったやろ！
english: That's my line! You guys didn't answer your phones, and you didn't reply to my emails either!

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
はァッ！？
そんなわけあるかい！
オレらはなァ――
english: Hah!? As if! We were--

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
ええからお兄ちゃんは黙っとき。
説明は私がするから。
english: Just be quiet, Sou. I'll explain.

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese: お、おお。
english: O-Oh.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
慎平さん、電話が繋がらなかったのは、
たぶん電波障害のせいです。
english: Shinpei-san, the reason the calls wouldn't connect was probably due to radio interference.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 電波障害……？
english: Radio interference...?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
島全体で電波の調子がおかしくなってるそうです。
他の人が言ってました。
english: Apparently the reception has been acting up across the whole island. That's what other people were saying.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
神社で起きたあの騒ぎが関係してるのかも
しれませんけど……
あくまで私個人の推測にすぎません。
english: It might be related to that commotion at the shrine... But that's strictly my personal guess.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうなんか……。
english: Is that so...

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
でも良かったなァ。
こうしてみんな無事集まれてよォ。
english: But I'm glad. That we were all able to gather here safely like this.

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
つか、アランさんも一緒やったんやな。
もしかして慎平らが迎えに行ったんか？
english: Anyway, Alain-san was with you too, huh. Did you guys go pick him up?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ、それは……。
english: A-Ah, well...

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
考えることは一緒やなァ！
オレとトキコもお母さんらが心配で、
一旦家に戻ったしよ。
english: We were thinking the exact same thing! Tokiko and I were worried about our mom and the others, so we went back home for a bit too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あれ？
じゃあ窓のお母さんや菱形先生は
どこにいるんだ？
english: Huh? Then where are your mom and Hishigata-sensei?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: トキコらと一緒やないの？
english: Aren't they with you guys?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
もう船に乗ってるで。
私らは慎平さんと澪が来るんを
ここで待ってたんよ。
english: They're already on the boat. We were waiting here for you and Mio to show up.

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
おまえらアランさんを迎えに行って
ホンマ正解やったで。
english: You guys definitely made the right call going to get Alain-san.

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
どうも、この騒ぎに便乗して
空き巣を働きよる不届きモンが
おるらしいんや。
english: Apparently, there are some scumbags taking advantage of this commotion to commit burglaries.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 空き巣？
english: Burglaries?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
はい。
そもそも、お祭りで人が出払う隙を狙おうと
島に来た連中もいたみたいなんです。
english: Yes. It seems there were some people who came to the island aiming for the opening when everyone was out at the festival.

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
例の化物がウロウロしとるのに泥棒とは、
呆れた根性や。
english: To be stealing while that monster is roaming around... They've got some nerve.

speaker: Alan Kofune (Shadow アラン)
japanese:
ホンマやなァ。
物騒な世の中になってもうたわ。
english: Seriously. The world's become a dangerous place.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （じゃあアランが言ってたのも……？）
english: (Then what Alain said was...?)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん、さっきのお父さんの話、
信じてもええんやない？
english: Shin-chan, we can believe what Dad said earlier, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
大丈夫か慎平？
えらいしんどそうやで。
english:
Are you okay, Shinpei?
You look really exhausted.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
しんどいっていうか……
今までずっと気ィ張ってきた分、
力の抜け方が半端ないわ。
english: It's not that I'm exhausted, it's just... After being so tense for so long, the sudden relief is hitting me hard.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
みんな無事で安心したら、
どっと眠たなってきよった。
english: Once I realized everyone was safe and felt relieved, I suddenly got super sleepy.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
大変だったんですね。
お疲れ様です。
english: You've been through a lot. Good work.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん、寝るんはまだ早いで。
せめて船に乗ってからや！
english: Shin-chan, it's too early to sleep. At least wait until we're on the boat!

speaker: Captain
japanese:
おおーい、そこの人ら！
のんびり話しとらんで早よ乗船してよー！
english: Hey, you over there! Stop chatting and hurry up and board!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: あ、はい！
english: Ah, right!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
はい、お疲れの慎ちゃんは、
ここに座って寝てええで。
english: Here, the exhausted Shin-chan can sit and sleep right here.

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
ああ、待った待った。
寝る前に少しだけ話聞かせてほしわ。
english: Ah, wait, wait. I want you to tell me a little bit about what happened before you sleep.

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
はぐれてからこっち、
おまえら二人がどうしとったとかな。
english: I was wondering what you two had been up to since we got separated.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
ふふっ……。
ホンマにいろいろあったなァ。
ねッ、慎ちゃん。
english: Hehe... We really have been through a lot, haven't we. Right, Shin-chan?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
なんやの？
その意味ありげな言い方。
english: What's that supposed to mean? Saying it so suggestively like that.

speaker: Sou Hishigata (Shadow Sou)
japanese:
お、おい慎平ッ！
逃げてる最中、
澪ちゃんとなんかあったんか！？
english: H-Hey, Shinpei! Did something happen between you and Mio-chan while you were escaping!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: な、なんもないわ！
english: N-Nothing happened!

speaker: Ship Announcement (Captain)
japanese:
大変お待たせいたしました。
これより出港いたします。
english: Thank you for waiting. We will now be departing.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ひとまず、これで安心やな……）
english: (Well, we're safe for now...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これからどうするか、
　考えなあかんことは山ほどある）
english: (There are still a mountain of things I need to think about regarding what to do next.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、この船が本土に着くまでは……
　何も考えずに休んでもええよな……）
english: (But until this boat reaches the mainland... It's okay for me to just rest without thinking about anything, right...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しまった……。
　いつの間にかホンマに寝てしもてた）
english: (Crap... I actually fell asleep before I knew it.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……あれ？
english: ...Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（人の気配がない？
　みんな、どこ行ったんだ？）
english: (There's no one around? Where did everyone go?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（他の乗客だって、
　あんなに大勢いたはずなのに！）
english: (Even the other passengers... There should have been so many of them!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、アラン、おらんのか？
english: Mio, Alain, are you there?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓？　トキちゃん？
english: Sou? Toki-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この感覚、影が近づいてきてるんか？
　でも、どこから！？）
english: (This feeling... is a Shadow approaching? But from where!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（船に影が……
　海から這い上がって来てる！）
english: (Shadows are on the boat... They're crawling up from the sea!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影が川や海を越えられやんって推測は、
　とんだ間違いやった！）
english: (My assumption that Shadows couldn't cross rivers and seas was completely wrong!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こないな沖まで影がきてしもてるやて！
　まさか本土まで届いてまうんか！？）
english: (To think the Shadows have reached this far out to sea! Could they even reach the mainland!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今、この船はどのあたりに……）
english: (Where is this boat right now...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （島が……影に覆われてる……？）
english: (The island... is covered in Shadows...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや待て！
　なんで島がこんなに近いんや！？）
english: (No, wait! Why is the island so close!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もしや、この船、戻っていってる？
　なんでや！？）
english: (Could it be... this boat is heading back? Why!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （とにかく船を島から離してもらわな！）
english: (Anyway, I have to get them to move the boat away from the island!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
船長さん！！
船を沖へ向かわせてください！
english: Captain!! Please head the boat out to sea!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
聞いてますか、船長さん！
早くあの影から離れてください！
english: Are you listening, Captain! Hurry up and get away from those Shadows!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの影は人を飲み込むんです！
このままじゃ、この船ごと
飲み込まれてしまいかねない！
english: Those Shadows swallow people! At this rate, this entire boat could be swallowed up!

speaker: Captain
japanese: ええ、わかってますとも。
english: Yes, I know.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: またお会いできましたね。
english: We meet again.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お……おまえはッ！？
english: Y-You're...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こいつ、境内にいた四本腕！
　なんでこいつが船を――）
english: (This guy, the four-armed one from the shrine grounds! Why is he on the boat--)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: し～んちゃん。
english: Shi~n-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: M-Mio…

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: あーあ、なんで起きてしもたんや。
english: Aw man, why did you have to wake up.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
寝たままやったら、
なんも苦しまんと終わりやったのに。
english: If you had just stayed asleep, it would have all ended without you suffering at all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お、終わりって……。
english: E-Ended...?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
お父さんも、トキコも、窓くんも、
みんな先行って待ってるで。
english: Dad, Tokiko, Sou-kun, they've all gone on ahead and are waiting for you.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: 慎ちゃんも、早よ行かなアカンね。
english: You need to hurry and go too, Shin-chan.

japanese: 10.サイシュウビン
english: 10. Final Ferry

speaker: Island Broadcast
japanese:
島内の皆様にお報せいたします。
ただいま、日都神社方面を中心に
原因不明の災害が発生しております。
english: Attention all island residents. Currently, a disaster of unknown cause has occurred, centered around Hitogashima Shrine.

speaker: Island Broadcast
japanese:
本土への避難を希望する方は、
まもなく出港する臨時便フェリーに
ご乗船ください。
english: Those who wish to evacuate to the mainland, please board the temporary ferry departing shortly.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、フェリーもう着いちゃあるで！
english: Shin-chan, the ferry's already here!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
ああ、間に合ったな。
窓たちも来てくれるといいけど。
english: Yeah, we made it. I hope Sou and the others can make it too, though.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
他にも、隠れとる人がおると思うけど……
なんとかここまで来れるやろか。
english: I think there are other people hiding too, but... I wonder if they can make it here somehow.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほら、さっき学校でも私ら以外に
誰かおったみたいやったし。
教室の方から、なんやでっかい音したやろ？
english: Like, earlier at the school, it seemed like there was someone else besides us. There was a huge noise coming from the classroom, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もし私らみたいに避難してた人やったら、
一緒にここまで逃げたら良かったかも。
english: If it was someone evacuating like us, maybe it would have been better if we ran here together.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
停電してやんかったら、
確かめに行っても良かったんやけどな。
english: If the power hadn't gone out, we could have gone to check it out, though.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
真っ暗な状況で影に襲われてまう可能性考えたら、
下手に動けやんかった。
english: Considering the possibility of being attacked by Shadows in the pitch dark, I couldn't make any careless moves.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん、わかってる……。
english: Yeah, I know...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
ほら、早よ乗ろ。
もしかしたら中に窓やトキちゃんがおるかも
しれんやろ。
english: Come on, let's hurry up and board. Maybe Sou and Toki-chan are already inside.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あれ？
船の中、誰もおらんみたい。
english: Huh? It looks like there's no one inside the boat.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
どうする？
乗り口の所に戻って、トキコたちが来るか
様子見てた方がええかも。
english: What should we do? Maybe we should go back to the boarding area and wait to see if Tokiko and the others come.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん？
english: Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
そんなことせんでええ。
ここで大人しくしとくだけでええねん。
english: You don't need to do that. Just be a good boy and stay right here.

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Huh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: ここで、終わりなんやから。
english: Because this is where it ends.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 一体なに言うて――
english: What on earth are you talking--

japanese: 11.最終便
english: 11. Final Ferry

speaker: Island Broadcast
japanese:
繰り返しお報せいたします。
ただいま、日都神社方面を中心に
原因不明の災害が発生しております。
english: We repeat. Currently, a disaster of unknown cause has occurred, centered around Hitogashima Shrine.

speaker: Island Broadcast
japanese:
本土への避難を希望する方は、
まもなく出港する臨時便フェリーに
ご乗船ください。
english: Those who wish to evacuate to the mainland, please board the temporary ferry departing shortly.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
見てや、慎ちゃん！
フェリーもう港に着いちゃある！
english: Look, Shin-chan! The ferry is already at the harbor!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、全然人がいないな……。
これだけアナウンスしてるのに。
english: But there's no one around at all... Even though they've been making all these announcements.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
……お父さんはどこやろ？
先にフェリー乗ってるんかな？
english: ...Where's Dad? I wonder if he got on the ferry first?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なあ、澪。
他の島民や観光客の姿が一人も見えないって
おかしないか？
english: Hey, Mio. Don't you think it's strange that we can't see a single other islander or tourist?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
もうみんなフェリーに乗り込んだ後なんかも。
トキコと窓くんもそうやと思うで。
english: Maybe everyone has already boarded the ferry. I bet Tokiko and Sou-kun did too.

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: ほら、私らもフェリー乗っとこ！
english: Come on, let's get on the ferry!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、待て！
english: Mio, wait!

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese: え？　なんで？
english: Huh? Why?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
念のため、オレが先に行く。
澪は後からついてきてくれ。
english: Just in case, I'll go first. You follow behind me, Mio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（おかしい……。
　何の気配もしやん）
english: (This is strange... I don't sense anyone at all.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どういうことや？
　誰も乗ってないんか？）
english: (What does this mean? Is there no one on board?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （だ、誰か倒れてる！？）
english: (S-Someone's collapsed!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あの、大丈夫ですか――
english: Um, are you okay--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……なん……や、これ？
み、お……？
english: ...What... is this? Mi...o...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんで、澪がここに……。
english: Why is Mio here…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だったら……
　今までオレと一緒におった澪は……）
english: (If that's the case... Then the Mio who's been with me all this time is...)

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
慎ちゃん、会えてよかったなァ。
本物の私に。
english: I'm glad you got to meet her, Shin-chan. The real me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……影かッ！！
english: ...A Shadow!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐあっ……！？
english: Guh…!?

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
お父さんの包丁、よう切れるわ。
手入れ完璧やな。
english: Dad's knife cuts really well. He kept it in perfect condition.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いつ……入れ替わった……？
english: When… did you switch…?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
いつからやと思う？
慎ちゃん、いつもみたいにフカンして
考えてみたら？
english: When do you think? Shin-chan, why don't you try taking a bird's-eye view like you always do?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お……おかしい……。
そんなことありえやん……。
english: Th... That's strange... That's impossible...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だって、おまえ……
浴衣着てるやないか……！
english: Because you're... wearing a yukata...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（前に見た影のミオは制服姿やった。
　だから影と見分けがつくように……）
english: (The Shadow Mio I saw before was in her school uniform. That's why, so I could tell her apart from the Shadow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（窓がトキちゃんに頼んで、
　着付けてもらったはずやのに……）
english: (Sou asked Toki-chan to help her put on the yukata, and yet...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影も同じ浴衣姿になるには、
　どこかで浴衣を着た澪を……）
english: (For the Shadow to be wearing the same yukata, it would have had to see Mio wearing it somewhere...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あっ……。
english: Ah...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: お兄ちゃん、あの人のファンだったの？
english: Sou, were you a fan of that person?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
いや、別にファンいうわけやないけど、
せっかくやから撮っとこ思て。
english: Nah, not really a fan, but since we're here, I figured I might as well take a picture.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: わっ、眩しっ……！
english: Whoa, it's bright…!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ホンマやな。
さっきからカメラのフラッシュが凄いわ。
あの人、えらい人気なんやね。
english: No kidding. The camera flashes have been crazy for a while now. That person must be really popular.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あの時か……！）
english: (It was back then...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえは祭りの時……
浴衣姿の澪をコピーしたんやな！？
english: During the festival... you copied Mio in her yukata, didn't you!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
そういうこと。
かおりちゃんには感謝せんとアカンね。
english: Exactly. I really have to thank Kaori-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
コピーしただけじゃなく……
お、おまえが澪を！？
english: You didn't just copy her... Y-You killed Mio!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
えっ、私が？
なに言ってるん、慎ちゃん。
私ら、ずっと一緒におったやん。
english: Huh, me? What are you talking about, Shin-chan? We've been together this whole time.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
やっぱり、そないようけ血ィが出てしもたら、
いくら慎ちゃんでも
上手く頭が回らんようになってまうん？
english: I guess with that much blood loss, even you can't think straight anymore, huh, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうだ、この影はオレと一緒だった。
　だったら誰が澪を……）
english: (That's right, this Shadow was with me. Then who killed Mio...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……う、うう。
english: ...U-Ugh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ダメ、だ……。
　もう立ってられ……やん……）
english: (It's... no use... I can't stand... anymore...)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
もうそろそろ限界？
私が楽にしてあげよか？
english: Are you about at your limit? Should I put you out of your misery?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こ、ここまでなんか……）
english: (Is... is this the end...?)

speaker: 男の声（影シンペイ）
japanese: やめとけ。
english: Stop.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: まだトドメは刺すな。
english: Don't finish him off yet.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （か、影のオレ……？）
english: (Sh-Shadow me...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （くそ……あの時のヤツか……）
english: (Damn it... it's the guy from back then...)

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
パパとママが……
黙ってろって……言うから……。
それより私の質問に――
english: Papa and Mama told me... to stay quiet... More importantly, answer my question--

speaker: Shiori
japanese: ……まあええか。
english: ...Well, whatever.

speaker: Shiori
japanese: 答えやんでも、あとで聞くし……。
english: Even if you don't answer, I'll just ask you later...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あの影――
　凸村さんに成り代わったのと同じ……！）
english: (That Shadow-- It's the same as the one that took Totsumura-san's place...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（凸村さんと同じように、
　オレそっくりの影が……？）
english: (Just like with Totsumura-san, there's a Shadow that looks exactly like me...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレは影の病に感染した……
　いや……していたんだ！
　初めから！！）
english: (I was infected with the Shadow Sickness... No... I had been infected! Right from the start!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こいつが、澪を……！）
english: (This guy killed Mio...!)

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
言うたやろ。
こいつは過去に戻ってやり直すことができるんやって。
english: I told you, didn't I? This guy can go back to the past and start over.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
詳しい条件はわからんけど、
死ぬことがきっかけになってるんは確かや。
english: I don't know the exact conditions, but it's definitely triggered by dying.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
何のためにおまえを監視役につけさせたか
忘れたんか？
english: Did you forget why I had you act as his watcher?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
忘れてへんよ。
でも、えらい苦しそうやったから。
english: I haven't forgotten. But he looked like he was in so much pain.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
まあええ。
行くぞ。
english: Well, whatever. Let's go.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ごめんね、慎ちゃん。
私、「見張るついでに遊んでやれ」って
言われてたんよ。
english: Sorry, Shin-chan. I was told to "play with you while keeping an eye on you."

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ホンマに澪とおるみたいやったやろ？
結構楽しめたわ。
english: It really felt like you were with Mio, didn't it? I had a pretty good time.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
バイバイ、慎ちゃん。
慎ちゃんが死んでしまう頃には、
全部終わってると思うで。
english: Bye-bye, Shin-chan. By the time you die, I think everything will be over.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Guh... ahh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（「全部終わってる」……？
　一体……なんのことだ？）
english: ("Everything will be over"...? What on earth... does that mean?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （いや……それより澪だ……）
english: (No... more importantly, Mio...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、しっかりしろ……！
english: Mio, hang in there...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Mio…!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うッ……く、くそォォォッ！！
english: Ugh... d-damn it!!

japanese: 12.失われた光
english: 12. Lost Light

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (...Where am I?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレは……どこでしくじったんだ？）
english: (Where... did I mess up?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （もう指一本すら動かせやん……）
english: (I can't even move a single finger anymore...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （命を絶ってやり直すことも、これじゃできへん……）
english: (I can't even end my life to start over like this...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんでだ……？
　どうしてこんなことに……）
english: (Why...? How did it come to this...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （この音は……）
english: (This sound is...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうか、あの黒い影が……
　船の中にまで……）
english: (I see, that black Shadow... Even inside the boat...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪が……消えてしまった……）
english: (Mio has... disappeared...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （もう……ここまでやな……）
english: (I guess... this is as far as I go...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪……そしてオレも……）
english: (Mio... and me too...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なにもかも……影に飲まれていくんだろう……）
english: (Everything... is going to be swallowed by the Shadows...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（消えていく……。
　音も……光も……）
english: (Fading away... The sound... the light...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮、ごめんな……）
english: (Ushio, I'm sorry...)

english: Key TIPS [<color=#GF_KEY_ROOTCLEAR_MIO>route: Mio Kofune</color>] obtained.

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ふぅ……。

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island

（参ったな。
　今度ばかりは本当にマズイ……）

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island

japanese:
（筆が止まることはこれまでにもあったが、
　今までの比ではない）

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island

（考えども考えども思考は堂々巡り。
　ドがつくほどのスランプだ……）

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（もはやどこから手を付けるべきか、
　それすらもわからん）
english: (I don't even know where I should start anymore.)

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（藁にも縋る思いで数年ぶりの帰郷を決めたが……
　今更、あの小さな島で得るものなどあるのか？）
english: (I decided to return home for the first time in years, grasping at straws... But is there anything to be gained from that small island at this point?)

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（むしろ環境が変わることで、
　思考が乱れる恐れすらあるのではないか！？）
english: (If anything, changing my environment might just mess up my thoughts even more!?)

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（そもそも、行き詰まったゆえの帰郷など
　安直すぎる！！）
english: (In the first place, returning home just because I'm stuck is far too simplistic!!)

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（いかん！
　ここまで思考が硬直化するとは我ながら情けない！！）
english: (This is no good! I'm ashamed of myself for letting my thinking become so rigid!!)

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （やはり引き返すか――）
english: (Maybe I should turn back--)

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（いや、すでに竜之介には連絡してしまった。
　ここで行かないと言えば、なぜだと
　無駄に騒がれることになるな）
english: (No, I've already contacted Ryunosuke. If I say I'm not going now, he'll just make a huge fuss asking why.)

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （……想像するだけで面倒極まる事態だ）
english: (...Just imagining it is an extremely troublesome situation.)

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（まったく。
　安易な判断を下した数日前の自分を
　怒鳴りつけてやりたい）
english: (Good grief. I'd like to yell at my past self from a few days ago for making such an easy decision.)

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（まあいい。
　次回作への取材も兼ねていると思えば
　無駄にはなるまい）
english: (Well, whatever. If I consider it as research for my next work, it won't be a waste.)

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata

chapter: 1. Ryunosuke Nagumo Returns to Hitogashima Island
speaker: Hizuru Minakata

english: (Before I can even think about how to be a writer, I'll lose sight of myself as a writer...!)

japanese: 2.波稲の日都ヶ島案内
english: 2. Haine's Guide to Hitogashima Island

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese: おーい、お姉ちゃーん！
english: Heeeey, Sis!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ひづるちゃん、お帰り～！！
english: Hizuru-chan, welcome back~!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 待ち合わせの時間から５分の遅れか。
english: You're five minutes late for our meeting.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
ごめん、ちょっと出掛けにトイレへ
行きたなってしもて。
でも、必死に急いで来たんやで？
english: Sorry, I suddenly had to go to the bathroom right as I was heading out. But I hurried here as fast as I could, you know?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そうか。
それは無用な努力だったな。
english: I see. That was a pointless effort.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
english: Huh...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: もう少し遅れてきても良かったということだ。
english: I mean that it would have been fine if you arrived a little later.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
こういった無駄に見える時間こそ、
小説家にとってアイディア構築の貴重な
時間なのだからな。
english: Because it's exactly this kind of seemingly wasted time that is precious time for a novelist to construct ideas.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ひづるちゃん！
english: Hizuru-chan!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ん……ああ、波稲か。
english: Hm... Ah, Haine.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ひづるちゃん！
人からお帰り言われたら、
なんて言うん？
english: Hizuru-chan! When someone says "welcome back", what are you supposed to say?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……ただいま。
english: …I'm home.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
えへへ。
お帰り、ひづるちゃん。
english:
Hehe.
Welcome back, Hizuru-chan.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: それと竜之介。
english: And Ryunosuke.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ご所望の品だ。
ありがたく持って帰れ。
english: Here is what you requested. Take it home with gratitude.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese: わっ、わっ……！？
english: Whoa, whoa...!?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
これ、お土産？
こんなに買うてきてくれたん！？
english: Are these souvenirs? You bought all this for me!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
なにを白々しい……。
買ってこいと要求したのはおまえだろうが。
english: Stop playing dumb... You're the one who demanded I buy them.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
いやいや、買ってこいら言うてやんよ！
お土産あったら嬉しなァて言うただけや。
english: No no, I never told you to buy them! I just said I'd be happy if there were souvenirs.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
よく言う。
なにも買って帰らなければ、不満を洩らしただろうに。
english: Yeah, right. If I hadn't bought anything and come home, you would have complained.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
そうやって文句言うとっても、
ちゃんと買うてきてくれるとこが、
お姉ちゃんらしわ。
english: The fact that you still properly bought them even while complaining like that is so like you, Sis.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
ありがとな。
ほら、波稲もお礼言うとき。
english: Thanks. Come on, Haine, you say thanks too.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ありがとー！
ひづるちゃん大好きー！
english:
Thank you~!
I love Hizuru-chan~!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 礼などいい、波稲。
english: No need for thanks, Haine.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
それで、この後はどうするん？
久しぶりに帰って来たんやし、
家でゆっくりしてくやろ？
english: So, what are you doing after this? It's been a while since you came back, so you're going to relax at home, right?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いや、そんな暇はない。
伝えただろう、新作準備中で
取材を兼ねて帰ってきたのだと。
english: No, I don't have the time for that. I told you, I'm preparing for my new work and came back to do research as well.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese: ああ、それでピリピリしてるんやな。
english: Ah, so that's why you're so on edge.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……それだけではないがな。
english: ...That's not the only reason, though.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese: うん？　何かあったん？
english: Huh? Did something happen?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
おまえ、私のことを
周囲に漏らしていないだろうな？
english: You haven't been leaking information about me to the people around you, have you?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
お姉ちゃんのことて……
『南雲竜之介』のこと？
english: Information about you...? You mean about "Ryunosuke Nagumo"?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese: まさか、誰にも言うてやんよ！
english: No way, I haven't told anyone!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……だったらいいが。
english: ...Then that's fine.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（誤魔化している様子はない。
　となると竜之介はシロ……。
　あの少年はどこから情報を得たのだ？）
english: (He doesn't seem to be hiding anything. Which means Ryunosuke is innocent... Where did that boy get his information from?)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ひづるちゃ～ん、遊ぼ～！
english: Hizuru-chan~! Let's play~!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
遊んでやりたいのはやまやまだが、
取材があるんでな。
english: I'd love to play with you, but I have research to do.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: なあ～、遊ぼうや～！
english: C'mon~, let's play~!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
自分の要求が通るまで主張を貫き通す、
まさに子供だな。
english: Pushing her demands until she gets her way... She truly is a child.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
そうそう、波稲はまだ子供で遊びたい盛りなんよ。
せやから、な？
english: Exactly, Haine is still a kid at the age where she wants to play. So, y'know?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese: 可愛い姪のわがままくらい聞いちゃってや。
english: You should at least indulge your cute niece's selfishness a little.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ひづるちゃんと遊びた～い！
english: I want to play with Hizuru-chan!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……私は仕事をしに来たのだ。
波稲と遊ぶために帰ってきたわけではない。
english: ...I came here to work. I didn't come back to play with you, Haine.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
ほんの少しだけでもええから、
かまってあげられやん？
english: Even just a little bit is fine, so couldn't you give her some attention?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
波稲、お姉ちゃんが帰ってくるん
楽しみに待ってたんよ。
english: Haine was really looking forward to you coming back, Sis.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
せやで！
待ってたんやで！
english: Yeah! I was waiting!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 遊びたいのなら竜之介と――
english: If you want to play, play with Ryunosuke--

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
パパじゃないのッ！
ひづるちゃんと遊びたいのッ！
english: Not Papa! I want to play with Hizuru-chan!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese: あ、あはは……。
english: A-Ahaha...

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
だ～か～ら～、ねッ！
遊ぼ、ひづるちゃん！
english: Sooo~, c'mon! Let's play, Hizuru-chan!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
もう一度説明するからよく聞け。
私は、仕事をするために島に来たのだ。
english: I'll explain it one more time, so listen carefully. I came to the island to work.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
うん！
だから遊ぼ！
english:
Yeah!
So let's play!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……『だから』の使い方がおかしいぞ。
これだから子供の思考は度しがたい。
english: ...Your use of "so" is incorrect. This is why children's thinking is so incomprehensible.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
ほな、仕事の後は？
少しくらいやったら時間あるやろ。
english: Then, what about after work? You'll have a little bit of time, right?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ひづるちゃん、お仕事いつ終わるん？
english: Hizuru-chan, when will your work end?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私にもわからん。
だから諦めて帰りたまえ。
english: Even I don't know. So give up and go home.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
いやや！　ひづるちゃんと一緒におる！
それやったら、お仕事終わってすぐ遊べるやろ！？
english: No! I'm staying with Hizuru-chan! That way, we can play as soon as your work is done, right!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……私の仕事は一人でやるものなんだ。
側に誰かがいると気が散る。
english: ...My work is something I do alone. Having someone by my side distracts me.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ひづるちゃんのお仕事ってなんなん？
お手伝いしちゃる！
english: What is your job, Hizuru-chan? I'll help you out!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 人の話を聞け……。
english: Listen to what people are saying...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
お姉ちゃん、これから取材やったよな。
波稲、お姉ちゃんはこの後、
島の中を歩き回らなアカンねんて。
english: Sis, you're going to do research now, right? Haine, Sis has to walk around the island after this.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
あっ！
それやったら私が島の案内しちゃるわ！
english: Ah! If that's the case, I'll be your guide to the island!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
不要だ。
私はこの島の生まれだぞ？
english: Unnecessary. I was born on this island, you know?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
いやぁ、そうは言うても、
この島かて多少は変わってきてるで。
english: Well, even so, this island has changed a bit too.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
お姉ちゃんがおった時のままやない所も
結構あるし、案内役がおった方が
なにかと便利とちゃう？
english: There are quite a few places that aren't the same as when you were here, so wouldn't having a guide be convenient in many ways?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: それは否定できないが……。
english: I can't deny that, but...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
聞いたか、波稲！
島の案内役頑張るんやで！
english: Hear that, Haine! Do your best as the island guide!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: うん！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: おい、まだ案内役を了承したわけでは――
english: Hey, I haven't agreed to having a guide yet--

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ほら、ひづるちゃん！
早よ行こら！
english:
Come on, Hizuru-chan!
Let's go already!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ハァ……。
english: *Sigh*...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（やはり子供は苦手だ。
　言動が不確定過ぎて手に負えん）
english: (I really am bad with children. Their words and actions are too unpredictable to handle.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
竜之介。
おまえは波稲を甘やかしすぎだろう。
english: Ryunosuke. You spoil Haine too much.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese: え？　そう見える？
english: Huh? Does it look that way?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
このままでは、意地を張れば
相手はなんでも言うことをきくと
勘違いしたまま成長するぞ。
english: If this keeps up, she'll grow up mistakenly believing that if she's just stubborn enough, people will do whatever she says.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
大丈夫やって。
別に波稲は意地張ってるわけやないねん。
english: It's fine. It's not like Haine is just being stubborn.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
相手がお姉ちゃんやから、
わがままを言うてるだけなんよ。
english: She's just acting spoiled because she's dealing with you, Sis.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 私だから、だと？
english: Because it's me?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
なァ～～！
早よ行こ～～って！
english: C'mooon~! I said let's gooo~!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（……こうなってしまっては、
　さっさと目的を遂げさせることが最も効率的だな）
english: (...Since it's come to this, letting her accomplish her goal quickly is the most efficient option.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
わかった。
だが、その前に荷物だけでも宿へ置かせてくれ。
english: Understood. But before that, at least let me leave my luggage at the inn.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
やったァ！
それじゃ、しゅっぱーつ！
english: Yay! Alright then, let's gooo!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: おい、聞いてるのか！？
english: Hey, are you even listening?!?

japanese: 3.親友たちの絆
english: 3. Bonds of Best Friends

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 待たせたな。
english: Sorry to keep you waiting.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
あ、ひづるちゃん！
トイレでも行ってたん？
english: Ah, Hizuru-chan! Did you go to the bathroom or something?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 宿に荷物を置いて、すぐに出てきたはずだが。
english: I just dropped my luggage off at the inn and came right out, though.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
そうなん？
なんかえらい待った気がするけど。
english: Really? I feel like I waited a really long time, though.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……年齢が違えば体感時間も異なるということか。
english: ...I suppose perceived time differs depending on age.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: えっ、なんて？
english: Huh? What?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いや、なんでもない。
それで、島のどこを案内してくれるんだ？
english: No, it's nothing. So, where on the island are you going to guide me?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: う～ん、どこにしよっかな？
english: Hmm, where should we go?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
まさか……あれだけ主張しておいて、
なんのプランもなかったのか……？
english: Don't tell me... after insisting that much, you didn't have any plan at all...?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: じゃあ、正義の味方のとこ行く？
english: Then, wanna go see the Hero of Justice?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: は？
english: Huh?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（架空のヒーローのことか？
　いや……そんなもの、刺激にはなりそうもない）
english: (Does she mean a fictional hero? No... something like that isn't likely to be stimulating.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（まあ、今はなんだっていい。
　波稲が満足して、さっさと解放してもらえるのならば）
english: (Well, anything is fine right now. As long as Haine is satisfied and lets me go quickly.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ、それでいい。
その正義の味方とやらに会わせてくれ。
english: Ah, that's fine. Let me meet this so-called Hero of Justice.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
わかった！
ほら、ついてきて！
english:
Got it!
Come on, follow me!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 無用に元気だな……。
english: She's pointlessly energetic...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（この島も多少は変わってる、などと
　竜之介は言っていたが……）
english: (Ryunosuke said that this island has changed a bit too, but...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（なんのことはない。
　私が暮らしていた時とほぼ同じだ）
english: (It's nothing of the sort. It's almost exactly the same as when I lived here.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （いつだって変わらぬ姿で出迎えてくれる故郷――）
english: (A hometown that always welcomes you with an unchanging appearance--)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（まあ、安直な表現ではあるが、悪くないものだ。
　帰る場所があるというのは）
english: (Well, it's a bit of a cliché expression, but it's not a bad thing. Having a place to return to, that is.)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ふんふふふ～ん♪
english: Hmm hm hm~♪

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（……こういう、
　理不尽が形になったような存在も
　襲いかかってくるのだが）
english: (...Even if this kind of existence, which is like unreasonableness taken form, also attacks you.)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: なあなあ、ひづるちゃん！
english: Hey, hey, Hizuru-chan!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: なんだ？
english: What?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
お話を考えるんが、
ひづるちゃんのお仕事なんやろ？
どんなお話書いてるん？
english: Coming up with stories is your job, right, Hizuru-chan? What kind of stories do you write?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
どんな、と言われてもな。
質問が大雑把すぎて応えようがない。
english: Even if you ask "what kind". Your question is too broad for me to answer.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
前にパパが見せてくれたことあるけど、
難しい字ばっかりで読めやんかった。
字ィも小さいし。
english: Papa showed me before, but it was full of difficult kanji so I couldn't read it. The letters were small too.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ああいうのやなくて、
絵本みたいなんも書いてくれやん？
それやったら私も読めるし！
english: Instead of stuff like that, couldn't you write something like a picture book? If you did that, I could read it too!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（絵本か……。
　スランプ脱出には、いっそ全く知らないジャンルに
　飛び込んでみるのも……）
english: (A picture book... To break out of a slump, maybe jumping into a completely unknown genre wouldn't be a bad idea...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（いや、さすがに絵本はない。
　さっそく思考が波稲に毒されているぞ）
english: (No, a picture book is out of the question. My thoughts are already being poisoned by Haine.)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
あっ、澪さんと朱鷺子さんだ！
お～～い！
english: Ah, it's Mio-san and Tokiko-san! Heeey!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: こんにちは、波稲ちゃん。
english: Hello, Haine-chan.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
こんにちは。
いつも元気やなァ。
english: Hello. You're always so energetic, huh.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: そちらの方は……。
english: And who might this be...?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
この人、ひづるちゃん！
パパのお姉ちゃんやで！
english:
This is Hizuru-chan!
She's Dad's older sister!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
南方竜之介の姉……
南方ひづるだ。
english: I am Ryunosuke Minakata's older sister... Hizuru Minakata.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ああ、竜之介さんのお姉さんの！
私は小舟澪です。
english: Ah, Ryunosuke-san's older sister! I'm Mio Kofune.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 菱形朱鷺子です。
english: I'm Tokiko Hishigata.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （小舟に菱形……）
english: (Kofune and Hishigata...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ、洋食コフネと菱形医院の。
島にいた頃は、どちらもよく世話になったよ。
english: Ah, from Western Restaurant Kofune and Hishigata Clinic. When I lived on the island, I was often indebted to both of your families.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（以前とは驚くほど印象が変わっている。
　やはりこの年頃は、数年経つと別人のように
　なってしまうこともあるものだな）
english: (Their impressions have changed surprisingly from before. I suppose at this age, it's not uncommon to become like a completely different person after a few years.)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
澪さんと朱鷺子さんはめちゃ仲良しなんよ。
なにをするにも一緒やしなァ。
english: Mio-san and Tokiko-san are super close. They do everything together.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なにをするにもって……
さすがにそこまで一緒やないと思うけど。
english: Doing everything together is a bit... I don't think we're together *that* much.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ふふ、けど昨日も会ったしなァ。
明日も一緒に勉強する約束やろ？
english: Hehe, but we met yesterday too. And we promised to study together tomorrow, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そ、それは……そろそろ夏休みの課題も
進めていかなアカンのやけど……。
私一人やと……なァ？
english: T-That's because... we need to start making progress on our summer vacation assignments soon... And if I'm by myself... y'know?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
はいはい。
ちゃんとわからんとこは教えちゃるよ。
english: Yes, yes. I'll properly teach you the parts you don't understand.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ありがと～！
今度なんかお礼するわ。
english: Thanks~! I'll give you something as thanks next time.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
別にええよ。
澪と一緒におると楽しいし。
english: It's fine. Being with you is fun, Mio.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……自分自身の時間を、
他人のために惜しみなく提供できるのだな。
無論、無償で。
english: ...You are able to unsparingly offer your own time for the sake of others. Without compensation, of course.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: えっ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
なおかつ、これは一方的な奉仕でもない。
違うか？
english: Furthermore, this isn't a one-sided service either. Am I wrong?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そ、それはもちろんです！
トキコに助けてもらったら、
その分、私もトキコを助けます！
english: O-Of course it isn't! If Tokiko helps me, then I'll help Tokiko just as much!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: Mio…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ふむ……。
いわゆる親友同士か。
english: Hmm... So-called best friends, huh.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
し、親友……ですか。
なんか照れますね。
でも間違うてへんよな？
english: B-Best friends...? That's a bit embarrassing. But it's not wrong, right?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: うん、間違うてへん。
english: Yeah, it's not wrong.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（言葉にすればチープに聞こえるかも
　しれないが……）
english: (Putting it into words might make it sound cheap, but...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（だが掘り下げれば、一生かけても
　書ききれないほど深大なテーマのひとつだろう）
english: (But if you dig deeper, it's one of those profound themes that you couldn't fully write about even if you spent your whole life on it.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（だが、たとえ親友同士であっても
　なにかのきっかけでその関係が綻ぶことも
　少なくはない）
english: (However, even between best friends, it's not uncommon for that relationship to unravel due to some trigger.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（親友に裏切られる話、か。
　使えないテーマではないな）
english: (A story about being betrayed by a best friend, huh. It's not an unusable theme.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （だが、なんのために裏切る？）
english: (But for what reason would they betray them?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（色恋沙汰？
　いや、私が書きたいものはメロドラマなどではない）
english: (A romantic entanglement? No, what I want to write isn't a melodrama.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あの……ひづるさん？
english: Um… Hizuru-san?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
単刀直入に聞く。
もし二人のどちらかがもう一方を裏切ったらどうする？
english: I'll ask point-blank. If one of you betrayed the other, what would you do?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ！？
english: Huh!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 裏切り……ですか？
english: Betrayal…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ああ、キミたち二人の考えを聞いてみたい。
english: Yes, I'd like to hear what you two think.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
きゅ、急にそんなこと言われても……。
トキコはそんなことするわけあらへんし、
もちろん私かて……！
english: E-Even if you suddenly ask us that... There's no way Tokiko would do something like that, and of course I wouldn't either...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
想像したまえ！
何のための思考能力だ！
english: Use your imagination! What do you think you have the ability to think for!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ええー……。
english: Eeh...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……最初は、怒ります。
でも悲しくもあって……
どうしてって、たくさん悩んで……。
english: ...At first, I'd be angry. But I'd also be sad... I'd worry a lot about why they did it...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 最後は、許してまうと思います。
english: In the end, I think I'd end up forgiving them.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そうやな……。
私もトキコと同じや。
english: Yeah... I'm the same as Tokiko.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: それが、どれだけ非道な裏切りであっても？
english: Even if it was the most cruel betrayal imaginable?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そうですね……。
トキコが私を裏切るやなんて、
よっぽどの理由があるはずやし。
english: Let's see... For Tokiko to betray me, there would have to be a really good reason.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ちゃんと本人に話聞いてから、
二人で解決します。
トキコとケンカ別れなんかイヤやもん。
english: I'd listen to what she has to say, and we'd solve it together. I don't want to part ways with Tokiko over a fight.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
それに、もし……
自分が裏切る側やったとして……。
english: Besides, if... I were the one doing the betraying...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
よほどのことやない限り、
裏切る前に二人で話し合うと思います。
english: Unless it was something extremely serious, I think we would talk it over together before I betrayed her.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん、やっぱそうやんな！
english: Yeah, that's what I thought!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（怒るけど許す……。
　裏切る前に相談する……）
english: (They'd get angry but forgive them... They'd consult them before betraying them...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（普通かっ！！
　なんの面白みもない！！）
english: (How ordinary!! There's no entertainment value in that at all!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（世の中には、簡単に相談できない事情も存在する。
　どんなに強い絆があろうと、抗えないものもある）
english: (There are circumstances in this world that you can't easily consult others about. No matter how strong your bond is, there are things you cannot resist.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（だが……二人がお互いに向ける笑顔は、
　「そんなものは存在しない」とでも
　言いたげな様子だ……）
english: (But... the smiles they direct at each other seem to be saying, "No such thing exists"...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（これが『親友』ということなのか。
　強い絆があればどんなことでも
　乗り越えられる）
english: (Is this what it means to be "best friends"? With a strong bond, you can overcome anything.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（思えば、これまで
　あまり目を向けてこなかった概念だ。
　そういった意味では新鮮味がある……）
english: (Come to think of it, this is a concept I haven't paid much attention to until now. In that sense, it has a certain freshness to it...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ありがとう。
参考になったよ。
english: Thank you. That was helpful.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
参考に……ですか？
一体なんの参考に……。
english: Helpful...? Helpful for what, exactly...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ああ、気にしないでくれ。
english: Ah, don't worry about it.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: は、はァ……。
english: O-Okay...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（若い……。
　実に若く真っ直ぐな答えだ）
english: (Young... What truly young and straightforward answers.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（世の中には、とても人には言えない悩みもある。
　どれだけ強い絆があろうと抗えないものもある）
english: (There are worries in this world that you simply can't tell anyone. No matter how strong your bond is, there are things you cannot resist.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（だが、もしもそうしたことすら乗り越える
　強固な信頼関係があるのだとすれば……）
english: (But, if there is a solid relationship of trust that can overcome even that...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （なるほど……悪くはないテーマだ）
english: (I see... That's not a bad theme.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（問題は『親友』という関係性に、
　私が至って疎いということだろうな）
english: (The problem is that I am completely unfamiliar with the relationship of "best friends".)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
どないしたんやろ？
ずっと空見て考え込んでるけど……。
english: I wonder what's wrong? She's been staring up at the sky deep in thought for a while now...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ちょっと変わった人なんかも……。
english: Maybe she's just a little eccentric...

japanese: 4.正義の味方……？
english: 4. Hero of Justice…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（小舟澪、菱形朱鷺子の二人と別れた後、
　波稲に連れられて辿り着いたのは――）
english: (After parting ways with Mio Kofune and Tokiko Hishigata, where Haine led me to was--)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
とうちゃーく！
ここが正義の味方の秘密基地やで！
english: We're heeeere! This is the Hero of Justice's secret base!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
なにかと思えば、ただの駐在所ではないか。
秘密でもなんでもない至極開かれた公僕施設……。
english: I wondered what it would be, but it's just the police box. An extremely open public servant facility with nothing secret about it...

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
凸村さ～ん！
あ～そ～ぼ～！
english: Totsumura-saaan! Let's plaaay!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ん～～……どちらさん？
english: Hmmm... Who might you be?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
おつかれさまです！
南方波稲であります！
english: Reporting for duty, sir! I am Haine Minakata!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
おお、波稲ちゃんやんけ！
よお来たなァ！
english: Oh, if it isn't Haine-chan! Welcome!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
報告します！
本日も島は平和であります！
english: I have a report! The island is peaceful again today, sir!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
おお、そらええこっちゃ。
パトロールごくろうさん。
english: Oho, that's good to hear. Good work on your patrol.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: えへへっ！
english: Hehe!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
おい、波稲。
この男が『正義の味方』か？
english:
Hey, Haine.
Is this guy the "Hero of Justice"?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
せや！
島の安全を守る、正義の味方や！
english: Yeah! He's the Hero of Justice who protects the island's safety!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ん？　んんっ！？
english: Hm? Hmmm!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（……視線があからさまに私の胸元を向いているぞ。
　隠そうという気もないのか、下種め）
english: (...His gaze is blatantly directed at my chest. He's not even trying to hide it, what a scumbag.)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あのォ、波稲ちゃん？
こ、この人は……？
english: U-Um, Haine-chan? W-Who is this person...?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ひづるちゃん！
パパのお姉ちゃんや！
english:
Hizuru-chan!
She's Papa's older sister!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: 今、ひづるちゃんに島の案内したげてるんよ！
english: I'm guiding Hizuru-chan around the island right now!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ああ、あの竜之介くんのォ……。
english: Ah, Ryunosuke-kun's...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
南方竜之介の姉、
南方ひづるだ。
english: Ryunosuke Minakata's older sister, Hizuru Minakata.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ……Ｈカップ。
english: …H-cup.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: は？
english: Huh?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
english: Ah…

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ああ、いやいや！
別になんも言うてやんでェ！？
あ、あはははは！
english: A-Ah, no no! I didn't say anything at all, y'know!? A-Ahahahaha!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……絵に描いたような低劣男だな。
english: ...What a picture-perfect lowlife of a man.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
物語の中でならなんとか許容できようが、
現実世界では甚だ鬱陶しいことが確認できた。
english: I might be able to tolerate him in a story, but I've confirmed that he is extremely annoying in the real world.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
本当の危機に直面したなら、
尻尾巻いて真っ先に逃げ出す――
そんな男だろうよ。
english: If he were to face a real crisis, he'd be the first to turn tail and run-- That's the kind of man he is.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ……ななッ！？
english: ...Wh-Wha!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
だが安心したまえ。
物語は勇敢な戦士ばかりでは成立しない。
キミのような愚鈍な人間も必要だ。
english: But rest assured. A story cannot be established with brave warriors alone. Foolish humans like you are also necessary.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ……なななァッ！？
english: ...Wh-Wh-Wha!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ぶ、侮辱罪じょ！
タイホしてまうでェ！
english: Th-That's an insult! I'll arrest you!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
それから！
私はＧカップだ、Ｈカップではない！
english: And another thing! I'm a G-cup, not an H-cup!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ななななな、なんやてェェェッ！？
english: Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-What did you saaaaay!?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ひづるちゃん、じーかっぷってなんなん？
english: Hizuru-chan, what's a "G-cup"?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
胸部の大きさの単位だ。
詳しいことはいずれわかる、大きくなればな。
english: It is a unit for the size of the chest. You'll understand the details eventually, once you grow up.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ふ～ん、大きなったらかァ。
english: Hmm, once I grow up, huh.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
波稲、正義の味方はもういい。
次の場所を案内してくれ。
english: Haine, that's enough of the Hero of Justice. Guide me to the next place.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
は～～い！
バイバイ、凸村さん！
english: Okaaaay! Bye-bye, Totsumura-san!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: お、おお……。
english: O-Oh...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
まったくもってくだらん。
あれで正義の味方を名乗るなど、世も末だな。
english: Utterly ridiculous. To call himself a Hero of Justice like that, the world is truly ending.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: でも凸村さん、よう遊んでくれるで？
english: But Totsumura-san plays with me a lot, you know?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
子供の遊び相手は、正義の味方の仕事ではない。
職務怠慢も甚だしい。
english: Playing with children is not the job of a Hero of Justice. It is an extreme dereliction of duty.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
だが……そんな暇があるということは、
それだけ島が平和だということか。
english: But... the fact that he has that much free time means the island is just that peaceful.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
うん！
今日も平和でええなァ！
english: Yeah! It's nice and peaceful today too!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……そうだな。
english: …Yeah.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（目に見えることがすべてではない。
　これまでの取材を通じて、私はそう実感している）
english: (What you can see isn't everything. Through my research up until now, I've come to realize that.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（のどかに見える農村が、
　実のところギスギスとした監視社会の
　縮図であることも珍しくない）
english: (It's not uncommon for a seemingly idyllic farming village to actually be a microcosm of a strained surveillance society.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（物事には裏と表があり、
　人という存在もその例に漏れない）
english: (Things have a front and a back, and the existence of people is no exception to that.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（しかし……
　この島は見た目通り、本当に安全な場所に思える）
english: (However... This island truly seems like a safe place, just as it appears.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（自分がこの島出身だという贔屓目が、
　そう感じさせるのかと思っていたが……）
english: (I thought it was just my bias of being from this island that made me feel that way, but...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （あの凸村に島の駐在が勤まっている――）
english: (The fact that Totsumura can serve as the island's resident officer--)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（この島がいかに平和であるかは、
　その事実が雄弁に物語ってくれていると
　考えていいだろう）
english: (I suppose you could say that fact speaks volumes about just how peaceful this island is.)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ねえ、ひづるちゃん！
english: Hey, Hizuru-chan!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: どうした？
english: What?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
こんなところでぼーっとしてやんと、
早よ次の場所行こら！
もっともっと案内したいとこあんねん！
english: Don't just space out here, let's hurry to the next place! There are still so many places I want to show you!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ああ……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（ぼーっとしていたわけではないのだが。
　子供には思索にふける時間など
　存在しないのだろうな）
english: (I wasn't just spacing out, though. I suppose children don't have the time to indulge in contemplation.)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ほら、こっちこっち～！
english: C'mon, this way, this way~!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: わかった、わかった。
english: Okay, okay.

japanese: 5.空腹期収縮
english: 5. Hunger Pangs

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ふんふふんふ～ん♪
english: Hmm hm hm hm~♪

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 波稲、次はどこへ向かっているんだ？
english: Haine, where are you headed next?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ナイショや！
着いてからのお楽しみやで！
english: It's a secret! Look forward to it when we get there!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
次の目的地がどこかは知らないが、
私を驚かせようとしても――
english: I don't know where our next destination is, but even if you try to surprise me--

speaker: Haine Minakata
english: Ah…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 今のは、おまえの腹の虫か？
english: Was that the bug in your stomach just now?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
あははははは！
次に行く場所考えてたら、お腹鳴ってもた。
english: Ahahahaha! I was thinking about where to go next and my stomach growled.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（そんなに空腹なのか。
　では、もしや次に向かう場所は……
　さきほど澪に出会ったことを考えると……）
english: (Is she that hungry? Then, could our next destination be... Considering we ran into Mio earlier...)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
お腹って、なんで鳴るんやろ？
中に虫がおるってホンマ？
english: Why do stomachs growl, I wonder? Are there really bugs inside?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いるわけがないだろう。
空腹期収縮だな。
english: Of course there aren't. It's hunger contractions.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
胃壁の収縮によって、胃の内容物が
十二指腸や小腸に押し出される際に
音が生じるとされている。
english: It is said that the sound is produced when the contents of the stomach are pushed out into the duodenum and small intestine by the contraction of the stomach wall.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ふ～ん、ようわからん。
english: Hmm, I don't really get it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
虫ではないと覚えておけ。
今はそれでいい。
english: Just remember that it's not bugs. That's enough for now.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: は～～い。
english: Okaaay.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ひづるちゃんは、お腹空いてやん？
english: Are you hungry, Hizuru-chan?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: いや、別に……。
english: No, not really…

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: あ、また鳴りよった。
english: Ah, it growled again.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
あはははははは！
なにこれ、めっちゃ鳴るやん！
あははははははははっ！
english: Ahahahahaha! What is this, it's growling so much! Ahahahahahahaha!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……何がそんなに面白いのかわからないが、
次の目的地で何か食べれば収まるだろう。
english: ...I don't know what's so funny, but it should settle down if you eat something at our next destination.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: でも私、お金持ってやんで？
english: But I don't have any money on me, you know?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私が出す。
コフネならなにを頼もうが足りるだけの
現金はあるから安心しろ。
english: I'll pay. If it's Kofune, I have enough cash for whatever you order, so don't worry.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
やったー！
ありがと、ひづるちゃん！
english: Yay! Thanks, Hizuru-chan!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
この先、隣で延々とその音を立てられるのは、
かなわないからな……。
english: I wouldn't be able to stand you endlessly making that noise right next to me from here on out...

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
あれっ？
でも、なんで次の目的地が
コフネってわかったん？
english: Huh? But how did you know our next destination was Kofune?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: そんなもの、簡単な推理だ。
english: That's simple deduction.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
かっこええなァ！
ひづるちゃんって、
やっぱりすごいんやね！
english: That's so cool! You really are amazing, Hizuru-chan!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ほら！
私のお腹も驚いてるで！
english: Look! My stomach is surprised too!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
さっきの説明を思い出せ。
それは単なる生理現象だ。
english: Remember my explanation from earlier. That is simply a physiological phenomenon.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: いらっしゃい！
english: Welcome!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: お邪魔しま～す！
english: Excuse me~!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああ、波稲ちゃん。
それに……。
english: Ah, Haine-chan. And...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: アラン、久しぶりだな。
english: Alain, it's been a while.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ひづるやないか！
島に帰ってきとったんか。
english: If it isn't Hizuru! You came back to the island?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ、今日着いたばかりでね。
アランも店も健在なようで、なによりだ。
english: Yes, I just arrived today. I'm glad to see that both you and the restaurant are doing well.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
おかげさんでな。
ひづるも元気そうでよかったわ。
english: Thankfully, yes. I'm glad to see you're looking well too, Hizuru.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
で、今日はなにしとるんや。
波稲ちゃんのお守りか？
english: So, what are you up to today? Babysitting Haine-chan?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 不本意だがそうなってしまった……。
english: Reluctantly, it has come to that...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
波稲、遠慮はいらん。
好きなものを頼んでいいぞ。
english: Haine, no need to hold back. You can order whatever you'd like.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: じゃあパフェ！
english: Then I'll have a parfait!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: それだけで足りるのか？
english: Will that be enough?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
せやな！
ほなパフェ２つや！
english: You're right! Then two parfaits!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ハハハ！
弱った顔やなァ！
english: Hahaha! You look like you're at your wit's end!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……子供とは、あまりにも不可解かつ不確定だ。
どう扱えばいいのか全くわからない。
english: ...Children are far too incomprehensible and unpredictable. I have absolutely no idea how to handle them.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
まあ、そやろなァ。
澪と潮も小さい頃はよう困らされたもんや。
english: Well, I'm sure. Mio and Ushio gave me a lot of trouble when they were little too.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: ひづるも子供持ったらわかるわ。
english: You'll understand once you have kids of your own, Hizuru.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
english: Huh...?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
波稲ちゃんぐらいの娘がおっても
おかしない年になったんや。
ええ人の一人くらいはおるんやろ？
english: You've reached an age where it wouldn't be strange for you to have a daughter around Haine-chan's age. You must have at least one good person in your life, right?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
よ、余計なお世話だ！
早くパフェを出してやってくれ！
english: N-None of your business! Hurry up and serve the parfaits!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: 了解、パフェ２つやな。
english: Understood, two parfaits.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: あ、いや待て２つは多い――
english: Ah, wait, two is too many--

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: やったァ～！
english: Yay~!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
お待たせ。
パフェ２つやったな。
english: Thanks for waiting. Two parfaits, here you go.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
１つは波稲に。
もう１つは私にくれ。
english:
One for Haine.
The other for me.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
あれ？
２つとも食べちゃダメなん？
english: Huh? I can't eat both of them?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
足りなければ追加でなにか頼め。
ただし冷たいものはダメだぞ、
それ以上は腹を冷やす。
english: If it's not enough, order something else. But nothing cold, it'll chill your stomach too much.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
は～～い！
それじゃ、いっただきま～す！
english: Okaaaay! Well then, time to eat~!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ん～！　おいし～！
ひづるちゃんも早よ食べや！
english: Mmm! Delicious~! Hizuru-chan, you eat up too!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私のことは気にするな。
食べることに集中しろ。
english:
Don't worry about me.
Focus on eating.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: は～～い！
english: Okaaaay!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （……これで少しは静かになるだろう）
english: (...This should keep her quiet for a bit.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（島の風景もそうだが……
　この店もずっと変わらないな）
english: (The island's scenery is one thing, but... This restaurant hasn't changed at all either.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （私がまだ十代だった頃のままだ）
english: (It's exactly the same as when I was still in my teens.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（振り返ればそこに、
　あの頃の私や朝子がいるような……
　そんな気さえする）
english: (It almost feels like... if I turn around, Asako and the me from back then will be sitting there...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（時の遡行……。
　実際にそんなことは起こり得ない）
english: (Going back in time... Something like that could never actually happen.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（この世に不変のものなどなく、
　すべては時とともに移ろう定めだ）
english: (There is nothing unchanging in this world, and everything is destined to change with time.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（だが、それ故に――
　過去への回帰は人類普遍の夢でもある）
english: (But, because of that-- Returning to the past is also a universal dream of humanity.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（時の逆行、回帰か……。
　これもテーマとして悪くないな）
english: (Going back in time, returning to the past... This isn't a bad theme either.)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ごちそうさまでした！
english: Thank you for the meal!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ん？
もう食べ終わったのか？
english: Hm? You're already done eating?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
うん、めっちゃおいしかった！
もうお腹いっぱい！
english: Yeah, it was super delicious! I'm so full now!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……それはよかった。
english: …That's good.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（あれだけ腹を鳴らしていたのに、
　パフェだけで満たされるものなのか）
english: (Even though her stomach was growling that much, can a single parfait really satisfy her?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（子供の胃袋の容量とはそんなものだったか……
　自分がどうだったのかなど忘れてしまったな）
english: (Was the capacity of a child's stomach really like that... I've completely forgotten how I used to be.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
アラン、ごちそうさま。
代金はテーブルに置いておく。
english: Alain, thanks for the food. I'll leave the money on the table.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: ああ、次来た時はゆっくり話でもしよら。
english: Yeah, let's take our time and chat next time you come.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そうだな。
じゃあ今日はこれで。
english: Sounds good. Well then, we'll be going now.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: さよ～なら～！
english: Bye~!

japanese: 6.人知れぬ戦士
english: 6. Unseen Warrior

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……。
english: *Pant... pant...*

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（まさか……
　こんな山道まで歩かされるとはな……。
　森は子供の遊び場なのかもしれないが……）
english: (I never imagined... I'd be made to walk all the way up a mountain path like this... The forest might be a playground for children, but...)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ひづるちゃん！
こっちやで、こっち！
english:
Hizuru-chan!
Over here, over here!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
山の中で走るんじゃない。
危険だろう。
english: Don't run in the mountains. It's dangerous.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: だ～いじょ～ぶ！
english: It's fiiiiine!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: なにを根拠に……。
english: Based on what, exactly...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
あと、道はこれで合っているのか？
私はこのあたりの道など詳しくないぞ。
english: Also, is this the right way? I'm not familiar with the paths around here.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
心配いらんで～！
この辺の道は全部覚えとるから～！
english: No need to worry~! I've memorized all the paths around here!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
おい……。
せめて、どこに向かっているのかくらい言え。
砲台跡にでも案内しようというのか？
english: Hey... At least tell me where we're heading. Are you trying to guide me to the gun battery ruins or something?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ううん、違うよ～！
english: Nope, that's not it~!

speaker: ??? (根津)
japanese: おまえらそこで、なにしとる！？
english: What are you two doing there!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
おい、藪に入るんやない！
マムシが出よるぞ！
english: Hey, don't go into the bushes! There are vipers around!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
おった！
根津さんや！
english: Found you! It's Nezu-san!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ああ？
なんや波稲ちゃんか。
english: Ah? Oh, it's just you, Haine-chan.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（根津……というと、確か猟師だな。
　銃を担いでいることからも間違いなさそうだ）
english: (Nezu... if I recall correctly, he's a hunter. The fact that he's carrying a gun seems to confirm it.)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
なにしに来たんや。
この辺りには近づくな言うたやろ。
english: What are you doing here? I told you not to come near this area.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
でも、根津さんに会おと思たら、
ここへ来るしかないやろ？
english: But if I wanted to see you, Nezu-san, I have no choice but to come here, right?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
そない言うてここへ来るんは何度目や？
ええかげんにせェ。
english: How many times have you come here saying that? Give it a rest.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（この猟師……波稲とは知り合いのようだな。
　どこまで顔が広いのだ、この姪は）
english: (This hunter... seems to be acquainted with Haine. Just how wide is this niece of mine's social circle?)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ほれ、これやるさけ帰れ。
english: Here, take this and go home.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: えへへへ～、ありがとう！
english: Hehehe~, thanks!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
見て、ひづるちゃん！
お花の形したキャンディや！
english: Look, Hizuru-chan! It's a candy shaped like a flower!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ご老体……随分と可愛らしい趣味だな。
english: Old man... you have quite a cute hobby.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
フフン……。
飴でもやらんと言うこと聞かんさけ、
持っとるだけや。
english: Hmph... I only carry them because she won't listen unless I give her some candy.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ふむ、波稲のような子供を手懐けるには
有効な手段というわけか。
参考にさせてもらおう。
english: Hmm, so it's an effective method for taming a child like Haine. I'll use that as a reference.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
大人が付いとるんやったら、
ここへ来る前に止めんかい。
この辺りはイノシシもマムシも出よるでよ。
english: If there's an adult with her, you should have stopped her before she came here. There are wild boars and vipers around here.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そうか……。
その話、ここへ来る前に聞かせておいて
ほしかったものだな。
english: Is that so... I really would have liked to hear that before we came here.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ああ、思い出したわ。
english: Ah, I remember.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……なにを？
english: …What?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あんた、ひづる言うたか。
南方んとこの。
english: You said your name was Hizuru? From the Minakata family.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 私を知っているのか？
english: Do you know me?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 狭い島やさけのォ。
english: It's a small island.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: そうか……。
english: I see...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（私が波稲と一緒にいたからだとしても、
　よく南方の人間だとわかったものだ）
english: (Even if it's because I was with Haine, I'm surprised he knew I was from the Minakata family.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（ほとんど顔を合わせたこともなく、
　私は何年も島を離れていたというのに）
english: (We've barely ever met face-to-face, and I've been away from the island for years.)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
仕事の邪魔や。
早よ去ね。
english: You're getting in the way of my work. Hurry up and leave.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （この猟師、なかなか興味深い……）
english: (This hunter is quite interesting…)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: えへへ、狙い通りや。
english: Hehe, just as planned.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……なにがだ？
english: ...What is?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ひづるちゃん、根津さんに興味津々やろ？
連れてきた甲斐あったわ。
english: Hizuru-chan, you're super interested in Nezu-san, right? It was worth bringing you here.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
まさか……この猟師と引き合わせるため、
私をここへ連れてきたのか？
english: Don't tell me... you brought me here to introduce me to this hunter?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: せやで？
english: Yup!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（そうだな……『島の案内』とはいえ、
　島の各地を案内することにこだわる必要はないから）
english: (That's true... even if it's an "island tour", there's no need to be fixated on touring the various locations on the island.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（島の興味深い人物に引き合わせることも、
　島の案内といって差し支えない）
english: (Introducing me to interesting people on the island can also safely be called an island tour.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……我が姪は、なかなかに侮れないようだ。
english: ...It seems my niece is quite a force to be reckoned with.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ああ？
なんの話しとんのや？
english:
Ah?
What are you talking about?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ、気にしないでくれ。
こっちの話だ。
english: Ah, don't worry about it. Just talking to myself.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
それより少し質問させてくれないか。
あなたはなぜ猟師をしているのだ？
english: More importantly, could I ask you a question? Why are you working as a hunter?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
はァ？
そんなもん聞いてどないすんのや。
english: Hah? What are you gonna do with that information?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
質問に深い意味はない。
直感で答えてくれて構わない。
english: There's no deep meaning behind the question. You can just answer based on your intuition.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
早よ去ね言うちゃあるのに、
この女も話聞かんやっちゃで……。
english: Even though I told her to hurry up and leave, this woman won't listen to me either...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
質問に答えてもらえば望みどおりにしよう。
猟師をしている理由は？
english: If you answer my question, I'll do as you wish. What is your reason for being a hunter?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
この島には害獣に困っとる人間が
ようけおるさけな……。
まあ、そんなところやしょ。
english: There are a lot of people on this island who are troubled by pests... Well, that's about it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
なるほど……。
人知れずこの島を守っているのだな。
english: I see... So you're secretly protecting this island.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
フン、そないたいそなもんやない。
気ィ済んだらとっとと去んでくれ。
english: Hmph, it's nothing that grand. If you're satisfied, hurry up and leave.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（人知れず戦う戦士か。
　ありがちだが、これも悪くはないな）
english: (A warrior who fights in secret, huh. It's a common trope, but it's not bad.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（世の中を支える人間というのは、
　得てして日常では目立たぬものだ）
english: (The people who support the world are often those who don't stand out in everyday life.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: しかし猟師というのは、どうも地味だな。
english: However, a hunter seems a bit too plain.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: な、なんや、いきなり！？
english: Wh-What are you saying all of a sudden!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: いや、世界観の設定にもよるか……。
english: No, I suppose it also depends on the setting of the world...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……さっきからなにを言うとんのや。
english: ...What have you been talking about this whole time?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ひづるちゃん、そろそろ次行こか！
バイバイ、根津さん！
english: Hizuru-chan, let's head to the next place soon! Bye-bye, Nezu-san!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 失礼する。
english: Excuse me.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: なんじゃアイツら……？
english: What's with those two...?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: またな～！
english: See you later~!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: もう来んな言うとるやろが！！
english: I told you not to come back here!!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: えへへ、面白かったやろ？
english: Hehe, wasn't it interesting?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: まあな……。
english: I suppose...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ここまで来る労力が
無駄にならなかっただけでも良かった。
english: It's good enough that the effort of coming all the way here wasn't wasted.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: 次はこっちや！
english: Next, this way!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: おい、走るなと言ってるだろ！
english: Hey, I told you not to run!

japanese: 7.光と影
english: 7. Light and Shadow

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
はい、とうちゃーく！
ここで最後だよ！
english: Alright, we're heeeere! This is the last stop!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
最後がコバマートか……。
ここは私もよく知っているが。
english: The final stop is Koba Mart, huh... I'm quite familiar with this place as well.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
営業していないということは、今日は定休日か？
休みではできることもないだろう。
english: It's not open for business, so is today their regular day off? There shouldn't be anything we can do here on their day off.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
あるある！
ここ、友達の家なんよ。
english: There is, there is! This is my friend's house.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 偶然だな、私にとってもここは友人の家だ。
english: What a coincidence, this is a friend's house for me as well.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
あれっ？
ひづるちゃんもしおりちゃんの友達なん？
english: Huh? Are you friends with Shiori-chan too, Hizuru-chan?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いや、違う。
私の友人は……。
english: No, that's not it. My friend is...

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: ……ひづる？
english: …Hizuru?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ、朝子。
久しぶりだな。
english:
Ah, Asako.
It's been a while.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
あ、あんたいつ帰って来たん！？
なんで連絡してくれやんのよ！
english: Wh-When did you get back!? Why didn't you contact me!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
すまない。
それどころではなかった――
english: Sorry. I didn't have the time to--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いや、現在進行形で、
それどころではなくてな。
