english: No, actually, I'm currently in a situation where I don't have the time for that.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: こんにちは～！
english: Hello~!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
こんにちは、波稲ちゃん！
ひづると一緒に来たん？
english:
Hello, Haine-chan!
You came with Hizuru?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
うん！
ひづるちゃんに島ん中を
案内したってるんよ。
english: Yeah! I'm guiding Hizuru-chan around the island.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: え、島の中を？
english: Huh, around the island?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
深い意味はない……。
竜之介に姪の世話を押しつけられたのだ。
english: There's no deep meaning behind it... Ryunosuke forced me to take care of my niece.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: あはは、そういうことなんか。
english: Ahaha, so that's what it is.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: しおりちゃん、いますか～？
english: Is Shiori-chan here~?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
うん、ウチにおるから遊んだってくれる！
ひづるもウチ寄ってきや！
english: Yeah, she's inside, so go ahead and play with her! Hizuru, you come inside too!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ああ、じゃあ少しだけ。
english: Alright, just for a bit then.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
なんもなくてごめんな。
はい、お茶。
english: Sorry we don't have much to offer. Here, some tea.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ああ、ありがとう。
english: Ah, thanks.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: で、どないしたん？
english: So, what's up?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
は？
なんだ、急に。
english: Huh? What is it, so suddenly.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: 何か元気なさそうやけど。
english: You don't seem very energetic, though.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……慣れない子供の相手で疲れただけだ。
english: ...I'm just tired from dealing with a child when I'm not used to it.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
子供言うても相手は波稲ちゃんやろ？
あの子やったら、
そない手ェかからんと思うけどなァ。
english: Even if you say a child, you're dealing with Haine-chan, right? If it's that girl, I don't think she'd be that much of a handful.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（他の子ならこれ以上なのか？
　信じられん……）
english: (If it were another child, it would be even worse than this? Unbelievable...)

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: なあ、ひづる……。
english: Hey, Hizuru…

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
ホンマは疲れてるだけちゃうやろ？
ほら、素直に言うてみ？
english: You're not really just tired, are you? Come on, tell me honestly.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
友達なめたらアカンで？
しばらく会ってやんでも、それくらいわかるわ。
english: Don't underestimate your friends, okay? Even if we haven't seen each other in a while, I can tell that much.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
でも無理に聞こうとは思わへん。
相談したなったら、いつでも言うてや。
english: But I won't force you to tell me. If you ever want to talk about it, just let me know anytime.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: だから……疲れただけだと言ってるだろ。
english: Like I said... I'm just tired.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
ふふっ……はいはい！
強情なとこは全然変わってやんなァ！
english: Hehe... Yeah, yeah! Your stubbornness hasn't changed a bit!

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese:
あははっ！
待て待て～～！
english: Ahaha! Wait, wait~~!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
へっへ～ん！
絶対捕まらへんで～～！
english: Hehe~n! You'll never catch me~~!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
コラッ！　走り回るんやない！
転んでまうで！
english: Hey! Don't run around! You're gonna fall!

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese: は～～い！
english: Okaaaay!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: も～、返事だけはええんよ。
english: Jeez, her replies are the only good thing about her.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: あの子が朝子の娘か。
english: Is that child your daughter, Asako?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
うん、しおり。
ごめんなァ、うちの子えらいうるそうて。
english: Yeah, Shiori. Sorry, my kid's so loud.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
問題ない。
朝子も昔は結構なものだった。
english: It's not a problem. You were quite something in the past too, Asako.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
む、昔って学生の頃の話！？
私あんなうるさかったか！？
english: B-By the past, you mean when we were students!? Was I really that loud!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: いや、今も健在なようだ。
english: No, it seems you're still going strong.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
あはははははは！
一本取られてもうたわ！
english: Ahahahahahaha! You got me there!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
でも子供ができたら、
どこの親もこんなもんやで？
english: But once you have a kid, any parent becomes like this, you know?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: そういうものなのか？
english: Is that how it is?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
そうそう、そういうもんや。
ひづるは子供欲しないの？
english: Yeah, yeah, that's how it is. Don't you want kids, Hizuru?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そもそも相手がいない。
ヒトに単為生殖は無理だ。
english: I don't even have a partner in the first place. Parthenogenesis is impossible for humans.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: たんいせいしょく？
english: Parthenogenesis?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
今は自分の家族を作るなど、
興味もなければ想像もできん。
english: Right now, I have neither the interest nor the imagination to create my own family.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
だが小説のテーマとしては普遍的な題材だ。
そういう意味なら興味はあるがな。
english: But as a theme for a novel, it's a universal subject. I have an interest in it in that sense, though.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（家族……家庭……
　親……子供……親子……）
english: (Family... Household... Parents... Children... Parent and child...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（家族、親と子か……。
　なにかのヒントになるかもしれんが、
　私の知識だけでは情報不足だ）
english: (Family, parent and child... It might be a hint for something, but my knowledge alone isn't enough information.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 朝子、子供とは何だ？
english: Asako, what is a child?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
出た！
唐突な質問！
english: There it is! A sudden question!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
ひづるが島におった頃は、
ようそんな風に唐突な質問ぶつけられて
困ったもんや。
english: Back when you were on the island, Hizuru, I used to get hit with sudden questions like that all the time and it was really troublesome.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: そうだったのか？
english: Was that so?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
知的探究心？
そういうのが強いんやろな。
english: Intellectual curiosity? I guess you just have a lot of that.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
ホンマ、ひづるは昔のまんまや。
まだまだ健在で安心したわ。
english: Really, you're exactly the same as you used to be, Hizuru. I'm relieved to see you're still going strong.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
よくわからん感心はいいから、
さっきの質問に答えてくれ。
english: Enough with the incomprehensible admiration, just answer my question from before.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
ん～、そやなァ……。
子供は私にとって……。
english: Hmm, let's see... To me, a child is...

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: ……光、かな。
english: …Light, I guess.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
english: Light…?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
そう、光や。
すべてを明るく照らす光。
english: Yeah, light. A light that brightly illuminates everything.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: しおりがおるだけで、毎日が明るなるんよ。
english: Just having Shiori around makes every day brighter.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
家の中の雰囲気、家族全員の気持ちや表情、
なんもかんも明るくしてくれるねん。
english: The atmosphere in the house, the feelings and expressions of the whole family, she brightens everything up.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ふむ……。
english: Hmm...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: では子供が光だとすると、おまえたち親はなんだ？
english: Then if the child is the light, what are you parents?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
子供が光やったら親は影……なんかな？
ほら、光に影はつきもんやしな。
english: If the child is the light, then the parent is the shadow... I guess? You know, shadows always accompany light.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
寄り添う影、離れて見守る影、
いろんな形で子供を支え続けるのが
世の親なんやと思う。
english: A shadow that stays close, a shadow that watches from afar, I think parents in this world are the ones who continue to support their children in various forms.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
でもな、もし子供が光を失ってしもたときは、
親が光になって子を照らすねん。
english: But you know, if a child ever loses their light, then the parent becomes the light and illuminates the child.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
そんな風に影響しあって……
親子は成長していくんとちゃうかな。
english: By influencing each other like that... I think that's how parents and children grow together.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
なるほど……影と光は表裏一体で、
その形はひとつではない、か。
english: I see... Light and shadow are two sides of the same coin, and their forms are not singular, huh.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: 少しは役に立った？
english: Was that helpful at all?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: ひづる？
english: Hizuru?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （光と影……子と親……）
english: (Light and shadow... child and parent...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（光であった子も、
　いつかは親になり影となる……）
english: (The child who was the light will also one day become a parent and a shadow...)

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: アカン、自分の世界入ってもた。
english: Oh boy, she's entered her own world.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（照らし方ひとつ変えれば、
　光は様々な大きさと形の影を生み出す……）
english: (If you change the way it's illuminated even slightly, the light will create shadows of various sizes and shapes...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（光……影……。
　そもそも今の私はどちらなのだ？）
english: (Light... Shadow... Which one am I right now, anyway?)

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
ちょっと、ひづる！
ひ～づ～るッ！！
english: Hey, Hizuru! Hi~zu~ru!!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ひづるちゃん、そろそろ帰ろや！
english: Hizuru-chan, it's time to go!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
あんた大丈夫？
何か昔よりこじらせてへん？
english: Are you okay? Haven't you gotten more complicated than before?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 気にするな……。
english: Don't worry about it...

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: おじゃましましたー！
english: Thanks for having us!

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese: バイバ～イ！
english: Bye-bye~!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: 二人とも、またおいでなー。
english: Come again, you two.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: は～～い！
english: Okaaaay!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ハァ……。
english: *Sigh*...

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ひづるちゃんのお友達って、
しおりちゃんのママやったんやね。
english: So your friend was Shiori-chan's mom, Hizuru-chan.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: そういうことだな……。
english: That's right...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（子と親……光と影……
　ヒントになりそうな言葉は得たが……）
english: (Child and parent... Light and shadow... I got some words that might be a hint, but...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （まだスランプ脱出には遠そうだな……）
english: (It still seems like I'm far from breaking out of this slump...)

japanese: 8.露天風呂
english: 8. Open-Air Bath

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
english: Phew~...

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
んん～、極楽じょ～。
やっぱ広いお風呂はええなぁ。
english: Mmm~, this is paradise~. A big bath really is great, huh.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: なぁ～、ひづるちゃん？
english: Hey~, Hizuru-chan?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……広い風呂がいいことには同意するが。
english: ...I agree that a large bath is nice, but.

speaker: Haine Minakata
english: Hmmm~~...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
なぜキミまでここにいる。
ここは、私の宿泊先の露天風呂だぞ。
english: Why are you here too? This is the open-air bath at my accommodation, you know.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
大丈夫！
旅館の人、入ってええって
言うてくれたし！
english: It's fine! The people at the inn told me I could come in!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 質問に答えていないぞ……。
english: You didn't answer my question...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（まあ、その点は私も驚いた。
　波稲の顔の広さには本当に感心する）
english: (Well, I was surprised by that point too. I'm truly impressed by how wide Haine's social circle is.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（ついでに言えば、この島の平和さも改めて感じるな。
　セキュリティという点では失格も失格だが）
english: (On a related note, it makes me feel the peacefulness of this island anew. Although it's a complete failure from a security standpoint.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
先ほどのコバマートで、キミの案内は終わったはず。
風呂なら家に帰って入ればいい。
english: Your guiding should have ended at Koba Mart earlier. If you want a bath, you can just go home and take one.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
だって、ひづるちゃんと一緒に
入りたかったんやも～ん。
english: Because I wanted to take a bath with you, Hizuru-chan~.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
こんな広いお風呂、
みんなで入った方が楽しいやろ～？
english: Taking a bath this big is more fun with everyone, right~?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミはそうかもしれないが、
私は一人で思索にふける方が好ましい。
その方がアイディアもまとまるというものだ。
english: That might be the case for you, but I prefer to be alone and lost in thought. That way, my ideas come together better.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
アイデアって、
ひづるちゃんが書いてるお話の？
english: Ideas? Like for the stories you write, Hizuru-chan?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ、そうだ。
だから少し静かにしていてくれ。
english:
Yeah, that's right.
So please be quiet for a bit.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: は～～い。
english: Okaaaay.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
english: Phew~...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（予定とは少し違ったが、
　今日は島のあちこちを巡り
　様々な人々と言葉を交わした）
english: (It was a little different from my plans, but today I went all around the island and exchanged words with various people.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（そしてそれらの経験はすべて
　『情報』として私の脳にインプットされた）
english: (And all of those experiences have been inputted into my brain as "information".)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（そうした情報は執筆活動の助けとなるが、
　すべてが常に有用であるわけではない）
english: (That kind of information is helpful for my writing activities, but not all of it is always useful.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （個々の情報には、それぞれ独特の味がある）
english: (Each piece of information has its own unique flavor)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（あの正義の味方のようなボケた味もあれば、
　不愛想な猟師のように野趣あふれる美味もある）
english: (There are bland flavors like that Hero of Justice, and there are also rustic, delicious flavors like that unfriendly hunter.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（そうした様々な味をブレンドし、
　新たな味を作り出す――）
english: (Blending those various flavors together to create a new flavor--)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （それが我々小説家の生業であり醍醐味なのだ）
english: (That is the livelihood and the true thrill of us novelists.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（だが最近はアウトプットばかりで、
　新たな情報のインプット――
　探求心を疎かにしすぎていたのかもしれん）
english: (But lately I've been doing nothing but outputting, and perhaps I've been neglecting the input of new information-- my spirit of inquiry, far too much.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （ああ、そうか……）
english: (Ah, I see…)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（要するに私が置かれている今の状況は、
　自業自得だったということか）
english: (In short, the situation I'm currently in was brought upon myself, I suppose.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （今さら、こんなことに気づかされるとはな）
english: (To think I'd be made to realize this now.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（認めたくはないが……
　私一人では、この理解に至らなかっただろう）
english: (I don't want to admit it, but... I probably wouldn't have come to this realization on my own.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……波稲に感謝しなければならないな。
english: ...I have to thank Haine.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: 何か言うた？
english: Did you say something?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
なんでもない。
キミは黙って浸かっていろ。
english: It's nothing. You just stay quiet and soak.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: は～～い。
english: Okaaaay.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
スマホ鳴っちゃあるで？
出んでええの？
english: Your smartphone is ringing, you know? Aren't you going to answer it?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
構わんよ。
編集からの進捗確認だ。
english: It's fine. It's a progress check from my editor.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: へんしゅう……？
english: Editor…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 要するに、私の書いたものを本にする係の者だ。
english: In short, they are the person in charge of turning what I write into a book.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: それやったら出た方がようない？
english: If that's the case, shouldn't you answer it?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
不用意な横やりで作家の思索を中断させるなど、
編集として無能の極み。
english: Interrupting a writer's thoughts with a careless interruption is the height of incompetence as an editor.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いちいち構ってやる必要などない。
放っておけばすぐ諦める。
english: There's no need to pay attention to them every single time. If I ignore them, they'll give up soon enough.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……ほらな。
english: ...See?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: ふ～ん、なんやようわからんけど――
english: Hmm, I don't really get it, but--

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: 今のひづるちゃんの顔、ちょっと怖いわ。
english: Your face right now is a little scary, Hizuru-chan.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 怖い？
english: Scary?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ひづるちゃんて、
いろんなお話書いてる人なんやろ？
そない難しい顔しやんとアカンもんなん？
english: Hizuru-chan, you're someone who writes all sorts of stories, right? Do you really have to make such a difficult face?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
私、やりたいことようけあるけど、
いつかホンマにやれた時のこと考えたら
ワクワクしてニヤけてまうで？
english: I have a lot of things I want to do, but when I think about actually being able to do them someday, I get so excited I can't help but grin, you know?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そうかもしれない……。
いや、私もそうだったはずだ。
english: That might be true... No, I should have been like that too.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （波稲の言う通りだ……）
english: (Haine is right...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （自分すら楽しめない作品に、なんの価値もない）
english: (A work that not even I can enjoy has no value whatsoever.)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
どうせやったら、
楽しんでやった方がええと思うで！
english: If you're going to do it anyway, I think it's better to enjoy doing it!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: どうせなら楽しんで、か。
english: Enjoy it if I'm going to do it anyway, huh.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（思えば久しく……
　そんな感情を抱いたことはなかったかもしれんな）
english: (Come to think of it, it's been a long time... since I've felt that kind of emotion, perhaps.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （特に仕事においては……）
english: (Especially when it comes to work…)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
見てみ、ひづるちゃん。
今日は晴れとって星がよう見えるわ。
english: Look, Hizuru-chan. It's clear today, so you can see the stars really well.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ああ……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
私、星見るん大好きや。
ぼーっと見ちゃあるだけでも楽しいもん。
english: I love looking at the stars. Just spacing out and looking at them is fun.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（日都ヶ島の夜空は、
　こんなにも美しかったのか……）
english: (Was the night sky of Hitogashima really this beautiful...?)

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
えへへ、今のひづるちゃん、
めっちゃええ表情してるで？
english: Hehe, you have a really nice expression on your face right now, Hizuru-chan.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そうか？
いや……。
english: Do I? No...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 波稲が言うなら、そうなんだろうな。
english: If you say so, Haine, then I suppose it is.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（いい機会だ……。
　しばらくはなにも考えないでいよう）
english: (It's a good opportunity... I won't think about anything for a while.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（なにも考えず……
　ただぼんやりと時の流れを感じる……）
english: (Without thinking about anything... Just vaguely feeling the flow of time...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （本来ならば無駄でしかないはずだが……）
english: (Normally this would just be a waste of time, but...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（これはこれで、
　とても贅沢な時間であるのかもしれないな）
english: (This might actually be a very luxurious way to spend time.)

japanese: 9.サマータイムレンダ
english: 9. Summer Time Rendering

japanese: 7月24日
english: July 24

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（翌々日。
　日都ヶ島の一大行事である、日都夏祭りが行われる日だ）
english: (Two days later. It's the day of Hitogashima's biggest event, the Hitogashima Summer Festival.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（島には観光客が押し寄せる。
　私が宿泊する旅館にも、泊まりで楽しもうという
　連中がやってきて騒がしいことこの上ない）
english: (Tourists are flocking to the island. People looking to stay over and have fun are pouring into the inn where I'm staying too, making it noisy beyond belief.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（仕方ない……。
　ここは別の場所にいくとしよう）
english: (It can't be helped... I suppose I'll go somewhere else.)

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: いらっしゃい！
english: Welcome!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: やあ、アラン。
english: Hey, Alain.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
おお、ひづるか。
また来てくれたんやな。
english: Oh, Hizuru. You came back again, huh.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese: あっ、ひづる～！
english: Ah, Hizuru~!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
朝子？
コバマートはどうした。
ここで働いているのか？
english: Asako? What about Koba Mart. Are you working here?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
ちゃうちゃう。
しおりとお昼食べに来てるだけや。
english: No, no. I just came to have lunch with Shiori.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese: お姉ちゃん、来たんか。
english: Sis, you're here.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
竜之介までいたのか。
おまえも昼食を？
english: Even Ryunosuke is here. Are you having lunch too?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
ああ。
コフネのランチは美味しいからな。
english:
Yeah.
Kofune's lunch is delicious.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: はは、ありがたい言葉やで。
english: Haha, those are kind words.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
お姉ちゃん、結局ウチに来んかったけど、
今までずっと宿におったん？
english: Sis, you didn't come to our place after all. Have you been staying at the inn this whole time?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ、久しぶりにリラックスした。
良い休息が取れたよ。
english: Yeah, I relaxed for the first time in a while. I got some good rest.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese: ああ、それでか。
english: Ah, so that's why.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
お姉ちゃん、なんか雰囲気変わったで。
まるで憑き物が落ちたみたいや。
english: Sis, your atmosphere seems to have changed. It's like a weight has been lifted off your shoulders.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
憑き物……か。
確かにそうかもしれないな。
english: A weight off my shoulders... huh. That might certainly be the case.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
こんなになにも考えずに過ごしたのは、
本当に久しぶりだよ。
何年ぶりだろうか。
english: It's been a really long time since I spent time without thinking about anything like this. I wonder how many years it's been.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
ええ！？
なんも考えやんで過ごしたて……
ひづるでも、やればできるんやな。
english: What!? Spending time without thinking about anything... Even you can do it if you try, Hizuru.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: まあ、自分でも意外だったよ。
english: Well, it was a surprise even to me.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: あ、ひづるちゃん！
english: Ah, Hizuru-chan!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
やあ、波稲。
一昨日は世話になったな。
english: Hey, Haine. Thanks for your help the day before yesterday.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese: うん、世話したったで！
english: Yup, I sure did take care of you!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
こらこら、波稲。
そんな言い方したらアカンやろ。
english: Hey now, Haine. You shouldn't talk like that.

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese:
波稲ちゃん！
なんか、おかしなってもうた！
画面がペカペカしとる！
english: Haine-chan! Something went weird! The screen is flashing!

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
え？　そうなん？
貸してみ？
english: Huh? Really? Let me see?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
ちょ、ちょっと波稲！
お父さんのタブレット壊さんでや！？
english: H-Hey, wait a sec, Haine! Don't break your dad's tablet, okay!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……賑やかだな。
english: ...It's lively.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
ごめんな、アランさん。
騒いでしもて。
english: Sorry, Alain-san. For making a racket.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
この時間ならかまへんよ。
ランチも終わって、
店も落ち着いとるからな。
english: It's fine at this time. Lunch is over, and the restaurant has calmed down.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ひづるはどないする？
腹が減ってるんやったら、
何か用意するで？
english: What are you going to do, Hizuru? If you're hungry, I can whip something up for you?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: いや、コーヒーだけでいいよ。
english: No, just coffee is fine.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
はいよォ。
すぐ用意しちゃるわ。
english: Sure thing. I'll get that ready right away.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
休暇楽しんでる？
新作の取材も兼ねてるって聞いたけど、
順調なん？
english: Are you enjoying your vacation? I heard you're also doing research for your new work, is it going well?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
さあ、どうなんだろうな。
正直まだ次回作の構想は、
なにも固まっちゃいないが……。
english: Well, I wonder. Honestly, I haven't solidified any concepts for my next work yet, but...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: まぁ、なんとかなるさ。
english: Well, it'll work out somehow.

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese: ママ～、ちょっとこれ見て～。
english: Mama~, look at this for a sec~.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
はいはい。
それじゃひづる、また後でな。
english: Yes, yes. Well then, Hizuru, see you later.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ああ。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: お待たせ、コーヒー置いとくで。
english: Sorry for the wait, I'll just set your coffee down here.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ああ、ありがとう。
english: Ah, thank you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
アラン、そろそろ夕方の仕込みやろ。
手伝うで。
english: Alain, it's about time to start prepping for the evening, right. I'll help out.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
そら、ありがたいけど……
もう少し休んどってもええんやで？
ランチ混んどったし疲れたやろ。
english: Well, I appreciate that, but... It's fine if you rest a bit more, you know? Lunch was crowded, so you must be tired.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
でも今夜は祭りやろ？
忙しくなるやろから、
早めに動いとった方がええ思てな。
english: But tonight is the festival, right? It's going to get busy, so I thought it'd be better to get moving early.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
なるほど。
確かにそうかもしれやんな。
english: I see. That might certainly be true.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
……あっ！
な、南雲先生ッ！？
english: ...Ah! N-Nagumo-sensei!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キミは、あの時の……。
english: You're the boy from that time...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: まったく、あの時は驚いたよ。
english: Good grief, you really surprised me back then.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 本当にすみませんでしたッ！
english: I'm truly sorry about that!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あ、あの、決してわざとではないんです！
ちょっと変な夢を見ていたみたいで！！
english: U-Um, it definitely wasn't on purpose! It seems I was having a bit of a weird dream!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ、そちらは別にいい。
私が驚いたのは、見ず知らずの少年に
素性を言い当てられたことだ。
english: Ah, I don't mind about that. What surprised me was having my identity guessed by a boy I've never met.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: Huh…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いい機会だ。
なぜキミが私の正体を知っていたのか説明してくれ。
english: This is a good opportunity. Explain to me why you knew my true identity.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私のプロフィールは全て非公開だ。
なのに、キミはなぜ一目見て
私が『南雲竜之介』だと判断できたのだ？
english: My profile is completely private. And yet, how were you able to determine that I was "Ryunosuke Nagumo" with just one glance?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
それが……その……
なんて言い表せばいいのか、
オレにもよくわからないんですけど……。
english: Well... um... I don't really know how to express it myself, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
オレは夢の中で……
その事実を知った気がするんです。
english: I feel like I learned that fact... in my dream.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 夢の中、だと……？
english: In a dream…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
うう……。
あの、これでも、ふざけたりは
してないんですけど……。
english: Ugh... Um, I'm really not messing around or anything...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 普通じゃ無いな……。
english: That's certainly not normal...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ですよね！　すみません。
english: Right! I'm sorry.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: その話、実に興味深い。
english: That story is truly fascinating.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: へ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: さあ、詳しく聞かせたまえ！
english: Come now, tell me in detail!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……なるほど。
キミはフェリーの中で
現実感をともなう不思議な夢を見た。
english: ...I see. You had a strange dream accompanied by a sense of reality while on the ferry.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そして、どうやらそれと同じ夢を
幼なじみの少女、小舟潮も見ていたらしい――
そういうことか。
english: And apparently, your childhood friend, Ushio Kofune, had the exact same dream-- Is that right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
はい。
夢の中の記憶はもうおぼろげなんですが。
english: Yes. Although the memories from the dream are already hazy.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
断片的に思い出せる内容は、
とても夢だったとは思えないような……。
english: The contents I can remember in fragments don't seem like they could possibly be a dream...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: で、その夢の中で私の正体を知ったと？
english: And you learned my true identity in that dream?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
もしかしたらそうかもって……。
具体的な内容は、オレも潮も
思い出せやんのですけど……。
english: I think that might be the case... Neither Ushio nor I can remember the specific details, though...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 予知夢か……それとも、記憶……。
english: A prophetic dream... or perhaps, a memory...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 並行世界の記憶――
english: Memories of a parallel world--

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
波稲！
そろそろお父さんのタブレット
返してくれやん？
english: Haine! Can you give Papa's tablet back soon?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
もうちょっとだけ！
今、しおりちゃんと写真撮ってんねん。
english: Just a little bit longer! I'm taking pictures with Shiori-chan right now.

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese: ママも一緒に撮ろ～！
english: Let's take a picture together too, Mama~!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
ええよ。
ほな竜くんも入ったら？
english: Sure. Then why don't you get in too, Ryu-kun?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
どうやろ？
自撮りでこの人数は入りきらんかも。
english: I wonder? It might be hard to fit this many people in a selfie.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
どうした？
気になるかね？
english: What's wrong? Does it bother you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: いや……波稲って……。
english: No... that girl Haine...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 私の弟、竜之介の娘だが。
english: She is the daughter of my younger brother, Ryunosuke.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: よかったなって……。
english: I'm glad...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: よかった？
english: Glad?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
変ですよね……。
なんでそう思うんやろう……。
english: It's strange... I wonder why I feel that way...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
さあな。
私には、キミが適当なことを
言ってるようには見えないが……。
english: Who knows. It doesn't look to me like you're just saying random things, but...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 聞く者によっては不審な発言だ。
english: Depending on who's listening, it's a suspicious statement.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あはは……。
まあ、そうですよね。
english: Ahaha... Well, I guess so.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
お姉ちゃん。
あんま慎平をいじめやんといてよ。
english: Sis. Don't bully Shinpei too much.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
慎平は『南雲竜之介』の大ファンやねん。
正体バレてもおかしないて！
english: Shinpei is a huge fan of "Ryunosuke Nagumo". It's not strange that your true identity was exposed!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私は覆面作家だ！
どこにも顔を出してないんだぞ……。
デタラメな演繹法で口を挟むなボケ！！
english: I am a masked author! I haven't shown my face anywhere... Don't butt in with your nonsensical deductions, you idiot!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
ごめんなァ？
お姉ちゃん、今、新作の準備で
ピリピリしてるんよ。
english: Sorry about that, okay? Sis is really on edge right now preparing for her new work.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: あァ！？
english: Hah!?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
でもこう見えてな、
ファン目の前にして喜んでんねん！
english: But despite how she seems, she's happy to meet a fan!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: なっ……何を！
english: Wh... What are you saying!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 新作って……今書いてるんですかっ！？
english: A new work... are you writing it right now!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……まァな。
english: ...Well, yes.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
えっ、スゴイ……！
聖シリーズですか！？
それとも別の……。
english: Wow, that's amazing...! Is it the Saint series!? Or something else...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キ……キミに言うわけないだろ！
english: L-Like I would tell you!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: しかし、まあ……。
english: However, well...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
取材と休養をかねた和歌山だったが、
キミの話は思わぬ収穫だよ。
english: I came to Wakayama for both research and rest, but your story was an unexpected harvest.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: さっきの話、もっと詳しく聞かせたまえ。
english: Let me hear more details about that story from earlier.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: は、はい！
english: Y-Yes!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ふむ……なるほどな……。
english: Hmm... I see...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
多数の並行世界とその記憶……。
うん、悪くない。
english: Numerous parallel worlds and the memories of them... Yes, not bad.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: だが、それだけではまだ弱い。
english: But, that alone is still weak.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
使い古された題材ではあるからな……。
なにかもっと……もっと新しい切り口があれば……！
english: It is a well-worn subject, after all... If only there was something more... a newer angle...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: なにか……ですか？
english: Something...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そうだ。
この話をより色鮮やかに際立たせる要素が欲しい。
もう一押しなんだが……。
english: Exactly. I want an element that will make this story stand out more vividly. Just one more push, but...

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese:
このお姉ちゃん、
なんでむずかしい顔してるん？
english: Why is this lady making such a difficult face?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ひづるちゃん、
今頑張って面白いお話作ってるとこなんよ。
english: Hizuru-chan is working hard to create an interesting story right now.

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese:
お話？
ふ～ん……。
english: A story? Hmm...

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese: それやったらこの島のこと、お話にしてほしいなァ。
english: If that's the case, I want her to write a story about this island.

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
あ、それええな！
なあ、ひづるちゃん聞いた！？
english: Ah, that's a great idea! Hey, Hizuru-chan, did you hear that!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……なにをだ？
english: ...Hear what?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
どうせお話書くんやったら、
この島の話にしたらええやん！
あんなにいっぱい島の情報集めたしな！
english: If you're going to write a story anyway, why not make it about this island! You gathered so much information about the island, too!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 島の情報――
english: Information about the island--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 不確定で不可解、ゆえに新しい視点を示す存在……。
english: Uncertain and incomprehensible, and therefore an existence that shows a new perspective...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 親友……裏切り……。
english: Best friends... Betrayal...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 空腹……時の遡行……。
english: Hunger... Going back in time...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 人知れず戦う戦士……。
english: A warrior who fights in secret...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 子と親……光と影……。
english: Child and parent... Light and shadow...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: そして……網代少年の記憶。
english: And... the Ajiro boy's memories.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ちょっと失礼……。
english: Excuse me for a moment…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: さ、逆立ち……。
english: A-A handstand...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 繋がったッ！！！！
english: It's connected!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: うわッ！？
english: Whoa!?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa
japanese:
な、なんやの？
いきなり声張り上げて……。
english: Wh-What is it? Raising your voice all of a sudden...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 繋がった……すべて繋がったぞ。
english: It's connected... everything is connected.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: おもしろいアイディア……閃いたかも……。
english: I might have... come up with an interesting idea...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 来たぞ、来たぞ、来たぞ！！
english: Here it comes! Here it comes! Here it comes!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
フハハハハ、降りて来た！！
私の勝利だ！！
english: Fuhahaha, it has descended upon me!! This is my victory!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: せ、先生？
english: S-Sensei?

speaker: Haine Minakata
japanese:
ひづるちゃん、めっちゃ楽しそう！
ニッコニコや！
english: Hizuru-chan looks like she's having so much fun! She's grinning from ear to ear!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
フフ……ウフフッ！
もはや手が止まらん！
english: Fufu... Ufufu! My hands won't stop anymore!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
フハハハハハハハ！
いいぞ、いいぞ！
いける！　これはいける！
english: Fuhahahahahahaha! This is good, this is good! I can do this! This will work!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata (Adult)
japanese:
お姉ちゃんのスイッチが入ったみたいや。
こうなったら、もう止まらへんで。
english: It looks like Sis's switch has been flipped. Once she gets like this, there's no stopping her.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: じゃあ新作、できそうなんですか！？
english: Then, you'll be able to write your new work!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ああ、そうとも！
english: Yes, indeed!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミはこの作品を生み出すきっかけを
与えてくれた恩人だ！
タイトルくらいは教えておいてやる！
english: You are the benefactor who gave me the catalyst to create this work! I will at least tell you the title!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ちょうどこの作品にピッタリのタイトルが
思い浮かんだところだ！
english: I just thought of the perfect title for this work!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ぜ、ぜひッ！！
english: B-By all means!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
よく聞きたまえ！
次回作のタイトルは！
english: Listen well! The title of my next work is!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 『サマータイムレンダ』だ！
english: "Summer Time Rendering"!

speaker: 一同（一同Ｂ）
english: Ooooh~~~!!

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese:
キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_EPILOGIE_HDR>ｅｐｉｌｏｇｕｅ：南方ひづる</color>】を
入手しました。
english: Key TIPS [<color=#GF_KEY_EPILOGIE_HDR>epilogue: Hizuru Minakata</color>] obtained.

japanese: 1.かおりとの再会
english: 1. Reunion with Kaori

japanese: 7月22日
english: July 22

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ごめんよ。
勝手に東京、出てったりして……。
english: I'm sorry. For leaving for Tokyo all on my own...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
私こそ……ごめん。
見送り行かんくて……。
english: I'm the one... who should be sorry. For not going to see you off...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
な、なんでこんな泣けてくるんやろ……？
こんなつもりやなかったのに……。
english: Wh-Why am I crying so much...? I didn't intend to...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
最近見た夢のせいやわ……！
慎平に二度と会えやんようになる夢。
english: It's because of a dream I had recently...! A dream where I wouldn't be able to see you ever again, Shinpei.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ヘンな夢やったなァ……。
english: That was a weird dream...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（オレも同じ夢を見ていたような気がする……
　でも、そんなことってあるのか？）
english: (I feel like I had the same dream... But could something like that really happen?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そこまでー。
english: That's enough of that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃん、慎ちゃんのことなぐるん違たん？
english: Sis, weren't you going to hit Shin-chan?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: そっ、そやかて……！！
english: Th-That's because...!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
……素直に帰ってきよったからな。
今回だけは勘弁したるわ。
english: ...Because he came back obediently. I'll let him off the hook just this once.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ホンマに今回だけなん？
実は慎ちゃんに会えて嬉しいんやろ？
english: Is it really just this once? You're actually happy to see Shin-chan, aren't you?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なっ……なに言うてるん！？
変なこと言わんといて。
english: Wh... What are you talking about!? Don't say weird things.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ああ～、なんや急にお腹すいてきたわ。
先帰ってるで！
english: Ah~, I suddenly got hungry. I'm heading back first!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ――って、おい！
english: --Hey, wait!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ハァ、素直やないなァ……。
english: Hah, she's not honest at all...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: オレたちも戻ろか。
english: Should we head back too?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: せやね……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それはそうと慎ちゃん、
めっちゃ標準語やな。
english: By the way, Shin-chan, you sound like a real Tokyo boy!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えっ、オレが？
english: Huh, me?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 向こうに染まってもたんやね。
english: You've been totally influenced by over there, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
染まったって……
そんなつもりはないけど。
english: Influenced... I didn't mean to be, though.

speaker: Chamber Member
japanese:
お～、慎平くん。
帰ってきとったんやな。
english: Oh~, Shinpei-kun. You're back, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あ、どうも。
english: Ah, hello.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（島の商工会の人だ。
　一緒にいる女の子は……誰なんだろ？）
english: (He's from the island's Chamber of Commerce. The girl with him... who is she?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（島の住人ってことはなさそうだ。
　観光客だろうか？）
english: (She doesn't seem to be an island resident. Is she a tourist?)

speaker: Chamber Member
japanese: 澪ちゃんも慎平くんとは久しぶりやいしょ。
english: It's been a while for you too, Mio-chan, hasn't it.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ええ、そうですね。
english: Yes, that's right.

speaker: Chamber Member
japanese:
慎平くん、いつまでこっちにおれるん？
よかったら商工会にも顔出してな。
english: Shinpei-kun, how long will you be here? If you'd like, show your face at the Chamber of Commerce.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そうですね、時間があったら……。
english: Right, if I have time...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あの……。
もしかして……網代くん？
english:
Um…
Could it be… Ajiro-kun?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: Huh…?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: この人……誰なん？
english: Who... is this person?

speaker: Chamber Member
japanese:
なんや慎平くん、
彼女と知り合いやったんか？
english: What's this, Shinpei-kun, were you acquainted with her?

speaker: Chamber Member
japanese:
慎平くんも隅に置けやんよォ。
現役のアイドルと知り合いやなんて。
english: You're quite something, Shinpei-kun. To be acquainted with an active idol.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: アイドル！？
english: An idol!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、いえ、違うんです！
知り合いとかじゃ無くて！
english: Ah, no, that's not it! We're not acquaintances or anything!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くん、その……覚えてないかな？
小学校で同級生だったんだけど……。
english: Ajiro-kun, um... do you not remember? We were classmates in elementary school...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （小学校で同級生だった……）
english: (We were classmates in elementary school...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、あの、ジッと見られるのは、
恥ずかしいというか……。
english: U-Um, being stared at like that is... kind of embarrassing...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （この子の雰囲気どこかで……）
english: (This girl's atmosphere, I've seen it somewhere...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
やっぱり覚えて無いよね。
図書館で少し話をした程度だし。
english: You really don't remember, do you. We only talked a little bit in the library, after all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （図書館で……）
english: (In the library...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ああっ！？
もしかして……小弓場さん！？
english: Ahh!? Could it be... Koyuba-san!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
よかったァ、覚えててくれて。
そう、小弓場かおりです。
english: Oh good, you remembered. Yes, I'm Kaori Koyuba.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
小学校で転校しちゃったから……
もう忘れられてるかと思ってた。
english: I transferred schools during elementary school, so... I thought you would have forgotten about me by now.

speaker: Chamber Member
japanese:
小学生ん時の同級生やったか。
お互いよう覚えとったもんやで。
english: So you were classmates back in elementary school. Impressive that you both remembered each other.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
え、ええ。
まあ……。
english: Y-Yeah. Well...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （かろうじてだけど……）
english: (Barely, though...)

speaker: Chamber Member
japanese:
うん、これもなにかの縁や！
慎平くん、それに澪ちゃん、
キミらの知恵も貸してくれやんか？
english: Yeah, this must be fate too! Shinpei-kun, and Mio-chan, won't you lend us your wisdom as well?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 知恵ですか？
english: Wisdom?

speaker: Chamber Member
japanese: 小弓場さんも、それがええ思うやろ？
english: Koyuba-san, you think that's a good idea too, right?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
え？　あ、そ、そうですね！
力を貸していただけるととても助かります！
english: Eh? Ah, y-yes! It would be a huge help if you could lend us your strength!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ、あのぉ。
english: U-Um.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 話が全然見えてこないんですけど……。
english: I have no idea what you're talking about...

speaker: Chamber Member
japanese:
詳しい話は役場の人がするさけよ。
ほら澪ちゃん、慎平くん行こら。
english: The town hall people will explain the details. Come on, Mio-chan, Shinpei-kun, let's go.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なあ、慎ちゃん。
いったい何が始まるん？
english: Hey, Shin-chan. What on earth is about to start?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: それはオレが聞きたい……。
english: That's what I want to know...

japanese: 2.町役場の依頼
english: 2. Town Hall Request

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: でも、ホンマ驚いたわァ……。
english: But I was really surprised...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 何を？
english: What?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
まさか慎ちゃんが、
あの、小弓場かおりちゃんと知り合いやなんて。
english: To think that you, Shin-chan, were acquaintances with *that* Kaori Koyuba-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 同級生やったって澪も聞いたやろ……。
english: You heard we were classmates, right, Mio...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
てか「あの」って、
そんな有名なんか小弓場さん。
english: By the way, what do you mean by "*that*"? Is Koyuba-san really that famous?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
有名も有名。
めっちゃ有名やで！
english: Famous doesn't even begin to describe it. She's super famous!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
アイドルグループ？
それのセンター？
そういうのしてたんやなかった？
english: An idol group? The center of it? Wasn't she doing something like that?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: なんで疑問符やねん。
english: Why the question marks?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私もそない詳しいわけやないからなァ。
english: Well, I'm not exactly an expert on the subject either.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも、アイドルに疎い私でも
知っちゃあるくらいなんやから、
すっごいアイドルなんは間違いない思うで？
english: But if even someone like me who's out of touch with idols knows about her, I'm sure she's an amazing idol!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （あの小弓場さんが、すっごいアイドルね……）
english: (That Koyuba-san is an amazing idol, huh...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （なんかピンとこないな）
english: (It just doesn't click for me.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: それでそれで、小弓場さん。
english: So, anyway, Koyuba-san.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: は、はい！
english: Y-yes!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
小弓場さんは慎ちゃんとどんな関係だったん
ですか？
english: What kind of relationship did you have with Shin-chan?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そ、そんな、
そういう質問に応えられるほど
親しくなかったよ。
english: W-We weren't close enough for me to answer a question like that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そうなんですか？
english: Is that so?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 図書館で少し話をした程度やった……はず。
english: We only talked a little bit in the library... I think.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、それであってる。
私、図書委員をやってたから、
それでちょっとお話ししたくらい。
english: Yeah, that's right. I was on the library committee, so we just talked a little bit because of that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、
昔から本の虫やったもんな。
english: Shin-chan has been a bookworm since way back when, after all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
澪こそ、小弓場さんのこと
覚えてへんのか？
english: What about you, Mio? Do you not remember Koyuba-san?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あはは……そんなには。
ごめんなァ。
english: Ahaha... not really. Sorry about that.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
仕方ないよ。
学年も違ったし。
english: It can't be helped. We were in different grades, too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（正直、意外もいいところだ。
　昔は大人しい印象だった彼女が、
　まさかアイドルになってるだなんて……）
english: (Honestly, it's beyond surprising. To think that she, who gave off such a quiet impression in the past, would actually become an idol...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、あと……小舟さん。
english: Ah, by the way… Kofune-san.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんですか？
english: What is it?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私のこと、
かおりって呼んで欲しいかなって。
english: I was wondering if you could call me Kaori.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
いいんですか！
ほな……かおりちゃん！
english: Is that okay! Then... Kaori-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 年上にちゃん付けは失礼やないか？
english: Isn't it rude to add "-chan" to someone older than you?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
別にいいよ。
その方が私も話しやすいし。
english: It's fine. It makes it easier for me to talk to you, too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あっ、私のことも澪って、
名前で呼んでもらえますか！
english: Ah, could you call me by my first name, Mio, as well!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、じゃあ澪ちゃんって
呼ばせてもらうね。
english: Okay, then I'll call you Mio-chan.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんは、
「小弓場さん」のままなん？
english: Are you going to keep calling her "Koyuba-san", Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ああ、別に今まで通りで良いやろ。
english: Yeah, it's fine to just keep it the same as always, right?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、うん、
網代くんに名前で呼ばれるのは……。
english: Y-Yeah, being called by my first name by Ajiro-kun is...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: かおりちゃん、嫌やってさ。
english: She says she doesn't want you to, Kaori-chan.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そ、そうじゃなくて！
網代くんに名前で呼ばれるのは……
は、恥ずかしくて。
english: Th-That's not it! Being called by my first name by Ajiro-kun is... e-embarrassing.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: じゃあ、これまで通り、小弓場さんで。
english: Then I'll stick with Koyuba-san, same as always.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うん……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
やあ、申し訳ない。
待たせて悪かったね。
english: Hey, my apologies. Sorry to keep you waiting.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あれ？　商工会のおじさんは？
english: Huh? Where's the guy from the Chamber of Commerce?

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
祭りの準備があるさけ帰ったで。
こっから先は私が説明させてもらうから、
こっち来てくれやんかのォ。
english: He went back because he has festival preparations to do. I'll be explaining things from here on out, so could you come over here?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: は、はい、よろしくお願いします！
english: Y-Yes, please!

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
二人も協力してくれるらしな。
ほんま助かるわァ。
english: I hear you two are going to help out as well. That's a real lifesaver.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あのぉ、私らって、
なんでここに呼ばれたんです？
english: Um, why exactly were we called here?

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese: なんや、なんも聞いてやんのか？
english: What, haven't you heard anything?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: はい……。
english: Yes…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ごめんね、二人とも。
詳しく説明してなかったよね。
english: Sorry, you two. I didn't explain it in detail, did I.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
実は私、この島の夏祭りのために
帰省してきたの。
english: Actually, I came back home for this island's summer festival.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 夏祭りって、日都神社の？
english: The summer festival... at Hitogashima Shrine?

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
そうそう、その夏祭りの盛り上げ役を
小弓場さんに頼んだんよ。
english: Exactly, and we asked Koyuba-san to be the one to liven up that summer festival.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 頑張ります！
english: I'll do my best!

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
売れっ子で忙しのに、
スケジュールの合間縫うて
来てくれたんや。
english: Even though she's a popular star and super busy, she squeezed us into her schedule and came all the way here.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
へえ～。
お祭りのために、わざわざ……。
english: Wow~. Coming all the way back just for the festival...

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
そらもう、小弓場さんは、
この島んこと心から愛してくれてるさけな。
ふるさと納税も欠かしやんくらいよ。
english: Of course, Koyuba-san truly loves this island from the bottom of her heart. She doesn't even miss a hometown tax donation.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ここは生まれ故郷ですし……
いつか時間がとれたら帰りたいって
常々思ってました！
english: This is my birthplace, after all... I've always thought that I'd like to return someday when I had the time!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あと、ずっと会いたいと思っていた人も
いましたから……。
english: Also, there was someone I've been wanting to see for a long time...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
会いたい人？
友達かなにかですか？
english: Someone you want to see? A friend or something?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
え？　あっ、友達……？
そ、そうなのかな？
友達じゃないかも、だけど……。
english: Eh? Ah, a friend...? I-I wonder if that's it? Maybe not a friend, but...

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
ようわからんけど、
今回の祭りで再会できたらええなァ。
english: I don't really get it, but it'd be great if you could reunite at this festival.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、はい……。
english: Ah, yes…

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese: で、ここからが本題なんやけど……。
english: So, this is where we get to the main point, but...

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
祭り当日、小弓場さんには、
トークショーとミニライブをしてもらう
予定なんよ。
english: On the day of the festival, Koyuba-san is scheduled to do a talk show and a mini live performance.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
やったッ！
かおりちゃんの歌聴けるんや！？
english: Yay! We get to hear Kaori-chan's singing!?

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
ミニライブは特に問題あらへんし、
ライブスタッフに任せとったら素晴らしい
ステージになると思う。
english: There aren't any particular problems with the mini live, and I think it'll be a wonderful stage if we leave it to the live staff.

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese: 問題はトークショーの方なんよ。
english: The problem is the talk show.

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
この日都ヶ島での思い出を語って、
島の観光アピールをしてもらう――
そういう予定やったんやけど……。
english: We planned for her to talk about her memories here on Hitogashima, and promote the island's tourism-- That was the plan, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 何か問題でもあったんですか？
english: Was there some kind of problem?

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
いや、それがなァ……
まだどんな話するか、
全然決まってやんらしいんやわ。
english: Well, the thing is... It seems she hasn't decided what to talk about at all yet.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
……そうなんです。
私、小さい頃は一人で過ごすことが
多くて……。
english: ...That's right. When I was little, I spent a lot of time alone...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
だから私のこの島での思い出って、
景色がきれいなお気に入りの場所のことばかりで、
人に話せるようなことは何もないの。
english: So my memories of this island are just about my favorite places with beautiful scenery, and I don't have anything that I can really talk about to people.

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese: 私らは、それでも十分や思うんやけどなァ。
english: We think that's more than enough, though.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
いいえ……。
トークショーで話す内容としては
弱すぎます。
english: No... As content to talk about at a talk show, it's too weak.

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
まあ、確かに小弓場さんの言うとおり、
インパクトのある話があるんやったら、
私らとしても大歓迎ではあるんや。
english: Well, it's certainly true that like Koyuba-san says, if there was a story with more impact, we'd be more than happy to have it.

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
そこでや！！
こっからが慎平くんと澪ちゃんの出番やで！
english: And that's where!! Shinpei-kun and Mio-chan come in!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ど、どういうことですか？
english: Wh-What do you mean?

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
改めて小弓場さんにこの島を
案内したってくれやんか？
english: Could you show Koyuba-san around this island again?

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
その過程で、
今まで忘れとったおもろそうなエピソードが、
思い出せるかもしれやんやろ。
english: In the process of doing that, she might be able to remember some interesting episodes she had forgotten until now.

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
この島の観光アピールになりそうなもんが
あったら儲けもんやいしょ。
english: If there's anything that could serve as a tourism appeal for this island, that's a bonus.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
それってオレたちじゃないと、
できないことなんですか？
english: Is that something that only we can do?

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
そやで。キミらみたいな若いモンやったら、
今どきの観光客にウケそうなポイントも
ようわかってるやろ？
english: That's right. Since you guys are young, you probably know what points would appeal to tourists nowadays, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
オレ、２年ほど、
この島を離れていたんですけど……。
english: I've been away from this island for about two years, though...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
大丈夫やって。
たかが２年程度で、この島は
なんも変わりよらんから。
english: It'll be fine. This island hasn't changed at all in a mere two years.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それよりも良かったなぁ、慎ちゃん。
アイドルとパートナーやて。
english: More importantly, good for you, Shin-chan. You get to be partners with an idol.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
アホ！
おまえもパートナーとして指名されてんやぞ！
english: Idiot! You've been nominated as a partner too!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: え、そうなん！？
english: Eh, really!?

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
澪ちゃんもこの島で若者にウケそうな
スポットを案内してもらえやんやろか？
english: Could you show her around some spots on this island that might appeal to young people, Mio-chan?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
案内してって、
そないなこと言われてもなァ。
english: Show her around... Even if you ask me to do that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私、店の手伝いもあるし……。
english: I have to help out at the restaurant too...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: まあ、祭り前でバタバタするやろうしな。
english: Well, I'm sure you'll be busy right before the festival.

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese: 二人とも、それでええんか……。
english: Are you two really okay with that...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なにがですか？
english: With what?

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
ここ数年、
日都ヶ島の観光客の人数は
どないなってると思てんのや！
english: How do you think the number of tourists to Hitogashima has been doing over the past few years!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そんなん聞かれても……
考えたこともあらへんし。
english: Even if you ask me that... I've never really thought about it.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
横ばい……
正確に言うなら微減ですよね。
english: It's plateauing... Or to be more accurate, it's slightly decreasing, right.

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
おお、こっから送った資料、
ちゃんと目ェ通してくれてたんか！
嬉しいわァ。
english: Oh, you actually read through the materials we sent you! I'm so happy.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 大好きな日都ヶ島のためですから！
english: It's for the sake of my beloved Hitogashima, after all!

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
リピート率は悪ない。
新規<color=#GF_TIPS_090>観光客</color>を呼び込めやんのが大問題なんや。
english: The repeat rate isn't bad. The major problem is that we can't attract new <color=#GF_TIPS_090>tourists</color>.

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
このままやと島の観光事業は先細る一方で、
やがて死に絶えてまう！
新たな一手を打っとかなアカンのや！
english: At this rate, the island's tourism industry will only dwindle, and eventually die out completely! We have to make a new move!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
だから今回……、
現役アイドルを起用したと？
english: So that's why this time... you brought in an active idol?

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
そうや！
今年の夏祭りは小弓場さん目当てに、
大勢の観光客が押し寄せてくるはず！
english: Exactly! This year's summer festival should see a huge influx of tourists coming just to see Koyuba-san!

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
目指すは起死回生のイベントや！
小弓場さんのライブを日都ヶ島観光業
再生の一手にせなアカン！
english: We're aiming for a miraculous comeback event! We have to make Koyuba-san's live performance the key to reviving Hitogashima's tourism industry!

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
この島に来てもらえさえすれば、
ここの良さは、
わかってもらえるはずなんよ！
english: If we can just get them to come to this island, they should be able to understand how great this place is!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: リピート率がそれを証明していますよね！
english: The repeat rate proves that, right!

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese: 大切なんは、この島を知ってもらうことや！
english: The important thing is to get people to know about this island!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
はい！　そうすれば、必ずこの島に
来てみたいと思ってもらえるはずです！
english: Yes! If we do that, I'm sure we can make them want to come visit this island!

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
ほしいんは、そのきっかけや！
それを作り出せるんは、
キミら若い世代しかおらんのや！
english: What we need is that catalyst! And the only ones who can create it are you younger generations!

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese: ……はぁっ、はぁっ。
english: ...Hah, hah.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
大熱弁やな……。
どうする、慎ちゃん？
english: What a passionate speech... What do we do, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: こんなに語られたら断れんやろ。
english: We can't really refuse after being talked to like that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃんも、
何か熱なってしもてるしな。
english: Kaori-chan seems to be getting pretty fired up too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、あはは……。
この島のことを思うと、
つい力が入っちゃって。
english: A-Ahaha... When I think about this island, I just end up putting a lot of energy into it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
まあ、オレたちでよければ……。
なあ、澪？
english: Well, if we're good enough... Right, Mio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん、なんかちょっと楽しそうやし。
english: Yeah, it seems kind of fun, too.

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
おおッ！
二人とも、わかってくれたんやな！
english: Ohhh! You two understand!

speaker: Town Hall Clerk
japanese:
ほな、くれぐれも頼んだで！
小弓場さんもよろしゅうな！
english: Well then, I'm counting on you! I'm counting on you too, Koyuba-san!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: はい、任せてください！
english: Yes, leave it to me!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ゴメンね、網代くん、澪ちゃん。
ヘンなことに巻き込んじゃって……。
english: Sorry, Ajiro-kun, Mio-chan. For getting you involved in something weird...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
気にせんでええよ。
こういうのも縁なんやろうし。
english: Don't worry about it. This kind of thing must be fate too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
そうやな。
とにかく一緒に島を巡ってみよら。
english: Yeah. Anyway, let's try touring the island together.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん……！
ありがとう、網代くん。
english: Yeah...! Thank you, Ajiro-kun.

japanese: 3.潮の提案
english: 3. Ushio's Proposal

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
……あー、懐かしい風景。
変わってないなぁ～。
english: ...Ah, what a nostalgic scenery. It hasn't changed at all~.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 昔はこの辺でよく遊んでたんですか？
english: Did you use to play around here a lot in the past?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ううん、
あまり外で遊ぶタイプじゃなかったから……。
english: No, I wasn't really the type to play outside much...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
でも雨が降るとあそこの辺りに水たまりができて、
アメンボがいっぱいいたのは覚えてる。
english: But I remember that when it rained, a puddle would form around there, and there would be lots of water striders.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
そういえば東京にいると、
こっちほどアメンボ見る機会ってないよな。
english: Come to think of it, when you're in Tokyo, you don't get the chance to see water striders as much as here, huh.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: へえ、そうなんや？
english: Oh, really?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
都会からこの島に来るような人たちって、
結局そんな自然の景色に魅力を感じてるのかもな。
english: People who come to this island from the city might ultimately be attracted to that kind of natural scenery.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そっかァ。
でも、島の自然な景色をＰＲするとしても、
この島ならではのもんやないとアカンのと違う？
english: I see. But even if we're PRing the island's natural scenery, doesn't it have to be something unique to this island?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そこが難しいんよなあ。
english: That's the difficult part, huh.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: そうなんだよね……。
english: Yeah, it is...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
じゃあ、学校のこと話題にしてみよか。
小中学校には通ってたんですよね？
english: Then, let's try making school the topic. You went to elementary and middle school here, right?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、えっとね……。
私、図書委員をやってて……。
english: Yeah, um... I was a library committee member...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うんうん。
english: Yeah, yeah.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
毎日ずっと、
図書館で本ばっかり読んでた……。
english: Every single day, I just read books in the library...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えーっと……それで終わりですか？
english: Ummm... is that the end?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、あとは……小さな校舎で、
生徒の数も少なかったなぁって。
それぐらい、かな？
english: Ah, besides that... it was a small school building, and there were very few students. That's about it, I guess?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……あの、他には？
english: ...Um, anything else?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 他には……う～ん、なにかあったかな？
english: Anything else... hmmm, was there anything?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ、そうや！
明後日の夏祭り！
english: Ah, I know! The summer festival the day after tomorrow!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お祭りは子供の頃のかおりちゃんも、
楽しんでたんちゃいます？
english: You enjoyed the festival when you were a kid too, didn't you, Kaori-chan?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、何度も行ったよ！
楽しかったな～！
english: Yeah, I went many times! It was so much fun~!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
家族と一緒に行って、タコ焼き食べたり
金魚すくいしたり……。
御海送りも綺麗だったなあ。
english: I went with my family, ate takoyaki, played goldfish scooping... The Umi-okuri was beautiful too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うんうん、あとは？
english: Yeah, yeah, and then?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: でも……それくらい、かも。
english: But... that might be about it.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そ、そですか……。
english: I-Is that so...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ごめんなさい……。
なんだか普通というか、
地味でありきたりなことばかりで。
english: I'm sorry... It's just kind of normal, or rather, plain and common things.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あはは……。
オレたちに謝る必要ないよ。
english: Ahaha... You don't need to apologize to us.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
とにかくもう少し島を歩こら。
そうすればもっと思い出せることが、
あるかもせーへんし。
english: Anyway, let's walk around the island a bit more. If we do, there might be more things you can remember.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 見っけたで！
english: Found you!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えっ？　あ、潮……！
english: Huh? Oh, Ushio!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: こんなトコにおったんか、慎平！
english: So this is where you were, Shinpei!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃん？
なんでこんなところにおるんよ。
english: Sis? Why are you in a place like this?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: なんでもクソもあらへん！
english: What do you mean why!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ずっとコフネで待っとったのに、
ちっとも帰って来やんから、
探し回っとったんや！
english: I was waiting at Kofune the whole time, but you didn't come back at all, so I was looking all over for you!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
澪も一緒で何してたん！？
電話しとったのに全然出やんし！
english: What were you doing with Mio!? I kept calling but you wouldn't answer at all!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
えっ？
……あ、ほんまやぁ。
気づかんかった。
english: Huh? ...Ah, you're right. I didn't notice.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ああ、オレもや。
役場でマナーモードにしたままやった。
english: Ah, me too. I left it on silent mode from when we were at the town hall.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
役場ァ？
なんで役場やら行く必要あったん？
english: The town hall? Why did you need to go to the town hall?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、あの……。
english: Ah, um…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あれ？　えっと……
もしかして、かおりちゃん！？
english: Huh? Um... Could it be, Kaori-chan!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
え、えええッ？
わっ、わわ、私のこと覚えて……！？
english: E-Eeeh? W-Wa-wa, you remember me...!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
うん、覚えちゃあるよ。
やっぱり、かおりちゃんやった！
えらい久しぶりやなァ！
english: Yeah, I remember you. It really is Kaori-chan! It's been so long!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
小舟潮さん、だよね？
嬉しい……私のこと、
覚えてくれてたんだ。
english: You're Ushio Kofune-san, right? I'm so happy... you remembered me.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
覚えとって当然やん。
小学校で一緒やった子やて少ないし、
忘れる方がおかしわ。
english: Of course I'd remember. There weren't many kids in our elementary school class, so it'd be weirder if I forgot.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: らしいで、慎ちゃん。
english: That's what she says, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: おまえなんて記憶に少しも残って無かったやろ。
english: You didn't remember her at all, did you.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うっ……。
english: Ugh…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
でも、どないしたん？
かおりちゃんが島に帰ってくるて、
えらい久しぶりやん。
english: But, what's going on? It's been a really long time since you came back to the island, Kaori-chan.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、うん。
えっとね……。
english:
Y-yeah…
Um…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なァ～んや。
そういうコトやったんか。
english: Ooh, I see. So that's what happened.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
わかった！
そんなら私に任しとき！
english: I get it! Then leave it to me!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
思い出がないんやったら、
これから一緒に作ればええ！
english: If you don't have any memories, we can just make them together from now on!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 小舟さん……。
english: Kofune-san...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも、なにして思い出作りするん？
お祭りまであんま時間ないで。
english: But, what are we gonna do to make memories? There's not much time until the festival.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
それはまぁ、
これから考えるってことで！
english: Well, that's something we'll figure out from here on out!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あいかわらず勢いだけやな……。
english: You're all momentum as usual, huh...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: うっさい！
english: Shut up!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふふっ……。
小舟さん、変わってないんだね。
昔のまんま。
english: Hehe... You haven't changed, Kofune-san. Just like you were in the past.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
せやろ～……って、あれ？
それって褒めてるんやんな？
english: Right~... wait, huh? That's a compliment, right?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、もちろんだよ。
english: Yeah, of course.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あはは、そっか！
ありがとな、かおりちゃん。
english: Ahaha, I see! Thanks, Kaori-chan.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ……あッ、そうや！
english: ...Ah, that's right!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: どうした？
english: What is it?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ええこと思い出した！
<color=#GF_TIPS_095>タイムカプセル</color>や！
english: I just remembered something good! The <color=#GF_TIPS_095>time capsule</color>!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: タイムカプセル？
english: Time capsule?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ほら、学校のみんなで色んなもん詰めて埋めたやろ？
かおりちゃんが引っ越す時にやったヤツや。
english: You know, when everyone at school packed various things and buried it? The one we did when Kaori-chan was moving away.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
そんなこともあったなァ……。
そういえばあれって小弓場さんが
引っ越す時やったんやっけ。
english: That did happen, didn't it... Come to think of it, was that when Koyuba-san was moving away?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うん……。
english: Y-yeah…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
せやったせやった。
下級生の私らも付き合わされたっけ。
english: Right, right. Us lowerclassmen were made to go along with it too.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
でも島の友達と埋めたタイムカプセルやなんて、
トークショーの思い出話にぴったりなん違う！？
english: But a time capsule buried with your island friends, isn't that perfect for a story to tell at the talk show!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
タイムカプセルをメインの話題にして、
何気ない日常の思い出や、島の風景なんかを
一緒に話したらええんや。
english: We can make the time capsule the main topic, and you can talk about your casual everyday memories and the scenery of the island along with it.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
お客さんの記憶にも残るし、
島のアピールにもなるやん！
english: It'll leave an impression on the audience, and it'll be good PR for the island too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
確かに、大きいエピソードがひとつあれば、
トークが盛り上がりそうやな。
english: True, if we have one big episode, the talk show will probably be more exciting.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
善は急げや！
さっそく掘り出しに行こら！
english: There's no time like the present! Let's go dig it up right away!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、あのっ、ちょっと待って……！
english: U-Um, wait a second...!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: どないしたん？
english: What's wrong?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あの、そ、そういうのは、
もっと大人になってから掘り出すべき
じゃないかな……？
english: Um, w-well, for something like that... Shouldn't we dig it up when we're a bit older...?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃんの言う通りやわ。
普通タイムカプセルって、
何十年か経ってから開けるもんやで。
english: Kaori-chan is right. Normally, you're supposed to open time capsules after a few decades have passed.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
そうよなァ。
埋めてから今年で７年か……
まだ時期尚早かもな。
english: Yeah. It's been 7 years since we buried it... It might still be too early.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ええねんて。
私ら、あの頃に比べたら、
もうええ大人やん。
english: It's fine. Compared to back then, we're basically adults now.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: さ、さすがにまだそこまでは……。
english: W-Well, we're not quite there yet...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もう～！
お姉ちゃんはコレやから困るわ。
ホンマ強引すぎ。
english: Jeez! This is why you're such a pain, Sis. You're way too pushy.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ていうか……結局、潮が中身を
見たくなったってだけやろ？
english: I mean... in the end, it's just that you want to see what's inside, right Ushio?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: だったら悪いんか？
english: Is that so bad?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: いや、別に……。
english: No, not really...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
よっしゃ、決まりやね！
ほな行こか。
english: Alright, it's decided then! Let's go.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃん、待ってや！
english: Wait, Sis!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うう……ど、どうしよう？
english: Ugh... Wh-What should I do?

japanese: 4.タイムカプセルはどこに？
english: 4. Where Is the Time Capsule?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: で、タイムカプセルを埋めた場所ってのは？
english: So, where did we bury the time capsule?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ああ、そのことなんやけどな。
慎平、よう聞いてや。
english: Ah, about that. Shinpei, listen closely.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あ、ああ。
english: Y-Yeah.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: どこに埋めたんやっけ？
english: Where did we bury it again?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ハァ！？
ほなおまえ、一体どこ向かって
歩いとったんや！？
english: Hah!? Then where the heck were you walking towards!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あはは、とりあえず歩いとったら、
何か思い出せるて思たんよ。
english: Ahaha, I thought if I just started walking, I might remember something.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんって、
考える前に動くもんなァ。
english: Sis always acts before she thinks, huh.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そんなわけで情報募集中や。
慎平、なんか覚えとらん？
english: So, we're currently looking for information. Shinpei, do you remember anything?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
うーん……？
タイムカプセルのこと自体、
忘れてたくらいやしなァ。
english: Hmm...? I had pretty much forgotten about the time capsule itself, so...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 澪は？
english: What about Mio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんと一緒に何か入れた覚えはあるけど、
それ以上は……。
english: I remember putting something in it with Sis, but beyond that...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: かおりちゃんは？
english: What about Kaori-chan?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ごめんなさい。
私、何も覚えてなくて……。
english: I'm sorry. I don't remember anything either...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そうなんや？
あと聞けそうなんは……
english: Is that so? The only other people we could ask are...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
窓とトキちゃんやな！
あの二人も、あの場におったはずや。
english: Sou and Toki-chan! Those two should have been there too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
電話してみるか？
覚えとるか知らんけど。
english: Should we try calling them? I don't know if they'll remember, though.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: せやな、かけてみよ！
english: Yeah, let's give them a call!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
もしもし、窓？
私や、潮や。
あんな、ちょっと聞きたいんやけど。
english: Hello, Sou? It's me, Ushio. Hey, I wanted to ask you something.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
小学校の時、タイムカプセル埋めたやん？
あれ掘り出そか思うんやけど、
場所が思い出せやんねん。
english: We buried a time capsule back in elementary school, right? I'm thinking of digging it up, but I can't remember where it is.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
窓はなんか覚えてやん？
うん、うん……。
english: Do you remember anything, Sou? Yeah, yeah...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あ、そうなん？
ほなトキちゃんも？
english: Oh, is that so? Then Toki-chan too?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
……うん、わかった。
ほなまたなァ。
english: ...Yeah, got it. See ya later.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ど……どうだった……？
english: H-How was it...?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ああ、なんも覚えてやんかったわ。
トキちゃんも場所はわからんって。
english: Ah, he didn't remember a thing. He said Toki-chan didn't know the location either.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ふぅ……。
english: Phew…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ……どないしたらええんやろ？
english: ...What should we do?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私……ちょっと思い出したんやけど。
あれって確か、お姉ちゃんが
埋めよったんとちゃうかった？
english: I... just remembered something. Wasn't it you who buried it, Sis?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
english: …Huh?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ……そういえば。
あの時たしか小舟さんが一人で
行くって言って……。
english: Ah... come to think of it. I'm pretty sure Kofune-san said she was going alone that time...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ああ、思い出した！
english: Ah, I remember now!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
みんなが知ってたら
誰かが掘り出してまうかもしれんって、
潮が一人で埋めに行ったよな。
english: You said that if everyone knew, someone might dig it up, so you went to bury it alone, Ushio.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: そうやっけ？
english: Was that how it was?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ハァ、ホンマお姉ちゃんは……。
english: *Sigh*, seriously, Sis...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 当の本人が忘れてどないすんねん？
english: What are we supposed to do if the person who did it forgot?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そやなァ。
言われてみたら、
私一人で埋めたような気が……。
english: I guess so. Now that you mention it, I feel like I might have buried it alone...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
……あ、だんだん思い出してきた！
たしかメモがあったはずや。
埋めた場所を書き残したメモが！
english: ...Ah, I'm starting to remember! There should definitely be a memo. A memo where I wrote down the location where I buried it!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
さすが私や。
抜かりなしやな。
english: That's me for you. I don't miss a thing.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
よっしゃ！
そうとわかれば、うち帰ってそのメモ探すで！
english: Alright! Now that we know that, I'm going home to look for that memo!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あっ、また勝手に突っ走って……！
english: Ah, she's running off on her own again...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 待ってや、お姉ちゃん！
english: Wait, Sis!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ふぅ……。
english: Phew…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
それじゃ小弓場さん。
オレらも行こか。
english: Well then, Koyuba-san. Shall we get going too?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うん……。
english: Y-yeah…

japanese: 5.コフネの思い出
english: 5. Memories of Kofune

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ただいまー！
遅なってごめん！
english:
I'm back!
Sorry I'm late!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ただいまー！
また帰ってきたでー！
english:
I'm back!
I'm back again!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
お帰り、お腹すいてるやろ？
お昼できてるで。
english: Welcome back, you guys must be hungry, right? Lunch is ready.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そやなッ！
タイムカプセル探しは一旦おいといて、
まずは腹ごしらえといこか。
english: That's right! Let's put the time capsule search on hold for now and get some food in us first.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
そうやな。
ただいま、アラン。
english: Yeah. I'm back, Alain.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
お帰り、慎平。
またなんやたいそなこと、しとるみたいやな。
english: Welcome back, Shinpei. Seems like you're up to something big again.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ああ、実はそうなんよ。
english: Yeah, actually, we are.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
お父さん、もう一人前追加して！
私らのお客さんの分。
english: Dad, add one more portion! For our guest.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ほら、かおりちゃん！
もっとこっち来て。
english: Come on, Kaori-chan! Come closer.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
こ、こんにちは。
お忙しいところお邪魔いたします。
english: H-Hello. I apologize for intruding while you're busy.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああ、いらっしゃい。
潮、高校のお友達か？
english: Ah, welcome. Ushio, is this a friend from high school?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ちゃうちゃう。
小学校の時に同級生やった子で、
小弓場かおりちゃんや。
english: No, no. She was a classmate of ours in elementary school, Kaori Koyuba-chan.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
高学年になってから転校で島を出たんやけど、
お祭りに合わせて来てくれたんよ。
english: She moved off the island when we were in the upper grades, but she came back in time for the festival.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああ、小弓場さんとこの子か！
キレイになったなァ。
ご両親は元気かい？
english: Ah, so you're the Koyuba family's girl! You've gotten so pretty. Are your parents doing well?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: はい、おかげさまで。
english: Yes, thankfully.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: そらァ良かった。
english: Well, that's good to hear.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃん、
今は東京でアイドルやってて、
えらい人気なんやで。
english: Kaori-chan is working as an idol in Tokyo now, and she's super popular.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
せやから、その人気で人を呼びたい言うて
島の役場や商工会がお祭りの目玉ゲストとして
招待したらしわ。
english: So, the town hall and Chamber of Commerce invited her as the main guest for the festival, saying they wanted to use her popularity to draw a crowd.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ほお～、そうなんか。
ほな栄養つけてもらわんとアカンな。
みんなと同じランチでええか？
english: Ooh, is that so. Then we'll have to make sure you get some nutrition in you. Is the same lunch as everyone else okay?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、お、お金は――
english: A-About the money--

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
遠慮はいらんで。
うちの子らと仲良うしてもらっとるお礼や。
english: No need to hold back. It's a thank you for being good friends with my kids.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そんなんええから早よ座り。
慎平の隣でええ？
english: Don't worry about that, just sit down. Is next to Shinpei okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: どうぞ、小弓場さん。
english: Go ahead, Koyuba-san.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
は、はいっ。
お言葉に甘えさせていただきます。
皆さんありがとうございます。
english: Y-Yes. I'll take you up on your kind offer. Thank you all so much.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: それでは……。
english: Well then...

speaker: 一同（一同Ａ）
japanese: いただきます！
english: Thanks for the food!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃん、どう？
お父さんのフライは絶品やで。
english: How is it, Kaori-chan? My dad's fried food is superb.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……んんっ、おいしい！
english: …Mmm, delicious!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: せやろ！
english: Right!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
この味……思い出した。
昔、食べたことある！
english: This taste... I remember it. I've eaten this before!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああ、たまに家族で
食べに来てくれとったもんな。
english: Yeah, you and your family used to come eat here sometimes.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ええ、そうだったと思います。
まだ小さかったので、うろ覚えですけど……。
english: Yes, I believe so. I was still small, so my memory is a bit hazy, but...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ふふ、すごく懐かしい。
english: Hehe, it's so nostalgic.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: さっそく思い出がひとつ見つかったな！
english: We've already found one memory!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん！
ありがとう、小舟さん。
english:
Yes!
Thank you, Kofune-san.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: いやァ～～～ッ、あっついあっつい！！
english: Man~~~, it's hot, it's hot!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: いらっしゃい、哲さん。
english: Welcome, Tetsu-san.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
おおォ！
なんや、みんなで仲良くランチかいな。
english: Ooh! What's this, everyone having a nice lunch together?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 凸村さんもお昼食べに来たん？
english: Did you come to eat lunch too, Totsumura-san?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: せや、あとパトロールの一環でな。
english: Yeah, and as part of my patrol.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
祭りを控えて観光客が増えるから、
ちょっと注意喚起……に――
english: The number of tourists is increasing ahead of the festival, so I'm just giving a little warning... to--

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ウオオオオオオオッ！！
こ、小弓場かおりちゃんッ！？
english: Uwoooooooh!! K-Kaori Koyuba-chan!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ウ、ウソやろ！？
なんでこないなとこに……！
english: Y-You're kidding, right!? Why are you in a place like this...!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
こんにちは～！
小弓場かおりです！
english: Hello~! I'm Kaori Koyuba!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
哲さん、かおりちゃんのこと
知っちゃあるん？
english: Tetsu-san, do you know Kaori-chan?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ファンなんやさけ当然やしょ！
祭りに来るて話やったから、
楽しみにしとったんやッ！
