english: I'm a fan, so of course I do! I heard she was coming for the festival, so I was really looking forward to it!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ありがとうございます！
english: Thank you so much!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: かおりちゃん、めっちゃ別人やん。
english: Kaori-chan, you're like a completely different person.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
言うな。
大人の営業スマイルっちゅうやつや。
english: Don't say that. It's what you call an adult's professional smile.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あ、あのォッ！
サインお願いしてもええやろか！？
english: U-Umm! Could I ask for your autograph!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
凸村さん！
かおりちゃん今からお昼なんやから、
後にしたってや！
english: Totsumura-san! Kaori-chan is having her lunch now, so leave it for later!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
まあ、しゃあないなァ……。
ほなかおりちゃんがメシ食うた後にでも――
english: Well, I guess it can't be helped... Then, maybe after Kaori-chan finishes eating--

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
いえ、大丈夫ですよ！
すぐ書きますから、
少しだけ待っててくださいね。
english: No, it's fine! I'll sign it right away, so please wait just a moment.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ホ、ホンマッ！？
ホンマにええんかッ！？
english: R-Really!? Is it really okay!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ええ、もちろんです。
english: Yes, of course.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
感激やッ！
家宝にさせてもらうでェッ！
english: I'm so moved! I'll make it a family heirloom!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（小弓場さん、優しいんだな……。
　嫌な顔ひとつしない）
english: (Koyuba-san is so kind... She didn't even show a hint of annoyance.)

japanese: 6.タイムカプセルのメモ
english: 6. Time Capsule Memo

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
お腹も大きなったし、
私は部屋でメモ探してくるわ。
みんなここで待っとってな。
english: I'm full now, so I'll go look for the memo in my room. Everyone wait here.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私も手伝った方が良くない？
二人で探した方が早いやろ。
english: Shouldn't I help too? It'll be faster if we search together.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: それならオレも手伝うぞ。
english: In that case, I'll help too.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ううん、私一人でええよ。
みんなはゆっくりしとってや。
english: No, I'm fine on my own. You guys just relax.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
なんで断るんやろ？
澪にも手伝ってもらえばいいのに。
english: Why is she refusing? She should just let Mio help her.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃん、他の人に部屋ん中、
見られたないんやと思うで。
めっちゃ散らかっとったし。
english: I don't think Sis wants other people to see the inside of her room. It was super messy.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あいつめ……。
english: That girl...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
かおりちゃん、どうかしたんですか？
なんか落ち着かん様子やけど。
english: Kaori-chan, is something wrong? You seem a bit restless.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、ごめんなさい。
えっと……。
english: Ah, I'm sorry. Um...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
友達の家にお邪魔するのに慣れてなくて……。
どんな風にしてればいいのかなって……。
english: I'm not used to visiting a friend's house... So I'm not sure how I should be acting...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そんなん気にしやんでええのに。
そんなたいそな部屋やないですし、
リラックスしとってください。
english: You don't have to worry about that. It's not a very fancy room anyway, so please just relax.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うん……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（本当に小弓場さんなんだな。
　昔のことだんだん思い出してきた……）
english: (It really is Koyuba-san. I'm starting to remember things from the past...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんやの慎ちゃん、ニヤニヤして。
english: What's with you, Shin-chan, grinning like that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
え……？
オレ、そんな顔してた？
english: Eh...? Was I making a face like that?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
してたしてた。
しかもかおりちゃんのこと見ながら。
english: You were, you were. And while looking at Kaori-chan, too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: えっ……え、ええと……。
english: Eh... u-um...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あ、ははは……ごめん。
ちょっと子供の頃の小弓場さんを
思い出してさ。
english: Ah, hahaha... sorry. I was just remembering what Koyuba-san was like when we were kids.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
なんか恥ずかしいな……。
目立たない地味な子だったから。
english: That's kind of embarrassing... Because I was an inconspicuous, plain kid.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それが今では人気アイドルかァ。
ホンマすごいと思います。
english: And now you're a popular idol, huh. I think that's truly amazing.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも、かおりちゃんは、
なんでアイドルになろ思たんですか？
english: But, Kaori-chan, why did you decide to become an idol?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、うん……えっとね……。
なんていうか……
自分を変えなきゃいけないって思ったの。
english: Y-Yeah... well, you see... How should I put it... I thought I needed to change myself.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
本当は私、すごく内向的で……。
それは今でも変わってなくて。
english: The truth is, I'm very introverted... And that hasn't changed even now.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そうなんですか？
english: Is that so?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん、ずっとコンプレックスだったの。
だから、転校を機にこんな自分を
変えたいなって思って……。
english: Yeah, it was always a complex of mine. So, I thought I'd use transferring schools as an opportunity to change this part of myself...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今はまだ、上手くできないことも多いけど、
少しずつ変われてるって実感はあるの。
english: Even now, there are still many things I can't do well, but I do feel like I'm changing little by little.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふふ、いまだにライブの前なんか、
胃が痛くなっちゃうこともあるけどね。
english: Hehe, even now, before a live performance or something, my stomach still hurts sometimes, though.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
へえ～、そうなんや……。
やっぱりアイドルって大変なんですね。
english: Wow~, is that so... Being an idol really is tough, isn't it.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
大変だけど、やり甲斐もあるよ。
元気をもらったって言われると、
とても嬉しいし。
english: It's tough, but it's rewarding too. When people tell me I gave them energy, it makes me really happy.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
いつも元気をもらう側だった私でも、
人を笑顔にすることができるように
なったんだなって。
english: It makes me realize that even I, who was always on the receiving end of energy, have become able to make people smile.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そんな時、
アイドルになって良かったって思う。
english: At times like that, I feel glad that I became an idol.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私、これからも一生懸命アイドルとして
がんばるつもり。
だから応援してね。
english: I plan to continue working hard as an idol from here on out. So please support me.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん、もちろん。
english: Yeah, of course.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あっ、できれば……網代くんも。
english: Ah, if possible... Ajiro-kun too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: うん、もちろん応援するよ。
english: Yeah, of course I'll support you.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ありがとう。
english: Thank you.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: んー……。
english: Hmm…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あっ、かおりちゃんは、
慎ちゃんのこと覚えとったんですよね？
何か思い出とかあります？
english: Ah, Kaori-chan, you remembered Shin-chan, right? Do you have any memories of him?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 網代くんとの思い出？
english: Memories with Ajiro-kun?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん、こういうことしたーとか。
ああいうこと話したーとか。
english: Yeah, like "we did this kind of thing". Or "we talked about that kind of thing".

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 本を借りるときに軽く会話したくらい。
english: We only really had light conversations when borrowing books.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃんには聞いてへん！
english: I wasn't asking you, Shin-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: な、なぜ睨む！
english: Wh-Why are you glaring at me!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 思い出か……えっとね……。
english: Memories, huh... let's see...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私、いつも図書館で本ばかり読んでたって
言ったでしょ？
網代くんもよく来てたんだよね。
english: I said I was always reading books in the library, right? Ajiro-kun used to come there a lot too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、昔っからヘンな本ばっか、
よう読んどったもんな。
english: Shin-chan has always read nothing but weird books since a long time ago, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ヘンな本て……。
english: Weird books...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くんが読んでた本はＳＦが多かったよね。
難しい本ばかりで、
同い歳なのにすごいなーって思ってた。
english: A lot of the books Ajiro-kun read were sci-fi, weren't they. They were all difficult books, and I thought it was amazing even though we were the same age.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そ、そうなんや……。
english: I-Is that so...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ある時、私がパズルの本を見ながら悩んでたら、
網代くんが声をかけてくれて……。
english: One time, when I was agonizing over a puzzle book, Ajiro-kun called out to me...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
一緒に考えてるうちに、
私より夢中になっちゃったことあったよね。
「あっちの本も解こう！」とか言い出して。
english: While we were thinking about it together, you ended up getting more absorbed in it than I was, right? Saying things like, "Let's solve that book over there too!"

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
二人して暗くなるまで
図書館でパズルやなぞなぞを
解き続けたんだよね。
english: The two of us kept solving puzzles and riddles in the library until it got dark, didn't we.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そんなこともあったっけ……？
english: Did that happen...?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふふ、あったよ。
その後、人渕先生に見つかってさ。
english: Hehe, it did. After that, Hitobuchi-sensei found us.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
しっかり怒られてから、
家まで送ってもらったんだよ？
覚えてない？
english: We got a good scolding, and then she walked us home, you know? Don't you remember?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ああっ、あの日か！
ぶっちーと小弓場さんと帰ったのは覚えてる。
あれってそういう経緯やったんか。
english: Ahh, that day! I remember going home with Butchi and Koyuba-san. So that's how that happened.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
困ってる人を見捨てておけやんとこ、
昔っからやったんやね。
english: You've been unable to ignore people in trouble since way back then, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
まあ……パズルに口出しするのは、
ありがた迷惑かもしれんけど。
english: Well... butting in on a puzzle might have been an unwanted favor, though.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そんなことないよ。
網代くんに教えてもらった解き方をきっかけに
考え方が変わったっていうか――
english: That's not true. The solving method Ajiro-kun taught me was the catalyst that changed the way I think, or rather--

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
視野が広くなったような気がする。
あの日をきっかけに、自分というものを
客観視するようになったの。
english: It felt like my perspective broadened. With that day as the catalyst, I started to look at myself objectively.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん得意の『フカン』やね！
すごいなァ、かおりちゃん。
私やて未だに全然できやんのに。
english: That's Shin-chan's specialty, "taking a bird's-eye view"! That's amazing, Kaori-chan. Even I still can't do that at all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 澪は目先のものに釣られやすいからな。
english: You're easily lured in by whatever's right in front of you, Mio.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: え～っ、そうなんかなァ？
english: Eeh, is that so?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも、パズル解いてた本人よりハマってまうとか、
ホンマ慎ちゃんらしい話やね。
english: But, getting more absorbed in it than the person who was actually solving the puzzle, that really is a very Shin-chan-like story.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ふふっ、本当にね……。
english: Hehe, it really is...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: みんな、ちょっとエエ？
english: Everyone, got a sec?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: どないしたん？
english: What's up?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
タイムカプセルのメモ、
見つかったんか？
english: Did you find the time capsule memo?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: うん、それっぽいもん見つけたで！
english: Yeah, I found something that looks like it!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ええ！？
english: Eh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
なんやねん？
『それっぽいもん』て？
english: What do you mean? "Something that looks like it"?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
見てもろた方が早いわ。
ほら、これなんやけど――
english: It'll be faster if you just look at it. Here, it's this--

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……なにコレ？
english: …What's this?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
せやからこれがさっき言うた、
『それっぽいもん』なんよ。
english: That's why this is what I was talking about earlier, "something that looks like it".

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
タイムカプセルのメモっぽい
何かってことか……。
english: So it's something that looks like a memo for the time capsule...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
これがそうなん？
メモいうより……地図に見えやん？
english: This is it? Rather than a memo... doesn't it look like a map?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……というより暗号？
english: ...Or rather, a code?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
暗号やったら慎ちゃん向きやな。
これ、意味わかる？
english: If it's a code, that's right up Shin-chan's alley. Do you know what this means?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
冷静に考えてみろ。
これを描いたのは潮やぞ。
english: Think about it calmly. The one who drew this was Ushio, you know.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
潮が暗号なんて高度なモン
描けると思うか？
english: Do you think Ushio could draw something as advanced as a code?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 痛っ！
english: Ow!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
慎平！
あんまりふざけたこと言うたら叩くで！
english: Shinpei! If you say too much nonsense, I'm gonna hit you!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 叩いてから言うな！
english: Don't say that *after* you hit me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: てか、なんなんコレ。
english: Seriously though, what is this.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うーんと、左のこれは木ィやんな？
english: Hmmm, this thing on the left is a tree, right?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: うん、たぶん。
english: Yeah, probably.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: たぶんって、おまえが書いたんやろ。
english: "Probably"? You're the one who drew it.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: なんか言うた？
english: Did you say something?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: な、なんも言うてへん！
english: I-I didn't say anything!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
木ィが何本か並んでて……
そのうち一本の木ィから線が伸びとる。
english: There are several trees lined up... And a line is extending from one of those trees.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
こっちは、猫……だよね？
ふふ、かわいいな。
english: And this one is... a cat, right? Hehe, it's cute.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: せやろ～？
english: Right~?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （これ、可愛いのか？）
english: (Is this cute?)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
慎平。
なんか文句あるん？
english: Shinpei. Do you have some kind of complaint?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: なんも言ってへんやろ！
english: I haven't said anything!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっと、猫ちゃんが同じように
線で繋がってるみたいだけど……。
english: Um, it looks like the cat is also connected by a line in the same way...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
その線と繋がってる、
こっちの丸いのは何やろ？
お姉ちゃんでもわからんの？
english: What is this round thing here that's connected to those lines? Do you not know either, Sis?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ええっと……なんや、コレ？
慎平、解読できやんの？
english: Ummm... what is this? Can you decode it, Shinpei?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
おまえが書いたんやろ。
自分で書いたもんの内容もわからんのか？
english: You wrote it. You don't even know the contents of what you wrote yourself?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
しゃあないやん。
これ描いたん、えらい昔のことやもん。
english: It can't be helped. I drew this a really long time ago.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なあ、これ石ころとちゃう？
english: Hey, isn't this a pebble?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: なんでそう思うん？
english: Why do you think that?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うまく言えやんけど、
お姉ちゃんなら石をこう描くんと
ちゃうかなって。
english: I can't explain it well, but I just feel like Sis would draw a rock like this.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ……さすが姉妹やな。
english: ...As expected of sisters.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: じゃあ、これが石ころだとすると……。
english: Then, assuming this is a pebble...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
木と黒猫と石ころが線で繋がってて、
その三角形の中心にあるもの――
english: The tree, the black cat, and the pebble are connected by lines, and the thing in the center of that triangle--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: これは……貝殻か？
english: Is this... a seashell?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
english: Ah…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
貝殻……？
タイムカプセルとなにか関係が
あるのかな？
english: A seashell...? I wonder if it has something to do with the time capsule?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 澪、妹としてどう見る？
english: Mio, what do you think as a sister?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そない言われても……。
お姉ちゃんたまに人間離れした発想するし。
english: Even if you ask me that... Sis sometimes has ideas that are out of this world.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 確かに……。
english: That's true…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 痛っ！　だからなんで叩くんなよ！
english: Ow! Seriously, why are you hitting me!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
慎平が馬鹿にしたようなこと
言うからやろ！
english: Because you're saying things making fun of me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 言うたのは澪やろ！
english: Mio was the one who said it!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
可愛い妹を叩け言うんか！
この人でなし！
english: Are you telling me to hit my cute little sister! You monster!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: オレならええんか！？
english: So it's fine to hit me!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
慎平は耐性ついてるやん。
昔から叩かれまくってるし。
english: You've built up a resistance to it, Shinpei. You've been getting hit constantly since way back when.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ……ああ、そりゃあな。
english: ...Yeah, I suppose.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、そこで納得したら
アカンと思うで？
english: Shin-chan, I don't think you should just accept that, you know?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あはは、網代くんと小舟さんは、
本当に仲がいいんだね。
english: Ahaha, Ajiro-kun and Kofune-san really are close, aren't they.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、昔からなにも変わってない。
english: Yeah, nothing's changed since the old days.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
で、どないする？
とりあえず、
木ィか猫か石ころ探してみる？
english: So, what do we do? For now, should we try looking for a tree, a cat, or a pebble?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 途方もない作業になりそうやな……。
english: That sounds like an endless task...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
島にはそこかしこに森や山があるし、
石や猫は動いちゃうもんね。
english: There are forests and mountains everywhere on the island, and stones and cats can move, after all.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それより、なんで
タイムカプセルの場所が貝殻なん？
english: More importantly, why is the location of the time capsule a seashell?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 普通はバツ印とかよな。
english: Normally it would be an X mark or something, right.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: それはまぁ……別にええやろ。
english: That's, well... it doesn't really matter, does it.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
せやから、
細かいコトはもうええねん。
english: Like I said, that's enough about the minor details.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
とにかくヒントは見つかったんや！
後は行動あるのみ！
english: Anyway, we found a hint! Now all that's left is to take action!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
だから、どこに行けばいいのか、
わからんて言うてるやろ！
english: That's why I'm telling you we don't know where we're supposed to go!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
まずは行動や！
島のそれっぽい場所手当たり次第
回ればエエやん。
english: Action comes first! We just have to go around all the likely places on the island one by one.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
デタラメに歩き回っても、
仕方ないやろ。
english: Wandering around randomly isn't going to help, you know.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
慎平は考えすぎや。
難しい本ばっか読んどるせいやな。
english: You overthink things, Shinpei. It's because you're always reading difficult books.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: おまえは考えなさすぎやろ！
english: You don't think *enough*!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
またコレや……。
二人ともケンカしすぎ。
english: This again... You two fight too much.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
仲いいんだね。
昔からこんな感じだったの？
english: They're really close, aren't they. Were they always like this?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ええ、ずーっとこうやったんです。
２年前となんも変わってやん。
english: Yes, they've been like this forever. Nothing has changed from two years ago.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ホンマ大概にしてほしわ……。
english: I really wish they'd give it a rest...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
とにかく行こら！
澪もかおりちゃんも、早よせな置いてくで！
english: Anyway, let's go! Mio and Kaori-chan, hurry up or we're leaving you behind!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ったく……。
澪と小弓場さんもそれでいい？
english: Good grief... Are you okay with this, Mio and Koyuba-san?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん！
行こ、かおりちゃん。
english: Yeah! Let's go, Kaori-chan.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そうだね……。
うん、行こうか。
english: Right... Yeah, let's go.

japanese: 7.島中を巡って
english: 7. Scouring the Island

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
やっと着いたでェ、タカノス山！
あのメモの場所、
絶対ここで間違いないわ！
english: We finally made it, Mt. Takanosu! The location on that memo, it's definitely here, no mistake!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
おまえ、他のとこ行った時も、
同じこと言うてたやろ。
english: You were saying the exact same thing when we went to the other places, too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
アランの畑に行った時も、
虎島に行った時も、
<color=#GF_TIPS_044>深蛇池</color>に行った時もな。
english: When we went to Alain's field, when we went to Torashima, and even when we went to <color=#GF_TIPS_044>Shinja Marsh</color>.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
島中歩き回って、もうクタクタや……。
なあ、かおりちゃん。
english: We've walked all over the island, and I'm exhausted... Right, Kaori-chan?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あはは……。
けっこうあちこち歩いたもんねー。
english: Ahaha... We really did walk all over the place.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
だから、今度こそ本命やって！
ほら、このメモ見てみィ！
english: I'm telling you, this time it's the real deal! Look, take a look at this memo!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
さっき思い出したんよ。
この猫の絵は、タカノス山によくおった
黒猫のことやったんや。
english: I just remembered earlier. This drawing of a cat was of the black cat that used to hang around Mt. Takanosu.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ほら、昔、
野外実習で来た時もおったやろ？
覚えてやん？
english: See, remember when we came here for an outdoor class a long time ago? Don't you remember?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あっ……！
私、覚えてる！
english:
Oh…!
I remember!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
岩場のところで日向ぼっこしてたコだよね？
ちょうど黒猫が出てくる本を読んだ後だったから、
よく覚えてるの。
english: It was the one sunbathing by the rocks, right? I had just finished reading a book with a black cat in it, so I remember it well.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そうそう！
で、私がその猫撫でたろ思て近づいたら、
斜面で足すべらせてしもてなァ。
english: Yeah, exactly! And when I got closer to try and pet that cat, I ended up slipping on the slope.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
……思い出した。
それオレが助けに行ったんやった。
そんで二人して怒られて。
english: ...I remember now. I was the one who went to help you then. And then we both got scolded.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんて、
いっつも慎ちゃんに迷惑かけてやん？
english: You're always causing trouble for Shin-chan, aren't you, Sis?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あれは慎平が「ウシオォッ！」って
大声出したから先生にバレてしもたんや。
english: That was because Shinpei yelled "Ushiooo!" so loudly that the teacher found out.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: おまえなァ……。
english: You...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
それよりこのメモにあるこっちの石！
これもただの石ころやないで？
慎平が投げた石や！
english: More importantly, this stone here on the memo! This isn't just any pebble, either! It's the stone Shinpei threw!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: え、オレが？
english: Eh, I did?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
せや、あっちの木が並んどるとこ。
あっこにリスがおったんよ。
english: Yeah, over there where the trees are lined up. There was a squirrel there.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
その子に蛇が近づいてたん、
慎平が気づいてなァ。
石投げて、その蛇追っ払ったんや。
english: Shinpei noticed that a snake was approaching it. He threw a stone and chased the snake away.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ふふ……網代くんらしいね。
english: Hehe... that's so like Ajiro-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
う～ん……そっちの話は、
覚えてやんわ……。
english: Hmmm... I don't really remember that story...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほな、このメモの木ィの絵は、
あそこに並んでる立ち木ってこと？
english: So, the drawing of the tree on this memo refers to those standing trees over there?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
言われてみれば……
そう見えなくもない、か？
english: Now that you mention it... I suppose it doesn't *not* look like that?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
名推理やろ？
このメモはタカノス山の地図やったんや！
english: Great deduction, right? This memo was a map of Mt. Takanosu!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そもそもメモ書いたんお姉ちゃんやん。
なんで推理せなアカンねん。
english: You're the one who wrote the memo in the first place, Sis. Why do you have to deduce it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
だいたい、もっと早く思い出してくれてたら、
虎島とか行く必要なかったやろ……。
english: Besides, if you had remembered earlier, we wouldn't have needed to go to Torashima and all those other places...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そういう苦労があるから、
正解の喜びってもんがあるんよ。
english: It's because of struggles like that that you can feel the joy of getting the right answer.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
それらしいこと言うてるけど、
ここもアカンかったら別の場所へ行くつもり
やっただけなんとちゃうか？
english: You're saying something that sounds plausible, but weren't you just planning to go somewhere else if this place was a bust too?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: まあ、それは否定せんけど。
english: Well, I won't deny that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃんてホンマ考えなしやな。
english: You really don't think things through, Sis.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 臨機応変って言うてや！
english: Call it being adaptable!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ハァ～……
巻き込まれる方の身にもなってくれ。
english: *Sigh*... Try putting yourself in the shoes of the people getting dragged into it.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……ふふっ！
english: …Hehe!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ははっ、あはははは！
english: Haha, ahahahahaha!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: こ、小弓場さん？
english: K-Koyuba-san?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふふっ、ごめんなさい！
面白くって、つい！
三人とも、すっごく楽しそうだね。
english: Hehe, I'm sorry! It was just so funny, I couldn't help it! You three look like you're having so much fun.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
私らいつもこんな感じやで。
なあ、慎平。
english: We're always like this. Right, Shinpei?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ああ、まあな。
english: Yeah, pretty much.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（とりあえず……小弓場さんが、
　楽しんでくれてるみたいで良かった）
english: (Anyway... I'm glad Koyuba-san seems to be having fun.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（最初は少し固い感じだったけど、
　今は表情も穏やかになった気がする）
english: (She seemed a bit stiff at first, but now her expression seems much more relaxed.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（そう考えたら……
　島中を西へ東へ行ったり来たりしたんも
　無駄やなかったんかもな）
english: (Thinking about it that way... going back and forth all over the island might not have been a waste after all.)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
とにかく、この三つのポイントの真ん中に
お宝があるのは間違いない！
english: Anyway, there's no doubt that the treasure is right in the middle of these three points!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あとはタイムカプセルの場所を特定して
掘り出すだけや！
慎平、持ってきたシャベル出しといてな！
english: Now all we have to do is pinpoint the location of the time capsule and dig it up! Shinpei, get out the shovel you brought!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: はいはい。
english: Yeah, yeah.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……あっ！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えっ？　どうかしたん？
english: Huh? Did something happen?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、ううん、なんでもない……。
私たちもタイムカプセル探しにいこっか。
english: N-No, it's nothing... Let's go look for the time capsule too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そうやな。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ほら、もうあとちょっとやで。
丘の上はすぐそこや。
english: Look, we're almost there. The top of the hill is just ahead.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
みんな、足元に気ィつけや。
このあたり斜面やし、滑りやすいで！
english: Everyone, watch your step. This area is a slope, and it's slippery!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ひゃあっ！
english: Hyaa!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: って、おまえが気をつけろよ。
english: Hey, you're the one who needs to be careful.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
今のは悪い見本や！
ほな、先行ってるで！
english: That was a bad example! Anyway, I'm going on ahead!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ～、なんか私、
ホンマに探検しちゃあるような
気分になってきたわ。
english: Ah~, I'm starting to feel like we're really on an expedition or something.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 昔もようこんな風に遊んでたなァ。
english: We used to play like this a lot in the past too, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
そうやったな。
窓も一緒になって、砲台跡とかあの辺で、
よう探検ごっこや鬼ごっこしてたわ。
english: We sure did. Sou would join us too, and we'd play make-believe explorers or tag around the gun battery ruins and places like that.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ふ～ん……網代くんたちって、
そんなことして遊んでたんだね。
english: Hmm... so you guys used to play like that, Ajiro-kun.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 澪ォ、ちょっと来てェな！
english: Mio, come here for a second!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんやの、お姉ちゃん！？
english: What is it, Sis!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
潮のやつ、いっつもこんな感じやったなァ。
秘密基地作るんやとか言うて、
よう引っ張りまわされたもんやわ。
english: Ushio was always like this, huh. Saying we were going to make a secret base, and dragging us all over the place.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ふふっ、なんか目に浮かぶかも。
english: Hehe, I feel like I can picture it.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私も……あの頃から今くらい
積極的になれてたら、
網代くんたちと一緒に――
english: If I... had been as proactive back then as I am now, I could have been with Ajiro-kun and the others--

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……きゃっ！？

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 危ないッ！！
english: Look out!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ふう、危なかったな。
大丈夫？
english:
Phew, that was close.
Are you okay?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うん……ありがとう。
english: Y-Yeah... thank you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
この辺すべりやすいから、
気ィつけないとな。
english: It's slippery around here, so we have to be careful.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
小舟さんにも言われたばかりなのに……。
ごめんなさい。
english: Even though Kofune-san just warned us about it... I'm sorry.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
謝る必要なんてないって。
この辺り、ぬかるんでるし。
english: You don't need to apologize. It's muddy around here, anyway.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
それよりも怪我はない？
小弓場さんに怪我なんてさせたら、
大事やろ。
english: More importantly, are you hurt? If Koyuba-san were to get hurt, it would be a huge deal.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
だ、大丈夫だよ。
網代くんが受け止めてくれたおかげ。
english: I-I'm fine. Thanks to you catching me, Ajiro-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そっか、それならよかった。
english: I see, that's good then.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、あの、えっと……。
english: U-Um, well...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ん？　どうした？
english: Huh? What's wrong?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: えっと、ありがとう。
english: Um, thank you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: お礼を言われるような事じゃないって。
english: It's nothing to thank me for.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 嬉しかったし……それに……。
english: I was happy... and besides...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あの頃も……そうだったから。
english: It was... like that back then, too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ううん、なんでもない！
それよりも……。
english: No, it's nothing! More importantly...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ん？
english: Huh?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: もう大丈夫だから、離して貰えると……。
english: I'm okay now, so if you could let go...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あ、ああ！　ごめん！
ひ、一人で立てる？
english: A-Ah! Sorry! C-Can you stand on your own?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うん、なんとか……きゃ！
english: Y-Yeah, somehow... kya!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ハハハ、足が滑って無理そうやね。
english: Hahaha, looks like you're slipping and it's not going to work.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ごめんなさい。
english: I'm sorry.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: じゃあ、手ェ貸すから。
english: Then, I'll lend you a hand.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、ありがと……。
english: Ah, thank you...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
歩きやすいとこに出るまでは、
オレの腕に捕まってなよ。
english: Hold onto my arm until we get somewhere easier to walk.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、ありがとう……。
english: Th-Thank you...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
慎平ェ、何してるん！
早よこっち来ィ！
english: Shinpei, what are you doing! Hurry up and come over here!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 潮が呼んでる。行こか。
english: Ushio is calling. Let's go.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うん。
english: Y-Yeah.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
はぁ～、結局見つけられやんかったなァ。
タイムカプセル。
english: *Sigh*~, we couldn't find it in the end, huh. The time capsule.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 絶対あの辺やと思たんやけど……。
english: I was sure it was around there...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
もう諦めてくれ……。
これ以上穴掘ったら、
明日は全身筋肉痛で動けやんわ。
english: Just give up already... If we dig any more holes, I won't be able to move tomorrow from full-body muscle soreness.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ゴメンな、かおりちゃん。
タイムカプセル見つけられやんで。
english: Sorry, Kaori-chan. We couldn't find the time capsule.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それに……ライブ前やのに、
変に疲れさせてしもて。
english: Plus... even though it's before your live performance, we ended up making you unnecessarily tired.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ううん、全然気にしてないよ！
すっごく楽しかったもん。
english: No, I don't mind at all! It was so much fun.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: でも、これじゃ思い出が……。
english: But, at this rate, your memories...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
小舟さん、言ってたでしょ？
思い出がないなら一緒に作ればいいって。
english: Kofune-san, you said it yourself, didn't you? If you don't have any memories, we can just make them together.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
本当にその通りになったよ。
今日はみんなとの思い出、
ちゃんと作れたもん。
english: It really turned out just like that. I was able to properly make memories with everyone today.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
一緒に島中あちこち探索して、
宝探しみたいな冒険して……。
english: Exploring all over the island together, going on an adventure like a treasure hunt...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 私、すっごく楽しかった！！
english: I had so much fun!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: かおりちゃん……。
english: Kaori-chan...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私ね……この島にいた頃、
一人で過ごすことが多かったって言ったよね。
english: You know... I said earlier that when I lived on this island, I spent a lot of time alone, right.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あ……うん。
english: Ah... yeah.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
日都ヶ島で暮らしてた頃は、
寂しい思いをすることが多かった。
english: When I lived on Hitogashima, I often felt lonely.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: でも、今日は違ってたの。
english: But, today was different.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今日一日、小舟さんと網代くん、
それに澪ちゃんが付き合ってくれて、
本当にうれしかった。
english: I was really happy that Kofune-san, Ajiro-kun, and Mio-chan kept me company all day today.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
楽しい気持ちで島を巡って、
昔は気づけなかったいろんな島の魅力を
知ることができたし……。
english: I was able to tour the island with a happy feeling, and learn about various charms of the island that I hadn't noticed in the past...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
この気持ちがあれば、
トークショーでも日都ヶ島の魅力を
ちゃんと伝えられると思う。
english: With these feelings, I think I'll be able to properly convey the charm of Hitogashima at the talk show.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: だから……ありがとう！
english: So... thank you!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
みんなのおかげで
今日という日が、とても楽しく思い出深い
一日になりました！
english: Thanks to everyone, today has become a very fun and memorable day!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 小弓場さん……。
english: Koyuba-san...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （気のせいなんかじゃないな）
english: (It's not just my imagination.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（最初に会った時より、
　ずっと笑顔が輝いて見える）
english: (Her smile looks so much brighter than when we first met.)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そっか……。
それなら良かった！
english: I see... I'm glad to hear that!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
まあ、全部私の計算通りやけどな！
わざわざ島中を巡った甲斐があったわ。
english: Well, it was all according to my calculations! It was worth going out of our way to tour the whole island.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
エエように言うなって。
下手したら連れ回しただけで
終わったかもしれんのに。
english: Don't make it sound so good. If things had gone wrong, it might have just ended with us dragging her around.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ホンマや。
ライブが中止になっとったら、
どうするつもりやったん？
english: Seriously. What were you planning to do if the live performance ended up getting canceled?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あはは、そんときはそんときや！
なっ、かおりちゃん？
english: Ahaha, we'd cross that bridge when we come to it! Right, Kaori-chan?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん！　ホントそう！
english: Yeah! Exactly!

japanese: 8.何年も先の話
english: 8. Years From Now

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あ～、お腹すいた～。
帰ったら慎平のカレー食べさせてや。
english: Ah~, I'm hungry~. Let me eat your curry when we get back, Shinpei.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あんなぁ、オレ今日帰ってきたばっかやぞ？
島中引っ張りまわした挙げ句、
メシまで作らせるつもりなんか？
english: Hey, I just got back today, you know? After dragging me all over the island, you're going to make me cook on top of that?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
これくらいで、なに言うてるん。
島出てって体力落ちてしもたんと違う？
english: What are you saying over something like this. Didn't your stamina drop after leaving the island?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: おまえなぁ……。
english: You...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
まあ、嫌なら別にええけど。
あー、久しぶりに慎平のカレー食べたかったなァ。
english: Well, if you don't want to, that's fine. Ah~, I really wanted to eat Shinpei's curry for the first time in a while.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
わかった、わかったよ。
でもおまえも手伝えよ。
english: Alright, alright. But you have to help too.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
やった～っ！
楽しみにしとこ～っと！
english: Yay~! I'm going to look forward to it~!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ホンマお姉ちゃんに甘いんやから。
ねえ、かおりちゃん。
english: He's really soft on Sis. Right, Kaori-chan.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ふふっ、本当だね……。
english: Hehe, that's true…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: （そう、あの頃からずっと……）
english: (Yes, ever since back then...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（だから……今日は良かった。
　タイムカプセルが見つからなくて）
english: (That's why... it's a good thing that we didn't find the time capsule today.)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: （だって……）
english: (Because...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（あのタイムカプセルに入れてたのは、
　網代くんへの……<color=#GF_TIPS_074>ラブレター</color>だったから）
english: (What I put in that time capsule was... a <color=#GF_TIPS_074>love letter</color> to Ajiro-kun.)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（一生懸命に書いたけど、結局渡せなかった手紙。
　あの頃の私には、そんな勇気が出せなかった）
english: (A letter I wrote with all my might, but couldn't give to him in the end. I couldn't muster up that kind of courage back then.)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（時が経って大人になった私なら
　渡せるかもと思って……
　それで、あの箱にしまったんだよね）
english: (I thought that maybe the adult me, after time had passed, would be able to give it to him... And that's why I put it in that box.)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（でも……。
　本当はわかってたんだ、私）
english: (But... I actually already knew.)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（きっと大人になっても渡せる日は来ない。
　だって……）
english: (The day I can give it to him will surely never come, even when I'm an adult. Because...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（だって、網代くんの視線の先には、
　いつも小舟さんがいたから）
english: (Because Kofune-san was always at the end of Ajiro-kun's gaze.)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（それは大人になっても変わらないって、
　私、わかってたんだと思う……）
english: (I think I knew... that wouldn't change even when we became adults...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（もしもいつか、本当にタイムカプセルを
　開く日が来るとしたら……）
english: (If the day ever truly comes when we open the time capsule...)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（そのとき私は、
　網代くんに何を伝えるんだろう？）
english: (What will I tell Ajiro-kun then?)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
この想い……
振り切るのにあと何年かかるかな。
english: I wonder how many more years it will take... for me to shake off these feelings.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えっ、なんか言うた？
english: Huh, did you say something?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ううん、な～んにも！
english: Nope, nothing at all!

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese:
キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_EPILOGIE_KAO>ｅｐｉｌｏｇｕｅ：小弓場かおり</color>】を
入手しました。
english: Key TIPS [<color=#GF_KEY_EPILOGIE_KAO>epilogue: Kaori Koyuba</color>] obtained.

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?

english: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?

english: July 22

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ごめんよ……。
勝手に東京、出てったりして……。
english: I'm sorry... For leaving for Tokyo all on my own...

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
私も……ごめん。
見送り行かんくて……。
english: I'm the one... who should be sorry. For not going to see you off...

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あーあ、お姉ちゃん……。
殴るんちごたん？
english: Jeez, Sis... Weren't you going to hit him?

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ま、ええか。
english: Well, whatever.

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんとお姉ちゃんが、
仲良うしてくれた方が……。
english: It's better if Shin-chan and Sis... get along well, anyway...

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: （ホンマに……その方がええんかな？）
english: (Is it really... better that way?)

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
（今のあの二人を見て嬉しく思う。
　その気持ちに嘘や偽りはあらへん）
english: (I feel happy seeing those two right now. There's no lie or falsehood in that feeling.)

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
（でも……なんでやろ？
　素直に喜べやん気持ちもある……）
english: (But... I wonder why? There's also a part of me that can't be genuinely happy about it...)

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……お父さんから？
english: ...From Dad?

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
あァ、澪。
どうやそっちは？
english: Ah, Mio. How are things over there?

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
慎平、いきなり飛び出してもたやろ。
心配でよォ……。
english: Shinpei just suddenly ran off, right. I was worried...

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あァ、大丈夫。
ちゃんと追いついたから。
english: Ah, it's fine. I caught up to him.

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 今はお姉ちゃんと話しちゃあるよ。
english: He's talking with Sis right now.

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
おォ！
そんなら良かったで。
english: Oh! That's good, then.

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ごめん、お店空けてしもて。
すぐ戻るわ。
english: Sorry for leaving the restaurant. I'll be back soon.

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
急がんでええやしょ。
慎平と話したかったんやろ？
english: You don't have to hurry. You wanted to talk to Shinpei, right?

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
久しぶりやさけ、

english: Shin-chan, Sis. Tokiko called me out, so is it okay if I step out for a bit?

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
トキちゃん？
何の用事なん？
english: Toki-chan? What does she want?

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
わからんけど……
あッ、私の分のカレーは残しといてな。
english: I don't know, but... Ah, make sure to save my portion of curry.

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ああ、もちろん。
遅くならんよう気ィつけてな。
english: Yeah, of course. Be careful not to be out too late.

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん、ありがとう。
カレーは帰ってからのお楽しみにしとく。
私がおらんでも仲良くしててな。
english: Yeah, thanks. I'll look forward to the curry when I get back. Play nice while I'm gone.

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そ、それはどうやろ！？
慎平は私を怒らせる才能があるからな！
english: W-We'll see about that!? Shinpei has a talent for making me mad, after all!

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
まあ、心配いらんよ。
こっちはなんとかやっとく。
english: Well, don't worry. We'll manage somehow here.

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん、ほな行ってくる。
english: Yeah, I'll be going then.

chapter: 1. Weren't You Going to Hit Him?
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
（ホンマは心配なんか、
　全然してやんけどな……）
english: (I'm not actually worried about them at all, though...)

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
japanese: 2.伝えられない二人、伝える二人
english: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 澪、お待たせ。
english: Mio, sorry to keep you waiting.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ、トキコ。
english: Ah, Tokiko.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: って、窓くんも？
english: Wait, Sou-kun too?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
よう、澪ちゃん！
ええ夜やな！
english: Yo, Mio-chan! Nice night, huh!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 急にゴメンな。
english: Sorry for calling you out so suddenly.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
別にええよ。
うちまで来てくれたんやし。
english: It's fine. You came all the way to my place, after all.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも場所だけ言うてくれたら、
私がそこまで行ったのに。
english: But if you had just told me the location, I would have gone there.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
呼び出したのはこっちやもん。
私が出向いてくるんが当然やろ。
english: We're the ones who called you out. It's only natural that we come to you.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: でも、なんで窓くんまでおるん？
english: But why is Sou-kun here too?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お兄ちゃん、私らの電話盗み聞きして
ついてきよったんよ。
english: My brother eavesdropped on our phone call and followed me.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: はぁっ！？
english: Hah!?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: え、そうなん？
english: Eh, is that so?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
た、たまたま聞こえただけや！
盗み聞きなんて真似、
オレがするわけあるかいな！
english: I-I just happened to overhear it! There's no way I'd do something like eavesdrop!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
それにほら、夜に澪ちゃんを
出歩かせるんも危ないやろ？
オレがおった方が安心やろ思て……。
english: Besides, look, it's dangerous to have Mio-chan walking around at night, right? I thought it would be safer if I was here...

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 私のことは心配しやんのに、よう言うなァ。
english: You don't even worry about me, yet you say that?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そ、そんなことないでェッ！
ちゃんと、おまえのことも心配して――
english: Th-That's not true! I was definitely worrying about you too...

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
はいはい。
お兄ちゃんはもう黙っちゃって。
話がややこしなる。
english: Alright, alright. Older brother, just shut up. You're making things complicated.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そうや、話したいことってなんなん？
english: Yeah, what did you want to talk about?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
あ……うん。
ちょっと歩きながら話そか。
english:
Ah… okay.
Let's walk while we talk.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ああ、別にええけど？
english: Yeah, it's fine with me.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 実は、慎平さんが――
english: Actually, Shinpei…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: あのな、澪ちゃん！！
english: Hey, Mio!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
悩みがあるんやったらオレが相談乗っちゃる！
せやから、なんでも言うてくれ！！
english:
If you have a problem, I'll listen!
So just tell me anything!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
えっ、なに？
急になんなん？
english: Huh? What's going on all of a sudden?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お兄ちゃん……。
黙っといてって言わんかった？
english: Older brother… didn't I tell you to be quiet?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: すっ、すまん……つい！
english: S-Sorry… I just couldn't help it!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
悩みって言われても。
私、別になんも悩んでへんで？
english: Even if you ask about my problems... I'm not really troubled by anything, you know?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
あんな、今日、慎平さんに聞かれたんよ。
澪の様子がおかしいけど、
なんかあったんかって……。
english:
You know, today Shinpei asked me.
He said he noticed something was off with you…
Did something happen?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ、慎ちゃんが？
english: Huh, Shinpei?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ、せや。
トキコにメールあってなァ。
english: Yeah, he sent Tokiko a message.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ちなみにお兄ちゃんがそのことを知ってるんは、
私のメールを盗み見たからなんよ。
english:
By the way, my older brother found out because
he snooped on my messages.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
た、たまたま見えてもただけや！
盗み見なんて真似、
オレがするわけあるかいな！
english:
I-I just happened to see it!
Snooping? That's not something I'd do!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: たまたまが一日に二度も起きるもんかなぁ。
english:
Can something that happens twice in a day really be
just a coincidence?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: （慎ちゃんがトキコに……）
english: (Shinpei sent a message to Tokiko…)

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: （私、そんなにいつもと違って見えてたんかな）
english: (Have I been acting so different lately?)

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
（まあ、少なくとも……
　慎ちゃんにはそう見えてたってことか）
english:
(Well, at least…
Shinpei saw it that way.)

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なぁ、澪ちゃん。
悩みっちゅうんは、
もしかして慎平のことなんか？
english:
Hey, Mio.
Is the problem about Shinpei?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お兄ちゃん！！
いきなりそんなこと……。
english:
Older brother!! 
Why'd you say that all of a sudden?!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
オレはストレートしか投げられへん。
ド直球が取り柄の男や。
english:
I only throw straight pitches.
That's my specialty.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: アホな言い訳しやんで！
english: Stop making up excuses!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ええんよ、トキコ。
english: It's fine, Tokiko.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: Mio…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: むしろ、窓くんはすごいと思うわ。
english: Actually, I think Sou's pretty amazing.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
どんなに言いにくいことでも、
言うべき時に言えるんやもん。
english:
No matter how hard it is to say,
you can say it when it's time.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ありがとな、澪ちゃん。
english: Thanks, Mio.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……それに、窓くんが言った通りやし。
english: Besides, it's just like Sou said.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そっか、やっぱり慎平のことやったか。
english: I guess it was about Shinpei after all.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
澪ちゃん、もっかい言っとくわ。
相談したいことがあったら、
どんなことでも話してや。
english:
Mio, I'll say it again.
If you have something to talk about,
just tell me anything.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なんもかも全部話して、
スッキリするんもアリやと思うで？
english:
Tell me everything,
and you'll feel better.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
もちろん、
慎平には絶対言わんから安心しィ。
english:
Of course,
I won't tell Shinpei a thing.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん……ありがとう。
english: Yeah… thanks.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
もう少し時間かかりそうやね。
海岸にでも出て話そか。
english:
It looks like we'll need more time.
Let's go to the beach and talk.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おっし！
なんでも言ってェな、澪ちゃん！
ばっちり受け止めちゃるで！
english:
Right on!
Just tell me anything, Mio!
I'll definitely listen!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ちょっと待って。
お兄ちゃんは向こう行っといてや。
english:
Wait a second.
Older brother, you should go over there.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
な、なんでや！？
オレかて相談のろ思て――
english: W-Why?! I was going to help you out too...

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お願いやから！
ちょっとの間でええんよ。
english:
Please!
Just for a little while.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: Ah, okay…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんか窓くんに悪いわ……。
english: I feel bad for Sou…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: でも、この方が気ィが楽やろ？
english: But this way, it's easier for you, right?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: う、うん……。
english: Y-Yeah…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
じゃあ続けよか。
話せることは全部話してみ。
english:
Then let's continue.
Tell me everything you can.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
トキコは……慎ちゃんが東京出る時、
お姉ちゃんと喧嘩別れになってたん
知ってるやろ？
english: Tokiko... you know that when Shinpei left for Tokyo, he and my sister parted on bad terms, right?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
うん、それなりにな。
喧嘩別れしたまま、
ずっと冷戦状態やったんやろ？
english: Yeah, more or less. They parted on bad terms and have been in a cold war ever since, right?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そうなんよ。
english: That's right.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
せっかく慎ちゃんが帰ってくんのに、
お姉ちゃん、今朝になっても
「会うたら殴る」とか言うててん。
english:
Even though Shinpei came back,
my sister still said this morning,
"I'll hit him if I see him."

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私は二人が喧嘩する姿見たないし、
仲直りしてほしい思てたから……。
english: I didn't want to see the two of them fight, and I wanted them to make up...

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
二人が楽しそうに話してるとこ見たら
心底ホッとしたし、
嬉しい気持ちになったんや。
english:
When I saw them talking happily,
I felt relieved,
and I was happy.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも、なんなんやろなァ。
嬉しい気持ちのはずやのに、
なんか……胸がざわざわすんねん。
english:
But… why?
Even though I should be happy,
my chest feels all fluttery.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: それってたぶん……。
english: That's probably…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん、私……お姉ちゃんに
嫉妬してるんやろな。
english: Yeah, I think I'm jealous of my sister.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私は……。
english: I…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私は慎ちゃんのことが……、
好きなんやと思う。
english:
I think I…
like Shinpei.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
澪……自分の気持ちに、
素直になれたんやね。
english:
Mio… you've finally been honest
with your own feelings.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そう……なんかな。
english: Yeah… I guess so.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そ、窓くん！？
english: H-Hey, Sou!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お兄ちゃん……！
今の話、聞いとったん！？
english:
Older brother…!
Did you hear that?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
悪い……喉渇いたやろ思て、
飲み物買うてきたんやけど。
english:
Sorry… I thought you were thirsty,
so I went to get a drink.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
えらいタイミングで、
帰ってきてしもたみたいやな。
english: It looks like I came back at a bad time.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
せやから向こう行っといてって、
言うたのに……。
english: That's why I told you to go over there…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
それよか……
さっきの話、ホンマなんか？
english: More importantly... Was what you just said true?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
で、でも慎ちゃんは私のこと、
妹みたいにしか思てやんし！
english:
But Shinpei doesn't see me
as anything more than a sister!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それに、お姉ちゃんと二人きりの時と、
私と二人きりの時では、
慎ちゃんの態度が明らかに違てるし！
english:
Plus, when it's just me and him,
his attitude is completely different
from when it's just my sister and him!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
せやから、もし慎ちゃんに……
私の気持ちを伝えても……。
english:
So if I told Shinpei…
how I feel…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
たぶんなんも進展やてあらへん。
きっと慎ちゃんの目はずっと……
お姉ちゃんに向けられたままや。
english:
It probably wouldn't go anywhere.
He'd still be looking at my sister.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それやったら……
結局なんも言わんまま今まで通りが
一番なんや。
english:
In that case…
it's probably best to just keep things
the way they are.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
せやのに、
嫉妬なんかして……。
english:
But then why do I feel…
jealous?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
二人のことめっちゃ好きやのに、
心から応援できやん……。
ホンマ性格悪いわ。
english:
I really like both of them,
but I can't even genuinely support them…
I'm such a bad person.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そないなことあらへん！
english: That's not true at all!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
澪ちゃんの性格の良さは、
このオレが保証しちゃる！
english: I'll vouch for Mio's good character!

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
シッ……声が大きい。
人に聞かれたらどうするん？
english:
Shhh… your voice is too loud.
What if someone hears?

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: あ……す、すまん。
english: Ah… sorry.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ふふっ……。
english: Hehe…

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
でも……澪の性格がええってのは、
私も同意見や。
english:
But… I agree with you.
Mio's a good person.

chapter: 2. Two Who Can't Convey It, Two Who Can
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
あんな、澪。
