english: Welcome back, Mio.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
し、慎ちゃん……？
なんで？
english: S-Shinpei...? Why are you here?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
窓から電話があったんや。
澪が一人で帰ったけど心配やから
迎えにいってやってほしいって。
english: Sou called. He said he was worried since you came back alone, and asked me to go pick you up.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
窓くんが？
……別に、大丈夫やのに。
english: Sou? ...I'm fine, really.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
しかたないやろ。
澪は女の子なんやからな。
english: Can't be helped. You are a girl, after all.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: （女の子やから……）
english: (Because I'm a girl...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ほな、慎ちゃんも？
english: Then, Shin-chan too?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃんも私のこと心配しとった？
english: You were worried about me too, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そりゃあ……。
english: Of course…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
澪はオレにとって
妹みたいなもんやからな。
家族のこと心配すんのは当然やろ？
english: You're like a sister to me, Mio. Of course I'd worry about family, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……妹かぁ。
まあ、そうやんな。
english:
…A sister, huh?
Well, that makes sense.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ほな帰ろか。
帰ったらカレー用意するわ。
english: Well, let's head back. I'll make curry when we get home.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
食べたら驚くぞ？
今日のカレーは会心の出来やからな。
english: You'll be surprised when you eat it. Today's curry is my masterpiece.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
へえ、そんなに良くできたん？
お姉ちゃんと一緒に作ったから？
english: Wow, it turned out that well? Because you made it with my sister?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
いやいや、それはないやろ。
料理中、潮はオレにちょっかい出して、
足引っ張ってばっかやったからなァ。
english: No, no, that's definitely not it. While we were cooking, Ushio kept messing with me and holding me back.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: でも楽しかったやろ？
english: But it was fun, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あ、ああ、まあ……それはそうやな。
少なくとも退屈はしやんかったわ。
english:
Ah, yeah… I guess that's true.
At least it wasn't boring.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ふふ、そうなんや。
english: Hehe, is that so.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
……澪？
どうかしたんか？
english:
…Mio?
What's wrong?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ありがとう、慎ちゃん。
english: Thanks, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ……やっぱりトキちゃんから聞いとったか。
english: ...So you heard it from Tokiko after all.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん。
私の様子が変やから、
気にかけてくれてたんやて？
english:
Yeah.
Because I was acting strange,
you were worried about me, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あー……まあな。
でも帰ってきた澪の顔見て安心したわ。
english:
Ah… yeah.
But seeing your face when you came back made me feel better.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
トキちゃんとなに話したかしらんけど、
なんか吹っ切れたみたいやな。
english: I don't know what you and Tokiko talked about, but you look like you've moved past whatever it was.

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Ah…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ホンマ慎ちゃんはそういうの、
よう気づくよなァ……。
english:
You really do notice things,
don't you, Shin-chan…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それやのに肝心なことは、
気づけやんねんな。
english: And yet, you can't seem to notice the important things.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 肝心なことて……なんの話なん？
english: The important stuff… what are you talking about?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……気になる？
english: …You're curious?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そりゃァ、まあ。
english: Well… yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
なんも気づけやんまま間違うてしもて、
後悔するんは嫌や。
english: I'd hate to mess up without noticing anything and end up regretting it.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
でも澪が言いたくないことやったら、
言わんでもええぞ？
english:
But if you don't want to say it,
you don't have to.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
せやなァ。
ほんまは言いたなかったんや。
english:
Yeah.
I didn't really want to say it.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんに気づいてもらって、
そんで慎ちゃんから言うてもらえてたら――
english: If you had noticed, and then told me yourself――

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: な～んてねッ。
english: Juuust kidding.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もう、そんなん止めや。
立ち止まってやんで前に進むことにする。
english: Geez, I'm done with that. I'm going to stop standing still and move forward.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
なんて言うか……
いろいろ気づいてやれんくてゴメン。
english: How do I put this... I'm sorry I didn't notice all those things.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
謝ることあらへん。
こっちが勝手に期待しとっただけやから。
english: There's no need to apologize. I was just getting my hopes up on my own.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: じゃあ、聞いてくれる？
english: Then, will you listen?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ああ。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ご、ごめん。
ちょっと待ってな……。
english:
S-sorry.
Wait a second…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なにコレ……めっちゃ緊張する……。
english: What is this... I'm so nervous...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 落ち着くんや……前に進むって決めたやろ。
english: Calm down... I decided I was going to move forward.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もう大丈夫や。
慎ちゃん、心の準備はええ？
english:
I'm okay now.
Are you ready, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: おう。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: （アカン……全然大丈夫ちゃう！）
english: (Oh no... I'm not okay at all!)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
（「心の準備はええ？」とか言うといて、
　まだ躊躇してるとか……）
english: (Asking him 'Are you ready?' and I'm still hesitating...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: （でも……立ち止まったらアカン！）
english: (But... I can't stop here!)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: （勇気を出すんや！）
english: (I have to be brave!)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、私……。
english: Shin-chan, I…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私、慎ちゃんが好き。
大好き。
english: I like you, Shin-chan. I really love you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ええッ！？
english: What?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
オ、オレ？
えっ……マ、マジでオレに言うてんの！？
english: M-Me? Huh... A-Are you seriously saying that to me?!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
他に誰かおる？
ちゃんと「慎ちゃんが」って言うたやん。
english: Who else is there? I clearly said 'Shin-chan'.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: で、でも、なんでオレ！？
english: But why me?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
世の中、オレなんかより
かっこいい男も頭のいい男も山ほどおるし……！
english: There are tons of guys out there who are cooler and smarter than me...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
わざわざオレみたいな、
たいした取り柄もないような――
english: Why would you go out of your way for someone like me, who has no real redeeming qualities――

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: はい、そこまで！
english: Alright, that's enough!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
いくら慎ちゃん本人でも、
私の好きになった慎ちゃんをあんまり
馬鹿にしやんといてくれる？
english: Even if you are Shin-chan himself, can you please not make fun of the Shin-chan I fell for?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ご、ごめん……。
でもホンマにオレなんか……。
english: S-Sorry... But really, someone like me...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そもそも私なんかに告白されたくらいで、
おどおどせんといてよ。
english: To begin with, don't get all flustered just because someone like me confessed to you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
いや、ちょっと待てよ！
おまえこそ「私なんか」とか言うなって！
english: No, wait a second! You shouldn't say 'someone like me' either!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
お、おまえにあんなこと言われたら、
動揺するに決まってるやろ……。
english: O-Of course I'd be flustered if you said something like that to me...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
しかも、こんな急に……
もう、どう反応してええか……。
english: And so suddenly too... I just, don't know how to react...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ほな、いつ言えば良かった？
english: Then, when was I supposed to say it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: Ugh...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんにとっては急やろな。
でも、私にとっては全然急やないねん。
むしろ今までよう黙ってたと思う。
english: It must be sudden for you, Shin-chan. But it's not sudden at all for me. If anything, I think I did a good job keeping quiet until now.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ずっとずっと前から、
この気持ちは変わってへんのやもん。
english: Because this feeling hasn't changed since a long, long time ago.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そ、そっか……。
english: I-I see...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あはは！
慎ちゃん、顔まっかっかやで。
english: Ahaha! Shin-chan, your face is bright red.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: か、からかうなって……。
english: D-Don't tease me...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほな、ちゃんと答え聞かしてや。
忘れてしもたんやったら、もっかい言おか？
english: Then let me hear your answer properly. If you forgot, should I say it again?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えっ、ちょっ――
english: Huh, wait――

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私、慎ちゃんが好き！
大好き！
english: I like you, Shin-chan! I really love you!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
はい！
慎ちゃん、返事はッ！？
english: There! Now Shin-chan, your answer!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: え、ええええええええええ～～！？
english: E-Eeehhhhh~!?

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_EPILOGIE_MIO>ｅｐｉｌｏｇｕｅ：小舟澪</color>】を入手しました。
english: Key TIPS [<color=#GF_KEY_EPILOGIE_MIO>epilogue: Mio Kofune</color>] obtained.

japanese: 1.照れ隠し
english: 1. Hiding Embarrassment

japanese: 7月22日
english: July 22nd

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: Ushio…?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: しんぺェェェェェ～～～ッ！
english: Shinpeeeeee!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（拳を握り締めて……
　エッ、もしかして怒ってる！？）
english: (Clenching her fists... Eh, is she mad?!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: う、ご……ごめっ、ごめん潮っ……！
english: I-I'm sorry… sorry, Ushio…!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
english: ...Ugh... ugh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: (Ushio…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ごめんよ……。
english: I'm sorry…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
勝手に東京……。
出てったりして……。
english: For leaving for Tokyo... All on my own...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 私も……ごめん……。
english: I'm sorry too…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 見送り行かんくて……。
english: For not going to see you off...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: な……なんでこんな泣けてくるんやろ……。
english: W-Why am I crying so much...?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: こ……こんなつもりやなかったのに！
english: I... I didn't plan for this to happen!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
最近見た夢のせいやわ……！
慎平に二度と会えやんようになる夢。
english: It's because of a dream I had recently...! A dream where I'd never be able to see you again, Shinpei.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えっ。
english: Eh.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
悲しいんやけど嬉しい。
ヘンな夢やったなァ……。
english: It was sad, but also happy. It was a weird dream...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （……同じだ）
english: (...It's the same.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （同じ夢を、オレも見ていたような気がする）
english: (I feel like I had the exact same dream too.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 潮、その夢って――
english: Ushio, that dream is――

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なに見つめ合ってるん？
english: Why are you two staring at each other?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
しかも手ェ取り合って
抱き合っちゃあるやて、
なんやドラマのワンシーンみたいやなァ。
english: And you're holding hands and hugging each other. It's like a scene from a drama.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
だ、抱き合ってって……
そんなことしとったか！？
english: H-Hugging...? Were we doing that!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
明らかにしとったで。
なあ、お姉ちゃん？
english: You obviously were. Right, big sister?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
それは、たまたまそう見えてしもた
かもしれやんけど……。
english: It might have just looked like that by coincidence, but...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ホ、ホンマはちゃうねん。
勢い付けすぎて、つんのめって……！
english: N-No, that's not it. I came in too fast and tripped...!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そんで目の前の慎平に
突っ込んでしもただけやねん！
english: And I just ended up crashing into Shinpei who was right in front of me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ……そうやったんか？
english: ...Is that what happened?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ほんまは一発なぐっちゃろ思てたんや。
english: I was actually planning to punch you once.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
しかも、急に抱きしめよるとか信じられやん！
もう二、三発追加したい気分やわ！
english: Plus, I can't believe you suddenly hugged me! I feel like adding two or three more punches!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
け……けどまあ、
素直に帰ってきよったからな。
今回だけは勘弁したる。
english: B-But well, you did come back obediently. I'll let you off the hook this time.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
何言っちゃあるん。
実は慎ちゃんに会えて嬉しいんやろ？
english: What are you talking about? You're actually happy to see Shin-chan, aren't you?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
みっ、澪こそなに言うてるん？
変なこと言わんといて。
english: M-Mio, what are you saying? Don't say weird things.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
嬉しないんやったら、
なんで慎ちゃんに抱きついたん？
english: If you weren't happy, why did you hug Shin-chan?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
つんのめって突っ込んだだけやて
言ってるやろ！
english: I told you I just tripped and crashed into him!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
だいたい慎平が背中に手ェ回したりするさけ、
澪に勘違いされてまうんや！
english: Besides, Shinpei wrapped his arms around my back, so Mio ended up misunderstanding!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ええっ！？
そ、それは、おまえが……。
english: Eh!? T-That's because you...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ～あ、ホンマ素直やないなァ。
もう認めてしもたらええやん。
english: Ah~, you're really not honest. You should just admit it already.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 「思わず抱きしめてしまいました」って。
english: I hugged him without thinking.'

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: だからちゃうって……！
english: I said that's not it...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なあ、お姉ちゃん。
english: Right, big sister?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: う、うう……。
english: U-uh…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ああ～、なんや急にお腹すいてきたわ。
先帰ってるで！
english: Ah~, I'm suddenly getting hungry. I'm heading back first!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ――って、おい！
english: ――Hey, wait!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ハァ、素直やないなァ……。
english: *Sigh*, she's not honest at all...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: じゃあ、私らも戻ろか。
english: Well, should we head back too?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そうやな……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……ふふっ。
english: ...Hehe.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
な、なんや澪？
急にニヤニヤして……。
english: W-What is it, Mio? Grinning all of a sudden...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、目ェちょっと赤いで。
二人とも泣いてたんやろ？
english:
Shin-chan, your eyes are a bit red.
You two were crying, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あ、ああ、実はな。
でも、なんで泣いてたんやろ？
自分でもようわからんわ。
english: A-Ah, actually, yeah. But why was I crying? I don't really know myself.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そんだけ嬉しかったってことなんとちゃう？
本人も気づけてやんかったくらい。
english: Isn't it just because you were that happy? So much so that you didn't even realize it yourself.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（さっきの澪の言葉……
　やけに腑に落ちたというか）
english: (What Mio just said... It somehow really makes sense.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（そうだよな……
　やっぱり、オレ、嬉しかったんやな）
english: (That's right... I really was happy after all.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（電話で声は聞いとった。
　今日会えるのも知っとった）
english: (I heard her voice on the phone. I knew I'd be able to see her today.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（でも潮の顔を見たら……
　心の底から、ものすごく安心した）
english: (But when I saw Ushio's face... I felt incredibly relieved from the bottom of my heart.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （それこそ、本気で涙が出るくらい……）
english: (Enough to literally bring tears to my eyes...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: でも……本当に良かった……。
english: But… I'm really glad…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ、なにが？
english: Huh? What?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: だから――
english: Because――

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あれ……なんやっけ？
english: Huh... what was it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（何だろう、この感覚？
　思い出せそうで、思い出せない）
english: (What is this feeling? I feel like I can almost remember, but I can't.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（でもたしかに……
　たしかにオレは安堵している）
english: (But it's true... I really am relieved.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ほら慎ちゃん、ボーッとしてるヒマあるん？
english: Hey Shin-chan, do you have time to be spacing out?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃん行ってまうで。
早よ追いかけたら？
english: My sister's getting away. Shouldn't you hurry up and chase after her?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
べ、別に追いかけんでも、
行き先はわかってるやろ……。
english: I-I don't need to chase her, we know where she's going...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
も～、慎ちゃんも素直やないなぁ。
照れてる場合ちゃうやろ。
english: Jeez, you're not being honest either, Shin-chan. This is no time to be shy.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: て、照れてやんし！
english: I-I'm not being shy!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
どっちでもええけど、
急がんかったら置いてくで。
english: Either way, if you don't hurry, I'll leave you behind.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あっ、おい、待てって！
english: Ah, hey, wait!

japanese: 2.久しぶりの食卓
english: 2. A Long-Overdue Meal

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あぁ～、めっちゃええニオイ！
慎ちゃんのカレー、久々やァ。
english: Ah~, it smells so good! Shin-chan's curry, it's been a while.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: すまん澪、こっちのサラダも運んでくれるか。
english: Sorry Mio, can you carry this salad over too?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ええよー。
へえ、サラダも美味しそやなァ。
english: Sure thing. Wow, the salad looks delicious too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
今日の晩御飯めっちゃ豪華やね。
なあ、お姉ちゃん？
english: Tonight's dinner is super fancy. Right, big sister?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: そやね……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
２年ぶりの再会記念と、
今晩ここに泊めてもらうお礼も兼ねて
用意したもんやからな。
english: It's to celebrate our reunion after two years, and also as thanks for letting me stay here tonight.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: もちろん味も期待してくれていいぞ。
english: Of course, you can expect the taste to be great too.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: う、うう……。
english: U-Ugh...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんのお父さんとお母さん、
今日は家におらんっていうの、
ホンマやったんやね。
english: So it was true that Shin-chan's dad and mom aren't home today.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
そんなウソついてどうすんねん。
あの二人は大学のシンポジウムで
大阪に行ってるんや。
english: Why would I lie about that? Those two went to Osaka for a university symposium.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
できるだけ長い間、
お姉ちゃんと一緒におるための口実やと思っとったわ。
english: I thought it was an excuse to spend as much time as possible with my sister.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: なぁっ！？
english: What?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: アホ、そんなんとちゃうわ。
english: Idiot, it's nothing like that.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 澪、おかしなこと言わんといて。
english: Mio, don't say weird things.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そもそもお父さんかて、
そないな事情があるから言うて
慎平をうちに泊めやんでも。
english: Besides, even if there were circumstances, Dad didn't have to let Shinpei stay at our place.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ホンマ、余計なことして。
english: Really, doing unnecessary things.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: また、心にもないこと言うてるん？
english: Are you saying things you don't mean again?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ちゃうわ！
めっちゃ心からの本心や！
english: No! It's my true feelings from the bottom of my heart!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
慎平も慎平やで！
少しは遠慮しよとか思わんのか！？
english: And Shinpei is Shinpei too! Don't you ever think about holding back a little?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
いや……でも、せっかくアランが
誘ってくれたんやし。
english: Well... but since Alain went out of his way to invite me.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃん、まだむくれちゃあるん？
昼間からずっとやん。
english: Big sister, are you still sulking? You've been like that since the afternoon.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 別に、むくれてなんか――
english: I'm not sulking or anything――

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あはははは、ほなそろそろ食べよか。
このままやとお姉ちゃん倒れてまうわ。
english: Ahahahaha, well let's eat soon. At this rate, big sister is going to collapse.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
べ、別に倒れてまうほど、
お腹空いてやんし！
english: I-I'm not hungry enough to collapse!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 無理しよってからに……。
english: You're just pushing yourself...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 慎平、何か言うたかァ？
english: Shinpei, did you say something?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: いや、別に？
english: No, not really?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほんま、お姉ちゃんは、
いつになったら素直になるんやら。
english: Honestly, big sister, when are you ever going to be honest?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
みーおー？
それ以上言うたら、
カレー食べさせやんで！
english: Mi-o? If you say anything more, I won't let you have any curry!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんでお姉ちゃんが、
そんなえらそうなこと言うん。
作ったの慎ちゃんやんか。
english: Why are you acting so bossy, big sister? Shin-chan is the one who made it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ほら潮、大盛りにしといたぞ。
大人しく座れって。
english: Here Ushio, I made yours a large portion. Just sit down quietly.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
別に大盛りもいらんし。
そもそも食べへんし！
english: I don't need a large portion. And I'm not even going to eat it anyway!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （まったく……）
english: (Good grief...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 澪は普通盛りやな。
english: Mio, yours is a normal portion.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
う、うん。
ありがとう、慎ちゃん。
english: Y-Yeah. Thanks, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
アランはまだ帰ってきてないんよな。
どこへ行っちゃあるんか知らんけど。
english:
Alain hasn't come back yet, right?
I don't know where he went.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
たぶんまだかかるんとちゃう？
今日は準備に駆り出されて忙しいみたいやし。
english: He'll probably be a while, won't he? He seems busy getting dragged into preparations today.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 準備って、なんの？
english: Preparations for what?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そんなん決まってるやん。
日都神社の夏祭りや。
english: Isn't it obvious? The summer festival at Hitogashima Shrine.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なにやってるん。
スプーン落ちてもたで？
english: What are you doing? You dropped your spoon, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あ、ああ、ごめん。
ちょっと手が滑ってしもた。
english: A-Ah, sorry. My hand just slipped a little.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （なんだ……今の感覚？）
english: (What was that… feeling?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（『夏祭り』って聞いた瞬間、
　まるで全身が粟立ったような……）
english:
(As soon as I heard 'summer festival',
it was like my whole body got goosebumps…)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃん、
代わりのスプーン取ってくれやん？
english: Big sister, can you get me another spoon?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃん？
english: Big sister?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
english: Summer… festival…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （潮も……オレと同じ反応？）
english: (Even Ushio… had the same reaction?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
二人とも、どないしたん？
えらい鳥肌立てて……。
english: What's wrong with both of you? You've got major goosebumps...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なんかようわからんけど、
急に寒気がしたような……。
english: I don't really know, but I suddenly felt a chill...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （やっぱりオレと同じや……）
english: (It really is the same as me...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
も、もしかしたらエアコンの温度設定、
ちょっと低いんかもな。
english: M-Maybe the AC temperature setting is just a bit low.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 別にいつもと変わらんと思うけど。
english: I don't think it's any different from usual.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ、ひょっとして風邪引きかけなんかも。
熱出たりしてやん？
english: Ah, maybe you're catching a cold. Do you have a fever?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: そんなことないと思うけど……。
english: I don't think so…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
慎平、ちょっとおでこ貸してみ。
手当ててみるわ。
english: Shinpei, let me see your forehead. I'll check with my hand.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あ、ああ。
english: A-Ah.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
うん、おでこは熱くない。
私のおでこと同じくらいや。
english: Yeah, your forehead isn't hot. It's about the same as mine.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それ、お姉ちゃんも風邪ひいちゃあるって
ことかもしれへんで。
寒気感じたんやろ？
english: That might mean you're catching a cold too, big sister. You felt a chill, right?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: それやったら澪のおでこと比べてみるわ。
english: In that case, I'll compare it with Mio's forehead.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: うん、同じくらいや。
english: Yeah, it's about the same.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
大丈夫そうやんね？
まあ、熱があっても慎ちゃんのカレー食べれば
大丈夫やろ。
english: You seem fine, right? Well, even if you had a fever, eating Shin-chan's curry would fix you right up.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: な、お姉ちゃん？
english: Right, big sister?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: うん……まあ、そうやね。
english: Yeah… I guess so.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
た、食べモンに罪はあれへんし、しゃあないから
食べたるわ。
english: T-The food didn't do anything wrong, so I guess I'll eat it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: まるでオレには罪があるような言い方やな……。
english: You make it sound like I did do something wrong...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほーら、冷める前に食べよ？
いただきまーす！
english: Come on, let's eat before it gets cold. Itadakimasu!

speaker: 潮と慎平（慎平収録）
japanese: いただきます。
english: Itadakimasu.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
english: So gooood~!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 慎平、カレー作りの腕は落ちてやんようやなァ。
english: Shinpei, it seems your curry-making skills haven't dropped.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: はいはい、ありがとな。
english: Yeah, yeah, thanks.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: べ、別に褒めてやんわ！
english: I-I'm not praising you!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
むしろ、料理学校に行っとって、
明らかな上達が見受けられやんってのは、
どうなんやろなァ？
english: If anything, since you go to a culinary school, isn't it a problem that there's no obvious improvement?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
味が同じなんは当然やろ。
作り方も材料も前と変えてやんし。
english: Of course the taste is the same. I didn't change the recipe or the ingredients.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
隠し味に洒落たもん入れたとか、
そんなんは一切ないんか？
english: You didn't add any fancy secret ingredients or anything like that?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
さっきから、なに言うんてんねん。
お姉ちゃんはこの味が食べたかったんと
ちゃうんか？
english: What are you talking about? Isn't this the taste you wanted to eat, big sister?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: そ、そんなことあらへんし？
english: N-No it's not!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ははは……。
english: Haha…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （さっきの気味の悪い寒気……）
english: (That creepy chill from earlier...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （あれって一体……なんだったんだ？）
english: (What on earth... was that?)

japanese: 3.謎の感覚
english: 3. Mysterious Feeling

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（浜辺で潮と再会した時といい、
　さっきの晩メシの時といい……）
english: (First when I reunited with Ushio on the beach, and then just now during dinner...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （オレ、なんかおかしくないか？）
english: (Is there something wrong with me?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （いや、おかしいのはオレだけじゃなく――）
english: (No, it's not just me that's acting weird――)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん！
english: Shin-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: うわっ！？
english: Whoa!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ご、ごめん！
そない驚くとは思わんくて。
english: S-Sorry! I didn't think you'd be that surprised.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ああ、大丈夫。
ちょっとスマホで調べ物してたから、
余計驚いてしもただけや。
english:
Ah, it's fine.
I was just looking something up on my phone,
so I got startled more than usual.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 何調べてるん？
english: What were you looking up?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: まあ、いろいろや。
english: Well, all sorts of things.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: それより、オレに何か用あったんちゃうの？
english: Anyway, didn't you need something from me?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
用って言うか……
もうすぐお風呂空くて言いにきたったんや。
次、慎ちゃん入って。
english: Well, I guess you could say that... I came to tell you the bath will be open soon. You can go in next, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ああ、ありがとう。
english: Ah, thanks.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
長旅で疲れたやろ？
ゆっくり浸かったらエエわ。
何か必要なモンあったら言うてな。
english: You must be tired from the long trip, right? You should take your time and soak. Let me know if you need anything.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
了解。
そうさせてもらうわ。
english: Got it. I'll do just that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （……なんでだ？）

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（この家に来るのは２年ぶりのはず。
　でも、それなのに……）
english: (It's supposed to be my first time here in two years. And yet...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （つい最近来たような気がして――）
english: (I feel like I was just here recently――)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: うわッ！？
english: Whoa!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: う、潮ッ！？
english: U-Ushio!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なにボーッと歩いてんねん！
ぶつかるとこやったわッ。
english: Why are you walking around spaced out!? We almost crashed into each other.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
おまえもボーッとしとったから、
ぶつかりそうになったんやないか。
english: We almost crashed because you were spacing out too.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
うっさい！
私かて考え事くらいするんや！
english: Shut up! I'm allowed to be lost in thought too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（風呂上がりの熱気と……
　シャンプーの香り……）
english: (The heat from the bath... and... the scent of shampoo...)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ……なっ、なに見ちゃあるん！
english: ...W-What are you staring at!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あ……いや……
風呂入ってたんか。
english: Ah... no... You just got out of the bath.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
せやでッ。
何か文句ある？
english: Yeah. Got a problem with that?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: いや……別にないけど……。
english: No… not really…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: な、なんでモジモジしてるん？
english: W-why are you fidgeting!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: し、してへんし……。
english: I-I'm not!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ……い、言っとくけどなァ！
english: ...J-Just so you know!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
浜辺のアレは違うからな！
私から抱きついたりしてやんから！
english: That thing on the beach was a misunderstanding! It's not like I hugged you or anything!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （潮から抱きついてきたんやろが！）
english: (You definitely hugged me!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（……と言いたいところやけど、
　怒らせてしまったらまた堂々巡りや）
english: (...Is what I want to say, but if I make her mad, we'll just go in circles again.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（せっかくカレーで機嫌を直しかけてたんだ。
　話を変えよう）
english: (She was just starting to get in a better mood after the curry. Let's change the subject.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あー、えっと……
アランはまだ帰ってこないんかな？
english: Ah, um... I guess Alain hasn't come back yet?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ああ、まだみたいやな。
english: Yeah, seems like he's still out.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
せっかくなんやし、
アランにもカレー食べて欲しいわ。
その分は、ちゃんと残しといたし。
english: Since I made it, I want Alain to eat some curry too. I made sure to save some for him.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
正直、おまえが全部食べてまうんやないかって、
ヒヤヒヤしたけどな。
english: Honestly, I was nervous that you might eat it all.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: そこまで食い意地はっとらんわ！
english: I'm not that much of a glutton!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
けど、お父さん、
お祭りの準備でお腹空かせて……。
english: But Dad must be hungry from all the festival preparations...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: …Ushio?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: お祭りの準備……。
english: The festival preparations…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
なあ、もしかして、
『祭り』が引っかかるんか？
english: Hey, does the word 'festival' bother you?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: なにがいいたいねん。
english: What are you trying to say?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
晩メシの時や。
『祭り』って聞いた瞬間、
寒気したんとちゃうか？
english: During dinner. The moment you heard 'festival', didn't you feel a chill?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そ、そうやねん！
でも、なんで知ってるん！？
english: Y-Yeah! But how did you know!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
オレも同じやったんや。
ほら、今も自分で口にしといて、
このザマや。
english: I felt the exact same way. Look, I just said it myself and got goosebumps again.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ホンマや……。
めっちゃ鳥肌立っとる。
english: You're right... You've got major goosebumps.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: でも……一体どういうことなん？
english: But… what's going on?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なんでこないにゾッとするんやろ？
お祭り、楽しみなはずやのに……。
english: Why does it give me the chills? I should be looking forward to the festival...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あんな、慎平。
実を言うと、おかしい思たんは
慎平のカレーもなんよ。
english: Hey, Shinpei. To tell you the truth, I also thought your curry was weird.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: は？　オレのカレーも？
english: Huh? My curry too?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あ、違うで！
マズかったとかやないねん！
めっちゃ美味しかったし。
english: Ah, no! I'm not saying it tasted bad! It was super delicious.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ただ、食べたんは２年ぶりのはずやのに、
全然そんな気ィがしやんくて……。
english: It's just, it's supposed to be the first time I've eaten it in two years, but it didn't feel like that at all...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: マジか……。
english: Seriously?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ついこないだ食べたような気がして、
しゃあないねん。
english: I just can't shake the feeling that I ate it recently.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
実は……オレもそうなんや。
日都ヶ島もこの家も、
つい最近来たことある気がするんや。
english: Actually... I feel the same way. I feel like I've been to Hitogashima Island and this house recently.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 戻ってきたんは２年振りやのに？
english: Even though you just came back for the first time in two years?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
なぁ、潮。
おまえ昼間浜辺で――
english: Hey, Ushio. Earlier at the beach, you――

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
まだ言うんか！？
あれは――
english: You're still on about that!? That was――

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 話を最後まで聞け！
english: Listen until the end!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
おまえ、ヘンな夢見たて
昼間浜辺で言うてたよな？
english: You said you had a weird dream earlier at the beach, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
たぶん、それと同じような夢……
オレも見た気がするんや。
english: I think I might have had... a dream similar to that.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
えっ……？
二人して同じ夢見るて……
そんなことありえやんやろ。
english:
Eh…?
Both of us having the same dream…
That's impossible, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ああ、普通ありえへんよな。
english: Yeah, normally that's impossible.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
けど、気になって、
さっき、そういう現象ってあるんかなって
いろいろ検索してみたんや。
english: But it bothered me, so I tried searching to see if a phenomenon like that exists.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: で、どうやったん？
english: And? How was it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あかん。
断片的な情報ばっかりで、
どないもならんかった。
english: No good. It was just a bunch of fragmented information, so it was no help at all.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: なんか今日は、ワケわからんことだらけや。
english: Today has just been full of things I don't understand.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ここはあれや、慎平お得意の
フカンで考えてみたらええんちゃう？
english: In times like this, shouldn't you try taking a bird's-eye view like you always do?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
いや、この状況でフカンしたところで、
なんも結論出やんぞ。
english: No, even if I take a bird's-eye view in this situation, I won't reach any conclusions.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あはは、まあそないなるやろな。
ちょっと言ってみただけや。
english: Ahaha, well I guess that's true. I just thought I'd say it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あんなぁ……。
english: Geez...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 二人して、なに笑てるん？
english: What are you two laughing about?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
english: Mio…!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……ふぅ～ん。
english: ...Hmph.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: な、なんなんッ？
english: W-What is it?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もう仲直りしよったん？
意外と早かったなァ。
english:
You two made up already?
That was quick.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
え？
あ、ああ、まあ――
english: Huh? A-Ah, well――

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
はァ！？
仲直りらまだしてやんし！
english:
What!?
We haven't made up yet!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: Eh…!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 調子乗んなよ慎平！
english: Don't get ahead of yourself, Shinpei!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ちょっと、お姉ちゃん？
english: Hey, big sister?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
もう寝る！
夜中ノックとかしやんでや！
english: I'm going to sleep! Don't come knocking in the middle of the night!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……行ってもた。
english: …She's gone.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: もしかして私、余計なこと言うてしもた？
english: Maybe I said something unnecessary?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
いや、気にしやんでええよ。
ようあったやろ、こんなこと。
english: No, don't worry about it. This kind of thing used to happen a lot, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ああ、うん。
なんか懐かしいわ。
english:
Ah, yeah.
It feels nostalgic.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんとお姉ちゃん……
ようケンカしてたもんなァ。
english: Shin-chan and big sister... You guys used to fight all the time.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
まあ、２年間ずっと
ケンカしてたようなもんやしな。
english: Well, it's kind of like we've been fighting for the past two years.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
けど、面と向かって言い合いするとこ見たんは、
久しぶりやわ。
english: But it's been a while since I've seen you two arguing face to face.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
実は、二人が言い合うとこ見て、
懐かしなァって思てたんよ。
english: Actually, seeing you two arguing made me feel really nostalgic.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そんなこと懐かしまれても……。
english: I don't know if that's something to feel nostalgic about...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも、よう考えてみィ？
これってつまり……。
english: But, think about it. This means...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
二人とも昔のまんまってことやん。
もう少し大人にならなアカンで？
english: It means you're both exactly the same as before. You guys need to grow up a bit, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ……はい。
english: ...Right.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ほな、お風呂出たら教えてな。
english: Well, let me know when you're out of the bath.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あ、ああ、わかった。
english: A-Ah, got it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: お祭り……か。
english: The festival…

japanese: 4.こじれる関係
english: 4. A Complicated Relationship

japanese: 7月23日
english: July 23rd

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: *Yawn*...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（朝か……。
　潮も澪ももう起きてるのか？）
english: (Morning, huh... Are Ushio and Mio already awake?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
おはよう慎ちゃん。
よう眠れた？
english:
Good morning, Shin-chan.
Did you sleep well?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
おはよう。
部屋用意してくれてありがとな。
おかげでぐっすり眠れたわ。
english: Good morning. Thanks for getting the room ready. I slept great.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ……潮は？
english: …Where's Ushio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: まだ寝てるみたい。
english: Seems like she's still sleeping.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 早よお姉ちゃんと仲直りできたらええね。
english: I hope you can make up with big sister soon.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（仲直りというか……
　潮が勝手にむくれただけなんやけど）
english: (It's not really making up... Ushio just got mad on her own.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なァ、慎ちゃん。
朝ごはん食べたらどうするん？
english:
Hey, Shin-chan.
What are you going to do after breakfast?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
久しぶりやし、少し島ん中、
歩いてみてもええんとちゃう？
english: Since it's been a while, why don't you take a walk around the island?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: いや、今日はコフネの手伝いしよかと思てる。
english: No, I think I'll help out at Kofune today.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ、ほんま！？
english: Huh, really!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ランチとか、観光客増えて忙しい時期やろ？
english: With lunch and all, it's a busy time with more tourists, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うんっ、ありがとう。
慎ちゃんが一緒にいてくれたら嬉し――
ううん、心強いわ！
english: Yeah, thank you. I'd be happy if Shin-chan was there with―― No, I mean it would be reassuring!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
どうやろなァ。
足引っ張らんよう頑張るわ。
english: We'll see about that. I'll do my best not to drag you down.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
大丈夫。
慎ちゃんウチの店のことようわかってるし。
english: It's fine. You know our shop well, Shin-chan.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
english: ...*Yaaaawn*.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ、お姉ちゃんおはよ。
english: Ah, good morning, big sister.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ああ……おはよう。
english: Ah… good morning.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: おはよう、潮。
english: Good morning, Ushio.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: おはよう、慎平。
english: Good morning, Shinpei.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あれ？
お姉ちゃん、一晩寝たら機嫌直ったん？
english: Huh? Big sister, did you get in a better mood after sleeping on it?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そ、そんなわけないやろ！
朝一で慎平の顔見るやなんて、
一日の始まりが台無しや。
english: O-Of course not! Seeing Shinpei's face first thing in the morning ruins the start of my day.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
けど今日一日、慎ちゃんも一緒やで？
店手伝うてくれる言うてるし。
english: But Shin-chan is going to be with us all day today, you know? He said he'd help out at the shop.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ふ～ん、慎平がおったら私やていらんやろ？
今日は店手伝うんやめとくわ。
english: Hmph, if Shinpei's there, you don't need me, right? I'll pass on helping at the shop today.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
潮……。
まだ怒ってるんか？
english:
Ushio…
Are you still angry?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
フン！！
当たり前やッ！！
english:
Hmph!!
Of course I am!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
マジでようわからんねやけど、
なにをそんなに――
english: I seriously don't get it, but what are you so――

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
わからんてなんや！
もっと、ちゃんと考えてみたら、
わかるはずや！
english: What do you mean you don't get it! If you actually think about it, you should be able to figure it out!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 考えてみたらって――
english: Think about it, you say――

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ほんまは一発なぐっちゃろ思てたんや。
english: I was actually planning to punch you once.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
しかも、急に抱きしめよるとか信じられやん！
もう二、三発追加したい気分やわ！
english: Plus, I can't believe you suddenly hugged me! I feel like adding two or three more punches!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （もしかして、あのことか！？）
english: (Wait, could it be about that!?)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なんやの？
急に考え込んで……。
english: What is it? Suddenly lost in thought...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 潮、ごめん。
english: Ushio, I'm sorry.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: えっ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: その、悪かったよ。
english: Um, my bad.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: な、なにが……？
english: W-What…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
えっと……なんて言うか、
おまえの気持ちとか……うまくわかってやれんくて。
english: Um... how do I say this... I couldn't really understand... how you felt.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そ、そうなん？
そっかァ、少しは分かったんかァ。
english: I-Is that so? I see, so you understand a little bit now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
オレなんかと抱き合うんは嫌やんな。
ごめんな、潮。
english: You don't want to hug a guy like me, right. Sorry, Ushio.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: そういうことちゃうから！！
english: That's not what this is about!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あ～～あ、話にならんわ！
結局、全然わかってへんかったし！
english: Ah~~, there's no talking to you! In the end, you didn't understand at all!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
待て待て！
せやったら、なんで怒ってるんや！？
english:
Wait, wait!
Then why are you angry!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
だからァ！
そんなん自分で考えろや！
english: I'm telling you! Figure that out for yourself!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 考えた結果が間違ってたんやろが！
english: But the conclusion I came to was wrong!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
知らん知らん！
慎平なんてもう知らん！
english: I don't care! I don't care! I don't care about you anymore, Shinpei!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あっ！
お姉ちゃん、どこ行くん！？
english: Ah! Big sister, where are you going!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
自分の部屋で寝直すねん！
ジャマしやんでや！
english: I'm going back to sleep in my room! Don't bother me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: お、おい……。
english: H-Hey...

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: おぉ、朝から賑やかやなァ。
english: Oh, it's lively this early in the morning.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
おはようお父さん！
ほな、おやすみ！
english: Good morning, Dad! Alright, good night!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
おやすみって、朝やで？
これから寝るんか？
english: Good night? It's morning, you know? You're going to sleep now?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 寝直すんや！
english: I'm going back to sleep!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: どないしたんや、アレ？
english: What's wrong with her?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
昨夜も機嫌ようなかったけど、
またケンカしたんかいな？
english: She wasn't in a good mood last night either, did you guys fight again?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ああ、たぶん……。
正直ようわからんねやけどな。
english: Ah, probably... Honestly, I don't really get it, though.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: はははっ、今回は長引きそやなァ。
english: Hahaha, looks like this one is going to drag on.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ごめんな慎ちゃん。
私がからかいすぎたんかも。
english: Sorry, Shin-chan. Maybe I teased her too much.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
気にすんなって。
大丈夫、何とかなるやろ。
english: Don't worry about it. It's fine, I'll figure something out.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （とは言ったものの……）
english: (Even though I said that...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（今回ばかりは潮がなにを考えてるのか、
　うまく理解してやれない）
english: (This time, I really can't seem to figure out what Ushio is thinking.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（あいつ……
　どうしてあんなに怒ってるんだ？）
english: (That idiot... Why is she so angry?)

japanese: 5.怒りの理由
english: 5. The Reason for Anger

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お父さん、Ａランチ二人前追加！
english: Dad, two more A-lunches!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: はいよォ！
english: Coming right up!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 澪、オレこの皿持ってくな。
english: Mio, I'll take this plate.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん、お願い！
english: Yeah, please!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: いらっしゃいませ。
english: Welcome.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: おう、慎平くん！
english: Hey, Shinpei!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
今日はコフネの手伝いか。
地元に帰省してるっちゅうのに労働とは
感心やなァ。
english: Helping out at Kofune today, huh? Working even though you're visiting your hometown, how admirable.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
こんだけ繁盛してたら手伝いも必要ですよ。
そっちのカウンター席、どうぞ。
english: With it being this busy, they need the help. Please, take a seat at the counter over there.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ああ、ありがとさん。
english: Thanks a lot.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
しかしなァ、店はこないな大繁盛で
慎平くんまで働いてんのに、
潮ちゃんはサボっとんのかいな？
english: But still, the shop is this busy and even you're working, Shinpei-kun, so is Ushio-chan slacking off?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ええ、まあ。
english: Yeah, well.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（潮のヤツ、あれから顔見てないけど、
　まだ寝てんのか……？）
english: (I haven't seen Ushio since then, but is she really still sleeping...?)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
さては、慎平くん……、
潮ちゃんとなんかあったやろ？
english: Let me guess, Shinpei-kun... did something happen between you and Ushio-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
えっ！？
な、なんでそんなこと……。
english: Eh!? W-Why would you say that...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
実はさっき、
外で潮ちゃんに会うたんよ。
english: Actually, I ran into Ushio-chan outside just a little while ago.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えっ、外で？
english: Eh, outside?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
挨拶がてらちょっと声かけただけやのに、
めっちゃ睨まれてんで！
english: I just called out to her to say hi, but she glared at me so hard!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
めちゃくそ機嫌悪かったんやろな。
その原因、慎平くんなんとちゃうか？
english: She must have been in a terrible mood. And the cause of that is you, isn't it, Shinpei-kun?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: まあ、その……。
english: Well, you know…

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ん～？
なんや心当たりありそうな顔やなァ。
english: Hm~? You've got a look on your face that says you have an idea.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あないなったら、
早よ謝ってもた方がええで～？
english: When she gets like that, you're better off apologizing quickly, you know~?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
女の子を怒らせたら
後が怖いからなァ。
english: It's scary when you make a girl mad, after all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
そうですね。
帰ってきたらすぐ謝って……。
english: You're right. I'll apologize as soon as she gets back...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（なんだ？
　妙な胸騒ぎが……）
english: (What is this? A strange sense of unease...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （帰ってきたら……）
english: (When she gets back...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （でも……もし帰ってこなかったら？）
english: (But... what if she doesn't come back?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（いやいや……
　なにを考えてるんや、オレは）
english: (No, no... What am I thinking?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（潮が帰ってこないなんて、
　そんなこと……）
english: (Ushio not coming back... There's no way...)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 慎平くん？
english: Shinpei-kun?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あ、あの、潮は……どこにおったんですか？
english: U-Um, where... did you see Ushio?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ん？
会うたんは学校の辺りやったなァ。
ビーチの方へ歩いていったで。
english: Hm? I saw her around the school. She was walking towards the beach.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（ビーチ……
　学校裏の……プライベートビーチ……）
english:
(Beach…
The private beach behind the school…)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
どないしたん慎平くん。
めっちゃ怖いカオしちゃあるで？
english: What's wrong, Shinpei-kun? You've got a really scary look on your face.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（根拠もなにもない。
　でも、オレの中のなにかが、そこはダメだと……）
english: (I don't have any proof or anything. But something inside me is telling me that place is no good...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（くそッ！
　なんなんだよ、この胸騒ぎは！？）
english: (Damn it! What is this feeling of unease!?)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: おーい、慎平くん？
english: He~y, Shinpei-kun?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
澪、アラン、ごめん！
やっぱオレ行かな！
english: Mio, Alain, sorry! I have to go after all!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
えっ？
慎ちゃん？
やっぱって何？
english: Eh? Shin-chan? What do you mean 'after all'?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: 慎平、急にどないしたんや？
english: Shinpei, what's wrong all of a sudden?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ホントごめん！
すぐ帰ってくるから！
english:
I'm really sorry!
I'll be back soon!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ハァッ、ハァッ、ハァ……！
english: *Pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: (...There she is!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 潮ォッ！！
english: Ushio!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: うひゃあっ！？
english: Uhyah!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なんや、慎平か。
驚かさんでや。
english: What, it's just Shinpei. Don't scare me like that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
おまえが、
ここへ向かってるかもしれやんて
聞いたから……。
english: I heard that you... might be heading here, so...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: なんか、えらい胸騒ぎがして……な。
english: I just had this terrible feeling of unease... you know.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
……胸騒ぎ？
ただそれだけで、ここまで来たん？
english: ...A feeling of unease? You came all the way here just for that?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なんなん、それ。
まさか、私が海で溺れてまうとか、
そないなこと考えたん？
english: What's with that. Don't tell me you thought I was going to drown in the sea or something?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あ、ああ……そうなんかな？
english: A-Ah... I guess so?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
余計な心配しやんでくれる？
私の泳ぎナメたらアカンで。
english: Could you not worry about unnecessary things? Don't underestimate my swimming skills.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
いや、知ってるて！
潮がどれだけ泳げるかって、
オレが知らんわけないやろ。
english: No, I know that! There's no way I wouldn't know how well you can swim.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: せやったら、そんなアホな心配――
english: Then why would you worry about something so stupid――

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: それでもッ！
english: Even so!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
それでもや……。
どうしてもおまえの顔見やんと不安になって……。
english: Even so... I just got so anxious, I had to see your face...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 店飛び出してきてしもた。
english: I ended up running out of the shop.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
english: Shinpei…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: また同じなんやな。
english: It's the same again, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 同じって……。
english: What do you mean, the same...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: おまえも、感じたんか？
english: Did you feel it too?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
私な、寝直した後、
散歩に出たんよ。
english: You know, after I went back to sleep, I went out for a walk.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
何となく学校まで来て、
プライベートビーチに行ってみよかと
思たら……。
english: I somehow ended up near the school, and when I thought about going to the private beach...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
「ビーチは危険や」
「ビーチに近づくな」って、
そんな感覚を体中で感じたんよ。
english: The beach is dangerous.' 'Don't go near the beach.' I felt that kind of sensation throughout my entire body.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
おまえなァ……！
それやったら近付くなよ！
english: You idiot...! Then don't go near it!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
けど、ただ怖がるだけやて、なんかムカつくやん？
せやから、なにが怖いんか確かめちゃろ思て。
english: But just being scared of it pisses me off, you know? So I thought I'd find out what was so scary about it.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
昨日、万年青浜へ行った時は、
そんな感覚なかったんやけどなァ。
english: When we went to Omoto Beach yesterday, I didn't feel anything like that at all, though.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
アホか……。
無駄な心配させんなよ。
english: You idiot... Don't make me worry for nothing.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ア、アホてなんなん！
私はそんな心配されるほど弱ないつもりやけど！？
english: W-What do you mean idiot! I don't think I'm weak enough to need that much worrying over!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: いや、それは……。
english: Well, that's...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ははっ……まあそうだよな。
潮は強いよな。
english: Haha... well, I guess you're right. You are strong, Ushio.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: なっ、なんで笑うん！？
english: Why are you laughing!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
でも……おまえが無事で、
ホンマに良かった。
english: But... I'm really glad you're safe.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ……慎平。
english: …Shinpei.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
も～ッ！
ホンマなんなん！？
昨日から変なコトだらけや！
english: Jeez! What is going on!? It's been nothing but weird things since yesterday!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そうやなァ……。
english: Yeah, you're right...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
全部慎平が帰ってきてからやで。
慎平、何かしよったん？
english: It's all been since you came back, Shinpei. Did you do something, Shinpei?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: してへんわ！
english: I didn't do anything!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
けど……この感覚は
あんまし気持ちのええもんやないな。
english: But... this feeling isn't a very pleasant one.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
なあ、もしかしてオレ……
帰ってこやん方が良かったか？
english: Hey, do you think maybe... It would have been better if I hadn't come back?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: そんなことあらへん！
english: Of course not!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
やっぱり慎平が島におってくれると
しっくりくるっちゅうか、
嬉しいっちゅうか……助かるねん。
english: Having you back on the island, it just feels right, or rather, I'm happy... it helps me out.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
心の中にたまってしもた
不安とかモヤモヤとか……。
english: All the anxiety and cloudy feelings that have built up in my heart...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そんな気持ちをケンカっぽく慎平にぶつけたら、
スッキリして安心できるんよ。
english: When I take those feelings out on you like we're fighting, I feel refreshed and relieved.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
えっ……！？
待て、どういうイミや？
english: Eh...!? Wait, what do you mean?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 『ケンカっぽく』て、おまえ……。
english: Like we're fighting... you...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 実はな……本気でずっと怒ってたわけやないねん。
english: Actually... I wasn't seriously mad the whole time.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: まさか……わざと怒ったフリしてたんか！？
english: Don't tell me... you were pretending to be mad on purpose!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: あはは、まあそういうコトや。
english: Ahaha, well, something like that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ほな、さっき店に来た凸村さんが、
潮にめっちゃ睨まれた言うてたけど、
あれは……？
english: Then, Totsumura-san came to the shop earlier and said you glared at him really hard. What was that about...?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
えっ？
あ、ああ、あん時か。
english: Eh? A-Ah, that time.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ちょうど、変な胸騒ぎがしとった時やからかな？
あの人の顔見た瞬間、
なんでかムカっとしてしもて。
english: Maybe it was because I was having that weird feeling of unease right then? The moment I saw his face, I just got pissed off for some reason.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あとで謝っとけよ……。
english: You'd better apologize later...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: はあぁぁ～～～……。
english: *Siiiiigh*...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: どないしたん？
english: What's wrong?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
一気に疲れがきただけや……
ここまで、めっちゃ走ったし……。
english: The exhaustion just hit me all at once... I ran super fast to get here...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そうなん？
日頃からもっと運動しといた方がええで。
english: Is that so? You should exercise more regularly.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ほっといてくれ。
english: Leave me alone.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なァ、慎平。
ホンマに怒ってやんとわかって嬉しい？
english: Hey, Shinpei. Are you happy to know I wasn't really mad?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
嬉しいっていうより、
心底ホッとした気分やな……。
english: More than happy, I feel relieved from the bottom of my heart...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ごめんなァ。
こっから先は優しくしたってもええで？
english: Sorry about that. I can be nicer to you from now on, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: なんで上から目線やねん！
english: Why are you acting so high and mighty!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ふふん！
english: Heheh!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ったく……。
english: Geez...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（潮は潮なりに、
　やっぱり不安やったんやな）
english: (Ushio was anxious too, in her own way.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
（そういうことなら、
　もっと気遣ってやってたら……）
english: (If that was the case, I should have been more considerate...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （いや、結局喧嘩になってたな）
english: (No, it would have ended in a fight anyway.)

japanese: 6.デート？
english: 6. Date?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ランチタイム……もう終わってる時間やな。
english: Lunchtime... it's already past that time.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ああ、最悪や。
すぐ戻る言うて店出たのに。
english: Ah, this is the worst. I left the shop saying I'd be right back.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
大丈夫やろ。
お父さんも澪も忙しいんは慣れてるし。
english: It'll be fine. Dad and Mio are used to being busy.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
おまえなァ。
凸村さんだけやなくて澪とアランにも
謝っとけよ？
english: You know... You better apologize to Mio and Alain too, not just Totsumura-san, okay?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なんで！？
私そもそも手伝わへん言うとったし。
english:
Why!?
I said I wouldn't help in the first place.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
というか慎平、
久しぶりに島に帰ってきたっちゅうのに、
やることはコフネの手伝いなん？
english: Besides, Shinpei, you finally came back to the island after so long, and all you're doing is helping out at Kofune?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
別にいいやろ。
やりたいことやってるだけや。
english: It's fine, isn't it? I'm just doing what I want.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 店の手伝いがやりたいことなん？
english: Helping out at the shop is what you want to do?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
なんかおかしいか？
今は東京で料理学んでるわけやし。
english: Is that so weird? I am studying cooking in Tokyo right now, after all.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: そうやけど――
english: That's true, but――

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: よぉ慎平、潮！
english: Hey Shinpei, Ushio!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ああ、窓。
english: Ah, Sou.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
二人でなにしてんねん。
デートか？
english: What are you two doing? On a date?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
デッ……！？
ちゃうわボケェッ！！
english: Da...!? No we're not, you idiot!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
痛ッ！？
なんも蹴ることないやろがッ！
english: Ow!? You didn't have to kick me!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: フン！！
english: Hmph!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 大丈夫か、窓。
english: You okay, Sou?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あ、ああ。
まあ、いつもこんなもんや。
慣れたもんやで。
english: A-Ah. Well, it's always like this. I'm used to it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
はは、オレがおらん間も、
相変わらずやったんやな。
english: Haha, you guys were the same as always even while I was gone, huh.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そや、ちょうどええ。
慎平に聞きたいことがあんねん。
english: Oh yeah, perfect timing. I have something I want to ask you, Shinpei.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: オレに？　なんや？
english: Me? What?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
いつまでこっちにおるんや？
夏休みやし、しばらくのんびりしてくんやろ？
english: How long are you staying here? It's summer vacation, so you're gonna relax for a while, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ああ、そうしたいところやけど、
バイトとかの都合で、
週末までには東京に戻らなアカンのや。
english: Ah, I'd like to do that, but because of my part-time job and stuff, I have to go back to Tokyo by the weekend.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: はァァァッ！？
english: Huuuuh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: えッ……？

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ちょっと、慎平！！
私、そんな話全然聞いてやんで！！
english: Hold on, Shinpei!! I haven't heard anything about that!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
潮に言うてやんかったんか。
昨日は潮んとこに泊まっとったんやろ？
english: You didn't tell Ushio? You stayed at her place yesterday, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ああ、まあ……。
english: Ah, well…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: どういうつもりや慎平ッ！
english: What were you thinking, Shinpei!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
黙ってたわけやない。
でも潮がずっとケンカ腰やったから
伝え損なってしもて……。
english: I wasn't keeping it a secret. But Ushio was being so combative the whole time that I missed the chance to tell her...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
言い訳すんな！
そもそもそういう大事なことは最初に言っとけ！！
english: Don't make excuses! You should say important things like that first!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
そ、そこまで気になるんやったら、
そっちから聞いてくれても
良かったんとちゃうか？
english: I-If you were that curious about it, you could have just asked me yourself, couldn't you?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
私のせいにしやんとって！
だいたい再会してすぐ慎平が変なことするからやろ！
english: Don't blame this on me! It's because you did something weird right after we reunited!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
変なこと？
なんや、何をやらかしたんや？
english: Something weird? What did you do?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ち、ちがっ……！
誤解や窓！
english: N-No...! It's a misunderstanding, Sou!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ……フン！
english: …Hmph!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: おいっ、潮……。
english: Hey, Ushio…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
もう帰る！
付いてきやんとって！
english: I'm going home! Don't follow me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: でもオレかて店に戻らな――
english: But I have to go back to the shop too――

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
慎平のアホ！
付いて来んな言うてるやろ！
english: Shinpei, you idiot! I told you not to follow me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: Ah…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 行ってもたな。
english: She's gone.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ああ……。
english: Ah…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
で、慎平……。
おまえ一体潮になにしたんや？
english: So, Shinpei... What exactly did you do to Ushio?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
別に変なことらしてへんわ！
おまえが想像しちゃあるようなことは、
まったくなかったからな！
english: I didn't do anything weird! Nothing like what you're imagining happened at all!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そない必死に否定すんなや……。
english: Don't deny it so desperately…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
まあ、そらそうか。
おまえと潮やもんなァ。
english: Well, I guess so. It is you and Ushio, after all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ハァ……ホンマ疲れた。
昨日からこんなんばっかりや。
english: *Sigh*... I'm really tired. It's been nothing but this since yesterday.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: （やっと普通に話せたと思ったのに……）
english: (Just when I thought I could finally talk normally…)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
それにしても、週末には帰るってか。
ちょい早すぎやないか？
english: Still, you're going back by the weekend, huh. Isn't that a bit too soon?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
そうかもしれやんけど……
オレにも事情があんねん。
english: That might be true, but... I have my own circumstances.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そうなんやろうけど、
潮からしたら薄情に感じてまうんやろなァ。
怒る気持ちは、わからんでもないわ。
english: I guess so, but to Ushio, it probably feels cold-hearted. I can kind of understand why she's mad.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
まァ、今夜も潮ん家泊まんねやろ？
ウマいモンでも食わせて、機嫌直してもらえ。
english: Well, you're staying at Ushio's place again tonight, right? Feed her something good and get her in a better mood.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
いや、今日は店の手伝いだけしたら
実家に帰る予定なんや。
english: No, I was planning to go back to my parents' house after I finish helping out at the shop today.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
はァ？
それ、潮に言うちゃあるんか？
english: Huh? Did you tell Ushio that?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
せやなかったら、
またキレられてまうで？
english: If you didn't, she's going to snap at you again, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ……ヤバイかもしれん。
english: ...This might be bad.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そうか……。
ほな、おまえの無事を祈っといたるわ。
生きて東京帰れるようにな。
english: I see... Well, I'll pray for your safety. Hope you make it back to Tokyo alive.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: そうしてくれ……。
english: Please do...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
マジな話、東京帰るまでには、
潮のことなんとかしとけよ？
english:
Seriously, before you go back to Tokyo,
sort things out with Ushio.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ケンカ別れしたら、また何年も後悔するで。
「素直になっとけばよかった」ってよ。
english: If you part on bad terms, you'll regret it for years again. Thinking, 'I should've been honest with her'.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ……ああ。

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
でも、その澪ちゃんの影……
澪ちゃんを狙っとったんやったら、
なんでさっさと家に押し入らんかったんや？
english: But, about Mio-chan's Shadow... If it was targeting Mio-chan, why didn't it just break into the house right away?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……それはたぶん、
変に目立たないように――
english: Ah... that's probably so it wouldn't stand out weirdly――

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ちょっと待ち！
english: Hold on a second!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうかしました？
english: Is something wrong?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
もしかしてやけど、影のホンマの狙い、
それって実はオレやったんとちゃうか？
english: This is just a 'what if', but the Shadow's real target... could it have actually been me?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……？

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
せやからコフネに入らんと、
道でオレを待ち伏せしとった――
english: That's why it didn't go into Kofune, and was ambushing me on the road――

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: オレが正義の味方で優秀な駐在やから――
english: Because I'm a hero of justice and an excellent local cop――

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
うん、絶対そうや！
そうに違いあらへん！
english: Yeah, that's definitely it! It has to be!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……そうなん？
english: ...Is that so?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ははは……。
english: A-Ahahaha...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （たぶん、そんな事はないと思うけど……）
english: (I highly doubt that's the case, but...)

japanese: 3.刑事はどこに？
english: 3. Where is the Detective?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……刑事さんっぽい人、見当たらへんね。
english: ...I don't see anyone who looks like a detective.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの、凸村さん。
あの便で本土からの応援が
来るんじゃなかったんですか？
english: Um, Totsumura-san. Weren't the backup detectives from the mainland supposed to come on that ferry?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: そのハズやったんやけどなァ。
english: That's what was supposed to happen.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もしかしたら……
哲さんが見当たらんから先に町へ
行ってしもたんかも。
english: Maybe... Since they couldn't find Tetsu-san, they might have gone to town first.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレらは先に港へ来てましたけど、
凸村さんがいなけりゃ、
誰が刑事さんかなんて……。
english: We came to the port first, but without Totsumura-san here, we wouldn't know who the detectives are...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん……全然わからんかった。
english: Yeah... I had no idea.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ち、遅刻してしもたんは悪かった。
english: I-I know it was my fault for being late.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
でも、しゃあないやろ。
どうしてもいっぺん駐在所に戻らなあかん
用事があったんやさけ……。
english: But it couldn't be helped. I had an errand that required me to go back to the station once...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
まあ、過ぎ去ったことはしゃーない。
今考えるべきことは応援の刑事が、
どこへ行ってしもたんかってこっちゃ。
english: Well, what's done is done. What we need to think about now is where the backup detectives went.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: どうにかして連絡とれやんのですか？
english: Can't you contact them somehow?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
携帯にかけても応答あらへん。
こっちから探しに行った方がええやいしょ。
english: They're not answering their cell phones. We'd better go look for them ourselves.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それじゃあ……。
とりあえず町に戻りましょうか。
english: Then... Let's head back to town for now.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
おらんなぁ、刑事っぽい人。
てっきり聞き込みでもしてるんかと
思てたけど……。
english: No one who looks like a detective. I thought they might be asking around, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
商店街の人たちに聞いたけど、
誰もそれらしき人は見てないらしい。
english: I asked the people in the shopping district, but no one has seen anyone like that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
となると……残ってる可能性は、
凸村さんがたしかめにいった――
english: In that case... the remaining possibility is where Totsumura-san went to check――

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
おーい、慎平くん、澪ちゃん！
ここにおったんか！
english: He~y, Shinpei-kun, Mio-chan! So this is where you were!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あっ、哲さん。
駐在所、どうでした？
刑事さん来てました？
english: Ah, Tetsu-san. How was the station? Were the detectives there?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
いや、おらんかった。
誰かが訪ねてきた形跡もなかったわ。
english: No, they weren't. There was no sign of anyone visiting either.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さんとすれ違いで駐在所に来てたって
線は消えましたね。
それじゃ一体……。
english: So the theory that they passed by Totsumura-san and went to the station is gone. Then where in the world...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 澪。
english: Mio.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あっ、トキコ。
english: Ah, Tokiko.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
なんや珍しい組み合わせやな。
何かあったん？
english: What an unusual combination. Did something happen?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ、うん。ええっと……。
english: Ah, yeah… um…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪の気持ちはよくわかる）
english: (I understand how Mio feels.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ここまでのことをどう説明していいか、
　すぐには言葉に出来ないよな……）
english: (It's hard to put into words right away how to explain everything up to this point...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ねぇ、慎ちゃん……。
一応トキコにも話しといた方がええんやない？
english: Hey, Shin-chan... Shouldn't we probably tell Tokiko too?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 何も知らんままやと危ないかもしれへんし……。
english: It might be dangerous if she doesn't know anything...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……かもな。
english: ...Maybe so.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
あの、私に話せないことだったら、
無理に教えてもらわなくても……。
english: Um, if it's something you can't tell me, you don't have to force yourselves to...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや、そういう事じゃなくって。
ただちょっと、信じられないような話で……。
english: No, it's not like that. It's just a bit of an unbelievable story...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それに……詳しい事はオレらでも、
ようわかってへんし……。
english: Plus... even we don't really understand the details...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それでもいいなら話してみるけど……。
english: If you're okay with that, I'll try explaining...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ええ、お願いします。
english: Yes, please.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 今の話……信じていいんですよね？
english: That story just now... I can believe it, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……。
簡単には信じられない内容かもしれないけど……。
english: Yeah... It might be hard to believe, but...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私もまだ実感はないんやけど……。
でも……。
english: I still don't really feel it myself, but... But...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: Mio…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それと……その影ってヤツ……。
一人や二人って話じゃないと思う。
english: Also... those Shadow things... I don't think there's just one or two of them.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
はっ！？
そんな話、聞いてへんで慎平くん？
english: Hah!? I haven't heard anything about that, Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さん言ってましたよね？
影の病っていうのは、
昔からこの島に伝わってるって。
english: You said it yourself, didn't you, Totsumura-san? That the Shadow Sickness has been passed down on this island since a long time ago.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それなら、他にも影がいる可能性だって……。
english: If that's the case, there's a possibility that there are other Shadows...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （現にしおりちゃんはもう影にされてる……）
english: (In fact, Shiori-chan has already been turned into a Shadow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（死ぬ寸前……
　オレは本物の凸村さんが影のミオに殺された後、
　影の凸村さんが生まれるところを見た）
english: (Right before I died... I saw the real Totsumura-san get killed by Shadow Mio, and then a Shadow Totsumura-san was born.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（他の影も、そんなふうに人を殺して
　仲間を増やしていたとしたら……）
english: (If the other Shadows are also killing people and increasing their numbers like that...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （それも、ずっと前から……）
english: (And if they've been doing it for a long time...)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そんなアホな……！
もし影が正義の味方を目の敵にするんやったら、
オレ、狙われ放題やん！？
english: That's ridiculous...! If the Shadows treat the hero of justice as their enemy, I'll be targeted left and right!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: と、とにかく応援の刑事を探さんと！
english: A-Anyway, we have to find the backup detectives!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
……いや、今よりもっと応援が必要や！！
駐在所戻って連絡してくるわ！！
english: ...No, we need even more backup now!! I'm going back to the station to contact them!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、オレらも行こう！
english: Mio, let's go!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: う、うん！
english: Y-yeah!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: トキコ、気ィつけてね！
english: Tokiko, be careful!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: うん、澪もな……。
english: Yeah, you too, Mio...

japanese: 4.平和を願う仕事
english: 4. A Job Wishing for Peace

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さん、どうでした？
本土からの返事……。
english: Totsumura-san, how was it? The response from the mainland...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 話、信じてくれました？
english: Did they believe the story?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: う～ん……なんとも言えんなァ。
english: Hmm... hard to say.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうですか……。
english: I see…

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
せやけど、とにかく必死に説明した甲斐が
あったんか、事の重大さには気づいてもらえた
みたいや。
english: But it seems my desperate explanation paid off, because they seem to have realized the severity of the situation.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
明日の朝、またこっちに応援送るって
約束してもらえたで。
english: They promised to send more backup tomorrow morning.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ホンマですか！？
english: Really!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ああ、これで一安心やいしょ。
english: Yeah, we can rest easy for now.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
それもこれもオレが、
思いつく限り必死にまくし立てた
おかげやな！
english: And it's all thanks to me talking their ears off as best I could!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: まくし立てたって……。
english: Talking their ears off...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あとな、本土と話したんはそれだけやない。
他にもいろいろ話聞いたんや。
english: Also, that wasn't the only thing I talked to the mainland about. I asked about some other things too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: いろいろってなんです？
english: What other things?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
今日来る言うてた応援の刑事な。
とっくに島に着いとるはずらしいんやけど、
本土の方でも連絡ができやんらしいわ。
english: The backup detectives who were supposed to come today. They should have arrived on the island a long time ago, but the mainland can't contact them either.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……本当ですか！？
english: …Really?!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
向こうの担当も困っとったわ。
まったく、どこで油売っとんねん。
english: The people in charge over there were troubled too. Jeez, where are they slacking off?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 刑事さん、どうしたんやろね……。
english: I wonder what happened to the detectives...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
とにかく今は明日の応援を待つしかないですね。
……身の回りに気をつけて。
english: Anyway, we have no choice but to wait for tomorrow's backup for now. ...Be careful out there.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、あんま遅うならんうちに帰ろ？
english: Shin-chan, let's head back before it gets too late, okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、そうだな。
english: Yeah, you're right.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ちょ、ちょっと待ってぇ！
もしかして二人ともコフネに戻るん？
english: W-Wait a minute! Are you two going back to Kofune?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？　当たり前じゃないですか。
english: Eh? Isn't that obvious?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: まだ何かありますか？
english: Is there something else?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あると言えばあるし、
無いと言えば無いと言うか……。
english: You could say there is, or you could say there isn't...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんなんです。歯切れが悪いですね。
english: What is it? You're being vague.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
～～～～～～！
な、なんでもあらへん、二人とも暗くなる前に帰り。
english: ~~~~~~! I-It's nothing, you two head back before it gets dark.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そうですか？
じゃあ、私達はこれで……。
english: Is that so? Well then, we'll be off...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: あっ……。
english: Ah…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: な、なんです？
english: W-What?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: なんでもあらへん、なんでもあらへんよ。
english: It's nothing, nothing at all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの、もしかしてなんですけど、
凸村さん怖いんですか？
english: Um, this is just a guess, but... are you scared, Totsumura-san?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そ、そんなワケないやろ！
オレは正義の味方のポリスメンやぞ！
english: T-There's no way! I'm a policeman, a hero of justice!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
今晩かて、駐在所に籠もって
島の平和を一心に願うちゅう大切な仕事があるんや。
english: Even tonight, I have the important job of holing up in the station and earnestly wishing for the peace of the island.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや、願ってないで巡回してくださいよ……。
english: No, please patrol instead of wishing...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……ねえ。
哲さんを一人にしてもうたん、
やっぱり良くなかったかな？
english: ...Hey. Was it a bad idea to leave Tetsu-san alone?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ホンマに哲さんが影に狙われてるとしたら、
誰かと一緒におった方が……。
english: If Tetsu-san really is being targeted by a Shadow, it would be better if he was with someone...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
たしかにそうやけど……、
今はヘタな動きを見せない方がいい。
english: That's true, but... It's better not to make any careless moves right now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影が人に化けて行動してるんなら、
オレらの動きが連中に見られていたとしても
おかしくない。
english: If the Shadows are acting disguised as people, it wouldn't be strange if they were watching our movements.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ここでオレらがおかしな動きを見せれば、
凸村さんが危険に晒される可能性もある……。
english: If we show any strange movements here, it might put Totsumura-san in danger...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だから、こっちもできるだけ平静を装って
おいた方がいい。
english: So it's better for us to act as normal as possible.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もし凸村さんになにかあったら……
　オレだって不安に思わなくもない）
english: (I'm not without my own worries... if something were to happen to Totsumura-san.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、おそらく澪の影は、
　たまたま凸村さんに話しかけられたから
　殺しただけ）
english: (But Mio's Shadow probably only killed Totsumura-san because he happened to talk to her.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（最初から凸村さんを
　狙っていたわけじゃないだろう）
english: (It's not like she was targeting Totsumura-san from the beginning.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレたちだけじゃ何もできやしない）
english: (We can't do anything on our own.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（とにかく本土から来た応援の刑事と
　合流することが先決だ）
english: (Anyway, meeting up with the backup detectives from the mainland is our top priority.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪を守るためにも……）
english: (To protect Mio too...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、ちょっと……。
english: Shin-chan, hold on a second...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
どうした？
晩飯ならもうすぐできるぞ。
english:
What's wrong?
Dinner will be ready soon.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ううん、そうやなくて。
私、これからトキコんち行こうと
思ってるんやけど……。
english: No, that's not it. I'm thinking of going to Tokiko's house now...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……これから？
english: ...Now?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: やっぱり危ないかな？
english: Is it too dangerous?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まあ、いつ影のミオが来るかも
わからんしな。
english: Well, we don't know when Shadow Mio might show up.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それはわかってるんやけど……
大事な用事があんねん。
english: I know that, but... I have something important to do.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それ、明日の昼とかじゃアカンのか？
english: Can't that wait until tomorrow afternoon or something?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
トキコ、明日の昼は用事あるんやて……。
だから今日の晩しか時間ないねん。
english: Tokiko said she has plans tomorrow afternoon... So tonight is the only time we have.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（向こうには窓もいるし、
　ここにいるよりはトキちゃんとこにいる方が
　安全かもしれないな……）
english: (Sou is over there too, so it might be safer to be at Tokiko's place than here...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（セキュリティも
　うちよりしっかりしてるだろうし）
english: (Their security is probably better than ours too.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: わかった。じゃあ送ってく。
english: Alright. I'll walk you there.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ホンマ！　ありがとう、慎ちゃん！
english: Really! Thanks, Shin-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: で？　大事な用事ってなんなん？
english: So, what's this important matter?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
祭りの日に着る浴衣の……
着付けの練習や。
english: Practicing how to put on... the yukata for the festival.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？　なんだって？
english: Eh? What was that?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
な、なんでもあらへん！
慎ちゃんには関係ないことや！
english: I-It's nothing! It has nothing to do with you, Shin-chan!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: たぶん……。
english: Maybe…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
すっかり暗なってしもたわ。
……ごめんな、こんな時間に。
english: It's gotten completely dark. ...Sorry for doing this so late.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 別にいいよ。
english: It's fine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（念のためナイフは持ってきた……。
　菱形家なら問題ないと思うけど）
english: (I brought a knife just in case... I think it'll be fine at the Hishigata house, but...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……あんな、慎ちゃん。
