english: ...Hey, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 明日の事なんやけど……。
english: About tomorrow…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
明日の事？
……何かあったか？
english:
Tomorrow?
Did something happen?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もぉっ、やっぱり忘れとる。
明日は日都夏祭りやん！！
english: Jeez, you really did forget. Tomorrow is the Hitogashima Summer Festival!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ……ああ、そうだったな。
english: Ah… Yeah, that's right.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（正直言ってそれどころじゃないけど……
　考えようによってはむしろ好都合かも）
english: (Honestly, I don't have the leeway to think about that, but... depending on how you look at it, it might actually be convenient.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（祭りで賑やかになれば、
　影も手を出しづらくなるかもしれないし……）
english: (If it gets lively with the festival, it might make it harder for the Shadows to make a move...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あんな、お祭りなんやけど……。
english: Hey, about the festival...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 澪！
english: Mio!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: トキコ！？
english: Tokiko!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: もう、遅いから心配した。
english: Jeez, you were late so I got worried.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そうなん！？
……ご、ごめん。
english: You did!? ...S-Sorry.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 慎平さんに送ってもろてたんやね。
english: Shinpei-san walked you here, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、一人で出歩くのは危ないから。
トキちゃんも気をつけた方がいいよ。
english: Yeah, it's dangerous to walk around alone. You should be careful too, Tokiko-chan.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: そうですね……。
english: I suppose so...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん！　誰か来る！
english: Shin-chan! Someone's coming!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: わ、私の影かな……。
english: I-Is it my Shadow...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪っ、トキちゃんっ、オレの後ろに隠れてっ！
english: Mio, Tokiko-chan, hide behind me!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: う、うん！
english: Y-Yeah!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（くそっ！
　オレだけで澪とトキちゃんを守れるのか？）
english: (Damn it! Can I protect Mio and Tokiko-chan by myself?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（落ち着け、まずは状況を把握しろ！
　フカンして考えるんだっ！）
english: (Calm down, grasp the situation first! Take a bird's-eye view!)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: うぃ……。

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？
english: Eh?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: あっれー、こんな時間に出歩いたらアカンでぇ。
english: Huhhh, you shouldn't be walking around this late.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……お酒臭い。
english: ...He reeks of alcohol.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……凸村さん、
よくこんな時にお酒なんて飲めますね……。
english: ...Totsumura-san, how can you drink at a time like this...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
逆や！　こないな状況やからこそ、
シラフで過ごせやんのじゃ。
……ひっく。
english: It's the opposite! It's because of this situation that I can't stay sober. ...*Hic*.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
勤務時間外とは言え、
警察官がそれだけお酒に飲まれるのは
どうかと思いますが……。
english: Even if you're off duty, I don't think it's right for a police officer to be that drunk...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
一人で心細かったんやさけ、
しゃあないやろ。
english: I was feeling lonely by myself, so it couldn't be helped.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
こんなときにオレの心癒やせるんは、
<color=#GF_TIPS_001>エリカちゃん</color>以外おらん、
そう考えてまうんは自然の流れやろ。
english: At a time like this, the only one who can heal my heart is <color=#GF_TIPS_001>Erika-chan</color>. It's only natural to think that way.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: <color=#GF_TIPS_045>都</color>に行ってたんですね……。
english: You went to <color=#GF_TIPS_045>Miyako</color>, huh...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
せやけど……ママから出てけ言われてしもた。
他の客が気分悪なるからってな。
english: Yeah, but... Mama told me to get out. Said I was making the other customers uncomfortable.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 何をしたんですか……。
english: What did you do?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オレはただ親切心で注意したっただけなんや。
今、この島に危ない通り魔がおる。
安易に出歩かんほうがええってな。
english: I was just warning them out of the kindness of my heart. There's a dangerous phantom killer on the island right now. It's better not to wander around carelessly.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
せやのに……みんな心底イヤそうな顔しよって。
まさかエリカちゃんにまで、
あないな顔されるやなんて……。
english: And yet... everyone looked so disgusted. I never thought even Erika-chan would look at me like that...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（たしかに楽しい酒の席には
　ふさわしくない話だったかも……）
english: (True, that might not have been a fitting topic for a fun drinking party...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも……島の人たちに、
　いくらか注意喚起できたって考えれば
　悪いことでもないのかも……）
english: (But... considering he was able to give some warning to the islanders, maybe it's not a bad thing...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ねえ、慎ちゃん……。
お祭り、どうなんのかな。
english: Hey, Shin-chan... I wonder what's going to happen with the festival.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうだな……。
もしこのまま大きな騒ぎにでもなったら、
思うように人が集まらなくなるかも。
english: Yeah... If this turns into a big uproar, people might not gather like they expect.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そこまでになったら……
　逆にマズイかもしれない……）
english: (If it comes to that... it might actually be a bad thing...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、送ってくれてありがとう。
帰り道、大丈夫？
english: Shin-chan, thanks for walking me here. Will you be okay on the way back?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、大丈夫。
凸村さんと一緒だし。
english:
Yeah, I'm fine.
I'm with Totsumura-san.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: エリカちゃん……。
english: Erika-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （大丈夫……だよな？）
english: (It'll be fine... right?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: じゃあトキちゃん、澪のこと頼んだよ。
english: Alright, Tokiko-chan, I'm leaving Mio in your hands.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ええ、わかってます。
警戒は怠りません。
english:
Yes, I understand.
I won't let my guard down.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
だから心配せずに、
後のことは全部私に任せてください……。
english: So don't worry, and leave the rest to me...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん、よろしくな。
english: Yeah, counting on you.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: じゃあ、慎ちゃんおやすみ。
english: Alright, good night, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ。
トキちゃんもおやすみ。
english: Yeah. Good night to you too, Tokiko-chan.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: はい……さよなら、慎平さん。
english: Yes… Goodbye, Shinpei-san.

japanese: 5.注意喚起
english: 5. Warning

japanese: 7月23日
english: July 23rd

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ここまで来たら、
コフネまでもうすぐやなァ。
english: Now that we're here, Kofune is just a bit further.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あの……どこまで着いてくるつもりですか？
english: Um… how far are you planning to follow me?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そ、そらぁ、
慎平くんを一人にはできやんしよォ。
english: W-Well, I can't just leave you alone, Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （酒の匂いをまき散らしながら言われてもなぁ）
english: (I can't really take that seriously when you're reeking of alcohol.)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ん？　どないしたん？
english: Huh? What's wrong?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （まあ、いいか）
english: (Well, whatever)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さん、せっかくですから、
今後の事について相談しておきましょう。
english: Totsumura-san, since we're here, let's discuss what to do moving forward.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 今後の事て……？
english: Moving forward...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
明日、応援の刑事さんが来るんですよね。
本土の人たちにはどう説明したんですか？
english: The backup detectives are coming tomorrow, right? How did you explain it to the people on the mainland?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ああ、それはやなァ……。
english: Ah, about that...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: それは……。
english: About that...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
アカン、思い出せやん。
オレ、なんちゅうて報告したんやったっけ？
何かいろいろ言うた覚えはあるんやけど。
english: Damn, I can't remember. What did I say in the report again? I remember saying a bunch of things, but.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ま、まぁ、いずれにせよ、
この島が危険な状況なのは事実なんですから、
なんとか調査して貰うしかないでしょう。
english: W-Well, either way, it's a fact that this island is in a dangerous situation, so we just have to get them to investigate somehow.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
せやな。
うん、その通りやで！
english: Right. Yeah, exactly!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（とはいっても……、
　盗撮したミオ――影のミオの映像を、
　本土の刑事に見せるのは避けたい）
english: (Even so... I want to avoid showing the secretly recorded video of Mio―― of Shadow Mio, to the mainland detectives.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（凸村さんに見せた時も、
　はじめは悪ふざけだと勘違いされたし）
english: (Even when I showed it to Totsumura-san, he thought it was a bad joke at first.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（下手すれば、澪を余計なゴタゴタに
　巻き込んでしまうだけだ）
english: (If I mess up, it'll just drag Mio into unnecessary trouble.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 後は……祭りの事も心配です。
english: Other than that... I'm also worried about the festival.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
祭り……？
ああ、明日の日都夏祭りか。
english: Festival...? Ah, the Hitogashima Summer Festival tomorrow.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
祭りの日は本土からの観光客も増えて
島がごった返しますよね。
もし、そんな中で騒ぎが起こったら――。
english: On the day of the festival, tourists from the mainland increase and the island gets packed, right? If a commotion happens in the middle of all that――.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ん、まぁ……それについては、
一応オレの方でも手ェ打っといた。
english: Hm, well... regarding that, I've taken some measures on my end too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ、凸村さんが……？
english: Eh, you did, Totsumura-san...?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
慎平くんから例の影の話聞いた後、
昼間のうちに各地区の地区長や責任者の人らに、
注意喚起だけはしといたんや。
english: After hearing about the Shadows from you, Shinpei-kun, I went ahead and issued a warning to the district heads and people in charge during the day.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
変なヤツが目撃されとるから、
あんま無駄に外へ出歩かんようにってよォ。
english: I told them that a weirdo has been spotted, so they shouldn't wander outside unnecessarily.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そない言うても、みんな楽しみにしとった祭りや。
どこまで守ってもらえるか、わからんけどな。
防犯意識をもって貰うだけでも違うやろ。
english: Even so, everyone's been looking forward to the festival. I don't know how well they'll listen, but just raising their awareness of crime prevention makes a difference.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: なんや、その顔は。
english: What's with that face?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ？　い、いえ……！
english: Huh? No, it's nothing…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まさか凸村さんが、
　ここまでちゃんと仕事してたとは……）
english: (To think Totsumura-san was actually doing his job this well...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あっ……もしかして、
昼に港へ来るのが遅くなったのは――
english: Ah... could it be, the reason you were late coming to the port this afternoon was――

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ああ、さっき言うた注意喚起の連絡が、
思いの外、長引いてしもてな。
english: Yeah, the warning calls I just mentioned ended up taking longer than expected.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
結構大変やったけど、
伝え漏らすわけにもいかんし。
english: It was pretty tough, but I couldn't just leave anyone out.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オレはこの島の駐在で<color=#GF_TIPS_097>正義の味方</color>、
島のみんなを守るんがオレの仕事や！
english: I'm the local cop on this island, a <color=#GF_TIPS_097>hero of justice</color>. Protecting everyone on the island is my job!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん……。
english: Totsumura-san…

japanese: 「本当に正義の味方みたいだ」
english: He really is like a hero of justice.'

japanese: 「凸村さんのこと誤解してたかも」
english: "I might have misunderstood Totsumura-san."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんだか、今の凸村さん、
本当に正義の味方みたいだ。
english: Somehow, Totsumura-san right now really does seem like a hero of justice.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あァ！？
ほんまにってどういうこっちゃ？
english: Hah!? What do you mean 'really'?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ほら、日頃がアレですし。
english: Well, you know how you usually are.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
失礼なこと言うなァ。
まあ、否定はせんけど。
english: Don't say such rude things. Well, I won't deny it, though.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレ、凸村さんのこと誤解してたかも。
意外としっかりしてるんですね。
english: I might have misunderstood you, Totsumura-san. You're surprisingly reliable, aren't you.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
意外とって……
慎平くん、オレのことどんな風に
思っとったん？
english: Surprisingly'... What kind of person did you think I was, Shinpei-kun?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: なんか傷ついてまうわァ。
english: I feel kinda hurt.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この人がどこまで頼りになるか、
　正直よくわからないけど……）
english: (Honestly, I don't know how reliable this guy will be, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （とにかくオレの話を信じてくれている）
english: (At the very least, he believes my story.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（その事だけでも嬉しいし……
　心強くもある）
english: (Just that fact alone makes me happy... and it's reassuring.)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: なんや？　今の光。
english: What was that light?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
澪ちゃん？
なしてこんなとこに……。
english: Mio-chan? Why are you in a place like this...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん、近づかないで！
english: Totsumura-san, don't get close!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ？？　血相変えてどうしたん。
english: ?? What's wrong, you look so pale.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: たぶんこいつは澪じゃありません……。
english: This probably isn't Mio...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
何言ってんの。
どこからどう見ても澪ちゃんやん。
english: What are you talking about. She looks exactly like Mio-chan from every angle.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いい加減、酔いを覚ましてください！
english: Please, sober up already!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トキちゃんとこに行った後、
制服に着替えて、先回りして――
そんなことできるはずないでしょ！
english: Going to Tokiko-chan's place, changing into her uniform, and getting ahead of us―― There's no way she could do that!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 確かに変やな……。
english: That is weird...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
えっ、ちょっと待たんかい。
ほな、この澪ちゃんは……。
english: Eh, wait a minute. Then, this Mio-chan is...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレの家の前で包丁を持ってたミオですよ。
english: It's the Mio who had a kitchen knife in front of my house.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: コ、コイツが……！？
english: T-This is... !?

japanese: 6.夜闇に紛れて
english: 6. Slipping into the Darkness

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（体が光ってる！
　凸村さんの影が生まれた時と同じだ……！）
english: (Her body is glowing! It's the same as when Totsumura-san's Shadow was born...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも……今のところ
　追ってくる気配は……ない？）
english: (But... for now there's no sign of her chasing us...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もしかしてあの状態では動けないんじゃ……？
　だったら！）
english: (Could it be she can't move in that state...? If so!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん、走って！！
english: Totsumura-san, run!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: えっ！？　お、おおっ！
english: Eh!? O-Ooh!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ハァハァ……なんやアイツ！？
めっちゃ体光っとったぞ！
english: *Pant* *pant*... What was that guy!? Its body was glowing so much!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
たぶん……新しい影を生み出してたんです。
前にも似たようなことがあって……。
english: Probably... it was giving birth to a new Shadow. Something similar happened before...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
慎平くんの言うてた話……、
やっぱりほんまやったんやな……。
english: The story you were telling me, Shinpei-kun... It really was true, huh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
とにかく今は逃げましょう！
あいつが追ってこないうちに――
english: Anyway, let's run for now! Before that thing chases after us――

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ハァ、ハァ、ハァ……。
english: *Pant*, *pant*, *pant*...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: と、凸村さん？
english: T-Totsumura-san?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
アカン……。
もうオレ、走れやん……。
english: No good... I can't run anymore...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……でも逃げなきゃ影が！
english: ...But if we don't run, the Shadow will!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
わかってる。
でも無理なもんは無理やいしょ……。
english: I know. But impossible is impossible...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
わかりました。
でも走って逃げるのが無理なら、
どこかに隠れるとか……
english: I understand. But if we can't run away, we should hide somewhere...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 駐在所……はアカンか。
english: The police station... won't work, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でしょうね……。
もうあいつらの手が回ってるかもしれない。
english: Probably not... They might already have it surrounded.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それに……できるだけ巻き添えになる人は
出したくないので、
人のいる場所は避けましょう。
english: Besides... I want to avoid getting anyone else involved as much as possible, so let's avoid places with people.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
それ逆やしょ。
人混みの方が、澪ちゃ……いや、あいつは
襲ってきやんのとちゃうか？
english: Isn't it the other way around? If we're in a crowd, Mio-cha... no, that thing won't attack us, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 確かに今まではそうだったかもしれません。
english: That might have been true up until now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だけど今は事情が違う……たぶんですけど……。
english: But things are different now... probably.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレが２回目……ミオに殺された時――）
english: (The second time... when I was killed by Mio――)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あの時ミオは、
　拳銃の発砲音のリスクを恐れて慎重な姿勢を
　崩さなかった）
english: (At that time, Mio maintained a cautious stance, fearing the risk of the gunshot sound.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（つまりそれは、自分たちの存在がばれるのは
　ミオ達にとって何かしらのリスクを伴う
　ということだ）
english: (In other words, that means having their existence revealed carries some kind of risk for Mio and the others.)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 慎平くん、黙ってやんで何か言うてや！
english: Shinpei-kun, don't just stay quiet, say something!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 説明をするのは難しいんですが……。
english: It's hard to explain, but…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影のミオは、自分たちの存在がばれないよう
慎重に行動している所がありました。
english: Shadow Mio had been acting cautiously so their existence wouldn't be revealed.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それなのに、今日になっていきなり
オレたちの前に現れたんです。
english: Despite that, she suddenly appeared in front of us today.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: つまり……どういうことなん？
english: So… what does that mean?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ですから、それくらいのリスクを冒しても、
オレたちの前に出ざるを得ない事情が発生したんです。
english: I'm saying that a situation has occurred where they had no choice but to appear before us, even if it meant taking that kind of risk.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 影のミオたちにとっては、都合の悪い事情が……。
english: An inconvenient situation for Shadow Mio and the others...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
それやったら、
人がおるところにオレらがおったら
マズイやん！
english: If that's the case, then it's bad if we're around other people!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ですから、そう言ってるんですよ。
english: That's exactly what I'm saying.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: とにかく町から離れよら。
english: Anyway, let's get away from town.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ええ、身を隠せる場所を探しましょう。
english: Yes, let's find a place to hide.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
痛たたた……くそっ！
こんな夜更けに森ん中とか、
まともに歩けやんで……。
english: Owowow... damn it! I can't even walk properly in the middle of the forest this late at night...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まだ影の姿は見えませんね。
今のうちに身を隠しておきましょう。
english: I still don't see the Shadow. Let's hide while we have the chance.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ああ。
ほな、そこの茂みの陰に……。
english: Yeah. Then, in the shadow of those bushes...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
なんで……
こないな事になってしもたんやろな……。
english: Why... did things end up like this...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ともかく今は、どうやって逃げ切るかだけを
考えましょう……。
english: Anyway, for now, let's just think about how to escape...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
こうしていつまでも隠れてるわけにも
いかないでしょうし……。
english: We can't just stay hidden like this forever, either...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
せやな……。
でも朝になったら本土からの応援が来るはずや。
それを待って――
english: You're right... But backup from the mainland should arrive in the morning. If we wait for that――

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや、それはマズイです。
english: No, that's bad.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ……な、なんでなん！？
english: ...W-Why!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっきの影……凸村さんかオレのどっちかを
コピーした可能性があります。
english: That Shadow from earlier... there's a possibility it copied either you or me, Totsumura-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もしコピーされたのが
凸村さんやったとしたら……。
english: If the one that was copied was you, Totsumura-san...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ……したら？
english: ...Then?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
応援の刑事が来ても、そのニセモノ……
影の凸村さんに言いくるめられて
本土へ帰ってしまうかも……。
english: Even if the backup detectives come, that fake... Shadow Totsumura-san might sweet-talk them into going back to the mainland...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: そんなアホな！？
english: That's ridiculous!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もちろん朝になる前に、
オレたちが殺されてしまうって可能性も
十分ありますけどね。
english: Of course, there's also a very good chance that we'll be killed before morning comes.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 一体どないしたらええんや……。
english: What the hell are we supposed to do...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （影のミオにはコフネの場所も知られてる）
english: (Shadow Mio knows where Kofune is too.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも帰る場所がないとしても、
　このままただ身を潜めてるだけじゃ……）
english: (But even if we have nowhere to go, just hiding here like this is...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（少なくとも何か身を守るような
　ものがあれば……）
english: (If only we had something to protect ourselves with, at least...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 身を守るもの……。
english: Something to protect ourselves…

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: なんやのジッと見て。
english: Why are you staring at me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん、拳銃持ってますよね？
english: Totsumura-san, you have a gun, right?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
拳銃……？
ああ、そりゃ持っとるけど……
english: A gun...? Yeah, I have one, but...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
って、アカン！
これはアカンで！！
english: Wait, no! I can't do that!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ここでこんなもん使てしもたら
始末書どころじゃ済ませやんやいしょ！
english: If I use this thing here, I won't get off with just a written apology!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん、落ち着いてください！
english: Totsumura-san, calm down!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もしコピーされたのが凸村さんだったとしたら……
相手も拳銃を持っているって事になるんですよ？
english: If the one copied was you, Totsumura-san... That means the enemy has a gun too, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（前のループで影のミオは影のトツムラさんから
　銃を借りていた……）
english: (In the previous loop, Shadow Mio borrowed a gun from Shadow Totsumura-san...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（コピーされた影は、
　コピー元の人間が持っていたものすべてを
　持ってると考えておいた方がいいだろう）
english: (It's better to assume that the copied Shadow has everything the original person had.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレらがこのまま朝まで逃げ切れる保証は
どこにもありません。
english: There's no guarantee anywhere that we can escape until morning like this.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それに、たとえ朝まで逃げ切れたとしても、
根本的な脅威を排除しない以上、
危険は尽きません。
english: Besides, even if we manage to escape until morning, as long as we don't eliminate the fundamental threat, the danger won't end.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 根本的な……脅威？
english: The fundamental… threat?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ええ……根本的な脅威、
あの影をどうにかしない以上、
オレらはずっと狙われたままなんです！
english: Yes... the fundamental threat. As long as we don't do something about that Shadow, we'll constantly be targeted!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そう考えたら……
もう覚悟するしかないと思いませんか？
english: When you think about it that way... Don't you think we have no choice but to prepare ourselves?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あいつらは人を殺すのにまったく躊躇しない化物です。
english: They are monsters who don't hesitate at all to kill people.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレを殺した時でさえ……
　影のミオは顔色ひとつ変えなかった）
english: (Even when she killed me... Shadow Mio's expression didn't change at all.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だから……。
english: So…

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: やられる前にやれ……ちゅうことか。
english: Kill or be killed... is that it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ええ、影については分からない事
ばかりですけど……
english: Yes, there's a lot we don't know about the Shadows, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
包丁を使ったりするぐらいだし、
身体能力は人間と大差ないんじゃないかと
考えてます。
english: Seeing as they use things like kitchen knives, I'm thinking their physical abilities aren't much different from humans.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もし影が拳銃を持っていたなら、
ヤツらは躊躇なくそれを使ってくるでしょう。
だから……
english: If the Shadow has a gun, they will use it without hesitation. Therefore...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もしものときは、
戦うしかないんです。
english: If it comes down to it, we have no choice but to fight.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
生き残るためにも……。
島の人たちを守るためにも……。
english: To survive... And to protect the people of the island...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 島の人たちを……守るため……。
english: To protect... the people of the island...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
せやな……。
オレは正義の味方。
english: You're right... I'm a hero of justice.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 島のみんなを守るんがオレの仕事や。
english: Protecting everyone on the island is my job.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
エリカちゃんのためにも、
いっちょやったるわい！
english: For Erika-chan's sake too, I'm gonna do this!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
やりましょう！
戦って、みんなを守るんです！
english: Let's do it! We'll fight and protect everyone!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: おお、やったるでェ！
english: Ooh, let's do this!

japanese: 7.ふたつの影
english: 7. Two Shadows

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: な、ななな、なんや今の音……！？
english: W-W-W-What was that sound just now...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: シッ、声を小さくしてください！
english: Shh, please keep your voice down!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あああ、あの音……犬や猫とかやないな。
もっと大きな……。
english: T-That sound... it wasn't a dog or a cat. Something much bigger...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もしかしたら、影のミオかも。
そうでなければ……。
english: It might be Shadow Mio. And if not...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
し、慎平くん……いや、
オオオ、オレのニセモンかもしれんってワケか。
english: S-Shinpei-kun... wait, y-y-you're saying it might be my fake?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ええ、そういう事になります。
english: Yes, that's what it means.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
かかか、影どもめ……もしオレの目の前に
現れよったら、そそ、その時は……その時は！
english: D-D-Damn Shadows... if they show up in front of me, t-t-then... then I'll...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん？
english: Totsumura-san?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
その時は、その時は、
この拳銃で、この拳銃で……。
english: Then I'll, then I'll... use this gun, use this gun...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん、落ち着いてください。
english: Totsumura-san, please calm down.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: お、お、落ち着いてるわい。
english: I-I-I am calm.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうは見え――
english: You don't look like――

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん、来ます……！
english: Totsumura-san, here they come...!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん、どこー？
その辺に隠れてるんやろ？
出て来てよー。
english: Shin-chan, where are you~? You're hiding around here, right? Come out~.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 来よった……！
english: She's here...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
おい、あの澪ちゃんのニセモン、
包丁持っとるぞ……！
english: Hey, that fake Mio-chan, she's holding a kitchen knife...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影のミオ……。
　顔や姿だけじゃなく、
　声まで澪そのものだ……）
english: (Shadow Mio... Not just her face and body, even her voice is exactly like Mio's...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ここで下手すると、
　また首を刺された時みたいに……）
english: (If I mess up here, it'll be just like when I got stabbed in the neck...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや……怯えたらアカン！
　フカン、フカンするんや！）
english: (No... I can't be scared! Bird's-eye view, take a bird's-eye view!)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ア、アカン……来んな……！
english: N-No... don't come any closer...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: こっち来んなって……！
english: I said don't come any closer...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん……声が大きい！
english: Totsumura-san... you're too loud!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
見～つけた！
そこにおったんかァ！
english: Found~ you! So that's where you were!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （しまった……！）
english: (Damn it...!)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃんにちょっと聞きたいこと
あんねやけど……。
english: I have something I wanna ask you, Shin-chan...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: う……うあああぁぁぁ！！！！
english: U... Uwaaaahhh!!!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
こっ、このバケモン……！
思い知ったか、コラぁ！
english: Y-You monster...! How do you like that, huh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: と、凸村さん……！？
english: T-Totsumura-san...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （倒れて……動かない）
english: (She fell... she's not moving.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （やった……のか？）
english: (Did he... get her?)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 澪のこと……守っちゃってね……。
english: Take good care of Mio...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （落ち着け、あれは澪じゃない……）
english: (Calm down, that's not Mio...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あれは影のミオ……。
　オレたちを殺しにきたんだ……！）
english: (That's Shadow Mio... She came to kill us...!)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
もぉ～。
不意打ちとか、ずるいわぁ。
english: Jeez~. A surprise attack, that's not fair.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……えっ？

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ア、アホな……！
たしかに当たったはずや！
english: T-That's impossible...! It definitely hit!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
胸のど真ん中やぞ！？
せやのに……こんなんありえへん！！
english: Right in the middle of her chest, too!? And yet... this is impossible!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
うるさいなァ。
じゃ、今度はこっちの番。
english: You're so noisy. Well, it's my turn now.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 慎平くんッ！？
english: Shinpei-kun!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
避けやんといてよ、慎ちゃん。
あともうちょっとやったのに。
english: Don't dodge, Shin-chan. I almost had you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（な、なんだ、今の動き……！？
　人間の速さじゃない！）
english: (W-What was that movement just now...!? That's not human speed!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （しかも銃で撃たれても死なないなんて……）
english: (And she didn't even die after getting shot...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こんなヤツ相手に戦って……
　本当に勝てるのか！？）
english: (Can we really win... fighting against something like this!?)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: も、もうアカン……！
english: I-It's no use...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
退却や……！
一時撤退やで、慎平くん！
english: Retreat...! We're making a temporary retreat, Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん……！？
english: Totsumura-san…!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
あ～あ。
哲さん、自分だけ逃げてしもた。
english: Ah~a. Tetsu-san ran away all by himself.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
まァ、ええか。
ちゃんとそっちの備えもしといたし。
english: Well, whatever. I made sure to prepare for that too.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
な、なんやおまえ……！
オレそっくりやんけ！？
english: W-What are you...! You look exactly like me!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
って……えっ？
まさかオレのニセモン？
english: Wait... eh? Are you my fake?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: わぁぁぁぁぁぁッ！？
english: Waaaaaah!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん！！
english: Totsumura-san!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （挟み撃ちされていたのか……！）
english: (We were being pincered...!)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
そういうことやから、
慎ちゃんも観念して答えてや。
english: So that's how it is. Give up and answer me, Shin-chan.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
私のこと動画で撮ったらしいやん。
でも、なんで私のこと……
私が来ること知っとったん？
english: I heard you took a video of me. But, why did you... How did you know I was coming?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （動画のこと……バレてる！？）
english: (She knows about the video...!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もしかして……コバマートでつくられた
　オレのコピーから聞いたのか？）
english: (Could it be... she heard it from my copy that was made at Koba Mart?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だとすれば……影は他にもいて、
　影同士連携をとってる可能性が……）
english: (If that's true... there are other Shadows, and there's a possibility they're coordinating with each other...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くそ……。
english: Damn it...

speaker: Mio
japanese: 答える気ィないみたいやね。
english: Looks like you don't feel like answering.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
あ～あ、慎ちゃん本人の口から
聞きたかったんやけどなァ。
english: Ah~a, I wanted to hear it from Shin-chan himself, though.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（と、とにかく今は、
　この状況を乗り切らないと……）
english: (A-Anyway, for now, I have to get through this situation...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なぜこんな事をする……？
目的は何だ！？
english: Why are you doing this...? What's your goal!?

speaker: Mio
japanese: それ聞いてどうするん？
english: What are you going to do if I tell you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
こっちの質問に答えてくれ。
ちゃんと答えてくれたらこっちも――
english: Answer my question. If you answer properly, I'll――

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ああ、無理無理。
たとえ慎ちゃんでもそれは言えやんよ。
english: Ah, no way. I can't tell you that, even if it's you, Shin-chan.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ごめんな。
きっちり殺しちゃるから、
それで勘弁してや。
english: Sorry. I'll kill you properly, so let's leave it at that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえは……絶対に澪じゃない！
澪がそんな事、絶対に言うわけがない！
english: You're... definitely not Mio! There's no way Mio would ever say something like that!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
慎平くん、えらいこっちゃ！
あ、あっちにオレのニセモンが……！
english: Shinpei-kun, this is terrible! M-My fake is over there...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん……！？
english: Totsumura-san…!?

speaker: Mio
japanese: あれ？　まだ死んでへんかったん？
english: Huh? You're not dead yet?

speaker: Totsumura
japanese: コラコラ、逃げたらアカンやんけ。
english: Hey, hey, you can't run away.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
死刑じょ。
大人しゅう観念せェ。
english: Death penalty. Give up quietly.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こいつが影のトツムラ……）
english: (This is Shadow Totsumura...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （二人の影に挟まれて……逃げ場が無い）
english: (Pincered by two Shadows... there's nowhere to run.)

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
ほな、ここらで終いにしよか。
まだまだやらなアカン事が
ようけあるさけよォ。
english: Well then, let's finish this here. We've still got a lot of things we have to do.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ほんまやね。
テツさん、このあと大忙しやし。
english: That's right. Tetsu-san is going to be very busy after this.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
せやでェ。
本土からまた刑事が来るらしいからな。
english: Yeah. Seems like more detectives are coming from the mainland.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
前に来た連中みたいに
早いトコ始末しとかなアカンじょ。
english: Gotta dispose of them quickly like the guys who came before.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
し、始末って……
まさかおらんようになった刑事らは、
おまえが！？
english: D-Dispose of... Don't tell me you're the one who got rid of the missing detectives!?

speaker: Totsumura
japanese: せやで。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
増援の始末が終わったら、
次はそいつが吹聴したオレらの噂を
消して回らなアカンねん。
english: After I'm done disposing of the reinforcements, next I have to go around erasing the rumors he spread about us.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese: ほんまやる事多てかなわんわァ。
english: I've really got too much to do, it's a pain.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: おまえ……そ、そんな事まで！
english: You... y-you'd go that far!

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
おまえのかわりは、
このオレがちゃ～んとつとめちゃる。
せやさけ、安心して死んどき。
english: I'll make sure to take over your place properly. So you can die in peace.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: こ、このバケモンが……！
english: Y-You monster...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まだだ……。
　まだ何か出来る事があるはず……）
english: (Not yet... There must still be something I can do...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （どうにかしてみんなを助けるんだ！）
english: (I have to find a way to save everyone!)

japanese: 自分が囮になって凸村を逃がす
english: Act as a decoy and let Totsumura escape

japanese: なんとしても凸村を連れて逃げる
english: Escape with Totsumura no matter what

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もしオレが殺されても、
　またやり直せるチャンスがあるかもしれない）
english: (Even if I get killed, there might be a chance to start over again.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （でも凸村さんは……）
english: (But Totsumura-san...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だったら今はオレが囮になってでも、
　凸村さんを逃がすしかない！）
english: (Then right now, even if I have to be a decoy, I have to let Totsumura-san escape!)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 慎平くん、どないしたらええ？
english: Shinpei-kun, what should we do?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
できたら、オレ、
まだ死にたないんやけどなァ……。
english: If possible, I don't really want to die yet...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
大丈夫です、凸村さん。
オレにまかせてください……！
english: It's okay, Totsumura-san. Please leave it to me...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そのためにも、
　ここはどうにかして凸村さんを連れて
　逃げ切るしかない！）
english: (For that reason too, I have to find a way to escape with Totsumura-san!)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: もしかしてオレら、このまま……。
english: Are we going to... just like this...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まだ諦めないでください！
必ず二人で生きて帰りましょう。
english: Don't give up yet! We will definitely both make it back alive.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 慎平くん……。
english: Shinpei-kun…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だから、しっかりしてください。
凸村さんは正義の味方なんですよね？
english: So, please pull yourself together. You're a hero of justice, right, Totsumura-san?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: A-Ah...

japanese: 8.悪夢は終わらない
english: 8. The Nightmare Won't End

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この場を乗り切るためならもう……
　こっちだってなりふり構ってられない！）
english: (If it's to survive this situation... I can't afford to care about appearances anymore!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あいつらは本物とまったく同じ姿をしてる。
　おそらく、記憶も……）
english: (They look exactly like the real ones. Probably their memories too...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （だとしたらやっぱり……この方法しかない！）
english: (If that's the case, then... this is the only way!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん……。
english: Totsumura-san…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレが合図したら走ってください……。
english: When I give the signal, run...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: いや、急に走れ言われても……。
english: Even if you tell me to run all of a sudden...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お願いします。
騙されたと思ってオレを信じてください。
english: Please. Just trust me on this.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ……信じて、ええんやな？
english: ...I can trust you, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい……。
何も考えず一心不乱に走ってください。
english: Yes... Don't think about anything and just run for it.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese: なにブツブツと話しとんねん。
english: What are you muttering about.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
なァ、ミオちゃん。
こいつらなに企んどるかわからんで？
さっさと片付けてまおや。
english: Hey, Mio-chan. Who knows what these guys are plotting? Let's just finish them off.

speaker: Mio
japanese: そうやね。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（クソッ……！
　そう簡単に殺されてたまるかよッ！）
english: (Damn it...! Like hell I'm going to let them kill me so easily!)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
じゃあ慎ちゃん。
覚悟はもうエエ？
english: Well then, Shin-chan. Are you ready?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （よし……ここだ！）
english: (Alright... now!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、あれって、エリカさんじゃ……！
どうしてここに！？
english: I-Is that Erika-san...! Why is she here!?

speaker: Mio
japanese: えっ……？

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
エリカちゃんやとォ！？
どこや！　どこにおんねん！？
english:
Erika-chan!?
Where! Where is she!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今だ、凸村さん！
english: Now, Totsumura-san!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
慎平くん、どこや！？
エリカちゃん、どこにおんねん！？
english: Shinpei-kun, where!? Where is Erika-chan!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: って、凸村さんまで引っかかってる！？
english: Wait, even you fell for it, Totsumura-san!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
合図をしたら走ってくださいって
言ったじゃないですか！
english: Didn't I tell you to run when I gave the signal!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
せやけど、エリカちゃんがおるって
慎平くんが……。
english: Yeah, but you said Erika-chan was here, Shinpei-kun...

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
クソッ、どこにもおらんやないか！
騙しよったな、コラッ！
english: Damn it, she's nowhere to be seen! You tricked me, you punk!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
しくじった……。
凸村さんにはもう少し詳しく説明して
おいたほうが良かったか。
english: I messed up... I should have explained it a bit more clearly to Totsumura-san.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
あっははっ！
残念、作戦失敗やね。
english: Ahahaha! Too bad, your plan failed.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: く……ッ。
english: Guh...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 作戦失敗って……？
english: Plan failed...?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ああッ、しもたァ！
そういうことやったんか！？
english: Aah, damn it! So that's what that was!?

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
こんボケがァッ！！
ようもダマしてくれたのォ～～！！
english: You little punk!! How dare you trick me~~!!

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
もォ勘弁できやんじょ！
ぶち殺しちゃる！！
english: I won't let you off anymore! I'm gonna kill you!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やっちまった……！
　最悪の展開だ……）
english: (I messed up...! This is the worst possible outcome...)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
う、うおォォォォ！！
だァっとれ、クソだらァァァ！！
english: U-Uwoooohhh!! Shut up, you piece of shit!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん……！
english: Totsumura-san…!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
どや……ニセモンのドタマ、ブチ抜いたったわ……！
オレかてこれぐらい……。
english: How's that... I blew that fake's head clean off...! Even I can do this much...

speaker: Mio
japanese: これくらい、なんです？
english: This much, what?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なっ！？　ミオいつの間に！
english: Wha!? Mio, when did you...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ぐふっ……！
english: Guh...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……凸村さん！！
english: …Totsumura-san!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ほ、包丁が腹に……。
いっこも躊躇しやんて……普通やない……。
english: T-The kitchen knife is in my stomach... She didn't hesitate at all... this isn't normal...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ぐふっ、あかん……体に力入らん。
english: Guh, no good... I can't put any strength into my body.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
でも、へへ、やったで慎平くん。
オレの影は倒せた……あとはミオちゃんだけや。
english: But, hehe, I did it, Shinpei-kun. I defeated my Shadow... now it's just Mio-chan.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
だ、そうですけど、テツさんいつまで寝てるんです。
遊んでやんで起きてください。
english: So he says, but how long are you going to sleep, Tetsu-san? Stop playing around and get up.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？
english: Eh?

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
もうちょっと期待させといたろ思たのに、
ミオちゃん、ネタバレ早すぎるわ。
english: I was thinking of letting him get his hopes up a bit more, but you spoiled it too quickly, Mio-chan.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: おまえら……不死身なんかい……。
english: You guys... are you immortal or something...

speaker: Mio
japanese: さあ、どうでしょね。
english: Well, I wonder.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ぐはっ！
english: Gah!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: やめろ……。
english: Stop...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: やめろーーーーーーーーー！！
english: Stop ittttttttt!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ……ああ……凸村さん……。
english: A... Ah... Totsumura-san...

speaker: Totsumura
japanese: ほんで、慎平くんはどないする？
english: So, what are we doing with Shinpei-kun?

speaker: Mio
japanese: もちろん殺すけど。
english: Killing him, of course.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
ま、あとはミオちゃんに任せるわ。
オレは、やるべきことやらんと。
english: Well, I'll leave the rest to you, Mio-chan. I have things I need to do.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
それはええけど、
余計な事はせんといてくださいね。
english: That's fine, but please don't do anything unnecessary.

speaker: Totsumura
japanese: わかってる、わかってる。
english: I know, I know.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うぅ……凸村さん……。
english: Uugh... Totsumura-san...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん、私らに真っ向勝負とか、
無駄死にもええとこやったね。
english: Shin-chan, trying to fight us head-on was a complete waste of your life.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （クソッ、こんなヤツに……）
english: (Damn it, to someone like this...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（すみません、凸村さん……。
　次は、次こそはきっと……）
english: (I'm sorry, Totsumura-san... Next time, next time for sure...)

speaker: Mio
japanese: それじゃ、さようなら。
english: Well then, goodbye.

japanese: 4周目
english: 4th Loop

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （い、生きてる……？）
english: (I-I'm alive...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やった、戻れたんだ……！
　これでまたやり直せる！）
english: (Yes, I made it back...! Now I can start over again!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: って、あれ……？
english: Wait, huh...?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん、どこー？
その辺に隠れてるんやろ？
出て来てよー。
english: Shin-chan, where are you~? You're hiding around here, right? Come out~.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 来よった……！
english: She's here...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
おい、あの澪ちゃんのニセモン、
包丁持っとるぞ……！
english: Hey, that fake Mio-chan, she's holding a kitchen knife...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ここは……同じ場所じゃないか。
　しかも、ついさっきと同じ……）
english: (This is... the exact same place. And it's exactly the same as just a moment ago...)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ア、アカン……来んな……！
english: N-No... don't come any closer...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: こっち来んなって……！
english: I said don't come any closer...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: て事は……！？
english: Which means...!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
見～つけた！
そこにおったんかァ！
english: Found~ you! So that's where you were!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （せっかくやり直せたのに……これじゃ……）
english: (I finally got to start over... but at this rate...)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃんにちょっと聞きたいこと
あんねやけど……。
english: I have something I wanna ask you, Shin-chan...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: う……うあああぁぁぁ！！！！
english: U... Uwaaaahhh!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （悪夢は……）
english: (The nightmare...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （始まったばかり、か……）
english: (Has only just begun, huh...)

japanese: 9.島のヒーロー
english: 9. The Island's Hero

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（とにかく慎重に……
　どうにかして時間を稼ぎながら……）
english: (Anyway, I need to be careful... and somehow buy time...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （この状況を打開できる策を考えるんだ）
english: (I need to think of a way to break out of this situation.)

speaker: Mio
japanese: もう覚悟は決まった？
english: Have you made up your mind?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: うぅッ……！
english: Ugh…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
どうしてもここで……
オレらを仕留めるつもりなんだな。
english: So you're determined to... finish us off here, huh.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃんがアカンのやで。
余計な事に首突っ込むから。
english: It's your own fault, Shin-chan. Because you stuck your nose where it didn't belong.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 余計な事って……！
english: Where it didn't belong...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
おッ……おまえらは何なんや！？
一体どんだけおんねん！？
english: H-Hey... what the hell are you guys!? How many of you are there!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
島中の人を殺しまくって、
おまえらがその人らになりすますつもりか！？
english: Are you planning to kill everyone on the island and take their places!?

speaker: Totsumura
japanese:
黙っとかんかいや。
そんなん言う必要あらへん。
english: Shut up. I don't need to tell you that.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: そんな事……。
english: Like I'd let you...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: そんな事させるか、ボケぇぇぇ！！
english: Like I'd let you do that, you punk!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん……！？
english: Totsumura-san…!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オレは正義の味方やぞ！
おまえらなんぞに勝手させてたまるかい！
english: I'm a hero of justice! I won't let you guys do whatever you want!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オレはこの島の駐在や！
日都ヶ島の平和はオレが守っちゃる！
english: I'm the local cop on this island! I'll protect the peace of Hitogashima!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
どんなバケモン相手でもなァ！
正義の味方は、絶対負けへんのじゃァアアア！！
english: No matter what kind of monster I'm up against! A hero of justice will never lose!!!

speaker: Totsumura
japanese: なんッ……！？
english: What…!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （銃弾が命中したようにも見えたけど……）
english: (It looked like the bullets hit, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（とっさに伏せてしまったから、
　状況がよくわからない……！）
english: (I ducked instinctively, so I don't really know what happened...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あいつらは……
　影たちはどうなったんだ！？）
english: (What happened to them... What happened to the Shadows!?)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……ハァ……。
english: *Pant*... *pant*... *pant*...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
やった……。
やったで慎平くんッ！
english: I did it... I did it, Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ニセモンを倒した……！
本物のオレがオレのニセモンを
倒したったでェッ！
english: I beat the fake...! The real me defeated my fake!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん……。
english: Totsumura-san…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（一発はあいつに命中したように見えたけど……
　もう一発は影の足をかすめただけだった……）
english: (It looked like one shot hit him... but the other just grazed the Shadow's leg...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あたりに影トツムラの姿がないけど……
　もしかして本当に倒せたのか？）
english: (I don't see Shadow Totsumura around... Could he have actually defeated him?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影ミオは銃弾が命中しても
　けろっとしてたのに……）
english: (Even though Shadow Mio was completely unfazed even after getting hit by a bullet...)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
何してんの、テツさん。
ほんまマヌケな人やな。
english: What are you doing, Tetsu-san. You really are an idiot.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
て、手ェ上げろ！
澪ちゃ……いやニセモンのミオちゃんも
こないなりたなかったら……！
english: P-Put your hands up! Mio-cha... no, fake Mio-chan, if you don't want to end up like this...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: さっさと降参するんや！
english: Hurry up and surrender!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ハァ、もう最低や。
予定が狂いまくりやわ。
english: *Sigh*, this is the worst. My plans are completely ruined.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
いつまで余裕ぶっこいとんねん！
オ、オレは本気やぞ！
english: How long are you gonna act so smug! I-I'm serious!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
本気で撃ってまうぞ！
エ、エエんやなッ！？
english: I'll shoot you for real! Y-You're okay with that, right!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
哲さんが広めた私らの噂、
あの話をなかった事にするにはテツさん本人に
説明して回ってもらわなアカンかったのに。
english: Those rumors about us that you spread, Tetsu-san. To make that story go away, we needed you to go around explaining it yourself.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なあ、哲さん。
影のテツさんの代わりに
「あれは嘘やった」って言うて回ってくれやん？
english: Hey, Tetsu-san. Instead of Shadow Tetsu-san, could you go around saying 'that was a lie'?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
アホかッ！
言うわけないやろがッ！
english: Are you an idiot!? Like hell I'd say that!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
そっか。
まあ、ええわ。
english:
I see.
Well, it's fine.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 生きてたら都合の悪い人は殺せばええだけやし。
english: If someone is inconvenient alive, we just have to kill them.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
哲さん、慎ちゃん、
私らの事を知ってしもた人らも、
朝イチで来る本土の刑事らもみんな。
english: Tetsu-san, Shin-chan, the people who found out about us, and the mainland detectives coming first thing in the morning.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
一人残らず殺したらエエ。
それでなんも問題あらへん。
english: We'll just kill every last one of them. Then there won't be any problems.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: み、皆殺しする気か！？
english: Y-You're gonna massacre everyone!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オレが……オレがあのニセモンを
殺した報復か！？
english: Is this... retaliation for me killing that fake!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
そやね。
余計な手間増やしてくれたわ。
english: I guess so. You just created more unnecessary work for us.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
本土から来る刑事さえ片付けたら
良かったはずやのに。
english: We were supposed to just have to take care of the detectives coming from the mainland.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だ、だからって……！
english: E-Even so...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そんな……オレのせいで島のみんなが……。
ウソやろ……。
english: That's... because of me, everyone on the island... You're lying...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さん！　気を確かに！
諦めるのはまだ早い！
english: Totsumura-san! Pull yourself together! It's too early to give up!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
english: Eh…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
こいつを……！
この澪そっくりの影を今ここで
倒せばいいんですよ！
english: This one...! If we just defeat this Shadow that looks exactly like Mio right here and now, it'll be fine!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうすれば、これ以上の被害は出ません！
みんなを救えるんです！
english: If we do that, there won't be any more casualties! We can save everyone!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
たいした意気込みやね。
でも、どうやって私を殺すつもり？
english: That's some enthusiasm. But how are you planning to kill me?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
さっきは胸やったっけ。
次はどこ撃つん？
english: Earlier it was the chest, right. Where are you going to shoot next?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: し、慎平くん……。
english: S-Shinpei-kun...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （たしかに胸を撃っても影ミオには効かなかった）
english: (It's true that shooting the chest didn't work on Shadow Mio.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （でも、トツムラの影はなぜか倒せた……）
english: (But for some reason, we were able to defeat Shadow Totsumura...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（フカンしろ……！
　何か弱点があるはず……そこさえ狙えれば！）
english: (Take a bird's-eye view...! There has to be a weakness... if we can just aim for that!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さん！
さっき撃った二発、影のどこに当たりましたか！？
english: Totsumura-san! Where did those two shots from earlier hit the Shadow!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
え、えーっと……
一発は下にそれて地面に当たってしもたけど……
english: E-Erm... One missed low and hit the ground, but...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: もう一発は頭に命中したはずや！
english: The other one definitely hit him in the head!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （頭……そうか、頭か）
english: (The head... right, the head.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 残りの弾はあと何発ですか！？
english: How many bullets are left!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
え、ええと……！
ニューナンブは五連発で、
もう四発撃っとるから――
english: E-Erm...! The New Nambu holds five rounds, and I've already fired four, so――

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 残り一発……か。
english: Just one left... huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さん、オレが体張って
あいつの動きを抑えます。
english: Totsumura-san, I'll put my body on the line to hold her down.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
その間にあいつの頭を正確に撃ち抜いてください。
影の弱点は……たぶん頭です！
english: In the meantime, please shoot her accurately in the head. The Shadow's weakness is... probably the head!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: お、おお……。
english: O-Oh...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
って、ちょぉ待てや！
オレがしくじったらどないすんねん！？
english: Wait, hold on a sec! What happens if I mess up!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ヘッドショットら、
そない簡単に出来るもんやないで！？
english: A headshot, that's not something you can just easily pull off!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そこを何とか……お願いします！
ここが勝負所なんです！
english: Please... you have to manage it somehow! This is the decisive moment!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
もう話し合いは終わった？
十分時間あげたと思うけど。
english: Are you done talking? I think I gave you plenty of time.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: A-Ah...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
し、慎平くん。
さっきの作戦……やっぱりアカンわ。
english: S-Shinpei-kun. That plan from earlier... I can't do it.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ここは慎平くんやのうて、オレが行く！
english: Instead of you, Shinpei-kun, I'll go!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あんなバケモン相手に体張るとか……
そない危険な事は年長者の役目やいしょ！
english: Putting your body on the line against a monster like that... Something that dangerous is the elder's job!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: と……凸村さん……。
english: T-Totsumura-san...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
年長者だからというより……
島のヒーローだから、ですか？
english: Is it less because you're the elder... and more because you're the island's hero?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ははは……。
まあ、そんなトコや。
english: Hahaha... Well, something like that.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ほな、頼むわ。コレ……まかせたで。
english: Alright, I'm counting on you. I'm leaving this... to you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（本物の銃……初めて触った。
　思ってたよりずっと重い）
english: (A real gun... this is my first time holding one. It's much heavier than I thought.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今からこれで、オレは……）
english: (Now, with this, I'm going to...)

speaker: Mio
japanese: ほな、そろそろ――
english: Well then, it's about time――

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そうはさせんでェッ！
うおォォォォォォォッ！！
english: I won't let you! Uwoooooohhh!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （凸村さんが行った……！）
english: (Totsumura-san went...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （だったらオレは……！）
english: (Then I have to...!)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: どやァッ、捕まえたでェッ！
english: How's that, I caught you!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なんなん、哲さん？
足に抱きつくやて、セクハラやで。
english: What's this, Tetsu-san? Hugging my leg, that's sexual harassment.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
早よォ！
早よ撃ってェな、慎平くん！！
english: Hurry! Hurry and shoot, Shinpei-kun!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Right...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （くそっ、でも影のミオが動いて……っ！）
english: (Damn it, but Shadow Mio is moving...!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: もう面倒やな。
english: This is getting annoying.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ぐあっ！
english: Guh!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん！
english: Totsumura-san!

speaker: Mio
japanese: 不快や。はよ離れてくれへん？
english: It's unpleasant. Can you let go already?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ぐあっ、ぐはっ！
english: Guh, gah...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どうして、どうして、
　あんな平然と人を刺せるんだ……）
english: (Why, why can she stab a person so calmly...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （影っていったいなんなんだよ……）
english: (What the hell are the Shadows...)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: し、し、慎平くん……。
english: S-S-Shinpei-kun...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 早よ……早よォ……。
english: Hurry... hurry...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くそぉぉぉぉぉ！！！
english: Daaaaaamn it!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: や、やったんか……！？
english: D-Did I do it...!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
english: ...Ugh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん！！
english: Totsumura-san!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ぐほッ……！
慎平くん……うまく……いったんやな？
english: Guh...! Shinpei-kun... it went... well, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: は、はい……。
english: Y-Yes...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
大丈夫じょ……。
正義の味方は……これくらいで死なへん……。
english: I'm fine... A hero of justice... won't die from something like this...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん……。
english: Totsumura-san…

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
なあ……慎平くん……
オレ、島のみんな……守れたんかなァ……。
english: Say... Shinpei-kun... Did I... manage to protect everyone on the island...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はい、守れたと思います……。
english: Yes, I think you protected them...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
エリカ……ちゃん……。
褒めてくれるやろか。
english: Erika... chan... I wonder if she'll praise me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
絶対に褒めてくれます！
だから……だから……頑張って……。
english: She will definitely praise you! So... so... hang in there...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ……エリカちゃんに……伝えてや。
english: ...Tell... Erika-chan.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
凸村哲は……
最後まで島のために……頑張ったって……。
english: That Tetsu Totsumura... did his best for the island... until the very end...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それは自分で伝えてください！
english: Please tell her that yourself!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: そうしたいけど……無理そうや……。
english: I'd like to, but... it doesn't look like I can...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん！
english: Totsumura-san!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 頼んだで……慎平、く――
english: I'm counting on you... Shinpei, ku――

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん……？　凸村さん！！
english: Totsumura-san...? Totsumura-san!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さぁあああああんッ！！
english: Totsumura-saaaaaaaan!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: そんな大声出しても無駄やで。
english: It's useless to shout so loud.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
見てわからん？
その人、もう死んでもうてるし。
english: Can't you tell by looking? That person is already dead.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お、おまえ……！
english: Y-You...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こいつ……まだ生きてた！？）
english: (She... she's still alive!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （頭は……影の弱点じゃなかったのか！？）
english: (The head... wasn't the Shadow's weakness!?)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
残念やったね、慎ちゃん。
ちゃんとヒントはあったんやけどな。
english: Too bad, Shin-chan. There was a proper hint, though.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ど、どういうことだ……？）
english: (W-What does that mean...?)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
さあ、終わりや。
今度こそちゃんと観念してな？
english: Well, this is the end. Give up for real this time, okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……わかった。
english: ...I understand.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（たとえ殺されたとしても……
　うまくいけば、また時間をさかのぼって
　やり直せるはずだ）
english: (Even if I'm killed... If things go well, I should be able to go back in time and try again.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （だったら――）
english: (In that case――)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今度こそ観念する。
ひと思いにやってくれ。
english: I'll give up this time. Make it quick.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ええ心がけやね。
ほないくで。
english: That's a good attitude. Here I go.

speaker: Mio
japanese: うん……うん……。
english: Yeah… yeah…

speaker: Mio
japanese:
え、殺したらアカンの？
うん、うん……。
english: Eh, I can't kill him? Yeah, yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こいつ……誰と話してるんだ？）
english: (Who is she talking to...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
誰と話してる。
オレのこと殺さへんのか？
english: Who are you talking to? Aren't you going to kill me?

speaker: Mio
japanese: うん、殺したらアカンねんて。
english: Yeah, I've been told I can't kill you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……えっ？

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん、死んでも時間をさかのぼって
生き返るんやて？
english: Shin-chan, even if you die, you go back in time and come back to life?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なんで……こいつがその事を……）
english: (Why... does she know about that...)

speaker: Mio
japanese: だから慎ちゃんへのお仕置きはナシ。
english: So there's no punishment for you, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（何か……何かないか！？
　こいつを殺せる可能性のあるもの……）
english: (Something... isn't there something!? Something that could possibly kill her...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しめた！
　さっきこいつの落とした包丁が……！）
english: (Perfect! The kitchen knife she dropped earlier is...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: う……うおォォォォォォォッ！！
english: U... Uwoooooohhh!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: 気ィすんだ？
english: Are you satisfied?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ……あぁっ……！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あれだけ深く刺した包丁の傷が……
　もう消えてる……！？）
english: (The wound from stabbing her so deeply with the knife... It's already gone...!?)

speaker: Mio
japanese: つかまえた……！
english: Caught you...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐあッ……！？

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: や、やめろ！　離せッ……！
english: S-Stop! Let go...!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
もぉ～、そないバタバタしやんとってや。
いくら抵抗しても無駄なんやって。
english: Jeez, don't struggle so much. No matter how much you resist, it's useless.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレを……どうするつもりだ。
english: What are you going to do with me?

speaker: Mio
japanese: オカアサンのところへ連れてく。
english: I'm taking you to Mother's.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オカアサン……？）
english: (Mother...?)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃんにはオカアサンのところで、
ずっと生きててもらわなアカンねんて。
english: You have to stay alive forever at Mother's place, Shin-chan.

speaker: Mio
japanese: ほな行こか、慎ちゃん。
english: Alright, let's go, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なあ、ひとつだけ教えてくれ。
english: Hey, tell me just one thing.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 何？
english: What?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえら……どうすれば殺せるんだ？
english: How... do we kill you guys?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 私らを殺す方法？
english: How to kill us?

speaker: Mio
japanese: そんなん決まってるやん。
english: That's obvious, isn't it?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃんにも秘密。
english: It's a secret, even from you, Shin-chan.

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_ROOTCLEAR_TET>ｒｏｕｔｅ：凸村哲</color>】を入手しました。
english: Key TIPS [<color=#GF_KEY_ROOTCLEAR_TET>route: Tetsu Totsumura</color>] obtained.

japanese: 7月22日
english: July 22nd

japanese: 1.窓に電話
english: 1. Call Sou

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （まずは窓に連絡しよう）
english: (First, I should contact Sou.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これまでに起きたことを把握してもらうため
　潮の記憶を見てもらわんと……！）
english: (In order for him to grasp what has happened so far, I need him to see Ushio's memories...!)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おう、慎平！　どないした？
あとで電話する言うてたのに気ィ早いな。
english: Hey, Shinpei! What's up? You said you'd call later, you're pretty early.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あぁ、悪い。
english: Ah, sorry.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
いや、かまわんよ。
オレも早よ話したかったんやさけ。
english: Nah, it's fine. I wanted to talk early too.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あんな、慎平。
実は……潮のことなんやけど……。
english: Hey, Shinpei. Actually... about Ushio...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 吉川線やな。
english: The Yoshikawa lines, right.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
……なッ！？
何で知ってんねん！？
english: ...Wha!? How do you know!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そのことも含めて……頼みたいことがあんねん。
おまえの力を借してほしいんや。
english: Including that... there's something I want to ask of you. I want to borrow your strength.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これから日都ヶ島小中学校の体育館に来てくれ。
詳しいことはそこで伝えるわ。
english: Come to the Hitogashima Elementary and Junior High School gym now. I'll tell you the details there.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
はァ……！？
何やまったく意味分からんわ。
急に学校ら来いて……。
english: Hah...!? I don't get what you mean at all. Telling me to come to the school so suddenly...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
頼む、窓ッ！
大事な話なんや！
english: Please, Sou! It's important!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……分かった、行っちゃらァ。
english: ...Alright, I'll go.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: い……いいのか？
english: I-Is that okay?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おまえんことやさけ、何か理由あんねやろ。
電話じゃよう言えやんのやろ？
ワケは、学校で聞くわ。
english: Knowing you, there's gotta be a reason. It's something you can't say over the phone, right? I'll hear the reason at the school.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ありがとう……。
english: Thank you...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それと、トキちゃん近くにいてるか？
ちょっと代わってくれ。
english: Also, is Tokiko-chan nearby? Put her on the phone for a sec.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: トキコにか？
english: To Tokiko?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、トキちゃんも学校まで
来てほしいんや。
english: Yeah, I want Tokiko-chan to come to the school too.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そうか、
ちょっと待っとけ。
english: I see, wait a sec.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おーいトキコー！
慎平が話あるらしでー！
english: He~y, Tokiko! Shinpei wants to talk to you!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この時点でトキちゃんは、
　ハイネに協力している）
english: (At this point in time, Tokiko-chan is cooperating with Haine.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でもヒルコ洞での記憶を見せて、
　自分がハイネたちに裏切られることを知れば、
　仲間になってくれるはずだ）
english: (But if I show her the memories from Hiruko Cave, and she realizes she'll be betrayed by Haine and the others, she should become our ally.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハイネの本当の目的は知らないとしても、
　敵の内情について話が聞けるかもしれない）
english: (Even if she doesn't know Haine's true goal, we might be able to hear about the enemy's internal affairs.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……慎ちゃん。
english: ...Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
電話、代わって。
私がトキコと話す。
english:
Give me the phone.
I'll talk to Tokiko.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや、ダメだ。
english: No, can't do that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 何でなん？
english: Why not?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今のトキちゃんはまだ何も知らん。
記憶を共有するまで、
伝える情報は最低限に留めときたいんや。
english: The current Tokiko-chan doesn't know anything yet. Until we share our memories, I want to keep the information we give her to a minimum.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
言いたいこともあるやろうけど、
今は堪えとってくれ。
english: You might have things you want to say, but hold it in for now.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: すまん、トキコおらんみたいや。
english: Sorry, Tokiko's not here.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おっかしのォ？
さっき風呂出たあと部屋におった
思たんやけど。
english: That's weird. I thought she was in her room after getting out of the bath earlier.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それやったら、
トキちゃんにはおまえから
伝えといてくれ。
english: If that's the case, can you pass the message to Tokiko-chan for me?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ、ええで。
あとで言うといちゃるわ。
english:
Yeah, sure.
I'll tell her later.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もし直接言えやんかったら、
学校へ来てほしいてトキちゃんに、
メッセージ入れといてくれ。
english: If you can't tell her directly, leave Tokiko-chan a message telling her to come to the school.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
任しとけ。
ほな、またあとでな！
english:
Leave it to me.
See you later!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……よっしゃ！
窓とトキちゃんゲットやな！
次は誰にする？
english: ...Alright! We got Sou and Tokiko-chan! Who's next?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さんも呼ぼか。
ヒルコ洞で助けてもろたし、
やっぱり警官やからな。
english: Let's call Totsumura-san too. He helped us at Hiruko Cave, and he is a cop, after all.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あん人呼ぶんやったら、
あとで銃スキャンさしてもらおかな。
english: If we're calling him, I'll have to ask him to let me scan his gun later.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さん、今どこなんやろ？
駐在所におるとええけど……。
english: I wonder where Totsumura-san is right now? I hope he's at the police station...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ハイこちら正義の味方ァ！
english: Yes, this is the hero of justice!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
よかった！
凸村さん、おった。
english: Thank goodness! Totsumura-san is there.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
その声、慎平くんか？
どないしたんや？
english: That voice, is that Shinpei-kun? What's wrong?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
実は……このあと学校で、
大変なことが起こるんです！
english: Actually... something terrible is going to happen at the school after this!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
学校で？
何や、大変なことて！？
english: At the school? What do you mean, something terrible!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お願いします！
学校の体育館で待ってますから、
来てもらえませんか！？
english: Please! I'll be waiting in the school gym, so could you come!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オイオイ、具体的に言わんかいな！
何のこっちゃサッパリ分からんわ！
english: Hey, hey, be more specific! I don't understand what's going on at all!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そないイタ電めいた電話で、
警察は動けやんでェ？
english: The police can't just act on a phone call that sounds like a prank, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （まあ、そうなるよな……）
english: (Well, I figured he'd say that...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、こっちだって
　引き下がるわけにはいかないんだ）
english: (But I can't just back down here either.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そこをなんとか！
どうしても凸村さんの協力が必要なんです！
english: Please, somehow! I absolutely need your help, Totsumura-san!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: せやから、ちゃんと説明を――
english: That's why I'm telling you to explain properly――

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ひとつ、具体的に言えることがあります！
english: There's one specific thing I can tell you!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 何や？
english: What?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: Ｇカップの女性も来ます！
english: A woman with G-cups will be there too!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 体育館了解ィ！！
english: Gymnasium, understood!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
よし……！
これで全員揃いそうや。
english: Alright...! With this, it looks like everyone will be here.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
凸村さん、相変わらずやなぁ～。
なぁ澪？
english: Totsumura-san is the same as always~. Right, Mio?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
澪、しっかりしィ。
いつもの元気はどないしたん？
english: Mio, pull yourself together. What happened to your usual energy?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうか……まだ疑似ループの話を
　受け入れられないんだな）
english: (I see... she still can't accept the story about the pseudo-loop.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮の存在、
　トキちゃんが隠しとったこと……）
english: (Ushio's existence, the things Tokiko-chan was hiding...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しかも何度か澪自身も命を落としてるし……。
　すぐに受け入れろって言う方が無理か）
english: (Not to mention Mio herself has lost her life several times... It's probably unreasonable to tell her to accept it right away.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮、澪には少し時間を――
english: Ushio, give Mio a little time――

speaker: Ushio
japanese: よう聞きや、澪。
english: Listen closely, Mio.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
トキちゃんなら大丈夫や。
私の記憶見せたら、
絶対目ェ覚ましてくれるわ。
english: Tokiko-chan will be fine. If I show her my memories, she'll definitely wake up.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: でも……。
english: But…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私は何も気にしてやん！
なんもかんも、
今から全部やり直せばええだけや！
english: I don't care about any of that! Whatever it is, we just have to redo it all from now on!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 分かったか？
english: Got it?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: う、うんっ……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なぁ……お姉ちゃん？
english: Hey... big sister?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: んー？　何や？
english: Hm~? What is it?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉……ちゃんっ……！
お姉ちゃああんッ！！
english: Big... sister...! Big sisterrr!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うわァァァァ～～～ん！！
english: Uwaaaaahhhh!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ええッ！？
いきなりめっちゃ泣くやん！！
english: Eh!? You're suddenly crying so much!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんがっ！
お、お、おるゥゥゥ～～～～！！
english: Big sister is...! S-S-She's hereeeeee!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ううッ、えぐッ……！
ごめんな！
化物やなんて言うて……！
english: Uugh, *hic*...! I'm sorry! For calling you a monster...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんは、ひっく、
お姉ちゃんやッ……。
english: Big sister is, *hic*, big sister...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 本物の私のお姉ちゃんやッ！！
english: You're my real big sister!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……もう、泣きすぎやんか。
english: ...Jeez, you're crying too much.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ぐすっ……っく、ひっぐ、っく……。
ぐすっ……、私も戦う！
english: *Sniff*... *hic*, *hic*, *hic*... *Sniff*... I'll fight too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
えっ、戦うて……おまえを連れてくのは、
あくまでも安全のためで――
english: Eh, fight... I'm only bringing you along strictly for your safety――

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 守られてばっかりは嫌や！！
english: I don't want to just be protected all the time!!

speaker: Ushio
english: Mio…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、ええやろ？
english: Shinpei, it's okay, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪は影と戦ったこともないし、
　使える武器だって限られる……）
english: (Mio has never fought a Shadow before, and the weapons she can use are limited...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……なんて言っても、聞かないだろうな）
english: (...Even if I say that, she probably won't listen.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
じゃあ、準備するか。
すぐに出なきゃな。
english: Well then, should we get ready? We have to leave soon.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うんっ！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
よぉし！
みんなでやっちゃ……ろ……？
english: Alright! Let's all do... this...?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ああああッ！！
english: Aaaaah!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なッ、何や！？
english: W-What!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
な、なにッ、なんなん！？
何かおったん！？
english: W-What, what is it!? Was there something!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
カレー！！
今日は食べれやんの！？
english: Curry!! I can't eat it today!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんや、カレーか……。
脅かすなって。
english: What, it's just curry... Don't scare me like that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
煮込んでる時間ないから、
代わりにカレーサンド作っちゃる。
english: We don't have time to simmer it, so I'll make curry sandwiches instead.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: <color=#GF_TIPS_085>カレーサンド</color>……。
english: <color=#GF_TIPS_085>Curry sandwich</color>…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: アリやな！！！！
english: I'm down for that!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
集まってくれるみんなと、
アランの分も作っとかなアカンな。
english: I should make some for everyone gathering, and for Alain too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ、そや！
お父さん心配してしまうから、
メモ残しとかな。
english: Oh, right! Dad will be worried, so I should leave a note.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
カレエッ！
カレッ、カレッ！
english:
Curry!
Curry, curry!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
出た……！
お姉ちゃんの『カレーの律動』！
english: There it is...! Big sister's 'Curry Rhythm'!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
カレッ、カレッ！
カレ～～～～～ッ！
english:
Curry, curry!
Curry~!!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
サンドッ♪
サンドッ♪
english: Sando♪ Sando♪

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえら姉妹そろって……。
english: You sisters really are...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんか全然、これから命を懸けて
　戦うって雰囲気じゃないな）
english: (It doesn't feel like we're about to put our lives on the line and fight at all.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （でも、こんな時だからこそ……）
english: (But maybe because it's a time like this...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ウマい物でも食べて、
　英気を養うってのも大事か）
english: (It's important to eat something good and build up our strength.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よしッ！
　気合い入れてウマいカレーサンド
　作ってやるか！）
english: (Alright! I'm gonna put my all into making some delicious curry sandwiches!)

japanese: 7周目
english: 7th Loop

japanese: 2.全員集合？
english: 2. Everyone Gathered?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さん、来てくれたんですね。
ありがとうございます。
english:
Totsumura-san, you came.
Thank you.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
でも遅刻やね。
何やっとったん？
english:
But you're late.
What were you doing?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
いやァ～、ちょっと髪のセットに
時間かかってしも……て……
english: Well~, it just took a little time to style my hair...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
エェェェッ？
う……うし……うしおちゃ……！
english: Eeehhh!? U... Ushi... Ushio-cha...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: わァややぁあああァアアア！！
english: Waaayaaahhhhhh!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そのリアクション、
さっき窓がやったわ。
english: Sou already did that reaction earlier.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
出たァァァァァッ！！
オバケェェェェェッ！！
english: It appearedddddd!! A ghosttttttt!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
騒々しい男だな……。
こいつと共に戦えと言うのか。
english: What a noisy man... Are you telling me to fight alongside this guy?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ジジジッ、Ｇカップゥゥゥッ！！？？
english: G-G-G-G-cupsss!!??

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: それ……驚くところですか？
english: Is that... what you're surprised about?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: こここッ、小弓場かおりィィィッ！！？？
english: K-K-K-Koyuba Kaoriiiii!!??

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ど、どーいうこっちゃ！
慎平くん、
こらァ一体なんの集まりやねん！？
english: W-What is the meaning of this! Shinpei-kun, what in the world is this gathering!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
時間の無駄だ。
潮、この男に早くあれを。
english: This is a waste of time. Ushio, show this man that quickly.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
せやな。
凸村さん、こっち来て。
english:
Right.
Totsumura-san, come here.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: お、おお……。
english: O-Oh...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ほら、手ェ出して。
english: Here, hold out your hand.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
これが、今までに起きたこと。
そして……。
english: This is what has happened so far. And...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: これから起きるかもしれへんことや。
english: What might happen from now on.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: はい、これで終いや。
english: Alright, that's it.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
凸村さーん？
あら……固まってもた。
english: Totsumura-sa~n? Oh... he froze.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そのままでいいだろう。
静かでいい。
english: It's fine to leave him like that. It's nice and quiet.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
慎平、もう一人はどないした？
誘った言うとったやしょ。
english: Shinpei, what about the other person? You said you invited them, right.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それが、まだ……。
窓、トキちゃんから返事は？
english: About that, not yet... Sou, any reply from Tokiko-chan?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: いや……まだきてやん。
english: No... not yet.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: メッセージは入れてくれたんよな？
english: You did send her a message, right?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
家出る前に入れたし既読も付いた。
でも返事はあらへん。
何回か電話もしたけど出やんのや。
english: I sent it before leaving the house and it was read. But there's no reply. I called a few times too, but she didn't answer.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私も電話したんやけど、
出やんかった……。
english: I called too, but she didn't answer...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: どこにいてるんやろ、トキちゃん。
english: I wonder where Tokiko-chan is.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
何しちゃあるんや、あいつ！
トキコにこそ、潮の記憶を見せな
アカンのに……！
english: What is she doing! Tokiko is the one who really needs to see Ushio's memories...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
……えッ、ズルッ！！
朱鷺子ちゃんバックレてもたん！？
english: ...Eh, no fair!! Tokiko-chan bailed!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ちょっと凸村さん、
変な言い方しやんといてェな！
english: Hey Totsumura-san, don't put it like that!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
だ、だって……！
あんな化物と戦うとかムリじょ！！
オレも帰らしてもらうで！
english: B-But...! Fighting monsters like that is impossible!! I'm going home too!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: そうしてもらって構わないが――
english: I don't mind if you do, but――

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ホラッ、この人も、
こない言うてくれてるさけよォ……。
english: See, this person is telling me I can go too...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
だが警官、ここを出たとしても
おまえは確実に死ぬぞ。
english: But officer, even if you leave here, you will definitely die.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: もはや逃げ場など、どこにもない。
english: There's nowhere left to run.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
島内の人間は祭りの夜にすべて死ぬ。
それに島を脱出しようとしても無駄だ。
フェリーの関係者にも影はいる。
english: Everyone on the island will die on the night of the festival. And trying to escape the island is useless. There are Shadows among the ferry staff too.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: マ、マジかよ……。
english: A-Are you serious...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
どうせ死ぬのなら
弾丸一発でも相手にブチ込むくらいの
気概を見せてみるんだな。
english: If you're going to die anyway, at least show the spirit to fire a single bullet into the enemy.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: す、救いのないこと言わんといてやァ……。
english: D-Don't say such hopeless things...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
さて、網代慎平。
まだ彼女を待つつもりかね？
english: Now then, Shinpei Ajiro. Do you still intend to wait for her?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
もう待てやんぞ。
この人数で作戦立てるしかないやろ。
english: We can't wait any longer. We have to make a plan with the people we have.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そんなッ！？
english: No way!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ほ、ほなトキコはどうなるん？
english: T-Then what happens to Tokiko?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（根津さんの言うとおりだ。
　これ以上待っていたら
　初動で遅れを取ってしまう）
english: (Nezu-san is right. If we wait any longer, we'll fall behind on our initial move.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この腕の刻印を通じて、
　ハイネに情報を探られているはずだし……）
english: (Haine must be probing for information through this mark on my arm too...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓、澪……。
戦闘中にトキちゃんが来てしもたら危険や。
もう来なくていいと伝えよう。
english: Sou, Mio... It'll be dangerous if Tokiko-chan shows up during the battle. Let's tell her she doesn't need to come anymore.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
も、もうちょっと！
もうちょっとだけ待てやんかッ！？
english: J-Just a little longer! Can't we wait just a little bit longer!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トキちゃんが無事なら、
潮の記憶はいつでも見せられる。
english: If Tokiko-chan is safe, we can show her Ushio's memories anytime.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そやけど……。
english: That's true, but...

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: ...Ugh.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あと３分や。
それまでに現れやんなら諦めェ。
english: Three more minutes. If she doesn't show up by then, give up.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: はい……。
english: Okay...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 結局……来やんかったな。
english: In the end... she didn't come, huh.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ああ、しかたあらへん。
english: Yeah, it can't be helped.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
各自、さっき話した作戦と武器を
再確認してくれ。
english: Everyone, please double-check the plan and weapons we discussed earlier.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん……。
english: Shin-chan…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……大丈夫だ、澪。
english: …It's okay, Mio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪もトキちゃんが来てくれたら
　心強かったんだろうけど……）
english: (Mio probably would have felt more reassured if Tokiko-chan had come too, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （間に合わなかったか……）
english: (She didn't make it in time...)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 儂は定位置に移動するさけの。
english: I'll be moving to my designated position.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
