chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……警戒されてしまったか？）
english: (…Is she on her guard?)

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（このまま体育館に呼んでも、
　みすみすハイネにオレらの情報が
　流れてまうだけになるかも）
english: (Even if I call her to the gym like this, it might just end up leaking our information to Haine.)

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、今はトキちゃんの
　安全が最優先だ！）
english: (No, right now, Tokiko's safety is the priority!)

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トキちゃん、詳しいことは今なんも話せやん。
でもオレたちはトキちゃんを守りたいんや。
english:
Tokiko, I can't explain everything now.
  But we want to protect you.

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓からも連絡あった思うけど、
すぐ学校の体育館まで来てほしい。
english: I think Sou might have contacted you too, but I want you to come to the school gym right away.

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そこで……全部話すから。
english: I'll explain everything… when you get there.

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
今からですか？
それはちょっと難しいかも
しれません。
english:
Right now?
  That might be difficult.

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、代わって！！
english: Shin-chan, let me talk!!

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
えっ？
おい、澪……！！
english:
Huh?
  Hey, Mio…!!

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
トキコ、聞いてッ！
あんた騙されちゃあるんや！
english:
Tokiko, listen!
  You're being deceived!

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
english: M-Mio…!

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お願いやから目ェ覚まして！
english: I'm begging you, open your eyes!

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もうあんなこと絶対させへんッ！
慎ちゃんとお姉ちゃんが助ける！
私も行くから！！
english: I absolutely won't let that happen again! Shin-chan and Sis will save you! I'm coming too!!

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
そこにおる人らが……
菱形医院のこと何か言うたん？
english: Did the people there… say something about the Hishigata Clinic?

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
最悪や……。
澪には知られたなかったのに。
english:
This is the worst…
  I didn't want Mio to find out.

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
何ボソボソ言うてるん！？
ねえ、聞こえてる！？
english:
What are you muttering about!?
  Hey, are you listening!?

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata (Shadow Tokiko)
japanese:
ごめん、澪。
でも……心配せんでええから。
english: I'm sorry, Mio. But… you don't need to worry.

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あっ……トキコ？
トキコッって！
english: Ah… Tokiko? Tokiko!

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 切られてしもた……。
english: She hung up…

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Mio Kofune

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: アカン、出てくれやん。
english: No good, she's not picking up.

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、
さっきのトキコ本物やんな！？
まだ間に合うよね！？
english: Shin-chan, The Tokiko just now was the real one, right!? We're still not too late, right!?

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 人間か影かは……電話じゃ判断できやん。
english:
Whether she's a human or a Shadow…
  I can't tell over the phone.

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
人間と影、両方のトキちゃんが
別々に存在してる可能性もある。
english: There's also the possibility that both the human and Shadow Tokiko exist separately.

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私と同じ状態……。
english: Same situation as me…

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Ushio
japanese: 澪、慎平、早よ体育館に行かな！
english: Mio, Shinpei, we need to hurry to the gym!

chapter: 4. The Truth Behind the Cold Voice
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ。
南雲先生たちにも伝えて、
対策を考えないと……！
english: Yeah. I'll tell Nagumo-sensei and the others too, and we need to think of a countermeasure…!

japanese: 5.いくつかの希望
english: 5. Some Hopes

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ……マ、マジなんか？
english: …A-Are you serious?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そういうわけなんよ。
びっくりしたかもしれやんけど、
ちゃんと気持ちの整理しといてな！
english: That's how it is. You might be surprised, but make sure you process all of this!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……『彼女』は、まだ現れないな。
english: …'She' hasn't appeared yet.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 用心されとったら面倒やいしょ。
english: It'll be a pain if they're on their guard.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
より早い時間に
網代慎平の命を狙いに来ることも想定したが……。
そこまで単純ではなかったか。
english: We had considered the possibility of them coming to take Shinpei Ajiro's life even earlier… But I suppose it wasn't that simple.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
とはいえ、必ず影は攻めて来る。
前回のアレは、ハイネが送り込んだ刺客と見て
間違いないからな。
english: Still, the Shadows will definitely attack. There's no doubt that the one from before was an assassin sent by Haine.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
慎平のループに限界が近いからて、
不意打ちで命を削るとは小賢しよォ。
english: Knowing Shinpei's loops are nearing their limit, and striking unexpectedly to wear down his life… how shrewd.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
網代慎平、こういう状況だ。
早くその少年にも、潮の記憶を見せたまえ。
english: Shinpei Ajiro, this is the situation. Hurry and show the boy Ushio's memories.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうですね……。
english: Right…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: やっぱり……見せなあかんよね……。
english: I guess… we have to show him…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
な、なんや二人とも、深刻そうな顔しよって。
そないヤバイ内容なんか……？
english:
W-what, why are both of you looking so serious?
Is it something really bad?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓、腹はくくっといてくれ。
english: Sou, brace yourself.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……ああ、わかった。
english: …Ah, I get it.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 潮、やってくれ！
english: Ushio, do it!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ほな、手ェ出して。
……いくで。
english: Then, hold out your hand. …Here we go.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: これで全部や。
english: That's everything.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そんなアホな……。
ト、トキコが？
english: That's impossible… T-Tokiko did that?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
今見せられたんは、
ほんまのことなんかッ！？
english: Was what you just showed me… the truth!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
最後のアレは何やッ！？
オレの妹はあんなことするヤツや
あらへんぞッ！！
english: What was that at the end!? My sister isn't the kind of person who would do something like that!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
それに……あいつがもう影に
なってしもてるて……！
english: And… to think she's already become a Shadow…!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ウソやろッ！？
何かの間違いちゃうんかッ！？
english: You're lying, right!? Isn't this some kind of mistake!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
落ち着け、窓。
あくまでそれは前回のループや。
english: Calm down, Sou. That was strictly in the previous loop.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレが死んだことで１時間以上戻ったから、
その出来事はまだ起きてやん。
english:
Because I died, I went back over an hour.
That event hasn't happened yet.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ここに来る前トキちゃんに電話しといた。
それで、なにか変わったかもしれやん。
english: I called Tokiko before coming here. So, something might have changed.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
トキコは？
本物のトキコは無事なんよな！？
english: What about Tokiko? The real Tokiko is safe, right!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それは……。
english: Well…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
慎平ェェッ！！！
無事や言うてくれェ！！！
english: Shinpei!!! Tell me she's safe!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Sou…

japanese: 「ああ、きっと無事や」
english: "Ah, she's definitely okay."

japanese: 「それはまだ分からん」
english: "That's still unknown."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、きっと無事や。
心配いらん。
english:
Ah, she's definitely okay.
No need to worry.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そうやで！
トキちゃんなら大丈夫や！
english:
That's right!
Tokiko will be fine!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そうやろ……そうやんなッ！
english: Right… I knew it!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
では何故、菱形朱鷺子は
まだ現れないのだろうな？
english: Then why hasn't Hishigata Tokiko appeared yet?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それは……！
english: That's…!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
それ、どういう意味です？
トキコはもう手遅れや言うんですか！？
english: What does that mean? Are you saying it's already too late for Tokiko!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: そんなことはひと言も言っていない。
english: I never said anything like that.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私は単に客観的事実から得た疑問を
呈したまでだが？
english: I'm just raising a question based on objective facts.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: くッ……！
english: Ugh…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それはまだ分からん。
オレかて無事や思いたいけど……。
english: That's still unknown. I want to believe she's safe too, but…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: クソがァッ！！
english: Damn it!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
窓くん、大丈夫や！！
電話の声、いつものトキコやったもん！
english: Sou-kun, it's okay!! The voice on the phone was the usual Tokiko!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いくら声がそっくりでも、
それが影なら当然のことだ。
english:
Even if the voice is identical,
if it's a Shadow, that's natural.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そんなことは何の気休めにもならないと
知っているはず。
english: You should know that provides no comfort at all.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そんな……。
english: That's…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
覚えておくことだ、
過剰な期待は失望を加速させると。
english:
Remember this:
Excessive hope only accelerates disappointment.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: な、何が言いたいんですかッ！
english: W-what are you trying to say?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
前回ここに現れた菱形朱鷺子は影だった。
今回もその可能性がある。
english: The Tokiko Hishigata who appeared here last time was a Shadow. There's a possibility this one is too.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
もし影が現れるのなら、
我々の手で倒さねばならない。
english:
If a Shadow appears,
we'll have to eliminate it ourselves.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ト、トキコを殺す言うんか！？
そんなこと……！
english: Y-You're telling us to kill Tokiko!? We can't do that…!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 何とかできやんのですか！？
english: Isn't there something we can do!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
影になった自分を見たやろ。
影は本物と違う。
下手な温情は死に繋がるで。
english: You saw your own Shadow, didn't you? Shadows aren't the same as the real thing. Misplaced compassion will only lead to death.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……くっ。
english: …Ugh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 待ってください！
english: Wait!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そのことなんですけど……
影を殺さなくても何とかできるかも
しれません！
english: About that… we might be able to do something without killing the Shadow!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ほう……。
どないするつもりや？
english: Oh…? What are you planning to do?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私、影のシオリを消せるかもって、
前に言いましたよね。
english: I said before that I might be able to erase the Shadow Shiori, right?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ、ハイネに頭を弄られそうになった時、
その経路を逆に辿ってやったとか言ってたな。
english: Ah, you said something about tracing back the path Haine used when she tried to mess with your head.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
それと同じようなやり方で、
トキちゃんを助けられるかもしれません！
english: Using a similar method, maybe we can save Tokiko!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……ふむ、根拠は？
english: …Hmm, what's the basis?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハイネはテレパシーを使って、
『子供たち』に簡単な命令を聞かせて
いるようです。
english: It seems Haine is using telepathy to make the 'children' listen to simple commands.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ですが、潮はそれを受信しません。
english: But Ushio isn't receiving them.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
せやから、影のトキちゃんやミオも
私と同じように頭を調整して、
ハイネの命令が聞こえやんようにするんよ！
english: So, I'll adjust the heads of the Shadow Tokiko and Mio just like mine, so they won't be able to hear Haine's commands!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
影をハッキングして、
データを書き換えるということか。
english:
So you're saying you'll hack the Shadow
and rewrite the data?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そう！
うまくいけばミオもトキちゃんも、
仲間にできるかもしれやん！
english: Exactly! If it works, we might be able to make Mio and Tokiko our allies!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それが実現すれば影についての情報を
深く聞き出せるし、菱形医院と影の繋がりも
詳しいことがわかるはずです。
english: If that works, we can get more information about the Shadows, and we should be able to find out more details about the connection between Hishigata Clinic and the Shadows.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……いいだろう。
不確実ではあるが成功時のメリットは、
それを補って余りある。
english: …Alright. It's uncertain, but the benefits of success more than make up for it.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: せやろッ？
english: Right!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ならば彼女らの相手はキミたちに任せよう。
ただし、失敗は許されないぞ。
english: Then I'll leave dealing with them to you. But failure isn't an option.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はい、もちろんです！
english: Yes, of course!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
慎平！　影のトキコが来たら、
オレに相手させてくれッ！
english: Shinpei! If the Shadow's Tokiko comes, let me fight her!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: おまえにゃ無理やいしょ。
english: You can't handle it.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: なんでですかッ！？
english: Why not?!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
影を捕まえるんは下手に倒すより難しい。
どっちかが傷付くこともあるやろ。
english:
Capturing a Shadow is harder than defeating it.
One of you might get hurt.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
おまえは……妹相手に、
その覚悟はあるんか？
english:
You… do you have the resolve
to fight your own sister?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
できます！
いや、絶対にやってやります！
english:
I can do it!
No, I'll definitely do it!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
たとえ妹でも、
いや……妹を助けたいからこそ、
全力でやります！
english:
Even if it's my sister,
no, because I want to save her,
I'll do my best!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
そうか。
まあ頑張るんやな。
english:
I see.
Well, do your best.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ほんまに大丈夫か？
あんま無理せんでも……。
english:
Are you really okay?
Don't push yourself too hard…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
無理なんかしてやん。
兄貴のオレがやるべきことなんや！
english: I'm not pushing myself. It's my duty as her older brother!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
わかった……。
ほな頼むで、窓。
english:
I see…
Then I'm counting on you, Sou.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ああッ！！
english: Yeah!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
待ってや！
私にも手伝わせて！
english: Wait! Let me help too!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 澪ちゃん……！？
english: Mio-chan...?!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
トキコは親友のはずやのに……
今まで何も知らんかった。
ほんま最低や。
english: Tokiko's my best friend... but I didn't know anything about this. I'm really the worst.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: だから私もトキコを助けたい！
english: So I want to save Tokiko too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Mio…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 困ったものだな。
english: This is troublesome.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
こないなったら止めても無駄やろ。
やらせてみりゃええやいしょ。
english:
If they're set on going, it's pointless to stop them.
Let them try.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
任しといてくださいッ！
やるで、澪ちゃん！
english: Leave it to me! Let's do this, Mio-chan!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん、頑張ろなッ！
english: Yeah, let's do our best!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
よっしゃ！
気合い入ってきたでェッ！
english:
Alright!
I'm fired up now!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……って感じなんやけど、
凸村さんは、どないする？
english: ...That's how it is, but... Totsumura-san, what are you going to do?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: こないなったら……。
english: Since it's come to this...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
こないなったら、
もうやるしかないやんけッ！
english: Since it's come to this, there's nothing left to do but fight!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
チクショーッ！！
やったらァァァァァッ！！
english:
Damn it!!
I'll do it!!

japanese: 6.窓の叫び
english: 6. Sou's Cry

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そろそろ、
前回のループでトキちゃんが来た時刻になります。
english: It's about time... The time when Toki-chan came last loop.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 気を引き締めていきましょう。
english: Let's stay focused.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 竜之介さんも無茶せんといてな。
english: Don't be reckless, Ryunosuke-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレに影の気配は察知できない……）
english: (I can't sense the presence of Shadows...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも肌が粟立つような嫌な感じが、
　どんどん強まってる気がする……）
english: (But this awful feeling that makes my skin crawl feels like it's getting stronger and stronger...)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 慎平、ヤツらが来たぞ。
english: Shinpei, they're here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (They're here…)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
そっちに向かっとるぞ。
島民の影ようけ連れてきちゃあらァ。
english: They're heading your way. They've brought a bunch of islanders' Shadows with them.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
敵は大勢！
こっちに来ます！
english:
There are a lot of enemies!
They're coming this way!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 望むところです。
english: That's exactly what we want.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私も準備バッチリや！
思いっきし暴れたる！
english: I'm all set too! I'm gonna go all out!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 来たな……！
english: They're here…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハイネッ！　シデッ！
english: Haine! Shide!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
やあ慎平くん、お待たせしました。
みんなを集めてたら遅なってしもて。
english: Hello, Shinpei-kun. Sorry to keep you waiting. I was gathering everyone, so I ended up being late.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
うふふっ。
そっちの仲間ちょっと足りやんのと違うか？
english: Hehe. Aren't you a little short on members over there?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえら、トキちゃんを――
english: You guys, what did you do to Toki-chan—

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平ッ！！
シデの後ろから一人来るッ！
english: Shinpei!! One of them is coming from behind Shide!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: トキちゃんッ！？
english: Toki-chan?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: させんッ！
english: I won't let you!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（傷が治っていく……！
　やはりあのトキちゃんは……）
english: (The wound is healing...! So that Toki-chan really is...)

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ご挨拶ですね。
慎平さんたちには、こちらから挨拶しようと
思ってたのに。
english: What a greeting. I was planning on greeting Shinpei-san and the others myself.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: トキちゃん……！
english: Toki-chan...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （くっ、あの電話は手遅れだったのか！？）
english: (Damn, that call was too late!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 潮さん、右ッ！
english: Ushio-san, to your right!

speaker: Shadow A
japanese: ァアアァ゛ェエ！！
english: Aaaah!

speaker: Shadow B
japanese: グゥア゛ア゛ア゛！！
english: Gwaah!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: げっ、こっちにもおる！
english: Geez, there's more here too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しまった！
　トキちゃんに気を取られた隙に……！）
english: (Damn it! While I was distracted by Toki-chan...!)

speaker: Shadow A
japanese: ギャッ！！
english: Gah!

speaker: Shadow B
japanese: グェッ！？
english: Gueh?!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 根津さん、ナイス！
english: Nezu-san, nice job!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
あの猟師が隠れとるんか。
むぅ、せっかく連れてきたみんなが……。
english: That hunter is hiding, huh. Ugh, and after I went through the trouble of bringing everyone...

speaker: Shide
japanese: 惚れ惚れするような腕ですねえ。
english: What a fascinating display of skill.

speaker: Shide
japanese: おや？
english: Oh?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
も～、危ないやないですか。
もう少しでハイネがケガしてましたよ？
english: Jeez, that was dangerous, wasn't it? Haine almost got hurt, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（マンホールの盾で銃弾を防いだ……！
　やはりシデには隙がない）
english: (He blocked the bullet with a manhole cover as a shield...! Shide really has no openings.)

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: 逆方向から！？
english: From the opposite direction?!

speaker: Shide
japanese: おおっと！
english: Whoops!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
アカン！
防がれてしもたッ！！
english: No good! He blocked it!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: あんな所にも一人いてたんですか。
english: So there was someone hiding over there too.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: よそ見してていいのかい？
english: Is it okay to be looking away?

speaker: Shide
japanese: ……あちこちからうっとおしいですね。
english: ...You're annoying, coming from all directions.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平、作戦開始や！
早よ私につかまりッ！
english: Shinpei, the operation is a go! Hurry and hold on to me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
わかった！
潮、飛ばしてくれ！
english: Got it! Ushio, let's fly!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: よーいドンッ！！
english: Ready, set, go!!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: あの二人、逃げる気か！？
english: Are those two trying to run away!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 突っ走るでェッ！！
english: We're making a run for it!!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
ミオ、トキコ。
あいつらを追い詰めたれ。
english: Mio, Tokiko. Hunt them down.

speaker: Mio
japanese: お姉ちゃん、待ちやァァッ！！
english: Onee-chan, wait!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 逃がさないッ！
english: I won't let you escape!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、何人付いてきちゃあるッ？
english: Shinpei, how many are following us!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ミオとトキちゃん、二人や！
english: Mio and Toki-chan, two of them!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
上出来やな！
ほな、あの場所へ向かうで！
english: Perfect! Then let's head to that place!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、体育館に着いたでッ！
english: Shinpei, we've arrived at the gym!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓、澪！！
影がオレたちを追ってきてる！
english: Sou, Mio!! The Shadows are chasing us!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ミオとトキコの二人やッ！
english: It's Mio and Tokiko!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 予定通り、か。
english: Just as planned, huh.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: おるんやね、トキコの影……！
english: So she is here, Tokiko's Shadow...!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
さあ、来んかい！
死ぬ気で捕まえちゃらァ！！
english: Come on then! I'll catch you even if it kills me!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓ッ、ムチャすんなやッ！
english: Sou, don't do anything reckless!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
分かってる！
そっちは影のミオちゃん頼んだで！
english: I know! I'm counting on you to handle Shadow Mio-chan!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
待てェェェッ！！
お姉ちゃァァァんッ！！
english: Wait!! Onee-chaaaan!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
危なッ……！
包丁振り回したらアカンやろッ！
english: Dangerous...! You shouldn't be swinging a kitchen knife around!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なんなんッ！
鬱陶しい髪の毛やなッ！
english: What the heck! This hair is so annoying!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮の髪の毛攻撃で、
　ミオが包丁を落とした……！）
english: (With Ushio's hair attack, Mio dropped the knife...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今だッ！！
english: Now!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （くそッ、外した！）
english: (Damn it, I missed!)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
それ、釘打ち込むヤツとちゃう？
ほんま容赦ないわ。
english: Isn't that a nail gun? You're really ruthless.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん、そこまでして
私のこと邪魔したいん？
english: Shin-chan, do you want to get in my way that badly?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 背中が隙だらけですよ、慎平さん。
english: Your back is wide open, Shinpei-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それはどうかな？
english: I wonder about that.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
トキコッ！
おまえの相手はオレや！
english: Tokiko! Your opponent is me!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: お兄ちゃん……。
english: Older brother...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 邪魔や、私は慎平さんを――
english: You're in the way. I need to get to Shinpei-san—

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 行かせやんッ！！
english: I won't let you go!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: うゥッ！？
english: Ugh!?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
澪！？
あんた、何持ってるん！
english: Mio!? What are you holding!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ライターとスプレー！
窓くん直伝の火炎放射器や！
english: A lighter and hairspray! It's a flamethrower passed down directly from Sou-kun!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
だいたい、なんで澪まで出てくるん！？
引っ込んどけばええのに！
english: Why is Mio even here anyway!? You should have just stayed back!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
トキコを捕まえるためやッ！
絶対逃がさんからな！
english: To catch you, Tokiko! I definitely won't let you get away!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
澪ちゃん！
あまり近付いたらアカンで！
english: Mio-chan! Don't get too close!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん、わかってる！
english: Yeah, I know!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
……どいて澪。
私、ウシオさんと慎平さんに
用があるんよ。
english: ...Move aside, Mio. I have business with Ushio-san and Shinpei-san.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
オレらはおまえに
用があるんや！
english: We have business with you!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ウソやろッ！
全部避けよった！？
english: You're kidding me! You dodged all of that!?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 澪まで戦わせるやなんて……
english: Making Mio fight...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: お兄ちゃんも慎平さんも、最低や！
english: Both you and Shinpei-san are the worst!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なんて言われようが、
オレらの決意は揺るぎやん！
english: No matter what you say, our resolve won't waver!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おまえを捕まえて、
本物のトキコの居場所を吐かしちゃる！
english: I'll catch you and make you spit out where the real Tokiko is!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
お兄ちゃんは呑気やなァ。
いつもいつも……。
english: My older brother is so carefree. Always, always...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
いつもいつもいつもいつもッ！
さっさとそこどかんと、
本気ですり潰してまうでッ！
english: Always, always, always, always! Get out of the way right now, or I'll seriously crush you!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……な、なんか投げた！？
english: ...D-Did she throw something!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
澪ちゃん、下がれ！
何か出てくるッ！
english: Mio-chan, step back! Something's coming out!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: おいで、ローゼンクランツ！
english: Come forth, Rosencrantz!

speaker: Rosencrantz
japanese: アゥアァァァ！！
english: Awaaaa!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: さあ、ギルデンスターンも！
english: Now, Guildenstern too!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: アアア゛ア゛アアアア！！
english: Aaaaaah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あいつら、
　ヒルコ洞で<color=#GF_TIPS_039>潮を捕まえた影</color>！）
english: (Those are the <color=#GF_TIPS_039>Shadows that captured Ushio</color> in the Hiruko Cave!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まずい！
　二人を助けないと！）
english: (This is bad! I have to save them!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん、どこ見てるん！
english: Shin-chan, where are you looking!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うッ！
english: Ugh!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平！！
english: Shinpei!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
私の相手したいんやなかったん？
優柔不断はあかんでェッ！！
english: Weren't you the one who wanted to fight me? You shouldn't be so indecisive!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くっ……！
english: Ugh...!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
慎平、潮！
トキコはオレに任しとけ！
english: Shinpei, Ushio! Leave Tokiko to me!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おまえら二人は、
ミオを捕まえるんやァッ！！
english: You two, catch Mio!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: そんなこと言うてもて大丈夫なん？
english: Are you sure it's okay to say that?

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: ヴォゥウゥォォ……！！
english: Vouuuu…!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
舐めんな！
野良影らオレ一人でも倒せるわッ！
english:
Don't underestimate me!
I can take down those Stray Shadows alone!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: オオォヤアァアァァァ！！
english: OooohyaAAAAA!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
うォォォッ！？
なんや、こいつッ！
english: Uwaaah!? What is this guy!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 窓くんッ！
english: Sou-kun!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
澪ちゃん、オレの後ろに隠れとき！
あんなんまともに受けたら――
english: Mio-chan, hide behind me! If you take a hit like that head-on—

speaker: Rosencrantz
japanese: ゥア゛！！
english: Ugh!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
チィッ！
どえらい力やでッ！
english: Tch! What incredible strength!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
でも力は強ォても、
動きはちょっと鈍そやな！
english: But even if you're strong, your movements are a bit slow!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
手加減させてるだけや。
そんなことも分からんて……。
english: I'm just making them hold back. To think you don't even understand that...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: お兄ちゃんはほんまマヌケやね。
english: You really are an idiot, older brother.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
慎平さんたちに菱形医院のこと
調べさせたんも、お兄ちゃんか？
english: Were you the one who had Shinpei-san and the others investigate the Hishigata Clinic, older brother?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: だったら……どうなんや。
english: What if I did...?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ほんまアホやで。
お兄ちゃんも助かるはずやったのに。
そう約束させてたのに……。
english: You're really an idiot. You were supposed to be saved too, older brother. I made them promise...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: トキコ……？
english: Tokiko…?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
お兄ちゃんのことはもう知らん。
澪は……澪だけは、私が守る！
english: I don't care about you anymore, older brother. Mio... I will protect Mio, no matter what!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ、何の話……？
english: Huh, what are you talking about…?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
騙されんな澪ちゃんッ！
オレらを混乱させちゃろうとして
言うてるだけや……！
english: Don't be fooled, Mio-chan! She's just saying that to try and confuse us...!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
コイツら影は、
みんなテレパシーで操られてるんや！
english: These Shadows are all being controlled by telepathy!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: ……テレパシー？
english: …Telepathy?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
お兄ちゃん、なんか勘違いしてやん？
私は私のしてることに納得してる。
影になったんも、私自身の意思や。
english: Older brother, aren't you misunderstanding something? I'm satisfied with what I'm doing. Becoming a Shadow was my own choice too.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なッ、何言うてんねん！？
そんなワケあってたまるかいッ！！
english: Wh-What are you saying!? There's no way that's true!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
う、嘘や！
全部言わされてんねやろ！？
english: Th-That's a lie! You're being forced to say all that, aren't you!?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
嘘やないよ、澪。
私は私の意思で決断したんや。
english: It's not a lie, Mio. I made this decision of my own free will.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
私自身の意思で、
人間としての私は死んだんよ。
english: By my own will, the human me has died.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: Died…?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 死んだやとォ……！？
english: Died, you say...!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ふざけんなァァァァッ！！！！
english: Stop messing around!!!!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: ア゛ゥウヴ！！
english: Agh!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: くッ、影が盾になって……！
english: Ugh, the Shadow acted as a shield...!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: ア゛ァアア゛アアァアアア゛！！！！
english: Aaaaghhh!!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ぐぁッ！？
english: Guah!?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
下手に刺激せんほうがええよ、
ギルは怒りんぼやから。
english: It's better not to provoke him. Gil is short-tempered.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ト……トキコが……。
english: T… Tokiko…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
トキコが死んだなんて嘘やッ！！
ほな、さっきの電話は！？
english: Tokiko being dead is a lie!! Then what about that phone call from earlier!?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
あれは私や。
あの時、もう影になってたんよ。
english: That was me. I was already a Shadow back then.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そんな……！
english: That's impossible!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
人間だろうがそうでなかろうが、
別にどっちでも変わらん。
english: Whether I'm human or not, it doesn't really make a difference.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
みんな、あのウシオさんのこと
本物の潮さんや思てるやん。
english: Everyone thinks of that Ushio-san as the real Ushio-san, right?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
それやったら、私も同じことやろ？
……違う？
english: If that's the case, then I'm the same, right? ...Aren't I?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お、お姉ちゃんは……。
english: O-Onee-chan...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そうやな……。
おまえはトキコなんやろうな。
english:
That's right…
You're probably Tokiko.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そ、窓くん？
english: S-Sou-kun?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
どこをどう見ても
おまえはトキコにしか見えやん。
english: No matter how I look at it, you only look like Tokiko to me.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: なんやの急に？
english: What's with this all of a sudden?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
すまん、トキコ。
ほんまにすまん、すまんかったッ！
english:
I'm sorry, Tokiko.
I really am. I'm sorry!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
オレのせいや！
おまえの兄貴やのにオレは……
家のこと何も知らんかった！
english: It's my fault! Even though I'm your older brother... I didn't know anything about our family!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おまえは一生懸命、
お母さんのこと守ろうとしてた、
そうなんやろ！？
english: You were trying so hard to protect Mom. Isn't that right!?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: なんで、それを……。
english: Why do you know... about that...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ、知っちゃある。
お母さんは影なんやってな。
english: Yeah, I know. That Mom is a Shadow.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おまえと親父はお母さんを生かすために、
あいつらに協力してんねやろ。
english: You and Dad have been cooperating with them to keep Mom alive, right?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
それ、誰から聞いたん？
慎平さんからか？
english: Who did you hear that from? From Shinpei-san?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
違う……。
全部おまえが自分で言いよった。
潮の記憶の中でな。
english: No... You said it all yourself. Inside Ushio's memories.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 記憶……？
english: Memories…?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
慎平は死ぬ度に時間をループして、
死ぬ少し前の時間に戻ってんねん。
潮と一緒にな。
english: Every time Shinpei dies, time loops, and he returns to a time just before he dies. Together with Ushio.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
潮はそうしてループしてる間に
見聞きした記憶を、自分以外の人間にも
見せられるんや。
english: Ushio is able to show the memories of what she's seen and heard during those loops to people other than herself.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
誰かが死んだり、殺したり……
どうにもでけへんかったり……。
english: Someone dying, or being killed... Or not being able to do anything about it...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
潮が見せてくれた記憶の中で、
オレはいろんな事実を知ったんや。
それでわかった……。
english: In the memories Ushio showed me, I learned a lot of facts. That's how I figured it out...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: トキコ、おまえは影に利用されてる！！
english: Tokiko, you're being used by the Shadows!!

あれよォ。

（ここからネイルガンを撃っても

japanese: オラアアアアアアッ！！！

japanese: ア゛グゥッ……。

japanese: ホヤァア！！！

japanese:
ちょっと二人とも！

english: Hey, you two! Don't forget about me!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: ウウウウゥゥゥゥッ！？
english: Uuuuuuuu!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Mio…!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ええでェ、澪ちゃん！
english: Nice going, Mio-chan!

japanese: ヴア゛！！
english: Vuaa!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: きゃあッ！？

japanese: あッ、スプレー落としてもた……！

japanese: ホヤァアアアァアアァアッ！！！

japanese: ゥウゥ……。

japanese:

japanese:
ごめん、窓くん！

english: Ushio…!

english: (A knife is stuck in Ushio's Shadow...)

japanese:
スキができるのずっと待ってたんよ。
お姉ちゃん、強すぎるんやもん。
english: I've been waiting for an opening this whole time. You're just too strong, Onee-chan.

japanese:
まともにやったら、

english: If I fought you head-on, I'd be the one getting beaten.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro

慎平……わ、私は大丈夫や！
こっちはええから、窓を！！

japanese:
窓くんッ！
しっかりしてやァ……！

japanese:
トキちゃん、窓のことが

トキちゃん、ハイネの言いなりに

japanese:
いまさら……
そんなこと言われても……。

It's too late…

トキちゃんとミオをハイネの

japanese:

japanese: ゥオオオオオッ！！

japanese: 慎ちゃん！！！

なァ、死んでや！
早よォ死んでやァァァァ！！

japanese: あ……あァァ………。

やめてトキコ！！

english: 8. Tokiko's Memory Part 2

japanese: 菱形　朱鷺子
english: Tokiko Hishigata

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
（今の電話……。
　ハイネは本気や……）
english: (That phone call just now... Haine is serious...)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: （私が影になれ、か）
english: (Become a Shadow, huh...)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
（慎平さんらを止めるんやったら、
　まだ警戒されてへん私の不意打ちは、
　確かに効果的やろな）
english: (If we're going to stop Shinpei-san and the others, my surprise attack, since I'm not suspected yet, would definitely be effective.)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
（けど……そんな大事な話、
　いきなりされてもすぐには……）
english: (But... being told something so important so suddenly, I can't just...)

japanese: 朱鷺子。
english: Tokiko.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……お母さん。
english: ...Mom.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese: どないしたん、顔色悪いで？
english: What's wrong? Your face looks pale.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: なんでもない。
english: It's nothing.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
ううん、何でもないことない。
ちょっとお母さんとお話しよら。
english: No, it's not nothing. Let's talk with Mom for a bit.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese: 潮ちゃんのこと、考えてたん？
english: Were you thinking about Ushio-chan?

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
まだ信じられやんのやな……。
窓とも朱鷺子とも、
ほんま仲良うしてくれてたのに。
english: You still can't believe it, huh... Even though she was so good friends with both Sou and you.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……うん。
english: …Yeah.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
よっぽど寂しかったんやな。
お祭り、一緒に行きたかったな。
english: You must have been really lonely. You wanted to go to the festival together, didn't you?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
う……うんっ。
うっ……くぅぅ……！
english: Y-Yeah... Ugh... uuuh...!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ち、違うねん……。
別に……泣いてなんか……うぅっ……！
english: N-No... It's not like... I'm crying... uugh...!

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
ふふ、泣いてええんよ？
我慢することらあらへん。
english:
Hehe, it's okay to cry.
You don't have to hold it in.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
でも……お、お父さんとお兄ちゃんには……
い、言わんといてな……。
english: But... p-please don't tell... Dad and older brother...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
うっ、ううぅぅぅ……！
あんなァ、お母さん……。

japanese:
楽しかったんよ、私！
ほんま楽しかった……！

japanese:
私、ずっと……
ずっとあのままがよかった！

なんで！？
なんでこんなことになってしもたん……！

Why!?
Why did this have to happen…!

japanese:
好きやったんやで……？

くっ、うぅっ。
