speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese: うん、うん。
english: Yeah, yeah.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
みんな、好きなんよ……。
お兄ちゃんも、お父さんも、お母さんもっ……
澪のことかて……！
english: I love everyone... Older brother, Dad, Mom... Even Mio...!

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese: 朱鷺子は優しい子やなァ。
english: You're such a kind girl, Tokiko.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
うくっ……、
ううん、私、全然優しない……。
english: Uku... No, I'm not kind at all...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
（せやから選ばれたんや。
　お兄ちゃんやなくて、私が……）
english:
(That's why I was chosen.
Not my older brother, but me…)

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
なァ、朱鷺子。
他にも何か悩みあるんと違う？
english:
Hey, Tokiko.
You've got something else on your mind, don't you?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
えっ……？
ううん、何も……。
english:
Eh…?
No, nothing…

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
お母さんの目ェはごまかせやんで？
あんた、潮ちゃんのことがある前から、
たまに難しい顔してた。
english: You can't fool your mother's eyes, you know? Even before what happened to Ushio-chan, you sometimes had a troubled look on your face.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
それとも、
お母さんには言えやんことなん？
english: Or is it something you can't tell Mom?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ごめんな……。
お母さんだけやない、
誰にも言えやんねん……。
english: I'm sorry... It's not just Mom, I can't tell anyone...

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese: 澪ちゃんにも？
english: Not even Mio-chan?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: うん……絶対言えやん。
english: Yeah... I absolutely can't tell her.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese: ……ふふっ。
english: …Hehe.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: なんで笑うん……？
english: Why are you laughing…?

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
お父さんとおんなじで強情やなァ思て。
でも……せやなァ。
english: I was just thinking you're stubborn, just like your dad. But... let's see.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
その誰にも言えやん悩みの元から、
離れることはできやんの？
english: Can't you distance yourself from the source of that worry you can't tell anyone about?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: それは、できやん……。
english: I can't do that...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
（ハイネを看病して、食餌を与えて……
　対等に取り引きしてる気になっとった）
english: (Nursing Haine, giving her food... I felt like we were making an equal trade.)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
（でもほんまは違う……。
　立場はあいつらの方が確実に上で……
　頼まれたことは絶対無視できやん）
english: (But the truth is different... Their position is definitely higher... I absolutely can't ignore what they ask of me.)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
（それに今となってはもう……
　逆ろうたら澪まで……！）
english: (Besides, at this point... If I defy them, even Mio will...!)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: もうどうしよもないんよ……。
english: There's nothing I can do anymore.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
そうなんか……。
代われることなら、お母さんが
代わっちゃりたいけどなァ。
english: Is that so... If I could, I'd take your place for you.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese: でも、きっと大丈夫や！
english: But I'm sure it'll be okay!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: Huh...?

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
朱鷺子はいろんなこと
考えられる子ォやもん。
english: Because you're a girl who can think about a lot of different things, Tokiko.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
せやから、よう考えて、
自分の意思で決めたらええんよ。
english: That's why you should think carefully, and decide with your own free will.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……うん。
english: …Yeah.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese: 後悔はせんようにね。
english: Make sure you don't regret it, okay?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ふふっ……不思議やわ。
english: Hehe... it's strange.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お母さんの笑った顔見てたら、
大丈夫な気ィして来よらよ。
english: Looking at your smiling face, Mom, makes me feel like it'll be okay.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ありがとう、お母さん……
私、お母さんがいてくれて嬉しい。
english: Thank you, Mom... I'm so happy you're here for me.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
あら、そう？
そら私も嬉しわァ。
english: Oh, really? Well, that makes me happy too.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ありがとう。
やっぱりお母さんは私のお母さんや。
english: Thank you. You really are my Mom.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
アホなこと言わんの。
私以外にあんたのお母さん、
おるわけないやろ。
english: Don't say silly things. There's no way anyone other than me could be your Mom.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ふふ……そやな。
english: Hehe… that's right.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
（たとえ打算でもかまわへん。
　お母さんも澪も私が守ってみせる）
english: (Even if it's out of self-interest, I don't care. I will protect both Mom and Mio.)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: （そうして祭りの日を乗り越えたら……）
english: (And once we get through the day of the festival...)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: （家族一緒にいつまでも……）
english: (We can be together as a family forever...)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ちょっと難しく考えすぎとったみたい。
でも、もう大丈夫。
なんとかなりそうや。
english: It seems I was overthinking things a bit. But I'm okay now. I think it'll work out.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
ふふ、元気んなった朱鷺子に、
ええこと教えちゃろ。
english: Hehe, since you've cheered up, Tokiko, I'll tell you something good.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh...?

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
実はあんたの好きな
菫の砂糖漬けがあるんよ。
english: Actually, I have your favorite... candied violets.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ほんまっ！？
english: Really!?

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
こんな時間やけど、二人でお茶でもしよか？
もちろん、お父さんとお兄ちゃんには内緒や。
english: It's a bit late, but shall we have some tea together? Of course, keep it a secret from your dad and older brother.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ありがとう。
すごくうれしいんやけど今は無理。
ちょっとやらなあかんことがあるんよ。
english: Thank you. I'm really happy, but I can't right now. There's something I have to do.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
あらそうなん？
ほな、明日にしよか。
english: Oh, is that so? Then let's do it tomorrow.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: うん……また明日な。
english: Yeah… see you tomorrow.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: そこにおるんやろ？
english: You're there, aren't you?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
誰の影か知らんけど、
早よすませて？
english: I don't know whose Shadow you are, but can we get this over with quickly?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
えらいもんやね。
どこから見ても私にしか見えやん。
english: It's quite something. No matter how you look at it, you look just like me.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
そらそうや。
あんたさえおらんかったら、
私が本物なんやさけ。
english: Of course. If you weren't here, I'd be the real one.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
せやな。
ほな、苦しまんようにしてや。
english: That's true. Well then, make sure I don't suffer.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
うん、わかっちゃある。
思い残すことないようにな。
english: Yeah, I know. Make sure you don't leave any regrets behind.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ふふっ。
わかってるや――
english: Hehe. I know—

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: さよなら、私。
english: Goodbye, me.

japanese: 9.形勢逆転
english: 9. Turning the Tables

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ここは……。
english: This is...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （影との戦闘が始まる直前――）
english: (Right before the battle with the Shadows begins—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（体育館に集まったみんなに
　潮の記憶を見せた直後か）
english: (Right after showing Ushio's memories to everyone gathered in the gym...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平、急いでみんなに
記憶を共有しやんと……！
english: Shinpei, we need to hurry and share the memories with everyone...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そんな……。
english: No way...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: トキコ……！
english: Tokiko…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （「私自身の意思で、人間としての私は死んだ」）
english: ("By my own will, the human me has died.")

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あの時、影のトキちゃんはそう言ってた）
english: (That's what Shadow Toki-chan said back then.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（すでに確定してしまった時間だ……。
　もうトキちゃんを救うことはできやん）
english: (It's a time that has already been set in stone... We can't save Toki-chan anymore.)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ホンマにトキコは……
影になってしもたんか……！
english: Did Tokiko really... become a Shadow...!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: もう助けることもできやんのかッ！？
english: We really can't save her anymore!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: う、うぅ……トキコ……。
english: U-Uuu... Tokiko...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ひぐ……っ。
……っ、な、なァ慎ちゃん。
english: *Sniff*... ...H-Hey, Shin-chan.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あの影になったトキコ……
私の影とはどっか違うように思わへん？
english: That Tokiko who became a Shadow... Don't you think she's somehow different from my Shadow?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、オレもそう思っとった。
english: Yeah, I thought so too.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そうなんや！
まるで本物のトキコみたいやった……。
english: Exactly! It was just like the real Tokiko...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
いや、ほんまに本物やったって、
ことはありえんやろか！？
english: Actually, could it be possible that she really was the real one!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ただの影やったら死にそうなオレ見て、
あんな辛そうな顔せんやろ！
なァ！？
english: If she was just a Shadow, she wouldn't have made such a pained face seeing me about to die! Right!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミたちを混乱させるために
演技していた可能性は？
english: Is there a possibility she was acting in order to confuse you?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あれは演技なんかやない！
私らには分かります！
english:
That wasn't acting!
We can tell!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
まさか……お母さんと同じなんか？
影になっても人間やったときと
なんも変わらへんって……。
english: Could it be... it's the same as Mom? Even after becoming a Shadow, she hasn't changed at all from when she was human...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
もしかすると……
影のトキコは意図的に情報や感情を
調整されているのかもしれないな。
english: Perhaps... Shadow Tokiko's information and emotions are being intentionally adjusted.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
なるほどのォ。
そんほうが影に下手な演技させるより、
よっぽどこっちを翻弄できそうや。
english: I see. That would be much more effective at toying with us than making a Shadow do some poor acting.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
相手との関係が、
近けりゃ近いほど有効やいしょ。
english: The closer the relationship with the opponent, the more effective it'll be.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: くっ、トキコ……。
english: Damn it, Tokiko...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（トキちゃんは影にされてなお……
　自分の母親を生かすためだと騙され続けて
　いるってのか？）
english: (Even after being turned into a Shadow, Toki-chan is... still being deceived into thinking it's to keep her mother alive?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
みんな、気ィ落としてる場合と違うで！
早よトキちゃんを解放してあげな！
english: Everyone, this is no time to be feeling down! We need to hurry and free Toki-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、そうやな。
今度こそ……。
english: Yeah, you're right. This time for sure...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミ、ループの限界が近付いているのだろう？
チャンスはあと何回だ？
english: You, the limit of your loops is approaching, isn't it? How many chances do you have left?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……おそらく、今回が最後です。
english: ...Probably, this is the last one.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
こ、今回が最後ッ！？
ほんなら、もし次に慎平くんが
死んでしもたら……。
english: Th-This is the last one!? Then, if Shinpei-kun dies next...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ジ・エンド。
そういうことだろ。
english: The end. That's what it means, right?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そんなん聞いとらんでェッ！！
ま、間違いないんか！？
english: I haven't heard anything about that!! A-Are you sure!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ループする度、崖が崩れていくようにして、
時間の端っこが消えていくのが分かるんです。
english: Every time I loop, it's like a cliff is crumbling, and I can feel the edges of time disappearing.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっきループした時、
その崖がすぐそこまで迫ってきてるんが
見えました。
english: When I looped earlier, I saw that cliff closing in right up to me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
たぶん次に死ねば、
ループ先は真っ暗な崖の向こうになります。
english: If I die next, my loop destination will be beyond that pitch-black cliff.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そこに一切の足場はなく、
果てしない闇に落ちてしまう……。
そういうことか？
english: There will be absolutely no footing there, and you'll fall into an endless darkness... Is that it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はい……。
english: Yes…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ハイネもそのことに気付いて
彼の命を取りにきているのだろう。
事実だと考えて問題ないな。
english: Haine must have noticed that too and is coming to take his life. It's safe to assume that's the truth.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
マ、マジか……。
これが……ラストチャンス！
english: S-Seriously...? This is... our last chance!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
最後であろうがなかろうが、
我々が取るべき行動は同じだ。
そうだろう、網代慎平。
english: Whether it's the last one or not, the action we must take remains the same. Isn't that right, Shinpei Ajiro?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はい！
english: Yes!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: この場所でもう一度……。
english: Once more in this place…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ヤツらを迎え撃つ！！
english: We'll intercept them!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 来たな……！
english: They're here…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハイネッ！　シデッ！
english: Haine! Shide!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
やあ慎平くん、お待たせしました。
みんなを集めてたら遅なってしもて。
english: Hello, Shinpei-kun. Sorry to keep you waiting. I was gathering everyone, so I ended up being late.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そして再び……学校での戦いが始まった）
english: (And so, once again... the battle at the school began.)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 突っ走るでェッ！！
english: We're making a run for it!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: お姉ちゃん、待ちやァァッ！！
english: Onee-chan, wait!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 逃がさないッ！
english: I won't let you escape!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハイネたちは大きく違う動きを見せなかった）
english: (Haine and the others didn't show any major changes in their movements.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（前回と同じようにやれば、
　もう一度オレを殺せると判断したのだろう）
english: (They probably judged that if they did the same as last time, they'd be able to kill me again.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こちらも前回と同じように竜之介さん、根津さん、
　凸村さん、小弓場さんにシデたちを任せ、
　オレたちは体育館へと向かった）
english: (Just like last time, we left Shide and the others to Ryunosuke-san, Nezu-san, Totsumura-san, and Koyuba-san, while we headed for the gym.)

speaker: Rosencrantz
japanese: アアァァァウ！！
english: Aaaaaau!!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: ヴゥウウウゥ゛！！
english: Vuuuuuuuu!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （でも、ここからは前回と違う）
english: (But from here on out, it's different from last time.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（前回、窓と澪、オレは
　「ロズ」「ギル」と呼ばれる影たちの前に
　手も足も出なかった）
english: (Last time, Sou, Mio, and I couldn't do a thing against those Shadows called "Roz" and "Gil".)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （だから今回は――）
english: (So this time—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮、そこやッ！！
english: Ushio, right there!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: でえェェェェいッ！！！
english: Deryaaaa!!!

speaker: Rosencrantz
japanese: ア゛ァァゥ゛……！？
english: Aaaau...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: よしッ！
english: Alright!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（真っ先に潮をロズとギルにぶつけてみて
　正解やった！）
english: (Having Ushio clash with Roz and Gil right off the bat was the right move!)

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ロズッ！！
どうして……！？
english:
Roz!!
Why…!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どうやらトキちゃんは、
　７周目の戦いの記憶を持っていないようだ）
english: (It seems Toki-chan doesn't have memories of the battle from the 7th loop.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（つまり……窓の必死の呼びかけも、
　覚えていないということか……）
english: (In other words... she doesn't remember Sou's desperate pleas either...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そういうことなら、
　やっぱり潮とオレが……）
english: (If that's the case, then Ushio and I will have to...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ヒルコ洞でのことや、
　ハイネとのリンク――支配が切断できることを
　トキちゃんに伝えるしかない！）
english: (We have to tell Toki-chan about what happened in the Hiruko Cave, and that her link—her control—under Haine can be severed!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: トキちゃん、聞いてくれ！
english: Toki-chan, listen to me!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ハイネはトキちゃんを裏切る！！
この目で見たんや！
english: Haine is going to betray you, Toki-chan!! I saw it with my own eyes!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
そんなはずないッ！！
行けギルッ！！
english:
That's impossible!!
Go, Gil!!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: ホヤアアアア！！！
english: Hoyaaaaa!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（トキちゃんの反応は前回と同じ。
　いずれ動揺はピークに達するはず）
english: (Toki-chan's reaction is the same as last time. Eventually, her agitation should reach its peak.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレらはその綻びを全力でついて、
　勝機をつかんでやる！）
english: (We'll strike at that opening with everything we've got, and seize our chance at victory!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トキちゃん、止まるんや！
オレらの話を聞いてくれ！
english: Toki-chan, stop! Please listen to what we have to say!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: は、話を聞く必要なんて……！
english: Th-There's no need to listen to... !

speaker: Mio
japanese:
トキコ！
そいつらの話ら聞かんでええ！
english: Tokiko! You don't need to listen to what they're saying!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: えっ……あっ！？
english: Huh... ah!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おりゃァァァッ！！
english: Ooryaaaaa!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: ううッ……！？
english: Uugh...!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
よっしゃァ！
捕まえたでェ！
english: Alright! I caught her!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
あ～あ……トキコのことなんか、
ほっとけばよかった。
english: Ahh... I should have just left Tokiko alone.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: やったァ、窓くん！！
english: You did it, Sou-kun!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よし、あっちは
　影のミオの捕獲に成功したぞ！）
english: (Alright, they successfully captured Shadow Mio over there!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （流れはこっちにきてるで！）
english: (The momentum is shifting our way!)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃん、慎ちゃん！
こっちはもう終わったから、
次はそっち手伝うで！
english: Onee-chan, Shin-chan! We're done over here, so we'll help you guys next!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん、助かる！
english: Yeah, that helps!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: トキコ、まだ降参してくれやんの？
english: Tokiko, aren't you going to surrender yet?

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: ヴゥゥ……。
english: Vuuu…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
気ィ抜くんやないで、澪ちゃん。
トキコはまだ銃も持っちゃあるはずや。
english: Don't let your guard down, Mio-chan. Tokiko should still have her gun.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: う、うん。
english: Y-Yeah.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
トキコ、慎平から聞いたやろ！
おまえはハイネらに騙されてんのや！
english:
Tokiko, you heard from Shinpei, right!
You're being deceived by Haine and the others!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: そないな話、信じられやん。
english: I can't believe that story.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
何回言わすねんッ！
潮の記憶見たらわかる！
english: How many times do I have to say it!? You'll understand once you see Ushio's memories!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
慎平と潮は何度もループして、
未来を変えてきたんや！
english: Shinpei and Ushio have looped many times and changed the future!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
慎平を信じろ！
おまえが裏切られる未来かて、
必ず慎平と潮が変えてくれる！
english: Believe in Shinpei! Even the future where you get betrayed, Shinpei and Ushio will definitely change it!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: そ、そない言われても……！
english: E-Even if you say that...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なあ、トキちゃん。
お願いやから、オレらの話ちゃんと
聞いてくれやんかな？
english: Hey, Toki-chan. Please, won't you properly listen to what we have to say?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今やッ！）
english: (Now!)

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: お兄ちゃん！？
english: Big brother!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あかん、失敗してもた……！
やっぱり妹と同じ顔してるもん、
よう撃てやん！
english: Crap, I messed up...! I really can't bring myself to shoot someone with the same face as my sister!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
お兄ちゃん……
私のことハメよとしたんか！？
english:
Big brother…
You tried to set me up!?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: ギルッ、叩き潰したりッ！！
english: Gil, smash him!!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: ホヤァアアアァアアア！！！
english: Hoyaaaaaa!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 待てッ、待ってくれトキコ！
english: Wait, wait a sec, Tokiko!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: ギルッ、もう一発や！
english: Gil, one more shot!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: ホヤアアアアッ！！！
english: Hoyaaaaa!!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 火炎放射やァッ！
english: Flamethrower!!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: オゥアアアア゛……！！
english: Ouaaaaa...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 助かったで、澪ちゃんッ！！
english: You saved me, Mio-chan!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 影の平面、もらったァァァッ！！
english: Shadow's plane, I'm taking it!!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: ホヤッ……！？
english: Hoya…!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: よっしゃ！！
english: Alright!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: ギルッ……！！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
やった！
もう一匹もやっつけたぞ！
english: Alright! We took out the other one too!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なあ、トキコ。
こうなったらもう観念して――
english: Hey, Tokiko. Since it's come to this, just give up and—

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: まだや……まだ負けてやんッ！
english: Not yet... I haven't lost yet!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: トキコ！？
english: Tokiko?!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: その銃が最後の切り札なんか？
english: Is that gun your final trump card?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
違う……！
こんなもんなくてもお兄ちゃんになんか
負けやんもん。
english: No...! Even without this, there's no way I'd lose to you, older brother.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そんなら……証明してみィ。
english: Then… prove it.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そんなもんなくても、
オレには負けやんねやろ？
english: Even without that, you won't lose to me, right?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ほな、そんな銃捨ててまえ。
ほんで慎平と潮の話、
ちゃんと聞いちゃれ。
english: Then, throw that gun away. And listen properly to what Shinpei and Ushio have to say.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
結局……ウシオさんらの話が、
信用できやんかったら？
english: In the end... what if I can't trust what Ushio-san and the others are saying?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そんときは……
せやな、オレを殺してくれてええ。
一切抵抗らしやん。
english: In that case... Yeah, you can just kill me. I won't put up any resistance.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おい、窓！
english: Hey, Sou!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ええんや。
これくらい覚悟決めんと、
今のトキコとは話にならんやろ。
english: It's fine. If I don't show this much resolve, I won't be able to get through to Tokiko right now.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
オレが命懸けて頼んでんのや。
ええ返事期待してるで。
english: I'm begging you with my life on the line. I'm expecting a good answer.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: いつもそうや……。
english: You're always like this...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ほんまにいつもそうやって、
ええかっこしよる。
english: You're really always like this, trying to look cool.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: え、ええかっこて……。
english: T-Trying to look cool...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ええよ、お兄ちゃん。
話、聞かせてもらうわ。
english: Alright, older brother. I'll listen to what you have to say.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
この銃は預けとく。
使うなり壊すなり好きにすればええ。
english: I'll leave this gun with you. You can use it or break it, do whatever you want.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: お、おお。
english: O-Oh.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ほな早速やけど……
潮、頼んだで。
english: Then, without further ado... Ushio, I'm counting on you.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
まかしとき！
こんなもんがあるからアカンねん！
english: Leave it to me! Things like this are no good!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: おりゃッ！！
english: Oorya!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あはは、任務完了！
english: Haha, mission complete!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
無限に撃てるコピー銃かァ。
ちょっともったいなくない？
english: A copy gun that can shoot infinitely, huh. Isn't it a bit of a waste?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
いや、これでええんや。
あんなもん、誰にも持たせたないし。
english: No, this is for the best. I wouldn't want anyone holding onto something like that.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: なあ、話聞くんはええけど……。
english: Hey, I don't mind listening, but...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 私にはハイネとの繋がりが……。
english: I still have my connection to Haine...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
言うたやろ？
潮ならハイネとの繋がりを
切れるはずや。
english: I told you, right? Ushio should be able to sever your connection to Haine.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
そういうことやったら……
お願いします、ウシオさん。
english: If that's the case... Please do it, Ushio-san.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うん、ハイネとの繋がり――
リンクを断ち切ったら、
もうトキちゃんは自由や。
english: Yeah, once I sever your connection to Haine— your link— you'll be free, Toki-chan.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
その後、私の記憶を見せちゃる。
それで全部理解できるはずや。
english: After that, I'll show you my memories. Then you should be able to understand everything.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: はい……。
english: Yes…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
よ……、よかった……！
よかったァ……。
english: Th... Thank goodness...! Thank goodness...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そ、窓くん！？
english: S-Sou-kun!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 何や窓、腰抜かしてんのかいな！
english: What's wrong, Sou? Did your legs give out on you!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
や、やかましわッ……
気ィ抜けてもただけやッ……。
english: Sh-Shut up... I just let my guard down for a second...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: よかっ……うぅ、よかったァ！
english: Thank... ugh, thank goodness!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
うおおおおおッ！
ほんま良かったでええええッ！
english: Uwoooooo! I'm so glad, I really am!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: めっちゃ泣くし！
english: You're crying so much!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
長かった……。
やっと分かってくれたんやな……。
english: It took so long... She finally understood...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん、これでもうトキコと
戦わんでよくなるんやね。
english: Yeah, now we won't have to fight Tokiko anymore.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: ごめんな、澪、お兄ちゃん……。
english: I'm sorry, Mio, older brother...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、そろそろやってええ？
english: Shinpei, is it okay if I do it now?

japanese: ウシオに許可を出す
english: Grant Ushio permission

japanese: トキコに影縫いを施す
english: Apply Shadow Pin to Tokiko

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、頼む。
english: Yeah, please do.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
トキちゃん、
しばらく楽にしといてな。
english: Toki-chan, just relax for a bit.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そんな痛いことやないから、
安心しててええよ。
english: It's not going to hurt that much, so you can relax.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮、少し待ってくれ。
english: Ushio, wait a second.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: えっ、なんなん？
english: Eh, what is it?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
どないしたんや慎平！
早よトキコを解放したってくれ！
english: What's wrong, Shinpei! Hurry up and free Tokiko!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: お兄ちゃん……。
english: Older brother...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そない怖がらんでええんやって！
潮と慎平に任せたら、
問題あらへん。
english: You don't have to be so scared! If you leave it to Ushio and Shinpei, there won't be any problems.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ダ、ダメだ……。
　この状況で影のトキちゃんの影に
　釘を打ち込むやなんて）
english: (I-I can't... To drive a nail into Shadow Toki-chan's Shadow in this situation...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そんなことできっこない）
english: (There's no way I can do that.)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: どないしたんや、慎平？
english: What's wrong, Shinpei?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
う、ううん、なんでもない。
潮、後は頼んだで。
english: N-No, it's nothing. Ushio, I'll leave the rest to you.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: んじゃ始めよか、トキちゃん。
english: Then let's start, Toki-chan.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: はい……。
english: Yes…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ほな、そのまま私の手を――
english: Then, just like that, take my hand—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なっ！？
english: Wha!?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 約束……破ってしもた。
english: I broke the promise…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あ、がぁううッ……。
english: A-Gah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮ッ！　大丈夫か！？
english: Ushio! Are you okay!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なんでや！
なんでなんやッ、トキコ！？
english: Why! Why did you do that, Tokiko!?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: ごめんな、お兄ちゃん。
english: I'm sorry, older brother.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ご、ごめんて、おまえ……！
english: S-Sorry, you say...!

speaker: Ushio
english: Shi... n... pei...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: う……潮？
english: U… Ushio?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮ォォォォォォォォッ！！！！
english: Ushioooooooo!!!!

japanese: 10.闇の中のトキコ
english: 10. Tokiko in the Darkness

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 動いたら殺します。
english: If you move, I'll kill you.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: コピーのほうはハリボテやったけど……
english: The copy was just a fake, but...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 本物の銃は消さんといて助かったわ。
english: It's a good thing I didn't erase the real gun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮が壊した銃はコピーだったのか！）
english: (The gun that Ushio destroyed was a copy!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（コピーした機械は本物を消さない限り、
　役に立たない複製品だ……）
english: (A copied machine is just a useless replica unless the real one is erased...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（本来隠し持っておくべき護身銃を
　見せつけるようにしていた時点で囮だと気づく
　べきだったのに……）
english: (I should have realized it was a decoy the moment she showed off the self-defense gun she should have been hiding...)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: くそ……！
english: Damn…!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
あんな無防備に近づいてくるやなんて、
ウシオさんらしなァ……。
english: Coming so close, so defenselessly like that... That's not like Ushio-san at all...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: トキコ……！
english: Tokiko…!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
慎平さんも……
ちょっと迂闊やったんと違いますか？
english: Shinpei-san... Weren't you a bit careless too?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
たしかに……気づく機会はあった。
でも……！
english: True... I had chances to notice. But...!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
私を信じたとでも言うんですか？
こんな、化物になった私を……。
english: Are you saying you believed in me? Even though I've become a monster like this...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ト……キコ……！
お、おまえッ……！
english: To... kiko...! Y-You...!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
明後日――祭りの日に最後の食餌を与えれば、
ハイネの力が戻って、お母さんも生き長らえることが
できるはずやったんです。
english: The day after tomorrow—on the day of the festival, if we give her the final meal, Haine's power will return, and Mom should be able to live longer.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
お母さんだけじゃありません。
私はハイネに協力する条件としてお兄ちゃんと
澪の身の安全を約束させてました。
english: It wasn't just Mom. As a condition for cooperating with Haine, I made her promise the safety of you and Mio.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
それやのに……ウシオさんと慎平さんが
余計なことをし始めたせいで、
すべておかしくなってしまったんです。
english: And yet... because Ushio-san and Shinpei-san started doing unnecessary things, everything went wrong.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
違う！
ハイネは約束守る気なんかあらへんかった！
はなから裏切るつもりやったんや！
english: You're wrong! Haine never intended to keep her promise! She planned to betray you from the start!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
潮が……潮がおったら……
おまえにハイネの本性見してやれたんに！
english: If Ushio... if Ushio were here... I could have shown you Haine's true nature!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
もし、ハイネが裏切るつもりやったとして……
それがどないしたん？
english: Even if Haine planned to betray me... What does that matter?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
悪いヤツやから……、
嘘つきやから滅びるとでも言うん？
english: Because she's a bad person... Because she's a liar, you think she'll be destroyed?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
間違うてようが正しかろうが、
結局は強いもんが勝つんよ。
english: Whether it's right or wrong, in the end, the strong one wins.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
トキコ……
あんた自分がなに言うてるんか――
english: Tokiko... Do you even know what you're saying—

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
わかってる……！
でも考えてもみてや……。
english: I know...! But just think about it...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
命令されて……覚悟して影になってみたら、
今まで必死に信じ込んできたことと、
違う事実を突きつけられて……。
english: Being ordered to... and then preparing myself to become a Shadow, only to be confronted with facts that were different from what I desperately believed...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
澪には手ェ出さんはずやったのに、
知らん間にコピーされとるし……。
english: She wasn't supposed to lay a hand on Mio, but she was copied without me knowing...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
でも、でもせやからって逆らえやんやん！
逆ろうたら澪が、
どうなるかわからんって……！
english: But, but even so, I can't defy her! If I do, I don't know what will happen to Mio...!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ハイネはあんたらのせいで、
怒ってるんやッ！
english: Haine is angry because of you guys!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
落ち着け、トキコ！
いつまでもハイネを恐れてたらアカン！
未来は変えられるんや！
english: Calm down, Tokiko! You can't be afraid of Haine forever! The future can be changed!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
それやったら……
「ハイネが私を裏切る未来」も変えられる、
そうなんと違う？
english: If that's the case... We can change the "future where Haine betrays me" too, isn't that right?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そ、それはちょっと違うやろ……！
english: Th-That's a bit different...!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
なにが違うん？
私がウシオさんと慎平さん倒したら、
ハイネも機嫌直してくれるはず。
english: What's different? If I defeat Ushio-san and Shinpei-san, Haine's mood should improve.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
そしたら、澪と……お兄ちゃんくらいは、
見逃してくれるかもしれやんねや。
english: Then, she might at least spare Mio... and you, older brother.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
アホかッ！
ハイネが勝ったら、
みんな死んでしまうんやぞッ！
english: Are you an idiot! If Haine wins, everyone will die!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ウシオさんはもうおらん。
お兄ちゃんの言うことを信じられる根拠も
消え失せてしもたんや。
english: Ushio-san is already gone. The basis for believing what you say has also disappeared.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……トキコッ！
english: …Tokiko!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
なんなら、澪もお兄ちゃんも、
私みたいに影にしてもろたらええ。
english: If anything, Mio and you, older brother, could just be turned into Shadows like me.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
影にて……。
そ、そんなん嫌や！
english: Turn into a Shadow... I-I don't want that!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
安心しィ。
影でも本物となんも変わらんから。
english: Relax. Even as a Shadow, you're no different from the real thing.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ああ、澪が影になるんやったら、
今いてる影のミオは消してもらわなな。
あれはどうかしてしもてる。
english: Ah, if Mio is going to become a Shadow, we'll have to get rid of the current Shadow Mio. That one is messed up.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ハイネに頼んだら、
こんな風に殺し合うたことも
忘れさせてもらえるで。
english: If I ask Haine, she can even make us forget that we were killing each other like this.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
私のお母さんみたいに、
自分が影ってことすら
忘れさせてもらうんもええな。
english: Like my mom, it would be nice to be made to forget even the fact that I'm a Shadow.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
そしたら人間のときと全然変わらん。
今まで通り、楽しく――
english: Then it'll be no different from when we were human. Just like always, happily—

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
嘘やッ！
おまえはそんなことら思てやん！
english: That's a lie! You don't really think that!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: お兄ちゃんは黙っといて！
english: You stay quiet, older brother!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おまえが黙れ！
言ってることがメチャクチャや！！
english: You're the one who needs to shut up! What you're saying makes no sense!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
銃なんて似合わんモン持って……
ほんまひどい顔やで。
english: Holding something that doesn't suit you like a gun... You really have a terrible look on your face.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
でもよォ……その顔が……
後悔だらけのその顔がおまえの
本心なんとちゃうか？
english: But you know... Isn't that face, full of regret, your true feelings?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: もう遅い……。
english: It's too late…

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: もうどうにもならんのや！
english: There's nothing we can do anymore!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: —Gah!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 慎平ッ！！！
english: Shinpei!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（トキちゃんから伸びた影が……
　オレを締めつけてる！？）
english: (A Shadow extending from Toki-chan... It's squeezing me!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （う、動けない……！）
english: (I-I can't move...!)

japanese: 11.解けていく心
english: 11. The Heart Melting Away

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: さよなら、慎平さん。
english: Goodbye, Shinpei-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: U-Ugh...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ふざけんといてッ！！！！
english: Stop messing around!!!!

speaker: Tokiko
english: M-Mio...!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Ku...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ごめんな……。
私のこと、嫌いになったやろ。
english: I'm sorry... You must hate me now, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……最悪ッ！！
ほんま最悪やわッ！！
english: ...You're the worst!! You're really the worst!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: けど……。
english: But…

speaker: Tokiko
english: …Huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
けどトキコのこと、
嫌いになんかなれやんやんッ！
english: But there's no way I could ever hate you, Tokiko!

speaker: Tokiko
english: Mio…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんでこんなことになってしもたん！？
english: Why did things have to end up like this!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
勝手に影になったとか！
私のこと守ろうとしてたとか！
english: Becoming a Shadow on your own! Trying to protect me!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんなんそれッ！？
english: What's up with that!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私のためとか勝手に決めやんといて！
勝手に一人で抱え込んで苦しまんといて！
english: Don't just decide on your own that it's for my sake! Don't just shoulder it all by yourself and suffer!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんで……なんで一言、
私に相談してくれやんかったん……！？
english: Why... why didn't you talk to me about it, even just a little...!?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: そんなん……できるわけない……。
english: There's no way... I could do that...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
言えるわけないやろ！
あんな怪物の手助けしてるやなんて！
澪だけには、絶対知られたなかった！
english: There's no way I could say it! That I was helping a monster like that! I absolutely didn't want you to find out, Mio!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: でもッ……！
english: But…!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ごめんな澪……。
もう終わりなんよ……。
english:
I'm sorry, Mio…
It's over now…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……まだ終わりやない。
english: ...It's not over yet.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
まだそんなこと言うんですか？
いい加減諦めてください。
english: Are you still saying that? Please just give up already.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トキちゃん、まだやり直せる。
だからオレらの仲間になるんやッ！
english: Toki-chan, you can still start over. So become our ally!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
な、何言うてるんです？
私は……ウシオさんを……！
english: Wh-What are you saying? I... Ushio-san... I...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それでもトキちゃんは殺さへん。
english: Even so, I won't kill you, Toki-chan.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: なんでッ……なんでなん！？
english: Why... why!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
悪いのはトキちゃんやない。
ハイネとシデたちや。
english: The one at fault isn't you, Toki-chan. It's Haine and Shide.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だからあいつらは許さないし、
絶対に倒してみせる。
english: That's why I won't forgive them, and I'll definitely defeat them.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そのためにも、
トキちゃんの協力が必要なんや！
english: And to do that, I need your help, Toki-chan!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
潮に頼らんでもハイネとのリンクを
絶つ方法は必ずあるはずや！
english: Even without relying on Ushio, there must definitely be a way to sever the link with Haine!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
だからやり直そや！
なッ、トキコ！
english: So let's start over! Right, Tokiko!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: う……うあ、あ……ああ……。

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……トキコ？
english: …Tokiko?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（拘束が解けた？
　体が……動くぞ！）
english: (The restraints came undone? My body... I can move!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（トキちゃんが苦しんでる。
　一体なにが起こってるんだ！？）
english: (Toki-chan is suffering. What on earth is happening!?)

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
こっちはもうじきカタがつく。
そっちもことごとく殺せ。
english: Things are almost settled on this end. Kill every last one of them over there too.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: みなごろしじゃ。
english: Massacre them.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: あ、頭、が……うう、あァッ！！
english: M-My head... ugh, aah!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
さっきから何か変やで！
どないしたん！？
english: Something's been strange for a while now! What's wrong!?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 殺す……全員、殺す……！
english: Kill... I'll kill everyone...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: トキコッ！！
english: Tokiko!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ま、まさか……！
ハイネがテレパシーでトキちゃんを！？
english: D-Don't tell me...! Haine is using telepathy on Toki-chan!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
アカンで、トキコ！
ハイネの命令なんか聞かんでええ！
english: You can't, Tokiko! You don't have to listen to Haine's orders!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: しっかりしろトキコ！！
english: Pull yourself together, Tokiko!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: うううう……うあああッ！！！
english: Uuuuu... uwaaaaah!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （このままじゃ危険だ……！）
english: (It's dangerous if this keeps up...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なんとかして足を止めないと！）
english: (I have to stop her somehow!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: みんな、トキちゃんから離れろ！
english: Everyone, get away from Toki-chan!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: トキコォォォッ！
english: Tokikoooo!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ダメだ……対応が間に合わない！）
english: (It's no good... I won't make it in time!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （このままじゃ殺られ――）
english: (At this rate, I'll be killed—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Ugh…!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（反射的にネイルガンを撃ったけど、
　全部外れてしまった……！）
english: (I reflexively fired the nail gun, but they all missed...!)

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: ううう……殺、す……殺す！
english: Uuu... kill... kill!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あまり傷付けたくないけど、
　なんとか弱らせていければ――）
english: (I don't want to hurt her too much, but if I can somehow weaken her—)

japanese: 13.ごめんね
english: 13. I'm Sorry

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: あああああああッ！！！
english: Aaaaaaaah!!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: やめてェッ！！！！
english: Stop it!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: —Mio!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
澪ちゃんがトキコと慎平の間に
割り込みよった！
english: Mio-chan jumped in between Tokiko and Shinpei!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どけッ、どくんや澪！
english: Move, get out of the way, Mio!

speaker: Tokiko
english: M-Mio...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
どかへん！
私、絶対どかへんでッ！
english: I won't move! I absolutely won't move!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
お願い、澪……！
澪まで……殺したない……！
english: Please, Mio...! I don't want to... kill you too...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そん時はそん時や。
english: If that happens, then that's that.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
澪、アカン……
それ以上、近づいたら……！
english: Mio, you can't... If you get any closer...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私が受け止めなアカンかってん。
english: I'm the one who had to accept it.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
今まで何も知らんと……
トキコのこと苦しめてしもてたんやもん。
english: I didn't know anything until now... And I ended up making you suffer, Tokiko.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
トキコは私のこと、
ずっと守ってくれとったのにな。
english: Even though you've been protecting me this whole time, Tokiko.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
影に協力してること……
ずっと一人で悩んでたんよね。
english: Cooperating with the Shadows... You were agonizing over it all alone, weren't you.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 誰にも言えんかったんよね……。
english: You couldn't tell anyone, could you?

speaker: Tokiko
english: Y... yeah...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: トキコ……ごめん。
english: Tokiko… I'm sorry.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私が一番に気づいたらなアカンかった。
english: I should have been the first to notice.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
親友やのに……。
大事な、トキコのことやのに……。
english: Even though we're best friends... Even though it's you, Tokiko, who's so important to me...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: う、うぅぅッ……。
english: U-Uuuu...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
わ、私こそ……ごめんな！
私……潮さんを……。
english: I-I'm the one... who should be sorry! I... Ushio-san...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
取り返しのつかんこと……
して……しもた……！
english: I did something... that can't be undone...!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: う、ううッ……澪ォ……！！
english: U-Uuu... Miooo...!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
こんなん嫌やッ……！
なんで……なんで私ッ……！
english: I hate this...! Why... why did I...!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: うわああああんッ！！
english: Uwaaaaaan!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
ごめんなさいッ！！
ひぐっ、ごめんなさいぃ……！！
english: I'm sorry!! *Sniff*, I'm so sorry...!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 元に、戻りたい……！
english: I want to go back to normal!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
前みたいにッ……
みんなと、澪と一緒におりたい！
english: Like before... I want to be with everyone, with Mio!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん……そやね。
english: Yeah... that's right.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
うえッ、うぅッ……！
うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁッ！！
あぁぁぁああぁぁッ……！
english: Ue, uuu...! Uwaaaaaaaah!! Aaaaaaah...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
よかった……。
分かってくれたんやな……。
english: Thank goodness... You understood...

speaker: Shide
japanese: いやァ、青春ですね。
english: My, what a display of youth.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ええもん見せてもらいました。
感動してしまいましたよ！
english: You showed me something good. I was quite moved!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あんたら……！
english: You guys…

speaker: Shide
japanese:
おっと、すみません。
お邪魔してしまいましたかねぇ。
english: Oops, excuse me. Did I interrupt you?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
私としてはずっと見ていたいのですが、
ハイネはそうじゃないらしくて。
english: Personally, I'd like to keep watching, but it seems Haine feels differently.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
あないな茶番、
見るだけ時間の無駄じゃ。
english: A farce like that is just a waste of time to watch.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おいッ、みんなは……
先生たちはどうしたッ！？
english: Hey, what about everyone... What did you do to the teachers!?

speaker: Shide
japanese: ああ、もれなく始末させてもらいました。
english: Ah, I took care of them all without exception.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: マジかよ……！
english: Are you serious...!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
勝てる見込みもないのに、
それはもうしつこかったですよ？
あれこそ時間の無駄でしょうに。
english: Even though you had no chance of winning, you were so persistent, weren't you? That was the real waste of time.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
特に感動シーンもありませんでしたし、
最初からこっちに来ればよかったですね。
english: There wasn't even a moving scene, so you should have just come here from the start.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
まあまあ、そんな興奮しないで。
キミらもすぐに追いつけますから。
english: Now, now, don't get so worked up. You'll be catching up to them soon enough.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 黙れェェェェェッ！！！
english: Shut uuuup!!!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: 止まれ。
english: Stop.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 体が……動かせやん……！？
english: My body... won't move...!?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
おまんの役目は終わったんじゃ。
大人しゅうしとれ。
english: Your role is finished. Just be quiet.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
これは……私の体や！
私の体やのに……！
english: This is... my body! It's my body, and yet...!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
動けッ！
動けェェェェッ！！！
english: Move! Moveeee!!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: くう……うううッ！！
english: Kuu... uuu!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
そんな怖い顔で睨まないでくださいよ。
キミはこっちの仲間でしょ？
english: Don't glare at me with such a scary face. You're on our side, right?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: ち、違う……私は……！

speaker: Shide
japanese:
よく考えてみてください。
キミが慎平くんらの仲間になんて、
なれるわけないでしょう。
english: Think about it carefully. There's no way you could ever be allies with Shinpei-kun and the others.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
そこにいる澪ちゃんのお姉さん、
ウシオちゃんを殺しといて、
厚かましいと思わんのですか？
english: You killed Mio-chan's older sister, Ushio-chan. Don't you think it's a bit shameless?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: あ……う、うぅ……！

speaker: Shide
japanese:
賢い子ォや思てたんですけどねェ。
壊れてしもたみたいです。
english: I thought you were a smart girl. But it seems you've broken.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
そやなァ。
あとで頭ん中いじっちゃる。
english: That's right. I'll mess with your head later.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: い……嫌、いややッ……！
english: N-No... I don't want that...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: このォッ！！
english: You bastard!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
おっと、元気やなァ。
まだ戦いたいんか？
english: Oh my, you're energetic. Do you still want to fight?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
オレのネイルガンが消えてもた！
澪ちゃんの借りるで！
english: My nail gun disappeared! I'm borrowing Mio-chan's!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: これでも食らえ！！
english: Take this!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: これは……。
english: This is...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
火炎放射やッ！！
おまえら燃え散ってまえ！
english: A flamethrower!! Burn to ashes, all of you!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
心配すんな、トキコ！
おまえはオレらの仲間になるんや！
english: Don't worry, Tokiko! You're going to be our ally!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
せやからあいつの言うことらァ、
真に受けてんちゃうぞ！
english: So don't take what that guy says seriously!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: お兄ちゃん……。
english: Older brother...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
麗しき兄妹愛。
うん、悪くはないんですが。
english: Such beautiful sibling love. Yes, it's not bad, but...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
少し暑苦しいですね。
消えてください。
english: It's a bit too suffocating. Please disappear.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ぐあァァァァァッ！！！
english: Guaaaaaa!!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: お兄ちゃんッ！！
english: Older brother!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 窓くんッ！！
english: Sou-kun!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
くそォッ！
よくも窓をッ！！
english: Damn it!! How dare you do that to Sou!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
怒りに任せて攻撃しても
良い結果は得られませんよ？
english: Even if you attack out of anger, you won't get good results, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アカン！
攻撃がまったく効かへん！
english: It's no use! My attacks aren't working at all!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
相手を確実に仕留めたいのなら、
やはり冷静さが大事です。
それこそ、ほら――
english: If you want to take down your opponent for sure, calmness is key after all. Just like this, see—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐぼッ……。
english: Gubo...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃんッ！？
english: Shin-chan!?

speaker: Shide
japanese: こんな風に、ね。
english: Like this, you see?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんッ！？
起きてや、慎ちゃんッ！！
english: Shin-chan!? Wake up, Shin-chan!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃァァァァんッ！！！
english: Shin-chaaaan!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （まだや……まだ諦めてへん）
english: (Not yet... I haven't given up yet.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今のオレに何ができる？
　フカン……フカンするんや）
english: (What can I do right now? Bird's-eye view... take a bird's-eye view.)

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
うふふっ、考えても無駄じゃ。
おまんにできることは、
もうなんもないわ。
english: Hehe, it's useless to think. There's nothing left for you to do.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
さあそろそろフィナーレです。
存分に楽しんでくださいね、慎平くん。
english: Now then, it's almost time for the finale. Please enjoy it to the fullest, Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あかん……。
　もう……動けやん）
english: (It's no good... I can't... move anymore.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 窓くんに……慎ちゃんまで……。
english: Sou-kun... and even Shin-chan...

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: あぁ、あぁぁッ……！
english: Aa, aaaa...!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
トキコちゃん！
いやァ、ご苦労様でした。
english: Tokiko-chan! Well, thanks for your hard work.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
キミのおかげで、
すべて丸く収まりそうですよ。
english: Thanks to you, it looks like everything will be wrapped up nicely.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレはもう……ループできない）
english: (I can't... loop anymore.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪……トキちゃん……。
　せめて二人だけでも――）
english: (Mio... Toki-chan... If only the two of you at least—)

speaker: Shide
japanese:
よかったなァ、トキコちゃん。
これで大好きな澪ちゃんと、
ずっと一緒にいられるやないですか。
english: Good for you, Tokiko-chan. Now you can be with your beloved Mio-chan forever, right?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: そ、そんなこと……。
english: Th-That's...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
トキコ、こんなヤツらに
言われっぱなしでええの！？
english: Tokiko, are you really okay with letting these guys say whatever they want!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
みんなの敵討ちや！
私らでこいつらやっつけちゃろら！
english: It's to avenge everyone! Let's take these guys down together!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ははは、元気やなァ。
とっくに心が折れてるものと
思ってましたよ。
english: Hahaha, you're energetic. I thought your spirit would have been broken long ago.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ちょっと、私のこと忘れてへん！？
動けやんのやけど！
english: Hey, haven't you forgotten about me!? I can't move though!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ああ、そういえばそうでした。
あっちにもミオちゃんがいましたね。
english: Ah, come to think of it, that's right. There was a Mio-chan over there too.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
でも……どうでしょうか？
澪ちゃんは二人もいりませんよね。
english: But... what do you think? We don't need two Mio-chans, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
どっちかは消す、
そない言いたいん？
english: You're going to erase one of us, is that what you're saying?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
実に察しがいい。
つまりはそういうことです。
english: You're very perceptive. That is exactly what it means.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
お願いッ！
澪は、澪だけは殺さんでッ！！
english: Please! Mio... please don't kill Mio!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: さて……どちらにしましょうか？
english: Now then... which one should we choose?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
き、来てみィや！！
ただでは死なんで！！
english: C-Come at me!! I won't go down without a fight!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ほらッ、なんとか言うてみィや！！
english: Come on, say something!!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
ちょっと黙っとれ。
さっきからやかましで。
english: Shut up for a bit. You've been noisy for a while now.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ――えッ？
english: —Eh?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
いきなりどないしたんです？
てっきり全部私が任されてるもんやと
思てたのに。
english: What's with you all of a sudden? I thought I was being left in charge of everything.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
からかうだけで何もしやんから、
待ちくたびれてもうた。
english: You're just teasing them and not doing anything, so I got tired of waiting.

speaker: Shide
japanese: あらら、それは失礼。
english: Oh my, excuse me.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: まあ、腹が減っとったんもあるけどな。
english: Well, I was hungry too, you know.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （まさか……澪まで……！）
english: (Don't tell me... even Mio...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （意識が……遠のいて、く……）
english: (My consciousness... is fading...)

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: うッ……くッ、ぅあああああッ！！
english: Ugh... ku, uaaaaaah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （トキちゃんの……泣き声……）
english: (Toki-chan's... crying voice...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （結局、オレは……誰一人……）
english: (In the end, I... couldn't save...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （助けられ……なかった……）
english: (...anyone...)

japanese: 12.いつも見てるから
english: 12. Always Watching From the Side

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: あああああああッ！！！
english: Aaaaaaah!!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: え……み、澪？
english: E... M-Mio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: かはッ……！
english: Kaha...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪……弾があたった！？）
english: (Mio... she got hit by the bullet!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪ッ、オレのことかばったのか！？
english: Mio, did you protect me!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……っ、慎ちゃん……大丈夫？
english: …Shin-chan… Are you okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレのことなんかどうでもええ！
早くオレの後ろへ……！
english: Don't worry about me! Hurry, get behind me...!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
トキコッ……！
おまえ、澪ちゃんを……！
english: Tokiko...! You... to Mio-chan...!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: あ、あ、み、澪……！
english: A, a, M-Mio...!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
澪から血……血が……！
これ……わ、私が……！？
english: Blood from Mio... blood is...! Did... did I... do this...!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ト、トキコ……。
english: T-Tokiko…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （トキちゃんが正気に戻ってる……）
english: (Toki-chan has returned to her senses...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪を撃ったショックなのか……？）
english: (Is it from the shock of shooting Mio…?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……トキコのことは……
私が……一番ようわかってる……。
english: ...I understand Tokiko... better than... anyone else...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
だから……
次にトキコがなにしよ思てるか……
すぐに……わかった。
english: That's why... I knew right away... what Tokiko was planning to do next.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: 澪ッ、澪ォォォッ！
english: Mio, Mioooo!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
勝手なことして……
ごめんな、慎ちゃん……。
english: I acted on my own... I'm sorry, Shin-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんも気にしてやん！
もう無理にしゃべらんでええ！
english: Don't worry about it! You don't have to force yourself to talk anymore!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ちょっ……と、
突っ走って……しもたかな……。
english: I might have... rushed into things... a bit...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でも……しゃあないやんな……。
いつもやったら……
私を止めてくれるトキコが……。
english: But... it couldn't be helped... Normally... Tokiko would be the one to stop me...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
こんなことに……
なって……しもとるんやから……。
english: But since she's... ended up... like this...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
み、澪ちゃん！
しっかりせェッ！！
english: M-Mio-chan! Hang in there!!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
嫌や、澪ッ！
私をおいてかんで！！
english: No, Mio! Don't leave me behind!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
悲しませてごめんやけど……
最後にトキコの本音聞けて……嬉しいわ……。
english: I'm sorry for making you sad, but... I'm happy... I got to hear your true feelings at the end...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
し、慎ちゃん……窓くん。
トキ、コ……を――
english: Sh-Shin-chan... Sou-kun. Toki, ko... please—

speaker: Tokiko
english: Mio…?

speaker: Tokiko
japanese:
澪っ！　嘘やろ、澪！？
目ェ開けてや、澪ォォォォッ！！
english: Mio! This is a lie, right, Mio!? Open your eyes, Miooooo!!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: やってしもたな、トキコ。
english: You've really done it now, Tokiko.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: うあぁぁぁッ……っ！！
english: Uwaaaah...!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
そんな顔しないでくださいよ。
私らがやったわけやないのに。
english: Don't make that face. It's not like we're the ones who did it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハイネ……シデ……！！
english: Haine… Shide…!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
いやァ、澪ちゃんは勇敢でした。
命拾いしましたね、慎平くん。
english: My, Mio-chan was brave. You had a narrow escape, Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
でもお陰でイイモノを見れました。
友情とは尊いものですねェ。
english: But thanks to that, I got to see something good. Friendship truly is a precious thing.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
親友の死をきっかけに正気を取り戻すなんて、
実に感動的なシーンでしたよ。
english: Regaining your sanity triggered by the death of your best friend... It was a truly moving scene.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐッ……くぅぅ……ッ！！
english: Guh... kuuu...!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: おや、影のミオちゃんは？
english: Oh, what about Shadow Mio-chan?

speaker: Mio
japanese: ここや！
english: Over here!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
あれ、動けやんのですか。
誰かミオちゃんの釘抜いてあげたって。
english: Oh, you can't move? Someone pull the nail out for Mio-chan.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
いッた……！
もっと丁寧に抜いてやッ。
english: Ow...! Pull it out more carefully.

speaker: Shide
japanese: どないです？
english: How is it?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
大丈夫。
こんなんすぐ治るし。
english: It's fine. Something like this will heal right away.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
だそうですよ、トキコちゃん。
よかったですねェ。
english: That's what she says, Tokiko-chan. Isn't that great?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
今までいた本物は、
キミがし～っかり殺してくれたんで、
これからは彼女が本物です。
english: The real one who was here until now, you completely killed her for us, so from now on, she is the real one.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
末永く、
ず～っと一緒にいてやってください。
english: Please stay together with her, forever and ever.

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: よ、よくも……！
english: How dare you…!

speaker: Tokiko
japanese: うああああああああッ！！！
english: Uwaaaaaaaah!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……えっ？

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: き、消えた……？
english: D-Disappeared...?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: Toki... ko...?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
いつまでうだうだしとる。
待ちくたびれてまうわ。
english: How long are you going to dawdle? I'm getting tired of waiting.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
いやいや、待ちくたびれるもなにも、
トキコちゃん消してしもてるやないですか。
english: No, no, tired of waiting or not, you've erased Tokiko-chan, haven't you?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
別にええやないか。
もう用済みやったしのう。
english: It doesn't matter, does it? She'd already served her purpose anyway.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
わしらは約束守ったってたのに、
裏切りよって。
english: Even though we kept our promise, she betrayed us.

speaker: Shide
japanese: まあ、そうなんですけどね。
english: Well, that's true.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
アホなやっちゃで。
せっかくミオと一緒にいさせたろ
思てたのにのう……。
english: What an idiot. And after I was planning to let her be together with Mio...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
残念ですねェ。
まあ、慎平くんたちを追い込む駒としては、
よう働いてくれたんと違いますか？
english: It's a shame. Well, as a pawn to corner Shinpei-kun and the others, she worked quite well, didn't she?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おまえら、絶対許さへんぞ！
english: I'll never forgive you guys!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
たとえ死んでも、
おまえらだけは――
english: Even if I die, you guys are the only ones I'll—

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
飛んできた包丁で、
慎平のネイルガンが！
english: A thrown knife hit Shinpei's nail gun!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
頼みの武器も今ので終いや。
どうする、慎ちゃん？
english: Your relied-upon weapon is gone now too. What will you do, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: く、唯一残ってた武器が……！
english: D-Damn, my only remaining weapon...!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
だいたい慎ちゃんが悪いんよ？
私のこと無視しよるから。
english: This is mostly your fault, you know, Shin-chan? Because you were ignoring me.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ほなこの包丁をッ――
english: Then I'll use this knife—

speaker: Mio
japanese:
これは私のや。
勝手に触れやんといて。
english: This is mine. Don't touch it without permission.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: うッ……くそッ……！
english: Ugh... damn it...!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
で……おまんらは、
どないするつもりなんじゃ？
english: So... what do you guys plan to do?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
影になるか、
ひづるらと同じとこに行くか……。
english: Become a Shadow, or go to the same place as Hizuru and the others...

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: どっちでもかまわんぞ。
english: Either way is fine.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
私らはめっぽう寛大ですからね。
好きな方を選ばせてあげますよ。
english: We're incredibly generous, you see. We'll let you choose whichever you prefer.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
ふふっ……。
さあ、どないする？
english: Hehe... Now then, what will you do?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: く……ッ！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（諦めるな、フカンだ！
　フカンしろ……！！）
english: (Don't give up, bird's-eye view! Take a bird's-eye view...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（南雲先生、根津さん、凸村さん、
　小弓場さんがやられ……）
english: (Nagumo-sensei, Nezu-san, Totsumura-san, and Koyuba-san have been taken out...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮も澪ももういない……）
english: (Ushio and Mio are already gone...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（目の前にはシデとハイネ、
　それに加えて影のミオまで……）
english: (In front of me are Shide and Haine, and on top of that, Shadow Mio...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（武器はもうない。
　今からループできる可能性も……）
english: (I have no weapons left. And the possibility of looping from now on is...)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: し、慎平……？
english: Sh-Shinpei...?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: なんでずっと黙ってんねん！
english: Why have you been silent this whole time!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 慎平ッ、何か言うてくれや！
english: Shinpei, say something!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: うふふっ、あははははっ。
english: Ufufu, ahahahaha.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: あははははっ、あはははははっ！！
english: Ahahahaha, ahahahahaha!!

japanese: 14.ずっと一緒に……
english: 14. Always Together…

japanese: 菱形　朱鷺子
english: Tokiko Hishigata

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: なあ、澪……。
english: Hey, Mio…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: どないしたん？
english: What's wrong?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 私……澪と一緒におってええんかな？
english: Is it... okay for me to be with you, Mio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
聞くまでもあらへん。
ええに決まってるやん。
english: You don't even need to ask. Of course it is.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ほんまに……？
english: Really…?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほんまやよォ。
ふふ、そんな難しい顔せんといてよ。
english: Really. Hehe, don't make such a troubled face.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なあ、なんか悩みでもあるん？
私でよかったら、話聞くで。
english: Hey, do you have something on your mind? If I'll do, I can listen.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
いっつも私が頼ってばっかりやもん。
たまには頼りになるとこ見せちゃるよ。
english: I'm always the one relying on you, after all. I'll show you I can be dependable for once.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ほら、なんでも言うて。
english: Come on, tell me anything.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
なぁ、澪……。
前にメダルもろた時のこと覚えてる？
ほら、水泳部の。
english: Hey, Mio... Do you remember when I got a medal before? You know, from the swimming club.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あぁ、あんときのメダルな。
もちろん覚えちゃあるよ。
english: Ah, the medal from back then. Of course I remember it.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほんま嬉しかったし、
トキコもめっちゃ喜んでくれたもんな。
english: I was really happy, and you were super happy for me too, Tokiko.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: うん、私も嬉しかった。
english: Yeah, I was happy too.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
澪の泳ぎ、速いだけやのうて、
すごく綺麗やった。
english: Your swimming wasn't just fast, Mio, it was really beautiful.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ずっと見ときたかったくらいや。
english: I wanted to keep watching it forever.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あっははは……何か照れてまうわ。
english: Ahahaha... I'm getting kind of embarrassed.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
私なァ……澪のこと、
ほんまようけ覚えてるんよ。
english: You know... I remember so much about you, Mio.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
二人でいろんな話したやんな。
私らしか知らん秘密の話も。
english: We talked about all sorts of things together, right? Even secret things that only we know.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
他の人には言えやん秘密でも、
澪は私に話してくれた……。
english: Even secrets you couldn't tell anyone else, you told them to me, Mio...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そらトキコやもん。
トキコやったらなんでも話せるわ。
english: Well, it's you, Tokiko. I can talk about anything with you.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
なあ、澪。
もし私が隠し事してたら……
澪はどない思う？
english: Hey, Mio. If I was hiding something... what would you think?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 私のこと、嫌いになってまう？
english: Would you come to hate me?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なに言うてるんよ。
嫌いになるわけないやん。
english: What are you saying? There's no way I'd hate you.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
トキコのことやもん。
きっと私のこと考えてくれとるからこそ、
言えやんでおるんやろ？
english: It's you, Tokiko. I'm sure you're keeping it a secret because you're thinking of me, right?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: Mio…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
それくらい言われんでもわかる。
親友やもん。
english: I know that much without being told. We're best friends, after all.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
せやな。
澪はそうやっていつも私の味方で
おってくれたもんな。
english: Yeah. You've always been on my side like that, Mio.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
だから私……
澪のこと大好きなんよ。
english: That's why I... really love you, Mio.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私もトキコのこと好きやよ。
english: I like you too, Tokiko.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 大好きとは言ってくれやんの？
english: You won't say you love me?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もォ、そんなところにこだわるん？
大好きに決まっちゃある。
english: Jeez, you're getting hung up on that? Of course I love you.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ふふ……。
ありがとう、澪。
english: Hehe... Thank you, Mio.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あははっ。
どういたしまして。
english: Ahaha. You're welcome.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: やっぱり、澪は澪やな……。
english: As expected, Mio is Mio...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 澪、もう少しそっち寄ってええ？
english: Mio, is it okay if I move a bit closer?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ええよォ。
もっとこっち寄ってきィ。
english: Sure. Come even closer.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
今日のトキコ、
何かいつもと違わん？
english: Tokiko, today you seem... a bit different from usual, don't you?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
そう？
そんなことあらへんよ。
english: Really? I don't think so.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: でも……。
english: But…

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
何かもう……あれこれ考えるん
嫌になってきた。
english: Somehow... I'm getting tired of thinking about this and that.

ああ！！
おっきなったなァ……。
english: Ah!! She's gotten so big...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
……さっきの話な。潮が命にかえて救ったんが、
あのしおりちゃんなんや……！！
english: ...About what we were just talking about. The one Ushio saved in exchange for her life was that Shiori-chan...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうやったんか……。
english: Is that so...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
かわいそうによ……。
事故のショックで声が出やんようになったんや。
english: Poor thing... She lost her voice from the shock of the accident.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そんな……。
english: That's...

speaker: 神社の宮司（雁切）
japanese: 慎平くん。
english: Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、<color=#GF_TIPS_002>雁切さん</color>……。
english: Ah, <color=#GF_TIPS_002>Karikiri-san</color>...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （島の祭祀を取り仕切る、<color=#GF_TIPS_053>日都神社</color>の宮司さんだ）
english: (He's the head priest of <color=#GF_TIPS_053>Hito Shrine</color>, who oversees the island's rituals.)

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
そろそろ出棺です。
慎平くん……手を貸してくれますか。
english: It is almost time for the coffin to depart. Shinpei-kun... could you lend a hand?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……はい。
english: …Yes.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
また夜に電話すら。
詳しい話はそん時に……。
english: I'll call you again tonight. We'll talk more then...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……。
english: Yeah...

japanese: 6.潮のいない食卓
english: 6. A Table Without Ushio

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
こんなもんか。
なあ澪、ちょっと味見してや。
english: Is this about right? Hey Mio, give this a taste.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
やった！
どれくらい食べてええ？
english: Yay! How much can I eat?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
味見や言うてるやろ。
ひと口や、ひと口！
english: I said it's a taste test. Just one bite, one bite!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
えー？
せっかくの慎ちゃんの料理やのに……！
english: Ehhh? Even though it's Shin-chan's cooking...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……慎ちゃん、どうしたん？
……汗すごいよ？
english: ...Shin-chan, what's wrong? ...You're sweating a lot, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そ、そうか……？
火を使っとるからかな。
ははは……。
english: I-Is that so...? Maybe it's because I'm using the stove. Hahaha...

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
すまん慎平、遅なってもた！
雁切さん話長いさけよォ……。
english: Sorry Shinpei, I'm late! Karikiri-san's stories are so long...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おかえりアラン。
もうすぐ出来るよ。
english: Welcome back, Alain. It'll be ready soon.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お父さん、おかえり！
english: Welcome back, Dad!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
おお、ただいま……って澪！
おまんも何か手伝わなあかんやろがっ。
english: Oh, I'm home... hey, Mio! You should be helping out with something too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私は食べるん専門でーす！！
english: I specialize in eating!!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
まったく……。
ん、ええニオイや。
潮の大好物やなァ……。
english: Good grief... Hm, smells good. It's Ushio's favorite...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: で、味はどうだった？
english: So, how was the taste?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん、美味しい！
いつもの慎ちゃんの味やった。
english: Yeah, it's delicious! It tastes just like Shin-chan's usual.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: じゃあ、皿に盛るから運んでや。
english: Then I'll plate it, so carry them over.

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Ah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうした？
english: What's wrong?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃんの分もあるんやね。
english: There's a portion for Onee-chan too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんも
慎ちゃんのカレー久しぶりやって
喜んでるやろね……。
english: Onee-chan must be happy too, since it's been a while since she had Shin-chan's curry...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうだといいけどな……。
english: I hope so...

japanese: 小舟　澪
english: Mio Kofune

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ……あれェ！？

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
どないしたん澪ちゃん！
自分の家ボーーッとながめて……。
誰かとケンカでもしたんか？
english: What's wrong, Mio-chan! Staring blankly at your own house... Did you get into a fight with someone or something?

japanese: 7.吉川線
english: 7. Yoshikawa Line

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ご飯を食べたらドッと疲れが出たな……）
english: (I suddenly felt exhausted after eating...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（すぐに寝たいけど……
　風呂には入らないと……）
english: (I want to go to sleep right away... But I have to take a bath first...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （電話……窓からか）
english: (A call... from Sou?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もしもし。
english: Hello?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
慎平か？
今、時間大丈夫か？
english: Shinpei? Do you have a minute right now?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、大丈夫や。
english: Yeah, it's fine.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 昼間、話が途中になっとった件なんやけど……。
english: About that conversation that got cut off during the day...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……潮の遺体が解剖されたって話か？
english: Ah... the rumor about Ushio's body being autopsied?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: あれはウワサに尾ヒレ付いとんねん。
english: That rumor was exaggerated.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
え？
そうなんか？
english: Eh? Is that so?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ……解剖らしてへん。
警察の検死に親父が立ち会うただけのこっちゃ。
english: Yeah... there was no autopsy. My dad just attended the police's coroner's inquest, that's all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんや、それやったら――
english: What, if that's the case—

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ただな。
english: However.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
その検死で、<color=#GF_TIPS_064>吉川線</color>が見つかったんや。
潮の首にな……。
english: During that inquest, they found <color=#GF_TIPS_064>Yoshikawa lines</color>. On Ushio's neck...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 吉川線……？
english: Yoshikawa lines...?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そうや……。
――誰かに首絞められた跡や……！！
english: That's right... —Marks of being strangled by someone...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Eh...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
つまり……潮が死んでもうたんは、
ただの事故やのうて――
english: In other words... Ushio's death wasn't just an accident—

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 他殺の可能性があるゆうこっちゃ！！
english: It means there's a possibility of murder!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
！！　……は？
た……他殺って……そんな……！！
english: !! ...Huh? M-Murder... that's...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮を殺すようなヤツがおるっちゅうんか！？
ていうか、おまえら一緒やったんやろ！？
ど……どういうこっちゃ！！
english: Are you saying there's someone who would kill Ushio!? I mean, you guys were together, right!? W-What is going on!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ……確かにオレらは一緒におった。
けどな、誰も……何も見てへんねん。
english: Yeah... we were definitely together. But, no one... saw anything.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あの日……オレらは観光客の来えへん
小学校裏のビーチで遊んどった。
english: That day... we were playing at the beach behind the elementary school where tourists don't go.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おったんはオレとトキコ。
潮と澪、しおりちゃんとその友達の二人で……。
全部で七人や。
english: The ones there were me and Tokiko. Ushio and Mio, Shiori-chan and two of her friends... Seven people in total.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
溺れて沖に流されたしおりちゃんに、
まず潮が気付いて、浮き輪持って助けに……。
english: Ushio was the first to notice Shiori-chan drowning and being swept out to sea, and went to help her with a swim ring...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
すぐにオレと澪も飛び込んだけど、
怪しいヤツはおらんかった……。
english: Mio and I jumped in right after, but there was no one suspicious around...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんじゃそらッ！！
意味わからんぞ……！！
english: What the hell is that!! It doesn't make any sense...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ……。
しおりちゃんに話聞こにもあの状態でな……。
english: Yeah... And we can't even ask Shiori-chan about it in her condition...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……吉川線の話、みんな知ってんのか？
english: ...Does everyone know about the Yoshikawa lines?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: まさか！！
english: Of course not!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
知ってんのは澪とアランさん、
あと駐在と……オレの親父だけや。
けど状況から、他殺はありえへんちゅう結論で。
english: The only ones who know are Mio, Alain-san, the local cop... and my dad. But based on the situation, they concluded that murder is impossible.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……警察は？
english: …What about the police?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 事故死ちゅうことで処理してる。
english: They're processing it as an accidental death.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、ちょっとええ？
english: Shin-chan, do you have a sec?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、ちょっと待ってくれ。
english: Ah, wait a second.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 澪か？
english: Mio?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……。
すまん、今日はそろそろ……。
english: Yeah... Sorry, I should get going for today...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
わかった、また連絡すら。
……今日は澪のそばに居ってやってくれ。
english: Got it, I'll contact you again. ...Stay by Mio's side today.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うん……わかった。
ありがとう。
english: Yeah... got it. Thanks.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
すまん。
開けてええよ。
english: Sorry. You can open it now.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん……。
english: Shin-chan…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どした？
english: What's wrong?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あのな……これ。
お姉ちゃんが最後につけてた<color=#GF_KEY_USI_NECKLACE>ネックレス</color>。
english: You see... this. The <color=#GF_KEY_USI_NECKLACE>necklace</color> Onee-chan was wearing at the end.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃんが持ってた方がええと思て……。
english: I thought it would be better if you had it, Shin-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮が、これを？
english: Ushio had this?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん。プールバッグに入ってた。
お姉ちゃんの遺品……。
english: Yeah. It was in her pool bag. Onee-chan's memento...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
いつも身に着けとったんよ。
外出る時も、家に居る時も
大事そうにしてて……。
english: She was always wearing it. Whether she went out or stayed at home, she treated it like it was precious...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あの日もちゃんと持ち歩いとって……
でも、最期は……最期、だけは……。
english: She even carried it with her that day... But, at the very end... only at the very end...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なァ、慎ちゃん……。
english: Hey, Shin-chan…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんに……！！
もうっ……二度とっ……！！
会えっ……やん……っ！！
english: I can't...!! Ever again...!! See Onee-chan...!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そんなん嫌や……嫌やァ……！！
english: I hate this... I hate it...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……うん。
english: …Yeah.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……許せやん……。
english: ...I can't forgive them...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃんを……殺したやつ……ッ！！
english: The one who... killed Onee-chan...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……お……おい、澪……。
おまえ……何か知ってんのか！！？
english: ...H-Hey, Mio... Do you... know something!!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
チィィーーーン！！
ずびびびびっ！！
english: *Bllloooow!!* *Sniiiiiiff!!*

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お……おぉおおおおおっ！？
おまえなァ！！
人の服で鼻かむなや！！
english: W-Whoa!? Hey you!! Don't blow your nose on someone else's clothes!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
えへへ……ごめん。
何でもないっ。
english: Ehehe... sorry. It's nothing.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
いつまでも湿っぽかったら
お姉ちゃんに怒られるわ。
泣くんは今日でおしまいにせな……！！
english: If I stay gloomy forever, Onee-chan will get mad at me. I have to make today the last day I cry...!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
じゃあね慎ちゃん！
あ、お風呂空いてるから、入ってええよ！
english: See ya, Shin-chan! Ah, the bath is open, so you can go in!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ……お、おう。
english: A... y-yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……潮が、このペンダントを――
english: ...Ushio had this pendant—

speaker: Ushio Kofune (幼少時)
japanese: きれい……。
english: Pretty...

speaker: Ushio Kofune (幼少時)
japanese:
ありがと慎平！
大事にするわ！！
english: Thanks, Shinpei! I'll treasure it!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレがあげた貝殻……。
　ありきたりで、大したことないもんやのに……）
english: (The seashell I gave her... Even though it's so common and nothing special...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あいつ……まだこんなん……。
english: She... still kept this...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……うっ、うぅっ……。
english: ...Ugh, uu...

japanese: 8.ランチタイム①
english: 8. Lunch Time ①

speaker: 常連客（中年男性）
japanese:
潮ちゃん亡うなってまだ二日やろォ。
しばらく休んでもええのによォ～～ッ。
english: It's only been two days since Ushio-chan passed away. You could rest for a while, you know~~.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
いえいえ……そういうわけにはいきません！
どんな時でも生きている以上腹は減りますから。
english: No, no... I can't do that! No matter the time, as long as we're alive, we get hungry.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
レストランちゅうのは、
いっつも変わらずそこにないとあきません……！！
english: A restaurant... must always be there, unchanging...!!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
大事なんは日常ですわ。
お客さんにとっても、私ら家族にとってもね…………。
english: What's important is the everyday routine. For the customers, and for us as a family...

speaker: 常連客（中年男性）
japanese:
ううっ……！！
確かに今日も美味いわ……！！
english: Ugh...!! It certainly is delicious today too...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（日常……。
　アランが守ろうとしているのは
　いつも通りの「日常」）
english: (Everyday routine... What Alain is trying to protect is the usual "everyday routine".)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも……明日の９時――
　あとほんの数十時間で、
　日都ヶ島の日常は真っ黒な影に飲み込まれる……）
english: (But... tomorrow at 9 AM— In just a few dozen hours, Hitogashima's everyday routine will be swallowed by pitch-black Shadows...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そんなことさせてたまるか……！！
　もう……二度と！！）
english: (Like I'd let that happen...!! Never... again!!)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
消えたって……。
小早川さんとこ一家全員がですかっ！？
english: Disappeared... The entire Kobayakawa family!?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: 小早川さん、昨日も私に声かけてくれたのに……。
english: Kobayakawa-san talked to me just yesterday...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
まァまだ詳しい事は言えませんけど、
もうすぐ本土から刑事が来ますわ！
english: Well, I can't say much in detail yet, but detectives from the mainland will be here soon!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影を駆除していけば、
　行方不明者はこれからどんどん増えるだろう）
english: (As they exterminate the Shadows, the number of missing people will probably keep increasing from here on.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （それだけ影が増えているということでもあるんだ）
english: (Which also means the Shadows are increasing by that much.)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
せや！
慎平くんに渡しとかなあかんモンあんねん！
english: Oh right! I have something I need to give to you, Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: まさかこれ、お姉ちゃんの携帯！？
english: Could this be... Onee-chan's phone!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
潮ちゃんなァ、
亡くなる前日にオレんとこ来てよォ。
預かっといてくれってソレ……置いてったんや。
english: Ushio-chan, you see... came to my place the day before she died. She left that... asking me to hold onto it for her.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 「もし私に何かあったら慎平くんに渡して欲しい」ってな。
english: "If something happens to me, I want you to give it to Shinpei-kun," she said.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そういえば、潮は何を考えてこれを……。
　まさか……この中に重要な情報が入ってるのか！？）
english: (Come to think of it, what was Ushio thinking when she... Could it be... there's important information inside!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、パスワードわかる？
english: Mio, do you know the password?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃんの誕生日ちゃうかな。
english: Probably Onee-chan's birthday?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや……開かない。
english: No... it won't open.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やはりというか……
　前回のループでは色々試したが解けなかった）
english: (As expected... I tried various things in the previous loop, but couldn't unlock it.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: パスワード変えたんかな……？
english: Maybe she changed the password...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うーん……。
english: Hmm…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （意図的に変更されている……）
english: (It was intentionally changed...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（４ケタの数字の組み合わせは
　１０の４乗で１万通りか……。
　とても今日明日では解けない……）
english: (A 4-digit number combination is 10 to the 4th power, so 10,000 possibilities... I definitely can't solve it today or tomorrow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まてよ……！
　あいつ……潮ならパスワード知ってるんじゃ……？）
english: (Wait...! That girl... Ushio might know the password...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よし……
　これは後であいつに見せてみるとして……）
english: (Alright... I'll try showing this to her later...)

japanese: 19.ランチタイム②
english: 19. Lunch Time ②

japanese: 7月23日
english: July 23

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あっ！
お帰り慎ちゃん！
english: Ah! Welcome back, Shin-chan!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
どうやった？
しおりちゃん……。
english:
How was it?
Shiori-chan…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Y... yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どう話したらいいものか……
　すでに影に入れ替わってましたと
　言うわけにも……）
english: (How should I talk about this... I can't exactly say that they've already been replaced by Shadows...)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
いやァ～～～ッ、
あっついあっつい！！
english: Man~~~, it's hot, so hot!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: いらっしゃいませー。
english: Welcome!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
