english: It's true!! But it disappeared right in front of my eyes... O-Onee-chan died three days later...!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ううっ……しおりちゃんたちが……心配……！！
english: Ugh... I'm worried... about Shiori-chan and her family...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（落ち着け落ち着け落ち着け……。
　フカンしろ……。影の病だって！？
　バカバカしい話じゃないか！）
english: (Calm down, calm down, calm down... Take a bird's-eye view... Shadow Sickness!? What a ridiculous story!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（けど……小早川家が失踪したのは事実……。
　潮の死に、わからない所があるのも事実だ……）
english: (But... it's a fact that the Kobayakawa family disappeared... It's also a fact that there are unknown aspects to Ushio's death...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だいたい、かわいい義妹の言うことを
　信じられないとか……
　おまえの血ィは何色や、網代慎平！！）
english: (Besides, not being able to believe what your cute little sister says... What color is your blood, Shinpei Ajiro!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……澪。
今の話……誰かにしゃべったか？
english: ...Mio. That story just now... did you tell anyone else?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……ううん。

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 影のこと、ヒルコ様に行って聞いてみよか。
english: Let's go to Hiruko-sama and ask about the Shadows.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ！？
english: Eh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっきのおっさん言うてたやろ。
お祓いのことよォ……せやから……。
english: That old man from earlier said it, right? About the exorcism... so...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん、ありがとう慎ちゃん。
english: Yeah, thank you, Shin-chan.

japanese: 10.澪が二人！？
english: 10. Mio, Two of Her!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（<color=#GF_TIPS_121>ヒルコ様</color>……。
　島の北部にある日都神社の愛称だ）
english: (<color=#GF_TIPS_121>Hiruko-sama</color>... The nickname for Hito Shrine in the northern part of the island.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そこの宮司の雁切さんなら、
　何かを知ってるかもしれない）
english: (If it's the head priest there, Karikiri-san, he might know something.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
返事ないな……留守か……？
拝殿の方回ってみるか。
english:
No response… He's not here…?
I'll check the main hall.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪？
どうした……？
森のほうに何かあるんか？
english:
Mio?
What's wrong…?
Is there something in the forest?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 待って！！
english: Wait!!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん！
い……今のん見た！？
english:
Shin-chan!
D-did you see that!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……いや……ハッキリとは……。
english: Not clearly, no.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 今の……しおりちゃんやったような気ィする……。
english: That... I feel like that was Shiori-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: What!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 追っかけよ！！
english: Let's chase her!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お……おいっ！
english: H-Hey!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おらんな……。
どこに行ったんや？
english: She's not here... Where did she go?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
まさか……もっと奥へ？
この先は砲台跡や……
入り組んでて危ないのに……。
english: Could she have gone deeper...? There's an old artillery site up ahead... It's like a maze, it's dangerous...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪、もっとフカンして考えよう……。
何かおかしくないか？
english: Mio, let's take a bird's-eye view... Isn't something wrong?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 出た……慎ちゃんのフカン！！
english: There it is... Shin-chan's bird's-eye view!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっきのがしおりちゃんやとして。
なんでオレらから逃げた？
english: Assuming that was Shiori-chan earlier... Why did she run from us?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: たしかに……なんでやろ……？
english: True... I wonder why...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんなん、今の音？
こんな昼間に花火？
english:
What was that sound?
Fireworks at this time of day?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （いや違う、今のは！）
english: (No, that wasn't fireworks!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 銃声！？
english: A gunshot!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Eh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 奥のほうや！
english: It came from further in!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん！？
待って……！
english:
Shin-chan!
Wait…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: たしかこっちのほうから――
english: I'm pretty sure it came from this way--

speaker: ??? (Hizuru Minakata)
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……ハァ……。
english: *Pant*... *pant*... *pant*...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ウソだろ……
　まさかさっきの銃声……！？）
english: (No way... Was that the gunshot from earlier...?!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （この人たしか……船で一緒だった――）
english: (This person... she was on the ferry with us--)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、何ボーッとしてんの！！！！
この人、血ィが！！
english: Shin-chan, what are you spacing out for!!!! This person is bleeding!!

speaker: ??? (Hizuru Minakata)
japanese: ふっ……しくじっ……たよ……。
english: Heh... I messed... up...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私、人呼んで来る！！
english: I'll go get someone!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 待て澪！　一人で行くなっ！
english: Wait, Mio! Don't go alone!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うわっ！！
english: Whoa!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
な……何があったんですか？
だ、大丈夫なんですか……？
english:
W-what happened?
A-are you okay…?

speaker: ??? (Hizuru Minakata)
english: Listen closely... to me...

speaker: ??? (Hizuru Minakata)
japanese: あ……あいつは…………こ――
english: Th... that guy is... he--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そ……そん、な……。
　なん、だよ……これ……？）
english: (N... no way... What... is this...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あ……頭、撃たれて――）
english: (M... my head, I've been shot--)

speaker: 聞き慣れた声（ミオ）
japanese: お父さん、よう言うてたわなァ……。
english: Dad always used to say...

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: …Shin-chan…

speaker: Mio Kofune (Mio)
japanese:
お皿洗て、後片付け終わるまでが……
料理やァ……って。
english: That the cooking isn't done... until you wash the dishes and clean up...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（み……澪が……
　澪に、撃たれ……？）
english: (M... Mio... I was shot by... Mio...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ど、どうなってるんだ……
　いったい……！）
english: (Wh-what is going on... What the hell...!)

japanese: 11.水難事故の記憶
english: 11. Memory of a Water Disaster

japanese: 7月21日
english: July 21st

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (…Where am I…?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ここはたしか……
　小中学校裏のプライベートビーチ……？）
english: (This place is... the private beach behind the elementary and middle school...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……どうしてオレは
　こんなところにいるんだ……？）
english: (...Why am I in a place like this...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あれは……澪？）
english: (That's… Mio?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……お姉ちゃん……？
english: ...Onee-chan...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （えっ？）
english: (Huh?)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
トキコは学校行ってＡＥＤ持って来てくれ！！
職員室の前にあるはずや！
走れっ！！
english:
Tokiko, go to school and get the AED!! 
It should be in the staff room! 
Run!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: うっ……うん！！
english: Y... yeah!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: しっかりせえ、潮っ！！
english: Hang in there, Ushio!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（窓……？
　みんな……何やってんだ……？）
english: (Sou...? Everyone... what are you doing...?)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
死ぬなっ……。潮っ！！
目ェ覚ませ！！
english:
Don't die… Ushio!!
Wake up!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Ushio…!?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃ……。
english: Onee-cha...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これって……葬式で窓が言ってた……。
　じゃあ、潮は――）
english: (This is... what Sou was talking about at the funeral... Then, Ushio is--)

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_01>１度目のＥＮＤ</color>】を入手しました。
english: KEY TIPS [<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_01>First END</color>] obtained.

japanese: 3周目
english: 3rd Loop

japanese: 12.かおりとの再会
english: 12. Reunion with Kaori

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はァッ！！！！
english: *Gasp*!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハァッ……ハァッ……ハァ……ハァ。
う……。
english: *Pant*... *pant*... *pant*... *pant*. Ugh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （また……戻った）
english: (I've... returned again)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くん！
大丈夫！？
english: Ajiro-kun! Are you okay!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん……？
english: Koyuba-san...?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ご、ごめんね！
小舟さんのことで網代くんそれどころじゃないのに、
無理言っちゃって。
english: I-I'm sorry! I know you're dealing with Kofune-san's passing, and I'm just bothering you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さんと港……あの時声をかけられて、
　たしか、連絡先を交換して……）
english: (Koyuba-san and the harbor... She called out to me back then, and I think we exchanged contact info...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ええっと……ごめん。
正直、まだ気持ちが追いついてなくて。
english: Um... sorry. Honestly, my feelings haven't caught up yet.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
大丈夫！
全然、気にしないで。
english: It's okay! Please don't worry about it at all.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私、もうちょっと島にいる予定だから。
またどこかで話せたら嬉しいな。
english:
I'm planning to stay on the island a bit longer.
I'd be happy if we could talk again somewhere.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
それじゃあ……そろそろ行かなきゃ。
またね、網代くん！
english: Well then... I should be going soon. See you, Ajiro-kun!

speaker: Ship Announcement (Captain)
japanese: ―ご乗船、ありがとうございました。
english: Thank you for boarding.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ま……待て待て……。
　落ち着けって…………）
english: (W... wait, wait... Calm down...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ついさっき、「夢に決まってる」って
　断言したばかりじゃないか）
english: (Didn't I just confidently declare that "it has to be a dream" a moment ago?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なのに……なんだこの……
　つい昨日、同じことがあった感じは――）
english: (So then... what is this... This feeling that the exact same thing happened just yesterday--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（落ち着け落ち着け……こんな時はこれだろ。
　自分をフカンで見て落ち着け……）
english: (Calm down, calm down... This is what I do at times like this. Take a bird's-eye view and calm down...)

speaker: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
speaker_ja: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
japanese: ……あの。

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: は、はい！？
english: Y-yes?!

speaker: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
speaker_ja: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
japanese:
……ご、ごめんなさい。
驚かせてしまって。
english: ...I-I'm sorry. I didn't mean to startle you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（さっき、隣にいた人だ。
　何の用だろう？）
english: (She was sitting next to me earlier. What does she want?)

speaker: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
speaker_ja: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
japanese:
あの……勘違いだったらすみません。
もしかして、網代くん――じゃないですか？
english: Um... I'm sorry if I'm mistaken. But are you... Ajiro-kun?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
え……？
そ、そうですけど。
english: Eh...? Y-yes, I am.

speaker: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
speaker_ja: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
japanese:
やっぱり！
合っててよかったァ。
english: I knew it! I'm so glad I was right.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうしてオレの名前を？
english: How do you know my name?

speaker: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
speaker_ja: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
japanese:
……網代くん。
私が誰だか、わかってない……よね？
english: ...Ajiro-kun. You don't know who I am... do you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
っ！！
す、すみません……。
english: !! I-I'm sorry...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Ummmm?

speaker: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
speaker_ja: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
japanese:
……仕方ないか。
７年振りだし、
そんなに話をしたこともなかったもんね。
english: ...I guess it can't be helped. It's been seven years, and we didn't talk that much back then anyway.

speaker: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
speaker_ja: さっきの少女（小弓場かおり）
japanese:
覚えてないかな、網代くん？
昔、同じ<color=#GF_TIPS_123>小学校</color>に通ってた……。
english: Do you remember, Ajiro-kun? We used to go to the same <color=#GF_TIPS_123>elementary school</color>...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 同じ小学校……？
english: The same elementary school…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああっ！
もしかして、小弓場さん！？
english: Ah! Are you... Koyuba-san!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（思い出した！
　<color=#GF_TIPS_009>小弓場かおり</color>さん……小学校の時の同級生だ！）
english: (I remember! <color=#GF_TIPS_009>Kaori Koyuba</color>-san... a classmate from elementary school!)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そう！
よかったァ、覚えててくれて。
english: Yes! I'm so glad you remembered.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私、途中で転校しちゃったから、
もう忘れられてるかと思ってた。
english:
I transferred schools in the middle, so
I thought you'd have forgotten me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ごめん、すぐに思い出せなくて！
小弓場さんって、たしか図書当番の……。
english: Sorry I couldn't remember right away! Koyuba-san, you were on library duty...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そう、その小弓場だよ！
ほんと、久しぶりだね……網代くん！
english: Yes, that Koyuba! It's really been a long time... Ajiro-kun!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私がこの島を出てから、
もう７年も経っちゃったんだね。
english: It's already been seven years since I left this island.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あァ。思えばあれから、
全然連絡取ってなかったな……。
english: Yeah. Come to think of it, we haven't kept in touch at all since then...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……にしても、驚いた。
あの頃からずいぶん変わったね。
english: ...Still, I'm surprised. You've really changed since back then.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: え、そう？
english: Eh, really?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
昔の小弓場さんって、
もっと大人しい子って印象やったからさ。
english: Back then, my impression of you was that you were a much quieter girl, Koyuba-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
言い訳かもしないけど、
さっき気づけなかったのは、
それが理由で……。
english: It might sound like an excuse, but that's the reason why I didn't recognize you earlier...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんだか明るくなったというか……。
english: It's like you've become more cheerful...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
本当！？
そう言ってくれると嬉しいな……ふふ。
english: Really!? I'm happy to hear you say that... hehe.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そうだ。
スーツケースを持ってるということは
旅行か何かの帰り？
english: Oh, right. Since you have a suitcase, are you on your way back from a trip or something?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや、今は東京で暮らしてるんだ。
english: No, I'm living in Tokyo now.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そうなんだ？
私と同じだね……！
english: Oh, really? Same as me...!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
今日は帰省なの？
それとも、なにか別の用事で？
english: Are you visiting home today? Or are you here for something else?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ……ええと……。
english: Ah… um…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 実は……。
english: Actually…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
…………そっか。
小舟さん、亡くなったんだ……。
english: ...I see. Kofune-san passed away...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ、あの、無神経な質問しちゃって、ごめんなさい。
english: U-Um, I'm sorry for asking such an insensitive question.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 別に気にしてないよ。
english: Don't worry about it.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 私ね……小学校の頃は、小舟さんに憧れてたの。
english: You know... back in elementary school, I used to look up to Kofune-san.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私とまったく違うタイプで……
底抜けに明るくて、心も強くて。
english: She was a completely different type from me... Endlessly cheerful, and strong-willed too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あんな風になれたらいいなァ……なんて、
密かに思ってた。
english: I secretly used to think... how nice it would be to be like her.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
残念だね。
本当に、残念……。
english: It's a shame. It really is...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 私も時間を見つけて、挨拶に行くね。
english: I'll find some time to go pay my respects too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……うん、ありがとな。
english: …Yeah, thanks.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ……そうだ。
english: Ah… right.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あの……もしよかったらなんだけど、
連絡先の交換……ダメかな？
english: Um... if it's alright with you, could we... exchange contact info?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、構わないよ。
english: Sure, that's fine.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代慎平くん……と。
うん、登録完了。
english: Shinpei Ajiro-kun... there. Yep, registered.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: こっちもできた。
english: Got it on my end too.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あの、も、も、もし良かったら、
後で連絡取り合って……あ……。
english: Um, i-i-if you'd like, we could get in touch later... ah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうかした？
english: Something wrong?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 連絡……なんだけど。
english: About... keeping in touch.

japanese: 「気持ちの整理がついてからで……」
english: "Once I've sorted my feelings…"

japanese: 「普通にしてくれて構わないけど」
english: "It's fine if you treat me normally."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ……ごめん。
それは少し待ってもらえるかな？
english: Ah... sorry. Could you wait a little bit for that?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
正直、まだ気持ちが整理しきれてなくてさ。
葬儀が終わってからでもいい？
english: Honestly, I still haven't fully sorted out my feelings. Is it okay if we do it after the funeral?

english: (But with this, Totsumura-san won't pass by Kofune and should be safe from getting killed.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……怒られることは覚悟しないとな。
english: ...I'll have to be prepared to get yelled at.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なにもないならそれが一番。
　オレが怒られる程度で済むなら安いもんだ）
english: (If nothing happens, that's for the best. If all it takes is me getting yelled at, it's a small price to pay.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（窓には明日、
　こっちから連絡すると伝えておいた）
english: (I told Sou that I'd contact him tomorrow.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あとは……。
english: Now then...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（スマホだ。
　要らないアプリや写真なんかを消して……）
english: (My smartphone. I'll delete unnecessary apps and photos...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これでスマホのストレージは残り約７ＧＢ……。
　録画時間は充分足りるはずだ）
english: (Now my phone has about 7GB of storage left... That should be plenty of recording time.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（万が一着信がないように機内モード。
　フル充電。モバイルバッテリーにもつないでおく）
english: (Airplane mode, just in case a call comes in. Fully charged. And I'll connect it to a power bank too.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （幸い、あいつが来る時間はわかってる）
english: (Luckily, I know what time she's coming.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（見つからないように、
　スマホを植木に隠して……録画開始）
english: (I'll hide my phone in the potted plants so she won't see it... and start recording.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪の影を撮影して、証拠をおさえてやる…！！）
english: (I'll film Mio's Shadow and get proof...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ふう……。
english: Phew…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まだあいつは来ないと知っていても、
　めっちゃ緊張したな……）
english: (Even knowing she won't be here for a while, that made me super nervous...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（おかけで変な汗かいてしまった。
　風呂は澪が入ってるはずやし、
　顔だけでも先に洗って落ち着くか）
english: (Now I'm sweating like crazy. Mio should be in the bath, so I'll just wash my face to calm down.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あとは……どんなに気分が悪くても
　外の空気を吸いに行ったり絶対にしない。
　そしたら大丈夫だ…………）
english: (After that... no matter how bad I feel, I absolutely won't go outside for fresh air. Then I'll be fine...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（最初の２２日に
　オレは殺されてないんだから……！！）
english: (Because on the first 22nd, I wasn't killed...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: <color=#GF_TIPS_113>右目の色</color>が違う……いつからや……？
english: My <color=#GF_TIPS_113>right eye's color</color> is different... since when...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: !! My head... h-hurts...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Mio?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……返事がない。
　シャワーの音は聞こえてくるが……）
english:
(…No response.
I can hear the shower running…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪！
いるよな……？
english:
Mio!
Are you there…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……まさか、影に……）
english: (…Could it be… the Shadow…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪っ！！？
english: Mio!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あっ……。
english: Ah…

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: ...Ha... ...Haaaaah!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐっ！！
english: Guh!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: アホアホアホアホアホ！！
english: Idiot! Idiot! Idiot! Idiot! Idiot!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ゴ……ゴメン……。
english: I-I'm sorry...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（フカン！
　フカン！！
　フカン！！！）
english: (Bird's-eye view! Bird's-eye view!! Bird's-eye view!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪は無事！！
　……うん！）
english:
(Mio is safe!!
…Yeah!)

japanese: 16.証拠動画
english: 16. Evidence Video

japanese: 7月23日
english: July 23

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （さて、昨日のスマホは……）
english: (Now, about my phone from yesterday...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
くっそ……。
バッチリ<color=#GF_KEY_MI2_DOUGA>写っとる</color>やんけ……！
english: Damn it... It's perfectly <color=#GF_KEY_MI2_DOUGA>recorded</color>...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（撮れてしまった以上、
　このまま見過ごすわけにはいかない）
english: (Since I managed to record it, I can't just ignore it.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （まずは何より、澪に危険を知らせないと……）
english: (First and foremost, I need to warn Mio about the danger…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪、ちょっといいか？
english: Mio, can I talk to you for a second?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ええけど、どうしたん？
english: Yeah, what's up?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ちょっと見て欲しい動画があってな。
english: There's a video I want you to see.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
え？　なに、なに？
なんの動画？
english: Huh? What? What kind of video?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 昨夜、撮ったヤツなんやけど……。
english: It's one I took last night…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そうなん？
なにが映ってるんやろ。
english:
Oh really?
What's in it?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: え……なにこれ……。
english: Eh... what is this...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そいつは昨日の夜、
９時前にウチの前に現れた。
english: She appeared in front of our house last night, just before 9 PM.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そのあと５分間２階を見上げて、
歩いて山の方へ消えた……。
english: After that, she stared up at the second floor for five minutes, then walked off and disappeared toward the mountains...

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Who... is this...!? M... me!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
違う。
この時間おまえは風呂に入ってたからな。
english:
No.
You were taking a bath at that time.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……うん。
english: …Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影……っていうんやろ、
そういうの。
english: They call that kind of thing... a Shadow, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なァ……
影の病って知ってるな？
english: Hey... You know about the Shadow Sickness, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪……そいつは殺しに来たんや。
おまえをな……。
english: Mio... that thing came to kill. To kill you...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
わ……私が……。
私を……殺しに……。
english: M... me... Came to kill... me...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ここ……拡大してみ。
手のとこ……。
english: Try zooming in... here. At her hand...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ウソ……やろ……。
包丁持って……。
english: No... way... She's holding a kitchen knife...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
影の病……。
迷信……ちゃうんやな……。
やっぱりや……！！
english: The Shadow Sickness... It isn't... a superstition... I knew it...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮も……見たんだろ？
亡くなる三日前に影を……！
english: Ushio... saw one too, right? Three days before she died... a Shadow!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そっか、慎ちゃん……。
影のこと、お姉ちゃんから聞いてたんやね……？
english: I see, Shin-chan... You heard about the Shadows from my sister, didn't you...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （本当はおまえから聞いたんだけど……）
english: (Actually, I heard it from you…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……で、オレも見てしもたんや。
おまえの影を、昨日……うん……。
english: ...And, I ended up seeing it too. Your Shadow, yesterday... yeah...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ねえ……慎ちゃん。
english: Hey... Shin-chan.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんは……殺されたんかも知れへん。
影に……！！
english: My sister... might have been killed. By a Shadow...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
正直……バカげてると思うよ。
でも実際、見てしもたらな……。
english: Honestly... I think it sounds ridiculous. But once you actually see it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレな。
影が人を……コピーする所を見たんや。
english: I actually... saw a Shadow... copy a person.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
えっ！？
コピー……？
english: Eh!? Copy...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あァ。
あれは、写し取ってた……。
english: Yeah. It was copying them...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: カメラみたいに、フラッシュが……。
english: Just like a camera, with a flash...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……？
　フラッシュが……光って……？）
english: (...? A flash... went off...?)

speaker: 参列者Ｄ
japanese:
おいっ！！　誰な今のっ。
アカンで写真ら！！
english: Hey!! Who was that just now. You can't take photos here!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……フラッシュ……？
　なんでこんな場所で――）
english: (...A flash...? Why in a place like this--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうや！！
葬儀の最中にも光ったよな！
english:
That's right!!
It flashed during the funeral too!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの時、誰もカメラなんか持ってなかった。
ってことは……！
english: No one had a camera back then. Which means...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（くそっ……。
　あれは、葬儀場に入り込んだ影が
　誰かをコピーした光だったんだな……！）
english: (Damn it... That flash of light was a Shadow that sneaked into the funeral copying someone...!)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
待ってや、慎ちゃん。
葬儀中に光ったって、なんのことなん？
english: Wait, Shin-chan. What do you mean it flashed during the funeral?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……あれ？
覚えてへんのか？
english: ...Huh? You don't remember?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ほら……潮の棺に花入れた後！
ピカッて……！
ちょっと騒ぎになったやろ？
english: You know... after we put the flowers in Ushio's coffin! There was a flash...! It caused a bit of a commotion, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: し、知らんか！？
english: Y-you don't know!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: う、うん……。
english: U-uh… yeah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （いやっ……まてよ！？）
english: (No… wait!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あの騒ぎがあったのは２回。
　最初と前回の葬儀の最中だ……）
english: (That commotion happened twice. During the first funeral, and the one last loop...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（けど今回は……なかった！
　フラッシュは光っていない！）
english: (But this time... it didn't happen! There was no flash!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（つまり葬儀場にいた影は、
　今回コピーをしなかったってことだ！）
english: (That means the Shadow at the funeral didn't copy anyone this time!)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……ねえ、慎ちゃん。
english: ...Hey, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なぜ！？
　影は今まで２回とも誰かをコピーして……
　でも今回はやらなかった）
english: (Why!? The Shadow copied someone both times before... But this time it didn't do it.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん！
english: Shin-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレが何かこれまでと違うことをしたのか！？）
english: (Did I do something different from before!?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃんっ！！
english: Shin-chan!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
考え込むんは後にして、
影の話、しおりちゃんに教えてあげやな！
english: Save the thinking for later. We have to tell Shiori-chan about the Shadows!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
影が本人を殺しに来るんは迷信ちゃうって、
しおりちゃんも危ないって！！
english: That the Shadow coming to kill the real person isn't a superstition, and that Shiori-chan is in danger too!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうだ……小早川しおりちゃんも、
　自分の影を見たという話だった）
english: (That's right... Kobayakawa Shiori-chan also said she saw her own Shadow.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しおりちゃんも狙われているのかもしれない。
　確かに危険だ）
english: (Shiori-chan might be targeted too. It's definitely dangerous.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だからこそ、澪をその危険に
　近付けるわけにいかない……！！）
english: (That's exactly why I can't let Mio get anywhere near that danger...!!)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
今から行こ！
しおりちゃん家！
english: Let's go right now! To Shiori-chan's house!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……けど、行くんはオレ一人や！
english: …but I'll go alone.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ？　なんでなん！？
english: Huh? Why!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪は待っとってくれ。
……頼むわ。
english: Mio, stay here and wait. ...Please.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……澪を強引に説得して
　オレは一人でコバマートへ向かった）
english: (...I forcefully persuaded Mio to stay, and headed to Koba Mart by myself.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪の気持ちは痛いほどわかる。
　潮のこともあるから、
　いても立ってもいられんのやろうな）
english: (I understand how Mio feels painfully well. With what happened to Ushio, she probably can't just sit still.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（けど、影は危険や。
　影に狙われてる澪は連れていけない）
english: (But the Shadows are dangerous. I can't take Mio, who is being targeted by one, with me.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もちろん、オレが澪の側を離れることにも
　不安はあるけど……）
english: (Of course, I'm also anxious about leaving Mio's side...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（人に化けてコソコソするあたり、
　あいつらが人目につく所で襲って来る
　可能性は低いはず）
english: (Considering they sneak around disguised as people, the chances of them attacking somewhere with a lot of eyes around should be low.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いろんな客がやって来るコフネにいる方が、
　オレと一緒に行動するより、
　よっぽど安全だろう）
english: (It's much safer for her to stay at Kofune, where lots of customers come and go, than to act together with me.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……しおりちゃん、
無事でいてくれるとええんやけど。
english: ...I just hope Shiori-chan is safe.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ええか？
しおりちゃん。
いっつもパパとママと一緒におるんやで。
english: Listen, okay? Shiori-chan. Make sure you stay with your mom and dad at all times.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
自分そっくりの女の子がおっても、
絶対近づいたらあかん……。
english: Even if there's a girl who looks exactly like you, you absolutely must not get close to her...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（葬儀会場で、しおりちゃんには
　すでに危険を伝えてあるが……）
english: (I already warned Shiori-chan about the danger at the funeral home, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （どうか……無事でいてくれ……）
english: (Please... be safe...)

japanese: 17.感染していた、最初から……
english: 17. Infected from the Beginning…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（前々回――
　つまりオレがループを体験する前の７月２３日に
　凸村さんから聞いた）
english: (The loop before last-- meaning on July 23rd, before I experienced the loops, I heard from Totsumura-san.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（８時になってもコバマートは開いておらず
　小早川家は一家全員が姿を消してしまった、と）
english: (That Koba Mart still wasn't open at 8 AM, and the entire Kobayakawa family had vanished.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……やはり店は閉まっている。
　ダメだ……何も変わってない……）
english: (...The store is closed, as expected. Damn it... nothing has changed...)

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
あで！！
慎平くんやんかァ！
english: Oh my!! If it isn't Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: <color=#GF_TIPS_010>汐見</color>さん……おはようございます。
english: <color=#GF_TIPS_010>Shiomi</color>-san... good morning.

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
ほんまにこの度は……。
潮ちゃんのこと、残念やったなァ……。
english: My deepest condolences... It's such a shame about Ushio-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はい……。
english: Yes…

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
……無理せんでよ。
落ち着くまで、ゆっくりしとったらええ。
english: ...Don't push yourself. Just take it easy until things settle down.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ありがとうございます……。
english: Thank you...

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese: ところで慎平くん、朝からお買い物？
english: By the way, Shinpei-kun, you're out shopping this early?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ……はい。
english: Ah… yes.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そういえば、
　小早川家の失踪に気づいたのは
　汐見さんだって言ってたな……）
english: (Come to think of it, Totsumura-san said it was Shiomi-san who noticed the Kobayakawa family's disappearance...)

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
この島コンビニないさけなァ。
東京に慣れたら不便やろォ！？
english: This island doesn't have any convenience stores. Must be inconvenient after getting used to Tokyo, huh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いえ……ここの品揃え好きですよ。
抹茶ソフトも置いてるし……。
english:
No… I actually like the selection here.
They even have matcha soft-serve…

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
ははっ！
故郷の味かえ！
english: Haha! A taste of home, eh!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: でも、今日はお休みみたいですね……。
english: But it looks like they're closed today...

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
いやっ、閉まっちゃあらいしょ！
おかしなよォ～～ッ。
休むら聞いてへんけどなァ……。
english: No, they shouldn't be closed! That's strange~. I haven't heard anything about them taking a day off...

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
何かあったんかねぇ。
ちょっと見に行ってみよかな。
english: I wonder if something happened. Maybe I'll go take a look.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、じゃあ、オレも行きます。
心配だし。
english: Ah, then I'll come too. I'm worried about them.

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
あかな。
留守かいな？
english: It won't open. Are they not home?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あっ。
english: Ah.

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
なんや開いてるやん！
コバちゃん、いてへんのォ～！？
english: What, it is open! Koba-chan, are you here~!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: し、汐見さん？
english: Sh-Shiomi-san?

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese: コバちゃん、中入るでェ！
english: Koba-chan, I'm coming in!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いいんですか？
勝手に上がって……！？
english: Is that okay? Just letting ourselves in...!?

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
かまへな！
コバちゃーん？
english: It's fine! Koba-chan~?

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese: コバちゃーん？
english: Koba-chan~?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（テレビはついたまま、食事もそのまま……
　はっきり言って不自然すぎる……）
english: (The TV is left on, and the food is untouched... To be blunt, it's way too unnatural...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん……これは……。
english: Hmm… this is…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（床に人型のシミ……
　凸村さんが影に消された時のような……）
english: (A human-shaped stain on the floor... Just like when Totsumura-san was erased by the Shadow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （影だ……これは影のしわざだ！！）

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くそっ、間に合わんかった……！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（最悪の想像はしてただろ？

english: (I imagined the worst-case scenario, didn't I? There had to be other ways to handle this. There should have been a way to save them...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……馬鹿野郎！
　相手は化物だぞ！？
　もう殺されるのはゴメンだ！！）
english: (...You idiot! We're dealing with monsters here!? I don't want to get killed again!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレにできるのは警告と……）
english: (All I can do is warn them, and...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（起きた事態を
　注意深く観察することしかない……）
english: (carefully observe the situation that has unfolded...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……で？
　その観察で何か分かることは？）
english: (...And? What can I learn from observing this?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（料理は手つかずで冷め切っている……
　ビールがあることから見ても
　おそらく襲われたのは昨日……夕食の時間……）

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （他には……）
english: (What else...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（床に陥没したような跡が……？

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（すごい力で、殴った様な跡がいくつもある……。

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……黒いシミは２つ。

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （おそらく、しおりちゃんの両親だろう）

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （じゃあ……しおりちゃんはどこへ！？）

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
汐見さん！

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
はァ～～い。
頼むわァ！！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（暗いな……。

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 電気は……そこか――
english: The light switch is... over there--

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa (Shiori)
japanese: ねえ。
english: Hey.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (...Th... this voice is...)

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa (Shiori)
japanese:
なんで昨日……。
あんなこと言うたんですか。
english: Why did you... say that yesterday?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（１、２回目の葬儀ではやらなくて
　３回目で初めてやったこと――）
english: (Something I didn't do at the first or second funeral, but did for the first time at the third--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （それは、しおりちゃんに影の話を……）

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa (Shiori)
japanese:
あたしの事、じぃっと見て……
何か顔に付いてましたか。
english: You were staring right at me... Was there something on my face?

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa (Shiori)
japanese: それともあたしの体、どっか変？
english: Or is there something weird about my body?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (...It's... confirmed...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
こ……声、出てるな……。
治ったん……か？

japanese:

speaker: Shiori
japanese: 答えやんでも、あとで聞くし……。
english: Even if you don't answer, I'll ask you later...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:

english: (That Shadow-- It's the same as when one took over Totsumura-san...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:

　オレそっくりの影が……？）
english: (Just like Totsumura-san, there's a Shadow that looks exactly like me...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:

english: (I've been infected by the Shadow Sickness... No... I was already infected!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro

english: (Ever since the first funeral, <color=#GF_KEY_SNP_KANSEN>over and over</color>...!)

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese: 慎平く～ん？
english: Shinpei-ku~n?

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:
どうない！？
上に誰かおったか？
english: What's wrong!? Was someone up there?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (She disappeared...!?)

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese: どないしたん？
english: What happened?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ……いえ、その……。
english: Ah... no, um...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:

english: (The door behind where the Shadow was is open... Is she... in there...?)

speaker: Shizuka Shiomi
japanese:

Did you get a stomachache?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:

english: (No one's here... The window is open, but... Could she have squeezed out through a gap like that?)

japanese:

japanese: ……次は、ホンマに澪ちゃんが狙われてんのか？
english: ...And next, Mio-chan is really being targeted?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うん……。
オレは、この目で……。
english:
Yeah…
I saw it with my own eyes…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんだ、言えよ。
　オレの目の前で澪が殺されたって）
english: (Come on, just say it. Say that Mio was killed right in front of my eyes.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （いや、言えない――）
english: (No, I can't--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……それを言ったら、
　オレが同じ日をくり返してることを
　言わなくちゃならない……！！）
english: (...If I say that, I'll have to tell them that I'm repeating the same days...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いきなりそれは
　話がブッ飛びすぎてないか？）
english: (Isn't that way too crazy of a story to just suddenly drop on them?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しかし……
　嘘や隠し事からは必ず綻びが生まれる）
english: (But... Lies and secrets always lead to things falling apart.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうなったら全てを信じて貰えなくなるかも
　しれない）
english: (If that happens, they might not believe anything I say anymore.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうなるくらいなら、
　いっそここで打ち明けてしまった方が……）
english: (Rather than letting that happen, maybe it'd be better to just confess everything here...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……慎ちゃん？
english: …Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……でも、どう伝えればいいんだ？
　『オレ自身も実は２回殺されたんです』って！？）
english: (...But how should I tell them? "I was actually killed twice myself" !?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ふざけてると思われたら
　肝心の影の話まで信じてもらえなくなるぞ……）
english: (If they think I'm messing around, they won't even believe the crucial part about the Shadows...)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 慎平！
english: Shinpei!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
えっ……？
あ、ああ、すまん。
ちょっと考え込んでしもてた。
english: Huh...? Ah, yeah, sorry. I got lost in thought for a bit.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
影と本物の人間は――
パッと見、区別つくんか？
english: Shadows and real humans-- Can you tell them apart at a glance?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……いや。
見た目では区別つかなかった。
少なくともオレには……。
english: ...No. I couldn't tell the difference just by looking. At least, I couldn't...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そうか、そら厄介やなァ……。
english: I see, that's gonna be a problem...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
つまり、こんな話してるおまえが、
影かも知れやんちゅうこっちゃな。
english: Meaning, even you, the one telling us this, might be a Shadow.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……そうやな。
それはお互いにな……。
english: ...That's right. But the same goes for you...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんなんこれ……。
影って……なんなん……？
english:
What is this…?
What even is a Shadow?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 落ち着け、澪ちゃん。
english: Calm down, Mio-chan.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 要するにや、影っちゅうのは……。
english: Basically, these Shadows...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
この日都ヶ島に古くから棲んどる生物
……って、考えてみたらええ。
english: Think of them as creatures... that have lived on Hitogashima since ancient times.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 生物……。
english: Creatures...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
人に擬態する生物……。
コピーした本物を影みたいな『シミ』に
変えてしまう生物……ってこと？
english: Creatures that mimic people... Creatures that turn the original person they copied into a "stain" like a shadow... is that it?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
せやな……カメラに写るんやから
ハッキリそこに存在しとる生物や、
お化けや幽霊と違てな……！！
english: Yeah... Since they show up on camera, they're living creatures that physically exist there, unlike ghosts or spirits...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
生物やったら対処法はあるはずや。
そうやろ、慎平！！
english: If they're living creatures, there has to be a way to deal with them. Right, Shinpei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……確かに！
english: Yeah… That's true!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（さすが窓や。
　こういう冷静な分析ができるんは、
　医者志望なだけあるな）
english: (As expected of Sou. Being able to calmly analyze things like this shows he really is cut out to be a doctor.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やっぱり、打ち明けて正解やった。
　頼りになるわ……）
english: (It really was the right choice to tell him. He's so reliable...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ねえ慎ちゃん！
今からヒルコ様に行かん！？
english: Hey, Shin-chan! Why don't we go to Hiruko Cave right now!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
雁切さんやったら島の歴史に詳しいはずやし、
影についても何か知ってるかもわからん……！！
english: Karikiri-san should be familiar with the island's history, so he might know something about the Shadows too...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうだ……。
　そもそもオレと澪はヒルコ様に行こうとしてた……）
english: (That's right... Mio and I were originally planning to go to Hiruko Cave...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（けどダメだ……！
　少なくとも今からは！！）
english: (But I can't...! At least, not right now!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（神社の近くにはあいつがいる。
　近づくのは危険すぎる！！）
english: (That Shadow is near the shrine. It's too dangerous to get close!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ええと……
行くんやったら、あ、明日でもええか？
english: Um... If we're going to go, c-can we do it tomorrow?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
明日ァ？
明日はおまえ……
<color=#GF_TIPS_106>日都夏祭り</color>やで！？
english: Tomorrow? Tomorrow is the... <color=#GF_TIPS_106>Hitogashima Summer Festival</color>, you know!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english:
!!?
Oh… the festival…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
こいつ……忘れてる思たわ！
明日は１年で一番神社の忙しい日ィや……。
english: I knew it... you totally forgot! Tomorrow is the busiest day of the year for the shrine...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
宮司の雁切さんも、
オレらの相手してるヒマないんちゃうか？
english: Even Karikiri-san, the chief priest, probably won't have time to deal with us, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや……！
それやったらなおさら、都合がええかもしれん。
english: No...! If that's the case, it might actually be more convenient.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影はおそらく、賑やかな場所を嫌ってる。
祭りで人出が多なるほど、
襲われる可能性は少なくなるはずや。
english: The Shadows probably hate lively places. The more crowded the festival is, the lower the chances of us being attacked.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ、そうかもしれやんな。
人に化けてコソコソ行動しとるし……。
english: Yeah, that might be true. Since they sneak around disguised as people...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: よし、その予定で行こか。
english: Okay, let's go with that plan.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ほなまた明日、
５時にトキコとむかえに行くわ！
english: Then see you tomorrow, Tokiko and I will come pick you up at 5!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: わかった。
english: Got it.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
せや、合言葉決めとこら。
もしおまえらの影に会うても
本物と見分けつくようにな！
english: Right, let's decide on a password. So that if I run into your Shadows, I can tell you apart from the real ones!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 合言葉？
english: A password?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 「山」言うたら……。
english: If I say "Mountain"...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …River?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
アホ！！
誰でも言うわ！
english: Idiot!! Anyone would say that!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
じゃ、じゃあ……。
チグリス・ユーフラテス川。
english: Th-Then... The Tigris and Euphrates rivers.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 川から離れよか慎平……。
english: Let's step away from rivers, Shinpei...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: <color=#GF_TIPS_063>メソポタミア文明</color>。
english: <color=#GF_TIPS_063>Mesopotamian civilization</color>.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 澪ちゃん、それや！！
english: Mio-chan, that's it!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ええ……。
english: Eh...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: メソポタミア文明！！
english: Mesopotamian civilization!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こんなんで大丈夫か……）
english: (Is this really going to be okay...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、覚えた？
メソポタミア文明やで！
english: Shin-chan, did you memorize it? It's Mesopotamian civilization!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、もう覚えたわ。
それより……。
english: Yeah, I've got it memorized. More importantly...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ありがとう、窓……
こんな話信じてくれて。
english:
Thanks, Sou…
For believing this story.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: なんや水臭いなァ……！！
english: Don't be so distant...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おまえもオレを信じて
話してくれたんやろ？
english: You believed in me and told me all this, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おう……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まだ完全に信じたわけじゃない……。
　影と本人を見分ける方法が
　見つからない以上はな）
english: (I still don't completely trust him... Not until I find a way to tell the difference between a Shadow and the real person.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（フカンしたオレが……、
　すぐそうやって水を差す）
english: (The part of me taking a bird's-eye view... is always so quick to rain on the parade.)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あとな、
オレにもちょっと調べてみたい事あんねん！
english:
Oh, and I have something
I want to look into too!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
何かわかったらよォ！
また連絡すらァ！！
english: If I figure anything out, I'll let you know!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: きゃああっ、夕立！
english: Yikes, a sudden shower!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
予報はアテにならんな～。
夕立やし、ここで雨宿りしてくか。
english: The forecast is really unreliable~. It's just a sudden shower, so let's take shelter here.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん……。
english: Shin-chan…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん？　なんや？
english: Huh? What?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そ、その……。
english: U-um...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ、明日、雁切さん、
いつやったら時間空くんやろ？
english: A-About tomorrow, Karikiri-san... When do you think he'll be free?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
どうやろな……。
夕方からな御神輿やし、
その前は準備で大忙しなはずやし……。
english: I wonder... The mikoshi parade starts in the evening, and he'll probably be super busy with preparations before that...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: たぶん御海送りの後やろなァ。
english: Probably after the Umi-okuri.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
御海送りは、夜の８時半からやっけ。
その前の８時から花火で……。
english:
The Umi-okuri is from 8:30 PM,
and the fireworks start at 8 PM…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪？
english: Mio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ、あんな？
聞きたいこと、あるんやけど。
english: H-Hey... There's something I want to ask you.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん……
いつまで島にいてるん？
english:
Shin-chan…
How long are you staying on the island?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、そうやな……。
葬儀がすんで、しばらくしたらと思てたけど、
どうなるか……。
english: Ah, right... I was thinking of leaving a little while after the funeral, but now, who knows...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ずうっといてたらええのに。
english: I wish you could stay forever.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんてな！
い……言うてみただけやしっ。
english: Just kidding! I-I was just saying...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ウソウソ！！
ホラ、手ェ出して！！
english: Just kidding!! Here, hold out your hand!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
これ渡しとか。
お姉ちゃんが最後につけてたネックレス。
english: I'll give this to you. The necklace my sister was wearing at the end.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんが持ってた方が、
お姉ちゃん、きっと喜ぶよ。
english: My sister would definitely be happier if you had it, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ありがとう。
english: …Thank you.

japanese: 21.貝のネックレス
english: 21. Shell Necklace

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレたちが小学生の頃……）
english: (When we were in elementary school...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（金髪に青い目という目立つ外見の潮は
　人目をひいて、悪ガキどもに
　よくからかわれていた）
english: (Ushio, with her conspicuous blonde hair and blue eyes, stood out a lot, and was often teased by the local brats.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（けど潮はそんな奴らにも立ち向かって
　グーパンでやり返して……）
english: (But Ushio would stand up to them and punch them right back...)

speaker: Ushio Kofune (幼少時)
japanese:
ありがとな、慎平！
慎平のおかげでヤツらにスキが生まれたわ！
english: Thanks, Shinpei! Thanks to you, I found an opening to strike!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そ……そんなつもりで声かけたんと
ちゃうんやけどな……。
english: I-I didn't call out to you with that intention, though...

speaker: Ushio Kofune (幼少時)
japanese:
私がからかわれてたから、
助けてくれようとしたんやろ？
english: I was being teased, so you tried to help me, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: い、いや……その……。
english: N-No... well...

speaker: Ushio Kofune (幼少時)
japanese: なーに照れとるんや。
english: Why are you blushing?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: う、うるさいわ！
english: S-Shut up!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……なあ潮、手ェ出して。
english: …Hey Ushio, hold out your hand.

speaker: Ushio Kofune (幼少時)
japanese: え、なに？
english: Huh? What?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮、今日は誕生日やろ？
english: Ushio, today's your birthday, right?

speaker: Ushio Kofune (幼少時)
japanese: きれい……。
english: It's so pretty...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえ……。
もうそんな危ないことすんなよな。
english: You know... Don't do dangerous things like that anymore.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえは<color=#GF_TIPS_071>オレが守る</color>から。
english: Because <color=#GF_TIPS_071>I'll protect you</color>.

speaker: Ushio Kofune (幼少時)
japanese: えっ……。
english: Huh…?

speaker: Ushio Kofune (幼少時)
japanese:
ありがと、慎平！
大事にするわ！！
english:
Thanks, Shinpei!
I'll treasure it!!

japanese: 22.メソポタミア文明
english: 22. Mesopotamian Civilization

japanese: 7月24日
english: July 24

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮がオレに託したスマホ……）
english: (The smartphone Ushio entrusted to me...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なにかのヒントを与えようと
　してくれていたのかもしれない）
english: (Maybe she was trying to give me some kind of hint.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （けど、パスワードが……）
english: (But the password…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あいつの誕生日……？
english: Her birthday…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ダメか……。
english: No good, huh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん？
english: Huh?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: Mountain!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……はァ？
english: Huh?!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そこはメソポタミア文明やろォーーーッ！！！！
english: That's where you say "Mesopotamian civilization"!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 合言葉、忘れたんか！？
english: You forgot the password?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ……。
もうこんな時間か……。
english: Ah... Is it already that time...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
こ……このノリの悪さよ……
まちがいなく本物やわ……！！
english: Th... this awful reaction... It's definitely the real Shinpei...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
早く着替えてくださいね。
もうみんな用意できてますよ！
english:
Please change quickly.
Everyone else is already ready!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ね、澪。
english: Right, Mio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ど、どうかな……。
初めてなんやけどわたしっ……
浴衣……。
english: H-How is it...? It's my first time... wearing a yukata...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうって……。
english: How is it, you ask...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: めっっっちゃ似合てるわ！！！！
english: It looks soooo good on you!!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
どや？
トキコに頼んで着付けてもろたんや！
english: How about it? I asked Tokiko to dress her!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
この方がニセモノと区別つくように
なるんちゃうかと思てな……！！
english: I thought this way it'd be easier to tell her apart from a fake...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: た……確かに！！
english: T-That's true!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影の澪は制服を着ていた……。
　制服姿の澪をどこかでコピーしたのだろう）
english: (The Shadow Mio was wearing her school uniform... She must have copied Mio in her uniform somewhere.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（本物が浴衣を着たことで
　もし影とはち合わせることがあっても
　すぐに区別がつく……！）
english: (With the real Mio wearing a yukata, even if we run into the Shadow, we'll be able to tell them apart immediately...!)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 今のところトキコにはなにも話してへん。
english: I haven't told Tokiko anything yet.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……それでいいと思う。
english: Yeah... I think that's for the best.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そういや、
昨日言うてた調べたい事って何やったんや？
何かわかったんか？
english:
By the way,
what was that thing you said you wanted to check yesterday?
Did you find anything out?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……ああ……あれなァ～～～～。
english: ...Ah... that thing~~~~.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
別に大したこと違たわ！！
忘れてくれっ！
english: It wasn't anything important after all!! Forget about it!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ホレ！
話してやんとさっさと行こら！
潮、待ちくたびれてんのとちゃうかァ？
english: Come on! Stop talking and let's go! Ushio's probably tired of waiting, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……確かに。
english: That's true.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃん、今日のお祭りのこと
めっちゃ楽しみにしてたから……
どっかに来ててもおかしないわ。
english: My sister was really looking forward to the festival today... It wouldn't be weird if she was here somewhere.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
早よ行っちゃろら！
あいつのためによ……。
english:
Let's go already!
For her sake.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓……。
おまえ医者志望やろ？
なにを非科学的なこと言うてんねん！
english: Sou... You want to be a doctor, right? Why are you saying such unscientific things!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
別にええやろ。
祭りの夜なんやで。
english:
It's fine.
It's the festival night, after all.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 非科学的なことも起こるってもんや！
english: Unscientific things can happen too!

japanese: 23.お祭りと浴衣姿
english: 23. Festival and Yukata

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なあ窓……。
english: Hey Sou…
