speaker: Ushio
japanese:
南雲竜之介やろ！
映画になったとき観に行ったよな。
english: Ryunosuke Nagumo, right! We went to see it when it became a movie.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……しおりちゃんがどうなったんか
気にならんのか？
english: ...Aren't you worried about what happened to Shiori-chan?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
え……。
しおりちゃんがどないしたん？
english: Eh... What happened to Shiori-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なぜか影に関する記憶は
　すっぽりと抜け落ちている）
english: (For some reason, her memories regarding the Shadows are completely missing.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小早川しおりが影を見た話も、
　海水浴の日のことも……）
english: (The story about Shiori Kobayakawa seeing a Shadow, and what happened on the day we went swimming...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（自分がどうやって死んだのかも
　覚えていなかった）
english: (She didn't even remember how she died herself.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレにはそれが演技には見えなかった。
　「本気で知らない」……そんな表情……）
english: (It didn't look like she was acting to me. She "truly didn't know"... that's the expression she had...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……いや、何でもないよ……。
english: …No, it's nothing…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: っ！

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 電話？
english: A phone call?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん……澪や……。
english: Yeah... it's Mio...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 貸してっ！！
english: Let me talk!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あっ！！！！
コラ――
english: Ah!!!! Hey--

speaker: Ushio
japanese: もしもし、澪ォ！？
english: Hello? Mio?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
バ、バカ……！
返せっ！！
english: I-Idiot...! Give it back!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハイ、オレ！
オレです！
english: Yes, it's me! It's me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
み、澪っ！？　オレやから！！
ハイッ！
english: M-Mio!? It's me!! Yes!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え、ええと……。
english: Eh, um…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
今……。
お姉ちゃんの声がしたような……。
english: Just now... I thought I heard my sister's voice...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そんなわけないやろ！！
だ……大丈夫か？
english: There's no way!! A-Are you okay?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……そ、そうよなっ……。
ごめん……私どうかしてるわ……。
english: ...R-Right... Sorry... I must be losing it...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、今どこにおる？
もう花火終わって御海送り始まってるよ。
私ら今、境内。
english: Shin-chan, where are you right now? The fireworks are over and the Umi-okuri has started. We're in the shrine grounds right now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あァ、すまん……！
近くやから、すぐに行くわ。
english: Ah, sorry...! I'm nearby, so I'll be right there.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……ホンマ？
もう……ほんなら早よ帰って来て。
みんな心配しとるよ。
english: ...Really? Jeez... then hurry back. Everyone's worried about you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うん、わかった。
ダッシュで行きます……。
english: Yeah, got it. I'll dash right over...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ん、じゃあね。
english: Yeah, see you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はああぁぁ……。
english: *Sigh*...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 澪、何て！？
english: What did Mio say!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いいから！！
おまえはっ……出て来んな！！！！
english: Never mind that!! You... stay out of sight!!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ちょっ、ちょっ……！
そんな押さんとってよ！？
english: W-Wait, wait...! Don't push me like that!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あとでむかえにくるから！！
しばらくはここに隠れとってくれ……！
english: I'll come back for you later!! Just stay hidden here for a while...!

speaker: Ushio
english: ...*Sigh*.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえは知らんやろけどな！
今マジで大変なこと起きてて――
english: You might not know this, but! Something really serious is happening right now--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえが言うたんや……
澪のこと守っちゃれって……！！
english: You're the one who said it... Told me to protect Mio...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: えっ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレはもう、後悔だけはしたない。
english: I won't regret it.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……意味わからんっちゅうねん。
english: ...I have no idea what you're talking about.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: そんなこと私、言うてへんし――
english: I never said anything like that--

japanese: 26.御海送り
english: 26. Umi-okuri (Sea Send-off)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ。やっと来た。
慎ちゃん！！
english: Ah. You finally made it. Shin-chan!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: ハァッ……ハァッハァッ……。
english: *Pant*... *pant, pant*...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
遅いよ～～。
心配したんやからね！
english: You're late~~. I was getting worried, you know!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 山！
english: Mountain!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
ごめん。
ちょっと急にハラが痛くなって……。
english: Sorry. My stomach suddenly started hurting...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: メ、メソポタミア文明！
english: M-Mesopotamian civilization!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ホラな。
やっぱりデカい方や！！
english: See? It's definitely the big one after all!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 何なん、そのドヤ。
english: What's with that smug look?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: は、はは……。
english: H-Haha...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
（日都ヶ島には、海から流れ着いたモノに
　神が宿るという漂着神信仰が根付いている）
english: (Hitogashima has a deeply rooted belief in drifting gods, where it's said that deities reside in objects that wash ashore from the sea.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: （それが蛭子命……）
english: (That would be Hiruko-no-Mikoto...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
（島ではヒルコ様と呼ばれ、
　漁業の神とされている）
english: (On the island, they call it Hiruko-sama, and it's worshipped as the god of fishing.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
（なので浜に流れ着いた漂着物は
　ゴミとして捨てずに集め……）
english: (Therefore, any flotsam that washes ashore is gathered instead of being thrown away as trash...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
（夏と冬の２回。
　「<color=#GF_TIPS_070>御海送り</color>」という儀式によって
　焚き上げ、神様を返す）
english: (And twice a year, in summer and winter, they hold a ceremony called "<color=#GF_TIPS_070>Umi-okuri</color>" to burn them and return the god to the sea.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
（やはりかなりの人数のヒトが集まって来ている。
　境内にはザッと千といったところか）
english: (As expected, a huge number of people have gathered. There must be roughly a thousand people on the shrine grounds.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
こうやってみんなで御海送り見るん、
めっちゃ久しぶりやね。
english: It's been a really long time since we all watched the Umi-okuri together like this.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: そやな……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 潮も見てるでェ！！！！
english: Ushio is watching too!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: えっ！？
english: Huh!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 天国でな……。
english: In heaven, that is...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
あっ……そういうイミな……。
ハイ……。
english: Ah... that's what you meant... Right...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
（ウシオ……。
　まさか影の記憶を失ってるとはな……）
english: (Ushio... To think she'd lost her memories as a Shadow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: （あいつのアタマが直れば助かるんだが……）
english: (It'd be a big help if her head went back to normal, but...)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 考えごとですかっ？
english: Lost in thought?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: はっ！
english: Huh!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 大丈夫ですか？
english: Are you okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: いやァ……。
english: N-Nah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: あれ？　澪と窓は！？
english: Huh? Where are Mio and Sou!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: あの二人ならあそこです。
english: They're over there.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お兄ちゃん……。
今日は澪に告白するつもりだそうです。
english: My brother... He's apparently planning to confess to Mio today.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
確か昔２回告白してフラれてるよな、
あいつ？
english: Didn't he confess twice in the past and get rejected, that guy?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
はい……。
３度目の正直だそうで……。
english: Yes... He says third time's the charm...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: マ、マジか、あいつ……！！
english: S-Seriously, that guy...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 我が兄ながら非科学的です。
english: I love my brother, but he can be so illogical.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: でも、時には非科学的な事も起きる……。
english: But sometimes, unscientific things do happen...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……はい。
でも、アレはムリです。
english: ...Yes. But that's not going to happen.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
えっ？
なんで？
english:
Huh?
Why?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
だって！
澪には――好きな人、他にいますもん。
english: Because! Mio-- already has someone else she likes.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: へえっ。誰？
english: Oh. Who?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: …Oh!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ご、ごめんなさい……。
私の口から……それはちょっと……！！
english: I-I'm sorry... It's not really my place... to say...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 慎平ェ！！！！
english: Shinpei!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: お、おう！
english: Y-Yeah!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
トキコも！！
よう聞いてくれっ！！
english: Tokiko, you too!! Listen closely!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あ……あのな……。
澪ちゃん！
english: U-Um, you see... Mio-chan!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
いや、澪！！
こんな時に言うことちゃうかも
わからんけどよォ！
english: No, Mio!! This might not be the right time to say this, but!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
でもよォ……。
こんな時やからこそ言わせてくれや。
english: But... Because it's a time like this, let me say it.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
やっぱりオレ、澪のこと好きや！
せっ……せやから！！
english: I really do like you, Mio! Th-Therefore!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 澪のこと……このオレに守らしてください！
english: Please... let me protect you, Mio!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
おお……。
い、言うた……！
english: Oh... H-He said it...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ちょっ！！
窓くん、待って……何を言う……ええ！？
english: Wait!! Sou-kun, hold on... What are you saying... eh!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: きっ……聞いてるよ、みんな！？
english: E-Everyone is listening, you know!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……私なんかのどこがええの……。
english: ...What's so good about someone like me...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
気持ちはうれしいよ……。
でも、やっぱりゴメン。
窓くんとは私、ええ友だちでおりたいから！
english: I'm happy about your feelings... But, I'm sorry. I want to stay good friends with you, Sou-kun!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 言わんこっちゃないです……。
english: I totally saw that coming...

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese: ええモン見せてもろたっ！！！！
english: You showed me somethin' real good!!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: おい窓！！
english: Hey Sou!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ん？
english: Huh?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ドンマイ！
english: Don't worry!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: わっ！？
english: Whoa!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Huh…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
（出て来んなって、言うたよな……？
　あのアホ！！！！）
english: (I told her not to come out, didn't I...? That idiot!!!!)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: あ、あのキレイな髪……。
english: Th-That beautiful hair...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 今の、声……っ。
english: That voice... just now.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: Ushio!?!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: えっ。
english: Huh.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うっ……潮とかではないっ！！
english: Ugh... I'm not Ushio or anything!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 愛の戦士キュア――
english: Warrior of Love, Cure--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: コラ。
english: Hey.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平……。
秒でバレました……。
english: Shinpei... I was busted in a second...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
アホ……。
それで変身したつもりかよ……。
english: Idiot... Did you really think that counted as a transformation...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
しっ、慎平ェェ！！
こっ……こらまさかッ！
english: Sh-Shinpei!! Th-This couldn't be...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ごめんな……。
みんなの顔……どうしても見とて……。
english: Sorry... I just really wanted to see... everyone's faces...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 澪、浴衣トキちゃんに着せてもろたん？
english: Mio, did Toki-chan help you put on that yukata?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: よう似合てるなあ。
english: She looks good in it.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……違う。
english: …No.

speaker: Ushio
english: Mio...?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
何してんの慎ちゃんッ！！
早くそいつから離れてよ！！
english: What are you doing, Shin-chan!! Hurry, get away from that thing!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: そいつはお姉ちゃんと違う……。
english: That thing isn't my sister...

speaker: Ushio
english: Huh...?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: バケモンや！！
english: It's a monster!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
english: ...Mio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese: こいつはもう離さんよ。
english: I'm not letting go of this one.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なっ……。
english: Wha...?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
いたっ……腕、痛いよ……。
慎……平？
english: Ow... my arm, it hurts... Shin...pei?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: まて、澪っ！！
english: Wait, Mio!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
慎平ェッ！！
ちゃんと説明せえッ！！
english: Shinpei!! Explain yourself properly!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
はぁ……どうも……
フカン的に考えてよォ……。
english: *Sigh*... honestly... think about it from a bird's-eye view, would you...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
バレるに決まってるわな。
葬式まで済んだ人間と入れ替われるわけがない。
english: Of course we'd get found out. There's no way to replace someone whose funeral has already been held.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
始めっからおまえ……。
入れ替わる気なかったな？
english: From the very start, you... You never meant to switch places, did you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
なんで言うこときかんの？
おまえ、まさか……声がきこえてへんのか？
english: Why won't you listen? Don't tell me... you can't hear my voice?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……だ、誰？
誰や、おまえっ！？
english: ...Wh-who? Who are you!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: みんな逃げ――
english: Everyone, run—

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: こ、こいつッ！
english: Y-you—!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん……じゃ、ない……。
english: It's not... Shin-chan...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: もう遅い。
english: It's too late.

speaker: Ushio
english: *Pant, pant*...!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: ……時間や。
english: ...It's time.

japanese: 27.死屍累々
english: 27. Piles of Corpses

japanese: 十数分前
english: A few minutes ago

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァッハァッ……！
english: Hah... hah...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪……！
　いきなり飛び出してしまってすまない……！！）
english: (Mio...! I'm sorry for running off so suddenly...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮の葬式やったばっかりだし、
　影のこともあるのに……）
english: (We just had Ushio's funeral, and with the Shadows going on too...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレが澪に心配かけてどうする！
　あとでちゃんと説明しないと――）
english: (What am I doing, worrying Mio like this! I've gotta explain properly later—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今の音！？
english: That sound just now!?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん。
english: Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ッ。
おまえは……！！

speaker: Mio
japanese:
聞きたいことあんねやけど。
ちょっとええかなァ……？
english: There's something I want to ask you. Got a sec...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （包丁？　血？）
english: (A kitchen knife? Blood?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あれは澪？　いや影のミオなのか？）
english: (Is that Mio? No—is it the Shadow Mio?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレに聞きたい事ってなんだ？）
english: (What could she want to ask me?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （落ち着け。こういう時こそフカンで――）
english: (Calm down. This is exactly when I need that bird's-eye view—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: がっ……くっ……。
english: Gah... ngh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（い、いつの間に首を……！？
　う……動いたのが見えんかったぞ！？）
english: (W-when did she get my neck...!? I... I couldn't even see her move!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それにこの力！！
　澪の……いや、人間の力じゃない！！）
english: (And this strength!! It's not Mio's... no, this isn't human strength at all!!)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃんさァ……。
私のこと、動画に撮ったらしなァ……？
english: Say, Shin-chan... I hear you took a video of me...?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
それって不可能ちゃうかな……。
あらかじめ私が来ること知ってやんと……。
english: That should've been impossible, though... Not unless you knew I was coming ahead of time...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ゲホッ！
ゲホ……ゲェホ！
english: Kah! Cough... hgh!

speaker: Mio
japanese: なんで知ってたん？
english: How did you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ううっ！！
english: Ngh!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（バレ……てる……。
　影のミオを撮影したこと……）
english: (She knows... that I filmed the Shadow Mio...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（地面に、無数の人型のシミ……。
　影が人を消した痕……！）
english: (Countless human-shaped stains on the ground... the marks where Shadows erased people...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そ、そんなバカな！！！！）
english: (Th-there's no way!!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ウソだろ！？
　全部こいつがやったのか！？
　いったい何人殺したんだよ……）
english: (You've gotta be kidding!? Did she do all of this!? Just how many people has she killed...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ah... ngh...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
教えたんか？
あの裏切り者が。
english: Did someone tell you? That traitor.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（裏切り者！？
　誰の、ことだ……！？）
english: (A traitor!? Who is she talking about...!?)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
見過ごせやんなァ……。
計画の大詰めで邪魔されたら困るんやわ。
english: I can't let this slide... It'd be a pain to get interfered with now, at the climax of the plan.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なぁ、調べて。
こいつどこまで知ってる？
english: Hey, look into it. How much does he know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （他にもいるのか！？）
english: (There's another one of them!?)

speaker: 男の声（影シンペイ）
japanese: 途切れたり……くり返したり……。
english: Cutting out... repeating over and over...

speaker: 男の声（影シンペイ）
japanese:
おかしいよなァ。
オレの記憶……。
english: It's strange, isn't it. My memories...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: おまえ……殺されんの何回め？
english: You... how many times is this you've been killed now?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こいつっ！！！
　オ……オレの……影……！！）
english: (This thing...!!! My... my own... Shadow...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（コバマートの３階でコピーされた……。
　こいつにはあの時までの
　オレの記憶があんのか……！！）
english: (I got copied on the third floor of Koba Mart... So it has my memories right up to that moment...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ヤバい……。
　コピーされたら記憶が更新される！！）
english: (This is bad... If it copies me, its memories get updated!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（バレてしまう……！！
　オレたちが影について調べてることとか！）
english: (It'll all come out...!! Like how we've been investigating the Shadows!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （メソポタミア文明とか！）
english: (Like the Mesopotamia stuff!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（違うだろ！　違うって！！
　今考えるのはそこじゃない！！）
english: (No, wrong! That's not it!! That's not what I should be worrying about right now!!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 終わった？
english: Are you done?

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: 待て……。
english: Wait...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
もう更新終わったやろ。
本物は……殺してもええな？
english: The update's done now, right? So the real one... I can kill him, yeah?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（逃げなきゃ……
　逃げなきゃ殺される！）
english: (I have to run... if I don't run, I'll be killed!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （だから違う！　違うだろ！！）
english: (No, that's not it! That's not it!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （このままじゃ――）
english: (At this rate—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （みんなが殺される！！！！）
english: (Everyone's going to be killed!!!!)

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
待てって。
殺すな、ミオ……。
english: I said wait. Don't kill him, Mio...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
……なんで？
シンちゃん……。
english: ...Why? Shin-chan...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: ちょっとフカンして考えてみろ……。
english: Take a bird's-eye view and think for a second...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
オカアサンも言うてたやろ。
オレは死んでもやり直しができるんやぞ？
english: Mother said it too, didn't she. Even if I die, I get to start over—right?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ループの話？
ホンマなん！？　その記憶……
ゲームじゃあるまいし。
english: You mean the loop thing? Is that for real!? Those memories... It's not like this is some game.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
オレも自分で
コントロールしてるわけじゃない。
english: It's not like I can control it myself, either.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
が、オレがループしてると仮定すれば、
すべてに説明がつく。
english: But if you assume I'm looping, everything makes sense.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
コレは考え方を四次元にせんとアカン問題や……。
三次元の考えを四次元からフカンするんや。
english: This is a problem you've gotta think about in four dimensions... You take a bird's-eye view of three-dimensional thinking from the fourth dimension.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
……今オレがその方法を知らんかっても、
未来で身に付けるんかもしれへん。
english: ...Even if I don't know how to do that right now, maybe I'll pick it up in the future.

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……あんた、変な本の読みすぎやで。
english: ...You read way too many weird books.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
もしオレが記憶を保ったまま
２２日に戻れるなら、
いずれ必ずオレたちの障害になる。
english: If I can make it back to the 22nd with my memories intact, sooner or later I'm bound to become an obstacle to us.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
<color=#GF_KEY_SNP_NOTDEATH>だから殺すな</color>。
すべてが終わるまで。
english: <color=#GF_KEY_SNP_NOTDEATH>So don't kill him</color>. Not until it's all over.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
オレは上に行く。
ケータイ取ってくれ……。
オレの左のケツポケットや……。
english: I'm going up top. Grab my phone for me... It's in my left back pocket...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
おまえは下に何人か行かせて
ウシオをつかまえろ……。
テント裏の森にいるはずや。
english: Send a few people down below and catch Ushio... She should be in the woods behind the tents.

speaker: Mio
japanese: わかった。
english: Got it.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
早よ行きな！
時間に遅れたらうるさいで、あの人……。
english: Hurry up and go! She gets cranky if you're late, that one...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: クソッ……ま……待……て。
english: Damn it... w... wait...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: はァ……。
english: Haah...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
情けないよなァ……。
結局、オレは誰も守れやんねん。
english: Pretty pathetic, huh... In the end, I can't protect anyone.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...!!!! Wait... wait, damn it!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪に指一本でも触れてみろッ――
english: Lay even one finger on Mio and—

speaker: Mio
japanese: もうやめてよ慎ちゃん。
english: Just stop already, Shin-chan.

speaker: Mio
japanese: カッコよすぎ。
english: You're way too cool.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （う、腕が……こいつ、腕を折りやがった！）
english: (M-my arm... she—she broke my arm!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぎっ……うがああああああああァァァァ！
english: Gah... aaaaaaaaaahhhhh!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
でもな、もう手遅れやで……。
もうじき、オカアサンが起きて来る。
english: But you know, it's already too late... Mother's going to wake up soon.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ぐッ……ううッ！
澪……今……助けに……
english: Ngh... ugh! Mio... I'll... save you... right now...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
コラ！
じっとして、ホラ！！
往生際悪いとみっともないで、慎ちゃん！
english:
Nare sushi…?
I've never heard of that on Hitogashima.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: みっ……澪ォォォッ！！！！
english: Mi... Mioooo!!!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: しゃあないな……足も折っとこか。
english: Guess I have no choice... I'll break your legs too.

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
なれ寿司って……。
日都ヶ島で聞きませんよね？
english: Nare sushi... You don't really hear about that on Hitogashima, do you?

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
僕は食べたことないんです。
あなたはありますか？
english: I've never eaten it. Have you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: っは……ええ！？
english: Hah... eh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この人は……！！
　フェリーの！？）
english: (This person...!! From the ferry!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（！？！？
　み……ミオが消えたッ！？）
english: (!?!? Mi... Mio disappeared!?)

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）

speaker: Mio
japanese: ふっ……！
english: Fuh...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （危ないっ！　後ろ！）
english: (Look out! Behind you!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（う、後ろから来たミオを撃った？
　いやでも……なんで地面に……）
english: (Sh-She shot Mio who came from behind? No, but... why on the ground...)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
スゴイ……後ろに目ェ……。
ついてるんですか？
english: Amazing... Do you have eyes... in the back of your head?

speaker: Mio
japanese: それに、なんで……私らの殺し方――
english: And why... our way of killing--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ま、まさか今……この人……。
　倒したのか……！？
　……影を！！！！）
english: (N-No way, just now... did this person... defeat it...!? ...The Shadow!!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハァッ、ハァ……ハァ……。
ゼェッ……。
english: *Pant*, *pant*... *pant*... *Wheeze*...

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）
japanese: はじめまして、ですね。
english: Nice to meet you, I suppose.

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
島にいたのは子供の頃だったので。
食べたことないんですよね、なれ寿司。
english: I was only on the island when I was a child. So I've never eaten it, nare sushi.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……つッ！
english: ...Guh!

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
すみません。
少し痛むと思いますが、応急処置を。
english: Sorry. This might hurt a little, but I'll administer first aid.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……うっ、うぅ……。
english: ...Ugh, ngh...

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）
japanese: どんな味か気になるなァ……。
english: I wonder what it tastes like...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ……うぐっ！！
english: Ah... ugh!!

speaker: Woman in Black Suit (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 黒スーツの女（ポニテひづる）
japanese: 一応、これで完了です。
english: That should do it for now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ……ありがとう、ございます……。
あなたは――
english: Th... thank you... very much... Who are you--

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
えっと……申し遅れました。
僕は、<color=#GF_TIPS_013>南雲竜之介</color>といいます。
english: Um... apologies for the late introduction. My name is <color=#GF_TIPS_013>Ryunosuke Nagumo</color>.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なぐっ……え？
りゅうの……すけ……。
english: Nagu... huh? Ryuno...suke...

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
あなたを助けに来たんですけど……。
ごめんなさい。遅くなってしまいました。
english: I came to save you, but... I'm sorry. I was too late.

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese: 「網代慎平」さん。
english: "Shinpei Ajiro"-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……えっ？
english: …Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （どうしてこの人は、オレの名前を？）
english: (Why does this person know my name?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
……っ！
誰か来る……こっちへ！
english:
…!
Someone's coming… over here!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なっ……何が――
english: Wh... what is--

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
シーーーーッ。
……影です。
english: Shhh... ...It's a Shadow.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Eh…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Ushio…!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あいつ！
　じっとしてろって言ったのに……！！）
english: (That idiot! I told her to stay put...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （とにかく、止めないと――）
english: (Anyway, I have to stop her--)

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
待って。
上は危険です、影たちが集まってる。
english: Wait. It's dangerous up there, the Shadows are gathering.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、あなたは……
影と人間の区別がつくんですか！？
english: C-Can you tell the difference between Shadows and humans!?

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
影の上に立っているモノは、
ただ人の形をした肉の塊にすぎません。
english: The thing standing on top of the shadow is nothing more than a lump of flesh in the shape of a person.

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
足元をよく見てください。
ヤツらの正体は地面に落ちる
平面の「影」の方です。
english: Look closely at their feet. Their true form is the flat "shadow" cast on the ground.

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
なので<color=#GF_TIPS_076>影</color>を踏まれることを嫌います。
踏もうとすれば避けようと、
影の方だけが動いたりしますよ。
english: Therefore, they hate having their <color=#GF_TIPS_076>shadow</color> stepped on. If you try to step on it, only the shadow will move to avoid it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（足元の「影」が本体だって……！？
　そ、そんなことが……）
english: (The "shadow" at their feet is the main body...!? H-How could that be...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いやでも、さっきこの人が影のミオを
　倒したことで説明がつく）
english: (But wait, that explains how this person defeated the Shadow Mio earlier.)

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese: それと……。
english: Also…

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
ここからは姉の仮説ですが……。
影は光によってスキャンし、
その情報を取り込む……。
english: From here on is my sister's hypothesis, but... Shadows scan using light, and take in that information...

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
なぜそうするかといえば……。
それがヤツらの「食事」に
当たる行為ではないか……と。
english: As for why they do that... She thinks it might be their equivalent of "eating".

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese: 影は人間の情報を食べて生きている。
english: Shadows live by consuming human information.

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
しかし……「味」という情報だけは、
直接食べる必要がある……。
english: However... the information of "taste" alone must be consumed directly...

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
見て、あのシミ。
あれはヤツらが、人の肉を食べた跡……。
english: Look at that stain. That's the mark left behind after they eat human flesh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影のミオが殺した人たち……
　あれは食事だったのか）
english: (The people the Shadow Mio killed... That was a meal to them?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
僕たちはなりゆき上、影に狙われる身です。
まァ……あなたもでしょうけど。
english: Due to circumstances, we are targeted by the Shadows. Well... I suppose you are too.

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
影はこの三日間でどんどん増えてます。
倒しても倒してもキリがない……。
english: The Shadows have been rapidly increasing over these three days. No matter how many we defeat, there's no end to them...

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
何か、統率された意志を感じます。
すべてはひとつの目的のために
動いているようなね……。
english: I sense some kind of unified will behind it. Like they're all moving for a single purpose...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Purpose…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もうじき……。
オカアサンが起きて来る……？
english: Soon... Mother will wake up...?

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese:
境内が……光った。
今の光は……。
english: The shrine grounds... flashed. That light just now...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影はその銃で倒せるんですよね……。
南雲先生！！
english: Shadows can be defeated with that gun, right... Nagumo-sensei!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese: っ！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……では……ありませんか！？
小説家の！
english: ...Isn't that right!? The novelist!

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）
japanese: あ……まぁ……ハイ。
english: Ah… Well… Yes.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: や、やはり！
english: I-I knew it!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お願いします……！！
手を貸してください！
english: Please...!! Lend me a hand!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
き、聞きたい事、
山のようにありますけど……今は！！
english: I-I have a mountain of things I want to ask you... but right now!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
上に澪がっ……。
家族とか友だちがいてるんです！！
english: Mio is up there... My family and friends are up there!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ポニテひづる)
speaker_ja: 南雲竜之介（ポニテひづる）

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: っ！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: トキちゃん！！
english: Toki-chan!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……慎平さん？
english: …Shinpei-san?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ゼェッゼェッ……。
ハァッ……よかった……。
english: *Wheeze, wheeze*... *Pant*... thank goodness...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
みっ……みんなは！？
澪は！？
english: Wh-Where is everyone!? Where's Mio!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ッ！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんや、この黒い水溜まり？
　この臭い……まさか、血か！？）
english: (What is this black puddle? This smell... could it be blood!?)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ごめんなさい……。
english: I'm sorry…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
っ！！
トキちゃん……！？
english: !! Toki-chan...!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
こんな……こと……。

japanese:
悪いね、慎平くん……。
色々と説明してあげたいんだが――
english: Sorry, Shinpei-kun... I'd like to explain things to you, but--

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: 残念ながら時間切れですねェ。
english: Unfortunately, time's up.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……せ、先生！！
にげ――
english:
…S-Sensei!!
Run--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ah… ah…

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
いやはや、さすがに勘が鋭いなァ……。
慎平くん、キミと違ってね。
english: Well, well, she certainly is sharp... Unlike you, Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ugh...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
まぁ、色々と気になるでしょうが……。
これ以上のお話は無意味というもの。
english: Well, I'm sure you're curious about many things, but... Talking any further would be pointless.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: ゲームオーバーです、慎平くん。
english: Game over, Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
う……
うあああああああああああああああ！！！！
english: Ugh... Uwaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

japanese: 29.南方ひづる
english: 29. Hizuru Minakata

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……私だ。
english: ...It's me.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
７月２２日。
午前１１時ちょうど発の日都ヶ島行きの
フェリーに乗った。
english: July 22nd. I boarded the ferry bound for Hitogashima that departed at exactly 11 a.m.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
二度と戻らないはずだった。
帰るのは１４年ぶりだ……。
english: I wasn't ever supposed to return. It's been 14 years since I last came back...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミも、もし来るなら……。
１４年ぶりだな……。
english: If you're coming too... It's been 14 years...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
あのメッセージさえなければ、
私はここにいなかっただろう。
english: If it weren't for that message, I wouldn't be here.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 昨日のことだ……。
english: It was yesterday…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私のボイスレコーダーアプリに
題名のない音声ファイルが
いつの間にか追加されていた。
english: An untitled audio file had somehow been added to my voice recorder app.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミかとも思ったが、
キミなら題名を付けるだろう。
私だって付ける。
english:
I thought it might be you,
but if it were you, you'd have added a title.
I would too.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
再生してみると、
聞いたことのない女の声が入っていた。
english: When I played it, there was a woman's voice I had never heard before.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
録音状態は良好とはいえない……。
音声は途切れ途切れでノイズも多い……。
english: The recording quality couldn't be called good... The audio was choppy and full of noise...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
だが、その内容は……１４年ぶりの帰郷の為、
私に旅支度をさせるのに十分なものだったのだ。
english: But the contents were... Enough to make me pack my bags for my first trip home in 14 years.

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
南ぐ……先せ……聞こ……すか？
よく聞いてくだ……。
english: Nagu... sensei... can you hear... me? Please listen carefully...

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
今……日都……島……。
たいへ……ことが……起きて……。
english: Right now... on Hitogashima... Something terrible... is happening...

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
影が……あの子が……。
ハイネが……するんです……！！
english: The Shadows... that girl... Haine is... going to...!!

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
２４日……夏祭り……。
みんな影に殺され……。
島じゅうの……全員……
english: The 24th... the summer festival... Everyone will be killed by the Shadows... Everyone... on the entire island...

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
止められる……は……。
あじろしんぺい……いう人だけ……。
english: The only one... who can stop it... Is a person named... Shinpei Ajiro...

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
でも……彼一人では不可……で……。
私たち……力を合わ…………！！
english: But... it's impossible for him alone... We have to... join forces...!!

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
だからお願……す……。
日都ヶ島に来てくだ……い！
しんペ……を助けてくだ……。
english: So please... Please come to Hitogashima! Please help... Shinpei...

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
先生の力を……お願いです……。
どうか……。
english: Please... lend us your power, Sensei... Please...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
声はおそらく１０代……。
高校生くらいか。和歌山訛りがある。
english: The voice likely belonged to a teenager... Maybe a high school student. There was a Wakayama accent.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そして、『彼女』の名前を知っていたのだ……。
――以上だ。
english: And, she knew "her" name... --That is all.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （手がかりは<color=#GF_TIPS_072>これだけ</color>……）
english: (This is my <color=#GF_TIPS_072>only lead</color>...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（誰だ？
　なぜこの女は、私のことを知っているのだ――）
english: (Who is she? Why does this woman know about me--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: 潮っ！！
english: Ushio!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（……！？
　なんだ？　この男……突然……）
english: (...!? What is with this guy... suddenly...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: ……わああああっ！？
english: …Whoa!!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （そんなに汗をダラダラかいて顔をうずめて……）
english: (Sweating profusely and burying his face like that...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（苦しくないのか！？
　いや、そもそも窒息が目的！？
　自殺志願者！？）
english: (Isn't he suffocating!? No, maybe suffocation is the goal!? Is he suicidal!?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（おもしろいじゃないか！
　なかなかユニークなヤツだぞ、こいつ！！）
english: (How interesting! This guy is quite unique!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english:
Eh!!?
Ah…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
ごめんなさい、ごめんなさいっ！！
そそそそそんなつもりはっ……！！
english: I'm sorry, I'm sorry!! I-I-I didn't mean to...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
english: (...What? He's... apologizing!?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （普通かっ！！！！）
english: (How ordinary!!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: す……すみませんでしたっ……！！
english: I... I'm so sorry...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（うなされて飛び起きる程の夢……
　ふむ……内容によっては
　小説のネタになるかもしれないな）
english: (A dream that makes you jump up in a cold sweat... Hmm... depending on the content, it might be good material for a novel.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
大丈夫か？
ずいぶんうなされていたが……。
悪い夢でも見たのかい？
english: Are you okay? You were groaning quite a bit... Did you have a nightmare?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: A... dream...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese:
あ、あの……。
鉄砲で撃たれたことって……あ、あります？
english: U-Um... Have you ever... been shot by a gun?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
english: Huh!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （この男、まだ寝ボケてるのか？）
english: (Is this guy still half-asleep?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キミ……本当に大丈夫か？
english: Are you... really okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
japanese: あ……いや、何でも……。
english: Ah… no, nothing…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（私としたことが……。
　他人の見た夢の話ほど
　つまらないものはない……）
english: (What was I thinking... There's nothing more boring than listening to someone else's dream...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （ネタになりそうにはないな……）
english: (It doesn't seem like good material...)

speaker: Ship Announcement (Captain)
japanese: ご乗船お疲れさまでした――
english: Thank you for sailing with us--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（いまタラップにいた船員……
　いや、あの男の影……）
english: (That crew member on the ramp just now... No, that man's Shadow...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（踏まれる瞬間、明らかに動いていた……。
　つまり、ヤツは「影」……！！）
english: (It clearly moved the moment it was about to be stepped on... In other words, he is a "Shadow"...!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（あのメッセージの信憑性が
　ひとつ高まったな……）
english: (The credibility of that message just went up a notch...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
おおーーーい！！
おかえり「しんちゃん」！！
english: Heyyy!! Welcome back, "Shin-chan"!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （しんちゃん……？）
english: (Shin-chan...?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 長旅お疲れさまあああ～～～～～！！
english: You must be exhausted from the long trip~~~~~!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……しんちゃん。
しん……。
english: ...Shin-chan. Shin...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
しんぺい……。
あじろ……しんぺい……？
english:
Shinpei…
Ajiro… Shinpei…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（さっきの少年が？
　いや、まさかな……）
english: (Was that the boy from earlier? No, it couldn't be...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （とにかくあの老人と会わなければ）
english: (Anyway, I have to meet with that old man.)

japanese: 30.謎の女性
english: 30. The Mysterious Woman

speaker: 音声ガイダンス
japanese:
ただいま電話に出ることができません。
ピーという発信音のあとに
お名前とご用件をお話ください。
english: I am unable to answer the phone right now. After the beep, please leave your name and message.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（留守か……あの老人め。
　携帯電話も持たずに生きているとは）
english: (He's out... that old man. To think he lives without even owning a cell phone.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（人の迷惑を考えたことはないのか？
　まったく……）
english: (Has he never considered the trouble he causes others? Good grief...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ん……？
この看板は……。
english:
Huh…?
This sign is…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（『故小舟潮葬儀式場』……。
　今日は葬儀があるのか……）
english: ("Funeral Service for the Late Ushio Kofune"... There's a funeral today...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （こふね……うしお？）
english: (Kofune… Ushio?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Recording)
english: Ushio!!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
午前１１時４５分。
葬儀場に到着。
english: 11:45 AM. Arrived at the funeral hall.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 亡くなったのは、小舟潮……。
english: The deceased is Ushio Kofune...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 私はこの子を知っている……。
english: I know this girl...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ひづるちゃん！？
english: Hizuru-chan!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: っ！

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ああ、やっぱりそうや！
english: Ah, I knew it!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
南方ひづるちゃん。
……せやろ！？
english: Hizuru Minakata-chan. ...Right!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……よく分かったな……。
雁切真砂人。
english: ...You figured it out easily... Masahito Karikiri.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
まァ、キレイになって……！！
何年ぶりやろか！？
ひづるちゃん！
english: Well, you've grown into a beautiful woman...!! How many years has it been!? Hizuru-chan!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: １４年になるな……。
english: It's been 14 years…

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: もうそんなに経ちますか……。
english: Has it really been that long...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あれからどないしてたんですか？
心配してたんですよ……。
english: What have you been up to since then? I was worried about you...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（……影を踏んでも平気。
　こいつは影じゃない）
english: (...It's fine to step on his shadow. This guy isn't a Shadow.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
小舟潮とは、まさか……。
洋食コフネの……！？
english: Ushio Kofune, could it be... From Western Food Kofune...!?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
……ええ。
昨日……海の事故でね……。
english: ...Yes. Yesterday... in an accident at sea...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: もしかして潮ちゃんの事、誰かから聞いて？
english: Did someone tell you about Ushio-chan?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……いや。
english: …No.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
えっ！　ほな、どうして島に？
帰って来たわけとちゃうんでしょ？
english: Eh! Then why are you on the island? It's not like you moved back, right?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ。
今、東京で……。
english: Right. I'm in Tokyo right now...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あっと待って。
当てさせて！？
english: Ah, wait. Let me guess!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: は？
english: Huh?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ひづるちゃん頭よかったさけ、
きっと先生か弁護士さんか、
もしかして、お医者さん？
english: You were always smart, Hizuru-chan, so you must be a teacher or a lawyer, or maybe a doctor?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……フツフツと思い出してきたぞ。
english: ...It's all starting to come back to me now.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: はい？
english: Huh?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私はおまえの事が生理的に無理だった！！
そして、現在進行形で無理だ！！！！
english: I found you physically repulsive!! And I still find you repulsive now!!!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あははっ！
またまたウソばっかり！
english: Ahaha! Always telling lies!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 遺憾ながら真実だ！！
english: Regrettably, it is the truth!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あっ！
アランさん！！
english:
Ah!
Alain-san!!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
わかりますか、この人！
おどろいたらあきませんよ。
実はね――
english: Do you know who this is! You're going to be surprised. Actually--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 南方ひづるです。
english: Hizuru Minakata.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ああっ！
もう、私に言わせてくださいよ！
english: Ahh! Jeez, let me say it!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: ひづるて、あのひづるか！！？
english: Hizuru... you mean that Hizuru!!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ご無沙汰だな、アラン……。
english: It's been a while, Alain...

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
いや、うれしいわぁ……。
まさかこんな日ィに
ひづるにまた会えるとは……。
english: Wow, I'm so happy... I never thought I'd get to see you again on a day like this...

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
よかったら、潮の顔、
見てっちゃってよ……。
english: If you'd like, you should see Ushio's face before you go...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ええ、もちろん……。
english: Yes, of course…

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
っ！　澪からや……。
ちょっとごめんよ。
english: ! It's from Mio... Excuse me for a moment.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: もしもし……。
english: Hello…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （あの頃……）
english: (Back then…)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（私が中学二年生の時、
　私は洋食コフネの常連だった）
english: (When I was in my second year of middle school, I was a regular at Western Food Kofune.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（アランには二人の娘がいた。
　潮と澪……）
english: (Alain had two daughters. Ushio and Mio...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（アランの奥さんは澪ちゃんを産んで
　すぐに亡くなったと聞いている）
english: (I heard Alain's wife passed away shortly after giving birth to Mio-chan.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（アランが働いている間、
　客たちが子供の面倒を見ていたが……）
english: (While Alain was working, the customers would look after the children, but...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （あの潮が……まさか……）
english: (To think that Ushio... could it be...)

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
なんてよォ！？
落ちたてかい！！
english: What was that!? He fell in!?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
それで……！？
大丈夫なんか？
english: And...!? Is he okay?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: どうしました？
english: What's wrong?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
慎平迎えに行って海に落ちたって……。
ちょっと遅れるらしいですわ……。
english: Shinpei fell into the sea on his way here... Seems like he'll be a little late...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （……しんぺい？）
english: (…Shinpei?)

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: あれ大変や！
english: Oh, that's terrible!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
……ほなちょっと待とか！
慎平くんが来えへんかったらあかんもんなァ。
english: ...Then let's wait a bit! We can't start if Shinpei-kun isn't here.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: アラン！
english: Alain!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 今の……しんぺいと言うのは！？
english: Just now... who is this "Shinpei"!?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああ……ひづるはもう島出とったさけ、
知らんわな。
english: Ah... Hizuru had already left the island, so you wouldn't know him.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
私の親友の息子でね、
網代慎平いう男の子を引き取ったんよ。
english: He's the son of my best friend. I took in a boy named Shinpei Ajiro.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （あじろ……しんぺい……）
english: (…Ajiro… Shinpei…)

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ちょうど１０年前かな。
ご両親が船の事故で亡くなられてね……。
english: About exactly 10 years ago, I think. His parents passed away in a boat accident...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
慎平くんには他に身寄りがのうて……。
それでアランさんが里親になられたんですわ。
english: Shinpei-kun had no other relatives... So Alain-san became his foster parent.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああそうや！
慎平も東京なんやで！
調理師の専門学校に通てて――
english: Oh, that's right! Shinpei is in Tokyo too! He's attending a culinary school--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 失礼。
english: Excuse me.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: ひづる！！？
english: Hizuru!!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（フェリーで私の前に座っていた少年……。
　やはりあれが網代慎平だったのだ！！）
english: (The boy sitting in front of me on the ferry... That really was Shinpei Ajiro!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（一応、影を踏んで確認しておいたが、
　あの時点で彼は人間だった）
english: (I checked by stepping on his shadow just in case, but at that point he was human.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（だが現在も人間だという確証はない……！！
　会うわけにはいかない！
　今はまだ……！！）
english: (But there's no guarantee he's still human now...!! I can't meet him! Not yet...!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（私を島へ誘った謎の女の声……。
　あのメッセージの真偽も、声の主も不明の今……
　誰一人信用することはできない！）
english: (The voice of the mysterious woman who lured me to the island... With the authenticity of that message and the owner of the voice still unknown... I can't trust anyone!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（幸い、私の正体に気付いている者はまだいない。
　今のうちに動いておかなければ――）

japanese:

Hizuru?

japanese:

japanese:

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: ひづる！

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 騒がせたな、失礼するよ。

japanese:

speaker: 喪服姿の女性（影アサコ）

japanese: ……ひづる？

japanese: 磯兼朝子……。

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ああ、それは失礼した。

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese:
ホンマはひづるのこと、

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese:
ひづる……住所も電話番号も

元気にしてたん？
english: But you wouldn't give me your address or phone number, Hizuru... Have you been doing well?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
元気の定義にもよるが……。
私の心臓は動いているよ。
english: Depends on your definition of doing well... My heart is still beating.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese: ふふ、ホンマ変わってへん。
english: Haha, you haven't changed at all.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese:
……覚えてる？
潮ちゃんのこと。
english: ...Do you remember? About Ushio-chan.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese:
昨日のお通夜でね、
私がいっつもオムツ替えたんやとか、
みんな、そんな話してたんよ……。
english: At the wake yesterday, everyone was talking about things like how I was always the one changing her diapers...

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese: なんで、なんでこんなことに……！
english: Why... why did it have to come to this...!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese:
潮ちゃん……ね……。
ウチの娘を……助けてくれて……。
亡くなったんよ……！！
english: Ushio-chan... you see... She saved... my daughter... And passed away...!!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese: 潮ちゃんは……娘の命の恩人……。

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
朝子ちゃん……。
潮は最後まで潮やった、
しおりちゃんが無事で何よりや。
english: Asako-chan... Ushio was Ushio until the very end. The most important thing is that Shiori-chan is safe.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese: アランさん……。
english: Alain-san…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（何を……泣いているのだ？

english: (What is she... crying for? This thing...)

japanese: 31.四度目の葬儀～聞き込み

english: (1:30. Ushio's coffin went into the furnace.)

japanese:
（収骨までの１時間……。

english: (One hour until we collect her ashes... It's time for everyone to have lunch.)

japanese:
（ここは情報を集める絶好のチャンス。

english: (This is the perfect chance to gather information. I'll try throwing two questions at the people I'm curious about.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ひとつは、影の病を知っているか……

english: (First, do they know about the Shadow Sickness... And second, have they seen a woman with a large chest...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （誰と話そうか…）

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さん。
影の病って知ってます？
english:
Totsumura-san.
Have you heard of the Shadow Sickness?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あーーーー、聞いたことあるなァ～～～～ッ。
怪談やろ、日都ヶ島の！
小っちゃい頃は怖かったなァ～～～～。
english: Ahhhhh, I've heard of that~~~! It's a ghost story from Hitogashima, right! I was scared of it when I was little~~~~.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
言うこときかん悪い子ォは
影が来て食べられるでーー、いうてなァ……。
english: They'd say that bad kids who don't listen will get eaten by Shadows...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……影って、実在すると思います？
english: ...Do you think Shadows actually exist?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
え？
いやいやいや、迷信やろ！
そんなモン、ホンマにおるかいな！！
english: Eh? No, no, no, it's just a superstition! There's no way something like that actually exists!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そう、ですよね……。
あの、もうひとついいですか？
english: Right, of course... Um, can I ask one more thing?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: んん？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
えーと……眼鏡かけた……。
なんというか……胸の大きな人、見ました？
english: Um... someone wearing glasses... How do I say this... did you see a woman with a large chest?

なんか危ない人？　潮ちゃんの棺、

Ｇカップやて！　Ｇ！！

japanese:
リアルにＧ！！　見たことある！？
ヤバイで！　エモいで！！
english: A real G-cup!! Have you ever seen one!? It was insane! So hot!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: れ、連絡先とかは……？
english: D-Did you get her contact info...?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
いやそれがよォ！！
聞こ思たら逃げられてん！
タイホしといたらよかった～～～～！！
english: Actually, about that!! I was gonna ask, but she ran away! I should've arrested her~~~~!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はぁ……そうですか……。
ありがとうございました……。
english: *Sigh*... I see... Thank you very much...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アラン。
影の病って知ってるか？
english:
Alain.
Have you heard of the Shadow Sickness?

speaker: Alan Kofune
english: Shadows…?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああ……そういうん、
琴子から昔聞いたような気ィすら……。
english: Ah... I feel like I might have heard something like that from Kotoko a long time ago...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（琴子……
　潮と澪のお母さんから……）
english: (Kotoko... Ushio and Mio's mother...)

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
いわゆるドッペルゲンガーやな。
フランスでも有名な話や！
エミリー・サジュちゅう人がおってな。
english: That's a so-called doppelgänger, right. It's a famous story in France too! There was a person named Emilie Sagée...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮からそういう話を聞いたことは？
english: Did Ushio ever tell you about this?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: 潮から！？
english: Ushio??

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
いや……？
影の話ら聞いてへんなァ……。
english: No...? I haven't heard anything about Shadows from her...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そっか……。
なぁ、もうひとつ聞きたいんやけど。
english:
I see…
Hey, I have one more question.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: なんや？
english: What?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
眼鏡かけてて、黒髪の……こう……
モデルみたいに
スタイルのいい人は見なかった？
english: Did you see someone wearing glasses, with black hair... like... a model with a really good figure?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
眼鏡……黒髪……モデル……？
ああ、ひづるか！
english:
Glasses… black hair… model…?
Ah, it's Hizuru!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……っ！
知り合いなのか？
english:
…!
Do you know her?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
おう……ここにも来てくれたで。
あの子昔、ウチによう食べに来てくれてたんや。
常連やったんよ。
english: Yeah... she came by here too. She used to come eat at our place a lot in the past. She was a regular.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ。そうなん？
english: Huh. Really?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
あァ。だいぶ前に島出たから、
慎平は覚えてへんかなァ。
english:
Yeah. She left the island a while back,
so you probably don't remember her.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 島を出た……？
english: She left the island…?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ああ、ひづるが中学生の頃や。
ちょっと……色々あってなァ。
島にも全然戻ってこんかったんや。
english: Yeah, when Hizuru was in middle school. Well... a lot of things happened. She hadn't come back to the island at all since then.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（言葉を濁してるってことは、

　これ以上は聞くべきじゃないな）
english: (If he's dodging the question, it must be something hard to talk about. I shouldn't pry any further.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ってことは、今は帰省してきてるのか。
アランが連絡したのか？
english: So that means she's back visiting her hometown now. Did you contact her, Alain?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
私が？　いやいや！
連絡先知らんかったしよォ。
どうも島に来たんは、仕事らしわ……。
english: Me? No, no! I didn't even know her contact info. It seems she came to the island for work...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 仕事？
english: Work?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: 東京でライターしてるとか言うてと。
english: She said she's working as a writer in Tokyo.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そっか……ありがとう。
english: I see... Thanks.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
雁切さん。
影の病って知ってます？
english: Karikiri-san. Do you know about the Shadow Sickness?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
知ってるも何も……。
「影の病」て名前を付けたんは、
私の曽祖父ですよ。
english: What do you mean do I know about it... The one who named it "Shadow Sickness" was my great-grandfather.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
えっ！？
そうだったんですか！？
english: Eh!? Is that so!?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ええ……江戸の終わりの頃です。
昔は何でも妖怪のせいにしたさけに……。
english:
Yes… in the late Edo period.
Back then, everything was blamed on yokai…

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
祖父の代までは神社でお祓いも
やっとったとか……。
english: I heard that up until my grandfather's generation, they even performed exorcisms at the shrine...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
へえ……。
ちなみに効き目のほうは？
english: Huh... And how effective were they, by the way?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
効き目！？
う～～～～ん、どうやろなァ……。
english: Effective!? Hmmmm, I wonder...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 雁切さんはしたことないんですか？
english: Have you ever done one, Karikiri-san?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
私はしたことないですね……。
普通の厄払いならしますけども……。
english: I've never done one... I do normal exorcisms, though...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あ！　それより慎平くん。
東京はどないですか？
english: Ah! More importantly, Shinpei-kun. How is Tokyo?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
実は私、去年行ったんですよ！
ホラあそこの、海の近くの何ていうたか――
english: Actually, I went there last year! You know that place near the sea, what was it called--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あかん、この人話し始めると長いんやった……。
　無理にでも話を進めんと！）
english: (Crap, this person talks forever once he gets started... I have to push the conversation forward, even if I have to force it!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの、もういっこいいですか？
眼鏡の、黒髪の……胸がぁ、大きな……。
そういう女性って見たことあります？
english: Um, can I ask one more thing? With glasses, black hair... and a large chest... Have you seen a woman like that?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ん～～……。
それ、もしかしてひづるちゃんやない？
南方ひづるちゃん！
english: Hmm... Could that be Hizuru-chan? Hizuru Minakata-chan!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
えーと……あれ……。
まだそのへんにいてんのかな？
english: Um... huh... I wonder if she's still around here?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （それらしい姿は見えないが……）
english: (I don't see anyone matching that description, though...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
<color=#GF_TIPS_119>菱形先生</color>。
聞きたいことがあるんですけど……。
今、大丈夫ですか？
english: <color=#GF_TIPS_119>Hishigata-sensei</color>. I have something I want to ask you... Is now a good time?

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ、キミか……。
何が聞きたいんだ？
english: Ah, it's you... What do you want to ask?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お医者さんにこういうのを聞くのは、
どうかと思うんですけど……。
影の病って……ご存知ですか？
english: I know it's a bit weird to ask a doctor about this, but... Do you know about... the Shadow Sickness?

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ……知っているよ、確かに。
……ある種の「精神疾患」が……、
この島で集団的に発生したのは事実だね。
english: Ah... I know of it, yes. ...It's a fact that a certain kind of "mental illness"... occurred collectively on this island.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ってことは、記録が残ってるんですか？
english: So there are records of it?

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: あぁ、ウチにも古いカルテが残っているよ。
english: Yes, there are old medical records left at my clinic too.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
<color=#GF_TIPS_057>カプグラ症候群</color>といってね……。
友人や家族など身近な人間が瓜二つの偽者と
入れ替わっていると認識してしまうんだ……。
english: It's called <color=#GF_TIPS_057>Capgras syndrome</color>... The patient believes that close people, like friends or family, have been replaced by identical imposters...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
っ……！！
ちなみに、先生は診たことありますか？
english: ...!! By the way, Sensei, have you ever treated a case?

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
私？　……まさか！
昭和初期の話だよ。
私はそういった症例を診た経験はないね。
english: Me? ...Of course not! This is a story from the early Showa period. I have no experience treating such cases.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうですか……あ、もうひとつ。
眼鏡をかけた黒髪の女性をご存じありませんか？
english:
I see… Oh, one more thing.
Do you know a woman with glasses and black hair?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
島外の人みたいなんですけど。
何というか、スタイルがいいというか……。
english: She seems to be from off the island. How do I say it, she has a really nice figure...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
……もしや、さっきのあの女か。
私は知らんね……。
english: ...Perhaps you mean that woman from earlier. I don't know her...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
アランが友人だとか言っていたが……。
棺を開けるような人間など知り合いにいてたまるか。
english: Alain said she was a friend of his, but... I would never associate with someone who would open a coffin.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
え……？
な、何の為に棺を……？
english: Eh...? W-Why would she open the coffin...?

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
知ったことか！
非常識な女だよ！　まったく……。
english: How should I know! What an absurd woman! Good grief...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そう、ですね……。
english: R-Right...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これで一通り話は聞いたな……。
　ちょっと整理してみよう）
english: (That's everyone I wanted to talk to... Let's organize this information.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（参列者のほとんどは「影の病」を知ってた。
　でも口を揃えて「迷信」「怪談」と言ってる）
english: (Most of the attendees knew about the "Shadow Sickness". But they all unanimously called it a "superstition" or a "ghost story".)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（みんな「影」という化物が
　実在するとは思っていない……）
english: (None of them think that monsters called "Shadows" actually exist...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（興味深いのは、
　宮司の雁切さんと、菱形先生の答えだ）
english: (What's interesting are the answers from Karikiri-san, the chief priest, and Hishigata-sensei.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（二人の話が事実なら、少なくとも江戸時代に
　「影」はすでにこの島に存在し、戦前まで
　しばしば目撃されていたことになる……）
english: (If what they said is true, "Shadows" already existed on this island since at least the Edo period, and were frequently sighted up until before the war...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そして、菱形医院に残っているという
　「古いカルテ」……。
　調べてみる価値はありそうだ）
english: (And the "old medical records" left at Hishigata Clinic... It seems worth investigating.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そして、何よりも……。
　驚いたことに、大勢の人が
　「眼鏡の女性」を知っていた！！）
english: (And more than anything... Surprisingly, many people knew about the "woman with glasses"!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（島出身の「南方ひづる」……。
　恐らく南雲先生の本名に違いない！）
english: (A local named "Hizuru Minakata"... That must be Nagumo-sensei's real name!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（「南雲竜之介」は覆面作家だから
　誰も南雲先生＝<color=#GF_TIPS_033>南方ひづる</color>だと知らないんだ！）
english: ("Ryunosuke Nagumo" is a pseudonymous author, so no one knows that Nagumo-sensei = <color=#GF_TIPS_033>Hizuru Minakata</color>!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しかも、コフネの常連だったとか……。
　なんちゅうニアミスしてたんだ！！）
english: (And she used to be a regular at Kofune... What a near miss we had!!)

japanese: 32.謎の暗号
english: 32. The Mystery Cipher

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しかし、誰も連絡先を知らないとは。
　これじゃどうやって捜せばいいか……）
english: (But to think no one knows her contact info. How am I supposed to find her now...)

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
なあ、慎平。
ちょっとコレ見てくれへんか？
english:
Hey, Shinpei.
Can you check this for me?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なに？
english: What?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
さっきは言うの忘れとったんやけど……。
ひづるに連絡先聞いたら、こんなもん渡されてよ。
私には意味がさっぱりやねん。
english: I forgot to mention this earlier, but... When I asked Hizuru for her contact info, she gave me this. I don't understand what it means at all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……！
english: Huh…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（連絡先！！
　南雲先生の！）
english: (Contact info!! Nagumo-sensei's!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: これを先生が……。
english: Sensei gave this to you...

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
そうなんやけど、
こんなん番号と違て暗号やろ？
ホンマ、変わった子やで……。
english: Yeah, but this isn't a phone number, it's a code, right? She really is a strange girl...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これが連絡先？　どういうことだ？
　アランの言う通り、まるで暗号――）
english: (This is her contact info? What does it mean? Just like Alain said, it's like a code--)

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
スマン慎平。
ちょっとトイレや……。
english: Sorry, Shinpei. I'm gonna use the restroom real quick...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: これは……この暗号は……！
english: This is... this code is...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレはこれと似たものを見たことがある！！
　南雲先生の「漂着」に出てくる、
　<color=#GF_TIPS_096>解けない暗号</color>――「タマム・シュッド」！！）
english: (I've seen something similar to this before!! It's the <color=#GF_TIPS_096>unbreakable cipher</color> from Nagumo-sensei's "Drift"-- "Tamam Shud"!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （確かこの暗号の解法は――）
english: (If I remember correctly, the solution to this cipher is--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よ、よし……！
　なんとか解けた……！）
english: (A-Alright...! I managed to crack it...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この数字の羅列は……電話番号か。
　連絡先なのは間違いなかったんだな）
english: (This string of numbers... It's a phone number. It really was her contact info.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……かけてみよう。
english: I'll give it a try.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ッ！！
もしもしッ！　南雲先生ですか！？
english: ...!! Hello! Is this Nagumo-sensei!?

speaker: 男の声（根津銀次郎）
japanese: ……誰や、おまえ？
english: …Who are you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（南雲先生じゃない……。
　しゃがれた男の声……
　どこかで聞いたような……）
english: (It's not Nagumo-sensei... A hoarse man's voice... I feel like I've heard it somewhere before...)

speaker: 男の声（根津銀次郎）
japanese:
人に名前を聞くんやったら、まず名乗れや。
それが礼節ちゅうモンちゃうかァ……？
english: If you're gonna ask for someone's name, introduce yourself first. Ain't that basic manners...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、あの……。
english: Ah, um…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オ、オレは網代慎平といいます……。
あなたは……？
english: I-I'm Shinpei Ajiro... And you are...?

speaker: 男の声（根津銀次郎）
japanese:
そうかえ……。
思ったより早かったな……。
english: Is that so... That was faster than I expected...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
儂は根津や。
根津銀次郎。
english:
I'm Nezu.
Ginjiro Nezu.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……根津さん！
　最初のループをする前に、
　コバマートで影の病について話してくれた人か！）
english: (...Nezu-san! The guy who told me about the Shadow Sickness at Koba Mart before the first loop!)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
「南雲先生」とは
ちょっとした知り合いでな……。
english: "Nagumo-sensei" and I are somewhat acquainted...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
どうやって知った？
おまえ……この番号を？
english: How did you find out? You... about this number?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 南雲先生がアランに渡した暗号で……。
english: Nagumo-sensei gave Alain a code...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 解いたんか、アレを？
english: You cracked that thing?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
は、はい！！
先生の本に似た暗号が出てくるので……。
english: Y-Yes!! A similar code appears in Sensei's book, so...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
物語の中では、
解法は明らかにされないんですが、
メタ的には推理できるようになってて……。
english: In the story, the solution isn't revealed, but it's designed so that you can deduce it from a meta perspective...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
試しにその解法で文字を変換したら……
１１ケタの数字になりました。
それで恐らく……電話番号だろうと……。
english: When I tried converting the characters using that solution... It became an 11-digit number. So I figured it was probably... a phone number...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: フン……。
english: Hm…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
おまえ……。
今、葬儀会場やな？
english: You... You're at the funeral hall right now, aren't ya?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、はい！
english: Yes!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ほなら、そこ抜けて表まで出てこい。
english: Then slip out of there and come out front.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……。
english: Eh...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
一人でや！
また連絡する。
english: Come alone! I'll contact you again.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの！！
もしもし！？
english: Um!! Hello!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（言われた通り一人で出てきたけど……。
　誰もいないぞ？）
english: (I came out alone like he told me to... But there's no one here?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もしもし！？
根津さん……つ、着きました！！
english: Hello!? Nezu-san... I-I'm here!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
よっしゃ……。
一人やな？
english: Alright... You're alone, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい！
もちろんです！
english:
Yes!
Of course!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの……。
こっからどうすれば……！？
english: Um... What should I do from here...!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 動くな。
english: Don't move.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
カカシみたいに……。
そこにジーッとォ立ってよよ。
english: Like a scarecrow... Just stand there completely still.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（！？
　一体どういうつもりだ！？）
english: (!? What is he planning!?)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: すぐ終わるさけ……。
english: It'll be over soon enough...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ちょっ……。
ウソでしょッ！！
english: Wait... You've gotta be kidding me!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （じ、地面に穴がっ……！！）
english: (Th-There's a hole in the ground...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今……何か撃ちました？
根津さん！？
english: Did you... just shoot something? Nezu-san!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 根津さんですよね、今の……！？
english: That was you just now, right, Nezu-san...!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: どうやら……人間みたいやな。
english: It seems… like a human.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレの影を狙撃して
　影かどうか確かめたのか……！？）
english: (He sniped my shadow to check if I was a Shadow...!?)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ひづるが会うそうや。
第四砲台跡まで来い。
english: Hizuru says she'll meet you. Come to the Fourth Artillery Battery Ruins.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ははは……。
自分の影とは言え銃で撃たれるって、
とんでもない経験かも……。
english: Hahaha... Even if it's just my shadow, getting shot with a gun might be a crazy experience...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（南雲先生……。
　ようやく会えるんだな……！）
english: (Nagumo-sensei... I'm finally going to meet you...!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ひづる)
japanese:
もしも、キミ。
ほんとうに戻れたのなら――。
english: If you... truly can return--

speaker: Ryunosuke Nagumo (ひづる)
japanese:
私に……キミの名を名乗りたまえ。
必ず助ける。
english: Tell me... your name. I will definitely help you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（初日から先生と協力できれば……
　ミオを倒せる！！）
english: (If I can cooperate with Sensei from the first day... We can defeat Mio!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それに、なんで先生は影のことを
　知っているのか……。
　聞くことは山ほどある……！！）
english: (And why does Sensei know about the Shadows... There's a mountain of things I need to ask her...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……第四砲台跡、か。
english: ...The Fourth Artillery Battery Ruins, huh.

japanese: 5周目
english: 5th Loop

japanese: 33.キミはタイムトラベラーだ
english: 33. You Are a Time Traveler

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （この辺りのはずだけど……）
english: (This should be around here…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あの、根津さん、ですね。
english: Um, you're Nezu-san, right.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あァ？
なんや……初対面のはずやけどな。
english: Hah? What... this should be our first time meeting.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あっ、そっか……。
　今回は会ってないんだよな）
english: (Ah, right... We haven't met yet this time around.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや……あ、あの！！
あなたも影のことを知って……？
english: No... u-um!! Do you know about the Shadows too...?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
聞きたい事あんねやったら、
まずはこっちの質問に答えてもらおうか。
english: If you've got things you wanna ask, first you're gonna answer my questions.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あの暗号の鍵になる単語は
作者「南雲竜之介」と、その本名――「南方ひづる」や。
english: The keywords for that cipher are the author "Ryunosuke Nagumo", and her real name-- "Hizuru Minakata".

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
つまり、この電話が鳴ったら、
その相手はひづるの正体を知っとるいうこっちゃ……。
どこで知った？
english: In other words, if this phone rings, the person on the other end knows Hizuru's true identity... Where did you learn it?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ひづるは儂以外の誰にも、
自分が小説家の「南雲竜之介」やとは言うてへんし、
実際、誰も知らん。
english: Hizuru hasn't told anyone but me that she's the novelist "Ryunosuke Nagumo", and in fact, no one else knows.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（信じてもらえるのだろうか。
　オレが未来を見て来ただなんて……）
english: (Will they believe me? That I came from the future...)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: おまえが影なんやったら話はわかるで。
english: If you're a Shadow, it makes sense.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
「知らん間ァにひづるが
コピーされとって正体がバレとる」……。
あいつが警戒してんのはそのパターンや。
english: "Hizuru was copied without us knowing, and her true identity was exposed"... That's the scenario she's on guard for.

speaker: ??? (Hizuru Minakata)
japanese: だが、キミは人間だ。
english: But you're human.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ah…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 南雲先生っ……！！
english: Nagumo-sensei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どうしよう、一体何から……
　あっ！！）
english: (What should I do, what should I start with... Ah!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
――あ、あのっ！！
南雲先生ッ、サインください！！
english: --U-Um!! Nagumo-sensei, please give me your autograph!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、網脂の網に依り代の代、慎む平らでっ！
「網代慎平くんへ」って、この本にお願いします！！
english: A-Ajiro with the character for net and substitute, Shinpei with the character for prudence and flat! Please write "To Shinpei Ajiro-kun" in this book!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えと……つまりっ……ファンです……！！
english: Um... what I mean is... I'm a fan...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生の出された本全部持ってます！！
こ、これ……ぬ、「沼男」も、
紙と電子両方持ってて……！！
english: I have all the books you've published!! T-This one... "Swampman" too, I have both the physical and digital versions...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よし……！
　言われた通りに名乗ったぞ！！）
english: (Alright...! I introduced myself just like she told me to!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（フカン的に見ても
　かなりキモくなってしまったが……！！
　さあ……ど、どうなる！？）
english: (Even from a bird's-eye view, that came off pretty creepy...!! Now... wh-what's going to happen!?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
この状況で……サイン？
キミは――
english: An autograph... in this situation? You are--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 普通じゃないね。
english: Not normal.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
「事実は小説よりも奇なり」と
バイロンは云った……。
english: Byron once said... "Truth is stranger than fiction".

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私は浪漫主義ではないが、
あらゆる可能性を観照しても
この結論に到達するのだ……。
english: I am not a romanticist, but even after contemplating every possibility, this is the conclusion I arrive at...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ほら、ご所望のものだ。
english: Here, what you requested.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの……ありがとうございます！！
こ、この本は家宝に――
english: Um... thank you very much!! I-I'll make this book a family heirloom--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
網代慎平。
今から述べる事が謬見ならば、
正してくれたまえ……。
english: Shinpei Ajiro. If what I am about to state is a fallacy, please correct me...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 今朝のフェリーではキミは私を知らなかったな？
english: This morning on the ferry, you didn't know me, right?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私の正体は私から名乗る以外に
知るすべはないが……。
私はまだ名乗っていない。
english: There is no way to know my true identity unless I introduce myself... And I have not introduced myself yet.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミは今日……この７月２２日を体験するのが
初めてではない。
何回も繰り返しているのではなかろうか。
english: Today... is not your first time experiencing this July 22nd. You have repeated it many times, haven't you?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: つまり、キミはタイムトラベラーだ。
english: In other words, you are a time traveler.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あァ！？
おまえ、何言うて――
english:
Ah!?
What are you saying--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はい……。
english: Yes...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: はい！？
english: Yes!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ム？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい！！
今……未来から戻って来ました。
english: Yes!! I just... returned from the future.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
english: Ushio...?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
よかったっ……！！
ひづるさんが……生き返った！！
english: Thank goodness...!! Hizuru-san... came back to life!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 動くな……ッ！！
english: Don't move…!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
待って根津さん！！
話を聞いてください！！
english: Wait, Nezu-san!! Please listen to me!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
どういうこっちゃ！！
こいつは昨日死んだ小舟の娘やないか！！
おまえやっぱり影の仲間か！！！
english: What is the meaning of this!! This is Kofune's daughter who died yesterday, isn't it!! You really are working with the Shadows!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
よせ、根津……。
早まるな！
english: Stop, Nezu... Don't be hasty!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ひづる！？
english: Hizuru!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
網代慎平。答えてくれ。
私は死んだのか？
english: Shinpei Ajiro. Answer me. Did I die?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……はい。
english: …Yes.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレは今までの出来事を
　すべて話した――）
english: (I told her everything that had happened up until now--)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
なるほど……。
キミが観測する世界が事実になる……
四本腕がそう言ったんだな？
english: I see... The world you observe becomes reality... That's what the four-armed one said?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ええ……。
でもなんで、オレにそんな力があるんか……。
english: Yes... But why do I have that kind of power...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミの右目がもともとハイネのものならば……。
その目は影で出来ているということだ。
いつプリントされたか、覚えてないのかね？
english: If your right eye originally belonged to Haine... That means that eye is made of a Shadow. Do you not remember when it was printed?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いえ……いつの間にかで……。
島に帰って来てからやとは思うんですけど……。
english: No... it just happened at some point... I think it was after I came back to the island, though...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ふむ……。
……今、私の中ですべてが繋がった。
english: Hmm... ...Everything has just connected in my mind.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
その目を網代慎平に授けたのは……
ウシオ。キミだな。
english: The one who bestowed that eye upon Shinpei Ajiro... Was you, Ushio.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
っ！？
わ……私が！？
どういうことですかっ！？
english: !? M... me!? What do you mean!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……授けた？
いや、「授ける」か……。
english: ...Bestowed? No, "will bestow", I suppose...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
まさに、卵が先か鶏が先かだな……。
因果性のジレンマ……循環する時の中で
「最初」は存在しない……。
english: It truly is a chicken or the egg dilemma... A causal loop... in circulating time, a "beginning" does not exist...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ニーチェも腰を抜かすだろう……。
english: Even Nietzsche would be dumbfounded...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ねえねえ、慎平……！
ひづるさんて何の先生！？
english: Hey, hey, Shinpei...! What kind of teacher is Hizuru-san!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……あ！　そっか……。
まだ言うてなかったっけ。
english: ...Ah! Right... I hadn't told you yet.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
南雲先生や。
ほら、小説家の……。
english: It's Nagumo-sensei. You know, the novelist...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……えーーーーっ！！！！
南雲って……あの南雲竜之介！？
english: ...Eeeehhh!!!! Nagumo... you mean that Ryunosuke Nagumo!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん。サインももろた。
english: Yeah. I even got an autograph.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
いつの間に！？
っていうか、女の人やったんや……。
知らんかった！
english: Since when!? Or rather, she was a woman... I didn't know!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もう１個、びっくりする情報があるぞ。
南雲先生は……コフネの常連やったらしい。
english: I've got another surprising piece of info. Nagumo-sensei... was apparently a regular at Kofune.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
え……えぇ～～～～ッ！？！？
ほんまに！？
スゴない！？
english: E... Eeh~~~~!? Really!? Isn't that amazing!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
なんやコレ……。
警戒しとる儂がアホなんか？
english: What is this... Am I an idiot for being cautious?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ウシオ……。
キミはキミの記憶を人に見せられると言ったな。
ぜひ私にも体験させてほしい。
english: Ushio... You said you can show your memories to others. I would very much like to experience it.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
っ！
私のこと……
今度は信用してくれるんですか？
english: ! Are you... going to trust me this time?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
網代慎平。
キミは、前回の失敗の原因を
何だと考えている？
english: Shinpei Ajiro. What do you consider to be the cause of our previous failure?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （失敗の原因……）
english: (The cause of the failure…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ひとつは、ミオを倒した後……
２３日から先生たちと
別行動を取ったことだと思います。
english: For one, after defeating Mio... I think it was taking separate actions from you guys starting on the 23rd.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
できるなら今回は、
みんなで協力したいです！！
english: If possible, this time... I want us all to cooperate!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ふむ……。
そうだな、私も同意見だ。
よろしく頼むよ。
english: Hmm... Yes, I am of the same opinion. I look forward to working with you.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: なっ……おい、ひづる！！
english: Wh... hey, Hizuru!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ひづるさん……。
english: Hizuru-san…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: なッ――
english: Wh--

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
english: ...!! ...Mm... guh... Wh-What is this...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんだ……？
　何が起こってるんだ……？）
english: (What...? What is happening...?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
脳に流れてくるこのイメージは……
ウシオの……記憶……？
english: These images flowing into my brain... Are they Ushio's... memories...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 根津……ウシオは味方だよ……。
english: Nezu… Ushio is an ally…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
彼女が最後まで味方だったからこそ、
あの「メッセージ」――私宛ての音声と……。
網代慎平の右目が、今ここにあるのだ……。
english: It's because she was an ally until the very end that that "message"-- the audio addressed to me... And Shinpei Ajiro's right eye, are here now...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キミを信じるよ、ウシオ。
english: I believe in you, Ushio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生……。
english: Teacher…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
嘘を心から信じられるのが人の業だ……。
貨幣然り、宗教然り、物語然り……。
だから私は、小説家なのだ。
english: Being able to truly believe in lies is human nature... Money, religion, stories... That is why I am a novelist.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 私のはフィクションちゃいます！
english: Mine isn't fiction!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ふっ。わかっているとも。
english: Hmph. I know.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……先生が笑ったの、初めて見た……）
english: (...That's the first time I've seen Sensei smile...)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……チッ！
おまえらも……命かけとるっちゅうわけかい……。
english: ...Tch! So you guys are putting your lives on the line too, huh...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 疑って悪かったな……。
english: Sorry for doubting you...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
根津さんも……
ありがとうございます！
english: Nezu-san, you too... Thank you!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
四本腕の目的はハイネを……
あの子を復活させることなのか……。
english: The four-armed one's goal is to revive Haine... That child...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……影たちは、
明後日の夏祭りに大勢の人を殺し……
ハイネに食べさせるつもりのようです。
english: ...It seems the Shadows are planning to kill a lot of people at the summer festival the day after tomorrow... and feed them to Haine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
その儀式の先に何があるのかはわかりませんが、
四本腕は確か、「エンディング」って……。
english: I don't know what lies beyond that ritual, but the four-armed one definitely called it the "ending"...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あのバカでかい平面がヤツの本体……
ヒルコ様なんや！
english: That ridiculously huge flat surface is its main body... Hiruko-sama!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
シオリの足元の影が
ヒルコ様の一部に過ぎやんなら……。
シオリをいくら殺しても死なんかった説明が付か！
english: If the shadow at Shiori's feet is nothing more than a part of Hiruko-sama... Then that explains why she didn't die no matter how many times we killed her!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
けど、シオリの戦闘能力は高くない……。
シオリやったら歩けるっちゅうだけで……
本体は弱ってて、あの洞窟から動けやんのです。
english: But Shiori's combat ability isn't high... She can just walk around as Shiori... The main body is weak and can't move from that cave.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
