japanese: なるほど……。
english: I see…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （つまりこういうことだろうか……）
english: (So it's something like this, then...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ヒルコ様は、ハイネの状態だと
　足が弱っていて満足に動けない。
　ヒルコ様本体も、衰弱して動けない状態だ）
english: (In Haine's state, Hiruko-sama's legs are weak and she can't move satisfactorily. Hiruko-sama's main body is also weakened and unable to move.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（一方で……シオリ状態なら歩き回れる。
　その際、足元の影は
　本体から分離した一部でしかない）
english: (On the other hand... in Shiori's state, she can walk around. In that case, the shadow at her feet is nothing more than a separated part of the main body.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そして今の時間、
　シオリは葬儀に参列している……）
english: (And at this current time, Shiori is attending the funeral...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キミたちのプランは？
english: What's your plan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうですね……今すぐでも地下へ潜って
本体を叩きたい……。
english: Let's see... I'd like to dive underground right now and strike the main body...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ですが、本体を守るあの四本腕を
確実に倒す目算がないと、二の舞になりそうです。
english: But unless we have a solid plan to defeat that four-armed one guarding the main body, history will just repeat itself.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
何より澪が心配ですし、窓たちのことも……。
何から手をつけるべきか……。
english: More than anything, I'm worried about Mio, and Sou and the others too... Where should we even start...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……私は。
前回と同じ様に、まずコバマートで
シオリを捕まえてほしい……！！
english: ...I want us to. First catch Shiori at Koba Mart, just like last time...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……しかし、殺せやんのやぞ！
捕まえてどないする？
english: But we can't kill it! What are we going to do once we catch it?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
それなんやけど……。
私……あいつを消せるかも。
english: About that... I might be able to erase her.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はい……。
english: Yes…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
はい！？
ど、どーいうこっちゃ？
english: What?! Wh-What do you mean?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……南雲先生……
　何も話していないのに気づいてくれるなんて……）
english: (...Nagumo-sensei... to think she noticed without me saying anything...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（くそっ……涙が……。
　泣いてる場合かよ、オレ！！
　しっかりしろ！）
english: (Damn it... my tears... This is no time to be crying!! Pull yourself together!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: なるほど……。
english: I see…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: だが、恐らく名乗ったのは私ではあるまい……。
english: But I doubt I was the one who gave my name...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キミは弟に会ったのか。
english: Did you meet your brother?

japanese: 34.駆除作戦
english: 34. Elimination Operation

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（葬儀が終わり、
　現在６時を少し回ったところ……）
english:
(The funeral has ended,
and it's just past 6 o'clock…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪と家まで帰ったオレは
　適当に理由をつけ外に出た）
english:
(After returning home with Mio,
I made up an excuse to go out)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そして再び南雲先生たちと合流し、
　オレたち三人はコバマートの前にいる）
english:
(Then I rejoined Nagumo-sensei and the others,
and the three of us are now in front of Koba Mart)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （南雲先生……一人で大丈夫なのか？）
english: (Nagumo-sensei... Will she be okay on her own?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 行くぞ、竜之介。
english: Let's go, Ryunosuke.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレを信じてくれる根拠はこの本ですね？
先生の書いた小説『沼男』は実話だ……！！
english: You're trusting me because of this book, right? Your novel, "Swampman," is based on a true story...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これに出てくる「スワンプマン」は
「影」にそっくりだし、
主人公の名前は先生の本名と同じ……！！
english: The "Swampman" in this story is exactly like a "Shadow," and the protagonist's name is your real name...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
つまりこれは、先生が中学の時に体験した
「事件」を元に書かれた……。
違いますか！？
english: In other words, this was based on an "incident" you experienced in middle school... Isn't that right?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミの言う通りだ。
脚色はしているし、結末も違うがね……。
english: You're right. I did dramatize it, and the ending is different, though...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私は１４年前、この島で……
ある影と出会い、そいつに家族を殺された。
english: Fourteen years ago, on this island... I encountered a Shadow, and it killed my family.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
その時、私を助けてくれたのが、
そこにいる根津銀次郎だ。
english: The one who saved me back then was Ginjiro Nezu over there.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そして同時に、私はある体験をした。
厳密にはその体験こそが、
キミを信じる根拠だよ。
english: And at the same time, I had a certain experience. Strictly speaking, that experience is the reason I believe you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ、それって……？
english: Wh-What do you mean...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
それは言えない。
私の正体に関わる事だからだ。
english:
I can't tell you.
It's related to my true identity.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
もしキミにしゃべり、キミがコピーされれば、
私の正体が影に知られてしまう。
そんなリスクは冒せない。
english: If I tell you and you get copied, the Shadows will learn my true identity. I can't take that risk.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 影は家族を狙うさけな。
english: Shadows go after the family.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ひづるもこの島に帰って来たら、
影に狙われる運命なんや……。
english: If Hizuru returns to this island, she's destined to be targeted by the Shadows...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 家……族？
english: Family…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……そうか！！　だから潮や澪、
そしてオレも狙われてるのか……！！
english:
…I see!! So that's why Ushio, Mio,
and even I are being targeted!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや……ま、待てよ。
じゃあアランは！？
english: Wait... Hold on. What about Alain?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 心配ない。
english: Don't worry.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
アランの影はすでに葬った。
さっきの葬儀の合間にな。
english:
I already eliminated Alain's Shadow.
I did it during the funeral.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ、そうだったんですね……！！
english: I-I see...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今までずっと……。
　南雲先生はオレの知らない所で
　戦ってくれていたんだ……！！）
english: (All this time... Nagumo-sensei has been fighting in places I didn't even know about...!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: これで、アランの影はもう生まれない。
english: His shadow will no longer be able to return.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
はしかと同じや。
「免疫」がつく……儂ァそう言うてる。
english: It's the same as measles. You get "immunity"... That's what I call it.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
影の病に罹っても、生まれた影を殺せたら、
もう一生なるこたないんやわ。
english: Even if you catch the Shadow Sickness, if you kill the Shadow that's born, you'll never get it again for the rest of your life.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
つ、つまり……
一度自分の影を倒せば、もう二度とコピーされない！？
english: I-In other words... If you defeat your own Shadow once, you'll never be copied again!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あァ……。
ほいで、儂には「免疫」がある。
english: Yeah... And I have "immunity."

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
せやさけ、儂の影は存在せぇへん……。
<color=#GF_TIPS_120>儂のこと</color>は信じてくれてかまへんで……。
english: That's why my Shadow doesn't exist... You can trust <color=#GF_TIPS_120>me</color>...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なるほど……。
english: I see…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（コピーされた人間には<color=#GF_TIPS_114>免疫</color>がつく。
　これは有益な情報だぞ）
english: (People who are copied gain <color=#GF_TIPS_114>immunity</color>. This is useful information.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも……先生はつまり、
免疫がないわけですよね？
english: But... Nagumo-sensei, you don't have immunity, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ではなぜ、
危険なこの島に帰って来たんですか！？
english: Then why did you come back to this dangerous island!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
「キミを助けに来た」……。
それだけは確かだ。
english:
"I came to help you…"
That much is certain.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私のことは信じない方が
いいかも知れんがな。
english: Though it might be better if you don't believe me.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: それで、キミのプランは？
english: So, what's your plan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
リミットは、あと５４時間です。
夏祭りの終わりにみんなが消えてしまう……！！
english: The limit is in 54 hours. Everyone will disappear at the end of the summer festival...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの四本腕の影……。
あいつがすべての影を
操っていたように感じました。
english:
That four-armed Shadow…
I felt like it was controlling all the Shadows.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あいつが現れた２４日の９時までに、
「四本腕」の正体をつきとめて
「駆除」できればと……。
english: If we can figure out the true identity of the "Four-Armed" Shadow and "eliminate" it by 9 a.m. on the 24th, when it appeared...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
駆除か……。
ええこと言わいしょ！
english: Elimination, huh... That's a good idea!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
見つけた影を片っ端から地道に
仕留めてったらエエ……。
ほんならいずれ「本命」にも当たら！
english: We just need to steadily take down the Shadows we find one by one... Then eventually we'll hit the "main target"!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
やるこたシンプル……。
害獣駆除や！！
english: It's simple... Pest control!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレの義妹の澪が危ないんです……！！
澪の影を倒すのに
力を貸していただけませんか！？
english:
My stepsister Mio is in danger…!!
Can you help me defeat Mio's Shadow!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いいだろう。キミのメモによれば、
今晩９時に洋食コフネの前にミオが現れる。
そこを狙おう……。
english: Alright. According to your notes, Mio will appear in front of Western Restaurant Kofune at 9 p.m. tonight. We'll target her there...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: だが、その前に片づけるべき問題がある。
english: But there's another issue to deal with first.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 「小早川家」ですね……？
english: The Kobayakawa family, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 失敗しますよ、このままやったら……。
english: You're bound to fail if you go as you are...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 何やて！？
english: What!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレは見てきました……。
２４日。あの境内に……シオリはいたんです！！
english: I saw it... On the 24th. Shiori... was on the shrine grounds!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
つまり、私は今日シオリを葬り損なう……。
というわけか。
english: So I will fail to eliminate Shiori today... Is that it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい……！！
だからオレも一緒に行かせてください！
english:
Yes…!!
So let me come with you too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
シオリが潮を殺した犯人だ！！
もう間違いありませんッ……。
あいつはカタキでもあるんです！！！！
english: Shiori is the one who killed Ushio!! There's no mistaking it... She's also my enemy!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それに最悪、
　また失敗したとしても……）
english: (Besides, even if the worst happens and we fail again...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なぜ失敗したのか？
　その理由を知っておきたい！！）
english: (Why did we fail? I want to know the reason!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……いいだろう。
english: …Alright.

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
だが、家の中に入るのは
私一人でいい……。
english: But I'm the only one who needs to go inside...

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生、どうしたんですか？
スマホで何かを聞いてるみたいで……。
english:
Nagumo-sensei, what's wrong?
You seem to be listening to something on your phone…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あァ……。
あいつにはひづるの時の記憶がないさけ。
english: Ah... He doesn't have memories from when he's Hizuru.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
え！？
それってどういう……。
english: Huh!? What does that mean...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生の正体に関すること……なのか？
　なら聞けないな……）
english:
(Is it something about Nagumo-sensei's true identity?
Then I can't ask…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今はとにかく信じよう。
　頼みますよ、先生……！！）
english: (For now, I'll just trust her. I'm counting on you, Nagumo-sensei...!!)

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 了解、お姉ちゃん。
english: Understood, Sis.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese:
あ！
ひづる！！
english:
Ah!
Hizuru!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
夕食時にすんませ――。
いや、すまない。
english: Sorry to intrude during dinner—. No, my apologies.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
せっかくなので
お土産を渡しとこうと思ってな。
english: I had some gifts from Tokyo to give you.

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese:
エーーーーっ！
かめへんのにそんなん～！！
english: Eeeeeh! You didn't have to do that~!!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese: ……どうぞ上がってェ～。
english: …Please come in.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: では失礼。
english: Excuse me, then.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
悪いな、朝子……。
ここで荷物を開けても？
english:
Sorry, Asako…
Can I open this here?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese: うん！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese:
なァ、ひづる……。
よかったら、ごはん食べて行かん？
english: Hey, Hizuru... If you'd like, do you want to stay for dinner?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese:
話したい事、いっぱいあるんよ――
旦那も紹介したいし。
english: I have so much I want to talk about— I want to introduce my husband, too.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
……いえ。
すぐにおいとま致します。
english: No, thank you. I won't be staying long.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（よし、頭をつぶした……！
　でもあくまで影の本体は平面！！）
english: (Alright, I crushed its head...! But the Shadow's true body is 2D!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（立体への攻撃はダメージを与えられない……
　が、僕を視ているのは
　あくまで顔に付いている両目！！）
english: (Attacking its 3D form doesn't deal damage... but it's using the eyes on its face to see me!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （たとえ一時でも、つぶすことに意味はある！！）
english: (Even if it's only temporary, crushing them has meaning!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（この家にはあと二体の影がいる……！
　アサコの旦那タツオと娘のシオリ！）
english:
(There are two more Shadows in this house…
Asako's husband Tatsuo and daughter Shiori!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（影の殺し方を知っている事がバレたら、
　こいつらは僕を警戒して近付いて来なくなる）
english: (If they find out I know how to kill Shadows, they'll be on guard and won't come near me.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （殺すなら、なるべく同時がベスト……！！）
english: (If I'm going to kill them, it's best to do it at the same time...!!)

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの……！！
もしかしてですけど……。
english: I was wondering...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 何や……。
english: What?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
南雲先生は……。
二重人格なんですね？
english: Nagumo-sensei... Do you have a split personality?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
二重人格！！？
……なんでそーなる？
english: A split personality!!? ...Why would you think that?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 砲台跡で先生がつぶやいた言葉です！！
english: It's what Nagumo-sensei muttered at the cannon ruins!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
「キミは弟に会ったのか」……。
あれって、つまり！！
english:
"Did you meet your brother?"…
That means…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
フン……当たらずとも
遠からじっちゅうトコやな……。
english: Hmph... It's not entirely wrong...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ほ、ほんまに先生一人で
大丈夫なんですか！？
english: I-Is Nagumo-sensei really going to be okay alone!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
儂らはここで待つ！
合図があるまでな……。
english:
We'll wait here!
Until we get the signal…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
見て来たんやったら知っとんねやろ？
「竜之介」には、
影と戦うだけの力がある……。
english: If you've seen it, then you know, right? "Ryunosuke" has the strength to fight Shadows...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……竜之介！？
english: …Ryunosuke!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: あァ……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: あいつは強い……！！
english: He's strong…!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ハッキリ言うとくがよ……。
儂ァ、あいつみたいにおまえを信用してへんし……。
ループがどうとか意味がわからんが……。
english: I'll be blunt... I don't trust you like she does... And I don't understand what this loop nonsense is...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ひづるのヤツが言うとったやろ？
english: Hizuru told you, didn't she?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
「おまえの見て来た未来とやらでは、
おまえは小早川家におらんかった」。
english: "In this future you saw, you weren't at the Kobayakawa house."

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
「おまえが中に入ったら、
小早川しおりの影を逃がす原因が
変わってしまうかもしらん……」。
english: "If you go inside, the reason Shiori Kobayakawa's Shadow escapes might change..."

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 「そしたら、次の対策を正しく立てられん」……。
english: "And if that happens, we won't be able to form the right countermeasures next time..."

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あいつは失敗の原因を見極めようとしとる。
儂らにできるんは、待つことだけや……！！
english:
She's trying to figure out the cause of the failure.
All we can do is wait…!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……はい。
english: …Yes.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ええか？
あいつはおまえを信じたんや。
english: Listen up. She believed in you.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あいつが死ぬんは今日やない……。
その話がウソやったら、儂ァおまえを許さんぞ……。
english: She isn't going to die today... If that turns out to be a lie, I won't forgive you...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Yes…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （確かに先生は強かった……）
english: (It's true, Nagumo-sensei was strong...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（神社でミオを倒した時も、
　あのすばしっこい影よりも速く動いていた……
　あれが「竜之介」！！）
english: (When she defeated Mio at the shrine, she moved faster than that agile shadow... That was "Ryunosuke"!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
根津さん……。
その、「竜之介」さんについて……。
教えてもらえませんか……！？
english: Nezu-san... About this "Ryunosuke"... Could you tell me about him...!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
チッ……。
まァ、調べりゃすぐわかってまう事か……。
english: Tch... Well, you'd find out soon enough if you looked into it...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ひづるには双子の弟がおったんや……。
それが竜之介や。
english:
Hizuru had a twin brother…
That was Ryunosuke.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
１４年前……。
タカノス山であいつの死体が見つかった。
english:
Fourteen years ago…
His body was found on Mt. Takanosu.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ひづるの悲鳴を聞いて……。
近くで仕事をしとった儂が駆けつけた。
english:
When I heard Hizuru's scream…
I rushed over since I was working nearby.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
竜之介は……。
ヒドイ有り様やった。
english:
Ryunosuke was…
In a terrible state.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……と、言うと？
english: ...Meaning?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 食われとったんや……。
english: He was eaten.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
体中に……肉を噛みちぎられた跡があった。
みんな、野犬の仕業や言うて大騒ぎや……。
english: All over his body... there were bite marks where flesh was torn off. Everyone made a huge fuss, saying it was the work of wild dogs...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
警察の指揮の下、すぐに山狩り……。
せやけど、ひづるは言うた……。
english: A mountain hunt was organized immediately under police direction... But Hizuru said...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: これは「殺人です」ってなァ……！！
english: This was a "murder"...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ、その根拠は？
english: Wh-What was her proof?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
噛み傷にまぎれてな……この首の所に……。
絞められた跡があったんや……！！
english: Mixed in with the bite marks... right here on his neck... There were marks from being strangled...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
<color=#GF_TIPS_035>竜之介</color>は食い殺されたんやない。
殺されてから食われたんやと……。
english: <color=#GF_TIPS_035>Ryunosuke</color> wasn't eaten to death. He was killed first, and then eaten...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: それがひづるの主張やった。
english: That was Hizuru's claim.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
せやけど、検死の結果は「出血性ショック死」や……。
ひづるの言うことら誰も信じやんかった。
english: But the autopsy results were "death by hemorrhagic shock"... No one believed what Hizuru said.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 調べようにも、遺体はその日の内に焼かれてしもた。
english: Even if we wanted to investigate, the body was cremated that same day.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
根津さん……！！
それって潮と……。
english: Nezu-san... That sounds exactly like Ushio...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ああ……よう似とるやろ？
english: Yeah, ain't it similar?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: すべてはつながってるんかも知らん。
english: Everything might be connected.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
１４年前から――いや、もっと昔から、
この島に巣食う化物……。
english: The monsters that have been nesting on this island since fourteen years ago—no, even longer...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 影は儂らから家族を奪った……。
english: The Shadows took our families from us...

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa (Shiori)
japanese:
パパ？
……ママ？
english:
Dad?
…Mom?

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa (Shiori)
japanese:
ウソや……。
な、なんで？
english: No way... Wh-Why?

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa (Shiori)
japanese: なんで殺したん？
english: Why did you kill me?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （外した！？）
english: (I missed!?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（いや、手応えはあった！！
　確実にハンマーで影を潰していた……！）
english: (No, I felt resistance!! I definitely smashed the Shadow with my hammer...!)

speaker: Shiori
japanese: ……ちッ！
english: …Tch!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（逃げた……浅かったか……！？
　端では大したダメージではないか……）
english: (It ran away... Was it too shallow...!? I guess hitting the edge doesn't do much damage...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（いや！！　しかし妙だ……。
　本来なら確実に、致命の一撃のはずなのに）
english: (No!! But it's strange... Normally, that should have been a guaranteed fatal blow.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（何かおかしい……。
　あの影……「シオリ」！！）
english: (Something's wrong... That Shadow... "Shiori"!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（しかし、やはり３階に逃げたか……
　お姉ちゃんが言うた通りや……）
english: (But it really did run to the third floor... Just like Sis said...)

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
儂はこの島から、
影を一匹残らず「駆除」しよう思とる……
命をかけてな。
english: I intend to "eliminate" every last Shadow from this island... even if it costs me my life.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
おまえにもその覚悟はあんのか？
慎平……！！
english: Do you have that kind of resolve? Shinpei...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい……！！
オレも家族を守りたい……。
命にかえてもです！！
english: Yes...!! I want to protect my family, too... Even if it costs me my life!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 覚悟ならあります！！
english: I have the resolve!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
フン！
儂ァ、言葉は信用せん……。
おしゃべりが過ぎた……。
english: Hmph! I don't trust words... We've talked too much.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: おまえはもう黙ってろ……。
english: Just stay quiet now...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
せ、先生からのメッセージですね！？
オレにも見せてください！
english: Th-That's a message from Nagumo-sensei, right!? Let me see it, too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
「アサコとタツオは排除。
　シオリを討ちもらしました。
　３階へ逃亡」……。
english: "Asako and Tatsuo are eliminated. Failed to kill Shiori. Escaped to the third floor"...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
「追いますが、慎平さんの言う通りに
　なるかもしれません」か……。
english: "I will pursue, but it might turn out just as Shinpei-san said," huh...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: チッ！
english: Tch!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
プランＢに変更やな……！
儂らの出番や。
english: Change to Plan B...! It's our turn.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: プランＢ……！！
english: Plan B...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ホレッ！
おまえの釘打機や！
english:
Here!
Your nail gun!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
見せてもらおやないか……。
おまえの覚悟っちゅうやつをよォ……。
english: Let's see it, then... This resolve of yours...

japanese: 35.影を捕獲しろ
english: 35. Capture the Shadow

japanese: 南方　竜之介
english: Ryunosuke Minakata

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（３階の間取りは……
　収納が３つにトイレ……夫婦の寝室が１つ。
　ベランダがあるな……）
english: (The layout of the third floor is... three closets, a toilet... and the master bedroom. There's a balcony...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（そして、隣が子供部屋……。
　角部屋で窓が２つ……）
english: (And next to it is the children's room... A corner room with two windows...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（北側――ここにもベランダ……。
　窓が少し開いている……）
english: (On the north side—there's a balcony here too... The window is slightly open...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（追加で連絡しておくか。
　３階、北側の窓……）
english: (I should send an additional message. Third floor, north window...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 背後をとっても無駄ですよ。
english: Taking my back is useless.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
コピーする光を放った後、
あなたは数秒間身動きがとれなくなる。
english: After emitting the copying light, you're unable to move for a few seconds.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
人間一人の情報をスキャンするのには、
結構労力がかかるってことのようですね……。
english: It seems it takes quite a bit of effort to scan the information of a single human...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 僕がその一瞬を見逃すと思いますか？
english: Do you think I'd miss that moment?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
あなたが僕をコピーしようとした瞬間！
あなたを殺します、今度こそね……。
english: The moment you try to copy me! I'll kill you... this time for sure.

speaker: Shiori
japanese: ……つまらん。
english: …How boring.

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
網代慎平の言うように、
私はシオリを逃がしてしまうのだろうな。
english: Just as Shinpei Ajiro said, I will likely end up letting Shiori escape.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
おいおい……。
こんなワケのわからんヤツを信じてよォ……。
english: Hey, hey... You're actually believing this guy and his nonsense...?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
やる前から失敗するかもとか
気ィの弱いこと考えるさけ、
失敗してしまうんとちゃうんかい！！？
english: Thinking weak thoughts about how it might fail before you even try is exactly why you end up failing!!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
笑止……！！
これはそんな昭和の根性論とは無関係だ。
english: Ridiculous...!! This has nothing to do with that Showa-era willpower nonsense.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ぐぬぬ……。
english: Grr...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
それに、カン違いするな。
私はシオリを逃すつもりは一切ない。
english:
Don't misunderstand.
I have no intention of letting Shiori escape.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私は家の「中」で従来通りに動くが、
キミたちには「外」で、違う行動をとってもらう！
english: I will move "inside" the house exactly as before, but I want you two to take different actions "outside"!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
重要なのはここからだ……。
根津にはバックアップとして南側……。
家の裏手に待機してもらうつもりだった。
english: This is the important part... I had planned for Nezu to wait around the back on the south side as backup.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
これはキッチンとトイレの窓、
そして玄関を見通せるポジションだからだが……。
english: This is because it's a position with a clear view of the kitchen and bathroom windows, as well as the front door...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
それでは逃げられたのだ……。
浴室の窓も捨て切れんが……。
english: But that allowed it to escape... I can't completely rule out the bathroom window, but...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ヤツが逃げたのは、
２階からではない可能性が高い。
english: It's highly likely that it didn't escape from the second floor.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 私は３階のシオリの部屋だと推測する。
english: I surmise it used Shiori's room on the third floor.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
シオリの部屋だけが
「北側」に窓が付いているからだ……。
english: Because only Shiori's room has a window facing "north"...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私が合図を出したら、
キミたちは武器を持ち、
家の正面で待機したまえ。
english: When I give the signal, grab your weapons and wait at the front of the house.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 根津さん、窓から影が！
english: Nezu-san, a Shadow is coming from the window!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
来よったな……！
これが――
english: So it's here...! This is—

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 「<color=#GF_TIPS_111>プランＢ</color>」じゃ……！！
english: "<color=#GF_TIPS_111>Plan B</color>"...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
縫い付けたつもりが……３本目を外したか……！！
やったら――
english: I thought I pinned it down... Did I miss the third shot...!! In that case—

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 来いやァァァ！！！！
english: Bring it on!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……ッ！
　こっちに来る……！！）
english: (...! It's coming this way...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（つまり、隠れてるオレに
　気付いてないってことだ……！）
english: (Which means it hasn't noticed me hiding here...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （動くなら今……！）
english: (If I'm gonna move, it's now...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どうする……？
　撃つにはまだ遠い……！？
　だったら……飛びかかって動きを封じる！？）
english: (What do I do...? It's still too far to shoot...!? In that case... should I jump it and seal its movements!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ネイルガンを撃つのは初めてだ……
　もしここで当たらなかったら……？
　いや、考えてる場合かッ！）
english: (This is my first time firing a nail gun... What if I miss here...? No, this is no time to be thinking!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どんどん近付いてくる！！
　覚悟を……決めろ！！）
english: (It's getting closer!! I have to... steel my resolve!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （気づかれた！！）
english: (It noticed me!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （悩んでる暇なんかない！）
english: (I don't have time to hesitate!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今しかない……！！
　撃つんだ、オレェ！！）
english: (It's now or never...!! Shoot it, me!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （外した！！）
english: (I missed!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ど、どうにかしないと……！！）
english: (I-I have to do something...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （でも、どうすれば――）
english: (But what can I—)

speaker: Shiori
japanese: 邪魔やァ！！
english: Out of the way!!

speaker: Shiori
japanese: ハッ！！？
english: Hah!!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
足が止まった！！
慎平さんッ！！
english: Its feet stopped!! Shinpei-san!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くっそォォォォ！
english: Daaamn it!!

speaker: Shiori
japanese: ハッ！！？
english: Hah!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐっ……おおおお！！！！
english: Guh... Oooohhh!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……おまえが！！
おまえがやったんか！？
english: ...You!! Did you do it!?

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
きしょいんじゃ……。
離せよ、ボケ！
english: You're creeping me out... Let go, idiot!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえが潮を……殺したんかァッ！！！！
english: Did you... kill Ushio!!!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
もうええ……ッ。
はなれろ、慎平……！！
english: That's enough... Let go, Shinpei...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 影を釘でブッ刺した。
english: I pierced the Shadow with a nail.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
そいつァ、もう、
指ひとつ動かせやんさけ……。
english: It can't even move a single finger anymore...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: １本でも２本でもアカン……。
english: One or two won't do it...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
そうやって３か所な……。
釘とか杭で影をブッ刺せたらよォ……。
english: You gotta hit three spots like that... If you pierce a Shadow with nails or stakes...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
奴らはその場に縫い止められる……！！
つまり捕獲できるちゅうこっちゃ……！！
english: They'll be pinned in place...!! Meaning they can be captured...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ほ……捕獲！！
プランＢって……。
最初からそのつもりで！？
english: C-Capture!! So Plan B was... Was that your intention from the start!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: おうよ。
english: Yup.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: き、聞いてないですよ！！
english: I-I didn't know!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
そら言うてへんもん！
ハナからおまえに期待してへん！
english: Course I didn't tell ya! I didn't expect anything from you from the start!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （くっ……このジジイ……！！）
english: (Ugh... this old geezer...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、でもスゴイぞ！
　シオリを捕まえられるなんて……）
english: (No, but this is amazing! To think we could capture Shiori...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これで未来が変わる！
　……確実に！！）
english: (This will change the future! ...For sure!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: どうして飛びかかったんです？
english: Why did you jump at it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それは……。
より確実な方法を選んだだけです。
english: That's... I just chose the more reliable method.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ちょっとでも影の動きを止められたら、
根津さんが絶対やってくれるやろうって。
english: I figured if I could stop the Shadow's movement even a little, Nezu-san would definitely take care of it.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
english: Mm…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まあ、つまり……。
とっさの行動の結果です。
english: Well, in other words... It was a spur-of-the-moment action.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
なるほど……。
影は立体を平面の中に潜らせ、
すばやく動くことができます。
english: I see... Shadows can submerge their 3D forms into 2D surfaces and move quickly.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
……が、
どうやら立体の方を掴まれていると、
潜れなくなるようですね。
english: ...However, it seems that if their 3D form is grabbed, they can no longer submerge.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
これは新発見ですよ、慎平さん！！
おかげで逃がさなかった！
english: This is a new discovery, Shinpei-san!! Thanks to you, it didn't get away!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
僕たち二人では、
やはり失敗してましたね？　根津さん。
english: Just the two of us would have failed after all, right? Nezu-san.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
フンッ！　……若いわりに、
肝は据わっちゃあるようやな……。
english: Hmph! ...You've got some guts for a young guy...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: やらいしょ。
english: Not bad.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （根津さん……）
english: (Nezu-san...)

speaker: Shiori
japanese: うふふふふふふふふふふふふ。
english: Ufufufufufufufufufufufufu.

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
うふっ！
うふふふふふふふっ。
english: Ufu! Ufufufufufufufu.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 何がおかしい？
english: What's so funny?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
……二人とも。
こいつは他の影とは何か違います。
english: ...You two. This one is somehow different from the other Shadows.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
捕獲に変更したのは、
こいつを調べたいと考えたからです。
english: I changed the plan to capturing it because I wanted to investigate it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 何かが違う……？
english: Something is different...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
まずはさっきの慎平さんの
質問に答えてもらいたいですね……。
english: First, I'd like it to answer Shinpei-san's question from earlier...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: っ！

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
おまえが小舟潮を殺し、
その影を生み出したんか？
english: Did you kill Ushio Kofune and give birth to her Shadow?

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
あ～～……。
潮おねえちゃんな……？
english: Ah~~... Ushio-oneechan...?

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
うん、殺したよ。
あたしが首絞めて殺した。
english: Yeah, I killed her. I strangled her to death.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……殺したっ……て……。
english: ...You... killed her...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
慎平さん。
落ち着いて。
english:
Shinpei-san.
Stay calm.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんでや！？
なんで潮をッ……。
english: Why!? Why did you do that to Ushio...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえらは何をしてるんや！！！？
人、殺して入れ替わって……。
何が目的なんや！！！！
english: What the hell are you guys doing!!!? Killing people and taking their places... What is your goal!!!!

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
おわりやねん……この夏で。
もう、おしまいやねん。
english: It's over... this summer. It's already over.

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
せやから帰るんです。
かぞくで帰るんです。
english: That's why we're going home. We're going home as a family.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……なんやと？
いったい、何の話をしてる？
english: ...What? What on earth are you talking about?

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
くっくっくっくっくっ……。
そんなに怖がらんといてください……。
english: Kukukukuku... Please don't be so scared...

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
慎平さん……。
カン違いしてますよ？
english: Shinpei-san... You're misunderstanding.

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
人間のあたしは確かに影に殺されたけど、
あたし別に影のことうらんでへんし……。
もう怖くもない……。
english: The human me was definitely killed by a Shadow, but I don't really resent the Shadows... I'm not scared anymore either...

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
影はあたしを、
完璧にコピーしたんですよ……。
english: The Shadow copied me perfectly...

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
体も心も記憶も。
だから、あたしは小早川しおり。
english: My body, my mind, and my memories. That's why I'm Shiori Kobayakawa.

speaker: Shiori
japanese: ただ生まれ変わっただけですよ……。
english: I was just reborn…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ウソをつくな！！！！
おまえはしおりちゃんじゃない！！
english: Don't lie!!!! You're not Shiori-chan!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
しおりちゃんも！　その家族も！
おまえが殺したんやろがッ！！
english: Shiori-chan! Her family! You're the one who killed them!!

speaker: Shiori
japanese: 慎平さんも早よ影になったらええのに……。
english: You should become a Shadow soon too, Shinpei-san...

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
ね？
あたしのお兄ちゃんになってよ。
english: Okay? Become my big brother.

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
うふっ……。
あははははっ、あはははははっ……ふふっ！
english: Ufu... Ahahahaha, ahahahahaha... fufu!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くっ……！
english: Ugh...!

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
あはははははははっ！
ははははっ、ふふふふあははっ――！
english: Ahahahahahahaha! Hahaha, fufufu, ahaha—!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
ここまでにしときましょうか……。
あまり影と長く話すと、惑わされてしまいます。
english: Let's stop here... If you talk to a Shadow for too long, you'll be led astray.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Damn it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮を殺した犯人……！！
　見つけたら殺してやろうと思ってた……）
english: (The culprit who killed Ushio...!! I thought I would kill them when I found them...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それが化物なら
　躊躇することもないと……）
english: (If it was a monster, I wouldn't hesitate...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、こうやって目の前に現れて……。
　それが小さい頃から知ってる
　近所の子供の姿で……）
english: (But having it appear right in front of me like this... taking the form of a neighborhood kid I've known since they were little...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレは殺すどころか……。
　殴ることさえできなかった……！！）
english: (Far from killing it... I couldn't even throw a punch...!!)

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
japanese: 36.影に惑わされるな
english: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: しぶとい奴やったのォ……。
english: That one was tough...

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: アサコとタツオはどやったんや？
english: How were Asako and Tatsuo?

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
普通です。
ハンマーで一撃です。
english: Normal. One hit with the hammer did it.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
「人間の致命傷と同量のダメージを
平面に与えれば影は死ぬ」……。
english: "If you deal the equivalent of a fatal wound to a human to its 2D plane, the Shadow will die"...

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
この姉の仮説がまちがいか……。
シオリだけが特別タフだったのか……。
サンプル不足ですね……。
english: Either my sister's hypothesis is wrong... Or Shiori was exceptionally tough... We lack sufficient samples...

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
妙な事も言うとったな。
家族で帰るとか何とか……。
english: It said some weird things, too. Something about going home with its family...

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
コピーが……。
本物の人間と同じ様にふるまうなんて……。
english: A copy... Acting just like a real human...

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
シオリは「生まれ変わった」
と言うとったな……。
english: Shiori said she was "reborn"...

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
「完璧なコピーは、本物と何が違うのか」……。
これは「<color=#GF_TIPS_099>沼男</color>」のテーマでしたね、
竜之介さん……！！
english: "What is the difference between a perfect copy and the original"... That was the theme of "<color=#GF_TIPS_099>Swampman</color>," wasn't it, Ryunosuke-san...!!

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: えっ！
english: Huh?!

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
「二重人格」ってトコまでは言うちゃある……。
ひづるがええ言うたさけよ。
english: He did mention the "split personality" part... Hizuru said it was fine.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
そうですか。
では、はじめましてですね！
english: Is that so? Then, it's nice to meet you!

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
南雲竜之介です。
南方ひづるの弟だった者です。
english: I am Ryunosuke Nagumo. The person who used to be Hizuru Minakata's younger brother.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの……確認ですが、
小説を書かれているのは竜之介さん……？
english: Um... just to confirm, you're the one writing the novels, Ryunosuke-san...?

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
あっ、いえいえ！！
書いているのは姉です。
english: Ah, no, no!! My sister is the one writing them.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
双子ですが、僕に文才はありません。
姉がペンネームの一部に、
僕の名前を使ったというだけです。
english: We're twins, but I have no literary talent. My sister just used my name as part of her pen name.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
僕が「表」に出るのは、
姉が嫌いな人付き合い……。
english: I only come out to the "front" to handle the socializing my sister hates...

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
取材を受けたりだとか、打ち合わせだとかに
行かなければならない時で……。
english: Like when she has to do interviews or go to meetings...

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
だから僕も、
「南雲竜之介」を名乗ってるんです。
もう、ずうっとね……。
english: That's why I also go by "Ryunosuke Nagumo." For a long time now...

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
にしても、慎平さんって
姉の本を読んだことあるんですね。
english: Still, Shinpei-san, you've read my sister's books before, haven't you.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
え！？
いや、あるどころか……。
english: Well, actually...

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
こいつオタクや！
南雲オタク！！
english: He's a nerd! A Nagumo nerd!!

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
おや！？
そうなんですか？
english: Is that right?

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
そんな話はレコーダーに入ってなかったな。
きっと姉の照れ隠しですね。
english: That wasn't on the recorder. She was probably just trying to hide her embarrassment.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
余計な事言うたら、
ひづるが怒りよるぞ。
english: If you say anything unnecessary, Hizuru will get mad.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
ハハ、確かに。
ではここからは姉に任せます。
english: Haha, true. Well then, I'll leave it to my sister from here.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: カン違いしないでおきたまえよ。
english: Don't get the wrong idea.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……？
english: Huh…?

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私は別に照れていないし、
ゆえに隠してもいない！
english: I wasn't embarrassed, and therefore I wasn't hiding anything!

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
伝える必要のないことを……。
こう……カットしただけだ！！
english: I just... cut out the things that didn't need to be said!!

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Nagumo... sensei...?

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（か、髪をほどくと
　ひづるさんの人格に戻るのか……）
english: (S-So when she unties her hair, she reverts to Hizuru-san's personality...)

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
先ほどの「沼男」の話に戻るが……。
影の姿と言葉に心を動かすな、網代慎平。
english: Returning to the "Swampman" topic from earlier... Do not let the Shadows' appearances and words sway your heart, Shinpei Ajiro.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
今後ヤツらが友人や家族……。
愛する者の姿で現れたとしても
ためらってはならん。
english: From now on, even if they appear in the form of your friends or family... or someone you love, you must not hesitate.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
時間はないのだ……。
コピーとオリジナルの同一性について哲学するのは、
すべてが終わってからでよい。
english: We don't have time... You can philosophize about the identity of copies and originals after everything is over.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
小早川家は手遅れだった……だが。
キミはまだ間に合うのだぞ。
english: We were too late for the Kobayakawa family... but. You can still make it in time.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キミは本当に……ミオを殺せるか？
english: Can you really... kill Mio?

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 儂らは時間まで外で待機しとるさけな……。
english: We'll be waiting outside until it's time...

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 了解です。
english: Understood.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ、そうだ……。
連絡先を交換しておこうか。
少しでも今までと異なる出来事が起きたら、教えるのだ。
english: Ah, right... Let's exchange contact info. If even the slightest thing happens differently from before, tell me.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
可能な限り今までの周回と同じ様に過ごし、
事態を見極めろ。
english: Spend your time as close to your previous loops as possible, and assess the situation.

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キミは「観測者」だ。
english: You are the "Observer".

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Yes!!

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （可能な限り同じように過ごせか……）
english: (Spend my time as close to the previous loops as possible...)

chapter: 36. Don't Be Fooled by the Shadow
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小早川家のことも
　しおりちゃんの影を抑えつけたときに怪我した左腕も、
　すでに違うことばかりだ……）
english: (The situation with the Kobayakawa family, my left arm that got injured when I held down Shiori-chan's Shadow... so many things are already different...)

japanese: 37.招かれざる訪問者？
english: 37. Uninvited Visitor?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ただいまー。
ゴメン、澪。遅なった――
english: I'm home. Sorry, Mio. I'm late—

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ～～。
おかえり慎ちゃん……。
english: Ah~~. Welcome home, Shin-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえ、台所に立って何やってんの？
english: What are you doing standing in the kitchen?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 見たらわかるやろ～～～～っ。
english: You can tell just by looking, right~~~~.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
冷蔵庫にタマネギと鶏肉あったから、
炒めよ思ったんやけど……。
english: There were onions and chicken in the fridge, so I thought I'd stir-fry them, but...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
タマネギ切ってたら、
涙が溢れてなんも見えやんように
なってしもたんよ～～～！
english: When I was cutting the onions, tears started pouring out and I couldn't see anything anymore~~~!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あっコラ、危ないだろ！
包丁持った手で目ェ擦んなって！
english: Hey, that's dangerous! Don't rub your eyes with the hand holding the knife!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うぅ、だって～～。
english: Ugh, but~~.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あれ？）
english: (Huh?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（前回まで、澪が料理するなんて展開は
　一度もなかったのに！！）
english: (Up until the last loop, there was never a development where Mio cooked!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（未来が変化して予測が立てにくくなるのはまずい。
　これまでと同じ流れに戻さないと……）
english: (It's bad if the future changes and becomes harder to predict. I need to get things back to the same flow as before...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ば、晩飯はオレが作るから！
なんでこんな……。
english: I-I'll make dinner! Why are you...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん、今朝から体調悪そうやん……。
せやから、その……。
english: Shin-chan, you've looked sick since this morning... So, um...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私が何か作れたらなっ……て！！
グスッ……。
english: I thought maybe I could make something for you...!! *Sniffle*...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こいつ……。
　オレのためにか……！！）
english: (She was doing this... for me...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……そっか。
english: …I see.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ありがとう……でも、後は任しとけ。
危なっかしくて見てられやんわ！
english: Thanks... but leave the rest to me. It's too dangerous to watch you!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うっ！？
でもっ……。
english: Ugh!? But...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……心配いらん。
オレならもう大丈夫や。
ほら、包丁貸してみ。
english: ...No need to worry. I'm fine now. Here, let me have the knife.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影は、地面の本体、
　それへの接触を嫌がる……）
english: (Shadows hate having their main body on the ground touched...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（大丈夫だとは思うけど、
　念のため、澪の影を踏んで……）
english: (I think it's fine, but just in case, I'll step on Mio's shadow...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……かっ、顔洗ろて来ら！！
english: ...G-Go wash your face!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よかった……。
　澪はまだ影じゃない）
english: (Thank goodness... Mio isn't a Shadow yet.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （てか、あいつは何を作ろうとしてたんだ？）
english: (Anyway, what was she trying to make?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ジャガイモ、タマネギ、鶏肉……。
　まだカレーに方向転換できるか）
english: (Potatoes, onions, chicken... Can I still pivot this into curry?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やれやれ……。
　かわいいとこあるな、アイツ……）
english: (Good grief... She has her cute moments...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……じゃないだろ、慎平！！
　「異なる展開」はマズイんだって！）
english: (...No, what am I saying, Shinpei!! "Different developments" are bad!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ああ……そうだった。
　オレのせいで澪の行動が
　すでに変化してしまってる）
english: (Ah... that's right. Because of me, Mio's actions have already changed.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレはカレーを作る。
　それが今までと同じ行動だからな……）
english: (I'll make curry. Because that's the same action I've taken up until now...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まあ、外に南雲先生たちが
　武装待機してる時点で、
　今までとまったく違うんだけど……）
english: (Well, the fact that Nagumo-sensei and the others are waiting outside fully armed makes it completely different from before, though...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（とにかく「影を殺すため」以外の行動は
　なるべく変えないようにする）
english: (Anyway, I should try not to change any actions other than those "to kill the Shadows.")

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（特に、誰かに見られたり、聞かれたり、
　食べさせたりする内容を変えたら、
　人の行動に変化が生まれ……）
english: (In particular, if I change things like what someone sees, hears, or eats, it will cause changes in people's actions...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それが連鎖し、未来が大きく変わる可能性が高くなる。
　そうなれば、オレが見て来た未来が
　役に立たなくなる）
english: (That would cause a chain reaction, making it highly likely that the future changes significantly. If that happens, the future I saw will become useless.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それで良い未来になるならいいが、
　そんな楽観はとてもできない）
english: (It'd be fine if that led to a good future, but I can't be that optimistic.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おいおい、澪。
すごいハラの虫やな……。
そんなにお腹空いてんの――
english: Hey, Mio. Your stomach is growling super loud... Are you really that hungry—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Huh?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……うん。
english: …Yeah.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あっ！
もしかして、今晩カレー？
english: Ah! Could it be... curry for dinner tonight?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平のカレー！？
english: Shinpei's curry!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
…………あ。
あああぁ……あぁ……。
english: ...Ah. Aaaah... ah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮ォッ！！！？
english: Ushio!!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……い、いや！！
　潮じゃなくて……影の『ウシオ』！！）
english: (...N-No!! Not Ushio... it's the Shadow "Ushio"!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
またかァ……もう！
オバケでも見たような顔して！！
english: Not this again... Jeez! You look like you've seen a ghost!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だって、おまっ……。
なんで！？
english: Because, you're... Why!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お、おまえが出て来んのは、
に……２４日の夏祭りのはずやろ……！？
english: Y-You're supposed to show up... at the summer festival on the 24th, right...!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
えっ！？
なんでその事知ってんの！！？
english: Huh!? How do you know about that!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh…?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あんな、慎平……。
信じられやんかも知れやんけど、よう聞いて！
english: Look, Shinpei... You might not believe me, but listen closely!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ２４日に大変な事起きんの……！！
english: Something terrible is going to happen on the 24th...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
真っ黒い影みたいな化物に……。
みんな飲み込まれて、消えてしまうんよ……！！！
english: Everyone gets swallowed up by these pitch-black shadow monsters... and disappears...!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ま、待てよおまえ。
ま、まさか……おまえも……。
english: ...W-Wait a minute. D-Don't tell me... you're also...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あの夏祭りから来たんか……！！？
english: Did you come from that summer festival...!!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……え！？
も、もしかして慎平も！！？
english: ...Huh!? D-Don't tell me you did too, Shinpei!!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
はーーーーっ……。
水で洗たら、ちょっとマシになった……。
english: I washed my eyes, so I feel a bit better now...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……ん？
慎ちゃんどうしたん、
キッチンに座り込んで……。
english: ...Hm? What's wrong, Shin-chan? Why are you sitting on the kitchen floor...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
い、いや……！
何も！？
english: N-No...! Nothing!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こ、ここは一旦平常心で……）
english: (I-I need to act normal for now...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪の位置からは、
　隠れてるウシオは見えないはずだ……。
　気づかれないように――）
english: (From Mio's position, she shouldn't be able to see Ushio hiding here... I can't let her notice—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: W-What!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もしや、このニオイは……。
カ、カレー！！？
english: Could this smell be... C-Curry!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: せ……正解！
english: C-Correct!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うわぁ～～っ！
その手があったか……！！
english: Wow~~! I didn't think of that...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まずいッ……！
　ウシオの腹の音が……！）
english: (This is bad...! Ushio's stomach is growling...!)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ふふっ！
慎ちゃん、めっちゃお腹鳴った～～。
english: Fufu! Shin-chan, your stomach is rumbling so loud~~.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃんみたい……！
english: Just like Sis...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
よかった……。
お腹空くんなら元気やね！
english: Thank goodness... If you're hungry, that means you're doing okay!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ま、まあな～～～～ッ。
english: W-Well, yeah~~~~.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（落ち着け落ち着け、
　カレーの手順をフカンして落ち着け！）
english: (Calm down, calm down. Take a bird's-eye view of the curry-making process and calm down!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（タマネギをみじん切りにする。
　ニンニクとしょうがをすりおろす。
　トマトをざく切りに……）
english: (Finely chop the onions. Grate the garlic and ginger. Roughly chop the tomatoes...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……さ、さてと……。
次はァ……と、鶏肉でも焼くかァァァ～～～ッ。
english: ...W-Well then... Next... I'll fry the chicken~~~.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（か、かなりマズイぞ、この状況……
　何とかウシオをここから逃がさないと……）
english: (T-This situation is really bad... I have to get Ushio out of here somehow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そ、そうだ……！　メモ！
　こいつでウシオに伝言を……）
english: (T-That's it...! The notepad! I'll use this to pass a message to Ushio...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （うう、なんでこんなことに……）
english: (Ugh, why is this happening…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（南雲先生……。
　こんなん、「異なる展開」って
　レベルじゃありません！！）
english: (Nagumo-sensei... This is way beyond the level of a "different development"!!)

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
すまん慎平、遅なってもた！
雁切さん話長いさけよォ……。
english: Sorry Shinpei, I'm late! Karikiri-san's stories are so long...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お、おかえりアラン……。
もうすぐ出来るよ。
english: W-Welcome back, Alain... It'll be ready soon.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お父さん、おかえり！
english: Welcome back, Dad!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
おお、ただいま……って澪！
おまんも何か手伝わなあかんやろがっ。
english: Oh, I'm home... Hey, Mio! You should be helping out, too.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私は食べるん専門でーす！！
english: I specialize in eating!!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
まったく……。
ん、ええニオイや。
潮の大好物やなァ……。
english: Good grief... Hm, smells good. Ushio's favorite, huh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ウシオ！　気付け！
　このメモ見ろ！）
english: (Ushio! Notice it! Look at this memo!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あと５分ほどでアランは洗面所へ、
　澪はトイレへ行く――）
english: (In about 5 minutes, Alain will go to the washroom, and Mio will go to the bathroom—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（その隙にオレの部屋へ向かってくれ。
　見つかるなよ！！）
english: (Head to my room while they're gone. Don't get caught!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……わかった。
english: …Got it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お、おしっ。
完成……！！
english: A-Alright. It's done...!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うわぁ～、おいしそ～！
english: Wow~, looks delicious~!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: また腕上げたんちゃうか、慎平。
english: You've gotten even better, haven't you, Shinpei.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そ、そうかな？
んじゃ、冷めない内に盛り付けてぇ～……。
english: Y-You think so? Well, let's dish it out before it gets cold~...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（アランも澪も記憶通りに動いて、
　ウシオもオレの部屋に行けたし……）
english: (Alain and Mio moved just like I remembered, and Ushio was able to get to my room...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレもこのまま
　しれっと部屋に戻ろう）
english: (I'll just casually head back to my room now, too.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あれ？
慎ちゃんどこ行くん？
english:
Huh?
Where are you going, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……。
ちょっと、自分の部屋で食うわ……。
english: Oh, uh... I'm gonna eat in my room.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……え？
２皿も持って！？
english: ...Huh? With two plates!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いっ……。
いやホラ、めっちゃハラ減ってんねん……！！
english: U-Uh... Well, you see, I'm super hungry...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ははっ！　もう元気やから……。
あはははは～～っ。
english: Haha! I'm feeling totally fine now... Ahahahaha~~.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ウシオ……。
english: Ushio…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: カレエッ！
english: Curry!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
カレッカレッ！
カレ～～～～ッ！
english: Curry, curry! Curry~~~~!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
フン！
フン！！
english: Hn! Hn!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こ……これは……。
　カレーの律動（リズム）！！）
english: (Th... this is... The Rhythm of Curry!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（カレーへの食欲がＭＡＸになった潮が
　テンション上がってやる謎の儀式！）
english: (That mysterious ritual Ushio does when her craving for curry hits its peak and she gets super hyped!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（くそぉ～～～～～～～～ッ。
　な、何でこんなことに！！）
english: (Daaamn it~~~~~~~~. W-Why did things turn out like this!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 影の姿と言葉に心を動かすな、網代慎平。
english: Do not let the Shadows' appearances and words sway your heart, Shinpei Ajiro.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
今後ヤツらが友人や家族……。
愛する者の姿で現れたとしても
ためらってはならん。
english: From now on, even if they appear in the form of your friends or family... or someone you love, you must not hesitate.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（わかってます。
　じゃなきゃ、おしまい……）
english: (I know. If I don't, it's all over...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （目の前のウシオが本性現した時は……）
english: (When the Ushio in front of me reveals her true nature...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（隠し持って来た
　果物ナイフで影を刺す……！）
english: (I'll stab her Shadow with the fruit knife I hid and brought with me...!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なぁ、慎平。
食べてええん……？
english: Hey, Shinpei. Can I eat...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Yeah…

japanese: 38.ウシオとミオ
english: 38. Ushio and Mio

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ウシオ……）
english: (Ushio…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なぜかこいつは
　オレと一緒にループして来た）
english: (For some reason, she looped back with me.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（発言からすると
　そう考えるのが自然だろう……）
english: (Judging from what she said, it's natural to think that...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: いただきまーす！！
english: Thanks for the food!!

speaker: Ushio
english: ...Mmm~~~~!! So delicious~~~~~~~~.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（油断し切ってるな……。
　い、今ならやれるか……？）
english: (She's completely off her guard... C-Could I do it now...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや……待て……。
　これはオレの出方を窺ってるのか？）
english: (No... wait... Is she trying to see what I'll do?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だとしたら、
　下手に動くのは危ない……）
english: (If that's the case, making a careless move is dangerous...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （もう少し泳がせてみるか……）
english: (I'll let her think she has the upper hand a bit longer...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……おまえ。
どっからどうやって家まで来た？
english: ...You. Where did you come from, and how did you get here?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
え？
そりゃあ歩いて！
english:
Huh?
I walked, of course!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なんか目ェ覚めたら
万年青浜におってさァ？
english: When I woke up, I was at Omoto Beach, y'know?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
それまでは夏祭りでさ。
ヒルコ様におったのに……。
夢でも見てたんかなて思たんやけど……。
english: Before that, I was at the summer festival. I was at the Hiruko shrine... I thought maybe I was dreaming, but...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
で、自分ん家しか行くとこないから
帰ったけど誰もおらんくて……。
english: And, since my house was the only place I could go, I came back, but no one was here...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
テレビつけたら
今日は２２日てやってるし……。
english: When I turned on the TV, it said today was the 22nd...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
今日って私の葬式やったんよな？
だから家に誰もおらんかった？
english:
Today was my funeral, wasn't it?
That's why no one was home?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……そうや……。
english: Yeah... that's right...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あ！　大丈夫！！
誰にも見られてへんで！
もう十分わかったから！！
english: Ah! It's okay!! No one saw me! I've figured that much out!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私……バケモンみたいやからな。
もう、誰にも見つかれへんようにする。
english: Since I'm... like a monster. I'll make sure no one finds me anymore.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ばっ！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
バケモンって、そっ……。
そんなことは……。
english: A monster... Th-That's not...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いやいや、だからフカンしろ！
　本当にそう言い切れるんか？）
english: (No, no, take a bird's-eye view! Can you really say that for sure?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生も言ってたやろ！
　影に心を動かされるなって！）
english: (Nagumo-sensei said it too! Don't let the Shadows sway your heart!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まずは確かめる……。
　床に手を置くふりをして
　それとなくこいつの影に触れる……）
english: (First, I need to check... I'll pretend to put my hand on the floor and casually touch her shadow...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ひゃんっ！！？
english: Hyan!!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なっ……何！！？
今めっちゃこしょばかったんやけど！？
な……何かしたっ！？
english: Wh... What!!? That was super ticklish just now!? D-Did you do something!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
は……？
な、何もしとらんよ。
オレの手、ここにあるし。
english: Huh...? I-I didn't do anything. My hands are right here.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ホンマや……。
なんか触られた気ィしたんやけど。
お、オバケちゃうやろな……？
english: You're right... I felt like I was touched, though. I-It wasn't a ghost, right...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 気のせいちゃうか？
english: Probably just your imagination, right?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
もうっ！
さぶいぼたっとー！！
english: Jeez, I got goosebumps!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ははは……。
english: Haha…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（間違いない……！
　影に触れるとくすぐったいと言うことは
　他の影と同様、こいつの急所は平面の影にある……！）
english: (No doubt about it...! If touching her shadow makes her ticklish, then just like the other Shadows, her weak point is the 2D shadow...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（つまり影さえ刺すことができれば
　間違いなく殺すことができるということだ……！）
english: (Which means as long as I can stab her shadow, I can definitely kill her...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今、ナイフでこいつの影を
　ブスリとやれば、こいつは死ぬ……！！）
english: (If I stab her shadow with the knife right now, she'll die...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（見てみろよ……こいつ……
　スキだらけじゃないか……！）
english: (Just look at her... she's... completely wide open...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……ダメだ、できない……！）
english: (...Damn it, I can't do it...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こいつはあの時――）
english: (She was the one who, back then—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（神社の境内でループする直前、
　四本腕を殴ってオレを助けてくれたんだよな……）
english: (Right before I looped at the shrine grounds, she punched the four-armed Shadow and saved me...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （２年前のあの時――）
english: (That time two years ago—)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 東京ォ！！？
english: Tokyo!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: アランの知り合いが東京におんねんやて。
english: Alain has an acquaintance in Tokyo.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そこで
下宿させてもらえることになった……。
english: And they agreed to let me board there...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレはそっから
料理の学校に通うんや。
english: I'll commute to culinary school from there.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 何それ……。
english: What's that…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
和歌山の高校は受けん。
もう決めたことや。
english: I'm not taking the exams for the high schools in Wakayama. It's already decided.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 私聞いてないんやけど。
english: You never told me about this.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
別に。
おまえに言う必要ないやろ。
english: Whatever. I don't need to tell you.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なんで！！？
そんな大事なこと勝手に決めんの！？
english: Why!!? How could you decide something so important on your own!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なんで勝手に決めたらアカンねん！！！
english: Why can't I decide on my own!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレはな。
このままこの家の……小舟家の子にはならんっ！！
english: Listen. I'm not going to just stay as a child of this house... of the Kofune family!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
早よ、自分の金は
自分で稼げるようになるんや！
english: I'm going to learn to earn my own money as soon as possible!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ずうっとアランやおまえらに
迷惑かけっ放しは嫌なんや！！
english: I don't want to keep being a burden on Alain and you guys forever!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ……迷惑？
english: ...A burden?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ……慎平は、ここがキライなん？
english: …Shinpei, do you hate this place?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
は！！？
なんでそうなる！？
english: Huh!!? How did you come to that conclusion!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もうええ！！
おまえと話すことらないわ！！
english: Fine!! I have nothing more to say to you!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: もうええんはこっちじゃ！！
english: I'm the one who's had enough!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（違うよ潮……。
　キライなわけないやないか）
english: (You're wrong, Ushio... There's no way I could hate it here.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……オレはおまえが好きなんや……！）
english: (...I love you...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（おまえとはこんなカタチで
　家族になりたくないんだよ……）
english: (I just don't want to be family with you in this way...)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: なァ、慎平。
english: Hey, Shinpei.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
今日で最後やからさ。
晩ご飯は慎平のカレーがええな。
english: Since today is your last day. I'd like Shinpei's curry for dinner.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えぇ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これから荷造りとか色々あんねん！
また今度な。
english: I've got a lot of packing and stuff to do! Let's do it next time.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 慎平のあっぽけ……。
english: Shinpei, you idiot...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: もしもし……。
english: Hello…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪か？
久しぶりだな。
english: Mio? It's been a while.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、慎ちゃん……。
english: Shin-chan, Shin-chan…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
どうした？
何かあったのか！？
english: What's wrong? Did something happen!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ひぐ、お姉ちゃんが……。
english: *Hic*, Sis...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: う、潮がどうかしたのか？
english: U-Ushio? Did something happen to Ushio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃん、死んじゃったぁ……。
english: Sis... she died...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（「今度」なんてなかった。
　そう思ってた……）
english: (There was no "next time." That's what I thought...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なのに……）
english: (And yet...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: やっと作ってくれたなァ……。
english: You finally made it for me...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
よかった……。
また慎平のカレー食べられて……。
english: I'm so glad... I got to eat Shinpei's curry again...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 生きててよかった……。
english: I'm so glad I'm alive...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 美味い、か……？
english: Is it... good?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: おかわりっ！！
english: Seconds!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
お父さんが作っても
なんかこの味とちゃうんよな。
やっぱ慎平のが一番やわ！
english: Even when Dad makes it, the flavor just isn't the same. Shinpei's is definitely the best!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そっか……。よかった。
english: I see... I'm glad.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こいつは『潮』だ……。
　潮だよ……）
english: (She is "Ushio"... She's Ushio...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……なァ、慎平？
english: …Hey, Shinpei?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
このまま２４日になったらさ。
また同じ事が起きんの？
english: If the 24th comes around like this. Will the same thing happen again?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……。
オレはなんとかそれを止めよう思てる。
english: Yeah... I'm planning to stop it somehow.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……そっか……。
なら、私も手伝う！！
english: ...I see... Then I'll help, too!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
日都ヶ島の夏祭りが、
あんなバケモンにメチャクチャにされるんは嫌……！
english: I don't want the Hitogashima summer festival to be ruined by those monsters...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
澪やみんなが消えてまうんは
もっと嫌！！
english: And I definitely don't want Mio and everyone else to disappear!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうやな……オレもや……！！
オレらで止めよう！！！
english: You're right... Me too...!! Let's stop them together!!!

speaker: Ushio
english: Yeah…!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あっ、そうや……。
english: Ah, right...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私、見たんよ……！！
本物の慎平が来る前、あの境内で……。
english: I saw it...!! Before the real Shinpei arrived, at the shrine grounds...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
トキちゃんが、
影としゃべってるのを……。
english: Toki-chan was... talking to the Shadows...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トキちゃんて……
あ、あのトキちゃん！？
english: Toki-chan... Y-You mean that Toki-chan!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うん……！！
窓の妹の朱鷺子ちゃんや！
english: Yeah...!! Sou's younger sister, Tokiko-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
待て！　待て待て待て待て……。
順を追って話してくれ！
english: Wait! Wait, wait, wait, wait... Tell me what happened in order!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まずオレはあの時、
おまえにテント裏の森で
待ってろって言うたよな？
english: First, at that time, I told you to wait in the woods behind the tents, right?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うん……。
しばらくはそこに隠れてたんやけど……。
english: Yeah... I was hiding there for a while, but...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 急に頭ん中に、変な声がして……。
english: Suddenly, I heard a weird voice in my head...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
はっきりとは聞き取れやんかった……。
けど、なんか呼ばれた様な……。
english: I couldn't make it out clearly... But it felt like I was being called...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ヒルコ様に行かなあかん気ィして来て……。
english: I started feeling like I had to go to the Hiruko shrine...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……で、境内着いたら
窓が澪に告白してて……。
english: ...And, when I got to the shrine grounds, Sou was confessing to Mio...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: マジでやったか、アイツ……！！
english: He actually went and did it, that guy...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
で、やっぱりフラれてて……。
その後、私出てったった！
ドンマイって！！
english: And, sure enough, he got rejected... After that, I came out! And told him "Don't mind it"!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ウソやろ……。
english: You've gotta be kidding me...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
けど、なんか目にうかぶわ、
その状況……。
english: But I can kind of picture it, that situation...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
まぁ……そしたら慎平が……。
いや、慎平じゃなくて……。
english: Well... then Shinpei... No, not Shinpei...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレの影か……。
english: My Shadow, huh...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そのシンペイの体がピカッて光って……。
足元から窓の影が……。
english: That Shinpei's body flashed with light... And from his feet, Sou's Shadow...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
で、それを合図にしたみたいに人が……。
黒い影に変わって……。
english: And then, as if that was a signal, people... turned into black Shadows...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あっちこっちから悲鳴が上がって……。
影が……みんなを襲い始めた……。
english: Screams started coming from all over... The Shadows... started attacking everyone...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
境内におった人の中に影が紛れてたんや……。
誰が影やったかわかるか！？
english: Shadows were mixed in among the people on the shrine grounds... Do you know who was a Shadow!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ゴメン……。
一瞬のことやったから……。
english: Sorry... It all happened in an instant...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
窓が澪を守りながら逃げようとしたけど、
逃げ道は影がふさいでて……。
english: Sou tried to escape while protecting Mio, but the Shadows blocked their escape route...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
二人とも、
だんだん境内の真ん中に追いつめられた。
english: The two of them were gradually cornered into the middle of the shrine grounds.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私は捕まってて……。
ただ見てるだけしかできやんかった……。
english: I was caught... and all I could do was watch...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……でな。
そこでトキちゃんが――
english: ...And then. That's when Toki-chan—

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: こんなん約束とちゃう。
english: This wasn't the promise.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お兄ちゃんと澪にはっ……。
手ェ出せへんて！
english: You weren't supposed to lay a hand... on my brother and Mio!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 言うたやないか！！！！
english: That's what you said!!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ト……トキコ？
english: T... Tokiko?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
菱形家には大変お世話になりました……。
でも、それも今日で終わりです。
english: The Hishigata family has been of great help to us... But that ends today.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そんな……。
　<color=#GF_TIPS_118>トキちゃん</color>が影と繋がってる！？）
english: (No way... <color=#GF_TIPS_118>Toki-chan</color> is connected to the Shadows!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どういう事だ？
　クソッ……）
english: (What does this mean? Damn it...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
その後は私……。
意識失ってもて……。
english: After that, I... lost consciousness...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （後はオレが見た通り、か）
english: (And the rest is just as I saw it, huh.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そういや、あの時……。
　ループの最中……）
english: (Come to think of it, that time... in the middle of the loop...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 赤い女の子……。
english: A girl in red...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ヒルコ様の上に浮かんでた……。
白くて長い髪の、赤い着物の女の子……。
english: She was floating above the Hiruko shrine... A girl with long white hair, in a red kimono...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえ、見たか！？
english: Did you see her!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……うん。
english: …Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影の親玉っぽいさ……。
四本腕のヤツがおったやろ？
english: That one who seemed like the boss of the Shadows... the four-armed guy, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あいつ……あの赤い女の子のことを
「母」って呼んでた。
english: He... called that girl in red "Mother."

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平の影も変なこと言うてたな……。
おまえは声が聞こえてへんのかって……。
english: Shinpei's Shadow said something weird, too... Asking if you couldn't hear the voice...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……そうか！
english: ...I see!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影には「母」がおる……。
「オカアサン」や！
english: The Shadows have a "Mother"... an "Okaasan"!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それが「赤い女の子」で……。
影たちはあの子から何らかのテレパシー……。
指令を受けて動いてるとしたら？
english: That's the "girl in red"... What if the Shadows are receiving some kind of telepathy... orders from her to act?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえが影らしくないのは、
その指令がうまく受信できてないからで……。
english: The reason you don't act like a Shadow is because you aren't receiving those orders properly...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんつうか、その……。
「故障」してるとか……！！
english: Like, um... you're "broken" or something...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……おまえ、
そもそも人間をコピーできんの！？
english: ...Can you even copy humans in the first place!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……や、やってみるか……！！
はぁっ！！
english: ...L-Let me try...!! Hah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……できんのやな。
english: …You can't, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影はおまえを「裏切り者」て言うてた。
身に覚えは？
english: The Shadows called you a "traitor." Ring any bells?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ない……私はあの夜、
万年青浜で慎平と会うた所までしか
思い出せやんねん……。
english: No... I can only remember up to the point where I met you at Omoto Beach that night...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
死んだ時のこともハッキリせんし、
私がその前に何してたんかもさっぱりや……。
english: I don't clearly remember when I died, and I have no idea what I was doing before that...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
７月１８日の万年青浜ゴミ拾い大会で
潮がコピーされてる。
おそらく、その時におまえが生まれた。
english: Ushio was copied at the Omoto Beach Trash Cleanup on July 18th. You were probably born then.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪の話ではおまえは潮と目が合って、
すぐに逃げて姿を消したそうや。
english: According to Mio, you made eye contact with Ushio, then immediately ran away and disappeared.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そのことも覚えてへんか？
english: You don't remember that either?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……あっ。

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ちょっと待って……なんか覚えてる……。
english: Wait a sec... I remember something...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
こ……この記憶は？
……私は、私となんか……してた……。
english: Th... this memory...? ...I was... doing something with... myself...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……なんやったかな……？
english: ...What was it again...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ムリはせんでええ……。
english: Don't force it…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そのうち思い出すよ。
何かキッカケがあれば――
english: You'll remember eventually. If there's some kind of trigger—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（南雲先生からだ……
　「異常はありませんか？」か……）
english: (It's from Nagumo-sensei... "Are there any abnormalities?" huh...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（少しでも
　今までと異なる出来事が起きたら
　教えることになっていた……）
english: (I was supposed to tell her if even the slightest thing happened differently from before...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こいつの存在を
　先生たちに伝えるべきか！？）
english: (Should I tell Nagumo-sensei and the others about her existence!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、当然……。
　言うべきなんだ……）
english: (No, of course... I should tell them...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (…but…)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平？
english: Shinpei?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……いや。なんでもない。
english: …No, nothing.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それより、だいぶ話し込んでしまったな。
いま何時や？
english: Anyway, we've been talking for quite a while. What time is it now?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: なんかあるんか？
english: Something's up?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん……ああ、実はな……。
english: Hm… Yeah, actually…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……え？
澪の影が来る……！？
english: ...Huh? Mio's Shadow is coming...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……あと５分ほどで
ウチの前に現れる……。
english: Yeah... It'll appear in front of our house in about 5 minutes...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 戸締りは！？
english: Did you lock the doors!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 大丈夫や……。
english: It's fine...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
けど、戸締りは
あんまり意味ないと思う……。
english: But I don't think locking the doors means much...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あいつらは影に潜って
ちょっとのスキマをすり抜けられる
みたいやからな……。
english: Since they can slip through tiny gaps by submerging into the shadows...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なにそれ！！
わ、私そんなんできやんけど！？
english: What's up with that!! I-I can't do anything like that, though!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……まあ、心配すんな！
english: …Well, don't worry!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あいつがウチの中に
入って来たことはない。
english: It has never come inside the house.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今まで１回もな。
english: Not even once.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それに今回は仲間がおる！
english: Besides, this time I have allies!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 仲間！？
english: Allies!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（自宅前にミオが現れたら、
　対岸から根津さんが狙撃する手はずになっている）
english: (If Mio appears in front of the house, Nezu-san is supposed to snipe her from the opposite shore.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……慎ちゃん？
english: …Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……澪や、隠れろ！
english: ...It's Mio. Hide!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ねぇ、おるんよね？
english: Hey, you're here, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、ああ、おるで！
ちょっと待っててや！
english: A-Ah, yeah, I'm here! Give me a second!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おい、早よ隠れろって！
english: Hey, hurry up and hide!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ええ！？
そない言われてもォ……。
english: Eh!? Even if you say that...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あ、せや！
とりあえず布団被っとくわ！
english: Ah, I know! I'll just hide under the futon for now!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃ～ん、もうええ～？
english: Shin-cha~n, are you ready~?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ、いいぞ。
english: A-Ah, yeah, it's fine.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: もう食べ終わった？
english: Are ya finished eating?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お皿洗ってしまいたいんやけど……。
english: I wanna wash the dishes.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ……。
ああ皿！　皿ね！！
english: Ah… Ah, dishes! Dishes, right!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あれっ！　スプーン２つ使たん？
コップも２つ……。
english: Huh! You used two spoons? Two cups, too...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
え？　それってそんなに変かな？
いや？　変じゃないよ！
english: Huh? Is that so strange? No? It's not strange!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ままままったく変じゃなくない？
english: N-N-Not strange at all, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なんで急に標準語……。
english: Why'd ya suddenly drop yer accent?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: まさか……お姉ちゃんおる？
english: Sis ain't here, is she?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
だって、慎ちゃんコレ、
お姉ちゃんの分も作ったんやろ？
english: I mean, Shin-chan, you made this for Sis too, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
きっといてるよ、お姉ちゃん。
日都ヶ島では、亡くなった人の魂は
家に帰って来て……。
english: Sis is definitely here. On Hitogashima, the souls of the deceased return home...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
その家の守り神になるんやって！
雁切さん言うてたよ。
english: And they become the guardian spirit of the house! That's what Karikiri-san said.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: Ah, yeah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そ、そういう意味か……）
english: (S-So that's what she meant...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
皿は置いといてええからな。
オレが後で洗うしよ……。
english: You can just leave the dishes. I'll wash them later...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえは先に風呂でも入ってな。
english: You should go take a bath first.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ん……。
ごちそうさま、慎ちゃん！
english: Hm... Thanks for the meal, Shin-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
やばいわ……。
寿命ちぢまるわ……。
english: That was close... My lifespan just shortened...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 澪、カン鋭いとこあるからな……！！
english: Mio can be pretty sharp sometimes...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ふふっ、確かに――
english: Fufu, definitely—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ファーーーーッ！？
english: Gwaaaah!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんッ……なんや！？
まっまっ……まだ何か――
english: Wh... What!? I-I-Is there something else—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Wait—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （お、オレの代わりに刺されて……！？）
english: (S-She got stabbed in my place...!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 痛っ……たい……。
english: It... hurts...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: なァァァァァァァッ！！！！！
english: Gaaaaaaaah!!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮っ！
大丈夫か……ッ！？
english: Ushio! Are you okay...!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ッ。

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ぁあああああああッ！！！！
english: Aaaaaaaaah!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （マズい！　このままじゃ潮が死ぬ！）
english: (This is bad! Ushio will die at this rate!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うおぉおおおッッ！！
潮から離れろ！！
english: Uoooooohhh!! Get away from Ushio!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハッ……ハッ……ハッ……。
english: Hah... hah... hah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （戦って勝てる相手じゃない……！）
english: (This isn't an opponent I can beat in a fight...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それはわかってる……。
　でも、それがどうした！？）
english: (I know that... But so what!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どうせ死ぬなら！
　何もしないで殺されるより、
　少しでもなにか……なにか！！）
english: (If I'm going to die anyway! Rather than doing nothing and getting killed, I have to do something... anything!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレにできるのは……。
　今オレにできる精一杯はっ！！）
english: (The only thing I can do... The best I can do right now is!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（カーテンを開けた……！
　これでミオが現れたことを
　根津さんが気づいてくれるはずだ……！）
