english: (I opened the curtains...! Now Nezu-san should notice that Mio has appeared...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 来いよ……ミオ……！
english: Come and get me... Mio...!

speaker: Ushio
english: ...Sh-Shinpei...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレが相手になっちゃる……っ！！
english: I'll be your opponent...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今、オレにできることは……。
　根津さんからの射線を通すこと！）
english: (What I can do now is... clear the line of fire for Nezu-san!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そして、根津さんを信じて、
　ミオを窓の近くに誘い込むこと……！！）
english: (And, trusting Nezu-san, lure Mio near the window...!!)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
お姉ちゃん。
なんであいつの味方するん……？
english: Sis. Why are you taking his side...?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃんは、
影を殺した根津と南方の仲間やで……。
english: Shin-chan is allies with Nezu and Minakata, who killed Shadows...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（知っているのか！
　オレたちがシオリを倒したことを！！）
english: (She knows! That we defeated Shiori!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ハァ、ハァ……。
な、なんでってか……。
english: Hah, hah... Wh-Why, you ask...?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なんや……。
ニセモンはカン鈍いやないか！
english: What's this... Fakes sure are slow on the uptake!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 私は慎平が好き……。
english: I love Shinpei...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
好きな人の味方でっ……
何か文句あんのか！！！！
english: Got a problem... with me taking the side of the person I love!!!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: 死んだくせに……。
english: Even though you're dead...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
お姉ちゃんは死んだくせに……。
お姉ちゃんは死んだくせに……。
english: Even though Sis is dead... Even though Sis is dead...

speaker: Mio
japanese: 死んだくせによォォオォッ！！！！
english: Even though you're dead!!!!

speaker: Ushio
english: Shin—

speaker: Ushio
english: Huh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ミオがよろけた！！
　チャンス！！！！）
english: (Mio staggered!! This is my chance!!!!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: がっ……！
english: Gah...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハッ、ハッ、ハッ……。
english: Hah, hah, hah...

speaker: Mio
english: ...It... hurts...

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……な、なんで？
english: ...Wh-Why?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
私だって……。
慎ちゃんのこと――
english: I also... love Shin-chan—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ミオ。
english: …Mio.

speaker: Mio
japanese: ぐふっ！
english: Guh!

speaker: Mio
japanese: あッ、あッ、あッ……！
english: Ah, ah, ah...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハッ……ハッ……。
ハァッ、ハッ、ハァッ……。
english: Hah... hah... Hah, hah, hah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （やった……ミオを……倒した！？）
english: (I did it... I... defeated Mio!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮っ！！？
english: Ushio!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おい……。
しっかりしろ、潮っ……。
english: Hey... Stay with me, Ushio...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレを庇って受けた刺し傷は
　ふさがってる……！！）
english: (The stab wound she took protecting me is already closing...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（肉体へのダメージは、
　すぐに再生するらしい。けど――）
english: (Damage to the body seems to regenerate quickly. But—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（腕からの出血……。
　影を切り裂かれてついた傷は
　治らないんだ……！！）
english: (The bleeding from her arm... The wound from having her shadow cut won't heal...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どうすればいい！？
　まさか、死ぬのか！！？）
english: (What should I do!? Is she going to die!!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （このまま出血が続けば……！！）
english: (If this bleeding continues…!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 失礼しまーーす。
english: Excuse me~~.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……な、南雲先生……ッ。
english: ...N-Nagumo-sensei...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: その影を駆除しに来ました。
english: I've come to eliminate that Shadow.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ま、待ってください！！
english: W-Wait, please!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: なんで邪魔するんですか？
english: Why are you getting in my way?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
まずは慎平さんが無事でよかった。
けど、それは何です？
english: First of all, I'm glad you're safe, Shinpei-san. But what is that?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
影、ですよね。それ。
さあ、殺すからどいてください。
english: That's a Shadow, right? Now, move aside so I can kill it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: い……嫌です……。
english: I... I refuse...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: その影に何か吹き込まれたんですか？
english: Did that Shadow whisper something into your ear?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
言いましたよね。
影と長く話すと惑わされるって。
english: I told you, didn't I? If you talk to a Shadow for too long, you'll be led astray.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生がっ……！！
english: Nagumo-sensei...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影を恨んでることは重々承知してますし、
この島の影を全部駆除するって目的も
理解してるつもりです！
english: I'm well aware that you hold a grudge against the Shadows, and I believe I understand your goal of eliminating all the Shadows on this island!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも！！！！
こいつは……。
english: But!!!! This one...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
二度もオレを守ってくれたんです……。
体張って、オレを……こいつは……。
english: She protected me twice... She put her body on the line for me... She did...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
後先考えへん……。
考えても先に手ェ出る……。
アホの潮なんですよ……。
english: She doesn't think ahead... Even if she thinks, her hands move first... She's the idiot Ushio...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だから先生、どうか……。
english: So please, Nagumo-sensei...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレの腕を治療してくれたみたいにっ……。
こいつの怪我も……。
手当てしてやってくださいっ……！
english: Just like how you treated my arm... Please treat... her injury too...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: ……判断はお姉ちゃんに任せます。
english: ...I'll leave the decision to my sister.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
まったくキミは……。
見逃してくれと嘆願するなら、いざ知らず。
手当てしろだと？
english: Honestly, you... It would be one thing if you were begging me to let it go. But to treat it?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
逆張りをすれば、私がなびくとでも
思っているんじゃなかろうね？
english: You don't think I'll be swayed just because you're taking a contrarian stance, do you?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
影に与するなら、
キミも殺すことになる。
english: If you side with the Shadows, I will have to kill you too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……かまいません……。
english: ...I don't mind...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そしたら、またループして、
次こそ先生を説得してみせますっ！！
english: If you do, I'll just loop again, and next time I'll convince you for sure!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平……澪は……？
本物の澪は……無事……？
english: Shinpei... What about Mio...? Is the real Mio... safe...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それは……。
english: That…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……本物は風呂だ。
さっき確認した。小舟澪は生きている。
english: ...The real one is in the bath. I checked earlier. Mio Kofune is alive.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ほっ、本当ですか！！
english: R-Really!!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そっか……。
よ、よかっ……た……。
english: I see... Th-Thank goodness...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
同じだ……この声。
私を島にいざなったあの声と……。
english: It's the same... This voice. The same voice that lured me to the island...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私にあのメッセージを吹き込んだのは
小舟潮……！！
english: The one who recorded that message for me was Ushio Kofune...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……臨機応変……か。
いいだろう。
english: ...Adapting to the situation, huh. Very well.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 傷を見せたまえ。
english: Show me the wound.

japanese: 39.責任
english: 39. Responsibility

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
まず傷を洗う。
腕を出したまえ。
english: First, we wash the wound. Hold out your arm.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あっ……！！？
ウソッ！　えっ……！？
english: Ah...!!? No way! Eh...!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
まって～～～～！？
腕が消えてしもたァァァッ！！！！
english: Wait~~~~!? My arm disappeared!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: U-Ushio...!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……あれ？
い、痛くない……。
english: ...Huh? I-It doesn't hurt...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 腕がなくなったら痛みも消えた。
english: Once the arm disappeared, the pain vanished too.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
その傷は、<color=#GF_TIPS_077>影</color>本体が負ったダメージの投影だろう。
網代慎平の傷とは違う。
english: That wound is likely a projection of the damage taken by the <color=#GF_TIPS_077>Shadow</color>'s main body. It's different from Shinpei Ajiro's wound.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
消毒や縫合などの通常の手当てで
治るとも思えない。
油断は禁物だな。
english: I doubt it will heal with normal treatments like disinfection or suturing. We must not let our guard down.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
まーーええかっ！！
痛ないんやったら！
english: Weeeell, whatever!! As long as it doesn't hurt!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: き、切りかえ早すぎやろ！！
english: Y-You switched gears way too fast!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: しかし、大きくなったな、キミ……。
english: However, you've grown quite a bit...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 私は南方ひづる。
english: I'm Hizuru Minakata.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミは覚えていないだろうがね。
昔はよくコフネに食べに来ていた。
english: You probably don't remember, but I used to come eat at Kofune quite often in the past.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: えっ、ほんま！？
english: Huh, really!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ごめん……覚えてへんわァ……。
こんな胸の大きい人……。
english: Sorry... I don't remember... Someone with such big boobs...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミは３歳だったし、
私は当時Ａカップだった……無理もない。
english: You were three years old, and I was an A-cup back then... It's understandable.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 何の話や！
english: What are you talking about!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ウシオ……。
これを聞いてくれ。
english:
Ushio…
Listen to this.

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
２４日……夏祭り……。
みんな影に殺され……。
島じゅうの……全員……
english: 24th... Summer Festival... Everyone gets killed by Shadows... The whole island... Everyone...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……えっ。
english: ...Huh.

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
止められる……は……。
あじろしんぺい……いう人だけ……。
english: The only one who can stop it... is... someone named Shinpei Ajiro...

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
だからお願……す……。
日都ヶ島に来てくだ……い！
しんペ……を助けてくだ……。
english: So I beg... you... Please come to Hitogashima...! Please save... Shinpei...

speaker: ??? (Ushio)
japanese:
先生の力を……お願いです……。
どうか……。
english: I beg you to use your power, Nagumo-sensei... Please...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
何、これ……。
私の声やんな……。
english: What is this... It's my voice, isn't it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: こ、これはいったい……。
english: Wh-What on earth is this...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: このメッセージに覚えは？
english: Do you recall this message?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
これが、私がこの島にやって来た理由だよ。
……覚えはないんだな？
english: This is the reason I came to this island. ...You don't remember it, do you?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: はい……。
english: Yes…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そうか……ならばよい。
忘れてくれたまえ。
english: I see... That's fine, then. Please forget about it.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
それよりも問題はよォ。
なんで影のミオが慎平の予知と違うて、
小舟家の中に侵入して来たかや！！
english: More importantly, the problem is why Shadow Mio broke into the Kofune house, unlike in Shinpei's premonition!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ミオはシオリが倒されたことを
知ってるみたいでした。
english: Mio seemed to know that Shiori had been defeated.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ヤツらは明らかに情報を共有してます……。
今までこんなことは！？
english: They're clearly sharing information... Has anything like this happened before!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: いや、ない。
english: No, it hasn't.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
儂が影と１４年ぶりに
遭遇したんが２ヶ月前や。
english: It was two months ago that I encountered a Shadow for the first time in 14 years.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
儂ァ、その影を仕留めたが、
そのことがバレてる様子はない……。
english: I killed that Shadow, but it doesn't seem like they've found out about it...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ミオは影を殺している我々を認知し、
敵とみなして排除しに来たと考えられる。
english: It's likely that Mio recognized us as the ones killing Shadows, deemed us enemies, and came to eliminate us.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
つまり、慎平が体験した「前回」までなら
ミオの標的は私と根津、だったのだろうが……。
english: In other words, up until the "previous time" Shinpei experienced, Mio's targets were probably just me and Nezu, but...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
しかし「今回」は、網代慎平も
我々の仲間であると影どもに知られた……。
english: However, "this time," the Shadows learned that Shinpei Ajiro is also our ally...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ゆえにミオは、
網代慎平を殺すために侵入して来た……。
english: Therefore, Mio broke in to kill Shinpei Ajiro...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレがコバマートに同行したせいか……。
english: Is it because I accompanied you to Koba Mart...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、なんでバレたんでしょう？
あの場にいた影はみんな……。
倒したはずですよね……。
english: But how did they find out? All the Shadows that were there... we should have defeated them...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いずれにせよ……私はこれ以上、
キミと行動を共にできない。
english: In any case... I can no longer act together with you.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミが彼女と――
ウシオと共に動くつもりならばな。
english: That is, if you intend to act alongside her—alongside Ushio.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ウシオは確かにキミを助けたのだろうし、
我々への敵意もないように見える……が。
english: Ushio did indeed save you, and she doesn't appear to have any hostility towards us... however.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミの言う通り、
ウシオが「故障」しているのだとしてもだ。
それがいつ「直る」とも限らない。
english: Even if Ushio is "broken" like you say. There's no guarantee she won't be "fixed" at any moment.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
影どもの情報共有手段が明らかではない以上……。
ウシオが「スパイ」になる危険性も出てくる。
english: As long as the Shadows' method of sharing information remains unclear... there's a risk that Ushio could become a "spy."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そんな……）
english: (No way...)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
そいつを殺さんのやったら
こっからは別行動や……。
english: If you ain't gonna kill her, we're parting ways here...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
以後の連絡は一切絶つ……！！
それが儂らにできる、最大の譲歩や。
english: We're cutting off all contact from here on out...!! That's the biggest concession we can make.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: でもっ……。
english: But…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
おまえが決めたんやろが。
「生かす」て……！！
english: You're the one who decided. To "let her live"...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
他人にあーせえ、
こーせえ言われたんやなかろ……。
english: It's not like someone else told you to do this or that...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……はい。
english: …Yes.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ほなら後悔せん！！
結果がどうあれな……。
english: Then don't regret it!! No matter the outcome...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ただし！
責任はおまえが負うんや。
english: However! You will bear the responsibility.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
大人の決断には責任が伴う。
おまえは大人か？
english: An adult's decisions come with responsibility. Are you an adult?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうありたいと思ってます……。
english: I'd like to think so...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生っ！！
english: Nagumo-sensei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生は２３日――
つまり明日の３時過ぎ……。
鎮守の森でミオに殺されました。
english: You were killed by Mio on the 23rd—meaning tomorrow, just past 3 PM... in the forest by the shrine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ミオは倒しましたが、
他の追っ手が来るかもしれません……。
english: I defeated Mio, but other pursuers might come...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 絶対に……死なないでください……！！
english: Please... absolutely do not die...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
「運命は変えられる」。
それを証明するまたとないチャンスだな。
english: "Fate can be changed." This is a perfect opportunity to prove it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ほんとにこれで……。
　よかったんだろうか……）
english: (Was this really... the right choice...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（けど影のミオは倒した……。
　これでひとまず澪は安全のはずや）
english: (But I defeated Shadow Mio... With this, Mio should be safe for now.)

speaker: Ushio
english: Huh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえなァ……。
緊張感なさすぎやろ！
english: You know... You have absolutely no sense of tension!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
せ、せやかてカレー
おかわりしてへんしっ！！
english: B-But I haven't even had seconds of curry yet!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あれだけ食うたら十分やろ！
まったく……。
english: You've eaten enough already! Good grief...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
仕方ないやん。
なんか急にお腹空いてしもたんやから。
english: I can't help it. I just suddenly got really hungry.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
とにかく、明日は窓んとこ行くで。
菱形医院を調べたいからな。
english: Anyway, we're going to Sou's place tomorrow. I want to investigate the Hishigata Clinic.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: なんで菱形医院なん？
english: Why the Hishigata Clinic?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえが聞いた、
トキちゃんの言葉が気になるからや。
english: Because I'm curious about what you heard Toki-chan say.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
菱形医院は影と裏で繋がってるかも
しれやん……ってこと？
english: You mean... the Hishigata Clinic might be secretly connected to the Shadows?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
明日も早い。
今日はもう寝よう。
english: Tomorrow's an early day. Let's go to sleep for today.

japanese: 根津　銀次郎
english: Ginjiro Nezu

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
english: Responsibility…

speaker: 根津薫
japanese:
あんた……。
お酒はほどほどにしときや……。
english: Dear... Please go easy on the alcohol...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ハァッハァッ、ハァッハァッ……！
english: Hah, hah, hah, hah...!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
english: ...Damn it...

japanese: 菱形　窓
english: Sou Hishigata

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
親父はホンマにっ……！
潮は事故死やと思てんのか！？
english: Does Dad really...! Think Ushio died in an accident!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 潮の首の……あの傷跡は！！！
english: That scar... on Ushio's neck!!!

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: ……その話は終わりだと言ったはずだ。
english: …I said this conversation is over.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おかしいやろ！！！！
ロクに調べもせんと、あんな診断！！
english: It's weird, isn't it!!!! Making a diagnosis like that without even properly investigating!!

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
小舟潮は残念だった。
それ以上の言葉はない。
english: What happened to Ushio Kofune was unfortunate. There is nothing more to say.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
……オレが……
助けられてたら……。
あの時、もっと速く泳げてたら……っ！
english: ...If I had... been able to save her... If I had been able to swim faster back then...!

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
窓。
失望したぞ。
english: Sou. I'm disappointed in you.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: 医学の道は今すぐあきらめろ。
english: Give up on the path of medicine right now.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
おまえは人の死を恐れ、
救えなかったと後悔している。
それは人の命を重いと感じる凡人だからだ。
english: You fear people's deaths, and regret that you couldn't save them. That is because you are an ordinary person who feels the weight of human life.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
話をすりかえてんなよッ！！
親父は……何か隠してる！！
english: Don't change the subject!! Dad... you're hiding something!!

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
何度言わせる。
出て行け！　話は終わりだ……。
english: How many times must I say it. Get out! This conversation is over...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: ~~~~!!!! Shitty old man!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
クソッ……！
何やねん、あの親父……。
english: Damn it...! What the hell is with that old man...

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese: 窓。
english: Sou.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: <color=#GF_TIPS_028>お母さん</color>……。
english: <color=#GF_TIPS_028>Mom</color>...

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese: またケンカしたん……？
english: You two fought again…?

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
お父さん、言い方キツイけど
悪い人ちゃうんよ？
english: Your father can be harsh with his words, but he's not a bad person, okay?

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese: 家族は仲良く……ね？
english: Family should get along... okay?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
わかってるよ……。
早よ寝やな、体に障るで。
english: I know... You should go to sleep early, or it'll be bad for your health.

speaker: Chitose Hishigata (Shadow Chitose)
japanese:
ハイハイ！
窓は優しいなあ……。
english: Yes, yes! You're so kind, Sou...

japanese: 40.ウシオのいる朝
english: 40. The Morning with Ushio

japanese: 7月23日
english: July 23

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……朝になってしまった……）
english: (…It's already morning…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いてて……背中が……。
english: Owowow... my back...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ずっと床に横になってたからな。
　ベッドはこいつに譲って……）
english: (I was lying on the floor the whole time, after all. I let her have the bed...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: すぅすぅ……。
english: *Sleepy breathing*...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮が水着姿で
　オレのベッドで眠っている）
english: (Ushio is sleeping in my bed in her swimsuit.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（その状況をフカンしすぎて、
　結局一睡もできなかった……）
english: (I was taking too much of a bird's-eye view of the situation, and ended up not sleeping a wink...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Jeez...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こいつはよくフツーに寝られるな。
　……昨夜あんなこと言っといて）
english: (How can she sleep so normally... After saying something like that last night.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（「好きな人の味方で何か文句あんのか！！」
　……か……）
english: ("Got a problem with me taking the side of the person I love!!" ...huh...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレのこと好きとか……
　ほ……本気で言ってんのかな……？）
english: (Saying she loves me... I-Is she serious...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そんなこと、人間の潮から
　１回も言われたことないよ！？）
english: (The human Ushio never said anything like that to me, not even once!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも……人間の完璧な複製で、
　気持ちまでコピーしてるなら……
　本当に潮は、オレのこと…………）
english: (But... if she's a perfect replica of a human, and even her feelings were copied... then Ushio really does... me...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……でも……じゃあ澪は……）
english: (...But... then what about Mio...)

speaker: Mio
english: ...It... hurts...

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……な、なんで？
english: ...Wh-Why?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
私だって……。
慎ちゃんのこと――
english: I also... love Shin-chan—

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、おはよう。
english: Shinpei, good morning.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お……起きてたんかよっ！
english: Y-You were awake!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: おなかすいた……のどもかわいた……。
english: I'm hungry... and thirsty...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あぁ……食パンあるからトーストして、
カレーの残りも持って来ら。
english: Ah... We have some bread, so I'll toast it and bring the leftover curry too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
パンやったら食べやすいやろ、
片手だけでも……。
english: Bread should be easier to eat, even with just one hand...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: わーい！
english: Yay!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ちょっと待ってろ。
部屋出んなよ。
english:
Wait a second.
Don't leave the room.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まずは朝飯……
　そのあとの行動はある程度決めてある。
　他にやるべきことは……）
english: (First, breakfast... I've more or less decided what to do after that. Is there anything else I need to do...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……あ！
そうや！！
english: ...Ah! That's right!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……澪、起きてるか？
english: …Mio, are you awake?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
オハヨ慎ちゃん。早いなァ……。
どないしたん？
english: Morning, Shin-chan. You're up early... What's wrong?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
も……もうオレ起きてるからよ。
へ……部屋に起こしに来んでもええからな！！
english: I-I'm already awake, so... Y-You don't need to come to my room to wake me up!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それだけや！
じゃあ！
english: That's all! See ya!

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Y-Yeah...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（最初のループの朝７時半、
　澪はオレを起こしに来た）
english: (On the morning of the first loop, at 7:30, Mio came to wake me up.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハッキリ言っとかないと、
　また部屋に入って来るかも知れないからな）
english: (If I don't tell her clearly, she might come into my room again.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……待って慎ちゃん！
english: …Wait, Shin-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……これ、持っててよ。
english: ...Hold onto this.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …This is…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃんが最後につけてたネックレス。
english: The necklace Sis was wearing at the very end.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro

japanese:
慎ちゃんが持ってた方が、

japanese: 澪がこれを……？

japanese: うん……こっちが本物やな。

speaker: Ushio

japanese: それ見て、何か思い出したりせえへんか？

japanese: え？

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: その……死ぬ前のこととかさ……。

japanese:
（自分が死んだ時の事を思い出させるとか……

japanese:
（でも潮の記憶が戻れば……

speaker: Ushio
english: ...I know!!!

japanese: 何かわかったか！？

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
この貝殻くれた次の日ィ……。
慎平、おねしょしたな！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そ、それは思い出さんでええことや。
他に何かないんか？

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うう～～～ん……。
思い出せやんなァ……。

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そっか……。
まあ、ちょっと意識して
考えといてくれ。
english: I see... Well, just try to keep it in mind and think about it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレ、行くから。
食べ終わった皿はそのまま置いといてくれ。

japanese: あれっ、どこ行くん？

japanese:
今日からもう店開けんねて。

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そっか……。
お父さんらしいわ……会いたいな……。

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （会わせてやりたいけど……）

japanese:
２時には戻ら……。

おとなしく待ってろよ？
english: I'll be back by 2... I don't think anyone will come here, but wait quietly, okay?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……了解ですっ！！
english: …Understood!!

japanese: 41.ウシオと窓の再会

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お待たせ。

japanese: おう。
english: Yo.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
行こか。
……おっと、そうや。
english: Let's go. ...Oh, right.

japanese: ハイこれ、傘。

japanese:
はァ！？　めっちゃ晴れやぞ今日！！
このあっつい日ィになんで雨傘ら……
３５度やで今日！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ええからええから。

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 何やねん、おかしなやっちゃな～～～～～！？

japanese:
（確かに「夕立がある」なんて言われても、

japanese:
あの日、ここで起こってしもたこと……。
潮の死因について、
おまえに言うとかなあかん事がある。

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……うん。
english: …Yeah.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
吉川線やろ？
私が殺されたかも知れやんっていう。

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そうや……実はな……。

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
うわォ！！
だっ……誰や！？
何やおまえは！！！

japanese:
……窓。
潮について、オレもおまえに言っとく事がある。

japanese:
潮！
もう変装解いてええぞ。

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
は？
潮て……は！？
english: Huh? Ushio... huh!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……ふぅ。
english: ...Phew.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ちゃっ……わやや……
そッそんッ……ばぁぁッ！？
english: Wha... huh... Th-That's... n-no way!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 潮ォォ！？！？
english: Ushio!?!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: よっ、窓。
english: Yo, Sou.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……あれ、フリーズしてら！
english: ...Oh, he's frozen!

japanese:
ちょっと慎平……！！
やっぱり私出て来ん方が……。
english: Hey, Shinpei...!! Maybe it would have been better if I didn't come out...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そんな心配もうせんでええ！！
オレがちゃんと説明する。
english: You don't need to worry about that anymore!! I'll explain everything properly.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 誰にもおまえを化物とは呼ばせへん。
english: I won't let anyone call you a monster.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……オレたちは、すべてを窓に伝えた）
english: (...We told Sou everything.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影のこと、南雲先生たちのこと……
　そしてループのこと）
english: (About the Shadows, Nagumo-sensei and the others... and about the looping.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（「今回」も窓は、黙って最後まで
　話を聞いてくれた……）
english: ("This time" too, Sou listened quietly until the very end...)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: オレは慎平を信じる……！！
english: I believe Shinpei...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
こいつはフザケへんし冗談も言わん……
ノリの悪いフカン野郎やけど、
嘘もつかん男や……！！
english: He doesn't screw around or tell jokes... He's a buzzkill always takin' a bird's-eye view, but he's not a liar...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……おまえ、それほめてんの？
english: ...Are you complimenting me?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
このこのぉ、
信用されてるやんか～～～～っ！！
english: Oh you, you're totally trusted aren't ya~~~~!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: Ushio…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ごめん……。
あの時オレが……
もっとうまく蘇生措置できてたら……。
english: I'm sorry... If only I had... performed CPR better back then...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: あの時オレが……もっと……もっと……。
english: If only I had... more... more...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あ……謝っても
取り返しつかんことくらいわかってる！
せやけど、せめてっ！！
english: I... I know apologizing won't change anything! But at least!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
せめて……オレを殴ってくれ……。
せやないとオレはッ……
おまえらの仲間になる資格はない……。
english: At least... punch me... If you don't, I... I don't have the right to be your ally...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Sou…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そんなに自分を責めてたのか……）
english: (Was he blaming himself that much...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（初めてループの時、オレが見た光景は
　やはり実際の出来事……！！）
english: (That scene I saw during my first loop was a real event after all...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえ、必死に助けようとしてくれたやないか！！
誰もおまえを責めてへんし、殴られることなんかっ――
english: You tried so hard to save me, didn't you!! No one is blaming you, and there's no reason for you to get punched—

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ふんッ！！！
english: Hnnngh!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ぐぶッ……！！
english: Gubu...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（蹴った……！！
　キレイに顎を蹴り上げよった！！）
english: (She kicked him...!! She kicked him right under the chin!!)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ぅ……ゲホッ、ゲホッゲホッ……。

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
立て！！　窓！
これで気ィすんだか！！！

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私らはあんたを頼りにしてんねんで！！
いつまでもグジグジすな！！！！

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ぐ……ううっ、う……。

japanese: ……だ、大丈夫か？

japanese:
……はっ、ははっ……
い……痛ェェ……。

japanese:
潮やな慎平……。
こいつホンマにっ、う……潮や……！！
english: It's Ushio, Shinpei... She really is... Ugh... Ushio...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……せやろ。
english: ...Told you.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 戻って来たんやな……潮……！！
english: You're back... Ushio...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: おうっ！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
潮、ここ……覚えてへんか？
この場所は……この海でおまえは……。
english: Ushio, do you... remember this place? This place... in this sea, you...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
小学校裏のプライベートビーチ。
ここで私、死んだんか……。
english: The private beach behind the elementary school. So this is where I died...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……ホンマに記憶ないんやな……。
english: ...She really doesn't remember...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮、これなんやけど……。
english: Ushio, about this...

japanese:
あ！
私の携帯……。
english:
Ah!
My phone…

japanese:
凸村さんから渡されたんや。
事故の前日に、潮から預かったいうて。
english: Totsumura-san gave it to me. He said you entrusted it to him the day before the accident.

japanese: 中身を調べたいんやけど、ロックされててな。

japanese:
パスワードやね。

japanese: あれっ……もう１回。

japanese:
……なんで！？
パスワード変わってる！！

japanese: そうか、おまえも知らんのか……。

japanese:
……なァ、それより慎平！
トキコのことやけど……。

japanese:
ほんまにその……影と……
つながってるって……！？

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あくまで推測の段階や……。

japanese:
菱形家……おまえん家と影が

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 何か思い当たる事ないか？
english: Does anything come to mind?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 親父が……何かを隠してる……。

japanese:
オレも調べたい事あってな……

japanese: 旧病棟……。

japanese:
今はもう使てへん、

japanese:
（それだけ古い時代なら、

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そこ……オレらも連れてってくれ！！

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
もちろん！！
協力しよら！！！
english: Of course!! Let's work together!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あ！　開いた……！
english: Ah! It opened...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh!?

japanese: スマホのロック開いた……指紋認証で！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、そっか！

japanese:
で、どうなん？

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ん～～～～～？

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
メールとかメモ……写真……
何でもええから見てみてくれ！

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
――んっ？
金曜て２０日よな？

japanese:
２０日の５時１７分……私が死ぬ前の日の朝に……。

おい慎平！

japanese:

何から話そか……そう……
事の始まりは、しおりちゃん……。
english: Where should I start... Right... It all started with Shiori-chan...

speaker: Ushio (Video)
japanese:
あれは７月１７日。
私はしおりちゃんから不思議な話を聞いたんや。
english: That was on July 17th. I heard a strange story from Shiori-chan.

japanese: 小舟　潮
english: Ushio Kofune

japanese: 7月17日
english: July 17

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese:
ちゃうよ潮！！
絶対ちゃう！！！
そっくりさんとかそんなレベルとちゃうんやってーー！！
english: No, Ushio!! Definitely not!!! It's not on the level of a lookalike or anything like that!!

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese:
今日かてよォ～～、学校の帰りに
誰かついて来てる気配したしよ～～～～～～ッ。
english: Even today~~, I felt like someone was following me on the way home from school~~~~~~.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
それ不審者ちゃうん！！
気ィ付けや！
凸村に言うといちゃろか！？
english: Isn't that a suspicious person!! Be careful! Should I tell Totsumura!?

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese:
凸村らアテになるかいな！！
ちゅうか絶対『あの子』よ！
昨日も一昨日も、私のことずっと見てたんよ！？
english: Like Totsumura would be any help!! Besides, it's definitely "that girl"! She was watching me all day yesterday and the day before, too!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 他人の空似ちゃうん？
english: Isn't it just a coincidence?

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese: もー、いっこも本気にしとらんやん！！
english: Jeez, you're not taking me seriously at all!!

japanese: 7月18日
english: July 18

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
（……そして１８日、
　ゴミ拾い大会の最中のこと……）
english: (...And then on the 18th, during the beach cleanup...)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
……よいしょっ、と。
はぁ～、今年もゴミ増えたんちゃう？
english: ...Heave-ho. *Sigh*~, didn't the amount of trash increase again this year?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
観光客増えんのも考えもんやな！
このままやと日都ヶ島は
ウェ～～イの巣ゥになるで！！
english: The increase in tourists is a double-edged sword! At this rate, Hitogashima is going to become a nest for party animals!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
まァまァ……。
ちゃんとゴミ持って帰るウェ～～イも
おるよきっと……。
english: Now, now... I'm sure there are party animals who take their trash home properly...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: えっ！？
english: Huh!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: あれ見て、澪！
english: Look at that, Mio!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ウソ！　……え？
あ、あれ……お姉ちゃん！？
english: No way! ...Huh? I-Is that... Sis!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ……あんた誰っ！？
english: …Who are you!?

speaker: Ushio
english: Huh...?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: あっ！　待て！！
english: Ah! Wait!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
……逃げたか……。
もう見えんようになってもた……。
english: ...She ran away... I can't see her anymore...

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: …A Shadow…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ほら！　小っさい時おばあちゃんが
よう聞かせてくれた、怪談……覚えてない！？
english: Look! The ghost story Grandma used to tell us when we were little... don't you remember!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あーー！！
あの……見たら死ぬとかいうヤツ！？
english: Ah!! The one... where you die if you see it!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
アホかっ。
ビビらせんなって澪！！
今のはただのそっくりさ――
english: Don't be stupid. Don't scare me, Mio!! That was just a lookalike—

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
（しおりちゃん、言うてた……
　「そっくりさんとかそんなレベルちゃう」……）
english: (Shiori-chan said... "It's not on the level of a lookalike"...)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
……澪！！
しおりちゃん探すで！！
english: ...Mio!! Let's go look for Shiori-chan!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: えっ……う、うんっ！
english: Huh... Y-Yeah!

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese: え？　影？
english: Huh? A Shadow?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そう！
しおりちゃん、『そっくりさん』のこと……
今日は見かけた！？
english: Yes! Shiori-chan, about the "lookalike"... Did you see it today!?

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese:
ううん！
今日はまだ見てへん！
english: Nope! I haven't seen it yet today!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 私、この話ちょっと調べてみる。
english: I'm going to look into this a bit.

speaker: Shiori Kobayakawa
japanese:
えっ！
やっと信じる気ィになった！？
english: Huh! You finally believe me!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
なった！！
せやからもう心配いらんで！
english: I do!! So you don't need to worry anymore!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 万年青浜ゴミ拾い大会、これにて終了！！
english: The Omoto Beach Trash Cleanup is now concluded!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
みなさんのおかげでキレイになって、
明日は海開きです～～～。
english: Thanks to everyone, it's all clean, and tomorrow is the start of the beach season~~~.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
今日集めたゴミは、
２４日の御海送りで焚き上げます！
english: The trash we collected today will be burned at the Umi-okuri on the 24th!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
え～～～、御海送りというのは
そもそも起源をさかのぼるとですね、
今から３００年前……。
english: Ummm, the origins of the Umi-okuri, if we trace them back, date back 300 years...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
雁切さん、
そのハナシ長なるんやったら今度にして～～っ！！
english: Karikiri-san, if that story's gonna be long, save it for next time~~!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
これは失礼！
みなさんお疲れやのにね！
english: My apologies! You must all be tired!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ではみなさん！
次は２４日の夏祭りでお会いしましょうーー！！
english: Well then, everyone! Let's meet next at the summer festival on the 24th~~!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: （……そして、家に帰ってから）
english: (...And then, after returning home)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ねえお姉ちゃん。
今年の夏は、慎ちゃん帰って来るんかな……。
english: Hey, Sis. I wonder if Shin-chan will come back this summer...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
はァ？
一生帰って来んでええしあんなん……！
english: Huh? I don't care if a guy like that never comes back...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……好きなくせに……。
english: ...Even though you like him...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃん、
慎ちゃんのこと好きなくせに。
english: Sis, even though you like Shin-chan.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: なっ……。
english: Wh...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
んなわけあるか！！
しょーもないこと言うて！！
english: Like hell I do!! Don't say such stupid things!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
どけっ！！
私が先に風呂入る！！！
english: Move it!! I'm taking a bath first!!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: （慎平……今ごろ何してるかな……）
english: (Shinpei... I wonder what he's doing right now...)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
（って、何考えてんねん私！
　あんなヤツ……！！）
english: (Wait, what am I thinking! A guy like that...!!)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: は～～～、早よ頭冷やそ！
english: Hah~~~, I need to cool my head!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
english: ...Huh?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: おかえり……。
english: Welcome home...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
english: ...M-Mio—

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ダメ！
english: Don't!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
んッ！？
んんんんんんんんーー！
english: Nngh!? Mmmmmmmmph!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
シィーーーーッ。
とりあえず落ち着いて！
english: Shhhhhh. Just calm down for a sec!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
……で、答えてもらおか。
あんた一体何者や！！？
なんでうちにおったんや？
english: ...So, care to answer? Who the heck are you!!? Why were you in our house?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私は小舟潮！！
自分ん家に帰って来ただけや。
english: I'm Ushio Kofune!! I just came back to my own house.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
……じ、じゃあ！
なんで風呂に隠れてたん！？
english: ...Th-Then! Why were you hiding in the bath!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あんたが澪と帰って来たからや！！
english: Because you came back with Mio!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: あ……あんたは……。
english: Y... You're...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あのさ……。
english: Hey...

speaker: 潮とウシオ
japanese: 影って知ってる？
english: Do you know about Shadows?

speaker: 潮とウシオ
english: Huh!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: あんたが影やろ！！
english: You're the Shadow!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あんたやろ！？
english: You are, right!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
（え～～っ！
　どうなってんのこれェーー！？）
english: (Eh~~~! What is going on here~~!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ちょっと待ってよ……。
影がホンマに実在するんやとしたら――
english: Wait a minute... If Shadows really do exist—

speaker: 潮とウシオ
japanese:
しおりちゃんの影も
この島のどっかにおるってことや！
english: That means Shiori-chan's Shadow is also somewhere on this island!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……嫌な予感がする。
english: …I have a bad feeling.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
english: Huh!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
しおりちゃんが影を最初に見たのって確か、
<color=#GF_TIPS_046>タカノス山</color>って言うてたわな！？
english: Didn't Shiori-chan say she first saw the Shadow at <color=#GF_TIPS_046>Mt. Takanosu</color>!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
こら調べてみる必要ありそうちゃう！？
タカノス山に何かあるんか……。
english: Looks like we need to investigate this, doesn't it!? Is there something at Mt. Takanosu...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
（……同じや！
　私とこの子……姿だけと違て、
　記憶や……考え方まで……！！）
english: (...We're the same! Me and her... Not just our appearance, but our memories... and even our way of thinking...!!)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: （今んとこ、害はなさそうやな……）
english: (She doesn't seem harmful for now...)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ぃよし！！
まァええ、あんたの事は後回しや！！
english: Alright!! Well whatever, I'll deal with you later!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: っ！

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: まずは……。
english: First…

speaker: 潮とウシオ
japanese: タカノス山へ！！
english: To Mt. Takanosu!!

japanese: 43.潮の動画②
english: 43. Ushio's Video ②

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
（……そして私たち二人は、
　タカノス山にやって来た）
english: (...And so the two of us came to Mt. Takanosu.)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: なんでついて来んねん！！
english: Why're ya following me?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あんたがついて来たんやろ！？
タカノス山に行く言うたんは私やで！
english: You're the one following me!? I'm the one who said I was going to Mt. Takanosu!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
私はしおりちゃんと約束したんや！
影について調べる！
心配いらんって！！
english: I made a promise to Shiori-chan! I'm going to investigate the Shadows! I told you not to worry!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: そうなん！？
english: Oh, really!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そうや！！
ちょっとでも妙な動きしくさったら、いてまうど！！
english: That's right!! If you make even the slightest weird move, I'll beat you up!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ええな！！
english: Got it!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
（だいぶ歩き回ってはみたものの、何も見つからん。
　今日は時間切れやな、暗なる前に山下りやな……）
english: (We've walked around quite a bit, but haven't found anything. We're out of time for today, gotta head down the mountain before it gets dark...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ちょっと、こっち来てみ！！
english: Hey, come look at this!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: どないしたん？
english: What's wrong?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
見て、この先、道になっちゃある。
でも……。
english: Look, there's a path up ahead. But...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 『危険、ここより先立入禁止』――
english: "Danger: No Entry Beyond This Point"—

speaker: Ushio
japanese: こういう看板見たら、入りたなれへん？
english: Doesn't seeing a sign like this make you want to go in?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: わかる。
english: I get that.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: でも、もうすぐ暗なる――
english: But it's gonna get dark soon—

speaker: Ushio
japanese: よっ、と。
english: Hup.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あ！
ちょっと！？
english: Ah! Hey!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
もう帰らなヤバイってば！！
聞いてんのーーー！？
english: I'm telling you it's bad if we don't go back now!! Are you listening~~~!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: ……言うてもきかんか……もう！！
english: ...You're not gonna listen, are you... Jeez!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
待てって！
私も行く！！
english: I said wait! I'm coming too!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
そっか……！！
ここって……。
english: Oh...!! This place is...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ほら、あの札……『菱形医院』。
窓んとこの旧病棟ちゃう！？
english: Look, that sign... "Hishigata Clinic." Isn't this Sou's family's old clinic!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そうみたいやな。
オバケが出るってうわさの……。
english: Seems like it. The one rumored to be haunted...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 初めて見たわ……。
english: It's my first time seeing it...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……窓から中、見てみよか。
english: …Let's look inside through the window.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: う、うん……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
うわ～～～、
中も荒れ放題やな……こわっ……！！
私……オバケだけは苦手なんや……。
english: Whoa~~~, it's completely trashed inside too... scary...!! I'm... really bad with ghosts...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あんたもか！
english: You too?!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: そのわりにどんどん行くなァ！
english: You're sure marching right in despite that!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……ここが入り口やな。
english: …This must be the entrance.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ちょっ……こん中入る気ィか！？
あんた平気なん！？
english: Wait... you're planning to go inside!? Are you okay with this!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
平気ちゃうけど……
でも……なんやろ……。
english: I'm not okay with it, but... But... I don't know...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私……ここに……
来たことあるような気ィする……。
english: I feel like... I've been here before...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
だっ……誰や！！
誰かおるんか！？
english: Wh-Who is it!! Is someone there!?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: （な、なんや……あれ……？）
english: (Wh-What is... that...?)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: うっ！
english: Ugh!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: なんや！？
english: What?!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
（く……黒いヤツの、形が……
　どんどん人間みたいになって……）
english: (Th... That black thing's shape... is steadily becoming more human-like...)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
（あの顔、私や！！
　こっ……これが……<color=#GF_TIPS_101>影</color>！？）
english: (That face is mine!! I-Is this... a <color=#GF_TIPS_101>Shadow</color>!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 危ないっ！！
english: Look out!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: あ、ありがと……。
english: Th-Thanks...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
（な、なに今の……。
　腕がビュッと伸びたような……？）
english: (Wh-What was that just now... It felt like my arm suddenly stretched out...?)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
な、なんやあれ……。
またかたちが変わって……。
english: Wh-What is that... Its shape is changing again...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ぐっ……！！
ううっ……！
english:
Guh…!!
Ugh…!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
はっ……放せェ！！
くそっ！
なんやこれ……くそォッ！！
english: L-Let go!! Damn it! What is this... damn it!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
こ、この……っ！
そいつ放せっ！！
english: Y-You...! Let go of her!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うぅっ……！
english: Ugh…!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: （ウソ……効いてないん？）
english: (No way... it's not working?)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: こんのォッ！！
english: Take this!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: （しまっ――）
english: (Oh no——)

speaker: 影（崩れた潮）
japanese: ギッ！
english: Gah!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ゲホッゲホッ！
english: *Cough, cough*!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
（効いた……！？
　はずれたはずやのに……どういうこと！？）
english: (It worked...!? Even though it missed... what does this mean!?)

speaker: 影（崩れた潮）
japanese: ギィ……ッ！
english: Gih...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うわっ！？
english: Whoa!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（刺された！？
　刺されたんは私の足やないのに……！
　この痛み……！）
english: (I got stabbed!? It wasn't my leg that got stabbed, but...! This pain...!)

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: （も、もしかして……影の弱点は……）
english: (C-Could it be... the Shadow's weak point is...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（うん……わかってる……！
　今ハッキリとカラダで理解したわ……！）
english: (Yeah... I get it...! I just clearly understood it with my own body...!)

speaker: 影（崩れた潮）
japanese: ヴァァッッ！
english: Vaaaah!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 来るッ！！
english: Here it comes!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: （私は人間じゃない――）
english: (I'm not human——)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（私の本体は平面の影――
　立体は――）
english: (My main body is the 2D shadow— The 3D body is—)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: （平面を守るための武器……！！！）
english: (A weapon to protect the 2D form...!!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……ハァッ、ハァッ……！！！
english: …Hah, hah…!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あんた……。
な、なに今の……。
english: You... Wh-What was that just now...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
スゴすぎ！！！
めっちゃカッコエエやんっ！！
english: That was amazing!!! You're super cool!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: っ！

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……せやろ！！
english: ...I know, right!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ほら、立てるか？
私の手ェ掴んで！
english: Here, can you stand? Grab my hand!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
……足を怪我しとったよな。
手当てせな！
english: ...You injured your leg, right. We need to treat it!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
この傷は手当てしても治らん……
元のデータに傷が入ったんや……。
english: This wound won't heal even if you treat it... The original data was damaged...

japanese: データ！？

japanese:

多分「上書き」してしもたんやと思う。
english: ...But I just can't remember anything before that. I think I probably "overwrote" it.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 上書き……ってどういうことなん？
english: Overwrite... what do you mean?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
影としての元の部分を消してしもたらあかんのに、
私は影の自分を、小舟潮のデータで上書きして……
消してしもたんや。
english: I wasn't supposed to erase my original parts as a Shadow, but I overwrote my Shadow self with Ushio Kofune's data... and erased it.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
せやから私は自分の事、小舟潮て思てる……。
ははっ……アホや私……。
english: That's why I think of myself as Ushio Kofune... Haha... I'm an idiot...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
コピーに失敗したんかな？
今となってはわからんわ……。
english: Maybe the copy failed? I don't know at this point...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: それとも私が……でき損ないやったんか……。
english: Or maybe I was just... a defect...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ほなら、もっかい上書きしたらええやん！
そしたらそのケガ治るんちゃう！？
english: Then you should just overwrite it again! That'll heal your injury, right!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
り、理論上は……。
でも、ええんか……？
私は……あんたの影やで？
english: Th-Theoretically... But, is that okay...? I'm... your Shadow, you know?

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: かまへんかまへん！！
english: It's fine, it's fine!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
あんたがかばってくれやんかったら、私死んでたし！
自分に借り作るんら気色悪りわ！！
english: If you hadn't protected me, I would have died! I don't want to owe myself a favor, it's creepy!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
靴と靴下は邪魔？
ちょっと待っててや。
すぐ脱ぐから。
english: Are my shoes and socks in the way? Wait a sec. I'll take them off right now.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
ほれっ！
これで貸し借りチャラや！！
english: Here! Now we're even!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
礼は言わんぞ！！
自分にありがとうら……気色悪りてよう言わんわ！！
english: I won't say thanks!! Saying thank you to myself... it's too creepy, I can't say it!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ほな、やるで。
english: Alright, here goes.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
すげーーーっ！！
治った！
english: Woooow!! It's healed!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
記憶まではコピーしてへん。
ちゅうかできやん……。
english: I didn't copy your memories. Or rather, I can't...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
また上書きしてしもたら、
私が私やなくなるから……
右足のデータだけ写さしてもろたわ。
english: If I overwrote everything again, I wouldn't be me anymore... So I just copied the data for your right leg.

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: 「データ」って感じなん？
english: It feels like "data"?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
上手いことよう言わんけど、そんな感じ。
でも、このコピーしたデータは……
しばらくしたら消えてしまうと思う……。
english: I can't explain it well, but something like that. But I think... this copied data will disappear after a while...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
本物を消せば、コピーが本物になって
この世界に存在していられるようになる……。
english: If we erase the original, the copy becomes the original and can continue to exist in this world...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:
消すって……つまり……殺す？

english: Erase... you mean... kill? Will you disappear if I don't die!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
多分な……

english: Probably... I don't know for sure, but I just have that feeling in my head.

japanese:

私は本物を殺さなあかんねやろな……。
english: Normally, I'd probably have to kill the original...

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese:

影を見たら死ぬって……

english: Wh... what the heck... Seeing a Shadow means you'll die... So that's what it meant...!!

speaker: Ushio Kofune
japanese: しおりちゃんが危ない……！！
english: Shiori-chan is in danger...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……もう帰らんと。
ここも安全じゃない。
english: ...We need to go back. It's not safe here either.
