speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: んン？　あァ……。
english: Hm? Ah...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
オレなァ……小学四年の夏休みに
１回だけ忍び込もうとしたことあんねん。
english: See... I tried to sneak in just once during summer vacation in fourth grade.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 凸村とその友達に誘われてな、肝試しするいうて……。
english: I was invited by Totsumura and his friends, they said we were doing a test of courage...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うわァ最悪……あいつ仮にも警察やろ！？
立入禁止の４文字が読めやんのか！
english: Wow, the worst... He's supposed to be a cop, right!? Can't he read the "No Trespassing" sign!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえが言うかソレ！
english: You're one to talk!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
でも結局中には入れんかってん。
親父に見つかってな……。
english: But in the end, we didn't get inside. My dad found us...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そんなことが……）
english: (So that happened...)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そん時はあんまり気に留めやんかった……。
この辺はウチの土地やし、
親父がおることもあるやろってな。
english: I didn't really pay it much mind at the time... This area is our land, so I figured my dad might be around sometimes.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
でも考えたら変やろ。
こんな廃墟に、親父が一人で何の用やったんや？
english: But thinking about it, it's weird. What business did my dad have alone in these ruins?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……なるほど。
それで何か隠してると思ったわけか。
english: ...I see. So you thought he was hiding something.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 廃墟に隠すモンいうたら、何やろなァ……。
english: If you're hiding something in ruins, what could it be...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮、影は近くにおるか？
english: Ushio, are there Shadows nearby?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: う～～むむむむむむ……。
english: Hmmmmmm...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（記憶を取り戻した潮は、
　影の「気配」を察知できるようになったという）
english: (Ushio, having regained her memories, is supposedly able to sense the "presence" of Shadows.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （この奥にいてもおかしくないが……どうだ？）
english: (It wouldn't be strange if one was further inside... How is it?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……ん～～～！
今んトコ大丈夫っ！！！
english: ...Hmm~! It's fine for now!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: き、急に人型に……！
english: S-Suddenly in human form...!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
って、おいおい！
おまえらなァ～～ッ！
水着ってフザけてんのかコラ！
english: Hey, wait a sec! You guys~~! Are you screwing around wearing a swimsuit!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
これから影と戦うかも知らんねやぞ！！？
泳ぎに来たんとちゃいまっせーーッ！
english: We might have to fight Shadows from here on out, you know!!? We didn't come here to swim~~!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
は？　あんたこそ野球しに来たんか？
おぉーーん！？
english: Huh? Did you come here to play baseball? Haaaaah!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
水着は私の戦闘服や！！
ナメとったらあかんぞコラァ！！！！
english: The swimsuit is my battle uniform!! Don't mess with me, you hear!!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ひィ！！
english: Eek!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
怖っ……！！　あの人怖っ！！
澪と大違いや！
おまえようあんなんと住んどったな、慎平！
english: Scary...!! She's scary!! Completely different from Mio! How did you live with someone like that, Shinpei!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うるさいッ！
慎平、さっさと説明しちゃって！
english: Shut up! Shinpei, just explain it to him already!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、ああ。
えーっと、いろいろ試した結果……。
english: A-Ah. Umm, as a result of trying various things...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
本物の服とか物とかを身に付けてたら、
変身する時にジャマになるってわかったんや。
english: We figured out that wearing real clothes or items gets in the way when transforming.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
たとえ鎧を着ても私の本体は平面の影……。
影を刺されたら死ぬ。
english: Even if I wear armor, my main body is a 2D shadow... If my shadow gets stabbed, I die.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
やから、私のレパートリーの中で戦うんやったら
水着が一番ってわけ！
english: So, if I'm fighting using my repertoire, a swimsuit is the best!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ちなみに私は、
一度コピーした物やったら何回でも変身できる。
頭の容量が許す限りレパートリーは増やせる。
english: By the way, I can transform into anything I've copied once as many times as I want. As long as my brain capacity allows, I can increase my repertoire.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: スゴイやろ！？
english: Amazing, right!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ……。
けど目のやり場に困るでェ！！
english: Yeah... But I don't know where to look!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おい！
english: Hey!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: うィ？
english: Huh?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うへェ……。
雰囲気ありすぎやろ……。
崩れてきたりしやんやろな？
english: Ugh... It's got way too much atmosphere... It's not going to collapse on us, right?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
１４年前に建物の老朽化で
立ち入り禁止になってるからなァ。
あり得なくもない。
english: It was declared off-limits 14 years ago due to the building's deterioration, after all. It's not impossible.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ちょっ！？
english: Wait!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
中を歩き回るくらいならええけど、
あんましドタバタすんなよ？
english: It should be fine just walking around inside, but don't stomp around too much, okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（古い家具や本がたくさん……。
　どのくらい昔のものかわからないほどだ）
english: (There's a lot of old furniture and books... It's hard to even tell how old they are.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
スゴイな……当時のまま残ってんのか。
歴史的な価値がありそう。
english: Amazing... Is it really preserved exactly as it was back then? It looks like it has historical value.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ああ……。
english: Yeah...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
和歌山大空襲の時にも焼けへんかったらしいから
明治の頃に建ったまんま、築１００年以上やな……。
english: Apparently it didn't burn down during the Wakayama air raid either, so it's stood just as it was built in the Meiji era, making it over 100 years old...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 廃墟になったんは１９６０年頃って聞いてる。
english: I heard it became abandoned around 1960.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ふむ……。
english: Hm…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （何かないか……影との繋がりを示す何か……）
english: (Is there anything... Anything that shows a connection to the Shadows...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……あれ？
なんか天井に大穴開いてるわ。
english: ...Huh? There's a big hole in the ceiling.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
上に行く階段が崩れてもうてるんやな。
となると２階を調べるんは無理か……。
english: The stairs going up have completely collapsed. I guess that means investigating the second floor is impossible...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや！
影の力で上がれそうちゃうか潮？
english: Can ya use shadow powers to get up there, Ushio?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
えっ？
それは……。
english: Huh? Well...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あっ！
確かオバケが怖いんやっけ？
かえらしトコあらいしょ～～。
english: Ah! You're scared of ghosts, right? You've got a cute side to you~~.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ぐ……ッぬぬぬ……言うんやなかった……。
english: Gu... Nnngh... I shouldn't have said anything...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: やったるわ、見てきたる！！
english: I'll do it, I'll go take a look!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: どや！！！
english: How's that!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おおっ！　すげ～～っ。
壁ん中、潜っていきよった……！
english: Ooh! Amazing~~. She went right into the wall...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 調べてくるからそこにいててよ慎平！！
english: I'll go investigate, so stay right there Shinpei!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
べ、別に怖いからとかちゃうからな！？
はぐれたら、あんたらに何かあっても
助けに行けやんからやからな！！！
english: I-It's not like I'm doing this because I'm scared or anything, okay!? It's because if we get separated, I won't be able to help you guys if something happens!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 了解。
english: Understood.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
オバケはおらんけど、影はおるからな！
気ィつけろよ！！
english: There are no ghosts, but there are Shadows! Be careful!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: わかってるわ、あっぽけ！！
english: I know that, you idiot!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: お～～怖っ！！
english: Oh~~ scary!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（さて、こっちは１階を調べておこう。
　どこから手を付けるべきか……）
english: (Now then, I'll investigate the first floor. Where should I start...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（目の前には薬棚。
　床には大量の紙が散乱してるな）
english: (There's a medicine cabinet right in front of me. And a ton of papers scattered on the floor.)

japanese: 薬棚を調べる
english: Check the medicine cabinet

japanese: 散乱した紙を調べる
english: Check the scattered papers

japanese: ２階の様子をウシオに尋ねる
english: Ask Ushio about the second floor

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（薬棚を調べてみよう。
　……危険なものがあるかもしれない。
　触るときは気をつけないと）
english: (I'll investigate the medicine cabinet. ...There might be dangerous things inside. I need to be careful when touching anything.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
見慣れない薬ばっかりやな……。
古いものが多そうや。
文字も旧字体だったり、印刷がかすれてたり……。
english: There are nothing but unfamiliar medicines... Looks like there are a lot of old ones. The characters are in old forms, and the printing is faded...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: どれどれ……。
english: Let me see…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
麦角エキス……。
こっちは安息香酸……保存や殺菌に使うもんや。
イソミンまである。
english: Ergot extract... This one is benzoic acid... used for preservation and sterilization. There's even isomine.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おっ！
これは……昇汞や！
english: Oh! This is... corrosive sublimate!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: しょうこう？
english: Corrosive sublimate?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
<color=#GF_KEY_SHOUKOU>塩化第二水銀</color>……猛毒で今は使われてへん薬や！
ヤバイな……
ウチこんなもんほったらかしにしてんのかよ……。
english: <color=#GF_KEY_SHOUKOU>Mercuric chloride</color>... a highly toxic chemical that isn't used anymore! This is bad... My family just left something like this lying around...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （この紙はなんだろう？）
english: (I wonder what these papers are?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: これって……！！
english: This is…!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（古いカルテや……処方箋？
　こんな無造作に、床に……！！）
english: (Old medical records... and prescriptions? Just casually scattered on the floor like this...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（患者の生年月日が
　昭和……大正……明治のもある！！
　明らかに戦前のもの！）
english: (The patients' dates of birth include Showa... Taisho... even Meiji!! These are clearly pre-war!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（胃腸炎、気管支炎、肺炎……。
　どれもありふれた病名ばかりだな……）
english: (Gastroenteritis, bronchitis, pneumonia... They're all common illnesses...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（菱形先生が、影の病のことを
　「カプグラ症候群」って呼んでたけど……。
　どのカルテにもそんな文字はないようだ）
english: (Hishigata-sensei called the Shadow Sickness "Capgras syndrome," but... I don't see those words on any of these medical records.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それに……放り出された書類に混じって……
　なんだこれ？）
english: (Also... mixed in with the tossed documents... What is this?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（<color=#GF_TIPS_109>パンダのぬいぐるみ</color>？
　ずいぶん汚れてるけど、
　これは戦前じゃなくて最近のものだろうな……）
english: (A <color=#GF_TIPS_109>stuffed panda</color>? It's pretty dirty, but this is probably recent, not from before the war...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮！
そっちはどうなってる？
english: Ushio! How are things on your end?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ひゃあ、急に話しかけんな！
話しかける前に一声かけてよ！
english: Hyaa, don't just suddenly talk to me! Give me a heads up before you talk!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: んなムチャな……。
english: That's unreasonable...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なんか……こっちは人が住んどったみたい！
アルバムがあったから、そっちに投げるで。
english: Seems like... someone used to live up here! There was an album, so I'll toss it down to you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おう。
english: Got it.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
……ん？　これって……。
<color=#GF_TIPS_104>うちのアルバム</color>やないかい！
気軽にほかすな！
english: ...Hm? This is... <color=#GF_TIPS_104>our family album</color>! Don't just toss it so casually!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （他に何かありそうな部屋は……）
english: (Are there any other rooms that might have something...)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: し……慎平っ！！！
english: Sh... Shinpei!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうした！？
english: What's wrong!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: な、なんや……？　あれ。
english: Wh-What is... that.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: どうやら手術室みたいなんやが……。
english: It seems to be an operating room, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
木彫りの像……か？
気味が悪いな……。
かなり古そうや。
english: A wooden carving...? It's creepy... It looks pretty old.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
手術室に像て……
普通、こんな所に像やて
置くもんやないやろ。
english: A statue in an operating room... Normally, you wouldn't put a statue in a place like this.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
左脇に魚をかかえてる。
鯛……か？
english: It's holding a fish under its left arm. A sea bream...?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
んー、こういうん見たことあるよな。
なんやっけ……ホラ……商売繁盛のォ～～。
english: Hmm, I feel like I've seen something like this before. What was it... You know... the one for prosperous business~~.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: エビス様か！
english: Ebisu-sama!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: それや！！
english: That's it!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ちょっと検索してみるわ。
english: I'll do a quick search.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
えびす……。
七福神の一柱、漁業の神様……。
english: Ebisu... One of the Seven Lucky Gods, the god of fishing...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……あ。
これは……！
english: ...Ah. This is...!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: どうした？
english: What's wrong?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
見てくれ。
エビス様について
詳しく書いとるサイトなんやけど……。
english: Look. It's a site with detailed information about Ebisu-sama, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
『えびす』という神は複数あり、
蛭子命と同一視されることもある、って……。
english: It says there are multiple deities called "Ebisu," and they are sometimes identified with Hiruko-no-Mikoto...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: まさか……ヒルコ様……？
english: Could it be… Hiruko-sama…?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ヒルコ様ァ！？　これが……？
english: Hiruko-sama!? This is...?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
どういうことや……
なんでそんなもんがここに……！？
english: What does this mean... Why is something like that here...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: わからん……ただの推測や。
english: I don't know... it's just a guess.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （でも……もしこれがヒルコ様なら……）
english: (But... if this really is Hiruko-sama...)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そもそも<color=#GF_TIPS_110>ヒルコ様</color>てどんな格好してんの？
見たことないわな……男か女かもわからん。
english: What does <color=#GF_TIPS_110>Hiruko-sama</color> even look like in the first place? I've never seen them... I don't even know if they're a man or a woman.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
詳しい姿はどこにも……。
手足のない蛭の様な姿……「異形」としか……。
english: There's no detailed description anywhere... A leech-like figure without limbs... it's only described as "grotesque"...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
わからんな……なんでそんな神様が、
めでたい神様として祀られるんや！？
english: I don't get it... why would a god like that be worshipped as an auspicious god!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (...A draft...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おーーい、潮！
english: H—ey, Ushio!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: どないしたっ！！？
english: What is it!!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
って、うわ！
何なんこれ！？
不気味～～～！！
english: Wait, whoa! What is this!? Creepy~~~!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ２階はどうやった？
english: What'd ya find upstairs?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
いろいろ置いとったけど……。
ちゃんと調べるんやったら、一日じゃ足らんなあ。
english: There were a lot of things up there... If we were to investigate properly, a single day wouldn't be enough.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
で？
何かあったん？
english: So? Did you find anything?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ほら、この壁に１センチほどのスキマあるやろ。
おまえやったら、影になって入れるんちゃうか？
english: Look, there's a gap of about one centimeter in this wall. If it's you, couldn't you turn into a shadow and go in?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
影使いの荒いやっちゃな……。
明日の祭りでたこ焼きおごってや！
english: You're really working your Shadow hard... Treat me to takoyaki at the festival tomorrow!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ええぞ。
１０コでも１００コでも買うちゃあそ。
english: ...Sure. I'll buy you ten or a hundred.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
まじでっ！
言うたな慎平、約束やで！！
english: Seriously! You said it, Shinpei. That's a promise, okay!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……どうな！？
何かあるか！
english: ...Well!? Is there anything?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なんか床に……どうなってんのコレ？
暗て何もわからん！
english: There's something on the floor... what is this? It's so dark I can't tell anything!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの……ピカッて光ったらどうや！？
もうできるんやろ？
別に何もコピーせんでええから！
english: Um... what if you flashed that light!? You can do it now, right? You don't have to copy anything!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: そっか！
english: Oh, right!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あ！？
この壁……扉かも！！
鍵穴がある！！
english: Ah!? This wall... it might be a door!! There's a keyhole!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 何っ！？
english: What?!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
でも、鍵がどこにあるんかわからん。
この辺にはないみたいやけど……。
english: But I don't know where the key is. It doesn't look like it's around here, though...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
それならオレの出番や！
バットで殴って、扉壊したる！
english: Then it's my turn! I'll smash the door down with my bat!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
よっしゃ！
潮、いったん戻って来い！
english: Alright! Ushio, come back out for a sec!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: わかった！
english: Got it!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ほな、頼むわ窓。
バットで壊せるか試してみてくれ。
english: Alright, I'm counting on you, Sou. Try and see if you can break it with the bat.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: いくでぇ……おりゃっ！！
english: Here I go... Orya!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ぐううううっ……！！
う、腕が……しびれるゥ～～～……！
english: Guuuuuh...!! M-My arms... they're numb~~~...!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あかん……頑丈すぎる！
壊して開けるんはムリやな……。
english: It's no good... it's too sturdy! Breaking it open is impossible...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: やっぱり鍵を探さんと……。
english: We need to find the key after all...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
くそっ！！
絶対怪しいのによォ……。
為す術ナシかよちくしょう！！！
english: Damn it!! It's definitely suspicious... Is there really nothing we can do, dammit!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……まだやれることはあるはずや。
他にも怪しいとこあるし、
調べてみよか。
english: ...There must still be things we can do. There are other suspicious places, so let's check them out.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
とりあえず、
あの像は思いっきし怪しいな！
english: For starters, that statue is incredibly suspicious!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
つってもなァ……。
見た感じじゃあ、エビス様っぽいって
ことくらいしかわからんで？
english: Even so... Just looking at it, all we can tell is that it looks like Ebisu-sama, right?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
でもエビス様いうたら太ったおっさんよなァ……。
これは何ちゅうか……女性的っちゅうか……。
english: But when you think of Ebisu-sama, you think of a fat old man... This is, how should I say... kinda feminine...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Feminine…?)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
もしかしたら、
これがヒルコ様かもしれんって
言うてたけど……。
english: You said this might be Hiruko-sama, but...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ええっ！？
こんな不気味なのがそうなん！？
english: Ehhh!? This creepy thing is!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
今んとこ慎平の推測にしか過ぎんけどな。
なあ慎平？
english: It's just Shinpei's guess for now, though. Right, Shinpei?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 慎平、どないした？
english: Shinpei, what's wrong?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや、さっきおまえ、
女性的って言ったよな？
english: No, you just said it looked feminine, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それで気になったんやけど、
このヒルコ様の像……お腹のとこ
膨らんでるよな。
english: That made me curious. This Hiruko-sama statue... its belly is swollen, isn't it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これってもしかして……
『妊娠』してるんとちゃうか？
english: Could it be... that it's "pregnant"?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
い、言われて見れば確かにな……。
でもヒルコ様に子宝のご利益なんかあったか？
english: N-Now that you mention it, it sure is... But did Hiruko-sama grant blessings for children?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや……なかったはず。
となるとこれは一体……。
english: No... they shouldn't have. Then what on earth is this...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
まって……。
私が像の中見てみる。
english: Wait... I'll look inside the statue.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
見る？
見るてどうやって――
english: Look? How are you going to look—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……っ！！
　コピーするときのフラッシュ……！）
english: (...!! The flash from when she copies...!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
影のスキャンは、モノの内側を見通す！
人間の骨格や内臓を……だからコピーできる！
english: A Shadow's scan can see through the inside of objects! It can see human skeletons and internal organs... that's why they can copy them!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……当たりや！
お腹の中に何かある！！
english: ...Spot on! There's something inside its belly!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: マジか！
english: Seriously?!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: コピーして確かめる！！
english: I'll copy it to see!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
髪の毛？
そんなもん抜いてどうすんねん。
english: A strand of hair? What are you going to do plucking that out?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: こうすんのや！
english: This is what!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうか、髪を使ってコピーを……。
english: I see, using hair to copy it...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
こっ……こいつは……！！
鍵……！！
english: Th... This is...!! A key...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮、頼んだ……！
english: Ushio, I'm counting on you!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: おう！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english:
!!
The door…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 開いた！
english: It's open!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
部屋の中には……穴か？
ここから地下へ降りるのか……。
english: Inside the room... is a hole? Does it lead underground from here...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
気ィつけて二人共……。
この下から影の気配を感じる……。
english: Be careful, you two... I can feel the presence of Shadows from down there...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
影が像の腹部をスキャンする……。
そして壁のスキマを通って中に入った影が、
コピーした鍵で内側から鍵を開ける……。
english: A Shadow scans the abdomen of the statue... Then, the Shadow that entered through the gap in the wall uses the copied key to unlock it from the inside...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
影がおらんと……
影の力を借りやな開かへん隠し扉……。
そんなモンがウチに……！！
english: Without a Shadow... A hidden door that can't be opened without borrowing a Shadow's power... Something like that is in my house...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: Dad...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Ushio.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
怖くないよ。
慎平といっしょなら。
english: I'm not scared. As long as I'm with Shinpei.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 行こう。
english: Let's go.

japanese: 48.影との戦闘
english: 48. Battle with the Shadow

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（地下へと続く隠し階段を
　慎重に降りていった先……）
english: (At the end of the hidden stairs leading underground, which we descended carefully...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そこには、思った以上に
　広い空間が待ち受けていた）
english: (A much larger space than expected awaited us.)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ここは……地下壕か。
english: Is this... an underground bunker?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
戦時中に掘られた壕が、
この島にいくつもあるって聞いてるが……。
english: I've heard there are several bunkers on this island that were dug during the war, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（日本軍の地下壕……閉ざされた入口……
　恐らく何十年も誰も入っていない）
english: (A Japanese military underground bunker... A sealed entrance... Probably no one has entered for decades.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……いや、影だけの通り道！？）
english: (...No, a path meant only for Shadows!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮、影の気配はあるか！？
english: Ushio, is there any presence of Shadows!?

speaker: Ushio
english: ...Over there...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 数は？
english: How many?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
わからん……。
寒気がする……ものすごい嫌な空気…………。
english: I don't know... I'm getting chills... A completely awful atmosphere...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ほんまに進んでええんか！？
english: Are we really going to keep going!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
行くしかない。
進みたくない方へ……！！
english: We have to go. Towards the direction we don't want to go...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……おう。
english: ...Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: その前に、二人とも聞いてくれ。
english: Before that, listen to me, both of you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……もしも戦闘になって、
抜き差しならない状況になった場合――
english: ...If we get into a fight, and end up in a situation we can't get out of—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮は自分の身だけを守れ。
そして窓も、潮を守ることに全力を注いでくれ。
english: Ushio, protect only yourself. And Sou, focus all your efforts on protecting Ushio.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
な、何言うてんねん……私の力を見たやろ！？
私があんたらを守るんや！！
english: Wh-What are you saying... You saw my power, didn't you!? I'm going to protect you guys!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
聞け！！
オレが最悪死んでも……またループするだけや！
english: Listen!! Even if the worst happens and I die... I'll just loop again!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレの意識は時間を逆行して、
過去のオレに「移動」する！
english: My consciousness will go back in time and "transfer" to my past self!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: でも……もしおまえが先に死んだら？
english: But... what if you die first?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえはなぜかオレのループについて来た……。
でもオレが死ぬ時、先におまえが死んでたら
おまえはオレについて来られんのか？
english: For some reason, you came with me when I looped... But when I die, if you're already dead, will you be able to come with me?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もしもそれが無理やったら……
おまえとは次どこで会える！？
english: If that's impossible... where will I be able to meet you next!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
２４日の花火まで待つことになんのか？
いや……もっと最悪なパターンも考えられる……！！
english: Will I have to wait until the fireworks on the 24th? No... there are even worse scenarios to consider...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 最悪なパターンって？
english: What worst scenarios?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （おまえと二度と会えないパターンだよ……！！）
english: (The scenario where I never get to see you again...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……とにかく！！
english: ...Anyway!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これから影を駆除していく上で、
おまえの戦力は百人力や！！
失うリスクは避けたい！
english: Going forward in eliminating the Shadows, your combat strength is equal to a hundred men!! I want to avoid the risk of losing you!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ゴチャゴチャ長いねん！
フカンはええから本音を言えや！！！
english: Enough with the bird's-eye view! Just say what you really feel!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
べ……！！　別にっ……。
今のがオレの心からの本音なんやけど……。
つ……つまりやなァ……。
english: W-Well... It's not like... That was my genuine feeling from the bottom of my heart, but... I... In other words...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮！　子供の頃の約束……
オレは一生やと思てるから！
english: Ushio! That promise we made as kids... I consider it to be for life!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……約束？
english: …A promise?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえはオレが守る。
今度こそ……！！
english: I will protect you. This time for sure...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平……それって…………。
english: Shinpei… that's…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: なんや、ようわからんけど……
english: I don't really get it, but...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
もう絶対におまえを死なさへん！！
オレも慎平と同じ気持ちや！！
english: I'm absolutely not letting you die anymore!! I feel the same way as Shinpei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
守られてくれるか？
潮。
english: Will ya let him protect ya, Ushio?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
べっ……！！
……別に……好きにすればっ！？
english: Wh-Whatever... Do what ya want!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いざという時の意思確認を済ませて、
　オレたちは地下壕の奥へ進んでいった……）
english: (Having confirmed our intentions for when push comes to shove, we proceeded deeper into the underground bunker...)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おわ゛ァァァーーーーーッ！！？
english: Bwaaaaahhhhh!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうした窓！！
english: What's wrong, Sou!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: むっ、虫が……！
english: B-Bugs...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うおっ！
よう見たらカマドウマがめっちゃおる……。
english: Whoa! Looking closely, there are a ton of camel crickets...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
さ、殺虫剤持ってきてるからッ！！
これで殺せ、慎平！
殺してくれェ～～ッ！！
english: I-I brought bug spray!! Kill them with this, Shinpei! Kill them~~!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
落ち着け！
キモイだけで害はない……。
光に寄ってきてるだけや。
english: Calm down! They're just gross, they aren't harmful... They're just drawn to the light.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なんや窓、虫嫌いなん？
かえらしいとこあらいしょ～～。
english: What, Sou, you hate bugs? You've got a cute side to you~~.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ギャァァァ！
素手で持つな！！
こっちに近づけんなァァァ！！
english: Gyaaaah! Don't hold it barehanded!! Don't bring it near meee!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
二人とも。
あっちの壁、人型の黒い染みがある。
english: You two. There's a black, human-shaped stain on that wall over there.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: なっ……！
english: Wh-what…!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: まって、確認する。
english: Wait, I'll check it.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……これ、めっちゃ古い。
昔ここで……誰かが影に消された……？
english: ...This is really old. In the past, here... someone was erased by a Shadow...?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: Huh?!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ネ、ネズミかよ……
おどかすな……。
english: A m-mouse... Don't scare me like that...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: いる……。
english: It's here...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
今ネズミが曲がった角の先……
影の気配がする……！！
english: Just past the corner that mouse turned... I sense a Shadow's presence...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……気付かれたか！？
english: ...Has it noticed us!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: わからん……私が様子見てくる！
english: I don't know... I'll go take a look!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
待て潮！
言うたやろ、オレが行く……！！
english: Wait, Ushio! I told you, I'll go...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 気ィつけろ……。
english: Be careful…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……ネイルガンは用意してる。
　こいつを影に三発……！！
　影に三発撃ち込んで動きを封じる！）
english: (...I have the nail gun ready. Three shots of this into its shadow...!! I'll shoot three shots into its shadow and seal its movements!)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おったんかっ！？
english: Is it there!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いる……！
一匹だけやが……！
english: It's here...! Just one of them, though...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（赤ちゃんみたいな奴だ……。
　ネズミを手で捕まえてる……！）
english: (It's like a baby... It's catching mice with its hands...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今の光……「食事中」……か！？）
english: (That light just now... is it "eating"...!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 野良……。
english: Stray…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
野良？
影シオリが言うてたヤツか……！！
english: A stray? The ones Shadow Shiori mentioned...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うん……。
それに、私がやっつけたヤツに似てる。
english: Yeah... Also, it looks like the one I defeated.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
こいつらは古い影……なんかも。
経年劣化して野生化した、
人の姿が崩れた影……とか…………。
english: These guys might be... old Shadows. Shadows that have deteriorated over time and gone feral, losing their human form... or something...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なあ潮！
おまえが影の気配を感じるんやったらよ。
あいつもおまえが近くにいてるって感付いてへんか！？
english: Hey, Ushio! If you can sense the presence of Shadows. Doesn't that mean it can also sense that you're nearby!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……そういうことになるんやけどな……。
english: ...That's what it should mean, but...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: それってヤバない！？
english: Isn't that bad!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
どうやろな……あいつの顔見た？
目ェも耳もないやろ。
english: I wonder... Did you see its face? It doesn't have eyes or ears.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あいつは今何も見えてへんし聞こえてへん。
それは確かや。
english: It can't see or hear anything right now. That much is certain.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（完全に無防備に見せて……罠！？
　気付いてないフリをして誘ってるのか？
　それとも……）
english: (Looking completely defenseless... is it a trap!? Is it pretending not to notice to lure us in? Or...)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
やるか！？
慎平……！！
english: Should we do it!? Shinpei...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（考えても答えはない！
　今は行動あるのみ……！！）
english: (Thinking about it won't give me an answer! Right now, I just have to act...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓、潮！
english: Sou, Ushio!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おうっ！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
いつでもええで！
打ち合わせ通りに！
english: I'm ready whenever! Just like we planned!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先制攻撃や……！！
english: Preemptive strike...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まずはオレが、ヤツの影に釘を三発撃ち込み
　動きを封じる……！！）
english: (First, I'll shoot three nails into its shadow and seal its movements...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そこを安全に潮がトドメを刺す。
　窓はバックアップだ）
english: (Then Ushio will safely deliver the finishing blow. Sou is backup.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まずは相手の出方を見る。
　小石を影の近くに放り投げて……）
english: (First, I'll see how it reacts. I'll toss a pebble near the Shadow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（反応ナシ……
　マジに目も耳もないのか！）
english: (No reaction... Does it seriously not have eyes or ears!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なら、呼吸を整え……）
english: (Then, I'll steady my breathing...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ライトとネイルガンを改めて影に……向ける！）
english: (And aim the light and nail gun at the Shadow... once again!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ライトに照らされて……。
　ヤツの影が背後の壁に伸びてる……）
english: (Illuminated by the light... Its shadow is stretching across the wall behind it...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
こっちに気付いてへん証拠やで。
狙われてんのに、
光の影響を受けっぱなしにしてる……。
english: That's proof it hasn't noticed us. Even though it's being targeted, it's just letting itself be affected by the light...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いいぞ……。
　的は大きいほどいい……！！）
english: (Good... The bigger the target, the better...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あとは……根津さんの話を思い出して……！）
english: (Now... I just need to remember what Nezu-san told me...!)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ネイルガンは、先端を対象に押しつけやんと
釘が発射されへん安全装置がついちゃあるが……。
english: The nail gun has a safety mechanism that prevents nails from firing unless the tip is pressed against the target, but...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
これは儂が、釘を銃弾みたいに
「撃てる」ように改造したモンや。
english: I modified this one so you can "shoot" nails like bullets.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
せやけど、十分な長さのバレルがないさけ、
釘の「弾道」はバラけて、集弾性能はすこぶる悪い。
english: However, since it doesn't have a long enough barrel, the nails' "trajectory" scatters, and the grouping performance is extremely poor.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: キチっと当てるには、射程は１～２メートルほどやろな。
english: To hit accurately, the range is probably about 1 to 2 meters.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
こいつは飛び道具やけど、近距離武器と心得よ。
十分引きつけてから撃て……！！
english: It's a projectile weapon, but consider it a close-range weapon. Draw them in close before you shoot...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（壁まで５メートルってとこか……。
　遠すぎる……！！
　近付きたい……あと数歩前へ……！！）
english: (It's about 5 meters to the wall... Too far...!! I want to get closer... just a few more steps forward...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（近付けば近付くほど！
　影も大きくなっていくはずだ！！）
english: (The closer I get! The bigger the shadow should become!!)

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese: おやアアアアアアア！！
english: Oyaaaaaaaa!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（！！？
　気づかれた！！）
english: (!!? It noticed me!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （影が向かってくる！！）
english: (The Shadow is coming at me!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（撃つべきか！？
　でもこの距離じゃダメだ！
　もっと引き寄せて……！？）
english: (Should I shoot!? But not from this distance! I need to draw it in closer...!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……躊躇してる場合か、オレ！！
　今すぐ撃たないと、影がどう襲ってくるか……！）
english: (...Is this the time to be hesitating, me!! If I don't shoot right now, who knows how the Shadow will attack...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （どうする……どうするッ……！！）
english: (What do I do... what do I do...!!)

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese: アアアアアアアアアア！！
english: Aaaaaaaaaaah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （撃つしかないっ！！）
english: (I have no choice but to shoot!!)

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese: ギィイッ！！
english: Giiii!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ッッ！！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あいつッ……！！
　横に飛びのいて、影をひっこめた！！）
english: (That thing...!! It jumped to the side and pulled its shadow back!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（くっ……！
　ここまで来たら……食うか食われるかだ！
　近づいて撃つ……！！）
english: (Damn it...! Now that it's come to this... it's eat or be eaten! I'll get close and shoot...!!)

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese: オヤァァア！！
english: Oyaaaaa!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （この距離なら……！！）
english: (At this distance…!!)

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese: ヤッ！！
english: Yah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ッ！！？
とっ……飛び越された！？
english: !!? I-It jumped over me!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あいつ……オレを無視して）
english: (That thing... it ignored me...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まさか……狙いはオレじゃなくて、
　後ろの二人……！！）
english: (No way... its target wasn't me, but the two behind me...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english:
Ushio!!
Sou!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
わかっとる！！
潮は下がってろよォッ！！
english: I know!! Ushio, stay back!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あんたがふがいなくなけりゃな！！
english: Only if you don't act pathetic!!

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese: アアアア！！
english: Ohhhhh!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
こんなやつ……！
野球の球やと思えばよォォーーーーーッ！
english:
This kind of thing…
Think of it as a baseball!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
しャアァッ！
クリーーーーンヒットォ！！！！
english: Shaa!! Clean hit!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
……ッ！？
な、なんやこれッ！！
english: …!? Wh-What is this...?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（殴られた瞬間に平面化して
　バットに張り付いた……！？）
english: (It flattened out the moment I hit it and stuck to the bat...!?)

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese:
オヤァッ。
オヤァァア。
english: Oya... Oyaaa...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
アカン！！
実体化するで！？
english: Watch out!! It's materializing!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ぐぅっ！？
english: Guh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（マスクが壊れたッ……！！
　窓がやられる！！？）
english: (His mask broke...!! Sou's gonna get killed!!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（落ち着け！！
　フカンしろ！　フカンしろ！！
　今フカンしないでいつするんだ！！）
english: (Calm down!! Bird's-eye view! Take a bird's-eye view!! If I don't do it now, when will I?!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (フカン)
japanese:
（……今更ビビッてんのか？
　ふるえてるじゃないかおまえ……）
english: (…Are you getting scared now? You're shaking…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (フカン)
japanese:
（こんなんじゃあ何発撃っても当たりゃしない。
　力を抜け。
　もっと集中しろ）
english: (You'll never hit anything like this, no matter how many times you shoot. Relax. Focus.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (フカン)
japanese:
（ガチガチに凝り固まった体から
　意識だけを抜き出すイメージだ）
english: (Imagine pulling just your consciousness out of your stiff body.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (フカン)
japanese: （あの時から、いつもやってるイメージだろ）
english: (It's the same thing you've always done since that day.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ああ……そうだ…………。
　お父さんとお母さんが……死んだ時から……）
english: (Yeah… that's right… Ever since… Mom and Dad died…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こう見れば……）
english: (Looking at it like this…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (フカン)
japanese:
（何でもないことのように思える。
　つらいことも悲しいことも怖いことも……。
　どんなこともこうして乗り越えてきただろう）
english: (It all seems like nothing. The pain, the sadness, the fear… You've overcome everything like this, haven't you?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (フカン)
japanese:
（今だってヨユーさ。
　見ろ、目の前――）
english: (It's a piece of cake now. Look, right in front of you—)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: うわぁぁぁぁぁっっ！！
english: Uwaaaaaaah!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: おりゃああああああっ！！！！
english: Ooryaaaaah!!!!

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese: ブギィッ！！
english: Bugi!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （髪の刃で切り裂いた……ッ！！）
english: (She cut it with her hair blade…!!)

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese: ギィイイイイ……！！
english: Giyeeeee...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まずい！！
　影が逃げる！！）
english: (This is bad!! The Shadow is escaping!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今度こそ……当たれッ！！！）
english: (This time… hit!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やったッ……！！
　窓のプロテクターにヤツを縫いつけたぞ！！）
english: (I did it…!! I pinned it to Sou's protector!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓ッ！！
english: Sou!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おうッ！！
潮ッ、やってくれッ！！
english: Yeah!! Ushio, do it!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
任して！！
食らえぇええええッ！！
english: Leave it to me!! Eat this!!!

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese: ブギィッ……！？
english: Bugi...!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: や……やったな……！！
english: W-We did it…!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あぁ……よかったァ……。
english: Yeah… thank goodness…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: すまん……オレがもっと早く撃ってれば……！
english: I'm sorry… if I had just shot sooner…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
外したらどうするとか、
窓に当たってしもたらとか、
いろいろ考えてて……。
english: I was overthinking it… What if I missed, what if I hit Sou…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
結果的に窓が、危険な目にあってしもた。
……ほんとごめんな。
english: And because of that, I put you in danger, Sou. …I'm really sorry.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
いや、気にすんな！
オレかて同じ状況やったら
撃てたかしらんし……。
english: Nah, don't worry about it! If I were in your shoes, I don't know if I could've shot either…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
オレのことなんか、もうちょい雑に扱え。
当たったらどうするかとか考えんでええわ。
english: Treat me a little rougher next time. You don't need to worry about hitting me.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おまえに心配されるほどは、
ヤワやないぞ！
english: I'm not so fragile that you need to worry about me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よしっ……！！
　プロテクターに縫いつけたぞ！！）
english: (Alright…!! I pinned it to the protector!!)

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese: ……オ、オァ……ギャッ！
english: …O-Oa… Gya!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓ッ！！
プロテクターを脱いで投げろ！！
english:
Sou!!
Take off the protector and throw it!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
わ、わかった……！！
うおおぉおおっ！！
english: G-Got it...!! Uwoooohhh!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
やるやないか！
二人共！！
english: Not bad! Both of you!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……フンッ！！
english: …Hmph!!

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese: ブギィ！！
english: Bugi!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
やったぞ慎平！！！
やっつけたぞ！！
english: We did it, Shinpei!!! We got it!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: おう！！
english: Yeah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Y-Yeah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （倒せた……オレたち三人の力で……！！）
english: (We beat it… with the power of all three of us…!!)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ッしゃあ！！！
english: Hell yeah!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ゴメン、窓……おまえごと撃ってしもた。
腹のとこ大丈夫か！？
english: Sorry, Sou… I shot you too. Is your stomach okay!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
どってことないわ！
プロテクターのおかげで体は無事や。
english: It's nothing! Thanks to the protector, I'm perfectly fine.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ちょっとヒヤッとしてしもたけど、
慎平はよう落ち着いとったなァ！
english: I was sweating bullets for a second there, but you stayed super calm, Shinpei!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ま、私はわかっとったよ！
慎平やったら絶対当てるって！
english: Well, I knew it all along! I knew you'd definitely hit it, Shinpei!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ、なんで……。
english: Huh, why…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
昨日の夜、
一睡もせんと練習してたんやもん！
私見てたで！
english: Last night, you were practicing without sleeping a wink! I was watching you!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はッ！？
お、おまえ起きとったんか！！
english:
Huh!?
You were awake this whole time!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 声かけろよ……ハズ……。
english: You should've said something… how embarrassing…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ふふっ！
english: Hehe!

speaker: Ushio
english:
…Ow!
My…arm…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうかしたか？
english: What's wrong?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……まだ安心すんの早いで！
最初に感じた影の気配は消えてへん。
english: …It's too early to relax! The Shadow presence I felt earlier hasn't disappeared.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
近くはないのにめっちゃ嫌な感じ……。
黒板に爪立てる音が
遠くから聞こえてくるみたいな……。
english: Even though it's not close, it feels really bad… It's like hearing nails on a chalkboard from far away…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: マジかよ……いったい……。
english: Are you serious… what the hell…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: その「音」、方角はわかる？
english: Can you tell which direction the "sound" is coming from?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あっち……！！
あの角を左やと思う。
english: That way…!! I think it's left at that corner.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: よし。
english: Alright.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おいっ！？
慎平！！
english: Hey!? Shinpei!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あいつスゲーわ……。
迷わずヤバイ方に進むんかよォ～～～～ッ。
english: That guy's crazy… He's heading straight for danger without hesitating at all!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……見て来てるからな。
このまま何もせんかったら
起きてしまう未来を……。
english: …Because he's seen it. The future that will happen if we do nothing…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あんたも澪を守りたいやろ。
english: You want to protect Mio too, right?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
当たり前や！
命かけるでオレは！！！
english: Of course I do! I'd put my life on the line for her!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ほんなら、ビビッてるヒマないで！
前進あるのみや！！
english: Then you don't have time to be scared! The only way is forward!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おうッ！！
english: Yeah!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……影ミオにやられた腕の傷が……。
潮のデータから腕をプリントしたけど
見た目だけってこと！？
english: …The wound I got from Shadow Mio… I printed an arm from Ushio's data, but is it just for show!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
本体に受けたダメージが
回復したわけじゃないんや……。
english: The damage my main body took hasn't healed…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: なァ慎平！
english: Hey, Shinpei!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ちょっと質問やけどよ。
潮はネイルガンをコピーできやんのか？
コピーしてもろたら、それ２丁に増やせるやろ？
english: Quick question. Can't Ushio copy the nail gun? If she copied it, we'd have two, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もちろん試してみた……
髪を使ってな。
english: Of course I tried… using her hair.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
結果は「コピーできた」！
でもそのままじゃ動作せんかった。
english: The result was "it copied"! But it didn't work just like that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮が言うには、
「機械」をコピーしても
本物が存在する以上、形だけのパチモンなんやと。
english: According to Ushio, even if she copies a "machine," as long as the original exists, it's just a fake that looks like it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: だから、動作させるには本物を消す必要がある。
english: So, to make it work, you need to erase the original.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なるほど……
なら増えるわけちゃうんか！
english: I see… So we can't multiply them!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっきの「鍵」とか「水着」とか、
形だけでいい物はパチモンでもかまへんのやけど。
english: For things like the "key" or "swimsuit" from earlier, where just the shape is enough, a fake is fine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
電気とかガスとか、他にエネルギー使て動かすには
本物を消さなあかんみたいやな。
これはオレの部屋の「リモコン」で検証済み。
english: But for things that use electricity or gas to operate, it seems you have to erase the original. I already tested this with the "remote control" in my room.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あと……
小さい物なら髪の毛にプリントできるけど、
ベッドは体ごと変身せなあかん。
english: Also… she can print small things onto her hair, but for a bed, she has to transform her whole body.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 本棚くらいデカイと、プリントは不可能やった。
english: Something as big as a bookshelf was impossible to print.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そうか……。
で、結局そのネイルガンは？
english: I see… So, what about that nail gun in the end?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……これは「<color=#GF_TIPS_079>コピー品</color>」や！
根津さんにもらった「本物」はすでに消してある。
english: Ah… This is a "<color=#GF_TIPS_079>copy</color>"! The "original" I got from Nezu-san has already been erased.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
コピー品のメリットはかなり大きい。
釘を撃ち尽くしても、ガスや充電がなくなっても、
潮が元のデータを「プリント」すれば満タンに戻る。
english: The benefits of a copy are huge. Even if we run out of nails, gas, or charge, if Ushio "prints" the original data, it goes back to full.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
マ……マジかよ！！
すげえ……。
english: S-Seriously?! That's amazing…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ほなこのバットから、
折れても元に戻せるバットを作れるってことか！
english: So from this bat, you can make a bat that can be fixed even if it breaks!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うん……
コピーしちゃりたいとこやけど、ゴメンな……。
私の「容量」の問題でこれ以上は――
english: Yeah… I'd like to copy it for you, but sorry… Due to my "capacity" limit, I can't do any more—

speaker: Ushio
japanese: な……なんや！？
english: Wh-What was that!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: A gunshot…!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おい慎平！！
こっちや、この先に開けた場所がある！！
english:
Hey, Shinpei!!
Over here, there's an open area ahead!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……行ってみよう。
気をつけろよ……！
english:
Let's go…
Be careful…!

japanese: 49.地下洞窟
english: 49. Underground Cave

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
こっからイキナリ雰囲気違うで。
人工物やない！！　自然の洞窟や……！！
english: The atmosphere suddenly changed here. It's not artificial!! It's a natural cave…!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うん……それにこの臭い。
潮の香り……海が近いんか！？
english: Yeah… and this smell. The scent of the tide… Is the sea close!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ヤバ……。
そんな……いつの間に……。
english: Oh no… No way… Since when…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうした！？
english: What's wrong!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
影の気配が……私らの周りに！
右からも……左からも……！！
囲まれてるッ！
english: Shadow presences… all around us! From the right… from the left…!! We're surrounded!

speaker: 影の群れ
japanese: おやァ。おや。おやァ。
english: Oyaa. Oya. Oyaa.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
な……何匹おるんや……。
これぜんぶ野良の影か……！？
english: H-How many of them are there…? Are these all Stray Shadows…!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
こらアカン！
慎平、どうする！？
english: This is bad! Shinpei, what do we do!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （数が多すぎる……）
english: (There are too many…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （逃げるか迎え撃つか……！？）
english: (Should we run or fight back!?)

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ａ)
japanese: オヤアアァァァッ！！
english: Oyaaaaaah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あ、危なかった！
　いきなり飛び掛かってくるとは……！）
english: (Th-That was close! I didn't expect them to just jump at us like that…!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: かかってこいやァッ！！
english: Bring it on!!

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ａ)
japanese: オヤァッ！！
english: Oyaa!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: よし……オレもやったるわァ！！
english: Alright… I'll take 'em on too!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
しャアァッ！
影ども、道開けろォッ！！
english: Shaa!! You Shadows better make way!!

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｂ)
japanese:
オヤァッ。
おやァアアアア。おやァ……。
おやおヤァ。
english: Oyaa. Oyaaaaa. Oyaa… Oyaoyaa.

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｃ)
japanese:
おや。おやおやァッ。
おやァアア。オヤアアアアァァ！
english: Oya. Oyaoyaa. Oyaaaa. Oyaaaaaah!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
こ、こいつら、
無限に湧いてくるんやないやろな！？

japanese:
なんで黙ってた！！

ごめん……。

japanese:

speaker_ja: 女の子の声（菱形朱鷺子）
japanese:
ゆっくり振り返りなさい。
二人とも……少しでも妙な動きをしたら、
ウシオさんの命はないですよ？
english: Slowly turn around. Both of you... if you make the slightest funny move, Ushio-san's life is over.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
な……なんで……
なんでおまえが……ここに……おる……！？
english: Wh... Why... Why are you... here...!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: トキコ！！！
english: Tokiko!!!

japanese: 52.ヒルコ洞
english: 52. Hiruko Cave

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
鉄格子が見えます。
この先は行き止まりのようですね。
english: I can see iron bars. It seems this is a dead end.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
影どもはこっちから来た……。
ヤツらだけの抜け道か。
english: The Shadows came from this direction... Is this a secret passage just for them?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
これでハッキリしましたね。
影たちは、下水とかの地下道を通って
島を移動していた。
english: This makes it clear. The Shadows have been using the sewers and underground tunnels to move around the island.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
うむ……それにこの辺りの地下は、
軍に何べんも掘り散らかされちゃあるさけな……。
english: Hmm... and the underground around here has been dug up over and over by the military...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
その全容は最早、誰にも分からん……。
こんな抜け道がいくつあってもおかしない。
english: No one knows its full extent anymore... It wouldn't be strange if there were countless secret passages like this.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
しかしどうします？
鉄格子を切断する道具はないですし……。
english: But what should we do? We don't have tools to cut steel bars...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
一度上がって別の入口を探しますか？
地図だとちょうど島の真ん中あたりのようですが。
english: Should we go up and look for another entrance? According to the map, we're right around the middle of the island.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
いや……おそらく出入口はないやろ。
少なくとも人が通れる出入口はな……。
english: No... there probably aren't any entrances or exits. At least, none that a person could pass through...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
見てみィ。
そこの先は下水道とは違う……。
恐らくは元々ここにあった自然の洞窟や。
english: Look. What's past there isn't the sewer... It's probably a natural cave that was originally here.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……まさか実在したんか……『ヒルコ洞』……。
english: …Hiruko Cave really existed...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: え？
english: Eh?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 子供の時分、爺さんから聞いた話や……。
english: It's a story I heard from my grandpa when I was a kid...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
日都ヶ島の地下にはどでかい空洞が
横たわっちゃあるんやと……。
それがヒルコ洞や。
english: He said there was a massive cavern lying beneath Hitogashima Island... That's Hiruko Cave.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
明治の半ばごろまでは、
干潮の時だけ現れる入口が
日都ヶ島港のあたりにあったらしいが。
english: Apparently, until the mid-Meiji period, there was an entrance near Hitogashima Port that only appeared at low tide.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
日清戦争中……。
軍が港を整備した時に塞がれたとか何とか――
english: During the First Sino-Japanese War... The army supposedly sealed it up when they renovated the port—

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
この島の伝説……あくまで作り話や思とったが――
大昔、日都ヶ島の守り神<color=#GF_TIPS_054>ヒルコ様が
この島に流れ着いたあと、住みついたといわれる場所</color>や。
english: This island's legend... I thought it was just a made-up story— But it's <color=#GF_TIPS_054>the place where the guardian deity of Hitogashima, Hiruko-sama, is said to have settled after washing ashore</color> long ago.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
ヒルコ伝承ですね……
お姉ちゃんなら詳しいはずです。
変わりましょうか？
english: The Hiruko legend... My sister should know a lot about it. Shall we switch?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
やめとけ！
……今はな……。
english: Don't! …Not right now…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
雁切のせがれに聞いてみてもええが……。
あいつの親父が生きとったらな……
何か知っとったかも知れん。
english: We could try asking Karikiri's son... If his old man were still alive... He might've known something.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
どっちにしても
ここを通るには金切り鋸がいる。
一旦戻って――
english: Either way, we'll need a hacksaw to get through here. Let's head back for now—

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
……シッ！
静かに……。
english:
…Shh!
Be quiet…

japanese: 小舟　澪
english: Mio Kofune

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
なァ～ッ、もう帰ろらよォ！
こんなとこにおるわけないってェ……。
english: Heey, let's just go back already! There's no way she's in a place like this...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
さっきのは見まちがいちゃいます！！
哲さんも見ましたよね！
english: What I saw wasn't a mistake!! You saw it too, right, Tetsu-san!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あ～～もう……、
下水のくっさい臭い付いと……。
こら都行く前に風呂入らな……。
english: Ahhh, geez... Now I smell like nasty sewage... I'm gonna have to take a bath before going to Miyako...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もう！
エリカさんに言うといてあげますよ。
哲さんが頼もしかったってことを！
english: Jeez! I'll be sure to tell Erika-san how reliable Tetsu-san was!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
えっ！
それホンマ！？
english: Eh! Really!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
……と言いたいとこやが、
どうやらこの先は行き止まりっぽいで。
鉄格子がついてらァ。
english: …Is what I'd like to say, but it looks like it's a dead end up ahead. There's an iron gate.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: しおりちゃん！！
english: Shiori-chan!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
いや……！！
おい待て澪ちゃん！
english: Hold on a sec, Mio-chan!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
どうやってん？
どうやって柵の向こうへ――
english: How did she...? How did she get to the other side of the gate—

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: まぶしっ……！？
english: So bright...!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あっ……！

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
な……なんや今の！？
鉄格子が一瞬で消えたでェ……！！？
english: Wh... What was that!? The iron gate vanished in an instant...!!?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: 不味……。
english: Tastes bad...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
待って！！
しおりちゃん……！！
english: Wait!! Shiori-chan...!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: オレら……夢でも見てんちゃうか……？
english: Are we dreaming?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
えっ！？
行くん！？　澪ちゃん！！
english: Eh!? Yer going!? Mio-chan!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: マジかよ……！
english: You gotta be kidding me...!

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……おい、今んは……。
english: …Hey, just now…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
小舟澪さんと……警官の凸村哲ですね。
お姉ちゃんをＨカップって間違えたという……。
english: Mio Kofune-san... and Officer Tetsu Totsumura. The one who mistook my sister for an H-cup...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
違う！！
儂が言うてんのは、
鉄格子を消しよった影のことや！！！
english: No!! I'm talking about the Shadow that made the iron gate disappear!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
……当たったんかも知れません。
お姉ちゃんの嫌な予感が……。
english: …Maybe it was right on the mark. My sister's bad feeling...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
儂なら追わん。
罠や。
english: I wouldn't follow them. It's a trap.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
しかし、少なくとも澪さんは人間ですよ。
免疫がある。
english: But at least Mio-san is human. She has immunity.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……チッ！
知らんで……鬼が出るか、蛇が出るか。
english: …Tch! Don't blame me... whatever comes out of there.

japanese: 53.ロズとギル
english: 53. Roz and Gil

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: 巨大な２体の影（ロズとギル）
speaker_ja: 巨大な２体の影（ロズとギル）
japanese: オォオ……。
english: Ooo…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: トキ……ちゃん……。
english: Toki... chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（トキちゃんの背後の影……。
　トキちゃんを襲おうとしている様子はない、
　それどころか……）
english: (The Shadows behind Toki-chan... They don't seem to be trying to attack her. In fact...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まるでトキちゃんが、
　影を従えてるように見える！）
english: (It looks like Toki-chan is commanding the Shadows!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ってことは……、
　トキちゃんも影にコピーされていたのか！？）
english: (Which means... Toki-chan was copied by a Shadow too!?)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 禁域に踏み込んで、よう生きてたな、お兄ちゃん……。
english: I'm surprised you're still alive after stepping into the forbidden zone, Shinpei...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ど……どういうこっちゃ……トキコォッ！！
答えろッ！！
english: Wh... What's the meaning of this... Tokiko!! Answer me!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ここからは遠い……
　ネイルガンの射程外だ……）
english: (She's too far away... Out of the nail gun's range...)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ここで何やってんのか聞いてんねんッ！！！
english: I asked you what you're doing here!!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 愚問。
english: Stupid question.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: な……何やと……！？
english: Wh... What...!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: それでも答えてあげるなら、不良品回収です……。
english: But if you must know, I'm retrieving a defective product...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（不良品……。
　それって、まさか……）
english: (Defective product... Don't tell me...)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
慎平さん、
ウシオさんを連れて来てくれて感謝します。
捜しにくいんですよね、彼女は壊れてるから。
english: Shinpei-san, thank you for bringing Ushio-san here. She's hard to track down because she's broken.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （やはりか……）
english: (Just as I thought...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しかし、不用意に距離をつめて来る……
　あと３歩で射程に入る！）
english: (But she's closing the distance carelessly... Three more steps and she'll be in range!)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: あとは私たちが処理します。
english: We'll take care of her from here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮に指一本、触れさせないッ！！
　トキちゃんの影を……ネイルガンで撃ち抜くッ！）
english: (I won't let them lay a single finger on Ushio!! I'll shoot Toki-chan's Shadow... with the nail gun!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （頼む……止まってくれ……！！）
english: (Please... stop...!!)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: …Heh…

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
くッ！　くッ！　くッ！
くくくッッ！
english: Heh! Heh! Heh! Heheheh!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
違うんよ……慎平……ッ。
ト……トキちゃんは……！！
english: You're wrong... Shinpei...! T-Toki-chan is...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
残念でした。
慎平さん、私は人間です。
english: Too bad. Shinpei-san, I'm human.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 影は殺せても、殺人は無理ですよね。
english: You can kill shadows, but not humans.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……おまえ……ホンマに、トキコか……。
english: ...Are you... really Tokiko...?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: …………少しお話しましょか。
english: …Let's chat for a bit.

japanese: 菱形　青銅
english: Seidou Hishigata

speaker: 根来
japanese: お呼びですか先生……。
english: How may I help, Doctor?

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: 何度も悪いね……根来くん。
english: My apologies, Negoro-kun.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: 今日の食餌にこちらを追加する。
english: Add this to today's fodder.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
じき９時だ。
急いで運んでくれたまえ。
english: It's almost 9 o'clock. Hurry and take it there.

speaker: 根来
japanese: はい先生……承知しました。
english: Yes, Doctor... I understand.

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: 巨大な２体の影（ロズとギル）
speaker_ja: 巨大な２体の影（ロズとギル）

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（相手は、影でなく本物のトキちゃん……。
　そして後ろに控える、２体の巨大な影……）
english: (My opponent isn't a Shadow, it's the real Toki-chan... And behind her are two giant Shadows...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この状況……
　もう……こうするしかない）
english: (In this situation... There's no other choice but this...)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……殊勝ですね。
武器を投げ捨てるなんて。
english: …How admirable. Throwing away your weapon like that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あァ……降参や。
english: Yeah... I surrender.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そんな！
慎平っ！！
english: No way! Shinpei!!

speaker: Ushio
english: Sou!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平の言う通りや……。
くやしいけどもう……私らに勝ち目はない……。
english: Shinpei is right... It's frustrating, but... we don't have a chance of winning anymore...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
変な気ィ起こさんといてよ？
お兄ちゃん……。
english: Don't get any funny ideas, okay? Shinpei...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: くッ……。
english: Ugh...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 捕まえて。
english: Grab her.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ううっ！？
english: Ugh!?

speaker: 巨大な２体の影（ロズとギル）
speaker_ja: 巨大な２体の影（ロズとギル）

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
潮っ！？
くそっ……やめろよトキコ！！
english: Ushio!? Damn it... stop it, Tokiko!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓、落ち着け……。
殺すつもりならとっくに終わってるよ……。
こいつらは潮を連れてくだけや……。
english: Sou, calm down... If they wanted to kill us, it'd be over by now... They're just taking Ushio...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
違うか！？
トキちゃん！！
english: Am I right, Toki-chan!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……肯定と受け取るぞ、その沈黙！！）
english: (…I'll take that silence as a yes!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……ならまだだ……まだ早い……。
　すまない潮……！！　あと少し……。
　あともう少しだけ耐えてくれ……！！）
english: (…Then it's not over yet… it's too early to act... I'm sorry, Ushio...!! Just a little longer... Please hold on just a little longer...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……どこへ連れてく？
菱形先生の所か！？
english: …Where are you taking her? To Dr. Hishigata's place!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そっ……そうか！！
トキコ、おまえっ！
親父に言われてこんなっ……。
english: I-I get it now!! Tokiko, you...! Dad told you to do this...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……何にも知らんお兄ちゃん。
english: …You don't know anything, do you, Sou?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
まァ……当然や……。
お兄ちゃんはお父さんに選ばれやんかった……。
english: Well... it makes sense... You weren't chosen by Dad...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: …W-What…!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
けどここまで見られたら、
もう隠しておくのも阿呆らしいです。
むしろ知ってもらういい機会と捉えます。
english: But since you've seen this much, hiding it anymore would be stupid. In fact, I consider this a good opportunity for you to find out.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
荷物を捨てて丸腰になってください。
従うなら案内します。
english: Drop your bags and go unarmed. If you obey, I'll show you the way.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
手荒な真似はしたくないですから……。
できればご自分の足でついて来てください…………。
english: I don't want to resort to rough methods... So please follow on your own two feet...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ヒルコ様がお待ちです。
english: Hiruko-sama is waiting.

japanese: 54.悍ましい何か
english: 54. Something Horrifying

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
澪さんを見失ってしまいました……。
無事でしょうか？
english: I've lost sight of Mio-san... I wonder if she's safe?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
他人の心配してる場合やないかもわからんぞ……。
見よよ……いったい何やいここは……！？
english: This might not be the time to worry about others... Look at this... What the hell is this place...!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
あれは深海のイソギンチャクですね。
地上で生きてるなんてありえません。
english: Those are deep-sea anemones. It's impossible for them to be alive on land.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: あり得るとしたら、こいつらも全部影……！
english: If it is possible, then they're all Shadows too...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
……まてよ……ヒルコ様は海から来た……。
まさか……影たちは――
english: …Wait… Hiruko-sama came from the sea… Could it be… the Shadows are—

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
english: …Ngh!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: …………気に入らんなァ……。
english: …I don't like this at all…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
２度も！！　あいつはおまえが止め刺したろ……。
なんであいつは！！
不死身かッ！？
english: Twice!! You delivered the finishing blow to him… Why is he!! Is he immortal!?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
……あれ？
おまえは驚かんの？
english: …Huh? Aren't you surprised?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
あなたが死んでないと仮定すれば、
辻褄が合うんですよ。
english: Assuming you weren't dead, everything makes sense.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
あなたは僕にやられたように見せかけ、
地面のヒビの隙間から地中へ潜った……
違いますか？
english: You faked being beaten by me, and slipped underground through the cracks in the ground… Am I wrong?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: ……姉は下水道が怪しいと睨んでいた。
english: My sister was suspicious of the sewers.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: ……へえ……さすがひづるや……。
english: …Heh… As expected of Hizuru…

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
なんで邪魔しに帰って来た。
次に会うたら殺す言うたやろ……？
english: Why did you come back to interfere? I told you I'd kill you next time we met, didn't I…?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
おまえに言うてもわからんか。
南方竜之介……。
english: I guess telling you wouldn't mean anything. Ryunosuke Minakata…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
おい！！
おまえ、奴に名前を！？
english: Hey!! Did you tell him your name!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: いえッ！
english: No!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: まさか、ひづるの中に入っとったとはな……。
english: To think you were inside Hizuru...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: ウソや……まさかおまえ……。
english: No way… Don't tell me you're…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: ハイネ……なのか？
english: Are you… Haine?

speaker: 不気味な声（シデ）
japanese: １４年ぶりの再会というわけですか……。
english: A reunion after 14 years, is it...?

speaker: 不気味な声（シデ）
japanese:
……しかしあなたには用はない。
人格と記憶だけの竜之介には。
english: …But I have no business with you. A Ryunosuke made only of personality and memories.

speaker: 不気味な声（シデ）
japanese: 「体」の方はどこへ行ったんですか？
english: Where did the "body" go?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: 母の右目を奪い去った「体」の方は？
english: Where's the body that stole Mother's right eye?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
ハイネ……。
はじめっからおまえは……。
またごっこ遊びなんか？
english: Haine… So it was you from the start… Are you playing make-believe again?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 今度は、小早川しおりの記憶を使て……！！
english: This time, using Shiori Kobayakawa's memories...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（ショットガンが防がれた！？
　スキャンしたマンホールの蓋で！？）
english: (My shotgun blast was blocked!? With a scanned manhole cover!?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（いや、それより……
　当たるはずの弾が防がれた……！！）
english: (No, more importantly... The shot that should have hit was blocked...!!)

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
記憶を読んだ……。
ひづるも竜之介も体の行方を知らん。
ジジイの方は読めやん……「免疫」か。
english: I read their memories... Neither Hizuru nor Ryunosuke know where the body went. I can't read the old man's... "Immunity," huh.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: 殺しても？
english: May I kill them?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: ええよ。
english: Fine by me.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 逃げるぞ竜之介……ありゃ無理や。
english: We're running, Ryunosuke... They're impossible to beat.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 冗談ですよね？
english: You're joking, right?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
わからんのか！！
狩られてんのァ儂らの方や！！！
english:
Don't you get it?!
We're the ones being hunted!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あいつら人間の影やない……！！
何やもっとおぞましい……別の何かや！！
english: They aren't human Shadows...!! They're something more horrifying... something else entirely!!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: ……ケホッ。
english: …Cough.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
気ィ付けよよ？
竜之介はズレちゃあるさけな。
english: Be careful, okay? Ryunosuke is shifted.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
２秒かそこら……
先の方へズレちゃある。
english: He's shifted about two seconds... into the future.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: ええ、わかってますとも。
english: Yes, I know.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 竜之介ッ！！！
english: Ryunosuke!!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ぐッ！！
english: Guh!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: はい、ワンダウン。
english: Alright, one down.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （根津さんが……僕をかばって、撃たれた……！！）
english: (Nezu-san... protected me and got shot...!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（撃ってくる未来は見えてたのに……！！
　クソ！！　クソッ！！！）
english: (Even though I could see the future where he shot...!! Damn it!! Damn it!!!)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
english: Number two...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: くっ！！
english: Ngh!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: おや……避けられました。
english: Oh... you dodged it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 根津さんっ……！！
english: Nezu-san...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: クッ……！
english: Ngh...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: クソッタレがァァァーーーーーッ！！！
english: You piece of shiiiiiiit!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （全弾……防がれたッ！！）
english: (Every shot... blocked!!)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ふむ……。
このへんか？
english: Hmm... Around here?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（弾道を読め……
　ここから、逃げ――）
english: (Read the trajectory... Escape from—)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: ぐふっ……！！

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: こらムズイわ……先を読んで当てるいうのは。
english: This is tricky... predicting ahead to land a hit.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: ぐ……ううッ……！！

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（あれは……拳銃……！！
　ショットガン以外もコピーしてたのか……！）
english: (That's... a handgun...!! He copied something besides the shotgun...!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （ダメ、だ……無理やりにでも、逃げるしか……！！）
english: (This is bad... I have to get away, even if I have to force it...!!)

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: 追わんのか？
english: You're not going after him?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
必要ないでしょう……。
地面を見てください。
english: There's no need... Look at the ground.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
血が黒い……。
肝臓を撃ち抜きました。
致命傷です……放っておいてもじき死ぬ。
english: The blood is dark... I shot through the liver. It's a fatal wound... He'll die soon enough even if left alone.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: ウシオと慎平くんたちは？
english: What about Ushio and Shinpei-kun?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
もうそこまで来てるが安心せえ。
朱鷺子に野良を二人付けちゃある。
english: They're already close, but don't worry. I've attached two Strays to Tokiko.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
それよりもわしはお腹ペコペコや……。
早よ９時にならんかのう。
english: More importantly, I'm starving... I wish it would be 9 o'clock already.

japanese: 55.ハイネ
english: 55. Haine

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……いつの間にか、ライトなしで
　周りが見えるようになってきたな）
english: (…Before I knew it, I can see my surroundings even without a light.)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
壁が、淡く光っとる……。
発光バクテリアの一種やろか。
english: The walls are glowing faintly... It must be some kind of bioluminescent bacteria.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうかもな……。
english: Maybe...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（トキちゃんは、
　「前回」の夏祭りで四本腕の影に殺されている）
english: (Toki-chan was killed by the four-armed Shadow at the summer festival "last time".)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（つまり、「トキちゃんは奴らに利用されていて
　最後には裏切られる」と考えられる……
　そして彼女はまだそれを知らない！）
english: (In other words, it's likely that "Toki-chan is being used by them and will be betrayed in the end"... And she doesn't know that yet!)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
こんな……こと……。
こんなことのためにッ……。
手ェ、汚してきたわけちゃう……。
english: This... I didn't get my hands dirty... for something like this...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あの涙だ……。
　あの涙の理由がわかればトキちゃんを説得できるし、
　助けられるかも知れない！）
english: (Those tears... If I can figure out the reason behind those tears, I might be able to convince Toki-chan, and maybe even save her!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （影に捕まったままの潮が、オレを見ている……）
english: (Ushio is looking at me while still captured by the Shadows...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まだ動くな潮……。
　今はまだその時じゃない。
　オレは真相を知らなきゃいけないんだ！）
english: (Don't move yet, Ushio... Now isn't the time. I have to find out the truth!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まだループする訳にはいかない。
　情報を得てから……オレは死ぬ気で足掻く！）
english: (I can't loop just yet. Once I get information... I'll struggle with everything I have!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（うなずいてくれた……。
　オレの考えが通じたんだと信じてるぞ、潮！）
english: (She nodded... I'm trusting that you understood my intentions, Ushio!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: わっ……わたしとちゃうで！！
english: I-It's not me!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ヒルコ様です。
彼女の腹の虫です。
english: It's Hiruko-sama. Her stomach growling.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まるで地の底から響くような音……
　全身に鳥肌が立つ。
　この世のものでは……ない）
english: (It sounds like it's echoing from the depths of the earth... It's giving me goosebumps all over. It's not... of this world.)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 私は<color=#GF_TIPS_031>私のしてること</color>に納得してます。
english: I've made peace with <color=#GF_TIPS_031>what I'm doing</color>.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
許してくれとは言いません……。
こうなった以上、私が望むのは、
みんなにも私と同じように納得してもらうことです。
english: I won't ask for your forgiveness... Now that it's come to this, all I want is for everyone to accept it just like I have.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
父は……兄に話すことには反対してますけど。
誰にも言うなって警告するまでもなく、
誰にも言えやんやろし？
english: Father... is against telling my brother, though. But even without warning you not to tell anyone, it's not like you can, right?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……でもね慎平さん。
澪には言わないでください……。
english: …But, Shinpei-san. Please don't tell Mio...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
これから見ること、知ることを……
澪にだけはっ……。
english: What you're about to see, what you're about to learn... Keep it from Mio...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪を巻き込むつもりはない……！！
english: I won't get Mio involved with this.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
よかった……
優しいんですね……。
english: I'm glad... You really are kind...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……つきました。
english: …We've arrived.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（目の前に広がる空間、
　長い長い影がその天井まで伸びている。
　その影の根元には……）
english: (The space spreading out before me, long, long shadows stretch all the way to the ceiling. At the base of those shadows...)

speaker: ??? (Heine)
japanese:
ちょうど９時やな……
食餌の時間じゃ。
english: It's exactly 9 o'clock... Time to eat.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（赤い着物の女の子……。
　ついに見つけた……夏祭りのときの子だ！！）
english: (The girl in the red kimono... I finally found her... the girl from the summer festival!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この子はあの夏祭りに何をしたのか……。
　いや、知るべきなのは、
　「何をするつもりなのか」だ！！）
english: (What did this girl do at that summer festival...? No, what I need to know is "what she plans to do"!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それがわかれば止められる！
　この状況から、少しでも手がかりを
　掴まなければ……！！）
english: (If I know that, I can stop her! I have to grasp any clue I can from this situation...!!)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
あのお姿は、ヒルコ様が最初にコピーした人……
「ハイネ」です。
彼女はその名前で呼ばれることを好みます。
english: That form is the first person Hiruko-sama copied... "Haine." She prefers to be called by that name.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
彼女こそが日都ヶ島の神、ヒルコノミコト。
影たちの母。
english: She is the god of Hitogashima, Hiruko-no-Mikoto. The mother of the Shadows.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
……ただの……女の子やないか……。
しおりちゃんくらいの……。
この子が……この子が神様やと！！？
english: ...She's just... a little girl... About Shiori-chan's age... This kid... this kid is a god!!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
まちがいないっ！！
ずっと感じてた嫌な気配……こいつや！
こいつから出てるんや！！
english: No doubt about it!! The bad presence I've been feeling all along... it's her! It's coming from her!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ヒルコ様が影の母……！！
　日都ヶ島は影を信仰する島だったというのか！？）
english: (Hiruko-sama is the mother of Shadows...!! Was Hitogashima an island that worshipped Shadows!?)

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ふっ……死にぞこないの裏切り者めが……！！
ケホッ。このわしを嫌な気配とは……
ずいぶん言うてくれるやないか……。
english: Hmph... you half-dead traitor...!! *Cough*. Calling my presence bad... You've got some nerve...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あの子はなんで輸血を！？
どっか病気なんか？
english: Why is she getting a blood transfusion!? Is she sick or something?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……見ての通り、
<color=#GF_TIPS_019>ハイネ</color>は弱っています。
原因は主に食料不足による栄養失調です。
english: …As you can see, <color=#GF_TIPS_019>Haine</color> is weak. The main cause is malnutrition due to a lack of food.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
空腹は、耐え難い苦痛をハイネに与え続けています。
ウシオさんならわかるでしょう？
english: Hunger constantly subjects Haine to unbearable pain. Ushio-san, you should understand, right?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
最近は足が弱って歩行が困難になりました。
なので……代わりの体を手に入れる必要が
あったんですよ。
english: Recently, her legs have grown weak, making it hard to walk. So... she needed to acquire a replacement body.

speaker: Heine
japanese: こうやって会うんは――
english: How many times have we met like this?

speaker: Shiori
japanese:
――何回めになるんかのう？
網代慎平。
english: Shinpei Ajiro.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
な……！
生きてたんか……おまえ……。
english: Wh...! You're alive... you...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……おまえやったんか！！
english: …It was you!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮を殺し、澪を殺し――
　みんなを……島を飲み込んだ化物……。
　あれが……この島の……神様だって？）
english: (She killed Ushio, killed Mio— The monster that swallowed everyone... the whole island... That's... the god of this island...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こいつはずっと……初めからずっと……）
english: (She's been here all along... from the very beginning...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ずっとオレの目の前に……ッ！
おったんか！！！
english: You were right in front of me...! This whole time!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うっ！！？
english: Ugh!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （巨大な影が迫ってくるッ……祭りの時と同じ！！）
english: (A giant Shadow is approaching... just like at the festival!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、下がって！！
english: Shinpei, get back!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: あかん、ハイネッ！！
english: Don't, Haine!!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
……だって……
そいつのでかい声が頭に響いてイライラする……。
うっかり殺してまいそうやわ……。
english: …But… His loud voice echoes in my head and gets on my nerves... I might just accidentally kill him...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くっ……。
english: Ngh...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
食べる時におしゃべりは行儀悪りて、
親に躾られやんかったんか？
english: Didn't your parents teach you that talking while eating is bad manners?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
わしは黙って食べるんが好きや……
二度と話しかけるでない。
english: I like to eat in silence... Don't ever speak to me again.

speaker: Heine
japanese: ――朱鷺子。
english: —Tokiko.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （看護服の……女性……？）
english: (A woman... in a nurse's uniform...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（腕が黒く溶けてる……彼女は影だ！
　影の力で、棺を２つ運んでる……！）
english: (Her arms are melting black... she's a Shadow! She's carrying two coffins with the power of the Shadows...!)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……<color=#GF_TIPS_015>根来</color>……さん……。
english: …<color=#GF_TIPS_015>Negoro</color>...-san...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？
english: Eh?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 看護師さんや……ウチの……。
english: She's a nurse... at our clinic...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
影たちが「情報」を食べて生きているのは、
ご存知ですか？
english: Did you know that Shadows live by eating "information"?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
中でもハイネは人の「味」を好みます。
味覚こそが彼女の栄養源なんです。
english: Haine in particular prefers the "taste" of humans. Taste itself is her source of nutrition.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
しかし昔ならいざ知らず、
食料の調達は年々難しくなりました。
english: However, whatever it may have been like in the past, procuring food has become more difficult every year.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そういえば根津さんが言っていた。
　最近は減ったが戦前は影の目撃例も多かったって）
english: (Come to think of it, Nezu-san said that. They've decreased recently, but there were many Shadow sightings before the war.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そういうことだったのか……）
english: (So that's what it was...)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
年に平均四人……日都ヶ島では死人が出ます。
病気や事故で。
english: An average of four people a year... die on Hitogashima. From illness or accidents.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
もうわかりますよね？
そうした死人を、菱形医院は
ずっと彼女に与え続けているんですよ。
english: You understand now, right? Hishigata Clinic has been continuously feeding those corpses to her.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
父も。祖父も。曽祖父も。
そのまたずっと昔から……。
english: My father. My grandfather. My great-grandfather. And even long before that...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
……待て……その棺……。
ま……まさか人を食わせるっちゅうんか！？
その子にっ！！
english: …Wait… those coffins... D-Don't tell me you're feeding people to her!? To that kid!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
やめろ！！！
何考えて……っ！！
english: Stop it!!! What are you thinking...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓、よせっ！
english: Sou, don't!

speaker: Rosencrantz
japanese: アアッ……！
english: Aaah...!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
クソッ！！
こんなんおったら、手が出せん……！
english: Damn it!! I can't do anything with these guys here...!

speaker: Negoro
japanese: ……お待たせしました。
english: …Sorry to keep you waiting.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
おほっ！　待っとったぞ！
今日も豪勢やのう！
english: Oho! I've been waiting! Quite the feast again today!

speaker: Negoro
japanese: 明日はもっとですよ、ハイネ……。
english: Tomorrow will be even better, Haine...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ふふっ……うふふふふふっ！
こっちの棺は……本土から来た刑事か。
english: Hehe... Ufufufufufu! This coffin is... the detective from the mainland, huh.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
慎平さん。
あなたに殺人は無理って、言いましたよね。
english: Shinpei-san. I told you murder is impossible for you, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Eh...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
でも……
慎平さんに殺される覚悟はできてます。私。
english: But... I'm prepared to be killed by you, Shinpei-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ま……待ってくれよ……。
トキちゃん……まさか……。
english: W-Wait a second... Toki-chan... don't tell me...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
そんで……こっちの棺が……。
ふふふっ……！
english: And... this coffin is... Hehehe...!

speaker: Heine
japanese: 近う寄ってよう見てみィ、ウシオ……。
english: Come closer and take a good look, Ushio...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
あの時わしが食いそびれた、
おまんの本物じゃ。
english: It's your original body, the one I missed eating back then.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そっ……そんな！！
潮！！！
english: N-No way!! Ushio!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （本物の……潮の遺体……！？）
english: (The real... Ushio's corpse!?)

speaker: Heine
japanese:
うふふふふふっ！
ふくくくくくくっ……ふふふッ……。
english: Ufufufufufu! Fukukukukuku... Fufufu...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お、おいっ！
それホンマに潮なんか！？
english: H-Hey! Is that really Ushio!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
