だって……昨日火葬した遺体は！？
集めた骨はッ！！？
english: But... what about the body we cremated yesterday!? The bones we gathered!!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
遺体はお父さんがすり替えました。
骨はハイネがプリントした、昔の誰かの骨です。
本物ではありません。
english: Father swapped the body. The bones were printed by Haine, they belonged to someone from a long time ago. They aren't real.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
死体は大事な食料ですよ。
焼いてしまうわけないじゃないですか。
english: Corpses are important food. We wouldn't just burn them.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なんでや！？
なんでそこまでして……
その子を看病せなあかんねん……！
english: Why!? Why do you have to go that far... to take care of that kid...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トキちゃん……全部知ってたんか？
しおりちゃんが狙われてることも……
潮が殺されることも！！
english: Toki-chan... did you know everything? About Shiori-chan being targeted... And about Ushio being killed!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
潮さんのことは知らんかったです。
まさか自分の影と協力して、
しおりちゃんを助けようとしてたなんて……。
english: I didn't know about Ushio-san. To think she was working with her own Shadow to try and save Shiori-chan...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
正義ぶって、余計なことに首つっこむから
死んだんですよ。
english: She died because she stuck her nose into things she shouldn't have, acting like some hero of justice.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……なんやと……？
english: …What did you say...?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……すべてはハイネのためです。
english: This was all for Haine.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ふざけんな！！！
許されるわけないやろこんなことォッ！！
english: Don't mess with me!!! There's no way this is unforgivable!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
親父はどこや！！！　神様が許しても！！
オレが許さんっ！！！！
english: Where's Dad!!! Even if God forgives him!! I won't forgive him!!!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……何も知らんくせに……っ。
english: …You don't know anything...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ギャーーギャーーうッッさいんじゃ！！
ボケェッ！！
english: Stop screaming, you're so annoying!! You idiot!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お兄ちゃんがそんなんやから！！！
私がやってんのやろがよォッ！！！！
english: Because you're like that, Big Brother!!! I'm the one who has to do it!!!!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
コホッコッホ……コホッ。
ゴボッ！
english: *Cough, cough*... *cough*. *Gobo*!

speaker: Heine
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……。
english: *Pant*... *pant*...

speaker: Negoro
japanese: ハイネ、また血ィが……。
english: Haine, you're bleeding again...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ど……どういう、ことや……！
english: Wh... What do you mean...?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
こうするしかないんですよ、こうするしか……！！
でないとお母さんがっ……
お母さんが死んでまうんやからっ……！！
english: We have no other choice, no other choice...!! Otherwise Mom... Mom will die...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ハイネが死んだら……。
お母さんも死んでしまうんやから…………。
english: If Haine dies... Mom will die too...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: What...!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お母さんが生きてんのは、
病気が治ったからじゃないんよ。
english: Mom isn't alive because her illness was cured.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お父さんがハイネに頼んで……
<color=#GF_TIPS_029>影</color>になって、死ななくなっただけ。
english: Dad asked Haine... She just became a <color=#GF_TIPS_029>Shadow</color> and stopped dying.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: …Huh? Wait... huh!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
だって……どういう……
い……意味がわからん……！！
お母さんが？　……え！？
english: But... what do you mean... I... I don't understand...!! Mom is? ...Eh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影……なんか！？
じゃあまさか本物はっ！？
english: A Shadow...!? Then don't tell me the real one is...!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
また愚問……。
お母さんはお母さんや……何も変わらん……！！
english: Another stupid question... Mom is Mom... nothing's changed...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お兄ちゃんも慎平さんも！！
ウシオさんのこと、本物の潮さんや思てるでしょう！？
english: Both you and Shinpei-san!! You think of Ushio-san as the real Ushio-san, right!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: トキちゃん…………。
english: Toki-chan......

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハイネ……刑事さんを食べる気だ！）
english: (Haine... is going to eat the detective!)

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
や……やめろ！！
食べたらあかんっ！！！
english: S-Stop!! You can't eat him!!!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
なんでじゃ？
ちゃんと手ェ洗うたよ？
english: Why? I washed my hands properly, you know?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: こんなんまちがってる！！！
english: This is wrong!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（遺体が……消えた……。
　食べられてしまったんだ……）
english: (The corpse... disappeared... It was eaten...)

speaker: Heine
japanese: んんっ！
english: Mmm!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
まちがってるとかまちがってないとか、
そんな次元の話してないんですよ。
納得して生きていくしかないんです、この島では。
english: Whether it's right or wrong, we're not talking on that level. We have no choice but to accept it and live on this island.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (…Accept?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ダメだ……。
　潮があいつに食べられて消えるなんて、
　そんなことあってたまるか！！！）
english: (No... I won't let Ushio get eaten by her and disappear! Like hell I'll let that happen!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だったら考えろッ！
　潮を助ける方法を……！）
english: (Then think! How to save Ushio...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮を取り戻す方法を！！）
english: (How to get Ushio back!!)

speaker: Heine
japanese: ほなら、次は潮をいただくとしようかの。
english: Well then, I suppose I'll have Ushio next.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影はスキャン中の数秒間、身動きができなくなる！
　今さっきこの目で見た！
　ハイネも例外じゃない！！）
english: (Shadows can't move for a few seconds while scanning! I just saw it with my own eyes! Haine is no exception!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （だったら……！）
english: (In that case...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……潮、今やッ！
プリントしろ！！
english: …Ushio, now! Print it!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 待ってたでその言葉ッ！！！
english: I was waiting fer ya to say that!!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: えッ！！？
english: Eh!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（さっきぶん投げたネイルガンを今！
　オレの手元にプリントし直す！）
english: (She's re-printing the nail gun I threw earlier right into my hands now!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こいつで潮を捕らえてる影の動きを封じる！）
english: (I'll use this to stop the Shadow holding Ushio!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くらえッ！！
english: Eat this!!

speaker: 巨大な影（ロズ）
japanese: ア゛ッ！
english: Agh!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よし、動きを止めた！
　あとは頼む、潮！）
english: (Alright, it stopped moving! I'm counting on you for the rest, Ushio!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 今やッ！！
english: Now!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
スキャン成功！
これで腕も戻せるわ！
english: Scan successful! Now I can get my arm back too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（やったッ……取り返した！！
　完璧だ！）
english: (We did it... we got it back!! Perfect!)

speaker: Negoro
japanese: ハイネ、おケガは？
english: Haine, are you hurt?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ズルッ！！　ズルゥーーーーッ！！！
わしの食餌を横取りしよった……！！
english: Cheater!! Cheaterrrr!!! You stole my food...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ありがとう潮……！！
うまくいったな！
english: Thank you, Ushio...!! It worked perfectly!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: へへッ、慎平の考えなんかお見通しや！
english: Hehe, I saw right through your plan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
けど、そろそろ潮時や……。
今すぐオレを――
english: But it's about time we left... Right now, I need you to—

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: なんで……！？
english: Why!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
影に逆ろて……馬鹿なんですか！？
死ぬだけですよ……？
勝てっこない……絶対に……。
english: Defying the Shadows... are you stupid!? You'll only end up dead, you know...? You can't win... absolutely not...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……私の知ってるトキちゃんは、
こんなこと喜んでやる子やない。
english: ...The Toki-chan I know wouldn't do something like this willingly.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あいつは利用してるだけや……！！
トキちゃん達の弱みにつけ込んでっ……。
english: She's just using you...!! Taking advantage of your weaknesses...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
自分の空腹を満たしたいがために！
トキちゃんの気持ち弄んでる！！
……それを納得して生きてけ？
english: Just to satisfy her own hunger! She's playing with your feelings!! ...And you're just going to accept that and live with it?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 絶対ムリやから！！！
english: That's absolutely impossible!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
妹の大事な親友をナメくさりやがってよォッ！！
神様かヒルコ様か知らんけどなァ……ッ！！
人間ナメんな！！！！
english: Don't you dare look down on my sister's precious best friend!! I don't care if you're a god or Hiruko-sama...!! Don't underestimate humans!!!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: ...!! Ushio-sa...

speaker: Heine
japanese: つまらん……。
english: Boring...

speaker: Negoro
japanese: うう……アアあああああ゛ッ！！！
english: Uu... Aaaaaaahhh!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なんだ……アレ……。
　化物の姿に変わっていく……
　ハイネの仕業か！？）
english: (What is... that... She's transforming into a monster... Is this Haine's doing!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （もはや人に擬態する必要ないってか！！）
english: (I guess she doesn't need to mimic a human anymore!!)

speaker: Heine
japanese:
アレの記憶はわしが食べたい。
半殺しまでや。
english: I want to eat her memories. Beat her half to death.

speaker: Negoro
japanese: ……オオオオオオッ！！！！
english: ...Oooooohhh!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くッ……！
english: Ngh...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（突っ込んでくる……！！
　最善手を打つのなら、今すぐ潮に
　オレの首をはねてもらってループを――）
english: (She's charging at us...!! If I'm to play the best move, I need Ushio to cut off my head right now and loop—)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平！！　私に任して！！
english: Shinpei!! Leave it to me!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮を止めるべきなのに止められない――
　なぜならオレも、潮とまったく同じ気持ちだからだ）
english: (I should stop Ushio, but I can't— Because I feel exactly the same way she does.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （どうせ死ぬなら――）
english: (If we're going to die anyway—)

speaker: Negoro
japanese: オオオオオオオオオオオッ！！
english: Oooooooooohh!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （戦って死ぬ！）
english: (We'll go down fighting!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
来たァ！！
ほな行くでェエエエエッ！！！
english: She's here!! Let's gooooo!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮の右腕が元に戻った……！！）
english: (Ushio's right arm is back to normal...!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 人間……ナメんな！！！！
english: Don't underestimate... humans!!!!

speaker: Negoro
japanese: ッッッッッッッ！！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （やったッ……！！）
english: (We did it...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あとはハイネだ！！
　ネイルガンを撃ち込めば――）
english: (Now just Haine!! If I shoot her with the nail gun—)

speaker: Heine
english: ……Tch!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ？
english: Eh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ネイルガンが……真っ二つに切られた……？
　オレの……指、ごと！？）
english: (The nail gun... was sliced in two...? Along with... my fingers!?)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: やめなさいハイネ、ここまでです。
english: Stop, Haine. That's enough.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
…………う、ぐッッ！！！
ああぁッあ……！！
あぁああアアア！！！！
english: …U-Guh!!! Aaaah...!! Aaaaaaah!!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: し、慎平！？
english: S-Shinpei!?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: 今、慎平くんのこと食べようとしたでしょ。
english: You were just about to eat Shinpei-kun, weren't you?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
だってだって！
こいつら、わしの食い物を！
english: But, but! They took my food!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: だってじゃありません！！
english: That's not a good reason.

speaker: Heine
japanese: プーーーッ！
english: Pffft!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
おまんが出て来んのが遅いさけ、
こんなことになってんのにっ……。
english: This only happened because you were so slow to come out...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
お許しを……。
おもしろかったんで、
しばらく見入ってしまいました。
english: Forgive me... It was so interesting, I couldn't help but watch for a while.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐ、あ、あ……ッ！
english: G-A-Ah...!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ハイネ。
小舟潮の遺体は、後でちゃんと取り返しますから……。
english: Haine. I'll get Ushio Kofune's body back for you later, so...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
これは食べたらダメですよ。
大事な人質ですので。
english: You can't eat this one. She's a valuable hostage.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: ...Huh?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
しつこい！
わかってるっちゅうねん……。
english: You're so persistent! I know already...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ngh...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
そう……賢いですよみなさん。
動かん方がええ……。
english: Yes... you're all very smart. It's best not to move...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ご心配なく……澪ちゃんは生きてます。
ただし、あなたたちが１歩でも動いたら、
このまま頭を生卵の様に割っちゃいます。
english: Don't worry... Mio-chan is alive. However, if you take even one step, I'll crush her head like a raw egg.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
もうこれ以上我々の邪魔はさせません。
全部あきらめてください。
english: We won't let you interfere with us anymore. Please give up on everything.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: おンまえッ……！！
english: Y-You...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: おい……どういうこっちゃ……？
english: Hey. What's going on?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
澪には手ェ出せへんて！！
言うたやないか！！！
english: You said you wouldn't lay a hand on Mio!! Didn't you!!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
どういうことも何も……
どうせみんな明日までの命ですし？
english: What do you mean...? You all only have until tomorrow to live anyway.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
何を……何を言うてんの？
明日……夏祭りの最後の食餌で、ハイネの体を治す……。
お母さんを生きられるようにするんや……！！
english: What... What are you saying? Tomorrow... at the summer festival, the final meal will heal Haine's body... So that Mom can live...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
誰にもバレずに……あとは今まで通り……。
今まで通り……！
それがお父さんの計画や……そうやろが！！
english: Without anyone finding out... everything will go back to normal... Just like it was...! That was Dad's plan... wasn't it!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
菱形家には大変お世話になりました。
でもそれももう終わりです。
english: We are very grateful to the Hishigata family. But that is also over now.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……裏切ったな……。
みんなをどないする気――
english: …You betrayed us... What are you going to do to everyone—

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: うるさいですね。
english: You're annoying.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: トキコッ！！
english: Tokiko!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: ワオ！
english: Wow!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: お兄…………ちゃん……？
english: Big... brother...?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: お父様もすべて、了解済みですよ。
english: Your father has already agreed to everything.

japanese: 56.正義の味方
english: 56. Hero of Justice

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: ハァ……ゼェ……。
english: *Pant*... *wheeze*...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（あかん……もう僕の意識が……。
　ごめん、お姉ちゃん……）
english: (This is bad... I'm losing consciousness... Sorry, Sis...)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
おいあんた……大丈夫か？
す……すごい血ィや……。
english: Hey, you... are you okay? Y-You're bleeding a lot...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （凸村……よかった彼は人間や……）
english: (Totsumura... thank goodness, he's human...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （僕はここまでや……）
english: (This is as far as I go...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （お姉ちゃん……さよ……なら……）
english: (Sis... good... bye...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
うっ！
竜之介……。
english: Ugh! Ryunosuke...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あッ！！
あんたは、潮ちゃんの葬儀におった……！
english: Ah!! You were at Ushio-chan's funeral...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
小舟澪はどうした……？
一緒だったはずだろう？
english: What happened to Mio Kofune...? You were supposed to be with her, right?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ば……化物が……連れてった……。
english: A... A monster... took her...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オレら、しおりちゃんを追ってて……。
そしたら、赤ちゃんの化物がいっぱい出て来て。
澪ちゃんはそいつらに捕まって……。
english: We were chasing Shiori-chan... Then a bunch of baby monsters came out. Mio-chan was captured by them...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オレは……怖くて……逃げた……。
澪ちゃんを置き去りに……。
english: I was... scared... and I ran away... Leaving Mio-chan behind...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 拳銃はどうした……？
english: What happened to your handgun...?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
多分……落とした……。
銃抜いてよォ……やつらに撃とうとしたけど……。
転んで……オレ……そんで……走って……
english: I probably... dropped it... I pulled my gun... tried to shoot them, but... I fell... and I... then I... ran...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
わからへん……
そっからもう……わからへん……。
english: I don't know... After that, I just... I don't know...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 逃げて正解だったな……。
english: Running was the right choice.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: えっ！？
english: Eh!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミに頼みがある……。
私はもう歩けない……。
だから私を……運んでくれたまえよ……。
english: I have a favor to ask of you... I can no longer walk... So please... carry me...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あ……ああ！！
今すぐ病院にっ……！！
english: R-Right! To the hospital, right now...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
違う。
この洞窟の…………一番奥へだ……！！
english: No. To the very deepest part... of this cave...!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
はァァ！？　あんた何言うてんの！！
ぜっ……絶対イヤや！！！
こんなとこ一刻も早よ出るんやっ！！
english: Haaah!? What are you saying!! N-No way in hell!!! I'm getting out of here as soon as possible!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
逃げ場などない……。
島は……影どもに支配されている……。
english: There is nowhere to run... The island... is controlled by the Shadows...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: なァッ！？
english: Wha!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
い、いいか……トリ頭……。
よ……く……聞け……。
english: L-Listen... birdbrain... Listen... closely...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
あ……あいつは、高次元の存在だ……。
ハイネには時間が見えている……。
あいつは竜之介の……ズレを観測した……。
english: Th-That thing is a higher-dimensional being... Haine can see time... She observed Ryunosuke's... shift...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
しかし……干渉する力は……失ったと見える……。
神とて不朽ではないというわけだ……。
english: However... it seems she's lost the power... to interfere... It means that even a god is not immortal...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
対抗できる……！！
網代慎平ならば……！！！
english: We can fight back...!! If it's Shinpei Ajiro...!!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
し、慎平くんならって……。
そない言われても、なにがなんやら……。
english: S-Shinpei-kun...? Even if you say that, I don't know what's going on...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ゴホッ……ゴホッ……。
頼むよ……手遅れになる前に……。
english: *Cough*... *cough*... Please... before it's too late...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: おまえは……正義の味方……なんだろう……？
english: You're... a Hero of Justice... aren't you...?

japanese: 57.観測者①
english: 57. Observer (1)

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: うあ……。
english: Ua...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: トキちゃんッ！！！
english: Toki-chan!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （窓……トキちゃんまで……！）
english: (Sou... even Toki-chan...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……ダメだ。
　これを……これを現実にしちゃダメだ……）
english: (…No. I can't... I can't let this become reality...)

speaker: Heine
japanese:
……ウシオ。
こっちに来い、ゆっくりとな。
english:
…Ushio.
Come here, slowly.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
…………おまえら……
許さん……！！
english: ...You guys... I won't forgive you...!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
許さなければ何です？
澪ちゃんが死にますよ。
english: And what if you don't? Mio-chan will die.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: 来なさい。
english: Come here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
や……やめろ……！！
何を……する気や…………！？
そいつに手ェ出すな！！！！
english: S-Stop...!! What are you... going to do...!? Don't lay a hand on her!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえ人を食いたいんやろッ！
だったらオレを食えよッ！！
english: You want to eat people, right! Then eat me!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ッッッが……
english: Gggh...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
挑発には乗らんぞ。
カッコよく死のうなんてムダなんやから。
english: I won't fall for your provocation. Trying to die a heroic death is pointless.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（右目を……！！
　眼球をえぐり取られた……ッ！！！）
english: (My right eye...!! She gouged out my eyeball...!!!)

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ウシオ。
劣化した野良言うたんは訂正しちゃる。
そんなんがネゴロを倒せるとは思えん。
english: Ushio. I'll correct what I said about you being a degraded Stray. I don't think something like that could beat Negoro.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
おまんは劣化とは逆じゃ……。
むしろ「成長」しておる……！！
english: You're the opposite of degraded... If anything, you've "grown"...!!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ただ消すんは惜しなった……アタマを直して使ちゃる。
明日は人手が要るからのう……。
english: It'd be a waste to just erase you... I'll fix your head and use you. I'll need the extra hands tomorrow...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: やめろ……！！
english: Stop...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
消えたくないよっ……。
私……消えたく……ない…………。
english: I don't want to disappear... I don't... want to... disappear...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: やめてくれッッ……！！
english: Stop it...!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: なッ！？
english: Wha!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Th... is is...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハイネに奪われた目が、戻ってきた！？）
english: (The eye Haine stole came back!?)

speaker: Heine
japanese:
チッ！
こやつの力を消すのは無理か……。
english: Tch! Guess I can't erase his power...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
「卵」が先か「鶏」が先か……。
因果が円環を成しておるわ……！！
ズルッ……！
english: Which came first, the "egg" or the "chicken"... The causality forms a circle...!! Cheater...!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
……キミのその右目……。
その目は高次元の視点から時間の流れを俯瞰し、
いくつもの並行世界を観測する。
english: …That right eye of yours... That eye takes a bird's-eye view of the flow of time from a higher dimension, and observes multiple parallel worlds.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （しまっ――）
english: (Cra—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (I... I can't... move...!!)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
そして慎平くん。
キミはキミの観測した世界を「<color=#GF_KEY_KANSOKUSYA>事実</color>」にする力がある。
今この世界はキミが描写している……。
english: And Shinpei-kun. You have the power to make the world you observe into a "<color=#GF_KEY_KANSOKUSYA>fact</color>". Right now, this world is being depicted by you...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
まさに恐るべき神の力です。
しかし幸運にも、
キミにはその力を使いこなせていない。
english: It truly is a terrifying, god-like power. But fortunately, you haven't mastered how to use it.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
「死」という自意識の消失がなければ
作動しない不完全なもの……。
english: An incomplete power that won't activate without the loss of self-awareness known as "death"...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
だから要するに、
最後までキミを殺さんかったらいいだけです。
english: So, in short, we just have to avoid killing you until the very end.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……そ……そんな…………。
　バレてる！
　オレのループのことが……！！）
english: (…N... No way... They know! About my looping...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なぜ！？
　「前回」と違って「今回」オレは、
　コピーを取られていないのに……！？）
english: (Why!? Unlike "last time", "this time" I haven't been copied...!!)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: カンタンなことですね。
english: It's simple.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
キミは明日が終わるまで、
ずうっとここで、ただ息を吸って吐いていてください。
絶望しながらね。
english: Until tomorrow ends, please just stay here, breathing in and out. In absolute despair.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Mio!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……イヤァアアアアアアアアッ……！！！！
english: …Noooooooo...!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どこで？
　どこで間違えた……？）
english:
(Where?
Where did I go wrong…?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （詰んだ……）
english: (It's over...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ループができなければ、
　もうどうすることもできない。
　もう二度とやり直すことはできない……）
english: (If I can't loop, there's nothing I can do. I can never do this over again...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレはまた約束を破る……。
　……オレには誰も守れない……）
english: (I'm going to break my promise again... ...I can't protect anyone...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ごめん……澪……。
ごめん……潮……。
english:
I'm sorry… Mio…
I'm sorry… Ushio…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや……まだだ！
　まだある……オレにはまだ、策が…！！）
english: (No... not yet! There's still... I still have a plan...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（『あれ』を使うチャンスは、きっと一瞬だ……。
　絶対に……絶対に見逃さない……！！）
english: (The chance to use "that" will probably only last a moment... I absolutely... absolutely won't miss it...!!)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: あっ！！
english: Ah!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
……ひいィッ！！
おっ……お取り込み中スかァ！！？
english: ...Eek!! A-Are you in the middle of something!!?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: 凸む――
english: Totsumu—

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
english: Guh!?!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （南雲先生……っ！！）
english: (Nagumo-sensei...!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 最後の……一発だ……！
english: The last... shot...!

japanese: 58.観測者②
english: 58. Observer (2)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: あ。
english: Ah.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
危ない、危ない……。
もう少しで慎平くんを殺されるところでした。
english: That was close, that was close... I almost had Shinpei-kun killed.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
不意打ちで私の腕を撃ち落とし、慎平くんを解放……。
それから慎平くんを銃殺して
ループさせようとしていたのですね。
english: You shot my arm off by surprise, freeing Shinpei-kun... Then you were going to shoot him and make him loop, weren't you.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ですが残念。
ここまできて
慎平くんを殺されるわけにはいかないのですよ。
english: But unfortunately, I can't let you kill Shinpei-kun after coming all this way.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
ともあれ、お掃除完了です……。
これでもう我々の邪魔をする者はいない……。
english: Anyway, the cleanup is complete... Now there's no one left to get in our way...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ヤツの腕が修復していく……！
　南雲先生と凸村さんが
　命を賭けてくれたというのに……！）
english: (His arm is repairing itself...! Even though Nagumo-sensei and Totsumura-san risked their lives for me...!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平ェッ！！！
english: Shinpei!!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
残念でしたね慎平くん。
これで……今度こそゲームオーバーです。
english: Too bad, Shinpei-kun. With this... it's game over for real.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: う……あァッ……。
english: Ugh... Aah...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
やめろッ！！
慎平を……はな、せっ……！！
english: Stop it!! Let... Shinpei... go...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （くそっ、体が……動か……！）
english: (Damn it, my body... won't move...!)

speaker: Heine
japanese:
諦めろ。
もう遅い、何もかも……。
english: Give up. It's already too late, for everything...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ぐッ……アァアアアアアアッ！！！
english: Guh... Aaaaaaaahhh!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: U... shi, o...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
すべて無駄になりましたねェ。
チャンスも、ヒントも……大事な人々の命も。
english: Everything was for nothing, wasn't it. The chances, the hints... the lives of the people you care about.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
でも、安心してください。
慎平くんの命だけは私が保証しますから。
english: But, please rest assured. I will guarantee Shinpei-kun's life, at least.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: すべてが終わるまでは、ね。
english: Until everything is over, that is.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……どこか遠くから……
　ウシオの叫ぶ声が聞こえる……）
english: (…From somewhere far away... I can hear Ushio screaming...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （でも……意識、が……もう……）
english: (But... my consciousness... is already...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァッ……ハァッ……！
english: *Pant*... *pant*...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さん……。
な……南雲、先……生……！！
english: Totsumura-san... N-Nagumo... Sensei...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ありがとうございます……。
english: Thank you...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
english: …What?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
が……ッ。
おかげで……ふっ……飲めました……。
english: Gah...! Thanks to you... *pant*... I was able to drink it...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: キミ……！
english: You…!

speaker: Ushio
english: Shin... pei...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 二人共聞いてくれ。
english: Listen, both of you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレたちのうち誰かが死んだり、
取り返しのつかない怪我を負ったりしたら……。
オレはすぐに、ループしてやり直す。
english: If one of us dies, or suffers an irreversible injury... I'll immediately loop and redo things.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おまえが自分で死ぬってことか！？
どうやって！？
english: You mean you'll kill yourself!? How!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 苦しいのは勘弁やからな、潮に首を刎ねてもらおかな。
english: I want to avoid suffering, so I'll have Ushio cut off my head.

speaker: Ushio
english: Huh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
即死やし、痛みとかなさそうやし、
何より確実に死ねる……！！
いいことずくめや！
english: It's instant death, probably painless, and most importantly, it's guaranteed to kill me...!! It's all good things!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私がやらなあかんってトコに目ェつぶればな！
もし私が身動きできやん状況やったら！？
english: If you ignore the part where I have to do it! What if I'm in a situation where I can't move!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そん時はコレを使う。
english: Then I'll use this.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あっ！！！
おまっ……それ昇汞！！
持って来たんかよっ！！！
english: Ah!!! You... that's corrosive sublimate!! You brought it with you!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
この毒薬はどれくらいで死ねる？
致死量は？
english: How long does it take to die from this poison? What's the lethal dose?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……水に溶かして１滴飲んだだけでもアカンわ……！！
english: ...Even drinking one drop dissolved in water is fatal...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: じゃあ、この中身全部飲んだら確実に逝けるな？
english: Then if I drink the whole thing, I'll definitely go, right?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……ただし、苦しむぞ……？
english: ...But, you'll suffer, you know...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……使うことにならんよう祈るよ……。
english: Yeah... let's hope I never have to use it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: っがはエ゛ッッ……。
english: *Gah*... *urgh*...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
毒……ですか……。
こんなものを躊躇なく飲むとは……
キミ、死に慣れてますね？
english: Poison... is it... To drink something like this without hesitation... You're used to dying, aren't you?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
……まさか慎平くん。
何回もここまで来てますか？
english: …Don't tell me, Shinpei-kun. Have you been here multiple times?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ふ……ふふっ！
初見で余裕じゃ……クソ……野郎……ッ！！
english: …He... heheh! Once is enough to deal with you... assholes...!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
……ほお。
まさかこれほどの覚悟とは。
子供やからって見くびれませんねェ……。
english: …Oh. To think you had this much resolve. I can't underestimate you just because you're a kid...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
何遍でも……！
ええか……！！　オレ……は……何遍でも……。
何遍でもやり直すッ……！！
english: No matter how many times...! Listen to me...!! I... will do it over... as many times as it takes...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そんで最後に……おまえらを倒す！！
か……必ずや……！！！
english: And in the end... I'll defeat you!! I... definitely will...!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お……おまえはいつまでそんな余裕……。
ブッこいてられるやろな……！？
english: H-How long are you going to keep acting... so damn confident...!?

speaker: Heine
english: …Hey!!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
もう手の施しようがありません……。
申しわけありません、ハイネ……。
english: There's nothing more we can do... I apologize, Haine...

speaker: Heine
japanese: そいつは……もうよい……！！
english: Forget about... him...!!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
見よ……こやつ……。
さっきからわしの侵食を……押し戻しよるわ……！！
english: Look... this one... She's been pushing back... my erosion since earlier...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平が…………！！
命……ッかけてる時にィッ……！
ね……寝てる場合や……。
english: Shinpei is...!! Risking his... life...! This is no time... to be sleeping...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ないんじゃああッ！！！！
english: Not at aaaaaaall!!!!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
うぬっ！　こやつ……！
逆にわしを……浸食しとる！
english: Ngh! This girl...! She's eroding me... instead!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
まさか貴様……！！
貴様が「卵」か！？
english: It can't be...!! Are you the "egg"!?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ウシオを殺せッ！！
わしごとでかまわんッ！！
english: Kill Ushio!! I don't care if you hit me too!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
今の一撃、確実に捉えたはず……。
消えた……？
english: That strike should have definitely hit... She disappeared...?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
おのれッ……。
連れて行きよった……。
english: Damn it... She took him with her...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平……っ。
english: Shinpei...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
大丈夫や！！
もう離さへんっ！！
english: I'm fine!! I won't let go anymore!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ごめん慎平！！
私のせいでみんながっ！！
澪がっ……！！！
english: I'm sorry, Shinpei!! Because of me, everyone...!! Mio...!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: You're wrong!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: まだ後ろは見やんでいい……今だけ見てろ……！！
english: You don't need to look back yet... just look at the present...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
やつらを倒す……！！
たとえオレの命が尽きてもな……！！
english: We'll defeat them...!! Even if it costs me my life...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私……何回でも……どこへでも行く……。
慎平といっしょに……！！
english: I'll... go anywhere... as many times as it takes... Together with Shinpei...!!

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_04>４度目のＥＮＤ</color>】を入手しました。
english: Acquired Key TIPS [<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_04>4th END</color>].

japanese: 6周目
english: 6th Loop

japanese: 59.コバマート、再び！①
english: 59. Koba Mart, Again! (1)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 消せるかもって……シオリをか！？
english: You might be able to erase her... you mean Shiori!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ヒルコ洞で私……
ハイネに頭ん中いじられそうになったんです。
あいつが私の中に入って来て……。
english: In Hiruko Cave... Haine almost messed with my head. She tried to get inside me...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: だから……その経路を逆に辿ったら――
english: So... if I trace that path backwards—

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キミにも同じことができると？
english: You can do the same thing to her?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: はい！！
english: Yes!!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
なんやようわからんが……
試す価値はありそうやな？
english: I don't really get it, but... It sounds like it's worth a try, right?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ……。
本当はこの私の手で葬りたいがな……。
english: Yeah... Though truthfully, I'd like to bury her with my own hands...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……前回、根津さんから聞いたんです。
１４年前、先生の双子の弟、
竜之介さんが影に殺されたことや……。
english: …Last time, Nezu-san told me. About how 14 years ago, Sensei's twin brother, Ryunosuke-san, was killed by a Shadow...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
竜之介さんの遺体に、潮が殺された時と同じ様な
首を絞められた跡があったこと……。
english: About how Ryunosuke-san's body had strangulation marks on it, just like when Ushio was killed...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さんを殺したのは、ハイネなのでは？
english: The one who killed Ryunosuke-san was Haine, wasn't it?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
…………そうだ……。
そしてあの子は……私の友人だった……。
english: …That's right... And she was... my friend...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 友達！！？
english: A friend?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あっ……すんません、オレのケータイです……！
english: Ah... sorry, it's my phone...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ――澪からや！！
english: —It's from Mio!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
出たまえ。詳しい話は後にしよう。
キミは今、葬儀を抜け出してここに来ているのだ。
戻らなければ怪しまれる。
english: Answer it. We'll talk about the details later. You snuck out of the funeral to come here. It'll be suspicious if you don't go back.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
では一度戻ります。
６時にコバマート集合ってことで！
english: Then I'll head back for now. Let's meet at Koba Mart at 6!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……生きてる……。
　スマホのバイブレーションが、
　澪の生存を伝えてくれる……）
english: (…She's alive... The vibration of my smartphone tells me that Mio is alive...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もう二度と澪を死なせるものか……！！
　たとえ何があっても！！）
english: (I won't let Mio die ever again...!! No matter what happens!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 根津さん、準備いいですか？
english: Nezu-san, are you ready?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: おまえが生まれる前からできとる。
english: I was ready before ya were even born.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 私もいつでもええでっ！
english: I'm good to go anytime too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮はオレの腕時計に変身している……。
　人気がなくなったら、潮を元の姿に戻す）
english: (Ushio is transformed into my wristwatch... Once there's no one around, I'll turn her back to normal.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そして……ハイネを消すんだ。
　四本腕が大事にしてるハイネを、今！
　今日ここで！！）
english: (And then... I'll erase Haine. The four-armed Shadow's precious Haine, right now! Today, right here!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうすれば、あの夏祭りの終わりから
　みんなを救える！！）
english: (If I do that, I can save everyone from the end of that summer festival!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハイネがみんなの仇だ！
　あいつがしおりちゃんの姿をしていようが、
　もはやためらいなど微塵もない！！）
english: (Haine is everyone's enemy! Even if she looks like Shiori-chan, I don't have a shred of hesitation left!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もう四本腕の思い通りにはならない！
　あいつの計画は……オレたちがぶっ壊す！！！）
english: (I won't let things go the four-armed Shadow's way anymore! We're going to... destroy his plan!!!)

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese: あ、ひづる！！
english: Ah, Hizuru!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
夕食時にすんませ――。
いや、すまない。
english: Sorry to bother you during dinn— No, my apologies.

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そろそろか……出てきてええぞ潮！
english: It's about time... you can come out now, Ushio!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ほっ！！
english: Hup!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
変身したり戦こうたり……。
おまえさんアニメみたいやの……。
english: Transforming, fighting... You're like something out of an anime...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……あっ！

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平、慎平！
今、すごいこと気ィ付いた！！
english:
Shinpei, Shinpei!
I just realized something amazing!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: な、なんや？
english: Wh-What is it?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
この服、窓と会う前の服やろ？
なんで今、これ着てるかわかるか？
english: These clothes, they're what I was wearing before we met Sou, right? Do you know why I'm wearing them now?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
前の周回でスキャンしたデータを、
<color=#GF_TIPS_080>次のループに持ち越せる</color>んか！！
english: You can <color=#GF_TIPS_080>carry over</color> data scanned in the previous loop <color=#GF_TIPS_080>to the next loop</color>!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: すごかろ！？
english: Amazing, right!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああすごい……おまえすごいぞ潮！！
english: Yeah, it's amazing... you're amazing, Ushio!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なるほど……
　これは色々試せるかもな……！！）
english: (I see... We might be able to try a lot of things with this...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （一度、使える武器について整理しておこう……）
english: (Let's sort out the weapons we can use first...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（根津さんが持参した２丁のうち、
　根津さんのを「ネイルガンＡ」、
　オレが前回壊したものを「ネイルガンＢ」とする）
english: (Of the two Nezu-san brought, I'll call Nezu-san's "Nail Gun A", and the one I broke last time "Nail Gun B".)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮がネイルガンＢを改めてスキャンする。
　壊れた旧いネイルガンに上書きしてから、本物を消去した）
english: (Ushio scans Nail Gun B again. She overwrote the broken old nail gun, then erased the original.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これでまた、
　ネイルガンＢ（影）が使えるようになった）
english: (With this, Nail Gun B (Shadow) is usable again.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（根津さんのネイルガンＡもコピーしたかったが
　潮の脳のストレージがいっぱいで断念した）
english: (I wanted to copy Nezu-san's Nail Gun A too, but Ushio's brain storage was full, so I gave up.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（つまりオレが持っているネイルガンＢだけは
　潮にプリントし直してもらえば
　何度でも撃てる状態になっているわけだ）
english: (So basically, as long as I have Ushio reprint it, I can shoot Nail Gun B as many times as I want.)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ところで慎平。
竜之介が家に入って５分経った……。
english:
By the way, Shinpei.
Ryunosuke has been in the house for five minutes…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
そろそろこのスマホに連絡あるはずやな？
「プランＢに変更します」ってよ。
english: We should be getting a message on this phone soon, right? Saying, "Changing to Plan B."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ええ……。
そしてその連絡から２分後くらいに、
３階のベランダからシオリが降りて来ます。
english: Yes... And about two minutes after that message, Shiori will come down from the third-floor balcony.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
根津さんはネイルガンで攻撃してください。
３本目が外れ、
シオリはあの抹茶ソフトの旗の方へ逃げます。
english: Nezu-san, please attack with the nail gun. The third shot will miss, and Shiori will run toward that matcha soft serve flag.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そこでオレが捕まえて……。
english: That's where I'll catch her...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 最後に私が消す……！！
english: And I'll erase her at the end...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うん。
……まずは竜之介さんからの連絡を待とう！
english: Yeah. …First, we wait to hear from Ryunosuke-san!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ！？
english: Eh!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: がはッ……！！

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
english: Wh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （何ィィーーーーーーー！！？）
english: (Whaaaaaat!!?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
english: ...R... Run away...!! Please...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: ここはもう……今までの２２日とは……違――
english: This is already... different from the 22nds... up until now—

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ひ……ひづるッ……！！！
english: H…Hizuru!!!

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: ……やあみなさん。お揃いで。
english: …Well hello, everyone. You're all here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……なんでや……！？
なんでッ……おまえが……ここに……！？
english: ...Why...!? Why... are you... here...!?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: ズルはいけませんねぇ……慎平くん……！！
english: You don't play fair, Shinpei-kun...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: What…!?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
あの時言うたいしょ。
「見つけた」て……。
english: I told you back then, didn't I. "Found you"...

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
おまんの右腕にある手形……
それは<color=#GF_TIPS_103>刻印</color>じゃ……。
english: The handprint on your right arm... That's a <color=#GF_TIPS_103>mark</color>...

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
これからおまんがどの世界へ行こうが、
すぐにおまんを見つけられる。
english: No matter what world you go to from now on, I can find you right away.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
わかるか？
わしはずっとおまんを追いかけて来た……。
目ェ合うたろ？　あの夏祭りの最後に……。
english: Do you understand? I've been chasing you this whole time... Our eyes met, didn't they? At the end of that summer festival...

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: わしもループできるんじゃ……。
english: I can loop too...

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
おまんらが今日コバマートに来るんは、
前回竜之介の記憶を探った時にわかっとったわ！
english: I knew you'd come to Koba Mart today when I looked into Ryunosuke's memories last time!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……そ、そんな……アホな……。
english: ...Th-That's... ridiculous...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
観測者は二人もいりません。
母か。キミか。
english: We don't need two observers. Mother. Or you.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
最後に生き残った方が見る世界が……
事実なのですッ！！！
english: The world seen by the one who survives at the end... is the fact!!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
来いやァ！！！
ぶち殺しちゃるァ！！！！
english: Bring it on!!! I'll kill ya!!!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
よしッ！
三発――
english: Alright! Three shots—

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: 無駄です。
english: It's useless.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: がッッ！！
english: Gah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （「影縫い」が……効かない！？）
english: (The "Shadow Stitch"... isn't working!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（根津さんの撃った釘は、
　ヤツの影に３本刺さった……！
　なのに……！）
english: (Nezu-san's nails pierced his shadow three times...! And yet...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（このままじゃ終わる！
　なんとかして死なないと！）
english: (It's over if this keeps up! I have to find a way to die!)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: 慎平くん、死なせませんよ。
english: I won't let you die, Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ア……カン……掴まる！
english: O... h no... he caught me!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
english: Eh... what... is this...? Eh...? Eh...!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （この声……）
english: (This voice...)

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
おや、小弓場かおりさん。
もっとも見られたくない人に
見られてしまいましたね。
english: Oh, Kaori Koyuba-san. I've been seen by the person I least wanted to be seen by.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今だ！
　潮、オレの首を――）
english: (Now! Ushio, my head—)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平！！
english: Shinpei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そう……だ……いいぞ……）
english: (That's... right... good...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ありがとう……潮……。
　オレの首……はね、て……）
english: (Thank you... Ushio... Cut off... my head...)

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
……チッ！
ループしよったか……。
english: ...Tch! He looped...

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: あと一歩で、慎平くんを捕獲できたんですがね……。
english: We were one step away from capturing Shinpei-kun...

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: まったく、余計な邪魔が入ったせいじゃ。
english: Good grief, it's because of that unnecessary interference.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: いや、何……なんなの。
english: No, what... what is going on?

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese:
彼女、こうなったらもう利用できませんよ？
どうします？
english: She can't be used anymore now that this has happened, you know? What will you do?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: 言わんでもわかるじゃろ。
english: You know without me having to say it.

speaker: Four-Armed Shadow (Shide)
japanese: やれやれ、食いしん坊ですね。
english: Good grief, you're quite the glutton.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: うるさい。
english: Shut up.

speaker: Heine
japanese: これは挨拶代わりじゃ、網代慎平……！！
english: Consider this a greeting, Shinpei Ajiro...!!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
何遍でも繰り返すがええ……。
その度にわしはおまんをたどり、
終にその力封じてくれようぞ……。
english: Repeat it as many times as you like... Each time I will track you down, and finally seal that power of yours...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（甘かった……！！　想定すべきだった！！
　敵も同じ力を持っていると！！！
　ハイネもあの夏祭りから来たんだ……！！！！）
english: (I was naive...!! I should have anticipated it!! That the enemy has the same power!!! Haine also came from that summer festival...!!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（二人を死なせてしまった！！！
　オレの甘さのせいで……！！
　小弓場さんも……巻き込んでしまった……！）
english: (I let two people die!!! Because of my naivety...!! And I dragged Kaori-san... into it too...!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ごめん！　痛かった首！？
できるだけ思っきしいったんやけどっ！！
english: Sorry! Did your neck hurt!? I swung as hard as I could!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレは平気や！
ようやってくれた！！
english: I'm fine! You did great!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ていうかおまえ、無茶すんな！！
最後にあいつのことスキャンしてたな！？
english: More importantly, don't do anything reckless!! You scanned that guy at the end, didn't you!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
自我はっ？
大丈夫か！？
english: Your ego? Are you okay!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
大丈夫！
腕一本だけにしといたから！
english: I'm fine! I only kept one arm!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
四本腕が誰の影なんか……。
あいつのＤＮＡとか、
そういうんだけでもわかればええと思たんやけどな。
english: Whose shadow the four-armed one is... I thought it'd be good if I could at least figure out his DNA or something.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
でも……空っぽやった。
あいつの体……。
english: But... it was empty. His body...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
データがない……。
どうやって動いてるんや……。
english: There's no data... How is he moving...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …I see…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
勝てると思うか？
ループする敵に……！？
english: Do you think we can win? Against an enemy that can loop...!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
多分ハイネは、
自分の力でループしてるわけとちゃう。
慎平の力を利用してついて来てるだけ。
english: Haine probably isn't looping with her own power. She's just tagging along using your power.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
だから次の「始点」も私らと同じはず。
条件はイーブンや！
勝てるよ！　私らなら！！
english: So her next "starting point" should be the same as ours. The conditions are even! We can win! If it's us!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio…!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ひゃっ！？
うっ……腕時計、手でくるまんといてよっ！
びっくりするやろ！！
english: Eek!? Ugh... don't wrap your hand around the wristwatch! You scared me!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ありがとう……。
english: Thank you...

japanese: 62.コバマート、再び！②
english: 62. Koba Mart, Again! (2)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ugh... guh...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 痛ッ……。
english: Ow...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミ……。
戻ったな……？
english:
You…
You're back…?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ここは……！！
コバマート突入前……！！
english: This is...!! Before we stormed Koba Mart...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: S-Sensei...

japanese: 「突入は中止です」
english: "The raid is canceled."

japanese: 「四本腕をおびき出しましょう」
english: "Let's lure out the four-armed one."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ダ……ダメです先生。
突入は……中止です……！！
english: N-No, Sensei. The raid is... canceled...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……詳しく聞かせろ。
english: …Tell me in detail.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
わかりました。
でも、その前にこの場を離れましょう。
english: Understood. But before that, let's leave this place.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
慎平！
どこ行くんや？
english:
Shinpei!
Where are you going?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
探しに行くんです。
急がないと……また巻き込んでしまう！
english: I'm going to look for someone. If we don't hurry... I'll get her involved again!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……あれ？
english: ...Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……いた！
　やっぱり……小弓場さんだ！）
english: (There she is! Just as I thought... it's Koyuba-san!)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、網代くん！
こんなところで奇遇……。
english: Ah, Ajiro-kun! What a coincidence meeting you here...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……えっと、後ろの人たちは？
english: ...Um, who are the people behind you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これから詳しく話す。
ごめん、黙ってついてきてほしい……！
english: I'll explain everything soon. Sorry, but I need you to follow me quietly for now...!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……う、うん！
english: ...Y-Yeah!

japanese: ハイネ
english: Haine

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: シオリの家……？
english: Shiori's house…?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese: どないした？　しおり。
english: What's wrong, Shiori?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: （ウシオが慎平の首を刎ねてループしたんや……）
english: (Ushio cut off Shinpei's head and looped...)

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: ママ今何時！？
english: Mom, what time is it!?

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese: えっと……６時ちょうどやな。
english: Let's see... it's six o'clock on the dot.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
……前は葬儀の骨拾う前から始まったのに。
始点が遅なっとるのう……？
english: ...Before, it started before we picked up the bones at the funeral. The starting point is getting delayed, isn't it...?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
店の前にも慎平らはおらん……。
やつらは逃げよったか……。
english: Shinpei and the others aren't in front of the store either... They must have run away...

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese:
コラしおり！
食事中に歩き回ったアカン！
english: Hey, Shiori! You can't walk around during dinner!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: はァーい！
english: Okaaay!

speaker: Asako Kobayakawa (Shadow アサコ)
japanese: さっきから何を言うてんの？
english: What have you been talking about since earlier?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: ママは気にせんといて！
english: Don't worry about it, Mom!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: こっちの話やから。
english: It's just my own thing.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ループの始点が遅なってるんは、
慎平くんの力が弱まってきてるからかも知れませんね。
english: The starting point of the loop getting delayed might be because Shinpei-kun's power is weakening.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
うむ。
観測可能な時間の限界が、
死ぬ度に狭まってきとるんじゃ。
english: Yes. The limit of the observable time is narrowing each time he dies.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
うふふっ！
これはええ発見じゃ……。
english: Ufufu! This is a good discovery...

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
ほならヤツの言う通り、
何遍も何遍もループさせちゃろやないか。
限界を超えるまでな。
english: Then, just like he said, let's make him loop over and over again. Until he exceeds his limit.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
慎平くんを殺して殺して殺し続ければ
やがて彼はループできなくなり、本当の死を迎えると？
english: If we keep killing Shinpei-kun over and over, eventually he won't be able to loop and will meet his true death?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
その通り。ヤツの命を削り切るぞ。
生け捕りよりもその方が簡単や……。
のう？　シデよ。
english: Exactly. We'll whittle his life down to nothing. It's easier than capturing him alive... Right? Shide.

speaker: Shide
japanese: ええ……。
english: Yes…

speaker: Shide
japanese: アサコちゃん、おかわりください。
english: Asako-chan, seconds please.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生……
四本腕をおびき出しましょう。
english: Sensei... Let's lure out the four-armed Shadow.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
何？
どういうことか話してもらおう。
english: What? Tell me what you mean.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレと同じくハイネもループしているんです……！
だからこの突入はヤツらにバレてるんです。
english: Haine is looping too, just like me...! So they already know about this raid.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小早川家にはあの四本腕――シデがいて、
オレたちは……皆殺しに遭います……！
english: The Kobayakawa house has that four-armed Shadow—Shide—waiting for us, and we'll... all be slaughtered...!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……撤退やな……。
english: ...So we retreat...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いえ。
だからこそ、ここでやりましょう！
english: No. That's exactly why we should do it here!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: どういうことだ？
english: What do you mean?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
敵の最大戦力がそこにいることを、オレたちは知っている。
普通に考えればこの場は仕切り直したほうが得策……。
相手もそう考えているなら、今が攻め時です！
english: We know their greatest fighting force is there. Normally, it would be best to regroup... If the enemy is thinking the same thing, now is the time to attack!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ウシオがハイネをハッキングすれば
シデも丸ごと消せるかもしれない。
……その可能性は高いはずです。
english: If Ushio hacks Haine, we might be able to erase Shide completely. ...The chances of that are high.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレと南雲先生、根津さんでシデをおびき出して
ウシオは最速でハイネを仕留める――
english: Nagumo-sensei, Nezu-san, and I will lure Shide out, and Ushio will take out Haine as fast as she can—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレたちはシデを倒さなくてもいい。
ウシオがハイネを消してくれるまで
時間を稼ぐことさえできればいいんです。
english: We don't even need to defeat Shide. As long as we can buy enough time for Ushio to erase Haine, that's enough.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
前のループで惨敗したオレたちが
再度挑んでくるとは、向こうも思っていないはずです。
english: They won't expect us to challenge them again after losing so badly in the previous loop.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ええね、虚を突く形や！
english: Sounds good, we'll catch them off guard!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……ふむ。
しかしハイネを消したらシデまで倒せるというのは
いささか楽観的のようにも思えるが……。
english: …Hm. But thinking that erasing Haine will also defeat Shide seems a bit optimistic...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
どちらにせよ長話をしている暇はない。
キミの見てきた未来を共有してもらえないか。
english: Either way, we don't have time for a long chat. Could you share the future you saw with us?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうですね。
潮、今すぐ実体化して――
english: Right. Ushio, materialize right n—

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 伏せろ！！！
english: Get down!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: がはっ……！？
english: Gah…!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ひづる！　大丈夫か！！！
english: Hizuru! Are you alright!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いかん……！
私より慎平くんを……！！
ゴホッ！　ゴボッ……！
english: No...! Protect Shinpei-kun over me...!! *Cough*! *Gobo*...!

speaker: Shide
japanese: いけませんねえ。
english: That's no good.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
夕食時にこそこそと井戸端会議は。
近所迷惑ではありませんか。
english: Sneaking around having a chat during dinner time. Isn't that a nuisance to the neighbors?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……あ……。
あああああああああああああああ！！！
english: A-Ah... Aaaaaaaaaaaah!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（腕が……吹っ飛ばされた！！
　潮が変身してた腕時計ごと……！）
english: (My arm... got blown off!! Along with the watch Ushio transformed into...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮……潮！！
無事か！？
english: Ushio... Ushio!! Are you safe!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
返事してくれっ！！
潮ッッ！！！！！！
english: Answer me!! Ushio!!!!!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: チィッ！！
english: Tch!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
情報の共有が出来ていませんねえ。
私にネイルガンが効かないことを伝えておかないと……。
english: You haven't shared your information well. You should have told them that nail guns don't work on me...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
どういうことじゃァッ！！！
こいつ、影と違うんかい！？
english: What's the meaning of this!!! Is this guy not a Shadow!?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ライフルでも無駄ですよ。
その程度で私は死なない。
english: Even a rifle is useless. I won't die from something like that.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
唯一私に抵抗できそうなウシオちゃんを
真っ先にやらせていただきましたので……。
詰みですね、あなたたち。
english: I made sure to take out the only one who could resist me, Ushio-chan, first... It's checkmate for you all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: N-No... way...

speaker: Shide
japanese: あとは一人ずつゆっくりやらせていただきましょう……。
english: Now, I'll take my time with the rest of you, one by one...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
おやァ？
さっきの弾はひづるちゃんにも当たってしまったようですね。
english: Oh? It seems that shot hit Hizuru-chan as well.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
english: Guh... Ah...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
潮ちゃんを守ろうとしたんですかね？
健気なことです。
english: Were you trying to protect Ushio-chan? How admirable.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
まあ、
順番なんてどうでもいいことですが。
english: Well, the order doesn't really matter anyway.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ナメくさりよってぇえええええ！！！！
english: Don't you underestimate us!!!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: があっ……！
english: Gah...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （南雲先生……根津さん……！）
english: (Nagumo-sensei... Nezu-san...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレのせいだ……！
　オレの判断ミスでみんなが……！！）
english: (It's my fault...! Because of my bad judgment, everyone...!!)

speaker: Shide
japanese: それでハイネ、慎平くんはどうします？
english: So Haine, what will you do with Shinpei-kun?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
ループの始点が遅なっとるのう。
観測可能な時間の限界が、死ぬ度に
狭まってきとるようじゃ。
english: The starting point of the loop is getting delayed. The limit of the observable time seems to be narrowing each time he dies.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
次に死んだら数十秒前ってところか。
ウシオが死んだ後の世界にな。
その絶望のまま、また殺す。
english: The next time he dies, he'll only go back a few dozen seconds. To a world where Ushio is already dead. We'll kill him again while he's still in despair.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
生け捕りより簡単じゃ。
こやつの命、限界まで削り切るぞ。
english: It's easier than taking him alive. We'll whittle his life down to the very limit.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ふふふふふ……慎平くん？
私、教えてもらいましたよ？
english: Fufufufu... Shinpei-kun? I was told about this, you know?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
毒を飲んでループした際にあなた、
こんな事を言っていたそうじゃないですか……。
english: When you drank poison to loop, apparently you said something like this...

speaker: Shide
japanese: 「初見で余裕」……って。
english: "Once is enough"...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
そうやってねぇ……
慢心した頃に足元をすくわれるんですよ。
逃げればよかったのにねえ。
english: That's right... You get the rug pulled out from under you just when you get cocky. You should have just run away.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
く……そォ……！
ちく……しょう……！
english: D-Damn it...! Damn... it...!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
まあ、終わったゲームの攻略法を教えても
仕方がありませんがね。
english: Well, there's no point in telling you the strategy for a game that's already over.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
今以上により絶望に歪んだ
表情を見るのが楽しみです。
english: I'm looking forward to seeing your expression twisted in even greater despair.

speaker: Shide
japanese: それでは……また会いましょう。
english: Well then... see you again.
60. 14 Years Ago (1)

japanese: 5月25日
english: May 25th

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……あれっ？
english: ...Huh?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平！　ここって……洋食コフネやん！
ループの始点がズレたんやとしても……。
私らこんなトコおった！？
english: Shinpei! This is... Western Restaurant Kofune! Even if the starting point of the loop shifted... Were we in a place like this!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いやっ、何かおかしいぞ。
風景にも違和感がある……！
english: No, something's wrong. The scenery feels off too...!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
ねえちょっと待ってよォ！
待ってって、お姉ちゃん！！
english: Hey, wait up! I said wait, Sis!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……！！　今のは！
まさか…………南雲先生っ！？
english: ...!! That was! Could it be... Nagumo-sensei!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
考えても始まらん！
慎平！　今の二人追っかけよ！
english: Thinking about it won't help! Shinpei! Let's chase those two!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おう……ん？
english: Yeah... hm?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……！！
　場面が変わった！？）
english: (...!! The scene changed!?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: あれ～～っ。今日は混んでるね！
english: Huh~. It's crowded today!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
おっ！
いらっしゃいひづる！　竜之介！
english: Oh! Welcome, Hizuru! Ryunosuke!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……！！
やっぱりこの二人……ひづるさんと……
双子の弟の<color=#GF_TIPS_036>竜之介</color>さん……！！
english: ...!! It really is those two... Hizuru-san and... Her twin brother, <color=#GF_TIPS_036>Ryunosuke</color>-san...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: どっ……どういうこと！？
english: Wh-What's going on!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
最初に死んだ時……
似たようなことがあった……。
english: When I died the first time... Something similar happened...

speaker: Akemi Ajiro
japanese:
いらっしゃい！
２名様？
english: Welcome! Table for two?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
あっ。なんでエプロンなんかしてるんですか？
暁見さん！
english: Ah. Why are you wearing an apron? Akemi-san!

speaker: Akemi Ajiro
japanese:
今日はちょうど洋食コフネ開店１０周年記念日やねん！
それで島のみんなが食べに来てくれててね！
english: Today happens to be Western Restaurant Kofune's 10th anniversary! So everyone on the island is coming to eat!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
そうなんですね！
おめでとうございます！
english: Is that so! Congratulations!

speaker: Akemi Ajiro
japanese:
ありがとー。
だから私も手伝ってんの！
english: Thanks~ That's why I'm helping out too!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ホンマや！　暁見さんや！！
スゴッ！！
english: You're right! It's Akemi-san!! Amazing!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: やっぱりここは過去か……。
english: So this is the past...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（コフネ開店１０周年記念の花が飾ってある。
　日付は２００４年５月２５日――
　１４年前……！！）
english: (There are flowers for Kofune's 10th anniversary. The date is May 25, 2004— 14 years ago...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
初めてオレが死んだ時、
澪が近くにいてこんなことが起きたんや！
english: The first time I died, Mio was nearby and something like this happened!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえが死んだプライベートビーチにオレもいて……。
過去の出来事を目の当たりにした……。
english: I was at the private beach where you died... And I witnessed a past event...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
それは澪の記憶か……？
じゃあここは、南雲先生の記憶……！？
english: That was Mio's memory...? Then this is... Nagumo-sensei's memory...!?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
洋食コフネ１０周年！！
おめでとうございまーーーーす！
english: Western Restaurant Kofune's 10th Anniversary!! Congratulatiooooons!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
おお透！　真砂人！
ありがとう！
english: Oh, Toru! Masahito! Thank you!

speaker: Toru Ajiro
japanese:
アラン……。
えっと……いつも、美味しいよ。
これからも……そのままの味でいてください。
english: Alain... Um... it's always delicious. Please keep... the taste exactly as it is.

speaker: Akemi Ajiro
japanese:
ちょっとあんた鏡見て来た！？
ヒゲ！
それに寝グセも！
english: Hey, did you look in a mirror!? Your beard! And your bedhead too!

speaker: Toru Ajiro
japanese: あ……ごめん……忘れた……。
english: Ah... sorry... I forgot...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
お父さんまで来たよっ！
こんな日あったんやなあ！
english: Even your dad came! So there was a day like this, huh!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん…………すごいな……動いてる……。
english: Yeah... it's amazing... they're moving...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平の両親って何の仕事してたんやっけ？
english: What kind of work did your parents do again, Shinpei?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 水中考古学者。水に潜る仕事。
english: Underwater archaeologists. A job diving in the water.

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: 透くんはどうな最近？
english: How have you been lately, Toru-kun?

speaker: Toru Ajiro
japanese: 前言ってたポイントに潜ってみようと思ってます……。
english: I'm thinking of diving at that spot I mentioned before...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ほお！
english: Oho!

speaker: Toru Ajiro
japanese:
日都ヶ島は歴史があっておもしろいですよ……。
移住して本当によかった……。
english: Hitogashima has a lot of history and is interesting... I'm really glad we moved here...

speaker: Akemi Ajiro
japanese: 食べ物も美味しいしな！
english: And the food is delicious too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （二人の声……仕草……あんなだったな……）
english: (Their voices... their gestures... they were just like that...)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
お姉ちゃん。
いい加減機嫌直してよ。
english: Sis. Cheer up already.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
フン！
おまえなんぞに話すんやなかった。
english: Hmph! I shouldn't have told you.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
だって……
お姉ちゃんに友だちができたって言うから……。
english: But... You said you made a friend...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: それのどこがおかしい？
english: What's so strange about that?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
だって……信じられやんでしょ？
中学は全校生徒２０人もおらんし……。
どこで新しく知り合うん？
english: Because... it's hard to believe, right? There aren't even 20 students in the whole middle school... Where would you meet someone new?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: タカノス山。
english: Mt. Takanosu.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （また……場面が変わった……！）
english: (The scene changed again…!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平！
ここって！
english: Shinpei! This is!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……旧菱形医院……。
english: Yeah... the old Hishigata Clinic...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
ホンマにこんなとこで会うたん？
どこの子？
島の子！？
english: You really met here? Where is she from? A kid from the island!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 多分な。
english: Probably.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 多分！？
english: Probably!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: それに……恐らく今の時代の人とちゃう。
english: And... she's probably not from our time.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
会うたらわかる、いっつもこの時間に現れる。
あっこ。あの２階から下りてくるんや。
english: You'll know when you meet her, she always appears at this time. Over there. She comes down from the second floor.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
やっぱ幽霊やろソレ！！
ここってオバケ出るって噂あるんよ！！
english: That's definitely a ghost!! There's a rumor that ghosts appear here!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 出やんねえ……。
english: She's not coming out...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
そろそろ帰らん？
暗なったら帰り道、危ないよ。
english: Shouldn't we go home soon? It'll be dangerous to go back once it gets dark.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 私は今日会うって約束した。約束は守る。
english: I promised to meet her today. I keep my promises.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
僕は先に帰るで？
こうなったらお姉ちゃん、テコでも動かんし。
english: I'm going home first, okay? Once you're like this, Sis, you won't budge an inch.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（竜之介さんが先に帰り、
　あとには先生が一人――）
english: (Ryunosuke-san went home first, leaving Sensei behind alone—)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平……あれっ！
english: Shinpei... look!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 今晩は、ハイネ。
english: Good evening, Haine.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ようおこし　万年青の白浜へ
遠い底よりくだりける
english: Welcome to the white beach of Omoto Descending from the distant depths.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
迷い勇魚が目にうつす
人の様なら　ヒルコ様
english: The lost whale reflects in your eyes If it takes human form, it is Hiruko-sama.

speaker: Heine
japanese: すまんのうひづる。
english: I'm sorry, Hizuru.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 何が？
english: For what?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ひづるの弟に会うてみたいて
わしが言うたんやのに……。
いざとなったら……。
english: Even though I'm the one who said I wanted to meet your brother... When the time came...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: したくないことをする必要はない。
english: You don't need to do anything you don't want to.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
……やはりわしはひづるだけでええ……。
ひづるは他の人と違う。
english: ...As I thought, I'm fine with just you, Hizuru... You're different from the others, Hizuru.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
違う？
私が？
english: Different? I am?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
みんなわしを見たら怖がって逃げよるが、
おまんは逃げるどころか追いかけて来たろ。
english: Everyone gets scared and runs away when they see me, but instead of running, you chased after me.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 旧病棟のおばけ、噂んなってる。
english: The ghost of the old ward, it's become a rumor.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
くすくすくすっ……。
せやからこうやって会うんは
あかんて言われとるんじゃ。
english: *Giggle*... That's why I was told it's bad for us to meet like this.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……誰に？
english: ...By who?

speaker: Heine
japanese: シデサマじゃ！
english: By Shide-sama!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: シデサマ……それは誰？
english: Shide-sama... who's that?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
うーん……ホンマはないしょやけどな、
ひづるにやったらちょっとだけ教えちゃる。
english: Hmm... it's actually a secret, but I'll tell you a little bit since it's you, Hizuru.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
シデサマは欲と二人連れじゃ！
せやさけ……腕が四本もありなさる。
english: Shide-sama is two people driven by greed! That's why... he has four arms.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: っ！

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
四本……？
シデ……四手……紙垂……。
english: Four...? Shide... four hands... paper streamers...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: <color=#GF_TIPS_011>あの四本腕</color>のことや！！
english: She's talking about <color=#GF_TIPS_011>that four-armed one</color>!!

speaker: Heine
japanese: むっ！
english: Hm!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
あ……そうそう……。
持って来たで。ほら。
ミント味の清涼菓子。
english: Ah... that's right... I brought it. Here. Mint-flavored breath mints.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
わあ！　これじゃこれじゃ！
ありがとうひづる！！
どんな味か気になっとったんじゃ！
english: Wow! This is it, this is it! Thank you, Hizuru!! I've been wondering what it tastes like!

japanese: 6月10日
english: June 10th

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: また別の日に飛んだのか？
english: Did we jump to another day?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平……なんか……あの子……。
ホンマにあのハイネ？
english: Shinpei... that kid... Is she really that Haine?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
わからん……。
でも……見届けよう……この記憶の結末を……。
english: I don't know... But let's see this through... to the end of this memory...

speaker: Heine
japanese: どうしたひづる！？
english: What's wrong, Hizuru?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 指を少し切った……。
english: I cut my finger a little…

speaker: Heine
japanese: 大丈夫か！？
english: Are you okay?!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 平気。
english: I'm fine.

speaker: Heine
japanese: 見せよ！
english: Let me see!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: どしたん？　ボーッとして？
english: What's wrong? Spacing out like that?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ハイネ？
english: Haine?

speaker: Heine
english: Mmm...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ちょっと……ハイネ？
くすぐったいよ……。
english: Hey... Haine? That tickles...

japanese: 6月18日
english: June 18th

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 今日はおやつ足らんかったかな。
english: I guess I didn't bring enough snacks today.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ひだるいんは嫌じゃ……。
嫌じゃあ…………。
english: I hate being hungry... I hate it...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
最近顔色悪いで。
私のお菓子以外に何か食べて――
english: You've been looking pale lately. Are you eating anything besides my snacks—

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……ハイネ？
english: …Haine?

speaker: Heine
japanese:
食べもんがのうなって……
飢えでぎょうさん死んだ……。
english: The food ran out... A lot of people died of starvation...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
漁に出る大人が死んで……
魚も獲れんようになった……。
english: The adults who went fishing died... And we couldn't catch fish anymore...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
夏になったらお父も……お母も……きょうだいも……。
みんな……みんな死んでもうた……。
痩せて細って死んでもうた……。
english: When summer came, my father... my mother... my siblings... Everyone... everyone died... They got so thin and died...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ひづる。
影も……。
english: Hizuru. My shadow too...

speaker: Heine
japanese: わ……わしの影も……撫でてくれ……。
english: P-Pet my shadow... too...

speaker: Heine
japanese: ええから。
english: Just do it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……こう？
english: …Like this?

speaker: Heine
english: Mmm... Fufu...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
あったかいのう……
ひづるの手ェ……。
english: Your hand... is so warm, Hizuru...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 影でわかるん？
english: You can feel it through your shadow?

speaker: Heine
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 次はもっと食べ物持って来る。
english: I'll bring more food next time.

speaker: Heine
japanese: ……ありがとう、ひづる……。
english: ...Thank you, Hizuru...

speaker: Heine
japanese: ずうっとわしと……友達でおってくれ……。
english: Please stay... my friend forever...

japanese: 7月7日
english: July 7th

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （蝉の声がする……夏になったようだな……）
english: (I hear cicadas... It seems summer is here...)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: おい。
english: Hey.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: えっ？
english: Eh?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
南方んとこの娘か……？
こんな藪で何しとる！！
english: Are you the Minakata girl...? What are you doing in these bushes!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: 歩いてます。
english: I'm walking.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
見たらわかるわ、そんなん。
危ないっちゅう話しとんねや！
この辺りはマムシが出るろ！
english: I can see that. I'm saying it's dangerous! There are pit vipers around here!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……ではなぜあなたは大丈夫なんですか？
english: ...Then why are you okay?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
大丈夫ちゃうわ！
大丈夫ちゃうさけこうやって……。
儂が駆除しとるんやろがい！！
english: I'm not okay! Because it's not okay, I'm... exterminating them like this!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
仕事の邪魔や！！
歩くんやったらちゃんと山道歩け！
english: You're getting in the way of my work!! If you're going to walk, stick to the mountain path!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
お姉ちゃんどこ行ったんやろ。
コバマートでたくさんお菓子を買ったらしいけど。
english: I wonder where Sis went. Apparently she bought a lot of snacks at Koba Mart.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: っっ！！

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
……もしかして、
タカノス山の友だちのところへ？
english: ...Maybe she went to see her friend on Mt. Takanosu?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
どうしよかな……。
行ってみよかな……。
english: What should I do... Maybe I'll go check it out...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 竜之介さん、タカノス山に行こうとしとる……！
english: Ryunosuke-san is trying to go to Mt. Takanosu...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうみたいやな……。
ここからどうするか……。
english: Looks like it... What should we do now...

japanese: 竜之介についていく
english: Follow Ryunosuke

japanese: ひづるを気にかける
english: Worry about Hizuru

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さんを追いかけよう。
english: Let's follow Ryunosuke-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
竜之介さんはハイネに殺されたて
南雲先生は言うてた。
english: Nagumo-sensei said Ryunosuke-san was killed by Haine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
この状況で、何ができるかわからんけど……
今は竜之介さんを見てへんと！
english: I don't know what we can do in this situation... But right now, we have to keep an eye on Ryunosuke-san!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: わかった、行こら！
english: Got it, let's go!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まずいな……。
南雲先生はどこにいるんだ？
english: This is bad... Where is Nagumo-sensei?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: まずいて、どういうこと？
english: Bad? What do you mean?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
竜之介さんはハイネに殺されたて
南雲先生は言うてた。
それがもし、この日のことなんやったら――
english: Nagumo-sensei said Ryunosuke-san was killed by Haine. If she meant today—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
竜之介さんが危ない。
先生を探しに行くぞ！
english: Ryunosuke-san is in danger. Let's go find Sensei!
61. 14 Years Ago (2)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……嫌な予感が……
　どんどん膨れ上がっていく……！）
english: (…This bad feeling... It's just getting stronger and stronger...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（腹をすかせたハイネ……。
　山に入った竜之介さん……。
　もし二人が出会ってしまったら！）
english: (A starving Haine... Ryunosuke-san entering the mountain... If those two were to meet!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （早く……早く知らせなくては！！）
english: (I have to... I have to warn them quickly!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平ッ、いたっ！！
english: Shinpei, there she is!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
よし……！
声が届くかわからんけど……ダメ元や！
english: Alright...! I don't know if my voice will reach her, but... it's worth a shot!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 南雲先生ッ！！！！
english: Nagumo-sensei!!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ……誰かそこにおるんか！？
english: ...Is someone there!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オ……オレの声が……聞こえた！？
english: S-She heard... my voice!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ナグモセンセイだと……？
空耳か……。
english: Nagumo-sensei...? Must be hearing things...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
あの猟師を撒くのに時間がかかってしもた……遅刻や。
ハイネに謝らんと……。
english: It took too long to shake off that hunter... I'm late. I have to apologize to Haine...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
……何？
今の光……。
english: ...What? That light just now...

speaker: Heine
japanese: フゥフゥッフゥッ……。
english: *Pant*, *pant*...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ダ……ダメだった……！
　やっぱりそうだったんだ……今日は……！）
english: (I-It's no good...! It really is... today...!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ひっ……！
り、竜之介さんが食……られてる……！！
english: Eek...! R-Ryunosuke-san is... being eaten...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
english: ...Ryunosuke.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
……なんで……？
ハイネ……キミがやったんか……？
english: ...Why...? Haine... did you do this...?

speaker: Heine
english: …Hizuru…

speaker: リュウノスケ（ハイネ）
japanese: わしじゃない……わしじゃない……。
english: It wasn't me... It wasn't me...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハイネが竜之介さんの姿に……！？
　さっきの光……スキャンしたのか！）
english: (Haine turned into Ryunosuke-san...!? That light from earlier... she scanned him!)

speaker: リュウノスケ（ハイネ）
japanese: うああああああああああああああああッ――
english: Uwaaaaaaaaaah—

speaker: Heine
japanese: あああああああああああああああああッ！！！！
english: Aaaaaaaaah!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハイネの右目が！！）
english: (Haine's right eye!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: ッッ！！！

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
english: Ah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: な、なにが起こったんだ……！？
english: Wh-What happened...!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ハイネから出た光がひづるさんの手に
入っていったように見えたけど……なんなん！？
english: It looked like the light that came out of Haine went into Hizuru-san's hand... what was that!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あの光球がハイネを内側から破壊したのか……？
　先生の体に入って大丈夫なのか……！？）
english: (Did that ball of light destroy Haine from the inside...? Is it okay that it went into Sensei's body...!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……それだけじゃない。
　右目は……？）
english: (…That's not all. What about her right eye...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（弾け飛んだ<color=#GF_TIPS_020>ハイネ</color>の右目は
　生き物のように走ってどこかに行ってしまった）
english: (The right eye that popped out of <color=#GF_TIPS_020>Haine</color> ran off somewhere like a living creature...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 今の……もしかして……。
english: That just now... could it be...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
……痛い……痛い……痛い……！
痛いィィィィッ！！
english: ...It hurts... it hurts... it hurts...! It hurrrrrts!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハイネが……どこかに消えた……！）
english: (Haine... disappeared somewhere...!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
english: Ryunosuke…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
竜之介！　竜之介！！
目ぇ……あけてよ…………竜之介ッ！！！！
english: Ryunosuke! Ryunosuke!! Open your eyes... Ryunosuke!!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
ひどい出血……脈も呼吸もない……！！
誰か……誰か呼ばんと……！！
english: He's bleeding so much... he has no pulse or breath...!! I have to... call someone...!!

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ａ)
japanese: ア。
english: Ah.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese: えッ！！？
english: Eh!!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
野良……！！
二匹もいる！
english: Strays...!! There are two of them!

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｂ)
japanese: てきゃら……。
english: Tekyara…

speaker: Stray Shadow (Shadow Ｂ)
japanese: ほれ、いっちょいな。
english: Here. Go on.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ひづるさん……危ない！
やられる！
english: Hizuru-san... watch out! They'll get you!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （影にナイフが刺さってる！）
english: (There's a knife stuck in the Shadow!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 根津さんや！
english: It's Nezu-san!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
くっ……。
何じゃこら……！？
いったい……！！？
english: Guh... What the hell is this...!? What on earth...!!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Past)
japanese:
危険や！
来るな！！
english: It's dangerous! Don't come closer!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: ぬッ！？
english: Ngh!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
english: ...M... M-Me!? N-N-No way...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
ぐッッ……！！
め、め、目がッ……！！
english: Guh...!! M-M-My eyes...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アカン！！
根津さんッ――
english: This is bad!! Nezu-san—

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese: ……お姉……ちゃん？

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
くっ、こら、どかんかい！
やられてまうぞ！
english: Ngh, hey, get out of the way! They'll get you!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese: 僕に掴まって……飛びます……。
english: Hold on to me... I'm going to jump...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: はァ……？
english: Huh…?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: なっ！？
english: Wha!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Eh!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: うお……おおおおおおおおおぉ！！
english: Uwo... oooooooh!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: That just now...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ウソ……。
ひづるさんが、根津さんを抱えて……飛んだ……！
english: No way... Hizuru-san carried Nezu-san... and jumped...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: これって……。
english: This is...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 私と同じ……影の身体能力……。
english: The same as me... A Shadow's physical ability...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
……な……何じゃ……おまえ……。
南方の娘……？　何もんじゃ……？
english: ...Wh... What are you...? The Minakata girl...? What the hell are you...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese:
こ……んな……所に……おったん……。
探したで……。
english: You were... in a place... like this... I was looking for you...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese:
……飲み物……お姉ちゃんの分も……。
買うちゃあるから……。
english: Sis, I got enough drinks fer ya too.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese: 今日は僕らの……誕生日やで……お姉ちゃん。
english: Today is our birthday, Sis.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 竜之介さんがいる……ひづるさんの中に……！
english: Ryunosuke-san is... inside Hizuru-san...!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese: おい、どこ行くんや！
english: Hey, where are you going!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese: 倒さんと……危険やから……。
english: If I don't defeat them... it's dangerous...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（根津さんの影ともう一匹の影は、
　ひづるさん……いや竜之介さんにとって
　敵ではなかった）
english: (Nezu-san's Shadow and the other Shadow were no match for Hizuru-san... No, for Ryunosuke-san.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（余計な動きはせず
　効率的に地面の影だけを狙う――）
english: (Without making any wasted movements, he efficiently targeted only the shadows on the ground—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（その動きはまるで影の特性を
　熟知しているようだ……）
english: (Those movements look as if he's completely familiar with the characteristics of Shadows...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今、地面の影を意図的に攻撃してたよな……。
english: He was intentionally attacking the shadows on the ground just now...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
たぶんやけど……ハイネがはじけて、
竜之介さんのデータがひづるさんの中に
入ったんや！
english: It's just a guess, but... when Haine burst, Ryunosuke-san's data went into Hizuru-san!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
じゃあ今……
<color=#GF_TIPS_034>先生</color>を動かしているのは……
リュウノスケさんの影……！？
english: Then right now... the one moving <color=#GF_TIPS_034>Sensei</color> is... Ryunosuke-san's Shadow...!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (過去）（リュウノスケ)
speaker_ja: 南方ひづる（過去）（リュウノスケ）
japanese:
ごめん……お姉ちゃん……。
肩……外れたかも……。
english: Sorry... Sis... My shoulder... might be dislocated...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu (14 Years Ago)
japanese:
お……おい！！
大丈夫か！　しっかりせえ！！！
おいッ！！！
english: H-Hey!! Are you okay! Hang in there!!! Hey!!!

japanese: 8月20日
english: August 20th

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （その後の顛末を、オレと潮は見届けていた……）
english: (Ushio and I watched the aftermath of what happened...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ご両親と一緒に島を去る、先生の姿……。
　朝子さんが駆けつけて、
　手紙を渡し……見送っている……）
english: (Sensei, leaving the island with her parents... Asako-san rushed over, handed her a letter... and saw her off...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……慎平！
