あそこ、見て……！
ハイネが……！
english: ...Shinpei! Look over there...! Haine is...!

speaker: Heine
japanese: 友だちやから１回だけ見逃しちゃる。
english: Since we're friends, I'll let ya go this once.

speaker: Heine
japanese: 次に会うたら……殺す。
english: The next time we meet, I'll kill ya.

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_05>５度目のＥＮＤ</color>】を入手しました。
english: Acquired Key TIPS [<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_05>5th END</color>].

japanese: 7周目
english: 7th Loop

japanese: 63.初動が肝心①
english: 63. First Steps Are Crucial (1)

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……ここでいいだろう。
少なくともコバマートからは距離がある。
安全とは断言できないが、それは島のどこであろうと同じだ。
english: …This should be fine. At least we're a good distance from Koba Mart. I can't say it's safe, but that's true anywhere on this island.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
慎平、早よ記憶を見せェ！
なんで儂らは負けたんや！？
english: Shinpei, hurry up and show us your memories! Why did we lose!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くん、あの……何の話をしてるの……？
あのお店が危険って、どういうこと……！？
english: Ajiro-kun, um... what are you talking about...? What do you mean that store is dangerous...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それは……。
english: That's...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どうする？
　ここまでついてきてもらったけど、
　どこまで説明するべきか……）
english: (What should I do? I had her follow me this far, but how much should I explain...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （本当は小弓場さんを巻き込みたくはない）
english: (I really don't want to involve Koyuba-san.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも……どうやらシデたちは、
　小弓場さんのことを知っているらしい）
english: (But... it seems Shide and the others know about Koyuba-san.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（その事を知っていながら、
　小弓場さんに何も知らせずにいる方が、
　危険かもしれない……）
english: (Knowing that, keeping Koyuba-san in the dark might be even more dangerous...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でも、だからと言って、
　どうすればいいのか……）
english: (But even so, what should I do...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どうする……？
　どうすればいい！？）
english: (What should I do...? What should I do!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、早よせな！！
english: Shinpei, hurry up!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: よっと！
english: Hup!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっ！？
人が……ど、どこから……！？
english: Eh!? A person... wh-where did she come from...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio…

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うしお？
もしかして、その髪……小舟潮さん！？
english: Ushio? Could it be... that hair... Ushio Kofune-san!?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっ、あれ、亡くなったんじゃ！？
ど、どういうこと……？
english: Eh, wait, didn't she pass away!? Wh-What is going on...?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
久しぶりやな、かおりちゃん！
知ってるで？
いまやアイドルとして大活躍やな！
english: It's been a while, Kaori-chan! I know, you know? You're doing great as an idol now!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ……ありがとうござい、ます……。
english: Th... Thank you... very much...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……アイドル？
english: An idol?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
え、知らんの？
今のかおりちゃんって、
めっちゃ有名人やで！
english: Eh, you didn't know? Kaori-chan is super famous right now!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ、そうなんか？
english: I-Is that so?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ごめん、オレあまりテレビとか
見ないから……。
english: Sorry, I don't really watch TV or anything...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、ううん、そんなことより……！
ねえ、網代くん、これどういうこと！？
夢……じゃないよね！？
english: N-No, more importantly...! Hey, Ajiro-kun, what's going on!? This isn't... a dream, right!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ああ、びっくりさせてごめん……。
english: Ah, sorry for surprising you...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、かおりちゃんにも私の記憶見せてみる？
english: Shinpei, should I try showing Kaori-chan my memories too?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: でも、小弓場さんを巻き込むわけには……。
english: But I can't just drag Koyuba-san into this...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
せやけどシデは、
かおりちゃんのこと知ってたみたいやで？
english: But it seems like Shide knew about Kaori-chan, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あの時、シデは……）
english: (At that time, Shide...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（「もっとも見られたくない人に見られた」と
　言ってた……）
english: (He said, "I've been seen by the person I least wanted to be seen by"...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （アレは一体どういうことだったんだ？）
english: (What on earth did that mean?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 何を考え込んでいるのだ、網代慎平。
english: What are you brooding over, Shinpei Ajiro.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
早く記憶を共有させておきたい。
こうしている間にもヤツらが動くぞ。
english: I want to share those memories as soon as possible. They're making their move while we're standing here.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ウシオ！
儂らにだけでも先に記憶を見せてくれ。
このままやと遅れをとってまうかもしれん。
english: Ushio! Show the memories to just us first. If we stay like this, we might fall behind.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あ……あの、網代くんっ！
english: U-Um, Ajiro-kun!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私が……その、記憶っていうのを見ればいいの？
その方がいいなら……私はそれでいいよ。
english: Should I... see those memories, or whatever? If that's better... I'm fine with it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ……。
english: Eh...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
よく分からないけど……
何か大変なことが起きてるんでしょ？
それは、みんなを見れば分かるから。
english: I don't really understand, but... something terrible is happening, right? I can tell just by looking at everyone.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも……大丈夫？
かなり辛い光景を見せることになると思うけど。
english: But... are you sure? I think you'll end up seeing some pretty painful scenes.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
た、たぶん大丈夫……。
私が少しでも力になれる可能性があるのなら、
見せて欲しい。
english: P-Probably, I'll be fine... If there's even a chance I can be of help, I want you to show me.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ほら、かおりちゃんのが分かってるやん！
english: See, Kaori-chan gets it!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうやな……。
ありがとう、小弓場さん。
潮、頼む。
english: You're right... Thank you, Koyuba-san. Ushio, do it.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
よっしゃ！　ほな私の手ェ握って！
ひづるさん、根津さんも。
english: Alright! Then grab my hand! Hizuru-san, Nezu-san too.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ああ。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: フン。
english: Hmph.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
糞ッ！！
ハイネもループしてるやとォ！？
なんちゅうこっちゃ……！！
english: Damn it!! Haine is looping too!? What a mess...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: やはり……。
english: Just as I thought...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生、どうかしました？
english: Sensei, is something wrong?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
いや、後でいい。
今は彼女の介抱を。
english: No, it can wait. For now, tend to her.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: い、今のって……うっ……！
english: Th-That just now was... ugh...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん！
english: Koyuba-san!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
だ、大丈夫……！
今見たことって、全部……本当の事なの！？
english: I-I'm fine...! Everything I just saw... was it all real!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
事実だ。
それよりもシデが気になる事を言っていたな。
english: It's the truth. More importantly, Shide said something concerning.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
「もっとも見られたくない人に見られた」って
やつですか？
english: The part about being "seen by the person I least wanted to be seen by"?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キミ、なにか心当たりは？
english: Do you have any idea what that could mean?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
いえ、なにも……。
私は商工会から事務所に依頼があって
お祭りの協力に来ただけで……。
english: No, nothing... My agency got a request from the Chamber of Commerce and I just came to help out with the festival...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: でも、そのお祭りで、あんな……ううッ！
english: But at that festival, something like that... ugh!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
発言の詳細な意図はわからないけど……
そんな状況で小弓場さんが祭りの日まで
島に留まるのは、やっぱり危険だ。
english: I don't know the exact intent behind what he said, but... It's definitely dangerous for Koyuba-san to stay on the island until the festival under these circumstances.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さんはすぐに島を出た方がいい。
english: Koyuba-san should leave the island right away.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: いや、それは逆に危険だろうな。
english: No, that would actually be more dangerous.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
english: Eh…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
この島は既に影で溢れかえっている。
本当に無関係の人間なら見逃すことだって
あるかもしれないが……。
english: This island is already overflowing with Shadows. They might overlook someone who is truly unrelated, but...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
すでに小弓場かおりは、
なんらかの形でこの事件に巻き込まれている
可能性が高い。
english: There's a high possibility that Kaori Koyuba is already involved in this incident in some way.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 網代くん……。
english: Ajiro-kun...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私なら大丈夫だよ？
こ、怖いけど……がんばるから。
english: I'll be fine, you know? I-I'm scared, but... I'll do my best.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なあ、慎平！　協力してもらおや！
ハイネをやっつけるには、
もっと仲間が必要やろ！？
english: Hey, Shinpei! Let's have her help us! We need more allies to defeat Haine, right!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも……。
これ以上小弓場さん巻き込むのは……。
english: But... Dragging Koyuba-san into this any further is...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
もう私の記憶見せてしもたんやから、
十分巻き込んでると思うけど？
english: We already showed her my memories, so I think she's involved enough, don't you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それはそうなんだけど……。
english: I guess that's true, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はぁ……わかったよ。
仲間にはなってもらうけど、あくまでも
オレたちが守ってやる立場だからね？
english: *Sigh*... alright. We'll have you join us, but remember that we're the ones protecting you, okay?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: う、うん！
english: Y-Yeah!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ただ、今見た記憶については、
影達に悟られないよう言動には注意してね。
english: However, regarding the memories you just saw, be careful with your words and actions so the Shadows don't find out.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ヤツらはまだ小弓場さんを、
オレたちの仲間だと認識していないはずだから。
english: They shouldn't have recognized Koyuba-san as one of our allies yet.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: わ、わかった……！
english: G-Got it...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平！
かおりちゃん以外にも仲間集めて、
私の記憶を見せてみやん？
english: Shinpei! Should we gather other allies besides Kaori-chan and show them my memories too?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ、敵もループしている以上、
初動で遅れは取りたくない。
english: Yes, since the enemy is also looping, we don't want to fall behind right from the start.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
集めた仲間全員に潮の記憶を追体験させ、
擬似的にループさせるのが得策だ。
english: It would be best to let all the gathered allies relive Ushio's memories and simulate a loop.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ヤツらんことや。
どうせすぐこっちの居場所を嗅ぎつけよるやろ。
迎え撃つつもりで準備せなアカンで。
english: Knowing them, they'll probably sniff out our location right away. We have to prepare to intercept them.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうですね。
それなら奴らを迎え撃つ場所は、
学校でどうでしょうか？
english: You're right. In that case, how about we intercept them at the school?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
賛成だ。
広い敷地に狭い廊下……死角も多い。
english: I agree. A wide campus with narrow hallways... and plenty of blind spots.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
相手がどれだけ戦力を動員するか分からんが、
迎え撃つには絶好の場所と言っていいだろう。
english: We don't know how much fighting force the enemy will mobilize, but it's safe to say it's a perfect place to intercept them.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
決まりやな！！
みんな、準備するで！！
english: Then it's decided!! Everyone, let's get ready!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あの、私は……。
english: Um, what about me...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キミはいったん旅館に戻った方がいい。
english: You should go back to the inn for now.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 一人は危険やないですか？
english: Isn't it dangerous for her to be alone?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……長時間、旅館に戻らない方が危険だ。
変に目をつけられてしまいかねない。
english: ...It's more dangerous if she doesn't return to the inn for a long time. It might draw unwanted attention to her.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ああ、確かに。
english: Ah, that's true.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん、
送ってあげられそうにないけど、大丈夫？
english: Koyuba-san, I don't think I can escort you back, but will you be okay?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、うん！
ここからそんなに遠くないし平気！
english: Y-Yeah! It's not that far from here, so I'll be fine!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そっか。
じゃあまたあとで連絡するよ。
english: I see. Then I'll contact you later.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん、網代くん……あまり無理しないでね？
english: Yeah. Ajiro-kun... don't push yourself too hard, okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: じゃあ、オレたちも行きましょうか。
english: Well then, shall we get going too?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: その前に話しておきたいことがある……。
english: Before that, there's something I need to talk about…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 話しておきたいこと？
english: Something you want to talk about?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……南雲先生、根津さんには
　先に学校へ移動してもらった）
english: (...I had Nagumo-sensei and Nezu-san head to the school first.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……そして、オレと潮は家に帰り
　澪に事情を話して「疑似ループ」させた……）
english: (...Then, Ushio and I went home, explained the situation to Mio, and had her "pseudo-loop"...)

japanese: 64.初動が肝心②
english: 64. First Steps Are Crucial (2)

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Eh? Wh... what was that just now...!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……すぐには信じられやんと思うけど、
ほんまのことなんや。
分かって、澪。
english: ...I know it's hard to believe right away, but it's the truth. Please understand, Mio.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平、澪ならきっと大丈夫や！
早よ他のみんなに電話して！
english: Shinpei, I'm sure Mio will be fine! Hurry and call the others!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （他に仲間にしたい人物……）
english: (Other people I want to bring in as allies...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（窓、トキちゃん、凸村さんは
　電話で学校に来て欲しいと伝えるほうがいいよな）
english: (It's probably best to call Sou, Toki-chan, and Totsumura-san and ask them to come to the school.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（共に戦ってくれる仲間を確実に集めないと！
　まずは誰に連絡する……？）
english: (I have to make sure to gather allies who will fight with us! Who should I contact first...?)

japanese: 「まずは窓に連絡しよう」
english: "First, let's call Sou"

japanese: 「トキちゃんに連絡するのが先だ」
english: "I should contact Toki-chan first."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今のトキちゃんは影に協力している状態だ。
　ハイネの裏切りを伝えるためにも、
　絶対に呼び出して潮の記憶を見せないとな）
english: (Right now, Toki-chan is cooperating with the Shadows. To tell her about Haine's betrayal, I absolutely have to call her out and show her Ushio's memories.)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……はい？
english: …Yes?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トキちゃん、慎平や。
急にごめんな、今何してた？
english: Toki-chan, it's Shinpei. Sorry for the sudden call, what were you doing just now?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
えっ……それ言わないといけません？
お風呂でしたけど……。
english: Eh... do I have to say? I was in the bath...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あっ！？　ご、ごめん！！
そんなこと聞き出すつもりやなくて……！
english: Ah!? S-Sorry!! I didn't mean to pry or anything...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （いきなり変なことを聞いてしまった……！）
english: (I ended up asking something weird right off the bat...!)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: あの、どうかしたんですか？
english: Um, did something happen?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……その、大事な話があるんや。
すぐトキちゃんに伝えなアカンことで。
english: ...Um, I have something important to talk about. Something I need to tell you right away, Toki-chan.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: はぁ、何でしょう。
english: Right, what is it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それが電話じゃ言えんくてさ、
これから小中学校の体育館に来てくれへんか？
english: I can't really say it over the phone, so could you come to the elementary and middle school gym?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
えっ、学校……？
こんな時間に？
english: Eh, the school...? At this time?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
詳しいことは言えやんのやけど、
澪も一緒に待ってるからさ。
english: I can't go into details, but Mio is waiting with me too.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: …Mio too…

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……分かりました。
いつ頃行けばいいんですか？
english: ...Understood. When should I head over?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ありがとう。
ほな、３０分後くらいに！
english: Thank you. Then, in about 30 minutes!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: はい、では。
english: Yes, see you then.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よし！
　トキちゃん呼び出し成功……！！）
english: (Alright! Successfully called out Toki-chan...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレは続けて窓と凸村さんにも連絡し、
　学校に来て欲しいと伝えた）
english: (I then contacted Sou and Totsumura-san, and told them I wanted them to come to the school.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（窓はオレが何も説明しなくても頼みを快諾してくれ、
　凸村さんとも約束を取り付けることができた）
english: (Sou readily agreed to my request without me explaining anything, and I was able to get a promise from Totsumura-san as well.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これで想定どおりの顔ぶれが揃いそうだ。
　あとは……）
english: (It looks like the group I expected will be gathered. Now all that's left is...)

speaker: Ushio
english: Mio…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……ごめん、お姉ちゃん。
english: ...I'm sorry, Sis.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: え？
english: Eh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
化物なんて言うてごめん。
お姉ちゃんは必死に戦ってたのに……。
english: I'm sorry for calling you a monster. Even though you were fighting so desperately...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あ～～～っ、夏祭りの時な！
ええねんええねん！
english: Ahhhh, during the summer festival! It's fine, it's fine!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ほら、実際化物みたいなモンやし！！
別に気にしてへ――
english: Look, I'm basically a monster anyway!! I don't really mind—

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うわああぁあん！！！
english: Uwaaaaaah!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
み、澪……
何やねん、抱きついたりして……。
english: M-Mio... What's with you, suddenly hugging me...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
もうっ、に……二度と会えやんと思てたっ！！
お゛っ……お゛姉ぢゃああああ～～～～～～～ん！！！！
english: I-I thought I'd never... see you again!! S... Siiiiiiiiis!!!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うえっ！　えぐっ！！
うっ、ううっ、ぐすっ……！
english: *Hic*! *Sob*!! Uh, uuh, *sniffle*...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: そんな泣かんでええがなっ……。
english: You don't have to cry that much...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃん……！！
私も戦う！！
english: Sis...!! I'll fight too!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんやお姉ちゃんに
守られてばっかりは嫌や！！
english: I don't want to just be protected by Shin-chan and you anymore!!

speaker: Ushio
english: Mio…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……やるで！！
あいつら倒そら！！
english: ...Let's do this!! Let's take them down!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん！！！
english: Yeah!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……よかった、澪が立ち直ってくれて）
english: (...I'm glad Mio's recovered.)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: お腹減った！！！
english: I'm hungry!!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ、私も。
english: Oh, me too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …You guys…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 分かったよ、サンドイッチでも作るか。
english: Alright, alright. I'll make some sandwiches or something.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
よっしゃァア！！
もちろんカレーサンドやろ！？
english: Alright!! Curry sandwiches, of course!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、集めたみんなと
アランの分も作るわ。
english: Yeah, I'll make enough for everyone we gathered and Alain too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （まったく、こいつらといると……心強いな！）
english: (Honestly, being with these guys... is really reassuring!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレん家……！？
english: My house…!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん、カレーサンドできた？
english: Shin-chan, are the curry sandwiches ready?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（みんなと学校で集まる前、
　サンドイッチを作ってる所だ！）
english: (It's right when I was making sandwiches, before we all gathered at the school!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（戻ってる……ループした？
　死んだ！？　オレ……？
　いつ！！？）
english: (I'm back... Did I loop? Did I die!? Me...? When!!?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
？？
どうしたん？　ボーッとして。
english: ?? What's wrong? You're spacing out.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平っ！！！
english: Shinpei!!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
わっ！？
びっくりした！！
どないしたんお姉ちゃん……？
english: Whoa!? You scared me!! What's wrong, Sis...?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 見て……記憶、澪も！！
english: Look... at my memories, Mio too!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓の外から狙撃されたのか……。
ライフルで……！！
english: I was sniped from outside the window... With a rifle...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平を撃ち抜いた弾は影やなくて
本物やった……！！
本物のライフルの弾！！
english: The bullet that shot through Shinpei wasn't a Shadow, it was real...!! A real rifle bullet!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
根津さんが隠れてたことが
ハイネにバレたんや……！！
english: Haine found out that Nezu-san was hiding...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ヤツら、根津さんを殺してライフルを……！
english: They killed Nezu-san and took his rifle...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 偵察してもらおうと距離を置いたのが間違ってた！！
english: It was a mistake to have him keep his distance for reconnaissance!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮が気配を探知できる範囲外になってしもた……
オレのミスや！！
english: He ended up outside the range where Ushio could detect his presence... It's my mistake!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
くそ！！
オレを直接狙ってくるとばかり……！
english: Damn it!! I thought they'd only target me directly...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……この感覚……！
　まるで崖が崩れていくような……）
english: (...This feeling...! It's like a cliff is crumbling away...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
まって！
ヤツらの狙いは慎ちゃんの
生け捕りのはずちゃうん？
english: Wait! Weren't they aiming to capture Shin-chan alive?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
殺してしもたらループするだけやのに
なんで……。
english: If they kill him, he'll just loop, so why...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
っ……、
ハイネもオレといっしょにループしてるから……
気付かれたんや……！！
english: Ngh... Haine is looping along with me, so... She realized it...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
言うたろ……？
ループの始点が遅くなって来てるって……。
english: I told you, didn't I...? The starting point of the loop is getting later...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 見えるんや……。
english: I can see it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
限界が近付いて来てる……
時間の端っこが…………。
english: The limit is approaching... The edge of time...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ゆっくり……でも確実に…………
崩れて来てる…………！！
english: Slowly... but surely... It's crumbling...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
このまま同じ時間に殺されたら
オレは多分――
english: If I'm killed at the same time like this, I probably—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あと１回しか
ループできない……！！
english: I can only loop one more time...!!

japanese: 65.疑似ループ、そして団結
english: 65. Pseudo-Loop, and Unity

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生、お腹空きませんか？
これ、サンドイッチ作ってきたんです。
よかったら……。
english: Sensei, aren't you hungry? I made some sandwiches. If you'd like...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……キミは変わった男だ…………
こんな時でも料理をする。
english: …You're an unusual guy... Cooking even at a time like this.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そういえば、先生はずっと手袋をしてるな。
　あの火傷のような跡を隠すためなんだろうか）
english: (Come to think of it, Sensei has been wearing gloves this whole time. I wonder if it's to hide those burn-like marks.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（１４年前の夏、タカノス山で
　ハイネの右目がぶつかった跡を……）
english: (The mark from where Haine's right eye hit her 14 years ago in the summer on Mt. Takanosu...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの日、
先生の中に竜之介さんが入ったんですね。
english: That day, Ryunosuke-san entered inside you, didn't he, Sensei.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……ああ、キミたちも見たのだったな。
私たちの過去を……。
english: ...Ah, you saw it too, didn't you. Our past...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
<color=#GF_TIPS_037>竜之介</color>が入ってきて、初めは驚いたよ。
じき慣れたがね。
english: I was surprised at first when <color=#GF_TIPS_037>Ryunosuke</color> entered me. I got used to it soon enough, though.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
竜之介さんは潮みたいに強いし、
先生のおかげで何度救われたか……。
english: Ryunosuke-san is strong like Ushio, and we've been saved so many times thanks to you, Sensei...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……私がやれるなら、なるべく私が戦いたい。
本当は竜之介をここに呼びたくないんだ。
english: ...If I can do it, I want to fight as much as possible. The truth is, I don't want to call Ryunosuke here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 弟思いなんですね、先生。
english: You really care for your brother, don't you, Sensei.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: なぜそうなる。
english: How did you come to that conclusion?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレも義妹がいるんで
なんとなくわかります。
english: I have a younger sister too, so I kind of understand.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
弟を……彼を殺した恐ろしい影と戦わせたくないと、
先生は思ってる。竜之介さんに
また怖い思いをさせないために。
english: You don't want to make your brother... fight the terrifying Shadow that killed him. To keep Ryunosuke-san from going through something scary again.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……キミ。
それはフカンし過ぎというものだ。
english: ...You. That's taking too much of a bird's-eye view.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そう……ですか？
english: Is... that so?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ただ自分のためだよ。竜之介が使うのは人の体だ。
あいつが影の運動神経で本気で戦えば
私の体など千切れ飛ぶだろう。
english: It's just for my own sake. Ryunosuke is using a human body. If he fought seriously with a Shadow's reflexes, my body would be torn to pieces.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
あの時だって、肩は外れるわ足は捻挫するわ
全身筋肉痛で四・五日はまともに動けなくなったのだ。
たまったものじゃないだろう？
english: Even back then, my shoulder was dislocated, my ankle was sprained, and I had full-body muscle pain that left me unable to move properly for four or five days. It was unbearable, you know?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（確かに……。
　普通の体じゃ耐えきれないよな……）
english: (That's true... A normal body wouldn't be able to withstand it...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生は、今夜の影の動きをどう読みますか？
english: How do you read the shadow's movements tonight, Sensei?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
そうだな……
今までの２２日の夜はミオがコフネに来たが、
おそらく今回はここに来るだろう。
english: Let's see... Up until now, Mio has come to Kofune on the night of the 22nd, but she will probably come here this time.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ミオは澪をほとんど無視している。
ミオは明らかに命令を受けて行動している。
english: Mio has mostly been ignoring the real Mio. Mio is clearly acting under orders.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
本物を殺すという影の本能よりも優先する
「上」からの命令……。
つまり、ハイネの命令だ。
english: Orders from "above" that take priority over a Shadow's instinct to kill the original... In other words, Haine's orders.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それを逆手に取るんですね。
english: You're turning that to our advantage, then.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: うむ。
english: Yes.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ミオに対する「あの作戦」……
　うまくいくだろうか？
　いや、潮ならきっとできる！）
english: ("That plan" for Mio... I wonder if it'll work out? No, I'm sure Ushio can do it!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
この腕の刻印で、ハイネには
オレの居場所もバレてるんでしょうか？
english: Does Haine know my location too because of this mark on my arm?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: それもこれから判る。
english: We'll find that out soon too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（敵もループしている……
　それにオレの場所がバレてるなら……）
english: (The enemy is looping too... And if they know my location...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なおさら初動が肝心、ですね。
english: Then the first move is even more crucial.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ああ。
初手から最大戦力で迎え撃つぞ……！
english: Yeah. We'll intercept them with maximum fighting force right from the start...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ほっほほほ本物やんっ！！
小弓場かおりちゃんやんかァ！！
本物はめっっっちゃカワエエわァ！！！
english: I-I-It's the real deal!! It's Kaori Koyuba-chan!! The real thing is suuuuuper cute!!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あは、あはは、ありがとうございます。
english: Aha, ahaha, thank you very much.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
慎平くん、なんで先に電話で言わんの！？！？
かおりちゃんに会えるんやったら
心の準備してきたのによォ！！！
english: Shinpei-kun, why didn't you tell me on the phone first!?!? If I knew I was going to meet Kaori-chan, I would've mentally prepared myself!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ちょっとやかましいで、凸村さん！！
声デカすぎ！！
english: You're being a bit loud, Totsumura-san!! Your voice is way too loud!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: せやかて潮ちゃん…………。
english: Even so, Ushio-chan...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: えええええええええ！！
english: Eeeeeeeeeehhh!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 結局、かおりちゃんも呼んだんやな。
english: So you ended up calling Kaori-chan too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
色々考えたけど、
結局これがベストやと思う。
english: I thought about a lot of things, but I think this is the best way in the end.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ただ、影に姿を見られるような行動は、
避けてもらうつもりや。
english: However, I plan to have her avoid any actions where her figure might be seen by the Shadows.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん、それでええんちゃう？
english: Yeah, that's probably for the best.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さんが一人でいる以上、
　スキャンされて記憶をコピーされる危険性が
　高まる）
english: (As long as Koyuba-san is alone, the risk of her being scanned and having her memories copied increases.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （正直、そこまでならまだ許容できる範囲だろう）
english: (Honestly, if it's just that much, it's still within an acceptable range.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もっとも悪いのは、
　オレが彼女の死を把握できないこと――）
english: (The worst thing would be if I couldn't grasp her death—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それにより、
　小弓場さんの死が確定してしまうことだ）
english: (And because of that, Koyuba-san's death becomes set in stone.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さんに限らず、この中の誰かが
　死んでしまっても、すぐにループできれば
　助けられる可能性が高い）
english: (Not just Koyuba-san, but even if anyone here dies, as long as I can loop right away, there's a high chance I can save them.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（死ぬことを前提に行動してるなんて、
　小弓場さんにはとても言えないな……）
english: (I really can't tell Koyuba-san that I'm acting on the premise of dying...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、全員に記憶見せ終わったで！
english: Shinpei, I'm done showing everyone my memories!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
凸村さん、真っ青になってたな……。
オレちょっと様子見て来るわ。
english: Totsumura-san turned completely pale... I'll go check on him for a bit.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: はは、そうしちゃり。
english: Haha, please do.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……あの、小舟さん。
english: ...Um, Kofune-san.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ん、どないしたん？
english: Hm, what's wrong?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
その……たいしたことじゃないんだけどね。
部屋に戻ってから、いろいろ考えたの。
english: Well... it's nothing major, but... After going back to my room, I thought about a lot of things.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
小舟さんは……網代くんと二人で、
あんなに大変な戦いを続けてきたんだって。
english: Kofune-san... you and Ajiro-kun, you've been continuing such a difficult battle together.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あはは、ごめんなァ。
私の記憶、キツかったやろ？
もしかしてまだ具合――
english: Ahaha, sorry about that. My memories were pretty tough, right? Are you still feeling—

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: そうじゃなくて……。
english: That's not what I meant...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: えっ？
english: Eh?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私は……
あなたにはなれないけど……。
english: I... can't be you, but...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
自分の力で、自分のできることで、
大事な人を助けるために戦おうって
決めたの。
english: I've decided to fight with my own strength, with what I can do, to save the person important to me.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
そ、それだけ言いたかったの！
深い意味とか聞かないでね……！
english: Th-That's all I wanted to say! Don't ask if there's any deep meaning behind it...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: かおりちゃん、それって……。
english: Kaori-chan, that's...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
それってめっちゃカッコエエわ！
かおりちゃんって強いんやな！
english: That's super cool! You're really strong, Kaori-chan!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
私が強い……？
そ、そうかな？
english: I'm strong...? I-Is that so?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
頼りにしてるで！
かおりちゃんが仲間になってくれて
よかったわ！
english: We're counting on you! I'm so glad you became our ally, Kaori-chan!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
潮、来てくれ。
武器について確認したい。
english: Ushio, come here. I want to check on the weapons.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: はい、今行きます！
english: Yes, I'm coming!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: カッコイイ、か………。
english: Cool, huh...

japanese: 凸村　哲
english: Tetsu Totsumura

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
マジかよ…………
マジかよ……。
english: Are you kidding me... Are you kidding me...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ムリやろ……！！
あんな化物と戦うとかっ……
み……みんなに教えて、避難させた方が……。
english: It's impossible...!! Fighting monsters like that... W-We should tell everyone and have them evacuate...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
みんな？
島民だけでも７００人やぞ……
混乱を招くだけや。
english: Everyone? There are 700 islanders alone... It'll just cause panic.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
本土から応援を……いやでも刑事さんも殺されてた……。
クソッ！！　そもそもなんて説明して
助けてもらうんや……！？
english: Call for backup from the mainland... no, but the detective was killed too... Damn it!! How are we even supposed to explain this to get help...!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ってか、オレなんであの洞窟で
殺されたんスかね？
english: By the way, why was I killed in that cave?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 知るか！！
english: How should I know!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ウシオが見た場面しか
見られへんさけな……。
english: We could only see the scenes that Ushio saw...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
しかし確かなんは、
あん時、あんたとひづるのおかげで
慎平はループできたっちゅうこっちゃ。
english: But what is certain is that thanks to you and Hizuru back then, Shinpei was able to loop.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あんたビビリ倒しちゃあるがよ、
やる時はやる男なんかもな。
english: You're scared out of your wits, but maybe you're the kind of guy who steps up when it counts.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
english: Eh!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そっ……そうか！！
オレは……やる時はやる男！！！！
english: I-I see!! I'm... a guy who steps up when it counts!!!!

japanese: 菱形　窓
english: Sou Hishigata

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: トキコ…………オレは…………。
english: Tokiko... I...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
アホちゃう……。
変な気ィ起こさんといてって……言うたのに……。
私のこと庇って死ぬとか……。
english: You idiot... I told you not to do anything stupid... Dying to protect me...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ホンマにアホ……っ……。
english: You're such an idiot...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
慎平は……
島のみんなを助けるつもりでおる。
オレやトキコのこともや。
english: Shinpei is... planning to save everyone on the island. Me and you too, Tokiko.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
あいつは、
おまえが影どもに利用されて殺されんのを見て、
今かておまえを助けようとしてる。
english: He saw you being used and killed by the Shadows, and he's still trying to save you.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
オレらは……
あいつの力になっちゃらなあかん……！！
english: We have to... be his strength...!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……トキコ。
english: ...Tokiko.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: っ！

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: Mio...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ごめんなさい、澪……潮さんの遺体を…………。
ごめんなさいっ…………。
english: I'm sorry, Mio... about Ushio-san's body... I'm so sorry...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: お姉ちゃんは許した……。
english: Sis forgave you...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
…………私は。
私は怒ってる。
めちゃくちゃ怒ってるよ。
english: ...As for me. I'm angry. I'm really, really angry.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……ごめんなさい……。
english: ...I'm sorry...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でもね。慎ちゃんの力でこうやって戻れた。
だからまだやり直せる。
english: But you know. Thanks to Shin-chan's power, we're back here like this. So we can still do it over.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私はやり直すから。
english: I'm going to do it over.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 来て、慎ちゃんが呼んでる。
english: Come on, Shin-chan is calling.

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……その後、根津さんは偵察のため
　ライフルを持って近くの山へ移動した）
english: (...After that, Nezu-san moved to the nearby mountain with his rifle for reconnaissance.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（小弓場さんはオレたちとの繋がりがわからないよう
　身を隠して作戦に備えてもらった）
english: (We had Koyuba-san hide and prepare for the operation so our connection wouldn't be known.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（彼女の一番の目的は、影に姿を見られないこと
　とも伝えてある）
english: (I also told her that her main goal is to not be seen by the Shadows.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （戦いの予感が膨らんでいく……）
english: (The premonition of battle is swelling...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（出ないな……アラン。
　いつもなら、もう帰ってる時間なのに……）
english: (He's not answering... Alain. Normally, he'd be home by now...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（戦闘が始まる前に
　無事を確認しておきたかったのにな……）
english: (I wanted to confirm his safety before the battle started, though...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （何だ、この感覚は……！？）
english: (What is this feeling...!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（目の奥が痛む……。
　あの崖は、もしかして――）
english: (The back of my eyes hurt... Could that cliff be—)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平？
english: Shinpei?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 大丈夫？
english: Are you okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
その、ちょっと緊張して……。
ホンマにやるん？
こんな、ステージの上なんかで……。
english: Um, I'm just a little nervous... Are we really doing this? Up here on a stage...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
作戦にはリーダーが必要だ。
みんなキミの話を聞きたがっている。
english: The operation needs a leader. Everyone wants to hear what you have to say.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、やっぱリーダーとか無理ですオレ……
せ、先生にまとめてもろた方がっ……。
english: But, I really can't be a leader... I-It'd be better if Sensei took charge...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
何言うてん、慎平しかおらんやろが！！
慎平の力がなかったら、
みんなこうやって集まってへんのやから！！
english: What are you talking about, it has to be you, Shinpei!! If it wasn't for your power, Shinpei, we wouldn't all be gathered here like this!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そやで、慎平！
english: That's right, Shinpei!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん。
english: Shin-chan.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……んっ。

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……じ……じゃあ……
その……えっと……。
english: ...T-Then... Um... let's see...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレは……昔から、
物事をフカンするクセがあって……。
english: I've... always had a habit of taking a bird's-eye view of things...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
こう……もう一人の自分が、
高い所から自分を見て、物を考えてる感じです。
english: Like... another version of me is looking down from a high place, thinking about things.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そしたら自分の立ち位置とか、
周りの状況とか色々見わたせて。
english: Then I can look out over my own position, and the situation around me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
全部自分が正しいっていうか、
失敗しないし、
失敗してもどっか他人事っていうか…………。
english: It's like I'm always right, I don't make mistakes, and even if I do, it feels like it's someone else's problem...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうやってなんか、
上手いこと生きてるつもりでした。
english: By doing that, I thought I was living life pretty well.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……でも。
潮が死んで、後悔しかないんです。
english: ...But. When Ushio died, I was left with nothing but regrets.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんであいつに電話の一本もしてやんなかったのか
とか、正月くらい帰って来ればよかったとか……。
english: Like why didn't I even give her a single phone call, or how I should have at least come home for New Year's...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
最後に頼まれたカレーを
ちゃんと作ってやればよかったとか……。
フカンしてたはずやのに、できてなかった……。
english: Or how I should have properly made the curry she asked for at the end... I thought I was taking a bird's-eye view, but I wasn't...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレは間違ってばかりです。
もう今さらどうしようもないことを悔むんは、
ほんま辛いです……。
english: I'm always making mistakes. Regretting things that I can't do anything about now is really painful...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これから二度と後悔しないなんてこと、
無理やろうけど……。
english: It's probably impossible to never have regrets again, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: こんな気持ちにだけはもう……なりたくない。
english: I just... never want to feel like this again.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だからオレは、
ちょっとでも後悔しそうやなって……
マズイなって思たら、それを回避する……。
english: That's why, if I feel even a little bit like I might regret something... If I think it's bad, I'll avoid it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 全力で逃げようって決めました。
english: I decided to run away with all my might.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……でもそしたら、
何かをしないって選択にはあんまならなくて。
english: ...But then, I rarely end up choosing not to do something.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
やりたないことでも、
やっぱやっといたらよかったって――
english: Even if it's something I don't want to do, I end up thinking I should have done it—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
後から思うくらいなら、
やってみよっていうか……。
english: Rather than regretting it later, I figure I might as well try it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今は……はい……そう思ってます。
つまり……えっと……。
english: Right now... yes... that's what I think. In other words... um...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
たとえ最後に失敗して……死ぬんだとしても……
命を使い切ってやったって、そう思いたいんです。
english: Even if I fail in the end... and die... I want to be able to think that I used up my life completely.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
みんな見たと思うんですけど、
生前の潮は、人知れず影と戦ってました。
しおりちゃんを助けようとして、命を落としました。
english: I think everyone saw it, but before she died, Ushio was fighting the Shadows in secret. She lost her life trying to save Shiori-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あいつのことやから……悔しかったと思います。
ほんまに……悔しかったはずです。
english: Knowing her... I think she was frustrated. She must have been... really frustrated.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレはあいつの遺志を継ぎます。
あの夏祭りの終わりを繰り返させはしません！
english: I will carry on her dying wish. I won't let the end of that summer festival repeat itself!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ここにいるみんなとならそれができると信じてます。
english: I believe we can do it with everyone here.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: ...Shinpei...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ――とは、言いません。
english: —I won't say that.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 言わんのっ！！？
english: You're not gonna say it!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
みんなの命の保証はないからです。
戦って勝てるのかどうかもわかりません。
english: Because there's no guarantee for anyone's life. I don't even know if we can fight and win.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、逃げたい人は逃げてくれとも言いません。
全部、オレが後悔しないための、オレの我儘です。
english: But I won't say that those who want to run should run either. It's all my own selfishness so that I don't have any regrets.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ここでみんなに無理強いしとけばよかったって、
後で思いたくないから、無理強いします。
english: I'm forcing you because I don't want to think later, "I should have forced everyone here."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
武器を手に取って、
オレといっしょに戦ってください！
english: Take up arms and fight with me!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ア……アホとちゃうか！！
慎平くんのために死ね言うんかよ！？
オ……オレらはおまえの駒ちゃうぞ！！
english: A-Are you an idiot!! You're telling us to die for you, Shinpei-kun!? W-We aren't your pawns!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 駒やなんて思てへんよ！
english: He doesn't think of you as pawns!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
だって……最初に一人で逃げることもできたのに、
慎平は戦い続けてるやんか！！
english: Because... even though he could have run away alone at first, Shinpei kept fighting!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
それってみんなを助けたいからやん？
みんなのこと大事に思てるからやんか！！
english: That's because he wants to save everyone, right? Because he cares about everyone!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
確かに言い方はいっつも悪いよ。
でも慎平はみんなの味方や！！
english: Sure, he always has a bad way of saying things. But Shinpei is on everyone's side!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
好きな人の味方して
何か文句あんのか！！！！
english: Do you have a problem with siding with the person you like!!!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私もっ！！
english: Me too!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: みっ……澪ちゃん！！？
english: M-Mio-chan!!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
私かて！
慎ちゃんのことっ――
english: Me too! For Shin-chan—

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……信じてる……！！
english: ...I believe in him...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
オレもや慎平ェ、オレは一生おまえの味方やからな！！
これから何がどうなってもや！
それだけは変わらんっ！！！
english: Me too, Shinpei! I'm your ally for life!! No matter what happens from now on! That won't change!!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……みなさん……ご存知なんですか？
影がどのくらいの数この島におるんかを。
現状勝ち目はありませんよ。
english: ...Does everyone... know? Just how many Shadows are on this island. As things stand, there's no chance of winning.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そやそや！
もっと言うたれ！！
english: That's right! Tell 'em!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
でも……。
どうせ一度は死んだ命……
慎平さんに預けます。
english: But... It's a life that died once anyway... I'll entrust it to Shinpei-san.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: なァ！！？
english: Wha!!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: み……みんなどうかしてるで！！！
english: E-Everyone's gone crazy!!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
逃げたいやつ逃げたらエエやんけ！
オレらと……大事な人だけでも
明日の朝イチのフェリーでよォ！
english: Those who want to run should just run! Just us... and the people important to us, on the first ferry tomorrow morning!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
フェリーは危険だぞ？　船員に影がいた。
私が到着した今朝の時点ですでにな。
english: The ferry is dangerous. There was a Shadow among the crew. Even as early as this morning when I arrived.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: もうヤツらを駆除するしか道はないのだ。
english: There's no other path left but to exterminate them.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ク……クソッ！
そんな……クソッ！！！
english: D-Damn it! That's... damn it!!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
わかったよ……！！
やったろやないかァ！！！！
チクショーーーーッ！！
english: I get it...!! I'll do it!!!! Damn iiiiit!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ありがとう、みんな……。
english: ...Thank you, everyone...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
別に慎平くんのためやないで！！
みんなのアイドルかおりちゃんを守るため！！
それから、エリカちゃんのためにオレは戦う！！！
english: It's not for you, Shinpei-kun!! It's to protect everyone's idol, Kaori-chan!! And, I'm fighting for Erika-chan!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: エリカちゃん？
english: Erika-chan?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ、ホラ、スナック都の――
english: Ah, you know, from Snack Miyako—

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_06>６度目のＥＮＤ</color>】を入手しました。
english: Acquired Key TIPS [<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_06>6th END</color>].

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ループの限界が近いやと……！？
english: The limit of the loop is approaching...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい……オレは死ぬたびに
時間の「限界」まで戻ります。
english: Yes... every time I die, I return to the "limit" of time.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
限界より前には戻れないので、
限界イコール始点と考えてください。
english: Since I can't return to before the limit, please think of the limit as the starting point.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
前回の死亡は７時５５分頃。
今回の始点は７時００分でした。
english: My previous death was around 7:55. The starting point this time was 7:00.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そこから時間が進んで……現在、７時２０分。
オレが一定の速さで「前」へ歩いてるイメージです。
english: Time progressed from there... and currently, it's 7:20. Imagine me walking "forward" at a constant speed.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そしてこの限界も「前」へ進んでいて、
今のところオレの歩みより遅いから――
english: And this limit is also moving "forward", and since it's currently slower than my pace—

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
普通に生きてれば追いつかれることは
ないですが……。
english: As long as I live normally, it won't catch up to me, but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: その速度は死ぬ度に速くなってます。
english: That speed gets faster every time I die.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: もし今慎平が死ねば、次の始点は！？
english: If Shinpei dies right now, where is the next starting point!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そやな……今の感じやとおそらく、
７時すぎごろか……。
english: Let's see... based on how it feels now, probably around a little past 7:00...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: それ……ついさっきやないか！！
english: That was... just a little while ago!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そしてまた前回と同じ時間
もしくはもっと早くに殺されてしまえば、
次はないと思う。
english: And if I'm killed again at the same time as last time, or even earlier, I don't think there will be a next time.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレが足踏みしてる間に
限界の方が「先」へ行くんや。
english: While I'm standing still, the limit will go "ahead" of me.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 戻ってもそこに足場がない……か。
english: Even if you go back, there's no foothold there... huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい……オレはあの……
真っ暗な崖の下へ落ちる。
english: Yes... I'll fall down... to the bottom of that pitch-black cliff.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オイオイ、それホンマか！？
慎平くんがそう思てるだけちゃうんか！
english: Hey, hey, is that really true!? Isn't that just what you think, Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
観測者の彼が見たのだ。
事実だろう。
english: He, the observer, saw it. It must be a fact.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: その崖は観測限界、『<color=#GF_TIPS_067>事象の地平線</color>』だ。
english: That cliff is the observation limit, the "<color=#GF_TIPS_067>Event Horizon</color>".

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: イベントホライズン……。
english: Event Horizon...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
落ちればキミの死は確定し、
後の世界はハイネが見たものが
事実として定着するだろう。
english: If you fall, your death is confirmed, and for the world after that, what Haine saw will be established as fact.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ハイネはその事に気付いて
慎平さんを殺しに来た。
english: Haine realized that and came to kill Shinpei-san.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 最悪っ！！
english: The worst!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……なぜ儂は見つかった？
english: ...Why was I found?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
以前、オレと潮が部屋で影のミオに襲われたとき、
根津さんのライフルのおかげで倒せましたよね。
あの作戦がハイネにバレてたんだと思います。
english: Before, when Ushio and I were attacked by Shadow Mio in my room, we were able to defeat her thanks to Nezu-san's rifle, right? I think Haine found out about that plan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あれを知ってるのはオレと潮、
南雲先生、根津さんの四人だけ……。
english: The only ones who know about that are me, Ushio, Nagumo-sensei, and Nezu-san... just the four of us...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
おそらく私だ……。
キミたちはスキャンされていないし、
根津には免疫がある。
english: It was probably me... You two weren't scanned, and Nezu has immunity.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
あの周の最後のシーンで、
私は致命傷を負っていた……。
english: In the final scene of that loop, I had suffered a fatal wound...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
あそこに至るまでに交戦し、
記憶を読まれたのだろう。
english: I must have engaged in combat before reaching that point, and had my memories read.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ウシオ、影どうしの情報交換はどないするんや？
おまえみたいに、自分の記憶を別のヤツに見せるんか？
english: Ushio, how do Shadows exchange information with each other? Do they show their memories to others like you do?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うん。アレはみんなすると思う。
あとは普通に話したり書いたり……
でもハイネはテレパシーも使う！
english: Yeah. I think they all do that. Otherwise, they just talk or write normally... But Haine uses telepathy too!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハイネはテレパシーで、
簡単な命令を「子供たち」に
聞かせることができるみたいですが……。
english: It seems Haine can use telepathy to give simple commands to her "children", but...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮は平気ですよ！
ハイネの命令は効かんみたいです。
english: Ushio is fine! It seems Haine's commands don't work on her.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……ハイネに接触した影は、
私たちと同じく疑似ループすると考えていいだろう。
シデは確実にループしている。
english: ...It's safe to assume that Shadows that have come into contact with Haine pseudo-loop just like we do. Shide is definitely looping.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
オイ、まてよ！
データはループを持ち越せるんやったな？
english: Hey, wait a minute! Data can be carried over through loops, right?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ヤツらに儂のライフルをコピーされとる可能性は！？
もしコピーされとったら、ここは危険やぞ！
english: Is there a possibility they copied my rifle!? If they did, it's dangerous here!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
それは大丈夫！
コピー品は、それをプリントした影から離れすぎると、
自然に消えるから。
english: That's okay! Copies naturally disappear if they get too far from the Shadow that printed them.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
いろいろ試してて気付いたん。
だいたい半径５０ｍほどの中でしか
コピー品は存在できやん！
english: I noticed it while trying various things. Copies can only exist within a radius of about 50 meters!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
つまり、長距離射程のライフルをコピーしても
たったの５０ｍしか弾が飛ばんと……。
english: In other words, even if they copy a long-range rifle, the bullets will only fly 50 meters...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
いくら弾が無限になっても、
それやったら意味ないな……。
english: No matter if the bullets become infinite, it's meaningless if that's the case...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 前回は敵が上手やったけど、収穫もありました。
english: The enemy had the upper hand last time, but we also gained something.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
この刻印でハイネは、
オレの居場所もわかるってことです。
english: With this mark, Haine also knows my location.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だから来る。ハイネはオレの死を見るために、
絶対来る……！！
english: That's why she'll come. Haine will definitely come to see my death...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今度はハッキリそう言い切れる。
今夜ここで、決着をつけます。
english: This time I can say that for sure. We'll settle this here tonight.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
作戦は？
前回と同じっちゅうわけにいかんぞ。
english: What's the plan? We can't just do the same thing as last time.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はい、オレはこう考えてます――
english: Yes, here's what I'm thinking—

japanese: 「根津さんのライフルがカギです」
english: "Nezu-san's rifle is the key."

japanese: 「火を使えないでしょうか」
english: "Can't we use fire?"

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
根津さんのライフルがカギです。
この中で一番攻撃力が高い武器はおそらくライフル。
それをコピーするんです。
english: Nezu-san's rifle is the key. The weapon with the highest attack power here is probably the rifle. We're going to copy it.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: なんやとォ！？
english: What did you say!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
射程が５０ｍになってまうよ！？
弾が無限になっても、それじゃ……！
english: The range will become 50 meters, you know!? Even if the bullets are infinite, that's...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、根津さんの遠距離射撃には
頼れなくなってしまうが……。
english: Yeah, we won't be able to rely on Nezu-san's long-range shooting anymore, but...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: それ以上の効果が得られるということか。
english: You mean we can get an effect greater than that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレの考えでは、そうです。
english: In my opinion, yes.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……ほならコピーするんはええが、
気がかりなことがあらァ。
english: ...Well, copying it is fine, but there's something I'm worried about.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ハイネにはあのシデとかいう影がくっついとるが、
あいつには「影縫い」が効かんかった。
english: Haine has that Shadow called Shide sticking to her, but "Shadow Stitching" didn't work on him.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
「シデ」の平面は他の影と違う……
いくら撃っても無意味かもしれやんぞ。
english: Shide's 2D form is different from other Shadows... It might be meaningless no matter how much we shoot him.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ヒルコ洞で南雲先生がオレを撃った時、
あいつらはマンホールを使って
それを阻止しました。
english: When Nagumo-sensei shot me in Hiruko Cave, they used a manhole to stop it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あれは盾にするためスキャンしたものだと
思われます。
english: I believe that was something they scanned to use as a shield.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
実戦の中で即座にそれを実体化できたことから
考えても苦し紛れに使ったとは考えにくい……。
english: Considering they were able to materialize it instantly in the middle of combat, it's hard to think they used it out of desperation...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
つまり、シデもしくはハイネのどちらか……
あるいは両者にはなにかしらの物理的弱点がある
ということです。
english: In other words, either Shide or Haine... or both of them, have some sort of physical weakness.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まずはシデの立体を狙い、
弱らせたところでハイネを狙います。
english: First we'll target Shide's 3D form, and once he's weakened, we'll target Haine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
一撃で致命傷は無理だとして、
相手が実体を持つ物質である以上、
ライフルならば強い衝撃は与えられるはずです。
english: Even if a fatal wound in one hit is impossible, as long as the opponent is a material with a physical body, a rifle should be able to deal a strong impact.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
立体への攻撃を続けることで、うまくいけば
シデの弱点も見付けられるかもしれません。
english: By continuing to attack the 3D form, if things go well, we might even be able to find Shide's weakness.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……シデを弱らせて……
最終的にはハイネを狙うんですか？
english: ...Weaken Shide... and ultimately target Haine?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……そうや。
english: ...That's right.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トキちゃんの言う通り、
最終的な狙いはハイネです。
english: Just as Toki-chan said, the ultimate target is Haine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
一度逃がしたとはいえ、
ハイネには影縫いが効くことが
わかっています。
english: Even though we let her escape once, we know that "Shadow Stitching" works on Haine.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
マンホールをスキャンしていたのは
ハイネの影を守るためと考えるのが自然だな。
english: It's natural to think that they scanned the manhole in order to protect Haine's shadow.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……そう思います。
シデは不確定要素もありますが、
ハイネは無敵じゃない……。そこが本命です。
english: ...I think so too. Shide has some uncertain elements, but Haine isn't invincible... That's our main target.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
でも慎平、ライフルをコピー品にする意味あんのか？
弾切れせんことより、射程のほうが……。
english: But Shinpei, is there a point in making the rifle a copy? Rather than not running out of ammo, the range is...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓、弾切れせんだけやない。
大きな利点がもう１つある――
「仕掛け」を使えるってことや。
english: Sou, it's not just about not running out of ammo. There's one more huge advantage— we can use a "trap".

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……火を使えないでしょうか。
これまでの戦いを経ての仮説ですが、
影にはおそらく火が有効です。
english: ...Could we use fire? It's a hypothesis based on our battles so far, but fire is probably effective against Shadows.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
確かに、旧病棟から地下に潜ったとき
火炎放射器が効いたな。
english: True, when we went underground from the old ward, the flamethrower worked.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
でも、全部の影に火が効くんかどうかは
よう分かってへんのとちゃうか？
english: But we don't really know for sure if fire works on all Shadows, do we?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そこは賭けになる……！
english: That part will be a gamble...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オイオイオイオイィ！！！！
ループの限界近いんやろ！？！？
賭けとる場合かよ！？！？
english: Hey, hey, hey, hey!!!! The loop's limit is close, right!?!? Is this really the time for a gamble!?!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
地下で使ったのはスプレー缶を使った簡易的なもの。
本物の火災と比べたら豆粒のような威力でしたが、
それでもあれだけの数の野良影を撃退できました。
english: What we used underground was a makeshift one using a spray can. Compared to a real fire, its power was like a speck, but it still managed to repel that many Stray Shadows.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ですから「影は炎に弱い」という仮説はそれなりに
いいセンまでいってるじゃないかと思います。
english: So I think the hypothesis that "Shadows are weak to fire" is actually pretty spot on.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
シデには「影縫い」が効きませんでした。
影平面への攻撃が効かないなら、
他の可能性を試す必要があると思うんです。
english: "Shadow Stitching" didn't work on Shide. If attacks on the Shadow's 2D plane don't work, I think we need to try other possibilities.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
哲さん、他にええアイデアあります？
責任重大ですけど。
english: Tetsu-san, do you have any better ideas? It's a huge responsibility, though.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ぐぅッ…………！
分かった分かった！！
もうどうにでもしてや！！！
english: Guh...! I get it, I get it!! Just do whatever you want!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
火を使うとして……どう使うつもりだ？
ライターと殺虫剤の火炎放射器程度で
ヤツらを倒せるとは思えん。
english: Assuming we use fire... how do you plan to use it? I don't think a makeshift flamethrower with a lighter and bug spray will be enough to take them down.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あっ……。
english: Ah...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: <color=#GF_KEY_GASOLINE>ガソリン</color>……とか……？
english: <color=#GF_KEY_GASOLINE>Gasoline</color>... maybe...?

japanese: 8周目
english: 8th Loop

japanese: 66.学校の激闘
english: 66. Intense Battle at School

japanese: 68.蜘蛛の姿
english: 68. Spider's Form

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァッハァッハァッ……！
english: *Pant* *pant* *pant*...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ngh, gah...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（目の奥が、頭が……割れるように痛いッ……
　崖から、落ちてしまいそうだ……！！）
english: (The back of my eyes, my head... it hurts like it's splitting open... I feel like I'm going to fall... off the cliff...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（手に潮の髪の毛束！！
　戻ってきたのは「ついさっき」……！？
　もう戦闘は始まっているのか！！）
english: (Ushio's lock of hair is in my hand!! Did I return to "just a moment ago"...!? Has the battle already started!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: みんな……！？
english: Everyone...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（近くには誰もいない？
　もうみんな定位置に着いてしまったんだ！
　早くこの事を伝えないと……！）
english: (There's no one nearby? Everyone has already taken their positions! I have to tell them about this quickly...!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平っ！！
english: Shinpei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
もうみんなの位置もバレてしもてる！
早よここから離れ――
english: They already know everyone's positions! Hurry and get away from here—

speaker: Shide
japanese:
やあ、慎平くん。
おかえりなさい。
english:
Hello, Shinpei-kun.
Welcome back.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: これが最期のようじゃな。
english: It seems this is the end.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: よくも――
english: How dare you--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: U-Ushi... o...!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
バッドエンドおめでとう。
慎平くん。
english:
Congratulations on the bad ending.
Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（７時４０分を過ぎた。
　オレが校庭でヤツらを待ち受けてる間……）
english: (It's past 7:40. While I'm waiting for them in the schoolyard...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレの背後、校舎の２階から、
　根津さんがライフルを構えて警戒してくれている）
english: (Behind me, from the second floor of the school building, Nezu-san has his rifle ready and is keeping watch.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そしてオレの腕には――）
english: (And on my arm--)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
慎平！
ヤツら、正面から来るぞ！
english: Shinpei! They're coming at ya head-on!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ずいぶん大勢でお出ましやな、シデ。
english: You've brought quite a crowd with you, Shide.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
キミこそ……
ずいぶんお仲間が増えたみたいですね、慎平くん。
english: You too... It seems you've gained quite a few allies, Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
みんな姿が見えやんけど……
さてはどっかに隠れてるな？
罠か？
english: I don't see anyone else around... I suppose they're hiding somewhere? Is this a trap?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
一緒にすんな。
おまえらみたいな卑怯な真似はせん。
お互い小細工はやめて、正々堂々と戦おら。
english: Don't lump us in with you. We wouldn't do something cowardly like you guys. Let's both stop the cheap tricks and fight fair and square.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
……ほお？
よほど自信があるようですね。
english: ...Oh? You sound so confident.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
望む所ですよ……。
ねえミオちゃん！
english: That's exactly what I want... Right, Mio-chan!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
はい……。
さすが慎ちゃんやわ。
english: Yes... As expected of Shin-chan.

speaker: Mio
japanese: カッコよすぎっ！
english: Too cool!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (It's time!!!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: お姉ちゃん、腕時計に変身してたんか……。
english: Sis, you were transformed into a watch...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、突っ走るでッ！！！
english: Shinpei, let's charge!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 頼む！
english: I'm counting on you!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ヤツらの狙いはオレの命だ！！
　オレが餌になって誘導する！）
english: (Their target is my life!! I'll act as bait and lure them in!)

japanese: ハイネ
english: Haine

speaker: Shide
japanese: 逃げた……。
english: He ran...

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: 何が正々堂々戦うじゃっ！！！
english: So much for fighting fair and square!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: ッ！

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
あの猟師が隠れとったか。
網代慎平……食えん男じゃ……！！
english: So that hunter was hiding. Shinpei Ajiro... what a shrewd guy...!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃんをどこに連れてくッ！
english: Where are ya taking Shin-chan?!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: まて、ミオ。
english: Wait, Mio.

speaker: Mio
japanese: うっ……ギッ！
english: Ugh... Gih!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: おまえはあの猟師にトドメを刺せ。
english: You finish off that hunter.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
はイ……わかりマした……
オカア……サン……。
english: Y-Yes... Understood... M-Mother...

speaker: Shide
japanese: さあハイネ、我々も――
english: Now Haine, let's us also—

japanese: 南方　竜之介
english: Ryunosuke Nagumo

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さんっ！！
english: Ryunosuke-san!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
慎平さん、潮さん、
ここは僕に任せて早く奥へ。
english: Shinpei-san, Ushio-san, leave this to me and hurry inside.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 頼んだでッ！！
english: We're counting on you!!

speaker: Shadows
japanese: グゲエェ゛エ！！
english: Gugeeeeh!!

speaker: Shadows
japanese: ア゛ォ゛オ゛オ゛！！
english: Awoooooh!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: さあ来い……。
english: Come at me...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（……ここでしゃべっても
　キミには聞こえないだろうが）
english:
(…Even if I talk here,
you probably can't hear me…)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （大事なことを伝え忘れていたよ、竜之介）
english: (I forgot to tell you something important, Ryunosuke.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （ありがとう……）
english: (Thank you…)

japanese: 小舟　澪
english: Mio Kofune

speaker: Mio
japanese: 猟師ヲ……殺す……！
english: Kill... the hunter...!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
来よったぞ！！！
出番や、おまえら！！
english: She's here!!! It's your turn, you two!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
来いっ……
私の……影……！！
english: Come at me... My... Shadow...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
見てろ澪っ！！
オレが倒しちゃるァッ！！！
english: Watch this, Mio!! I'll take her down!!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: ふん。
english: Hmph.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: あっ……当たらへ――
english: Ah... it won't hit—

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: アカン！　殺られ――
english: Oh no! She's gonna k—

speaker: Guildenstern
english: Oya!!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: ッガ！？
english: Gah!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
アホ……お兄ちゃん。
すぐ熱なって先走るんが悪い癖……。
english: Idiot... Big Brother. Getting heated and rushing in is a bad habit of yours...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……す……すまんトキコ……。
english: …Sorry, Tokiko…

speaker: Mio
english: Ugh... That hurts... Shadows...?
