japanese:
ウシオちゃん……
わ、私を火で殺すことなどできませんが
キ、キミは死ぬ……。
english: Ushio-chan... Y-You might not be able to kill me with fire, b-but you're going to die...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
わ、わ私思たたたんですけどね……
キミやハイネは持ってる情報を
次の周に引き継げるんでしょ？
english: I-I was th-th-thinking... You and Haine can carry over the information you have to the next loop, right?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
それはつまり、データの『破損』や……
『死』をも……持ち越してしまうってことや
ないですか？
english: Doesn't that mean... you would also carry over data 'corruption'... and even 'death'?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（う、潮を、助けないと……！！
　潮が……燃えてしまう！！！
　なのに体が……動かな……いッ……）
english: (I-I have to save Ushio...!! Ushio is... going to burn up!!! And yet my body... won't... move...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ぐ……ゲェホッ！！
ゲホ！　ゲホッ……！！
english: Gh... *cough*!! *Cough*! *Cough*...!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
慎平くんが死ぬのには数分かかりますよ。
あえて急所を外しましたかららね……。
english: It will take a few minutes for Shinpei-kun to die. I deliberately avoided his vitals, you s-see...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ウシオちゃんが今ここで！
慎平くんより先に死ぬとどうなるか、
すごく興味がわいてきますよッ！
english: I'm getting really interested to see what happens if Ushio-chan dies right here, right now! Before Shinpei-kun does!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐ……ぁ、う、うし、お……ッ……！
english: Gh... ah, U-Ushi, o...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮が、焦げて……ただの、黒い影に……）
english: (Ushio is burning... turning into just a black shadow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そん……な。
english: No... way.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そんなっっ！！！！！！
english: No way!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 後ろや。
english: Behind you!

speaker: Shide
japanese: ぐ……ふ。
english: Gh… fu.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
悪りけど、私は興味ないわ。
死ぬつもりなんかないから！！！！
english: Sorry, but I'm not interested. I have no intention of dying!!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
素早い……ですね……。
入れ替わったのに気付きませんでしたよ……。
english: You're... quick... I didn't notice you had switched places...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
私が握んでたのは……
毛の束にプリントした……人形……。
english: What I was holding was... a doll... printed on a bundle of hair...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮自身はネックレスに変身してたのか！）
english: (Ushio herself had transformed into the necklace!)

speaker: Shide
japanese:
それれにそうか！
この炎は――
english: B-Besides, I see! This fire is--

speaker: Shide
japanese: ぐッ！？
english: Gh…?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
おまえは無敵じゃない……
私が消しちゃるっ！！
english:
You're not invincible…
I'll erase you!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハッキングか……！
　いいぞ潮！）
english:
(Hacking…!
Good job, Ushio!)

speaker: Shide
english: Ru, ru, ru!!!?!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いま……人の手が見えた……！？
　あいつ、中に……誰かいる！）
english: (Just now... I saw a human hand...!? There's... someone inside him!)

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
……グヴォッ！
ア゛ァ゛ア゛ア゛ァァ！！！！
english: ...Gvoh! Ahhhhhhh!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……ハイネ！？
　あの状態でまだ動け――）
english: (...Haine!? She can still move in that condition--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（炎が……消えた！？
　一瞬で……！！）
english:
(The fire… it's gone!!!
In an instant!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
げはっ！　はっ……ぐ！
い…………息が……。
english: Geha! Hah... guh! I... I can't breathe...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハ……ハイ……ネ。
おまえが……やっ――
english: Ha... Hai...ne. You... di--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （窓が一斉に割れた！？）
english: (The windows shattered all at once!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ガラスの破片が大量に吹き込んで……！！）
english: (A massive amount of glass shards are blowing in...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うッ……ぐ！？
english: Uh... guh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハ、ハイネとシデが……！
english: H-Haine and Shide are...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (G-Gone...!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 逃げ……られた……！！
english: They... got away...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あ、あとちょっとで消せ……のに……。
english: I was so close to erasing it...

japanese: ハイネ
english: Haine

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: ゲホッ、ゲホッ……。
english: *Cough*, *cough*...

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: がぼっ……。
english: Gobo...

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: シデ……平気か……。
english: Shide… are you okay?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
はい……
捏ねれば戻りますから……。
english: Yes... If I knead it, it will return to normal...

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: ヤツらは……？
english: What about them?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
……慎平くんは私の銃弾で致命傷です。
あと数分で彼は死に、最後のループが始まるはずです。
english: ...Shinpei-kun is fatally wounded by my bullets. He should die in a few minutes, and the final loop should begin.

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: 腹が減った……。
english: I'm hungry…

speaker: Shide
english: Indeed...

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮ッ、大丈夫か！？
english: Ushio! Are you okay?!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ふふっ……私は大丈夫……！
いっぱいコピーして……疲れただけ……
そんな心配すること――
english: Fufu... I'm fine...! I just made a lot of copies... and got tired... There's no need to worry so--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも血ィ出てるやないか！！
おまえもう絶対、
痩せ我慢すんなよなっ！？
english: But you're bleeding!! Don't you dare try to act tough anymore, okay!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平……。
english: Shinpei…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
この血ィは立体にガラスが当たっただけ。
すぐ消えるし火傷もないよ！
私の髪とあいつらしか燃やしてへん。
english: This blood is just from the glass hitting my 3D body. It'll disappear soon, and I don't have any burns! I only burned my hair and them.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
それより慎平、撃たれたやろ！？
そっちの方が重傷……！！
english: More importantly, Shinpei, you were shot, weren't you!? That's a much more serious injury...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 大丈夫や……ほら、これ。
english: It's okay… look.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
防弾チョッキ……服の下に着込んでたんや。
ネットに作り方あってん。
english: A bulletproof vest... I was wearing it under my clothes. I found how to make it online.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……慎平ッ！！
english: …Shinpei!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いっ！？
いでででででェッ！
english: Ow!? Owowowowow!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だ、抱きついたらアカン、アカンて！
肩と脇には当たってんねんっ！！
english: D-Don't hug me, I said don't! I still got hit in the shoulder and side!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: よかった……！！
english: Thank goodness...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
竜之介、キミへの解説を録音しておく。
ガソリンのコピーとマッチのコピーで起こした炎は、
いわばデータであり、潮のコントロール下にあった。
english: Ryunosuke, I'll record this explanation for you. The fire caused by the copy of the gasoline and matches is, so to speak, data, and was under Ushio's control.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
何を燃やすのかを彼女が任意に設定でき、
建物や我々には無害な炎だった。
english: She could arbitrarily set what to burn, making it a harmless fire to the building and us.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
炎は影に有効だった……
シデと同化した通常の影は即死。
シデに対しても、動きを鈍らせる効果があった。
english: The fire was effective against the shadows... Normal shadows assimilated with Shide died instantly. It also had the effect of slowing Shide's movements.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
さらに潮の『ハッキング』で、
シデの体内に誰かが入っていることが
偶発的に判明……。
english: Furthermore, Ushio's 'hacking' accidentally revealed that someone was inside Shide's body...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
しかしハイネが体育館の空気をスキャン＆消去し
シデを窒息消火する……。
english: However, Haine scanned and erased the air in the gymnasium, extinguishing Shide by suffocation...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ぽっかり真空になった建物内に
外気が一気に流れ込み、その隙に逃げられる。
シデの正体をスキャンするには至らず……。
english: Outside air rushed into the suddenly vacuumed building, and they escaped in the confusion. We couldn't manage to scan Shide's true identity...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
しかし潮の証言によれば、
中身の手からは影の気配は感じられず
まちがいなく人であったという。
english: However, according to Ushio's testimony, she didn't sense any shadow presence from the hand inside, and it was definitely a human.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
シデは左手に火傷を負った。
これは正体への目印となるだろう。
english: Shide suffered a burn on the left hand. This will likely serve as a mark to identify their true identity.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: しかし空気て、そんな……。
english: The air, though? How in the world...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
気体も液体もコピーできるんよ！
ただし何らかの容器に入ってやなあかん！
そうやないとうまくスキャンできやんねん。
english: I can copy both gases and liquids! But they have to be in some kind of container! Otherwise I can't scan them properly.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
潮も缶の中のガソリンをコピーできたわけだしな。
体育館を「容器」と捉えれば可能なのだろう。
english: Ushio was also able to copy the gasoline in the can. If you consider the gymnasium as a 'container', I suppose it's possible.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: でも……敵ながらスゴイよ……。
english: But... even as an enemy, that's amazing...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
体育館なんて、こんなおっきなスケールで
スキャンする力、私にはないから……。
english: I don't have the power to scan something on such a huge scale as a gymnasium...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 悔しいっ……！！
english: It's frustrating...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: だが今夜の収穫は大きい……。
english: We did learn a lot from tonight, though.

speaker: Ushio
english: ...Yeah!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 全員生存！！
english: Everyone survived!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: これ以上のことってないよ……！！
english: That's the most important thing...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: そうだな。
english: That's right.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮、こっちに来てくれ！
予定通りにやるぞ。
english: Ushio, come here! We'll proceed as planned.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
もう１回確認するぞ潮！
ハイネとの繋がり……そのリンクを切ったら、
ホンマのホンマに安全なんやな！？
english: Let's confirm one more time, Ushio! If you cut the connection with Haine... that link, is it really, truly safe!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ロズとギルは上手くいきました。
english: It worked with Roz and Gil.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うん！
ちょっとアタマをいじって……
要は私と同じにしたらええんよ！
english: Yeah! I just have to mess with its head a bit... Basically, I just have to make it the same as me!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
今やったらこのまま簡単にトドメ刺せるけど、
ええんやな、澪？
english: If I do it now, I can easily finish it off like this, but are you sure about this, Mio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん。
やって！　お姉ちゃん。
english: Yeah. Do it, Sis.

speaker: Mio
english: Gu... gugu...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 捕らえた私の影を、仲間に……！！
english: Make my captured shadow into an ally...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（７時４０分を過ぎた。
　オレは校舎内の物陰に隠れ、息を潜めている）
english: (It's past 7:40. I'm hiding in the shadows of the school building, holding my breath.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（仲間もみんな、それぞれの位置で待機。
　潮は一人、敢えて見付かりやすい場所で
　影たちが来るのを待ち構えている）
english: (Everyone else is waiting at their respective positions. Ushio is alone, deliberately waiting in an easy-to-spot location for the shadows to come.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この作戦が成功するかどうかは
　チームワーク次第だ……。
　まずは頼むぞ、潮！）
english: (Whether this strategy succeeds or not depends on teamwork... I'm counting on you first, Ushio!)

japanese: ウシオ
english: Ushio

speaker: Ushio
japanese: この気配……来たな……！！
english: This presence... they're here...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ウシオ！
ヤツら正面から来よるぞ！
english: Ushio! They're coming from the front!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 了解っ！
english: Understood!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: えらい大勢連れて来よったなァ、シデ！！
english: You brought quite a crowd with you, Shide!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
……おや？
慎平くんに会える思たのに、
ウシオちゃん一人ですか？
english: ...Oh? I thought I'd get to see Shinpei-kun, but it's just Ushio-chan alone?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃんをどこに隠したッ！！
english: Where did you hide Shin-chan!!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
他にも仲間がおるんやろ？
さてはどっかに隠れてるな？
罠か？
english: You have other allies, don't you? I bet they're hiding somewhere, right? Is this a trap?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
罠かどうか、
自分らで確かめたらええんちゃう？
付いてきィや！！
english: Whether it's a trap or not, why don't you check for yourselves? Follow me!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: 逃げた……。
english: She ran away...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
めっちゃ罠っぽいやないですか。
ハイネ、どうします？
english: It looks incredibly like a trap. Haine, what should we do?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
鬼ごっこか。
ええわ、その挑発に乗っちゃろ。
english: Tag, is it? Fine, I'll take that bait.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 私もッ――
english: Me too--

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ちょい待ち！
ミオちゃんの相手はオレたちや！
english: Wait a sec! We're Mio-chan's opponents!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: あかん、外れてしもた～。
english: Ah man, I missed~.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
哲さん……。
そんなもん人に向けたら
危ないやないですか。
english: Tetsu-san... It's dangerous to point something like that at people, isn't it?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
包丁持っちゃあるミオちゃんが
言う台詞かいな！？
english: Is that really something Mio-chan holding a kitchen knife should be saying!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
澪の影……
あんたの相手は私らや。
english: Mio's shadow... We're your opponents.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そういうこっちゃ。
堪忍してや？
これも正義の味方のお仕事じょ！
english: That's how it is. Forgive me, okay? This is also the job of a hero of justice!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 出ておいで、ロズ、ギル！！
english: Come out, Roz, Gil!!

japanese: ウシオ
english: Ushio

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（トキちゃんたち、
　上手いことミオを止めてくれた！）
english: (Toki-chan and the others successfully stopped Mio!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（シデとハイネの気配は……
　うん、ちゃんと私に付いてきてる）
english: (Shide and Haine's presence... Yeah, they're following me properly.)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（あの場所まで誘導しやなアカンけど、
　できるだけ距離はキープしとかな）
english: (I have to lead them to that place, but I need to keep my distance as much as possible.)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（もし私が捕まってしもたら、
　「仕掛け」が使えやんくなってまう）
english: (If I get caught, the 'trap' will become unusable.)

speaker: Shadow A
japanese: ヴァア゛ア゛！！
english: Vaaaa!!

speaker: Shadow B
japanese: グォ゛オ゛！！
english: Gwooo!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（敵の影が予想以上に多いな……。
　でも大丈夫や、この先には……！）
english: (There are more enemy shadows than expected... But it's okay, up ahead is...!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 潮さん、ここは任せてください。
english: Ushio-san, please leave this to me.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: お願いしますッ！！
english: Please!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: さあ、何匹でもかかって来い！！
english: Come on, bring as many as you want!!

speaker: Shadow A
japanese: ア゛オォオ゛！！
english: Aghh!!!

speaker: Shadow B
japanese: ギィイ゛イ゛！！
english: Geeeee!!!

japanese: 小弓場　かおり
english: Kaori Koyuba

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ふぅ、ふぅっ……！
english: Phew… phew…!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: （……次はここの感知器を、発煙筒で……！）
english: (...Next, I'll use the smoke flare on this sensor...!)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（防火シャッターを閉めて、敵の退路を断つ！
　あの廊下まで確実に誘導しなきゃ！）
english: (Close the fire shutter and cut off the enemy's escape route! We have to reliably guide them to that hallway!)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
（網代くん、みんな……どうか無事で……
　影を倒して……！！）
english:
(Ajiro-kun, everyone… please be safe…  
Defeat those shadows!!)

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そろそろだ……。
　潮が角を曲がって来る！）
english:
(It's about time…  
Ushio is rounding the corner!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (—She's here!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
シデとハイネつれてきたで。
もうすぐ姿見せるはずや。
english: I brought Shide and Haine. They should show themselves soon.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
わかった。
じゃあ潮は影に潜って待機だ。
english: Got it. Then Ushio, hide in the shadows and wait.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: わかった！
english: Got it!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレが合図したら、すぐ屋外に移動だ。
english: When I give the signal, move outside immediately.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
了解！
慎平も早よ隠れな！
english:
Understood!  
Hurry and hide too, Shinpei!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮を追ってきたあいつらは、
　あの角を曲がって来るはず）
english: (Those chasing Ushio will come around this corner)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（その先の廊下は
　オレたちが包囲している）
english: (The hallway ahead is surrounded by us)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （隠れて待機しているのは――）
english: (The ones hiding and waiting are--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレ、根津さん、窓、澪。
　このメンバーでコピーしたライフルを
　武器にして戦う）
english: (Me, Nezu-san, Sou, and Mio. We'll fight using the copied rifle as our weapon.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ただしライフルのデータを『同時』に
　複数丁プリントすることはできない）
english: (However, we cannot print multiple copies of the rifle data 'simultaneously'.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だけど『一丁ずつ交互』なら、
　プリントできるんだ）
english: (But if we do it 'one by one, taking turns', we can print it.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレたち狙撃チームは、
　ライフルを実体化するために各々が潮の髪束を
　手にしている）
english: (Each member of our sniper team is holding a bundle of Ushio's hair in order to materialize the rifle.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（一人が狙撃したら潮がそのライフルを消去し、
　すかさず別の場所にいる仲間が持つ髪の毛束に
　プリントすれば……）
english: (When one person snipes, Ushio erases that rifle, and immediately prints it on the bundle of hair held by an ally in another location...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ライフルが増えたかのような
　連続攻撃が可能になる！）
english: (This makes continuous attacks possible, as if the number of rifles had multiplied!)

speaker: Shide
japanese: そこにおるんか、ウシオちゃん……！
english: Are you there, Ushio-chan...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮、まだだぞ……）
english: (Ushio, not yet...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（な、なんだ、あれ！？
　まるで巨大な蜘蛛だ！！）
english: (Wh-What is that!? It looks like a giant spider!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、怯むな！！
　みんな……作戦通りにいくぞ！！）
english: (No, don't flinch!! Everyone... we're going according to plan!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮はここで一旦離脱）
english: (Ushio will disengage here for now.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（みんなを見渡せる屋外に移動して、
　『仕掛け』を発動させる準備をする）
english: (She'll move outside where she can overlook everyone, and prepare to activate the 'trap'.)

speaker: Shide
japanese: ウシオちゃんが、いなくなった？
english: Ushio-chan... disappeared?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: 潜って……外に出たんか。
english: She dove in... and went outside, huh.

speaker: Shide
japanese: なにを企んでるんですかねェ？
english: What could she be plotting?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
さあのォ。
どうせサルの浅知恵じゃろ。
english: Who knows. It's probably just some monkey's shallow trick anyway.

speaker: Shide
japanese: ふむ……一旦、相手の出方を見ましょか。
english: Hm... Let's see what their next move is for now.

speaker: Shide
japanese: 私の影に銃弾？
english: A bullet in my shadow?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
猟師や！！
窓の外……二階から！！
english: The hunter!! Outside the window... from the second floor!!

japanese: 根津　銀次郎
english: Ginjiro Nezu

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: チッ！
english: Tch!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
（やはり平面には効かんか！
　ほなら立体をブチ抜いちゃらァ！！）
english: (So it doesn't work on flat surfaces after all! Then I'll just blast through the 3D body!!)

speaker: Shide
japanese: ぐッ！
english: Guhh!

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: シデ！
english: Shide!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: （手応えアリや……！）
english: (That hit the mark...!)

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（次は窓か……！
　しくじるなよ、窓！）
english: (Next is Sou...! Don't mess this up, Sou!)

japanese: 菱形　窓
english: Sou Hishigata

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
（よっしゃ！！
　潮、オレにライフルを！！）
english: (Alright!! Ushio, give me the rifle!!)

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ご老体……せっかくのライフルやのに、
位置取り近すぎるんちゃいますか？
english: Old man... even though you have a nice rifle, isn't your positioning a bit too close?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: （させるかよッ！！）
english: (Like I'd let you!!)

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
後ろから！？
またライフルやと！？
english: From behind!? Another rifle!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: （よっしゃ、命中や！）
english: (Alright, a direct hit!)

japanese: ウシオ
english: Ushio

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ナイス、窓！
次は澪……落ち着くんやで！
english: Nice, Sou! Next is Mio... stay calm!

japanese: 小舟　澪
english: Mio Kofune

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: （き、きたっ！！）
english: (H-Here it comes!!)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: （私は命中させやんでもいい……）
english: (I don't need to land a hit...)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
（シデの意識をこっちに向けさせるんが、
　目的なんやから！）
english: (Because drawing Shide's attention over here is my goal!)

speaker: Shide
japanese: なるほど、そういう仕掛けですか……。
english: I see, so that's the trick...

japanese: 根津　銀次郎
english: Ginjiro Nezu

speaker: Shide
japanese: ……ぬっ！
english: ...Nuh!

speaker: Heine
japanese: 大丈夫か、シデ。
english: Are you okay, Shide?

speaker: Heine
japanese: おのれ、目障りなハエども！！！
english: Damn you, you eyesore flies!!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
（……次は慎平のはずやったが、
　今のシデの位置では当たらん）
english: (...Next was supposed to be Shinpei, but from Shide's current position, he won't hit.)

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: （危険やが、もっかい頼むで、窓）
english: (It's dangerous, but I'm counting on you once more, Sou.)

speaker: Shide
japanese: 次はどこから――
english: Where is the next one coming from--

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese:
もうええ。
こんなもんに付き合う必要はない。
一人ずつ確実に始末してこ。
english: That's enough. There's no need to play along with this. Let's reliably eliminate them one by one.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
そうですか。
じゃあ、まずはご老体から……。
english: Is that so. Then, let's start with the old man...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: よそ見してんなオラアァア！！！
english: Don't look away, you bastard!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: ううっ！！
english: Ughh!!!

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （次は遂にオレの番か……）
english: (Next is finally my turn...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（急ごしらえのチーム、
　初めて使うライフル……
　上手くいくかは賭けだったけど）
english: (A hastily assembled team, using a rifle for the first time... It was a gamble whether it would go well, but)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（せっかくみんなが、
　ここまで繋げてくれたんだ！
　失敗なんてできやしない！）
english: (Everyone worked so hard to connect it to this point! There's no way I can fail!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（必ずオレが決めてやる！
　この想いを未来に繋げるんだ！！！）
english: (I'll definitely land this shot! I'll connect these feelings to the future!!!)

speaker: Shide
japanese: ハイネ、後ろに隠れてください……。
english: Haine, hide behind me…

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: うむ……！
english: Yes…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレの位置はまだバレていない。
　ここからならハイネの『本体』を狙える！）
english: (My position hasn't been discovered yet. From here, I can aim for Haine's 'main body'!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（狙うはハイネの影……！
　チャンスは一瞬しかない！）
english: (My target is Haine's shadow...! There's only a split-second chance!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （一発で沈める！！）
english: (I'll take her down in one shot!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （最高のタイミングを狙ってやる……！）
english: (I'll aim for the absolute best timing...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なっ！！？
english: Wha!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （蜘蛛の腕がハイネを守った――）
english: (The spider's arm protected Haine--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ごふッ！？！？
english: Gofu!?!?

speaker: Shiori (Heine)
japanese: 大当たりじゃ！
english: Bullseye!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（な、何が起きた！？
　蜘蛛の腕が一瞬でここまで……）
english: (Wh-What happened!? The spider's arm reached here in an instant...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平ェェェェエッ！！！
english: Shinpeeeeeeii!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （やられて……もた……）
english: (They... got me...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレの……ミス、や………）
english: (It was... my... mistake...)

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_SPIDER>蜘蛛の姿</color>】を入手しました。
english: Acquired Key TIP: [<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_SPIDER>Spider Form</color>].

japanese: 67.ミオへの尋問
english: 67. Interrogation of Mio

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮のハッキングは成功し、
　影のミオは無抵抗になった）
english: (Ushio's hacking was successful, and the shadow Mio became defenseless.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレたちは学校の保健室に場所を移し、
　さっそく尋問を開始した……）
english: (We moved to the school infirmary, and immediately began our interrogation...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: キミの名前は？
english: What's your name?

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……コフネ……ミオ……。
english: …Kofune… Mio…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: キミはいつ……誰から産まれた？
english: When were you born... and from whom?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
昨日……お通夜で……
オカアサンが澪をスキャンして……
その夜更けに……洞窟の中で私が産まれた……。
english: Yesterday... at the wake... Mother scanned Mio... and late that night... I was born in the cave...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オカアサンっていうのは……
しおりちゃんの姿をしたハイネの事やな？
english: By 'Mother'... you mean Haine in Shiori-chan's form, right?

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……うん。
english: ...Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: キミは、澪の自転車のブレーキを壊した？
english: Did ya cut the brakes on Mio's bike?

speaker: Mio
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 私を殺すために！？
english: To kill me?!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
死なんでも別に……怪我でもして
病院に行ってくれたら、やりやすいと思た……。
english: She didn't have to die... I just thought it would be easier if she got hurt and went to the hospital...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
病院の中で澪を殺して
すり替わりやすいってことか！？
english: You mean it'd be easier to kill Mio in the hospital and swap places with her!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
そうよ。
菱形先生は影の味方やから。
english: Yes, since Dr. Hishigata is an ally of the shadows.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それはハイネの命令？
english: Was that Haine's order?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
違う、私がそうしたかっただけ……
でも失敗。
english: No, I just wanted to do it... But I failed.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 澪の影を作るなんて……私は聞いてなかったで。
english: Creating a Shadow of Mio... I hadn't heard about that.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
安心してトキコ。
今となったらなんで殺したかったんか……
ようわからん……。
english: Don't worry, Tokiko. Now that I think about it, I don't even know... why I wanted to kill her...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ハイネは潮さんの影を探すために
あんたを産んだんやな？
english: Haine gave birth to you in order to find Ushio-san's shadow, right?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
うん……。
オカアサンに刃向かった裏切り者で、
邪魔になるかもって……。
english: Yeah... She was a traitor who opposed Mother, and she thought she might get in the way...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
でも今日は、葬儀中にお父さんの影が殺されて、
オカアサンは南方ひづるの仕業やって……。
english: But today, during the funeral, Dad's shadow was killed, and Mother said it was Hizuru Minakata's doing...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
しかも慎ちゃんたちもグルやって……
だからみんなを標的に。
english: And that Shin-chan and the others were in on it... So we made everyone a target.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
標的っておまえっ……一体何なんや！
影って何や！？
おまえらの目的を教えろ！！
english: Target... What the hell are you guys!? What are shadows!? Tell me your purpose!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: 人って何ですか？
english: What are humans?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: あァ！！？
english: Hah!!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
目的って？
人は何が目的なんですか？
english: Purpose? What is the purpose of humans?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
そっ……そんなんみんな……
た……ただ何となく……生きとんねや！！
english: Th-That's just... everyone... t-they're just living... without any real reason!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
私には２１日までの澪の記憶と、
私が影としてできることの知識しかないです。
english: I only have Mio's memories up until the 21st, and knowledge of what I can do as a shadow.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私は人のコピーができやん！
あんたはできるんか？
english: I can't copy people! Can you?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
コピーには２種類あって、
自分の体に写す「変身」と、
体を分裂させて新しい影を産む「分娩」。
english: There are two types of copying: 'Transformation', where we copy onto our own bodies, and 'Childbirth', where we split our bodies to give birth to a new shadow.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
私らコドモは人の影を
１回きりだけ「分娩」できる。
english: We children can 'give birth' to a person's shadow only once.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: コドモ「は」？
english: Children'?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ハイネなら何回でも産める……。
でも体が弱ってて……ハイネでも簡単じゃない。
english: Haine can give birth as many times as she wants... But her body is weak... so it's not easy even for her.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
私から産まれるマゴの代には分娩能力がない。
「変身」は影なら皆何回でもできる。
english: The grandchildren generation born from me won't have the ability to give birth. 'Transformation' is something all shadows can do as many times as they want.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ただし分娩でも変身でも、人をコピーするなら
１週間以内に本物を消さんと、体が<color=#GF_TIPS_081>泥</color>になって消える。
english: However, whether it's childbirth or transformation, if you copy a person, you have to erase the original within a week, or your body will turn to <color=#GF_TIPS_081>mud</color> and disappear.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
私もあと六日間の命……
でも今は、「だから？」って感じ。
english: I only have six days left to live... But right now, I just feel like, 'So what?'

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ミオはオレたちの質問に正直に答えている。
　やはりハッキングはうまくいってるようだ。
　そろそろいいか……）
english: (Mio is answering our questions honestly. It seems the hacking really was successful. It should be about time...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 小弓場さん、もう隠れなくていいよ。
english: Koyuba-san, you don't have to hide anymore.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あなたは、私のことを知ってる？
english: Do you know who I am?

speaker: Mio
english: …Who?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
『小弓場かおり』という名前を
聞いたことはないか？
english: Have you ever heard the name 'Kaori Koyuba'?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 小弓場かおり……どこかで……。
english: Kaori Koyuba... somewhere...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ああ。
アイドルの小弓場かおりちゃん？
なんでここに……？
english: Ah. The idol Kaori Koyuba-chan? Why is she here...?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっと……。
網代くん、言っちゃってもいいのかな？
english: Um... Ajiro-kun, is it okay if I say it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
その前に、ハイネたちの「標的」に
彼女は含まれていないんだな？
english: Before that, she's not included in Haine's 'targets', right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今夜学校に来る前にも、
情報共有はされなかった？
english: Even before coming to the school tonight, no information was shared?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
聞いてない。
日都ヶ島に来てることすら初めて知った。
english: I haven't heard anything. I just found out for the first time that she's even on Hitogashima.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうか。
english: I see.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: よかった……。
english: Thank goodness…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これで、ハイネたちに
　小弓場さんが仲間だと知られていないことも
　確認できた）
english: (With this, I've confirmed that Haine and the others don't know Koyuba-san is our ally.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（聞いておきたいことがいろいろある。
　順番に確認していこう……）
english: (There are various things I want to ask. Let's confirm them in order...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （何を聞こうか…）
english: (What should I ask...)

japanese: 「影についてもっと教えてくれ」
english: "Tell me more about Shadows"

japanese: 「食事はどうしてるんだ？」
english: "What do you do for meals?"

japanese: 「影の個体数は？」
english: "What's the Shadow population?"

japanese: 「おまえと澪は雰囲気が違うが？」
english: "You and Mio have a different vibe, though?"

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 影について、もっと教えてくれ。
english: Tell me more about Shadows.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ハイネが産んだコドモたち。
人の姿をコピーしたドッペルゲンガー……。
家族を乗っ取って、人のふりして暮らしてる。
english: The children Haine gave birth to. Doppelgängers that copied human forms... They take over families and live pretending to be human.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
影たちにも子孫を残し繁栄したい本能があるのか、
あるいは形だけの人の模倣か？
english: Do shadows also have an instinct to leave descendants and prosper, or is it just a superficial imitation of humans?

speaker: Mio
japanese: わからへん……。
english: I don't know…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 食事はどうしてるんだ？
english: What do you do for meals?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
一日に三食きちんと食べるのか。
食べないと餓死する？
english: Do you eat three meals a day properly? Will you starve to death if you don't eat?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
影は情報を食べて生きてる。
味も含め「情報」が栄養やから。
english: Shadows live by eating information. Because 'information', including taste, is our nutrition.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
オカアサン……ハイネには、
分娩、変身以外で人を食べるのを
みんな禁じられる。
english: Mother... Haine forbids everyone from eating humans outside of childbirth and transformation.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
でも言われるまでもなく、
私はお好み焼きが食べたいかな。
english: But even without being told, I kind of want to eat okonomiyaki.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
だってその方が美味しいし、
卵や豚肉にも、キャベツにも情報はあるから。
english: Because that tastes better, and there's information in eggs, pork, and cabbage too.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 食べないと、もちろん人と同じく餓死するよ。
english: If we don't eat, of course we'll starve to death just like humans.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……ハイネは人しか口にしません。
おそらく味が好みなんやと思います。
english: ...Haine only eats humans. I think it's probably because she prefers the taste.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
しかしそれだと餓死するので輸血を……
人の血には、情報が豊富に含まれてますから。
english: But she would starve to death like that, so we give her blood transfusions... Human blood contains an abundance of information.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
情報を食べる……
影の体って、何でできてるんや？
english: Eating information... What are shadow bodies made of?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
体？　何なんやろ……
ハイネは、泥って呼んでる。
それくらいしか……。
english: Body? What is it, I wonder... Haine calls it mud. That's about all I know...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 影の個体数は？
english: What's the shadow population?

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……分からん……。
english: …I don't know.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ハイネは、衰弱が進んだここ数十年ほどは
分娩を行っていなかったそうです。
english: It seems Haine hasn't given birth for the past few decades as her weakening progressed.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 無理を押して産んだのは、復活の儀式の為だけ。
english: She only pushed herself to give birth for the sake of the resurrection ritual.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
今現在、人に化けて潜んでいる影は、
２か月以内に産まれた数体のコドモと、
コドモたちが産んだマゴたちのはずです。
english: Currently, the shadows hiding in human form should be a few children born within the last two months, and the grandchildren born from those children.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 影の数は不明か……。
english: So the number of shadows is unknown...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
今日の葬儀会場でも数組の影を確認済みだ。
小早川家の他にも、私の知った顔があった。
english: I already confirmed several sets of shadows at today's funeral venue. Besides the Kobayakawa family, there were faces I recognized.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
子垣内家、人渕家だ。
あとは要調査だな。
english: The Kogaito family and the Hitobuchi family. The rest require investigation.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 野良の数も不明？
english: Is the number of Strays also unknown?

speaker: Mio
japanese: ごめん、見当もつかん。
english: Sorry, I have no idea.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 多分ハイネも把握しきれてないと思います。
english: I think probably even Haine hasn't fully grasped it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ミオ、おまえの性格っていうか……
雰囲気が、本物と違う気がするんやけど。
english: ...Mio, your personality, or rather... Your vibe feels different from the real one.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
影は人の完璧なコピーで、
私の肉体、声、指紋、ＤＮＡ、記憶、
全部澪と同じやけど……。
english: Shadows are perfect copies of people. My body, voice, fingerprints, DNA, memories, they're all exactly the same as Mio's, but...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
記憶に関してだけは……
ほら、人って忘れるやん？
english: Only when it comes to memories... You know how people forget things?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 記憶の取捨選択か。
english: Selective memory?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
はい。影には、嫌な記憶とか、
どうでもいい他愛のない記憶を「忘れる」機能が
ないんです。
english: Yes. Shadows don't have the function to 'forget' unpleasant memories or trivial, silly memories.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
だから、私は全ての出来事を均等に記憶してます。
本人が忘れていることや、押し込めた思いも、
コピーの時に写し取ってる。
english: So, I remember all events equally. Even things the person themselves forgot, or repressed feelings, I copy them over during the copying process.

speaker: Mio
japanese: その差が、人格の違いを生んでるんやと思う。
english: I think that difference is what creates the difference in personality.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 押し込めた思い……。
english: Repressed feelings…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
でっ、でもお姉ちゃんは！？
お姉ちゃんはお姉ちゃんのまんまやで！
english: B-But what about Sis!? Sis is exactly the same as Sis!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
お姉ちゃんは、記憶力が人間レベルっていうか……
……不良品やからとちゃう？
english: Sis's memory is at a human level, or rather... ...Isn't it because she's a defective product?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 言い方よ。
english: Watch how you say that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……まぁ……潮が特殊だってことか。
english: ...Well... I guess it means Ushio is special.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……聞けば聞くほど謎が深まっていくな。
　だが、ここは少しでも多く情報を得ておきたい）
english: (...The more I ask, the deeper the mystery gets. But I want to get as much information as possible right now.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （他に尋ねるべきことは――）
english: (Other things I should ask are--)

japanese: 「影の生態は？」
english: "What is the ecology of shadows?"

japanese: 「影の情報共有手段は？」
english: "What are the shadows' means of sharing information?"

japanese: 「影には何種類かいるよな？」
english: "There are a few different types of shadows, right?"

japanese: 「コピーした物のデータについて」
english: "About the data of copied objects"

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影の生態って、どうなってるんや？
人に化けて生活してても、
何年もそのままの姿でいることはできへんよな？
english: What is the ecology of shadows like? Even if you live disguised as a human, you can't stay in that form for years, right?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
うん……年取って、衰えて、いずれは死ななあかん。
まあ、それは死んだふりなんやけど。
english: Yeah... we have to age, weaken, and eventually die. Well, it's just pretending to be dead, though.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
老いた影は、菱形医院の手引きで死を偽装して、
社会から消えることになってるんです……。
english: Aging shadows fake their deaths with the help of Hishigata Clinic, and disappear from society...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
表向きは死んで、次の標的に変身して、
新たな別人として生活を始める。
english: On the surface they die, transform into their next target, and begin living as a new, different person.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
通常の影の生態は、
このサイクルの繰り返しやって……
お父さんからは聞いてます。
english: The normal ecology of a shadow is just repeating this cycle... That's what I heard from Dad.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
何回も何回も変身を重ねると、
コピー精度が劣化し始めて……。
english: When they transform over and over again, the copy accuracy begins to degrade...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
コピー不完全で形が崩れたり、
記憶障害、人格障害なんかが起きて、
だんだん人に擬態できやんようになるんよ。
english: The copy becomes incomplete and their shape breaks down, they develop memory disorders, personality disorders, and so on, and gradually become unable to mimic humans.

speaker: Mio
japanese: そうなった奴は人里を離れて野良になる。
english: Those who end up like that leave human settlements and become Strays.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 影の情報共有手段について教えてくれ。
english: Tell me about the shadows' means of sharing information.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ハイネは簡単な命令……
どこどこへ行けとか、誰々を殺せとかを
電波のように飛ばすことができる。
english: Haine can send simple commands... like 'go to such-and-such place' or 'kill so-and-so', transmitting them like radio waves.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
でもこれは一方的なもんで、
コドモやマゴからハイネに返信はできん。
english: But this is one-way, so the children and grandchildren can't reply to Haine.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
意思疎通するには、人と同じ手段……
会話とか電話、メモを残したりするか、
直接会って、触れて、記憶を見せ合うしかない。
english: To communicate, they have to use the same methods as humans... conversation, phone calls, leaving notes, or meet directly, touch, and show each other their memories.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: やっぱりそれはみんな同じなんやな。
english: So that really is the same for everyone.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
影には何種類かいるよな？
赤ちゃんみたいなやつとか、バケモノみたいに
手足が長いやつとか、ムキムキのやつとか。
english: There are a few different types of shadows, right? Like ones that look like babies, or ones with long limbs like monsters, or muscular ones.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
赤ちゃんみたいなやつが野良。
人としての形が崩れた古い影。
english: The ones that look like babies are Strays. Old shadows whose human forms have broken down.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
コピー能力が衰えてて、分娩能力はない。
変身も完璧じゃないから、
人前に姿を現すことは滅多にない。
english: Their copy ability has weakened, and they don't have the ability to give birth. Their transformations aren't perfect either, so they rarely show themselves in public.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
野良はネズミや鳥、魚、虫なんかを食べて、
人目につかない場所でひっそりと生きてます。
english: Strays eat things like mice, birds, fish, and insects, living quietly in places where people won't see them.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
姿は個体差があって様々ですけど、
最後はみんな赤ちゃんみたいになったあと、
記憶も人格もなくして、泥になって消えるといいます。
english: Their appearances vary with individual differences, but in the end, after they all become like babies, they lose their memories and personalities, turn to mud, and disappear.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
影は老いると赤子に近付く……
人の本質と、あるいは同じなのかも知れないな。
english: Shadows grow closer to babies as they age... Perhaps it's the same as the essence of humans.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ハイネから送られる信号によって
戦うことに特化した影は、「人無」って呼ばれてる。
english: Shadows specialized for fighting by signals sent from Haine are called 'Hitonashi'.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
たいていの個体は人の像を外れて
筋肉が肥大したり、手足が長く伸びたりする。
english: Most individuals deviate from the human form, their muscles hypertrophying or their limbs growing long.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
戦闘能力がむちゃくちゃ向上する反面、
知能は低下してて、人としての思考力を失う。
english: While their combat ability improves ridiculously, their intelligence drops, and they lose their ability to think as humans.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
私のローゼンクランツと
ギルデンスターンは、人無ですね。
english: My Rosencrantz and Guildenstern are Hitonashi, then.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: なんやその名前……。
english: What's with those names...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 名付けは私の趣味。
english: Naming them is my hobby.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ハイネに認められた菱形家の人間は、
自らの声に反応して、命令に忠実に動く影を拝領する……
これは古くからの仕来り。
english: Members of the Hishigata family recognized by Haine receive shadows that respond to their voice and faithfully follow orders... This is an old tradition.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……どっちがローゼンクランツ？
english: ...Which one is Rosencrantz?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
いつもぼーっとして涎を垂らしてるのがロズ、
右手に怪我した方が怒りんぼのギルです。
english: The one who's always spacing out and drooling is Roz, and the grumpy one with the injured right hand is Gil.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
野良を元にしてるのでコピー能力こそありませんが、
強化された戦闘能力は、
他の野良よりはるかに優れているんです。
english: Since they're based on Strays, they don't have copy abilities, but their enhanced combat ability is far superior to other Strays.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
看護師の……根来さんの影……。
あれは親父のんか！？
english: The nurse... Negoro-san's shadow... Is that Dad's!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: うん、彼女はハイネの世話係。
english: Yeah, she's Haine's caretaker.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 物をコピーした場合について質問や。
english: I have a question about copying objects.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
体育館の戦いで使った凸村さんの拳銃なんやけど、
これは潮のコピー品や。
english: About Totsumura-san's handgun used in the gym fight, that was a copy made by Ushio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
弾を撃ち尽くしても、
一旦消してからもう１回プリントしたら、
弾は初期状態の満タンに戻る。
english: Even if the bullets are used up, if it's erased and printed again, the bullets return to their initial full state.

speaker: Mio
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、火をつけたガソリンは
潮の頭の中からデータが消えたらしい。
english: But the data for the gasoline that was set on fire apparently disappeared from Ushio's head.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そうなんよ！
なんで？
english: Yeah, exactly! Why is that?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
無機物の変身や分娩で、
もう１回そのデータが使えるかどうかは、
消耗と破壊の差。
english: With the transformation or childbirth of inorganic objects, whether that data can be used again or not is the difference between consumption and destruction.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 何それ？
english: What's that?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
バッテリーとか弾とかの「消耗」は、
またプリントしたら初期状態に戻せるけど、
「破壊」されてしもたもんは無理。
english: Consumption', like batteries or bullets, can be restored to their initial state if printed again, but things that have been 'destroyed' cannot.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ガソリンに火ぃつけて燃やすんは、
破壊に当たるんやろな。
english: Lighting gasoline on fire and burning it probably counts as destruction.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 拳銃は消耗して、ガソリンは破壊されたと。
english: So the handgun was consumed, and the gasoline was destroyed.

speaker: Mio
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
じゃあこの拳銃も、折れたりバラバラに
なったりしたらあかんねやな。
english: Then it's no good if this handgun breaks or falls apart either, huh.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
人以外の、無機物のコピーも、
その影……平面の方が弱点なんか？
english: For copies of non-human, inorganic objects, is their shadow... the 2D plane also their weakness?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
変身の場合は影本人が化けてるから、平面が弱点。
でも、分娩された無機物の影は、普通の影よ。
english: In the case of transformation, the shadow itself is disguised, so the 2D plane is its weakness. But the shadow of an inorganic object that was given birth to is a normal shadow.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
破壊するには立体を壊せばいい……
……原理はわからん。
english: To destroy them, you just have to break the 3D object... ...I don't understand the principle behind it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 確かにネイルガンは壊れたままやったな。
english: It's true that the nail gun stayed broken.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……しかし、潮が次の周回にも
壊れたデータを持ち越したということは……。
english: ...However, the fact that Ushio carried over the destroyed data to the next loop means...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
網代慎平がループしても、
潮だけは時間が戻っていないということだな。
english: Even if Shinpei Ajiro loops, only Ushio's time isn't going back.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
うん。
いうたら私は、
体がデータでできてるみたいなもんやから……。
english: Yeah. To put it one way, my body is basically made of data, so...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
時間を遡る慎平の意識にくっついて
ループしてるんやな。
english: You're looping by attaching yourself to Shinpei's consciousness as it goes back in time.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
だからシデも言うてたけど、私は死んだら
それで終わりやと思う。
ループしても、もう今の私はいてへん。
english: That's why Shide said it too, but I think if I die, that's the end of it. Even if we loop, the current me won't be there anymore.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （これでひと通り、聞きたいことは聞いたか……）
english: (Have I asked everything I wanted to for now...?)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ごめんよ慎ちゃん……。
あんまり役に立つ情報なくて……。
english: Sorry, Shin-chan... I don't have much useful information...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
そっ……そんなん、
おまえが謝ることちゃうて！！
english: Th-That's... not something you need to apologize for!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
おいおいっ……
あいつは影やぞ窓くん！！
english: Hey, hey... She's a shadow, Sou-kun!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: あっ、いや……でもっ……。
english: Ah, no... but...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
……ああっくそっ！！
調子狂うでェ～～～！！
english: ...Ah, damn it!! This is throwing me off~~~!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ハイネは復活のために
大量の人を「食う」必要がある……
分娩はそのための兵隊作りだな。
english: Haine needs to 'eat' a massive amount of people for her resurrection... The childbirths are to create soldiers for that purpose.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
私とお父さんは、お母さんのために
ハイネを復活させようとしてました。
そのための食餌やと……。
english: Dad and I were trying to resurrect Haine for Mom's sake. I thought it was food for that...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
でも違った。
私は騙されてた……。
あいつらには別の目的がある……！！
english: But it was different. I was deceived... They have a different purpose...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ヒルコ洞で、あいつが言うてたよな。
親父は「了承済み」やて……。
english: In Hiruko Cave, that guy said it, didn't he. That Dad 'already consented'...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ふざけやがって……親父は……
オレらが死んでもええ思てるっちゅう
こっちゃ！！
english: Screwing with us... Dad... He thinks it's fine even if we die!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……お父さん……。
english: …Dad…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
納得できやんことも多いけど……
菱形先生なら、ハイネの本当の目的を
知ってるはずや。
english: There's a lot I can't accept, but... Dr. Hishigata should know Haine's true purpose.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そこに何か解決策があるかも知れない……。
english: There might be some kind of solution there...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 親父とは今晩１０時に会う約束をしてる。
english: I have an appointment to meet Dad tonight at 10.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: よし……次の目的が決まったな。
english: Okay, then we know what to do next.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……オレ行くわ……。
english: …I'm going…

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
窓くん！？
一人で出てく気！？
english: Sou-kun!? Are you planning to go out alone!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
こら！
待ちな窓！！
english: Hey! Wait, Sou!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
モタモタしてられるかよ……！！
今すぐ帰って親父に会う……！
english: Like I can just dawdle around...!! I'm going back right now to meet Dad...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 待て。
english: Wait.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……どいてくださいっ……。
english: ...Please move...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
キミの家は影の味方をしているんだぞ、
菱形窓……。
english: Your family is on the side of the shadows, Sou Hishigata...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
危険すぎる……。
もうおまえ一人では行かせられへん！
english: It's too dangerous... I can't let you go alone anymore!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
彼の言う通りだ。
菱形医院へはみんなで行く。
english: He's right. Let's all go to Hishigata Clinic.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
痒いよォ～～～ッ。
蚊ァめっちゃおるここ！
english: It's so itchy~~~! There are so many mosquitoes here!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ミオ。
english: …Mio.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、いや……。
english: Ah, no…

speaker: Mio
english: …Me?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うん……。
澪を……守ってくれ。
english: Yeah... Protect... Mio.

speaker: Mio
japanese: それは命令？
english: Is that an order?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
命令っちゅうか……
うん……まァ……命令か……。
english: An order, or rather... Yeah... well... I guess it's an order...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
……ていうか慎ちゃん、私のこと怖いん？
めっちゃ距離とるやん。
english: ...I mean, Shin-chan, are you scared of me? You're keeping a lot of distance.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そっ……そりゃあ……。
怖ない言うたらウソになるわ。
おまえに何回殺された思てんねん……。
english: W-Well, yeah... It'd be a lie to say I'm not scared. How many times do you think you've killed me...?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
それって別の世界のハナシやろ？
私まだ誰も殺してへんよ。
english: That's a story from another world, right? I haven't killed anyone yet.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そ……それは……そやけど……。
english: Th... That's... true, but...

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……私からも質問していい？
english: Can I ask ya something too?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Y-Yeah... What is it...?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 東京で彼女できた！？
english: Did ya have a girlfriend in Tokyo?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: がっ……！
english: Guh...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 彼女？
english: Girlfriend?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
カノジョォ～～ッ！！？
なっ……なっ……何聞くんあんた！！

オレ、あんまり菱形先生が悪いって思えやんねん。
大事な人を救うために手段を選ばんかっただけやろ？
english: I wonder why... I can't really think of Dr. Hishigata as a bad person. He just didn't choose his methods to save someone important, right?

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレも同じ立場やったら、
同じことしない自信ないよ……。
english: If I were in the same position, I'm not confident I wouldn't do the same thing...

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese:
でもその結果が復活の儀式……。
あの大量虐殺に加担したんですよ……。

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese:
犠牲になった人たちを影に変えてしもたら
殺された記憶は消して……あとは誰にもバレへんって。
english: If he turned the victims into shadows, he'd erase their memories of being killed... and then no one would find out.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese:
お父さんの計画には
さらにその先があったみたいやけどな。
english: It seems Dad's plan had something even further beyond that, though.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: はい……。
english: Yes…

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

影でも潮は潮やしなァ……。
千登勢さんも千登勢さんやし……。
やっぱりオレは自信ないかな……。
english: Even as a shadow, Ushio is Ushio... And Chitose-san is Chitose-san... I guess I'm still not confident...

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ……優しいんですね……。

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese: え？

japanese:
たくさんループして……
意識が連続してるんですよね？

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ヒドいですよ、目のクマ！
english: Your eye bags are terrible!

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 確かに……ずっと起きてる……かもな……。

ホラ！！
ムリしたらあきませんよ！
english: See!! You can't push yourself too hard!

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese: うん……。

japanese:
みんないるんですから、
今夜くらい眠ってくださいね。
english: Since everyone is here, please at least sleep tonight.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese:
（……トキちゃんの言う通り、
　もう今しか眠るタイミングないかもな）
english: (...Just like Toki-chan said, this might be the only time I can sleep.)

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ありがとう……。

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese: あの……網代くん……。

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese:
あァ、小弓場さん……！
色々とごめん。
大変なことに付き合わせちゃって。
english: Ah, Koyuba-san...! Sorry for everything. Getting you involved in such a mess.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうだ、夜が明けたら宿に帰った方がいい。
english: That's right, it'd be better to return to your inn once dawn breaks.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 長く部屋を開けるのも不自然だし疑われるから。
english: Leaving your room empty for long is unnatural and will raise suspicion.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
う、うん……。
その方がいいのかな……。
english: Y-Yeah... I wonder if that's better...

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese:
網代くんたちがこんな大変な時なのに私、
何もできないし……。
english: Even though Ajiro-kun and the others are going through such a hard time, I can't do anything...

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese:
そんなことないよ。
今日の戦いだって、小弓場さんのアイデアが
なければ勝てなかったと思う。

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah...

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もし何かあったら、すぐに連絡して。
english: If anything happens, please contact me immediately.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
すぐに駆けつけ……られるかはわからないけど、
なんとかするから。
english: I don't know if I can rush over... immediately, but I'll manage something.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
うん……わかった。
ありがとう。
english: Yeah... I understand. Thank you.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese:
慎平ェ！
トキちゃんから頼まれたベッドの用意できたで！
寝れやんのやったら子守歌サービスしちゃろか？
english: Shinpei! I got the bed ready like Toki-chan asked! If you can't sleep, should I provide a lullaby service?

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
やめてくれ。
よけい寝られんようになるわ。

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Kaori Koyumiba

japanese:
あっ、せや！
かおりちゃんに子守歌歌ってもろたらどない？
アイドルの生歌とか、めっちゃ貴重やん。
english: Ah, right! How about getting Kaori-chan to sing a lullaby? An idol's live singing is super precious, y'know.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アホか。
そんなん小弓場さんに失礼やろ。
english: Are you an idiot? That'd be rude to Koyuba-san.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: あーあ、やっぱりかなわないや……。
english: Ah man, I really can't compete...

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: えっ、何が？
english: Eh, with what?

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ううん、なんでもない。
english: No, it's nothing.

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese: そう？
english: Really?

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family

japanese:
もし私にできることがあったら連絡して！
絶対に力になるから！
english: If there's anything I can do, contact me! I'll definitely be of help!

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、うん……。
english: Ah, yeah...

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ほら、早く寝ないと朝になっちゃうよ。
おやすみ！
english: Come on, if you don't sleep soon it'll be morning. Good night!

chapter: 1. The Secret of the Hishigata Family
speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それじゃ、おやすみ……。
english: Well then, good night...

japanese: 2.けじめ
english: 2. Boundaries

japanese: 根津　銀次郎
english: Ginjiro Nezu

speaker: Ushio
japanese: どこ行くん！？
english: Where are you going!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
english: ...You, huh... Ushio...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
みんな寝てるのに、一人で行動したら危ないで！？
トイレも声かけてって言うたやん！
english: It's dangerous to act alone when everyone is sleeping! I told you to let us know even if you're going to the bathroom!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……帰らせてくれや……。
english: ...Let me go home...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
帰るって……家に！？
一人で！？
アカンアカン、何考えて――
english: Go home... to your house!? Alone!? No way, what are you think--

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
シィィーーッ。
声が大きいっ……。
english:
Shhh…
Your voice is too loud.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……何か忘れもんとか？
english: Did ya forget something?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
まァそんなとこや……。
どないしてもムリか……？
english: Well, something like that... Is there no way you'll let me...?

speaker: Ushio
english: No~~~, hmmm~~~... Mumumum...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ほな、私もいっしょに行こか！
どうしても帰るんやったら！
english: Then, I'll go with you too! If you absolutely have to go back!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……チッ、しゃあないか……。
ついて来いそォ……。
english: ...Tch, it can't be helped... Come along then...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
そこが儂の家や。
すぐ戻る、おまえは外で待ってろ。
english: That's my house over there. I'll be right back, you wait outside.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: なんでフツーについてくるっ！！！
english: Why are you just casually following me!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
だって……
影の気配がするんやもん！！
english: Well, I felt the presence of a shadow.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……心配いらん。
あいつは動けやんさけに……。
english: ...No need to worry. That thing can't move anyway...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ただいま……。
english: I'm home…

speaker: 根津薫
english:
…O…
G…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あの……。
こ……この人、まさか……。
english: Um... I-Is she...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あァ……。
影や……妻の薫のな……。
english: Yeah... It's a shadow... of my wife, Kaoru...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ちょうど２か月前や……。
こいつァ……一人で畑へ出てって……。
<color=#GF_TIPS_016>影</color>になって帰って来た。
english: Exactly two months ago... She... went out to the field alone... And came back as a <color=#GF_TIPS_016>shadow</color>.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あの光を浴びた時、すぐに思い出したよ。
１４年前のあの日……竜之介が殺された時のことをな。
english: When I was bathed in that light, I remembered immediately. That day 14 years ago... when Ryunosuke was killed.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
こいつは儂をコピーしようとしたが、
儂には免疫があった。
english: She tried to copy me, but I had immunity.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 儂はとっさに置いてあったネイルガンで……。
english: I impulsively used the nail gun that was lying there...

speaker: カオル
japanese:
……グ……。
グアウゥ！　アアッ！！
english: ...Gu... Guauu! Aah!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……どないした……。
様子がおかしい……こんなんは初めてや……。
english: ...What's wrong... She's acting strange... this is the first time...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
千登勢さんをおかしくしたハイネのテレパシーを、
奥さんも受信してしもたんやと思う。
english: I think your wife also received Haine's telepathy that made Chitose-san go crazy.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
english: ...I see...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 根津さん、まって！
english: Nezu-san, wait!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
悪りけどよォ……。
二人にしてくれや……。
english: Sorry, but... Leave us alone...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
まってよ！
私がハッキングしたら戻せるよ！
元の奥さんに！！
english: Wait! If I hack her, I can bring her back! To your original wife!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
そのつもりはない……。
元に戻しても、こいつは影なんや……。
english: I have no intention of doing that... Even if she's brought back, she's still a shadow...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
しかもおまえや菱形のんとは違う。
こいつは……儂の妻を殺して変身した……。
妻の仇やろ……？
english: Moreover, she's different from you and Hishigata's. She... killed my wife and transformed... She's my wife's killer, isn't she...?

speaker: Ushio
english: …But…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
儂はこいつをよう殺さんかった……。
影を駆除すると言いながら、
最大の仇であるこいつを生かしとった……。
english: I couldn't bring myself to kill her... While talking about exterminating the shadows, I kept my greatest enemy alive...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 慎平に決断を説きながら、できてないんは儂の方や……。
english: While preaching about making decisions to Shinpei, I was the one who couldn't do it...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
儂にこれ以上、ボーナスタイムはいらん。
頼む、儂にもケジメつけさせてくれ……。
english: I don't need any more bonus time. Please, let me settle this too...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……頼む。
english: …Please.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
すまなんだな、薫。
儂もじきに行く。
english: I'm sorry, Kaoru. I'll be joining you soon.

japanese: 3.チーム分け
english: 3. Team Division

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （長かった夜が明けた……）
english: (The long night has broken...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 朝や……。
english: It's morning...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オイオイ大丈夫か？
　ほんとにぐっすり眠っていたぞ）
english: (Hey, hey, are you okay? You were really sleeping soundly.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よかった……
　近付いてた時間の端っこが遠くなってる
　感覚がする）
english: (Thank goodness... I feel like the edge of time that was approaching has gotten further away.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これで残りのループ回数に少し余裕が
　生まれたはずだ）
english: (With this, there should be a little more leeway in the remaining number of loops.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……でも目の奥の痛みは取れてない。
　頭痛もひどくなってる……）
english: (...But the pain in the back of my eyes hasn't gone away. My headache is getting worse too...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……そうだ、みんなの安否は？）
english: (...That's right, is everyone safe?)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あ！
english: Ah!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: オハヨ。
english: Good morning.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お……はよう……！！
english: G... Good morning...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （全員無事に、２３日の朝を迎えた……）
english: (Everyone safely made it to the morning of the 23rd...)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
慎平くん、おまえよォ……。
昨日からオレがどんだけ犯罪に目ェつぶってるか、
わかってるか？
english: Shinpei-kun, you... Do you know how many crimes I've turned a blind eye to since yesterday?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
この銃、しかたないから渡しとくけどな……。
こんなんバレたら始末書で済まんわ……。
クビになったらおまえらのせいやからな！！
english: I'll give you this gun since it can't be helped, but... If this gets out, an apology letter won't cut it... If I get fired, it's your fault!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Y... Yes...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの……やっぱりこの銃、
凸村さんが使ってください！
english: Um... you should use this gun after all, Totsumura-san!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
english: Huh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
やっぱオレが持ってんの
よくない気がしてきました。
english: I feel like it's not a good idea for me to hold onto it after all.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
うむ……。
やはり銃はプロである警官に任せるべきだな！
english: Hmm... As expected, guns should be left to the professional police officer!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
あんたが言う！？
あんたも銃刀法違反やからな！
english: You're the one saying that!? You're also violating the Swords and Firearms Control Law!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
しかしそれはコピー品だからな。
潮と５０ｍ以上離れてはならないぞ。
最前線で戦ってくれたまえよ！
english: However, since that's a copy, you must not be more than 50m away from Ushio. Please fight on the front lines!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: あ……あはははあ。
english: A... ahahaha.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
それ、もうあげる！　キミにあげちゃうっ！
オレァ死んでもループできやんしよ！！
法律と心中するつもりはないですし！！
english: I'll give that to you! I'm giving it to you! I can't loop even if I die!! And I don't intend to commit double suicide with the law!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: バレなきゃいいのだ、バレなきゃ……。
english: It's fine as long as we don't get caught, as long as we don't get caught...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: こうなりゃ一蓮托生スよ……！？
english: At this point, we're all in the same boat...!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
……慎平くん、実銃撃った経験あんの？
ハワイとかでよォ……。
english: ...Shinpei-kun, do you have experience shooting a real gun? Like in Hawaii or something...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いえ……。
english: No...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オレが警察学校で初めてマジモンの銃持った時は
そらァ怖かった……。
english: When I first held a real gun at the police academy, I was so scared...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
初めは的に一発もよう当てやんかった……。
ビビッてしもてな……。
せやけどおまえは……落ち着きすぎやないか……？
english: At first, I couldn't hit the target at all... I was so nervous... But you... aren't you a little too calm...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや……怖いですよ。
でももう一人の自分が……
銃を持ってる自分を見てるんです。
english: No... I am scared. But it's like another me is... watching the me holding the gun.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ……フカン……てヤツか……。
english: ...That 'bird's-eye view' thing, huh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうやって他人事にしちゃえば、
なんとか撃てます。
english: If I treat it like someone else's problem like that, I can manage to shoot.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
フン……。
ほな、その天才に先輩から１個だけアドバイスや。
english: Hmph... Then, as your senior, I'll give this genius one piece of advice.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
この銃の持ち方な、左手で下からこう持つんは
やめとけ。
english: About how you hold this gun, stop holding it from below with your left hand like this.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
撃った反動で銃口がはね上がって、
一発目をもし外した時、二発目も絶対に
当たらんようになる……。
english: The recoil from shooting will make the muzzle jump up, and if you miss the first shot, you'll definitely miss the second shot too...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
こう握って、力の配分は
右手が３、左手が７くらいにしろ。
english: Grip it like this, and distribute your strength so your right hand is about 3 and your left hand is about 7.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 右手が３、左手が７くらい……か。
english: Right hand at 3, left hand at 7... huh.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 危険な男やな、慎平……。
english: You're a dangerous guy, Shinpei...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
おまえは相手が人でも撃てる。
一線を越えられる人間かもな……。
english: You could shoot even if the target was a person. You might be someone who can cross that line...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: おまえが味方でよかったわい……。
english: I'm glad you're on our side…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今日――２３日は「狩り」の日になる。
　明日の決戦に備えて、
　影の戦力を可能な限りそいでおくんだ）
english: (Today--the 23rd, will be the day of the 'hunt'. In preparation for tomorrow's decisive battle, we need to trim down the shadows' fighting power as much as possible.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレたちは二手に分かれた。
　まずは南雲先生が葬儀で見かけた影が標的だ）
english: (We split into two groups. First, the targets are the shadows Nagumo-sensei saw at the funeral.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（南雲先生、根津さん、凸村さん、トキちゃんの
　南雲チームが子垣内家を）
english: (Nagumo-sensei, Nezu-san, Totsumura-san, and Toki-chan's Nagumo team will take the Kogaito family.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレとウシオ、ミオと窓と澪は潮チーム）
english: (Me, Ushio, Mio, Sou, and Mio will be the Ushio team.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （こっちは人渕家を調べることにする）
english: (We'll investigate the Hitobuchi family.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （潮チームは一度コフネに戻った）
english: (The Ushio team returned to Kofune once.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（アランは開店の為に仕込みをしていた。
　怒られるのを覚悟して帰ったが、
　アランは優しく迎えてくれた）
english: (Alain was doing prep work to open the store. I returned prepared to be scolded, but Alain welcomed me kindly.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（一晩中コフネを見張ってくれていたロズとギルを、
　トキちゃんの元に帰した）
english: (We sent Roz and Gil, who had been watching over Kofune all night, back to Toki-chan.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪は店を手伝う。
　影ミオを護衛に残し、
　窓にもコフネに留まってもらう）
english: (Mio will help out at the store. We'll leave shadow Mio behind as a guard, and have Sou stay at Kofune too.)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
……ほな今日は、お姉ちゃんと慎ちゃん
二人っきりなんや……。
english: ...So today, it's just Sis and Shin-chan all alone...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
え？
あ……うん。
english:
Huh?
Ah… yeah.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ええなァ……。
なあ澪？
english: That's nice... Right, Mio?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
は！！？
こっちは窓くんおるから、平気！
な！　窓くん！
english: Huh!!? We have Sou-kun here, so I'm fine! Right! Sou-kun!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
english: Hm... O-Oh...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんも慎ちゃんも……。
気ィつけてね……！！
english: Sis and Shin-chan too... Be careful...!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あと、これ使て！
english: Also, use this!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ん？
english: Huh?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
お姉ちゃんの髪の毛なんやけど……。
洗面所とか部屋に落ちてたの集めたんよ。
english: It's Sis's hair... I collected the ones that had fallen in the washroom and her room.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……どゆこと！？
english: …What does that mean!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
髪の毛には、
本物のお姉ちゃんのデータがあるやろ？
english: This hair has the data of the real Sis, right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
数本しかないから傷全快！
とはいかんやろけど……。
ちょっとした回復薬みたいに使えるかなって。
english: Since there are only a few strands, it won't fully heal wounds! Or anything like that, but... I thought you could use it like a minor recovery potion.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
澪！
天才っ！！
english: Mio! You're a genius!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 髪の毛、復っっ活！！！！
english: Hair, completely restored!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: よし……じゃあ行くか！
english: All right, let's do this.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓、澪を頼むな。
english: Sou, take care of Mio.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
任しとけ！
おまえらも死ぬなよ……！！
english: Leave it to me! Don't die out there...!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん！
english: Shin-chan!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あとで私……話があるから！
絶対無事で……帰って来てよね……。
english: I have... something to talk to you about later! So definitely come back... safely, okay...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: わかった、何かあったらすぐ連絡しろよ。
english: Got it. If anything happens, call me right away.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: じゃ、行って来ます。
english: Then I'm off!

japanese: 4.ぶっちー
english: 4. Bucchi

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
近くに気配はない……。
この家にはもうおらん……。
english: There's no presence nearby... There's no one in this house anymore...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（人渕先生の家の中には、
　影にやられた痕跡しか残っていなかった……）
english: (Inside Hitobuchi-sensei's house, only the traces of being attacked by shadows remained...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
南雲先生が言うてた通りやったな……。
人渕家は全滅してる……。
english: It was just as Nagumo-sensei said... The Hitobuchi family has been wiped out...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（南雲先生が葬儀で見かけた影の一人。
　「人渕かなえ」は学校の先生だ。
　通称「ぶっちー」）
english: (One of the shadows Nagumo-sensei saw at the funeral. 'Kanae Hitobuchi' is a school teacher. Commonly known as 'Bucchi'.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレも潮も南雲先生も、
　島の子供全員が人渕先生の授業を
　受けたことがある――）
english: (Me, Ushio, Nagumo-sensei, every child on the island has taken Hitobuchi-sensei's classes--)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ぶっちー……。
優しかったよね……。
english: Bucchi... She was kind, wasn't she...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……そうやな……。
でも怒ると怖かったな。
english: ...Yeah... But she was scary when she got mad.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あの人からは勉強だけじゃなく
大切なことをたくさん教わった……。
本当に良い先生だった……！
english: I learned so many important things from her, not just studying... She really was a good teacher...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん……。
english: Yeah…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
行こ……慎平！！
先生の仇をとれんのは、私らしかいてへん！
english: Let's go... Shinpei!! We're the only ones who can avenge Sensei!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（家の状況と照らし合わせて考えるに、
　人渕家の人間は全員影に殺されたようだ）
english: (Judging from the condition of the house, it seems everyone in the Hitobuchi family was killed by shadows.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（人渕家は先生と郵便局員の夫、
　役場に勤める息子が二人の四人家族であり――）
english: (The Hitobuchi family was a family of four: Sensei, her husband who worked at the post office, and their two sons who worked at the town hall--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これはさっき人渕家で発見したシミの数とも
　一致する）
english: (This matches the number of stains we found in the Hitobuchi house earlier.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（つまり人渕家の影は「四人」……
　確実にこの島に潜んでいる）
english: (In other words, there are 'four' shadows of the Hitobuchi family... They are definitely hiding on this island.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレたちは影の気配を辿り、
　タカノス山の森の奥へと向かった）
english: (We followed the presence of the shadows, heading deep into the forest of Mt. Takanosu.)

japanese: 8周目
english: 8th Loop

japanese: 5.子供たちの危機
english: 5. The Children's Crisis

speaker: 浜路俊と灯台照
japanese: わああぁあああああッ！！！
english: Waaaaaaahhhh!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今の声は……子供！？
english: That voice just now... a child!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
影の気配も近い！
慎平、私に捕まって！！
english: The shadow's presence is close too! Shinpei, hold onto me!!

speaker: ブッチー
japanese:
あらあら、元気がよろしいねえ。
いい食餌になりそう……。
english: Oh my, you're so energetic. You'll make a good meal...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
一人仕留め損ねてもた！
……慎平っ！！
english: I failed to take one down! ...Shinpei!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 子供らのっ、うしろ――
english: Behind... the kids--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（フカンしろフカンしろ、
　人の姿をしている肉体の方は虚像！
　影の本体はヤツらの足元に落ちる影だ！）
english: (Take a bird's-eye view, take a bird's-eye view, the body in human form is an illusion! The shadow's main body is the shadow cast at their feet!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（体をラクに、教わった通りに。
　力の配分は「右手に３左手に７」だ――）
english: (Relax my body, just like I was taught. The power distribution is '3 in the right hand, 7 in the left'--)

speaker: ブッチー
japanese:
……大きなったなァ……慎平くん……。
元気に……してた……？
english: ...You've grown so big... Shinpei-kun... Have you... been well...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Yes... Hitobuchi... sensei...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ふう。
english: Phew.

speaker: Shun Hamaji
japanese: わぁっ！！
english: Wahhh!!!

speaker: Akari Toudai
japanese: し、慎平が……影をやっつけた！？
english: Sh-Shinpei... defeated the shadow!?

speaker: Akari Toudai
japanese: で、でもっ、あ……あの潮は！？
english: B-But, wh... what about Ushio!?

speaker: Akari Hamaji
japanese:
うしお、かえってきたん？
きのうおそうしきやったのに……。
english: Ushio, you came back? Even though your funeral was yesterday...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ま、いろいろあってん！
english: Well, a lot happened!

speaker: Akari Toudai
japanese:
つまり、悪い影といい影が戦ってて……
潮はいい影？
english: So basically, the bad shadows and good shadows are fighting... And Ushio is a good shadow?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ハイ灯台くん大正解！！
english: Yes, Todai-kun, you're absolutely correct!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
安心してね！
悪い影は私らがぜーーんぶやっつけちゃるから！！
english: Rest assured! We'll defeat aaaaaall the bad shadows!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
な！
慎平っ！！
english: Right! Shinpei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: その通りや。
english: That's right.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: って、いつまで木の上に登ってんの！？
english: Wait, how long are you going to stay up in the tree!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
お……降りられないんだよ！！！
おまえがここまで運んだんやろ！
english: I... I can't get down!!! You're the one who carried me up here!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
しゃーないなァ。
ホレ、捕まって。
english: Can't be helped. Here, grab on.

speaker: Shun Hamaji
japanese: 慎平って尻に敷かれるタイプやな！
english: Shinpei really gets led around by the nose.

speaker: Akari Hamaji
japanese:
うん！！
ふーふみた……い……。
english: Yeah!! Like a married coup...le...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Oh! What's that!?

speaker: Akari Toudai
japanese: あ……あれ！？
english: H... Huh!?

speaker: Shun Hamaji
japanese: 潮は！！？
english: Where's Ushio!!?

speaker: Akari Hamaji
japanese: さっきまでそこに……おったのに……。
english: She was just there...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ughh…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Ugh... guh...

speaker: Heine
japanese: 戻ったな……。
english: It returned...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ウシオの気配が消えたのう……。
ようやくあの小娘を消せて嬉しいぞ……。
english: Ushio's presence has disappeared... I'm glad I was finally able to erase that little girl...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハイネ……！！
english: Haine...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（銃が……ない……。
　そうか……潮が消えたから……）
english: (The gun... is gone... I see... because Ushio disappeared...)

speaker: Heine
japanese:
ところで、戻ったばかりということは、
慎平、おまん……崖っぷちやな……？
english: By the way, since you just came back, Shinpei, you're... on the edge of a cliff, aren't you...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（事象の地平線……！！
　ループ直後の限界ギリギリ！
　マズイッ！！）
english: (The event horizon...!! The absolute limit right after a loop! This is bad!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これを狙って！！
　鳥になってずっとオレを観ていたのか！？）
english: (Aiming for this!! Were you watching me the whole time as a bird!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (This sound is...!!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まずいぞ……。
　オレ一人じゃあ、野良一匹倒せない……）
english: (This is bad... By myself, I can't even defeat a single Stray...)

speaker: Akari Hamaji
japanese: お兄ちゃん……っ。
english: Onii-chan...

speaker: Shun Hamaji
japanese:
だ……大丈夫や、あかり。
オレが……守るんや！！
english: I-It's okay, Akari. I'll... protect you!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (...It's no use...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あきらめんな！！！！
　オレが死んだら全部終わる！！
　フカンしろ！　フカンしろ！！）
english: (Don't give up!!!! If I die, it all ends!! Take a bird's-eye view! Take a bird's-eye view!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（何か！　何かあるはずだ！！
　この状況を切り抜ける手がっ……！！）
english: (Something! There has to be something!! A way to get out of this situation...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まっ待て！！！
待ってくれ！！！！
english: W-Wait!!! Please wait!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ひ、ひとつだけ教えてくれないか。
english: ...C-Could you tell me just one thing?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえも……。
コピーしたデータを
引き継げるん……やろ……！？
english: You too... Can carry over the copied data... Right...!?

speaker: Heine
english: …It's your fault.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……じゃあ……
おまえは……あの時……。
english: ...Then... You were... at that time...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
２４日の夜に境内の人たちを……
食べたんとちゃうんか……。
english: You didn't eat the people in the shrine grounds... on the night of the 24th, did you...

speaker: Heine
japanese: ……おまんのせいじゃ……。
english: It's all yer fault...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
あの時戻った力は……
おまんを追いかけんのに使うてしもたわ……。
english: The power that returned at that time... I ended up using it to chase you...

speaker: Heine
japanese: おまんの命……ここで削り切る。
english: Yer life ends here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: D... amn... it!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （もう無いのか……他に……）
english: (Is there nothing else... left...)

speaker: Heine
japanese: バイバイ。
english: Bye-bye.

speaker: Stray Shadow A
japanese: う゛おおぉおぉお！
english: Uwooooooh!!

speaker: Stray Shadow B
japanese: オギィィッ！！
english: Ogiiii!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ちくしょう……潮……ッ！）
english: (Damn it... Ushio...!)

speaker: Heine
english: Wait!!!!

speaker: Stray Shadow B
japanese: オギっ。
english: Ogi.

speaker: Stray Shadow A
japanese: う゛ぉああ？
english: Uwoaa?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （野良影たちが……止まった！？）
english: (The stray shadows... stopped!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、ハイネが止めたのか？
　でもどうして……）
english: (No, did Haine stop them? But why...)

speaker: Heine
japanese: チッ……貴様。
english: Tch... you bastard.

speaker: Akari Hamaji
japanese: ……行ってしもた……。
english: ...They're gone...

speaker: Akari Toudai
japanese:
き、危機は脱した……
ということでしょうか？
english: W-We've escaped the crisis... Is that what this means?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（消えた……。野良たちも……。
　なんで助かった……？）
english: (They vanished... the Strays too... Why was I saved...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ポケットの中に、何か……）
english: (There's something... in my pocket...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……潮の貝殻……）
english: (...Ushio's seashell...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぐッ……。
english: Guh...

speaker: Akari Toudai
japanese: どっ……どうしたん！？
english: Wh-What's wrong!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや……。
早よみんなに……連絡を……。
english: No... Hurry and contact... everyone...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 潮が……死んだだと……。
english: Ushio... is dead...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Shadow Shinpei)
japanese:
はい……状況が変わりました……！！
一度集合して……はい……。
作戦を練り直さないと……。
english: Yes... the situation has changed...!! Let's gather once... yes... We need to rethink our strategy...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……わかった……。
……で、場所は？
english: ...Understood... ...So, where?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
くそ！！　繋がらんのかっ……！！
圏外なんや……ここは……！！
english: Damn it!! It won't connect...!! It's out of range... here...!!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: 島の北東……<color=#GF_TIPS_047>虎島</color>はどうです？
english: How about the northeast of the island... <color=#GF_TIPS_047>Torashima</color>?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 干潮の時だけ渡れる離れ小島か。
english: That small island you can only reach during low tide?

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
はい。
ちょうど３０分後に干潮です。
english: Yes. Low tide is in exactly 30 minutes.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
澪と窓にも伝えました……。
コフネに戻って合流してから向かいます。
english: I told Mio and Sou too... We'll head there after returning to Kofune and meeting up.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……了解した。
では３０分後に虎島で会おう。
english: ...Understood. Then let's meet at Torashima in 30 minutes.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
はい……じゃあ先生……。
３０分後に……。
english: Yes... well then, Sensei... In 30 minutes...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
すぐ山を下りよう……！！
ここは危ない！
english: Let's go down the mountain immediately...!! It's dangerous here!

speaker: Shun Hamaji
japanese: お……おうっ！！
english: O... Okay!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（みんなに知らせなければ……。
　潮が……潮が消えてしまったことを……！！）
english: (I have to let everyone know... That Ushio... Ushio has disappeared...!!)

japanese: ハイネ
english: Haine

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ハイネ。
その体……いつコピーしたんでしたっけ？
english: Haine. When did you copy that body again?

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
おまえもフカンして考えろ……。
ウシオの記憶にはない、
ヤツらの疑似ループの穴や……。
english: You should take a bird's-eye view and think about it too... The loophole in their pseudo-loop that isn't in Ushio's memories...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ……素晴らしい。
english: ...Wonderful.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
慎平の命、明日の儀式まで届かせない。
動いてもらうぞ、シデ。
english: I won't let Shinpei's life reach tomorrow's ritual. I'll have you make a move, Shide.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: お任せを……。
english: Leave it to me...

speaker: Akari Hamaji
japanese:
うん！！
ふーふみたい！
english: Yeah!! Like a married couple!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: そんなんちゃうわ！！！！
english: It ain't like that!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ええか！？　これは極秘の作戦やからな。
大人には言うたらアカンぞ！
english: Listen up!? This is a top secret operation. You must not tell the adults!

speaker: Shun Hamaji
japanese:
うおおーー！！　りょーーーかいっ！！！
なんかスゲェーー！！
english: Uwooooh!! Understooood!!! This is kinda amazing!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……本物のぶっちーが殺されてるってこと……
よう言わんかったな、私……。
english: ...I really couldn't bring myself to say... that the real Bucchi had been killed...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それでいい……怖がらせることもないし。
english: That's fine... no need to scare them.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: あのコら、影のこと黙ってられるかな……。
english: I wonder if those kids can keep quiet about the shadows...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 大丈夫、言うても誰も信じやん。
english: It's fine, no one would believe them anyway.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、止まって！
english: Shinpei, stop!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ん？
english: Hm?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そこの地面……血ィついてる！
まだ新しい！！
