english: The ground there... there's blood on it! It's still fresh!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ここで殺人があった……。
さっきの影の……ブッチーのしわざか……。
english: ...There was a murder here... Was it the doing of that shadow from earlier... Bucchi...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おいっ！？
english: Hey!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 大丈夫、ちょっと「読む」だけ……。
english: It's fine, I'm just going to 'read' it a little...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……３４才……女性……。
この島の人じゃない……。
大阪に住んでる……観光客……やな。
english: ...34 years old... female... Not someone from this island... A tourist... living in Osaka, huh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
見たとこ人形のシミはない。
その観光客は運ばれた……。
english: From the looks of it, there's no human-shaped stain. That tourist was carried away...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
くそ……！！
ハイネは昨日の傷を治すために、
いつもより人を食べてるんや……。
english: Damn it...!! Haine is eating more people than usual in order to heal her wounds from yesterday...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
阿保め……。
いくら他人を食べても治らんのに……。
english: You idiot... Eating more strangers won't heal her...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
小早川しおりも、波稲も……
もうオリジナルはこの世におらんのやからな……。
english: Shiori Kobayakawa, and Haine Minakata too... Their originals are no longer in this world, after all...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Ushio?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……あれっ？
私……今何か言うた？
english: ...Huh? Wait, did I just say something?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや……ちょい待ち、南雲先生からや！
予定通りに、一度みんなと合流しよう。
english: No... wait a sec, it's from Nagumo-sensei! Let's meet up with everyone once as planned.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もしもし？
english: Hello?

japanese: 6.合流そして状況報告
english: 6. Regrouping and Situation Report

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（７月２３日正午……。
　二手に分かれていたチームは合流し、
　状況を報告し合った）
english: (Noon, July 23rd... The team that had split into two regrouped, and reported the situation to each other.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（結論から言うと、倒せたのは人渕先生と
　その息子二人の影――あの子供たちに変身した――
　だけだった）
english: (To conclude, the only ones we were able to defeat were the shadows of Hitobuchi-sensei and her two sons--who had transformed into those children.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（子垣内家にはシミだけが残され、
　ロズとギルの「鼻」を使って追跡したものの、
　気配は途切れ、影を発見するに至らずだった）
english: (At the Kogaito house, only stains were left behind, and although we tracked them using Roz and Gil's 'noses', the presence broke off and we couldn't discover the shadows.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（その後オレたちは、凸村さんを中心に
　体育館での戦いで倒した影たちの
　本物の家々も調べた）
english: (After that, with Totsumura-san leading, we also investigated the real houses of the shadows we defeated in the gym battle.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （いずれももぬけのカラだったが……）
english: (All of them were completely empty, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（すべての家族が、「旅行」や「出張」など
　姿を消す理由を周囲に話しており、
　騒ぎにはなっていなかった）
english: (All the families had told people around them reasons for disappearing, such as 'traveling' or 'business trips', so it hadn't caused a commotion.)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 周辺の人に聞いたけどよォ……。
english: I asked the people around there, but...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
例えば小早川家は、しおりちゃんの静養で
海南におる朝子ちゃんの兄夫婦のとこに帰ったと
聞いちゃあるらしい。
english: For example, the Kobayakawa family supposedly told people they went back to Asako-chan's older brother's place in Kainan for Shiori-chan to recuperate.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ちなみにその兄夫婦に確認したが、
そんな事実はない！
english: By the way, I confirmed with that brother's family, and there is no such fact!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
１周目は、影のトツムラさんが
小早川家は借金で夜逃げしたって……。
english: In the 1st loop, the shadow Totsumura-san said the Kobayakawa family fled in the night due to debt...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
借金ン！？
借金あるら聞いたことないで！？
english: Debt!? I've never heard of them having debt!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 影が適当な理由をでっちあげているのか……。
english: So the shadows are fabricating random reasons...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
我々に駆除されて消されても
騒ぎにならないよう、先手を打っている。
明日の夏祭りを滞りなく開催するためだろう。
english: They're taking preemptive measures so it won't cause a commotion even if they are exterminated and erased by us. Probably in order to hold tomorrow's summer festival without a hitch.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
向こうから襲ってくる様子はないですね。
やっぱり潮さんのハッキングを怖がってるん
でしょうか。
english: There are no signs of them attacking us. I wonder if they're afraid of Ushio-san's hacking after all.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ヤツらめ……
儂らにはもうシッポ見せへんかもな……。
english: Those bastards... They might not show their tails to us anymore...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ヤツらが一番イヤがるんは祭りの中止か……
何とかして中止にできやんかな？
english: What they hate the most is the festival being canceled, huh... Can't we somehow get it canceled?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そうや！
花火の火薬で会場を爆破するとか！！
english: I know! Like blowing up the venue with firework gunpowder!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: だからやめてってば、そういうの！！
english: I told you to stop with that kind of stuff!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
テロまがいの騒ぎはマズイ……
何百人も混乱して二次災害も出てまうやろし、
ヤツらが何をしてくるか読めなくなる……。
english: A commotion bordering on terrorism is bad... Hundreds of people would panic and it'd probably cause secondary disasters, and we wouldn't be able to predict what they'd do next...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: が……中止にすんのは賛成や。
english: But... I agree with canceling it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: うむ……。
english: Hm...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そのためには……
やっぱりあの人に会うしかない。
english: In order to do that... We have no choice but to meet with him after all.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: それはかなりの危険を伴うぞ。
english: That comes with considerable danger.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 覚悟の上です。
english: I'm prepared for that.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
どうする？
みんなで一気に踏み込んでみる？
english: What are we going to do? Should we all charge in at once?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや……まずはオレ一人で行って
説得してみる。
english: No... first I'll go alone and try to persuade him.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
一人で行く……？
説得するやと！？
english: Go alone...? And persuade him!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
儂は反対や。
シデが生身さらしとったら、
何も考えんと引き金引かなあかん……！！
english: I'm against it. If Shide exposes his real body, we have to pull the trigger without thinking...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 儂が殺る。
english: I will kill him.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
待ってください！！！
１回だけ……１回だけオレにください！！
english: Please wait!!! Just once... give me just one chance!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アイツが何を考えてんのか、
ただオレ知っときたいんです。
english: I just want to know what he's thinking.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でないと……。
殺すなんて無理です……！！
english: If I don't know what's on his mind, then I can't kill him...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんでオレの両親を殺したんか……。
あいつの口から理由を聞きたい！
でないと納得できません……！！
english: Why did he kill my parents... I want to hear the reason from his own mouth! Otherwise I can't accept it...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: そのために危険を冒すっちゅうんか！？
english: You're saying you'll risk danger for that!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そのためやったらッ！！！
１回死ぬくらい……屁でもないです！！
english: If it's for that!!! Dying once... is nothing!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私はついてくからな！
慎平は影の気配察知できやんやろ。
english: I'm coming with you! Shinpei, you can't sense the presence of shadows, right.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
神社がもし影だらけで待ち受けられとったら、
話するどころちゃうで！
english: If the shrine is full of shadows lying in wait, there'll be no chance to talk!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 潮の言う通りだ。
english: Ushio's right.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
単身乗り込めば、
ヤツらがキミを捕獲するプランに
切り替える危険性も出てくる。
english: If you charge in alone, there's also the danger they might switch to a plan of capturing you.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
シデも疑似ループしているのだ……。
みすみすキミを二度も
自殺させたりしないだろう。
english: Shide is also pseudo-looping... He wouldn't just stand by and let you commit suicide twice.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 儂らも境内までは行かせてもらうぞ。
english: We'll be going as far as the shrine grounds too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……わかりました。
english: …Understood.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 会話もモニターできやんか？
english: Can we monitor the conversation too?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: グループ通話で胸ポケットに入れとけばどうかな？
english: How about putting it in your chest pocket on a group call?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あかんな、
これやと会話の内容までは聞き取れやん。
english: No, ya won't be able to hear the conversation clearly.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ほな、銃声を合図にしたらええわいしょ。
english: Then we should just use a gunshot as a signal.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なるほど……じゃあ二発……
いや三発目が聞こえたら
それを合図に踏み込んでください。
english: I see... then two shots... No, when you hear the third shot, use that as the signal to charge in.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それに、あの人がシデやったら、
あの鎧を纏えば影の気配がします。
english: Besides, if that person is Shide, he'll emit a shadow presence if he wears that armor.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もし少しでも影の気配がしたら、
一気に片をつけてしまいましょう。
english: If you sense even the slightest shadow presence, let's finish it all at once.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（思い返せば……
　初めからオレは『あの人』に
　会おうとしてたんだ）
english: (Thinking back... I was trying to meet 'that person' from the very beginning.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （初めてオレが殺された場所……）
english: (The first place where I died…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （日都神社――ここがすべての始まりだ）
english: (Hitogashima Shrine--this is where it all began.)

japanese: 7.日都神社
english: 7. Hitogashima Shrine

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……こんにちは。
english: …Hello.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: あら……こんにちは。
english: Oh... hello.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
少し、雁切さんに話があって来ました。
時間ありますか？
english: I came because I had something to talk to you about, Karikiri-san. Do you have time?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ええ、かまいませんよ。
ほな、立ち話も何ですし、どうぞ中に。
english: Yes, I don't mind. Well then, it's not good to just stand around talking, so please come inside.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 影の気配は？
english: Do you sense any shadow?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
南雲先生が言うてた通り、
やっぱり雁切さんは影じゃないね。
english: Just like Nagumo-sensei said, Karikiri-san really isn't a shadow.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうか……。
でも、気を緩めるな。
english: Okay, but don't let yer guard down.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 冷たい麦茶、持ってきましたよ。
english: I brought some cold barley tea for you.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
いや～～毎日暑いですねェ……。
はい、どうぞ。
english: Man~~ it sure is hot every day... Here you go.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ええ……どうも。
english: Yes… thank you.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
東京はアレですか、
和歌山より暑いんですか？
english: So, about Tokyo, is it hotter than Wakayama?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
や……。
あんま変わんないですよ。
english: No, it's not much different.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……あれ、でも雁切さん。
去年、東京来たんでしょ？
english: ...Oh wait, but Karikiri-san. You went to Tokyo last year, right?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
昨日言うてたじゃないですか。
東京のゲームのイベントに行ったって。
english: You said so yesterday, didn't you? That you went to a game event in Tokyo.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ああ！　そうそう、海の近くの！
幕張ね！　幕張は千葉やけど……。
english: Ah! Yes, yes, the one near the sea! Makuhari, right! Though Makuhari is in Chiba...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
いや～～そうやわ。
暑かったわ東京！
english: Man~~ that's right. Tokyo was hot!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 人の数もエライことになっててなァ～～。
english: The amount of people was also crazy~~.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ゲームお好きなんですね。
どんなんやるんですか？
english: You really like games, don't you. What kind do you play?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
昔はＲＰＧばっかりで……。
今はＰＣのＦＰＳとか、
シミュレーションゲームとか好きやねェ……。
english: In the past I only played RPGs... Now I like PC FPS, or simulation games...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今年も行くんですか？
english: Are you going again this year?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
……いや。
今年はもう……無理やろなァ……。
english: No, I probably won't make it this year.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あのＲＰＧのリメイク……やりたかったなァ～～。
いつ出るんやろ？
english: I wanted to play that RPG remake so bad~~ I wonder when it's coming out?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お好きな作品なんですね？
english: It's a game you like, isn't it?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
そりゃもう！
世界観が好きなんですよね。
発売されたんが世紀末やったからかな。
english: Oh, definitely! I really like the world setting. Maybe because it was released at the end of the century.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
アートも音楽もどこか退廃的なムードでね。
人生の終わり方について考えさせられる。
english: The art and music both have a somewhat decadent mood. It makes you think about how to end your life.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
人生ですか……。
雁切さんにとってのゲームは、
オレにとっての小説ですね。
english: Life, huh... Games are to you, Karikiri-san, what novels are to me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
南雲竜之介の「沼男」って小説知ってます？
すごく好きで……。
english: Do you know the novel 'Swamp Man' by Ryunosuke Nagumo? I really like it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これはオレの事を書いてるって……。
オレの物語だって……最近、そう思いますよ。
english: That it's written about me... That it's my story... I've been thinking that recently.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 沼男……。
english: Swampman...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
その小説は知りませんが、
思考実験の「<color=#GF_TIPS_047>沼男</color>」なら知ってますよ。
そういう内容なんですか？
english: I don't know the novel, but I do know the thought experiment '<color=#GF_TIPS_047>Swampman</color>'. Is it that kind of story?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい……。
ある日、主人公のコピー人間が現れて、
主人公になり変わって生活するんです。
english: Yes... One day, a copy of the protagonist appears, and lives life taking the protagonist's place.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
家でも学校でも誰からも、
コピー人間だと気づかれません。
english: No one at home or at school notices that they're a copy.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
コピー人間は、主人公の記憶も人格も
ＤＮＡもすべて完璧にコピーしてる。
english: The copy perfectly replicates the protagonist's memories, personality, and even DNA.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
その場合、そのコピー人間は
自分と同一人物といえるか……。
どう思います？
english: In that case, can that copy be said to be the exact same person as yourself...? What do you think?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
それは……。
「同一人物」……やろなァ……。
english: I would think it's the same person.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
人の細胞は、新陳代謝で
日々新しいものと入れ替わってる……。
english: Human cells are constantly being replaced with new ones every day through metabolism...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 細胞分裂をくり返してね。
english: By repeating cell division.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
それが一瞬で起きたか、
ゆっくり起きたかだけの差でしかない。
english: It's just a difference of whether it happened in an instant, or slowly.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: つまり、沼男は本物と同じだと。
english: In other words, Swampman is the same as the real thing.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: そう思いますね、私は。
english: Yes, I do.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
慎平くんて、
そんなことばっかり考えてるんですか？
昨日も影の事について聞いてきましたよね。
english: Shinpei-kun, do you always think about things like that? You asked me about shadows yesterday too, didn't you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ヒルコ伝承についても調べましたよ。
english: I also looked into the legend of Hiruko.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
初めは雁切さんに聞こうとしたんですが、
ひづるさんが詳しく教えてくれました。
english: At first I was going to ask you, Karikiri-san, but Hizuru-san taught me about it in detail.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
およそ３００年前、江戸時代に
この島に流れ着いた神、ヒルコ様。
english: About 300 years ago, during the Edo period, the god that washed ashore on this island, Hiruko-sama.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ＳＦ的想像をたくましくするなら、
それは遥か昔、この世界の「外」から来た。
english: To stretch my sci-fi imagination, it came from 'outside' this world long, long ago.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
深い海の底、遠い宇宙……
あるいは別の次元かもしれない。
english: The bottom of the deep sea, far out in space... or perhaps another dimension.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ここでは仮に、宇宙から来たとしましょう……。
とにかくそれは、宇宙を漂う生命体だった。
english: Let's assume for now that it came from space... Anyway, it was a lifeform drifting through space.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
近くの物をコピーして変身し、
コピーした情報を栄養にする生命体。
english: A lifeform that transforms by copying nearby objects, and uses the copied information as nutrition.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、宇宙空間では
変身できる物は限られている。
english: But in outer space, the things it could transform into were limited.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おそらくそれは「隕石」の形で、地球にやって来た。
落ちたのは海でしょう。
海は生命で満ち満ちている……。
english: It probably came to Earth in the form of a 'meteorite'. It must have fallen into the sea. The sea is brimming with life...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
魚や海藻、珊瑚にイソギンチャク……。
色んなものをコピーしたでしょうね。
english: Fish, seaweed, coral, and sea anemones... It probably copied all sorts of things.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そこでどれほどの時間が流れたか……。
english: How much time passed there, I wonder...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ここまではひづるさんの想像に過ぎない。
でも、この後が文献に出てくる
ヒルコ伝承に繋がるんです。
english: Up to this point is nothing more than Hizuru-san's imagination. But after this, it connects to the Hiruko legend found in the literature.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
３００年前。
それはクジラに変身したんですよ。
english: 300 years ago. It transformed into a whale.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そして、何らかの原因でこの島に流れ着き……
クジラを見に集まった、ある漁師の娘をコピーした。
english: Then, for some reason, it washed ashore on this island... And copied a fisherman's daughter who had gathered to see the whale.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それが影の病の始まりですよ。
english: That was the start of the shadow sickness.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ……確かに、<color=#GF_TIPS_107>ヒルコ伝承</color>はその通りやけど……。
english: ...Indeed, the <color=#GF_TIPS_107>Hiruko legend</color> goes exactly like that, but...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
慎平くん。
まさか、その話が実話やと？
english: Shinpei-kun. Don't tell me you think that story is true?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい、影は実在します。
そして潮を殺し、オレの両親を殺し――
english: Yes, shadows actually exist. And they killed Ushio, killed my parents--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
明日、この境内に集まった人たちを
皆殺しにする。
english: Tomorrow, they will massacre all the people gathered in these shrine grounds.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: あはっ……。
english: Ahaha...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
いや失礼……慎平くん……。
さすがに本の読みすぎや……。
それに不謹慎やないですか……。
english: Ah, excuse me... Shinpei-kun... You've definitely been reading too many books... Besides, isn't that inappropriate...?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
潮ちゃんが亡くなって動転するのはわかります。
よく休んだ方がいい。
english: I understand you're upset about Ushio-chan passing away. You should rest well.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もう全部わかってるんですよ。
english: I already know everything.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
雁切さん。
あなたはこれが実話だと知ってる。
english: Karikiri-san. You know this is a true story.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なぜなら、あなたは……
この一部始終を見ていたはずだからだ。
english: After all, you've watched it all unfold first-hand.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: この写真を見てください。
english: Please look at this photo.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
写りも小さいし、
初めは気付きませんでしたよ。
english: It's small, so I didn't notice at first.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、菱形先生にそれを見せると、
それはあなただと言った。
english: But when I showed it to Dr. Hishigata, he said it was you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
右隣の男性は、
菱形先生のおじいさんだそうですね。
english: The man on the right is apparently Dr. Hishigata's grandfather.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
７０年も昔の写真に……
なぜあなたが写ってるんですか？
english: In a photo from 70 years ago... Why are you in it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
雁切真砂人さん。
いや……。
english: Karikiri Masahito-san. No...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 菱形……紙垂彦！
english: Hishigata... Shidehiko!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえが、シデだ。
english: You are Shide.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （出方次第では躊躇なく撃つ……！）
english: (Depending on his move, I'll shoot without hesitation...!)

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 慎平くん――
english: Shinpei-kun--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 動くな。
english: Don't move.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 動けば撃つ。
english: If you move, I shoot.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……次に動いたら殺す。
english: ...If you move again, I'll kill you.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
菱形先生が……。
何を喋ったんです……？
english: What has Dr. Hishigata told ya?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえの質問には答えない。
聞くんはオレや。
english: I'm not answering your questions. I'm the one asking.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
昨日の夜、体育館から逃げた後、
おまえは菱形先生を
切り捨てる判断を下した。
english: Last night, after escaping the gym, you made the decision to cut off Dr. Hishigata.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
看護師のネゴロさんを送り込んで、
潮の遺体の回収と菱形先生の消去を命じた。
english: You sent in Nurse Negoro-san, and ordered her to recover Ushio's body and erase Dr. Hishigata.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もう１枚、写真がある。
それを見てみろ。
english: Look at the other photograph.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ネゴロさんは菱形先生の記憶をスキャンし、
その写真が金庫に隠されていることを知り、
隠滅しようとした……。
english: Negoro-san scanned Dr. Hishigata's memories, learned that the photo was hidden in a safe, and tried to destroy it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なぜならそこには、
おまえの正体が写ってるからや。
english: Because your true identity is captured in it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
けど、菱形先生は金庫を
トキちゃんに隠させて……。
自分はその場所を知らんようにしてたんや。
english: But Dr. Hishigata had Toki-chan hide the safe... And made it so he himself wouldn't know its location.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
時代は下って４０年前。
それは菱形先生のお父さんが撮ったもんや。
english: Moving down to 40 years ago. That was taken by Dr. Hishigata's father.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえは影じゃない。
でも、ただの人間でもない……。
english: You're not a shadow. But you're not just a normal human either...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレは、今まで得た手掛かりをもとに
　この真相にたどり着いた）
english: (Based on the clues I've gathered so far, I arrived at this truth.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（４周目、７月２３日。
　菱形医院、旧病棟探索中に見つけた
　奇妙な像――）
english: (4th loop, July 23rd. The strange statue I found while exploring the old ward of the Hishigata Clinic--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あれがヒルコ様の像なのだとしたら、
　菱形医院と日都神社に繋がりがあるのではと
　考えるようになった）
english: (If that was a statue of Hiruko-sama, I started to think there might be a connection between the Hishigata Clinic and Hitogashima Shrine.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (5th loop, July 22nd.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（第四砲台跡、
　南雲先生と根津さんの疑似ループ後――）
english: (At the Fourth Gun Battery Ruins, after the pseudo-loop with Nagumo-sensei and Nezu-san--)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 四本腕の正体は雁切真砂人かもな。
english: The true identity of the four-armed one might be Karikiri Masahito.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
はァ！？
雁切の倅が！？
english: Hah!? Karikiri's son!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: キミ達もそう考えているのでは？
english: Weren't you guys thinking that too?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Yeah...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ヒルコ様が……ハイネが影の母やったら、
それを祀ってる日都神社がめっちゃ怪しいやん？
雁切さんは神社の宮司なんやから……。
english: If Hiruko-sama... if Haine is the mother of shadows, then Hitogashima Shrine that worships her is super suspicious, right? Since Karikiri-san is the shrine's chief priest...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ほやけど……。
雁切は人間なんやろ？
english: Yeah, but ain't Karikiri a human?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
四本腕は、なぜ顔を隠す？
ヤツが影なら、誰か別人に変身すれば
いいだけのことなのに……。
english: Why does the four-armed one hide its face? If it were a shadow, it could just transform into someone else...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
実はヤツは人間で、
「コピー能力がない」としたらどうだ……？
english: What if he's actually human, and 'doesn't have copy abilities'?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
確かに、あいつがスキャンする所を
見たことないけど……。
でも、プリントはしてましたね……。
english: True, I've never seen him scan anything... But he did print things...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
影を構成するあの黒い泥……。
未知のエキゾチック物質と思われるが。
english:
That black mud which constitutes the shadow…
It seems to be an unknown exotic substance.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
四本腕は、その泥を
鎧のように纏っている人間だとすれば……？
english: What if the four-armed one is a human wearing that mud like armor...?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
顔を隠すっちゅうことは、見られたらマズイ……。
つまり、儂らがよく知っている人物……。
english: Hiding his face means it'd be bad if he was seen... In other words, a person we know well...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
四本腕の目的はハイネを……。
あの子を復活させることなのか……。
english: The four-armed one's goal is Haine... To resurrect that child...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……影たちは明後日の夏祭りに
大勢の人を殺し……
ハイネに食べさせるつもりのようです。
english: ...It seems the shadows intend to kill a lot of people at the summer festival the day after tomorrow... and feed them to Haine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
その儀式の先に何があるのかはわかりませんが、
四本腕は確か「エンディング」って……。
english: I don't know what lies beyond that ritual, but the four-armed one definitely called it an 'ending'...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（６周目、７月２２日。
　コバマート突入中止後――）
english: (6th loop, July 22nd. After aborting the Koba Mart entry--)

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 網代くん……あまり無理しないでね？
english: Ajiro-kun... don't push yourself too hard, okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: じゃあ、オレたちも行きますか。
english: Then we'll go as well.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: その前に話しておきたいことがある……。
english: There's something I want to talk about before that...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 話しておきたいこと？
english: Something you want to talk about?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
やはり四本腕は雁切真砂人だ。
今、潮の記憶でヤツと対面して確信した。
english: The four-armed one is Karikiri Masahito after all. I'm convinced of it now after facing him in Ushio's memories.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: なんでわかったん！？
english: How did you figure that out!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私はあの宮司が昔から苦手だった……。
四本腕もまったく同じく生理的に受け付けない！
english: I've always been bad with that priest... I instinctively reject the four-armed one in the exact same way!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
何じゃそら！！
おまえの感覚やないか！
english: What the heck!! That's just your intuition!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
鎧で顔は隠せても
人間性までは隠せない……。
english: Even if he can hide his face with armor, he can't hide his humanity...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
それに、
根津の「影縫い」が効かなかったのも
ヤツが人である可能性を高めた。
english: Besides, the fact that Nezu's 'Shadow Weaving' didn't work also increased the possibility that he's human.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、雁切さんはあの時間、
まだ葬儀場にいるはず……。
english: But Karikiri-san should still be at the funeral venue at that time...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 葬儀は影に任せたんかも。
english: Maybe he sent his shadow to the funeral.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ホンマに中身があるんやったら……。
暗殺っちゅう手ェが使えるなァ……。
english: If there really is someone inside... We can use the assassination method...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ヤツがただの人なら
殺すのは造作もない。
english:
If he's just human,
killing him would be easy.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
気付かぬフリで神社へ行き、
世間話でもしている間にズドン、だ。
english: Go to the shrine pretending not to know, and then BAM while making small talk.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
いや、それ殺人ですよ！！！
もっと決定的な確証がないと……。
english: No, that's murder!!! Unless we have more decisive proof...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それに人なら……追いつめれば、
話し合いに応じるかもしれませんよ。
english: Besides, if he's human... if we corner him, he might agree to talk.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: そうだといいのだがな……。
english: It would be good if that were the case...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
潮、確認したいのだが。
ハッキングでミオをこちらの仲間に
できないか？
english: Ushio, I'd like to confirm something. Can you make Mio our ally by hacking her?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そっか……！！
私と同じに、ハイネのテレパシーを
受信せんようにしたらええんや！
english: Oh, I see...!! I just have to make it so she doesn't receive Haine's telepathy, just like me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（７周目、７月２２日。
　体育館戦後――）
english: (7th loop, July 22nd. After the gym battle--)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
炎は影に有効だった……
シデと同化した通常の影は即死。
シデに対しても、動きを鈍らせる効果があった。
english: Fire was effective against shadows... Normal shadows assimilated with Shide died instantly. It also had the effect of slowing Shide's movements.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
さらに潮の「ハッキング」で、
シデの体内に誰かが入っていることが
偶発的に判明……。
english: Furthermore, through Ushio's 'hacking', it was accidentally revealed that someone was inside Shide's body...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
シデは左手に火傷を負った。
これは正体への目印となるだろう。
english: Shide suffered a burn on the left hand. This will likely serve as a mark to identify their true identity.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（７周目、７月２２日。
　菱形医院地下――）
english: (7th loop, July 22nd. Hishigata Clinic basement--)

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
ヤツはハイネの守護者であり、
彼女が最初に産んだ子供だ。
english:
He is Haine's guardian,  
and her first child.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: オリジナルの名は菱形紙垂彦。
english: The original name was Shidehiko Hishigata.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: 菱形医院の創始者、初代院長だ。
english: The founder and first director of the Hishigata Clinic.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
まだ朱鷺子は知らなかった……。
シデの正体についてはな……。
english: Tokiko still didn't know... About Shide's true identity...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: この子は私の指示で、金庫を隠しただけだ。
english: This child merely hid the safe on my instructions.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: そしてこれが……。
english: And this is…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: な……何ですか、この写真は！？
english: Wh-What is this photograph?

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
菱形家は古代からこの島の祭祀を司っていたが、
江戸時代中頃に、紙垂彦の父が医者の真似事を始めた……。
english: The Hishigata family had overseen the island's religious rituals since ancient times, but in the mid-Edo period, Shidehiko's father started imitating a doctor...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: それが菱形医院の原点だ……。
english: That was the origin of the Hishigata Clinic...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
待ってくれ！
菱形って……雁切やろ！？
神社は……。
english: Wait a minute! Hishigata... you mean Karikiri, right!? The shrine is...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
菱形と雁切は、元々は同じ家なんだ……。
雁切は、菱形から分かれてできた家系だ。
english: Hishigata and Karikiri were originally the same family... Karikiri is a lineage that branched off from Hishigata.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: なっ……。
english: Wha...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: キミたちはヒルコ伝承を知っているかね？
english: Do you know the Hiruko legend?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ヒルコが流れ着いた日……。
english: The day Hiruko washed ashore...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ヒルコはハイネになり、
ハイネは島民たちに神として祀られたのか……。
english: Hiruko became Haine, and Haine was enshrined as a god by the islanders...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: ……そうだ。
english: …That's right.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
やがて紙垂彦は……
神と交わり、子をなした。
english: Eventually, Shidehiko... communed with the god and bore a child.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
影として平面から分娩されたんじゃない。
立体の……。
english: It wasn't given birth from a 2D plane as a shadow. From a 3D...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
ハイネの肉体を妊娠させ、
出産させたのだ……。
english: He impregnated Haine's physical body and made her give birth...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
そして「神の夫」を自称し、
波稲の苗字、雁切を名乗り始める……。
english: And then he styled himself 'Husband of God', and began using Haine's surname, Karikiri...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: そして、紙垂彦には兄がいた。
english: Shidehiko also had a brother.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
ハイネの出産後、菱形家は分家した。
以後は雁切家が神を祀り……。
english: After Haine gave birth, the Hishigata family split into branches. From then on, the Karikiri family worshipped the god...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: 菱形家が医者の家系となったんだ。
english: And the Hishigata family became a lineage of doctors.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
つまり、シデと菱形は
血の繋がった遠い親戚……！？
english: In other words, Shide and Hishigata are blood-related distant relatives...!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ……アホな。
english: ...That's stupid.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……それで、その生まれた子供は！？
english: What happened to the child?

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
その赤子は長ずるにつれ、
紙垂彦に瓜二つとなっていったらしい。
english: As that baby grew up, he apparently became the spitting image of Shidehiko.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
これが影の性質なんだろう……。
ハイネが妊娠すると産まれてくる子は
父のクローンなんだ。
english: This is probably the nature of shadows... The child born when Haine gets pregnant is a clone of the father.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: ここからだ……。
english: This is where it begins...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
それを見た紙垂彦は、
ある欲望を目覚めさせた……。
english: Seeing that, Shidehiko awakened a certain desire...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …No way…

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
ヤツはハイネに、
自分の人格と記憶をコピーさせ、
クローンに移植させたんだ。
english: He had Haine copy his own personality and memories, and transplanted them into the clone.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
そうすることで
「若返り」をしたんだよ。
english: By doing so, he achieved 'rejuvenation'.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
反吐が出る……。
道理でいけ好かんわけだ……。
english: Makes me want to puke... No wonder I couldn't stand him...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
取り上げたのは私の父だ……。
その写真も父が撮った。
今のヤツの肉体が産まれた時のものだよ。
english: The one who delivered him was my father... My father took that photo too. It's from when his current body was born.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
シデはこの秘術を繰り返し、
自分を産んだ母に自分を産ませ続けて……。
english: Shide has been repeating this secret art, continuing to have the mother who birthed him give birth to him...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
３００年前から現在まで
生き続けているのさ……。
english: He's been living continuously from 300 years ago up to the present...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……<color=#GF_TIPS_003>おまえ</color>の体は、４０年前に産まれた人や。
english: ...<color=#GF_TIPS_003>Your</color> body is that of a person born 40 years ago.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
けど、中身は３００年前の
菱形紙垂彦なんや……！！
english: But your inside is Shidehiko Hishigata from 300 years ago...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 人と影の交配種……！！
english: A hybrid of human and shadow...!!

japanese: 8.シデ
english: 8.Shide

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
やれやれ……。
ズルイなァ、慎平くん……。
ループするんやもん……。
english: Good grief... That's unfair, Shinpei-kun... Looping like that...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 帰省して一日でここまで来ますか……。
english: Ya can't possibly know so much in just one day...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
けどまァ、落ち着いて。
麦茶、座って一杯いかがです。
大丈夫、毒なんか入ってませんよ。
english: But well, calm down. How about sitting down for a cup of barley tea? It's okay, there's no poison in it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 認めるんやな！？
english: You're admitting it!?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ふ……菱形先生が、
全部喋ってもうたみたいですね……。
english: Heh... It seems Dr. Hishigata has spilled everything...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ……ハァ。
english: ...Haa.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あの時はねェ……。
私が４０の時やから……。
english: At that time, you see... I was 40 years old, so...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
１７３２年の夏ですね。
世に言う、「享保の大飢饉」が起きた年です。
english: It was the summer of 1732. The year of what they call the 'Great Kyoho Famine'.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
知ってます？
日本史の教科書に載ってますよ。
english: It's in the Japanese history textbooks.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
えらい凶作でね……。
飢えで人がようけ死んだ。
english: It was a terrible crop failure... A lot of people died from starvation.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
漁に出る大人が死んで、
魚も獲れんようになってしもてな。
そらァもう生き地獄でしたよ。
english: The adults who went out fishing died, and we couldn't even catch fish anymore. It was a living hell, I tell you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……でも、そこにハイネが顕れた。
english: ...But then, Haine showed up.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そもそもこの島では、海から流れ着いた物に
神様が宿るって信じてたから……。
english: To begin with, on this island, we believed that gods dwelled in things that washed ashore from the sea...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハイネはまさに神そのものやった。
english: Haine was truly a god itself.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そして、彼女は人を食う。
かわりに豊漁をもたらしたと……。
english: And, she ate people. In exchange, she brought bountiful catches...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あ～～～～。
その伝承……その件は誤りですね。
english: Ah~~~~. That legend... that part is incorrect.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
島民を何百人か影に変えただけですよ。
影やったら漁師でなくとも、
舟も網もなくとも魚を獲れる……。
english: I just turned a few hundred islanders into shadows. If you're a shadow, even if you're not a fisherman, even without a boat or nets, you can catch fish...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 飢えた人を救うことができる……。
english: You can save starving people...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 日都ヶ島が今あるのは、私のおかげなんですよ。
english: The reason Hitogashima exists today is thanks to me.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ふざけんな、この野郎ッ！！
自分が正しい事してるつもり！！？
english: Don't screw with me, you bastard!! Do you think you're doing the right thing!!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
じゃあ、なんで……！
なんで慎平の両親を殺した！！！
english: Then, why...! Why'd ya kill Shinpei's parents!!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
そりゃあ潮ちゃんと同じく、
邪魔やったからでしょうが。
english: Well, just like Ushio-chan, because they were in the way, of course.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ヒルコ洞を発見して……公表しようとしましてね。
まったく、余計な事さえせんかったら、
もう少し長生きできたもんを……。
english: They discovered Hiruko Cave... and tried to make it public. Good grief, if they just hadn't done anything unnecessary, they could have lived a little longer...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
愚かな夫婦でしたが、
母が美味しくいただきました……。
english: They were a foolish couple, but Mother ate them deliciously...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: あっ。
english: Ah.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
もしかして、影にしといた方が
嬉しかったかなァ？
english: Maybe you would have been happier if I had turned them into shadows?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オ……オレは、
おまえとは違う……！！
english: I... I'm different from you...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
人殺しなんかしたくない……。
おまえかて死にたないやろ！！
english: I don't want to kill anyone... You don't want to die either, do you!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんでや？
なんでそこまでハイネを守る！？
english: Why? Why go so far to protect Haine!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえは人や……ハイネが帰る故郷に、
おまえは一緒に行けんはずやし……。
english: You're human... You shouldn't be able to go together to the hometown Haine is returning to...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハイネが死んでも、
おまえが死ぬわけでもない！
english:
Even if Haine dies,
you won't die either!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハイネをさし出せ……。
それで……終わりにできやんか……？
english: Hand over Haine... Can't we... end it with that...?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
それは私の終わりではない。
母の願いを叶える事が私の使命。
english: That is not my ending. Fulfilling my mother's wish is my mission.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（クソッ！
　クソッ……！！）
english: (Damn it! Damn it...!!)

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
それにわかりませんよ。
私の影がいるのかも。
english: Besides, you never know. My shadow might be around.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……何かがおかしい……）
english: (…Something's wrong…)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
引き金を引いて！！
近くに影の気配はない！！
english: Pull the trigger!! There's no shadow presence nearby!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なぜ？　なぜこいつは――）
english: (Why? Why is this guy--)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
撃って慎平！！！
シデを倒すのは今しかないッ！！
english: Shoot, Shinpei!!! Now is the only time to defeat Shide!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
わかりますよ。
キミは今こう考えてる……。
english: I understand. You're thinking this right now...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
「なんでこいつは左手に
　火傷してへんのや？」
english: Why ain't his left hand burned?'

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ……ってね。
english: ...Right.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ところで慎平くん。
もう私、動いてもええんですか？
english: By the way, Shinpei-kun. Is it okay if I move now?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ここまでや！
もうガマンできやんッ！！
english: This is it! I can't hold back anymore!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮、待――
english: Ushio, wait--

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
死んでる……。
……これで、終わり？
english: He's dead... ...Is it over with this?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレがやるって……。
言うた、やろ……。
english: I said... I would do it, didn't I...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえにこんなこと……。
させるつもりじゃ……。
english: I never intended... to make you do something like this...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: やっぱり慎平が人殺しらしたあかん。
english: I can't let ya murder someone.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんでや！！！
こいつはオレの！！
仇や……！！！！
english: Why!!! This guy is my!! Enemy...!!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平は優しいから、きっと後悔したよ。
english: Shinpei is kind, so I'm sure you would have regretted it.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
人として見てるやろ？
私のことも、こんなヤツのことも……。
english: You see us as human, right? Both me, and a guy like this...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 汚れ役は、全部私に任しとき！！
english: Leave all the dirty work from now on to me!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハァッ……ハァッ……！
くッ……ハァッ……！！
english: Hah... Hah...! Kuh... Hah...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平……！
english: Shinpei!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ウ、ウシオ……オレ……。
english: U-Ushio... I...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （人を……撃ってしまった……！）
english: (I... shot a person...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しかし……どうしてコイツは
　左手に……）
english: (But... why doesn't this guy have...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……火傷をしていないんだ……！？）
english: (...a burn on his left hand...!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
落ち着いて。
ゆっくり深呼吸して……。
english: Calm down. Take a slow deep breath...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あ、ああ……。
english: Y-Yeah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: スゥー……。
english: *Inhale*...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァー……。
english: *Exhale*...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 落ち着いた？
english: Have you calmed down?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……スマン……。
情けない姿見せたな……。
english: Yeah... sorry... I showed you a pathetic side of me...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……やっぱり私がやったらよかった。
english: ...I should have done it after all.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: な、何でや……？
english: Wh-Why...?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平は優しいから……。
今、めっちゃ後悔してるやろ……？
english: Because Shinpei is kind... You're regretting it a lot right now, aren't you...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それは……。
english: That's…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
それは人として見てるからや。
私のことも、こんなヤツのことも……。
english: That's because you see us as humans. Both me, and a guy like this...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: だから……。
english: So…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
これからの汚れ役は、
全部私に任しとき！！
english: Leave all the dirty work from now on to me!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
貸してん！
電話、まだ繋ぎっぱなしやろ？
english: Let me borrow that! The phone is still connected, right?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: もしもし、みんな聞いてた？
english: Hello, was everyone listening?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: シデは殺し――
english: We killed Shide--

speaker: Ushio
english: ...Shin--

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: はい、ワンダウン。
english: Yes, one down.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ごめん……慎平……。
気づ……い……て……っ。
english: Sorry... Shinpei... Notice... it...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
残念やったねえ……。
慎平くん……。
english: That's too bad... Shinpei-kun...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ほんのちょっぴり。
フカンが足らんかったんと――
english: Just a tiny bit. Your bird's-eye view wasn't quite enough--

speaker: Shide
japanese: ちゃいますか。
english: Don't you think?

speaker: Shide
japanese: 今。
english: Now.

speaker: Shide
japanese: どんな気分ですか、慎平くん。
english: How does it feel, Shinpei-kun?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ラスボス前のセーブデータが消えた、
小学生の気分かな……？
english: Like an elementary schooler whose save data got erased right before the final boss...?

speaker: Shide
japanese: ウシオは死んだ。
english: Ushio is dead.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
餓鬼どもが、
この私のエンディングを変えられるとでも？
english: Did you brats really think you could change my ending?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 大丈夫よ、慎平……。
english: It's okay, Shinpei…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 何があっても――
english: No matter what…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 私がついてる……。
english: I'm with you...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
キミとループするんは、
絶望と後悔だけや……。
english: The only things looping with you are despair and regret...

speaker: Shide
japanese: いってらっしゃい。
english: Take care now.

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_07>７度目のＥＮＤ</color>】を入手しました。
english: Acquired Key TIP: [<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_07>7th END</color>].

japanese: 9周目
english: 9th Loop

japanese: 9.オレからの電話？
english: 9. A Call from Me?

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハッ……ハァッ……。
english: Hah... Hah...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よし……無事に到着した……！
　時間は……１０時４５分……！）
english: (Alright... arrived safely...! The time is... 10:45...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （子供三人連れて約４０分か……！）
english: (About 40 minutes with three kids...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アラン！
ただいまっ！！
english:
Alain!
I'm back!!

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
ん？　おや……。
これまたちっこいお客さん連れて……。
english: Hm? Oh... You've brought some tiny guests with you again...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハァ……ハァ……。
みっ、澪たちは！！？
english: Hah... Hah... M-Mio and the others!!?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
え？　あァ。
トキちゃんからもそんな電話あっと……。
english: Eh? Ah. I got a call like that from Toki-chan too...

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
澪は窓といっしょに出かけてったんや。
「おまえに会う」いうて……。
english: Mio went out together with Sou. Said they were 'going to meet you'...

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: もう３０分ほど前やぞ。
english: It was about 30 minutes ago.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
どこへ行くって！？
場所は！？
english: Where did they say they were going!? Where!?

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese: いや……そこまでは……。
english: Well... I don't know that much...

speaker: Alan Kofune
japanese:
慎平！
なんどあったんか！？
english: Shinpei! What happened?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アラン！
その子らのこと頼む！！
english: Alain! Take care of those kids!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（頼む！　澪！　窓！
　電話に出てくれ！）
english: (Please! Mio! Sou! Answer the phone!)

speaker: 音声ガイダンス
japanese:
おかけになった電話は
電波の届かない場所にあるか――
english: The number you have dialed is either out of the service area--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……くっ。
english: ...Kuh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （澪たちが出てったのが３０分ほど前……）
english: (Mio and the others left about 30 minutes ago...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（対して、こっちは山の上から
　子供連れて約４０分……）
english: (On the other hand, it took us about 40 minutes coming down from the mountain with the kids...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （コフネまで３０分以上かかってる……）
english: (It took over 30 minutes to get to Kofune...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（電波が入るようになってから、
　ずっとかけてるが誰にも繋がらない！）
english: (I've been calling non-stop since we got signal, but I can't reach anyone!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（「オレに会う」だと！？
　まさかオレの影がいるのか……！！）
english: ('Going to meet me'!? Could my shadow be here...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なぜ！？
　オレはコピーされてない！）
english:
(Why!?
I wasn't copied!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（葬儀でコピーされたことも、
　コバマートの３階でコピーされたことも、
　全部なかったことになって――）
english: (Getting copied at the funeral, getting copied on the 3rd floor of Koba Mart, all of that was undone--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (...No, that's wrong!!)

speaker: Totsumura
japanese: ……これもコピーすんのォ？
english: ...You wanna copy him too?

speaker: Mio
japanese: いや……。
english: No…

speaker: Mio
japanese:
これはもう……
オカアサンがコピーしてる……。
english: He's already been... copied by Mother...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレをコピーしたのは
　ハイネじゃないか！！！！）
english: (The one who copied me was Haine!!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そしてハイネは……。
　３周目の夏祭りの終わりから来た……）
english: (And Haine... came from the end of the summer festival in the 3rd loop...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（３周目、
　コバマートでコピーされたオレの影が、
　８周目の今になって使われたんだ……！！）
english: (The shadow of me that was copied at Koba Mart in the 3rd loop, is being used now in the 8th loop...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でもどうやって電話を！？
　疑われずに！？）
english: (But how did he make a phone call!? Without being suspected!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレのケータイをコピーした所で、
　本物を消さないと使えな……い――）
english: (Even if he copied my phone, he couldn't use it without erasing the real one...)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎……ちゃん……？
english: Shin… chan…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今の声……！
　オレの部屋から！？）
english:
(The voice just now…!
From my room?!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……な、なんで慎ちゃんが……ここに……！？
english: ...Wh-Why are ya... here...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ミオ！？
english: Mio!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いったい誰がこんな……。
english: Who on earth did this...

speaker: Mio
japanese: まさか……さっきの電話は……。
english: No way... So that call just now was...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ふぅ……大丈夫か？
english: Phew... are you okay?

speaker: Mio
japanese: もっと優しに抜いてよね……。
english: Ya coulda taken 'em out more gently...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: M-My bad...!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん、手ェ……。
私の記憶をあげる。
english: Shin-chan, your hand... I'll give you my memories.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
澪っ！！？
どうしてミオを……！
english: Mio!!? Why did you do that to Mio...!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃんが言うてたの……。
お姉ちゃんが死んだって……。
english: Shin-chan told me... That Sis had died...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
だから、ハッキングが
解けたら危ないって……。
english: So, it would be dangerous if the hacking came undone...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: またミオが敵になるかも知らんって！！
english: That Mio might become an enemy again!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そんな……。
english: That's...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ミオを縫いつけたのは、
澪だったのか……。
english: The one who nailed Mio down was Mio...?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
澪に慎ちゃんのスマホから電話があって、
「お姉ちゃんが死んだ」って……。
それはホンマ？
english: Mio got a call from Shin-chan's smartphone saying 'Sis died'... Is that true?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、だけどその電話はオレじゃない……！！
オレの影が澪たちを騙したんや……。
english: Yeah, but that call wasn't from me...!! My shadow tricked Mio and the others...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
……ごめん。
私、澪を守れてへん。
english: ...I'm sorry. I wasn't able to protect Mio.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃんの影がいたのは知ってる。
お姉ちゃんの疑似ループで見たし。
english: I know Shin-chan's shadow was there. I saw it in Sis's pseudo-loop.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
あれはシオリ――ハイネにコピーされて
産まれたってのも慎ちゃんから聞いた。
english: I also heard from Shin-chan that it was born by being copied by Shiori--Haine.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……でもまさか、今……。
オレのケータイが、この世に「２台」
使える状態で存在してるとは……。
english: Yeah... but to think that right now... There are 'two' of my phones existing in a usable state in this world...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 迂闊やった……。
english: I was careless...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっき思い出したよ……。
３周目、神社でオレの影と会った時、
あいつは本物のケータイを奪ってった……。
english: I just remembered... In the 3rd loop, when I met my shadow at the shrine, he stole my real phone...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
最後に影がみんな、
ハイネの体に取り込まれてったやろ？
english: In the end, all the shadows were absorbed into Haine's body, right?

speaker: Mio
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see…

speaker: Mio
japanese:
あの時、本物が消去されて、
ケータイのコピーが使える状態になった上で
ハイネの中に……。
english: At that time, the real one was erased, and the copied phone became usable while inside Haine...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
それをこのタイミングで使ってくるって……。
さすが慎ちゃんの影やな。
english: To use it at this timing... As expected of Shin-chan's shadow.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 褒めてる場合かよ……！！
english: This isn't the time to be praising him...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハイネは南雲先生の記憶も読んでる……。
マズイぞ……先生の連絡先もバレてる……。
english: Haine has read Nagumo-sensei's memories too... This is bad... Sensei's contact info is exposed too...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪たちはどこへ行くって！？
english: Where'd Mio and Sou go?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……！！
先生からの着信……！！
english: ...!! An incoming call from Sensei...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: もしもしっ！？
english: Hello!?

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: ……よォ、慎平。
english: …Hey, Shinpei.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (...My voice...!)

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
どうじゃ？
影からの電話は。
english: How is it? A phone call from a shadow.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえ……ハイネか……。
なんで先生のケータイから……。
先生はどうしたッ！？
english: You're... Haine, aren't you... Why from Sensei's phone... What did you do to Sensei!?

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: 自分の目で確かめよ、観測者……。
english: Come see fer yerself, Observer...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
ひづるたちは虎島に、
澪たちはアランの畑におる……。
english: Hizuru and her group are on Torashima, Mio and her group are at Alain's field...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
おまん次第じゃ。
どっちを助けに行くかはな。
english: It's up to you. Which one you go to save.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まっ……オイ……。
待てよ――
english: Wa... Hey... Wait a--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もしもしッ！
もしもし！？
english: Hello! Hello!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
落ち着いて、慎ちゃん。
いろんな可能性を考えやな……。
english: Calm down, Shin-chan. We have to think of all possibilities...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: わかってる……。
english: I know…

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ハイネは今、慎ちゃんの人格で思考してる。
私らもフカンされてる。
english: Haine is currently thinking with your personality, Shin-chan. We're being looked down on from a bird's-eye view too.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: くっ……。
english: Kuh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （虎島とアランの畑は逆の方角だ……！）
english: (Torashima and Alain's field are in opposite directions...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どちらに行けばもう片方を助けられないかも
　しれない）
english: (If I go to one, I might not be able to save the other.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（フカンしろ。
　フカンしろ……）
english: (Take a bird's-eye view. Take a bird's-eye view...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハイネはなんでこんな……。
　回りくどいことを！？）
english: (Why is Haine doing such a... roundabout thing!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪か、先生か……。
english: Mio or sensei…

speaker: Mio
japanese:
どっちもウソで……。
どっちももう殺されてるかも。
english: Both could be lies... Both of them might already be killed.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……だからって、
何もせんわけにいかんやろ！！
english: ...But even so, we can't just do nothing!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
せんかったこと
悔やむくらいやったら……
したことを後悔する……。
english: If I'm going to regret not doing something... I'd rather regret doing something...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
かき集めろ……。
武器になりそうなモン……。
english: Gather them up... Anything that could be a weapon...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 全部や……！！
english: All of it...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （戻って来れた、か……）
english: (I was able to return, huh...)

speaker: Akari Toudai
japanese:
き、危機は脱した……。
ということでしょうか？
english: W-We've escaped the crisis... Is that what this means?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（タカノス山……！
　ハイネが去った直後か！）
english: (Mt. Takanosu...! Right after Haine left!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（周りの野良は……。
　よし、消えてる）
english: (The Strays around us... Good, they're gone.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（前の周回と変わってない……。
　それなら……！）
english: (It hasn't changed from the previous loop... In that case...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……そうやな。
危機は脱した……もう安全や。
english: ...Yeah. We've escaped the crisis... it's safe now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
けど、万が一ってこともあるからな。
みんなはこのままコフネに避難してくれ。
オレがいなくても行けるな？
english: But there's always the worst-case scenario. Everyone, evacuate to Kofune just like this. You can go even without me, right?

speaker: Shun Hamaji
japanese: 一緒に行ってくれやんの？
english: Won't you come with us?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレはやる事がある。
緊急事態ってやつや……！
english: I have something to do. It's an emergency...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だから、あかりちゃんの事……。
コフネまで連れてってくれ。
……兄貴やろ？
english: So, about Akari-chan... Take her to Kofune. ...You're her big brother, right?

speaker: Shun Hamaji
japanese:
……わかった！
みんな行くぞー！
english: ...Got it! Everyone, let's go!

speaker: 灯台照と浜路あかり
japanese: おーっ！！
english: Yeah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（子供たちには悪いが、
　一人でコフネに急いだほうが早い）
english: (I feel bad for the kids, but it's faster if I hurry to Kofune alone.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（影が再度襲いかかってくる
　可能性はなくはないが……）
english: (It's not like there's no possibility of the shadows attacking again, but...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あの場でハイネ以外も撤退する意味がない）
english: (There's no reason for anyone other than Haine to retreat in that situation.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（つまり……。
　あれは何か理由のある撤退……！）
english: (In other words... That was a retreat with some kind of reason...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（なら、前回もそうだったように、
　無事にコフネまで辿り着ける
　可能性のほうが高い！）
english: (Then, just like last time, the possibility of them reaching Kofune safely is higher!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （だったら、優先すべき行動は明白……！）
english: (If so, the action I should prioritize is clear...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪と窓がアランの畑に着く前に
　なんとしても止めないと！）
english: (I have to stop Mio and Sou no matter what before they reach Alain's field!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ミオ！
大丈夫か！？
english:
Mio!
Are you okay?!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
し、慎ちゃん……！？
なんでここに――
english: Sh-Shin-chan...!? Why are you here--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 説明は後や……釘を抜くぞ！
english: Explanations later... I'm pulling out the nails!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
手荒でスマン。
けど、今は１分１秒も無駄にできない。
english: Sorry for being rough. But right now, I can't waste a single second.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
……さっきの電話…………。
もしかして慎ちゃんの影？
english: ...That phone call from earlier... Could it be Shin-chan's shadow?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……ハイネの罠や。
だから、出てった二人を止める。
english: Yeah... it's Haine's trap. That's why we have to stop those two who went out.

japanese: 「とにかく最短距離を急ぐぞ」
english: "Let's hurry via the shortest route."

japanese: 「人目につかない下水を通るぞ」
english: "We'll go through the sewers where no one will see us."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: とにかく急ぐぞ！
english: Anyway, let's hurry!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
……わかった。
最短距離でええんやね？
english: ...Understood. The shortest route is fine, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ほんなら、背中捕まって。
それと走ってる時は口閉じる。
english: Then, grab onto my back. Also, keep your mouth closed while we're running.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
わかってる。
舌なんか噛んでられんからな。
english: I know. I can't afford to bite my tongue.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 人目につかない<color=#GF_KEY_GESUIDO>下水</color>を通るぞ！
english: We'll go through the <color=#GF_KEY_GESUIDO>sewers</color> where we won't be seen!

speaker: Mio
japanese: 下水……？
english: Sewers…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
日都ヶ島には無数の地下道がある。
敵の気配に気をつけながら最短の道で向かう。
english: Hitogashima has countless underground passages. We'll head there via the shortest route while being careful of enemy presence.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今さっきも言った通り、
相手してる暇はないからな。
english: As I just said, we don't have time to deal with them.

speaker: Mio
japanese: わかった。
english: Understood.

japanese: 10周目
english: 10th Loop

japanese: 10.分断された仲間たち①
english: 10. Divided Companions 1

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おっ、おまえら……。
english: Y-You guys...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんでここに！？
慎ちゃん！？
english: Why are you here!? Shin-chan!?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん……？
english: Shin-chan...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ああ、大丈夫。
大丈夫やから……。
english: ...Yeah, it's okay. It's okay, so...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おい、慎平！
ミオを助けたんか！？
english:
Hey Shinpei!
Did you save Mio!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓……こいつは……。
ああ、いや、今は時間がない。
english: Sou... she is... Ah, no, there's no time right now.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ミオ、虎島に行くぞ。
窓たちはここで待っといてくれ。
english: Mio, we're going to Torashima. Sou, you guys wait here.

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……まさか、慎ちゃん……。
english: ...No way, Shin-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、戻って来た。
english: Yeah, I came back.

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
ハァ……ハァ……。
くっ……。
english: Hah... Hah... Kuh...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
お、おい……。
マズイんやないのか……？
アレ……。
english: H-Hey... Isn't this bad...? That thing...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……チッ！
猟銃を破壊されたんは痛かったわ……。
english: ...Tch! Having the hunting rifle destroyed hurts...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
残った武器は、儂の山刀とおまえの拳銃、
朱鷺子のギル……！
english: Our remaining weapons are my machete, your handgun, and Tokiko's Gil...!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
さすがのひづるちゃんも
満身創痍のようですね。
english: It seems even you are covered in wounds, Hizuru-chan.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ご自慢のハンマーも壊れてもうたし……。
私の天沼矛を奪うことも
失敗しました。
english: Your prized hammer is broken too... And you failed to steal my Amenonuhoko.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
そろそろ体も限界やないですか。
この窮地から脱する奥の手はないんですか？
english: Your body is just about at its limit, isn't it? Don't you have any secret trump card to escape this predicament?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（竜之介、聞こえるか……。
　アレをやるぞ……
　ヤツの鎧に憑依して中から破壊するんだ）
english: (Ryunosuke, can you hear me... We're doing that... Possess his armor and destroy him from the inside.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（私の体を気遣う必要はない。
　遠慮はするな。
　全力で……シデの懐に入れ！！）
english: (You don't need to worry about my body. Don't hold back. With all your strength... get inside Shide's guard!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: ……わかった、お姉ちゃん。
english: ...Got it, Sis.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
油断したな、シデ……。
確かに触れたぞ、貴様の体……！
english: You let your guard down, Shide... I definitely touched it, your body...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
中から壊せ！！
竜之す――
english: Destroy him from the inside!! Ryunosu--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ぐふ……ッ！？
english: Guhu...!?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
アイツ……自分の体の一部を
切り落としやがった……。
ど、どうなっとんのや……！？
english: That guy... cut off a part of his own body... Wh-What is going on...!?

speaker: Shide
japanese: ……いやァ、惜しかったですねえ。
english: ...Well now, that was close.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
竜之介くんを
私の鎧に憑依させようとしたでしょ？
危なかったなァ。
english: You tried to have Ryunosuke-kun possess my armor, didn't you? That was dangerous.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
だから彼が触れる直前に
泥の一部を切り離させてもらったんです。
english: So I took the liberty of detaching a part of the mud right before he touched it.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……りゅ、竜之介はどこだ……？
english: ...Wh-Where is Ryunosuke...?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
さァ？
そのへんに落ちてる泥の中やないですか？
……ほら、きっとそれですよ。
english: Who knows? Isn't he in the mud dropped around there? ...Look, I'm sure it's that.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
あらら、うっかり踏み潰してしまいました。
すみませんねェ。
あまりに小さかったものやから。
english: Oh my, I accidentally crushed it. Sorry about that. It was just so small, you see.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
english: You... bastard...!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
というわけで。
はい、ワンダウン。
english: And so. Yes, one down.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ぐッ……！
english: Guh…!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
南雲先生！
みんな！！
english:
Nagumo-sensei!!
Everyone!!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 慎平くん！！
english: Shinpei-kun!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 慎平さん……！
english: Shinpei-san...!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
あら……。
さすがに早いなァ。
english: Oh... You're certainly fast.

speaker: Shide
japanese: でも、残念でした……！
english: But, too bad...!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
あと３０秒早かったら
何かが変わっていたかもしれませんが――
english: If you had been 30 seconds faster, something might have changed, but--

speaker: Shide
japanese: おかげで楽勝でした。
english: Thanks to ya, it was an easy win.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: せっ――
english: Se--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生ェエエェェェーーーー！！！！
english: Senseeeeeeeiiiii!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まだ息がある……！
　シデを撃退できれば助けられるかも）
english: (She's still breathing...! If we can drive off Shide, we might be able to save her)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ロズ！！
english: Roz!!

speaker: Rosencrantz
japanese: オオォォォォ……ン！
english: Ooooooh...n!

speaker: Shide
japanese: 意味ないですよ、それ。
english: It's pointless, you know.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: い、一瞬で！？
english: I-In an instant!?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: そんな……。
english: No way...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ご老体も。
それ以上近づいたら同じ目に遭いますよ。
ライフルはもうないんでしょう？
english: You too, old man. If you get any closer, you'll meet the same fate. You don't have your rifle anymore, do you?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: クソがァ……！
english: Damn it...!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
いやァ、それにしても……。
攻略情報があると全然違いますねェ……。
english: Well, even so... Having a strategy guide makes a huge difference...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
死にゲーというか、
アクションゲームなんかじゃ、
特にそうなんですけど……。
english: In 'death games', or action games and the like, that's especially true, but...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
私、強いボスと初見で戦う時は
負けるのを承知で相手のパターンを
見るようにしてるんですよ。
english: When I fight a strong boss for the first time, I make sure to watch the opponent's patterns fully expecting to lose.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
それで動きを覚えてから、
効率的に勝ちに行く。
english: Then, after memorizing their movements, I go for an efficient win.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
それで実際に勝った時って……。
爽快感って言うんかなァ……。
english: And when you actually win then... I wonder if you'd call it exhilaration...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
まあ、とにかく。
めちゃくちゃ気持ちいいんですよ。
english: Well, anyway. It feels incredibly good.

speaker: Shide
japanese: 慎平くんには感謝せんと。
english: I have to thank you, Shinpei-kun.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ……ああ……ッ！
そう、か……！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（もっと前に気づくべきだった……！
　南雲先生は何かしらの切り札を持っていたんだ。
　なのに――）
english: (I should have realized much earlier...! Nagumo-sensei had some kind of trump card. And yet--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレが、ループ……。
したから……。
english: Because I... looped...

speaker: Shide
japanese: そういうことです。
english: That's right.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……慎平、もういっぺんループや。
この状況を打破する方法を探せ。
english: ...Shinpei, loop one more time. Find a way to break through this situation.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
考える時間が必要やっちゅうんなら、
儂らがそれを――
english: If you're saying you need time to think, we'll give you that--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ダメです。
english: No.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん……？
english: Shin-chan...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それは、もう……。
english: That's, already...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今回のループは
　１０分ほどしか戻れなかった……！）
english: (This loop only took me back about 10 minutes…!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (...Next time, I won't...!)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
もう……？
もう、なんや……？
english: Already...? Already, what...?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ふふ、母から聞いていますよ。
あなたにはもう後がない。
english: Hehe, I heard from Mother. You have no more chances left.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 後がないって……まさか……。
english: No more chances left... no way...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ゲームでここまで手こずらされたのは
久しぶりでした。
english: It's been a while since I was given this much trouble in a game.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
でも、攻略のし甲斐があって、
そこそこ楽しめました……。
english: But it was worth the effort to conquer, and I enjoyed it quite a bit...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
お礼と言っては何ですが、
せめて苦しまないように
死なせてあげますよ。
english: I wouldn't call it a thank you, but at the very least, I'll let you die without suffering.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
さよなら、慎平くん。
ここでゲームオーバーです。
english: Goodbye, Shinpei-kun. It's game over here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ミオにおんぶしてもらって
　移動してるけど……さすが影だな）
english: (I'm moving while having Mio carry me on her back, but... as expected of a shadow.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この暗さなのに、
　滅茶苦茶すごいスピードだ……）
english: (Even in this darkness, she's going at an incredibly amazing speed...)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん。
english: Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ん？　どうした？
急に止まって――
english: Hm? What's wrong? Stopping so suddenly--

speaker: Mio
japanese:
追いついた。
澪、この上におるよ。
english: We caught up. Mio is right above us.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 影の気配は？
english: Any shadow presence?

speaker: Mio
japanese: ない。
english: None.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
よし……それなら先回りして、
マンホールから外に出よう！
english: Alright... then let's get ahead of them and go outside from the manhole!

speaker: Mio
japanese: わかった。
english: Got it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今の時間は……。
　１０時３９分！）
english: (The current time is... 10:39!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よっしゃ……！
　これなら無事に――）
english: (Alright...! With this, we can safely--)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: なっ、なに！？
english: W-what!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おっ、おまえら……。
english: Y-You guys...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんでここに！？
慎ちゃん！？
english: Why are you here!? Shin-chan!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ま、間に合った……！！
english: I-I made it...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
コフネからミオに下水道を
飛ばしてもろたんや！
english: I had Mio speed through the sewers from Kofune!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おまえっ！！
ミオを助けたんか！？
どうして……！？
english: You!! Did you save Mio!? Why...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、こいつは大丈夫や！！
敵に戻ることはあらへん。
english: Yeah, she's fine!! She won't turn back into an enemy.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……それより二人共、
ケータイは切ってんのか！？
english: ...More importantly, both of you, are your phones turned off!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 何？
english: What?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
だって、慎ちゃんが……。
ケータイは切っとけって……。
影から電話があるかもしれやんからって……。
english: Because Shin-chan said... To keep our phones turned off... Because there might be a call from a shadow...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
アホ……。
その電話が影からやったんや。
english: Fool. That was a shadow telling ya that.

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Eh…!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
すまん、慎平……！！
オレがついていながら……。
english: Sorry, Shinpei...!! Even though I was with them...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや……。
english: No…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
時間がない。
オレはミオと虎島に向かう！
english: There's no time. I'm heading to Torashima with Mio!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ごめん……。
その……撃ってしもて……。
english: Sorry... Um... for shooting you...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
痛かったけど、大丈夫……。
今あんたをコピーして傷治ったから平気よ。
めっちゃ痛かったけど。
english: It hurt, but I'm fine... I just copied you and healed the wound, so I'm okay. It really hurt, though.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ごめんなさいっ！
english: I'm sorry!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
……気にすんな。
私があんたでも同じことしてた。
english: ...Don't worry about it. If I were you, I would have done the same thing.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
窓と澪はコフネに戻って、
子供らを頼む……！！
english: Sou and Mio, go back to Kofune and take care of the kids...!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃんっ！！
english: Shin-chan!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
トキコたちのこと……。
お願い……！！
english: Tokiko and the others... Please...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……うん。
任せろ！
english: ...Yeah. Leave it to me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 行くぞ、ミオ！
english: Let's go, Mio!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生たちの待つ、虎島へ……！！
english: To Torashima, where Sensei and the others are waiting...!!

japanese: 13.分断された仲間たち②
english: 13. Divided Companions 2

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 全速力で頼むぞ。
english: Full speed ahead, please.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 振り落とされんようにね。
english: Make sure you don't get thrown off.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いいぞ、このスピードなら
　澪たちが畑に着く前に追いつける……！）
english: (Good, at this speed I can catch up before Mio and the others reach the field...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うわっ！！？
な、なんや！！？
english: Whoa!!? Wh-What the!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ミオ！？
なんで急に立ち止まって――
english: Mio!? Why did you suddenly stop--

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん。
野良や。
english: Shin-chan. Strays.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
しかも、一匹や二匹やない。
たくさん……囲むみたいにおる……。
english: Moreover, it's not just one or two. There's a lot... like they're surrounding us...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（クソッ！　退いたと思ったら、
　また集まって来やがって……）
english: (Damn it! Just when I thought they backed off, they gathered around again...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（地上を飛ばしていくのは
　さすがに目立ち過ぎたか……？）
english: (Speeding above ground was too conspicuous after all...?)

speaker: Mio
japanese: どうする？
english: What do we do?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ちなみに聞いとくけど、
このまま進んだら？
english: Just asking, but what if we keep going like this?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
無理。
囲まれてる。
english: Impossible. We're surrounded.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……戦って道を切り開くしかないな。
english: ...We have no choice but to fight and carve a path.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ミオ、悪いけど……。
今はおまえだけが頼りや。
english: Mio, sorry but... Right now, you're my only hope.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 私だけ……。
english: Just me...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん。
そんなら、私から……絶対に離れんといてよ。
english: Shin-chan. If so... absolutely do not leave my side.

japanese: 小舟　澪
english: Mio Kofune

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
なんで、ここに……。
雁切、さん……。
english: Why are you... here... Karikiri-san...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
（慎ちゃんからの電話で
　<color=#GF_TIPS_040>お父さんの畑</color>に呼ばれてきたのに……）
english: (Even though I was called to <color=#GF_TIPS_040>Dad's field</color> by Shin-chan's phone call...)

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
立派なキュウリやなァ、これ……。
アランは野菜作りも上手やわ。
english: These are splendid cucumbers... Alain is good at growing vegetables too.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ねえ……澪ちゃん？
english: Hey… Mio-chan?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 下がれ澪っ！！
english: Get back, Mio!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
私、キュウリはぬか漬け派やけど、
コフネで食べて以来、
ピクルスも好きになったんですよ。
english: I'm a rice-bran pickled cucumber kind of person, but since eating them at Kofune, I've come to like pickles too.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
やはりフランス……。
本場は違うよね。
english: As expected of France... The authentic taste is different, isn't it.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 慎平をどうしたッ！！？
english: What'd ya do with Shinpei!!?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
（まさか……
　お姉ちゃんに続いて慎ちゃんまで……）
english: (No way... After Sis, even Shin-chan...)

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
……でも、母はどっちも嫌いでねェ。
困ったもんやと思いません？
english: ...But Mother hates both of them. Don't you think that's troublesome?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 人って――
english: People…

speaker: Shide
japanese: どんな味なんでしょうね。
english: What do they taste like, I wonder.

japanese: 14.背水の陣
english: 14. Desperate Stand

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハッ、ハッ、ハッ……！
くッ……ハァ……！
english: Hah, hah, hah...! Kuh... hah...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（くそっ、
　このままじゃきりがない……！）
english: (Damn it, there's no end to this...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（フカンしろ……！
　この状況を切り抜けるには――）
english: (Take a bird's-eye view...! To break through this situation--)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん、危ない！
english: Shin-chan, watch out!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うおッ！？
english: Uwa!?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 大丈夫？
english: Are you okay?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ、ああ……ありがとな……。
もう少しで首が落ちてた……。
english: Y-Yeah... thanks... My head was almost chopped off...

speaker: Stray Shadow A
japanese: ヴアアアァ……！
english: Vaaaaa...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……くっ！
倒しても倒しても次から次へと……。
english: ...Kuh! No matter how many we defeat, they just keep coming...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（想定しておくべきだった……！
　後がないことを気づかれていたか……。
　何がなんでもオレを妨害するつもりだ）
english: (I should have anticipated this...! Did they realize I have no more chances left...? They intend to obstruct me no matter what.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（この調子じゃ
　先生たちのいる虎島へ向かう道にも
　同じように配置されているのだろう）
english: (At this rate, they must be deployed in the same way on the path heading to Torashima where Sensei and the others are.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これなら地下のほうが
　かえって手薄だったかもしれない……。
　やられた……）
english: (If this is the case, the underground might have actually been less guarded... They got me...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（くそ……考えろ……！
　さっさとここを突破する作戦を！）
english: (Damn it... think...! A strategy to quickly break through here!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……なあ、慎ちゃん。
english: ...Hey, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
悪い、ミオ……！
もう少し耐えて――
english: Sorry, Mio...! Endure it a little longer--

speaker: Mio
japanese: 今、澪が死んだ。
english: Just now, Mio died.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Huh?

speaker: Mio
japanese: もう一人の、人間のほうの私。
english: The other me, the human one.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: なっ……！
english: Wha...!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ってことは、多分やけど……。
窓くんも……。
english: Which means, probably... Sou-kun too...

speaker: Stray Shadow A
japanese: ゲギァァーーーッッ！
english: Gegyaaaaa!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ウ、ウソだろ！？
最短距離で来たのに！？
english: ...N-No way!? Even though we took the shortest route!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんでや！？
なんでこんな展開に！？
english: Why!? Why did it turn out like this!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（違う！
　フカンしろ！）
english: (No! Take a bird's-eye view!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
くそ……どうしたら……。
どうしたらええんや……ッ！！
english: Damn it... what should I do... What should I do...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （フカンしろ！！！！）
english: (Take a bird's-eye view!!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ループか！？
　ループすればいいのか！？）
english: (A loop!? Should I loop!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、もうループはできん！
　それはもう見えてる！）
english: (No, I can't loop anymore! I can already see that!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん！
english: Shin-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それに戻ったところで……。
　こうなった原因がわからないと……）
english: (And even if I went back... If I don't know the cause of this...)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん！！
english: Shin-chan!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （それを考えてる時間はあるのか？）
english: (Do I have time to think about that?)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃん、下がって！
危な――
english: Shin-chan, get back! Watch ou--

speaker: Stray Shadow B
japanese: てきゃ！！
english: Tekya!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ぎッ――
english: Gi--

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃ――
english: Shin-cha--

japanese: 11.奥の手①
english: 11. Secret Move 1

japanese: 15.奥の手②
english: 15. Secret Move 2

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (We're here…!)

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: このォッッッッ！！！！
english: Take thiiiiiis!!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: やれやれ。
english: Good grief.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: ロズッ！！
english: Roz!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あれは……シデの攻撃！！
　いったいヤツは何をやったんだ……！？）
english: (That was... Shide's attack!! What on earth did he do...!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ロズが一瞬で……！！）
english: (Roz, in an instant...!!)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 慎平くんっ！？
english: Shinpei-kun!?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
なるほど……。
こんなふうに変わるんやねえ……。
展開が……！！
english: I see... So this is how it changes... The development...!!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
……来たか。
思ったより早かったな。
english: ...You're here. Faster than I thought.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 慎平さん……！！
english: Shinpei-san!!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
死ぬよ？
トキコは手ェ出さんで。
english: You'll die, you know? Tokiko, don't interfere.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
ふむ……
ループして虎島の顛末を知っておるのか……。
逃げた朱鷺子から教わったな？
english: Hmph... You looped and know the outcome of Torashima... Did you learn it from Tokiko who escaped?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
おやおや……
何を驚いてるんですか慎平くん……。
english: Oh my... What are you surprised about, Shinpei-kun...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
キミがループしてくれたおかげで、
我々ももう一度ひづるちゃんと戦えたんですよ。
感謝します。
english: Thanks to you looping, we were able to fight Hizuru-chan once again. I thank you.

speaker: Shide
japanese: おかげで楽勝でした。
english: Thanks to ya, it was an easy win.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生ェェェッ！！！！
english: Senseeeeei!!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: さて……。
english: Well…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
シンペイがハイネか！！
ヤツめ……！！
この戦い二度目やと！？
english: Shinpei is Haine!!? That bastard...!! This is their second time fighting this battle!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
せやさけまず儂の猟銃を狙って
破壊してきよったんか！！
english: So that's why he aimed for my hunting rifle first and destroyed it!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
こっちの武器は儂の山刀と
凸村の拳銃、朱鷺子のギル、
そしてミオしかない……。
english: Our weapons are my machete, Totsumura's handgun, Tokiko's Gil, and Mio...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
少々心許ないぞ慎平っ……！！
今戦うたら――
english: It's a bit unreliable, Shinpei...!! If we fight now--

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 全滅……。
english: Total annihilation...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ふォ！？
english: Fwo!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
慎平！　ミオ！！
退くぞ！！！　ギルに乗れ！！
english: Shinpei! Mio!! We're retreating!!! Get on Gil!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 聞こえんのか慎平ッ！！
english: Are ya deaf, Shinpei?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……でも先生が！！
先生を……このまま放っていくんですか！？
english: ...But Sensei is!! Are we going to... leave Sensei behind like this!?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
阿呆陀羅！！
せやから退くんじゃ！！
ひづるの命を溝に放す気か！！
english: You idiot!! That's exactly why we're retreating!! Do you intend to throw Hizuru's life down the drain!!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: 去ぬぞ、シデ！
english: We're leaving, Shide!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: 多勢に無勢じゃ……今はこれでええ……。
english: We're outnumbered... this is fine for now...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
english: Oh!?

speaker: Shide
japanese: ……わかりました……。
english: ...Understood...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: たっ……助かった……！？
english: W-We're saved...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生ッ！！！
南雲先生ッ！！
english: Sensei!!! Nagumo-sensei!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……し……慎平くん……か……。
english: ...Shi... Shinpei-kun... huh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 先生！！
english: Sensei!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
す……すまない……。
必ず……助けると……言った……あの約束……。
私には……は……果たせそうに……ない……。
english: I... I'm sorry... That promise... I made... to definitely... save you... It seems... I... won't be able to... fulfill it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……そんなことない！！
そんなことないです！！
english: ...That's not true!! That's not true!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
銃を！！
凸村さん！！
english: The gun!! Totsumura-san!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
おっ？
おうっ！！
english: Oh? O-Okay!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ループして南雲先生を助けないと……！）
english: (I have to loop and save Nagumo-sensei...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 今すぐ戻ります……！！
english: I'll go back right now...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: よ、よせ……。
english: S-Stop...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
次は！
次こそは助けます……！！
english: Next time! Next time for sure, I'll save you...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
よせ……！！
手遅れだ――
english: Stop...!! It's too late--

speaker: Mio
japanese:
慎ちゃんが
一番ようわかってるはずやろ……。
english: Shin-chan, you should know best...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
ループ能力は限界ギリギリ。
「両方」はもう……助けられやんて……。
english: The loop ability is at its absolute limit. You can't... save 'both' anymore...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （次は……次こそは……！）
english: (Next time... next time for sure...!)

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_HELPHDR>ひづるを救え</color>】を入手しました。
english: Acquired Key TIP: [<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_HELPHDR>Save Hizuru</color>].

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: う……く……ううっ！！
