english: U... ku... uuh!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
な……なら病院へ！！
ミオならあっちゅう間に……！！
english: Th... Then to the hospital!! Mio could get there in a flash...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
english: Listen closely... to me...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: あ……あいつは……こ……子供なんだ……。
english: Th... That thing is... a... a child...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ハイネは……化物かも知れないが……。
元となる最初の……人……格は……。
english: Haine... might be a monster, but... The original first... person... ality is...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
さびしがり屋で……甘えん坊な……。
た……ただの……一人の子供だ……。
english: A lonely... clingy... j... just... a single child...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: シデの狙いは、ハイネとは……違う……。
english: Shide's aim is not the same as Haine's...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ハイネはおそらく……シデに……
利用されてるだけ……だ……。
親玉は……シデの方なんだ……ッ。
english: Haine is probably... just being used... by Shide... The real boss... is Shide...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
慎……平……くん……。
ハイネを……解放してやってくれ……。
english: Shin... pei... kun... Please... free Haine...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Yes... I promise...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
もうええっ、
もうしゃべるな……ひづる……。
english: That's enough, don't speak anymore... Hizuru...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ふっ……辛気くさい顔を……並べるな……。
最期としては……悪くない……。
english: Heh... don't line up... such gloomy faces... As a final moment... it's not bad...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
どれだけ……長く……、
生きたかじゃ……ない……。
いかに……命を……使い切ったかだ……。
english: It's not about... how long... you lived... It's about how... you completely used up... your life...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
竜之介……。
あとは……任せたぞ……。
english: Ryunosuke... I leave the rest... to you...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Huh?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
弟は……キミに託す……。
最後に……どんでん返しちゃれ……。
english: I entrust... my brother... to you... Give them a big twist... at the end...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……おい、ひづる……。
english: …Hey, Hizuru…

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ひづるゥゥゥゥッ！！
english: Hizuruuuuu!!

japanese: 南方　ひづる
english: Hizuru Minakata

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
危険やのォ……。
この地形は。
english: This terrain is dangerous...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ひづる、
電話はホンマに慎平やったんやろな……？
english: Hizuru, was that phone call really Shinpei...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
電話越しでは「竜之介」でも
人と影の区別はつかん。
着信は確かに網代慎平のスマホからだったが……。
english: Over the phone, even 'Ryunosuke' can't distinguish between a human and a shadow. The incoming call was definitely from Shinpei Ajiro's smartphone, but...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
潮がやられたんやろ……。
すでに慎平も殺されちゃある可能性はないんか？
english: Ushio was taken out, right... Is there no possibility that Shinpei has already been killed too?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……ある。
すでに慎平の命が尽きて、
ハイネの観測する世界になっている可能性はな。
english: ...There is. The possibility that Shinpei's life has already ended, and this has become a world observed by Haine.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
だがそうだとしても、やることは変わらん。
ハイネを殺す――それだけだ。
english: But even if that's the case, what we do doesn't change. Kill Haine--that is all.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 澪と連絡は？
english: Any contact with Mio?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
いえ……今は私たちも圏外です。
「慎平さんから電話があって二人とも出かけた」と
アランさんは言ってましたが……。
english: No... we're out of range right now too. Alain-san said that 'Shinpei-san called and they both went out', but...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: 行き先はわからんちゅうわけか……。
english: So you don't know their destination, huh...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 虎島に向かってたらええけどな……。
english: It'd be good if they were heading to Torashima, though...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
english: Mio…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
まず私だけ虎島に渡る。
ここから狙えるか、根津？
english: First, I'll cross over to Torashima alone. Can you snipe from here, Nezu?

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 島の南側だけやったらな……。
english: Yeah, but only on the southern part of the island...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
充分だ……。
慎平が影だった場合は合図を送る。
english: That'll be enough... I'll send you a signal if Shinpei is a shadow.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
朱鷺子、
その時はギルとロズで突入したまえ。
そして凸村は――
english: Tokiko, when that happens, charge in with Gil and Roz. And Totsumura--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ――なんでいるんだっけ？
english: --Why are you here again?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: え？
english: Huh?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: これをやる、生きる事に足掻け。
english: I'll give you this. Struggle to survive.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: これは……。
english: This…

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お父さんの護身銃ですね。
弾は二発しか装填できませんが……。
english: That's Dad's self-defense gun. It can only load two bullets, though...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
お、おう。
オレの拳銃は潮ちゃんとともに消えてもうたけど。
こ、これがあればなんとか……。
english: O-Oh. My handgun disappeared along with Ushio-chan, but... W-With this, I can manage...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
で……でも、
あんたの武器はっ！？
english: B-But... What about yer weapon!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 私にはハンマーがある。
english: I have a hammer.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
各自警戒を怠るな……。
慎平が本人だと確認できたら
ここに戻ってくる。
english: Everyone, do not neglect your vigilance... Once I confirm that Shinpei is the real one, I will return here.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
またあとで会おら。
ひづる……。
english: See you later. Hizuru...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……デリカシーのない老人だな。
死亡フラグを立てるんじゃない。
english: ...What a tactless old man. Don't go raising death flags.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: あァ！？
english: Hah!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
もしこの戦いが終わったなら
この島での体験を小説にするよ。
ノンフィクションはまだ書いたことないんだ。
english: If this battle ends, I'll turn my experiences on this island into a novel. I've never written non-fiction before.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（微かに……けど確かに頭に響く……。
　黒板を引っかくような……
　神経を逆撫でする音……）
english: (Faintly... but it's definitely echoing in my head... Like scratching a blackboard... A sound that rubs my nerves the wrong way...)

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: 南雲先生！
english: Nagumo-sensei!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （なんてことや……影の気配……）
english: (What is this... the presence of a shadow...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（いや……これは……！！
　ハイネの気配……！！）
english: (No... this is...!! Haine's presence...!!)

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
無事でよかった！
他のみんなは――
english: I'm glad you're safe! Where are the others--

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: 猿芝居はやめろ、ハイネ。
english: Quit your lousy acting, Haine.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
おまえ自身が変身してるとはな……。
慎平さんをどうした！？
english: To think you transformed yourself... What did you do to Shinpei-san!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（こちらに誘い出さないと、
　根津さんから狙えない位置……。
　…………読まれてんのか）
english: (If I don't lure her over here, Nezu-san won't be able to snipe her from that position... ...Is she reading my thoughts?)

speaker: Shinpei
english: ...Heh.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
１４年前、
ひづるに次会うたら殺す言うたんも
ここ……虎島じゃった。
english: 14 years ago, the place where I told Hizuru I'd kill her the next time we met was also here... Torashima.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: さらばじゃ、竜之介。
english: Goodbye, Ryuunosuke.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ふッ！
english: Hah!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
ふむん……。
あれをかわしよるとは……。
english: Hmph... To think you dodged that...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: お見事。
english: Well done.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
……やはりおまえがシデか。
雁切真砂人……。
english: ...So you are Shide after all. Karikiri Masahito...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
でも人だ……。
おまえから影の気配がしない。
今みたいに後ろから近付いて潮さんを殺したのか……？
english: But you're human... I don't sense a shadow's presence from you. Did you kill Ushio like this, sneaking up from behind...?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ふ……いやはや。
キミにこの手は通じやんか……。
english: Heh... well then. I suppose this trick won't work on you...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
予知能力があるんやってね？
南方竜之介くん！
english:
You have precognition, don't you?
Ryunosuke-kun!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
……やっぱりバレてたんか。
僕の秘密……。
english: So you knew my secret.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
１４年前、
わしが南方竜之介をコピーした……。
english:
Fourteen years ago,
I copied Ryunosuke Minakata…

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
じゃが、ハイネの少女やった頃の人格が、
友達の弟を食べてしもた事実に耐えられず、
竜之介のデータと共にわしから弾け出おった。
english: However, Haine's personality from when she was a young girl couldn't bear the fact that she ate her friend's younger brother, and she burst out of me along with Ryunosuke's data.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
あれはなにぶん事故……。
少々座標がズレて
プリントされたようじゃわ……。
english: It was an accident... The coordinates were slightly off, and it seems he was printed that way...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 座標……。
english: Coordinates?

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
位置ではなく時間の座標がじゃ。
正確には２秒……先の方へズレちゃある。
english: It's not spatial coordinates, but temporal coordinates. Precisely two seconds... shifted into the future.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: あらま～～～～ッ。
english: Oh my~!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
そいつは今２秒未来から、
ひづるの体を動かしとるんじゃ……！！
english: He's controlling Hizuru's body right now from two seconds in the future...!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
……正解かな？
ひづるちゃん！
english: Is that right, Hizuru-chan?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
……聞こえてるんはわかってますよ。
ねえ、ひづるちゃん？
キミがハイネに近付いて、彼女を惑わせた……。
english: ...I know you can hear me. Right, Hizuru-chan? You approached Haine and led her astray...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
キミのせいでハイネは深く傷付いた。
衰弱はより進み、
もはやこの世ではあと数か月と生きられへん。
english: Because of you, Haine was deeply wounded. Her weakening has progressed, and she can no longer live in this world for more than a few months.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: キミのせいなんや、ひづるちゃん。
english: It's all your fault, Hizuru-chan.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ハイネが帰らんとあかんのも、
キミの大事な弟が死んだんも――
english: Haine needing to return home, and your dear brother dying--

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
全部、キミのせいなんですよ……。
ひづるちゃん。
english: It's all your fault... Hizuru-chan.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
何を言う……。
これ以上、お姉ちゃんを傷付けんな。
english: What are you saying...? Don't hurt my sister any more.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: キミは私には勝てやんよ、竜之介くん……！！
english: You can't beat me, Ryunosuke-kun...!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ハイネの目がキミのズレを観測し、
私に伝えてくれている……。
english: Haine's eyes are observing your time shift, and transmitting it to me...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
つまりキミの「２秒」のアドバンテージは、
ここでは無意味や。
english: In other words, your "two second" advantage is meaningless here.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
これは泥です。
かつて影だったモノたち……。
そして今は誰でもないモノたち……。
english: This is mud. Things that were once shadows... And now, things that are nobody...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
私も私の能力を教えます。
フェアやないとゲームは面白ない。
泥は人の意志に反応して像を変える。
english: I'll tell you my ability as well. Games aren't fun if they aren't fair. Mud changes its form in response to human will.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（なんて不気味な……！！
　いったい何人分の…………！？）
english: (How creepy...!! Just how many people's worth of mud is that...!?)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（お姉ちゃんならなんて表現するやろか……。
　死体の塊……？　いや――）
english: (I wonder how my sister would describe it... A mass of corpses...? No--)

speaker: Shide
japanese: そして、誰でもないが故に、弱点もまたない。
english: And because they are nobody, they also have no weaknesses.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （<color=#GF_KEY_MUKUROARMAER>骸の鎧</color>……！！）
english: (<color=#GF_KEY_MUKUROARMAER>Corpse Armor</color>...!!)

speaker: Shide
japanese: 次はちょっと本気で行きます。
english: It's time to take this seriously.

speaker: Shide
japanese: ふんっ！
english: Hmph!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（やっぱりな……。
　お姉ちゃんの言うた通り……攻撃をかわさせて……、
　避けた先で僕を仕留める気か……）
english: (Just as I thought... Like my sister said... he's making me dodge his attacks... and planning to finish me off where I land...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（けど、シデに２秒先の僕が視えてるわけじゃない。
　ハイネが視てから、シデにテレパシーで伝えてる）
english: (But it's not like Shide can see me two seconds in the future. Haine sees it, and then telepathically tells Shide.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（ハイネの指示がシデに伝わるまで、
　ほんの一瞬、時間差がある！）
english: (There's a brief time lag before Haine's instructions reach Shide!)

speaker: Shide
japanese: これでどうです！？
english: How about this!?

speaker: Shide
japanese: 柄の部分で受け止めた……！？
english: He blocked it with the handle...!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（時間差があるなら……！！
　速く、より速く……！！
　僕が動けばいいだけの事……！！！）
english: (If there's a time lag...!! Faster, even faster...!! I just need to move faster than that...!!!)

speaker: Shide
japanese: ぐうオッッッッ！？
english: Guh-ohhh!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: もう一撃……！！
english: One more strike...!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: ぐああああああぁぁぁッッッ！！
english: Gwaaaaaahhh!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ……！
english: *Pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
……スゴイですよ。
人の身でありながらその動き……。
english: ...That's amazing. To have movements like that despite being human...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（頭部を叩き潰したつもりだったが、
　泥状になって衝撃を逃がしたんか……）
english: (I thought I smashed his head in, but did he turn to mud and let the impact escape...?)

speaker: Shide
japanese:
でもさすがにムリがあるようですね？
傷口が開いてますよ……。
それは昨夜、私が撃った銃創ですね？
english: But it seems you're pushing yourself too hard, aren't you? Your wound has opened up... That's the gunshot wound from when I shot you last night, right?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ふふっ！
慎平くんをかばったりするからや……。
english: Heheh! That's what you get for protecting Shinpei-kun...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（それだけじゃない……。
　右腕の骨にヒビが入った……。
　体中の筋肉も断裂してる……）
english: (That's not all... There's a crack in my right arm's bone... And the muscles all over my body are torn...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （これ以上はお姉ちゃんの体がもたん……！！）
english: (My sister's body can't take any more of this...!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: （くやしいけど逃げやな無理や……）
english: (It's frustrating, but we have to run...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese:
（なんとかして、
　根津さんの射程に入りさえすれば、
　一瞬のスキを作って逃げられる……！）
english: (If I can just somehow get into Nezu-san's firing range, we can create a momentary opening and escape...!)

speaker: ひづるの声
japanese: 待て！！！
english: Wait!!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata (Ponytail)
japanese: ……えっ。
english: …Huh?

speaker: Ryunosuke's Voice
japanese: おっ……お姉ちゃん！？
english: S-...Sister!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
逃げるな……！！
竜之介……！！
english: Don't run...!! Ryunosuke...!!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: ひづるか……！！
english: Hizuru...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke's Voice
japanese:
あ……あれっ！？
お姉ちゃんの時間に……
なんでボクが起きてるん！？
english: H-Huh!? Why am I awake... in my sister's time!?

speaker: Ryunosuke's Voice
japanese:
はじめてお姉ちゃんと
リアルタイムで話せた！！
なんで？　なんでなんで！？
english: This is the first time I've been able to talk with my sister in real-time!! Why? Why, why!?

speaker: Ryunosuke's Voice
japanese:
うわあーーっ！！
ウソウソ？　これ夢と違うん！？
ねえっ！！
english: Waaah!! No way, no way? Is this not a dream!? Hey!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ええいやかましい！！
緊急事態だ、止むを得ん。
english: Argh, shut up!! It's an emergency, I have no choice.

speaker: Ryunosuke's Voice
japanese: お姉ちゃん……うれしいよ……。
english: I'm so glad...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: いいか……よく聞け竜之介、勝機はある。
english: Listen... listen closely, Ryunosuke. There's a chance to win.

speaker: Shide
japanese: ……ほう。

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
網代慎平の安否が不明な以上、
ここでやるしかない……。
逃げてもどうせ明日死ぬ。
english: With Shinpei Ajiro's safety unknown, we have no choice but to do this here... Even if we run, we'll die tomorrow anyway.

speaker: Ryunosuke's Voice
japanese: でもっ……。
english: But…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（考えるな！！
　考えるのは私の役目だ……！！）
english: (Don't think!! Thinking is my job...!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke's Voice
japanese: お……お姉ちゃん……
english: S-...Sister...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（おまえも見ただろう……。
　あの物質は常識を超えている……
　あの鎧さえ壊せば中身は人だ）
english: (You saw it too, didn't you...? That substance goes beyond common sense... If we just break that armor, there's a human inside.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（いいか、いまから伝える作戦は……
　おまえにしかできない）
english: (Listen, the strategy I'm about to tell you... only you can do it.)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
体の操作は任せるぞ。
気合い入れろよ……竜之介……！！
english: I'll leave the body control to you. Give it your all... Ryunosuke...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私に気ィつこて……
まだ力をセーブしてるやろ？
english: You're worrying about me... and still holding back your power, aren't you?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私の体……壊れてもええ……。
存分に使え……！！
english: It's fine... even if my body breaks... Use it to your heart's content...!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
……勝機？
笑ける。
english: ...A chance to win? Don't make me laugh.

speaker: Shinpei
english: Fast...!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: ちょこまかと……！
english: Scurrying around...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （ハンマーが弾かれ……ッ！？）
english: (The hammer was deflected…?!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （ならばあれを……！）
english: (Then I'll use that...!)

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ちょっとそれ……！
日都神社の大事な神宝、<color=#GF_TIPS_065>天沼矛</color>……！
english: Wait, that's...! The important sacred treasure of Hitogashima Shrine, <color=#GF_TIPS_065>Amenonuhoko</color>...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: くらえ……！
english: Take this...!

speaker: Shide
japanese: うごっ……ぐぐぐぐごぉっ！？
english: Ugh... gugugugoo!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ハイネ！
english: Haine!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: おっと……！
english: Whoops...!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: はぁ、はぁっ……はぁっ……！
english: *Pant*, *pant*... *pant*...!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: 危ない危ない……。
english: That was close...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
今の動き、ウシオと同等……
いや、それ以上じゃった。
決死の覚悟というわけか、ひづる。
english: Those movements just now were on par with Ushio... No, even greater. So you're prepared to die, Hizuru.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: おいシデ、いつまで寝とんねん。
english: Hey Shide, how long are you going to sleep?

speaker: Shide
japanese: よっこいしょ……。
english: Heave-ho...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ウチの神宝、
めちゃ使いこなしてますやん。
english: You're really mastering my sacred treasure.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
竜之介はあれでも影じゃ。
コピーこそできんようじゃが、
モノマネは得意のようじゃな……。
english: Ryunosuke is still a shadow, after all. Though he can't copy, it seems he's good at imitating...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
一撃一撃の殺気がエグイですよ……。
ショックやわあァ～～。
キミが赤ちゃんの頃から知ってんのに！
english: The killing intent in each strike is brutal... I'm so shocked~. And I've known you since you were a baby!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
私のことそんなに嫌い？
なぜそこまでがんばります？
キミが命をかけて戦う意味は……？
english: Do you hate me that much? Why are you trying so hard? What's the meaning of fighting with your life on the line...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ……嫌いなのはおまえの言葉だ。
english: ...What I hate is your words.

speaker: Shide
japanese: ……言葉？
english: ...Words?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
人は言葉を持つ、語彙だ。
いかに言葉を使うかは人間性が決める。
english: Humans have words, vocabulary. How we use words is determined by our humanity.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
意味など理解できまいよ。
何百年生きようが……おまえにはな……！！
english: You probably can't understand the meaning. No matter how many centuries you live... you never will...!!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
……今一度問う。
なぜ帰って来た？　ひづる。
english: ...I ask you once more. Why did you come back? Hizuru.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
死ぬとわかっていて帰ってくるなど……、
愚か者のすることじゃ。おまんらしくない……。
english: Coming back when you know you'll die... That's something a fool would do. It's not like you...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……知ってるだろう。
前にその問いを発した時、
私の頭をスキャンしたはず……。
english: ...You should know. When you asked that question before, you should have scanned my head...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……そうか。
記憶は読めても、理解はできないのか。
english: ...I see. Even if you can read memories, you can't understand them.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
もう一度私をスキャンしてみたらどうだ？
私の影を産み、そいつに答えてもらいたまえ。
english: Why don't you try scanning me again? Give birth to my shadow, and have her answer you.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
……ふっ、その手にはのらん。
ひづる……免疫をつけたな？
ミオならそれができる。
english: ...Hmph, I won't fall for that. Hizuru... you've developed an immunity, haven't you? Mio could do that.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
わしが光ったスキをついて、
シンペイを壊す気じゃろう？
english: You're planning to take advantage of the opening when I flash to destroy Shinpei, aren't you?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （バレバレか……）
english: (She saw right through it...)

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: わしの目ェさえなければ、シデを倒せると……。
english: That if it weren't for my eyes, you could defeat Shide...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
シデを倒せば、
地下のわしの本体を叩くのはたやすいと……。
そう考えておるな？
english: And if you defeat Shide, it would be easy to strike my main body underground... That's what you're thinking, isn't it?

speaker: Shide
japanese: ハイネ。
english: Haine.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
答えよ！
なんで帰って来よった！！
メッセージに呼ばれたからか！？
english: Answer me! Why did you come back!! Was it because the message called you!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（網代慎平の人格だな……。
　物事を冷静にフカンする一方で、
　理解できない事を脇に置けず、イラついている）
english: (That's Shinpei Ajiro's personality... While he calmly takes a bird's-eye view, he gets irritated because he can't set aside things he doesn't understand.)

speaker: Ryunosuke's Voice
japanese: おしゃべりに付き合うん！？
english: You're gonna chat with them!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（時間を稼げるなら好都合だ。
　私に任せろ……）
english: (If we can buy some time, that works for us. Leave it to me...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
……初めは、好奇心だった……。
だが私は……ずっと探していた……。
償う機会を探していたんだ……。
english: ...At first, it was curiosity... But I... had been searching all along... Searching for a chance to atone...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: 償う？
english: To atone?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
シデの言った通り。
竜之介が死んだのは私のせいだ。
だが竜之介の死は事故として処理された。
english: Just as Shide said. Ryunosuke's death was my fault. But Ryunosuke's death was treated as an accident.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私がいくら真実を話しても。
当然だ……警察は影の病や伝承を本気にしなかった。
english: No matter how much I told the truth. Naturally... the police didn't take Shadow Sickness or the legends seriously.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
誰も私を責めない……。
友人も両親も……私を慰めた……。
english: No one blamed me... My friends and my parents... they all comforted me...

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
私は……
双子の弟を事故で亡くした
かわいそうな子供だった。
english: I was... a poor child who lost her twin brother in an accident.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 本当は、私が殺したも同然なのに。
english: But the truth is, it's as if I killed him.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
奇跡が起きて、
竜之介の影に謝ることができた。
だが、それであいつが生き返るわけじゃない。
english: A miracle happened, and I was able to apologize to Ryunosuke's shadow. But that doesn't mean he's going to come back to life.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
今の私にできる事といえば……。
せめてこれから失われる命を、救うことだけだ……。
english: The only thing I can do now... is to at least save the lives that will be lost from here on out...

speaker: Ryunosuke's Voice
japanese: お姉ちゃん……。
english: Sister…

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
だから助ける。
必ず……！！
english: So I'll save them. I swear it...!!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: ……償い……それが理由……。
english: ...Atonement... That's your reason...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
気持ち悪いですねえ……。
赤の他人の為に命をかけるんですか？
english: How disgusting... You're risking your life for complete strangers?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
一番迷惑なんですよね。
自分が正義やと思い込んでる人が。
english: They're the most annoying kind of people, aren't they? People who are convinced they're justice.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ふっ……正義……？
english: Hmph... justice...?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
正義って……うふふっ！
私がか？
english: Justice...? Heheh! Me?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ふっ……ふふっふふふふ……あっはっはっは！
はっははははははは！
あはははっはっはっは！！
english: Heh... hehehehehe... ahahahaha! Hahahahahahaha! Ahahahahahahaha!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ふはは……！！
おい……もっとフカンしたまえよ、
ハイネ……！！
english: Hahaha...!! Hey... take a bird's-eye view, Haine...!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
その男は、
本当におまえの為に動いているのか？
english: That man, is he really acting for your sake?

speaker: Shinpei
english: …What?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
ハイネの「故郷に帰る」目的と、
３周目の最後につぶやいた
その男の言葉がかみ合わない。
english: Haine's goal of "returning home" and the words that man muttered at the end of the 3rd loop don't match up.

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: 「これが私のエンディング」……。
english: "This is my ending..."

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: あれはどういう意味だ、シデ。
english: What did you mean by that, Shide?

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: エンディング……？
english: Ending…?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
その男……どこまでいっても我……。
一人称の視点しか持ち合わせていまい……！！
english: That man... is all about himself no matter what... He only has a first-person perspective...!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
はて……エンディング……？
何のことやら……？
english: Well now... ending...? Whatever do you mean...?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
戯言ですハイネ。
彼女は我らを言葉で惑わせようとしている……。
english: It's nonsense, Haine. She's trying to confuse us with her words...

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: うむ……。
english: Hmm...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ひるがえせばそれは、
彼女にもはや打つ手はないということ……。
楽しいおしゃべりは！！
english: On the flip side, that means she has no more moves left to play... So this fun little chat...!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: ここまでですッ！
english: Ends here!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（できればハイネに見られたくなかったが、
　贅沢は言ってられないか……）
english: (I didn't want Haine to see this if possible, but I guess I can't afford to be picky...)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （後は頼んだぞ……朱鷺子）
english: (I leave the rest to you... Tokiko)

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: 何をする気じゃ！？
english: What are you doing!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（シデの鎧は「誰でもない」。
　中身は空なんだ……。
　だからおまえなら、入り込めるはずだ……！！）
english: (Shide's armor is "nobody". The inside is empty... So you should be able to get inside it...!!)

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese:
（得意だろう竜之介？
　人に憑依するのは……！！
　ヤツの鎧に潜って――）
english: (You're good at that, right, Ryunosuke? Possessing people...!! Dive into his armor--)

speaker: Shide
japanese: な、何を！？
english: W-What!?

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: （――<color=#GF_KEY_OKUNOTE>中から壊せ</color>！！）
english: (--<color=#GF_KEY_OKUNOTE>Break it from the inside</color>!!)

speaker: Shide
english: ...I-Impossible...!!!!

speaker: Ryunosuke's Voice
japanese: ぐおオ、オッ………！
english: Guoo, ohhh...!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
ひづるめ……こんな奥の手を……！！
竜之介のデータをシデの泥に写し、
それを素材に――
english: Hizuru... to use a trump card like this...!! Copying Ryunosuke's data into Shide's mud, and using that as material--

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ――産まれたやと！？
english: --He was born!?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
……でっ……できた！！！
実体化……！
ほ……ほんまに！！
english: ...I... I did it!!! Materialization...! F-For real!!

speaker: Hizuru Minakata
japanese: ふっ……。
english: Heh...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: お姉ちゃんッ……！！
english: Sister...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: このォッッッッ！！！！
english: Take this!!!!

japanese: 12.たくさんの犠牲
english: 12. Many Sacrifices

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
やあ……。
待ちくたびれましたよ。
english: Hello... I'm tired of waiting for you.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 下がって……慎ちゃん……危ない……。
english: Step back... Shin-chan... It's dangerous...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪と窓は！？
どうしたっ！？
english: What about Mio and Sou!? What happened!?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
やっぱり……澪ちゃんの方に来ましたね。
慎平くん！
english: As expected... you came to Mio-chan. Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
下がってってば、慎ちゃん。
私がやる。
english: I said step back, Shin-chan. I'll do it.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
私よりも……
慎平くんを殺してあげた方が
ええんとちゃいますか、ミオちゃん。
english: Rather than me... wouldn't it be better to kill Shinpei-kun for him, Mio-chan?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
澪ちゃんと窓くんはヒルコ洞へ送りました。
今ごろ母が食べているころでしょう。
english: I sent Mio-chan and Sou-kun to Hiruko Cave. Mother is probably eating them right about now.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ちょおっと遅かったかな！
慎平くん！
english: You were just a bit too late! Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ええ度胸やないかシデ……。
逃げやんと一人で待ってるなんてよ……。
english: ...You've got some nerve, Shide... Waiting here all alone instead of running away...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
他の影には任せられません……。
これ以上仲間を失いたくないんでね……。
人間の私ならハッキングされませんから。
english: I can't leave this to the other shadows... I don't want to lose any more comrades, you see... Since I'm human, I won't be hacked.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …What!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハッキングを恐れてる？
　こいつ……潮が生きてると思ってるのか……！？）
english: (He's afraid of being hacked? This guy... does he think Ushio is still alive...!?)

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: おや……？

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（待て……待てよっ！！
　生きてると思ってるなら、
　そう思わせといた方がいい……！！）
english: (Wait... wait a second!! If he thinks she's alive, I should let him keep thinking that...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お見通しか……。
english: So you saw right through it...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
……ミオちゃん。
早よ慎平くん殺してループさせな。
でないと手おく――
english: ...Mio-chan. Hurry up and kill Shinpei-kun to make him loop. Otherwise it'll be too la--

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ……あっ、そう……。
english: ...Ah, I see...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ループすれば、
どうせ私は生き返……る。
english: If we loop, I'll just come back to life anyway...

speaker: Mio
japanese: 話が長い。
english: You talk too much.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（雁切さんは……シデは殺ったが……！
　澪と窓、南雲先生を助けに行かないと）
english: (We killed Karikiri... Shide, but...! I have to go save Mio, Sou, and Nagumo-sensei)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どうした？
english: What's wrong?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん。そいつが言うてたんホンマや。
english: Shin-chan. What he said was true.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 今……澪が死んだ。
english: Just now... Mio died.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……わかるんか！？
english: ...You can tell!?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 感覚でわかる。本物が死んだら。
english: I can tell by feeling. When the real one dies.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Damn it!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（澪……。
　そしてきっと窓も……）
english: (Mio... And surely Sou too...)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 戻るなら……殺そか？
english: If we're going back... should I kill you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……いや、まだだ……。
english: …No, not yet…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
状況を把握する……。
こいつの記憶を調べてくれ！
english: I need to grasp the situation... Check his memories!

speaker: Mio
japanese: わかった。
english: Got it.

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……あれ？
english: ...Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……どうした？
english: …What's wrong?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
……おかしい。
こいつ……記憶が、ない……。
english: ...Something's wrong. This guy... has no memories...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どういうことや！？
english: What do you mean!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
空っぽなんよ。
ついさっきまでの……私らと会話した記憶すらない。
english: It's empty. He doesn't even have the memory of talking with us... from just a moment ago.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
何やこれ…………。
どうやって、動いてたんや…………。
english: What is this... How was he even moving...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
シデは二人おる……。
影じゃない、人間が二人……クローンみたいに。
english: There are two Shides... Not shadows, but two humans... like clones.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
確かにこいつ手ェに火傷なかったな。
ほなもう一人は……。
english: This guy definitely didn't have burns on his hands. Then the other one is...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 南雲先生の方に違いない……！
english: He must be with Nagumo-sensei...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生も無事とは思えない。
　ハイネは先生のケータイから電話してきた……）
english: (I can't imagine Sensei is safe either. Haine called from her phone...)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん、こっち！
english: Shin-chan, over here!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（トキちゃんが倒れて……。
　ひどい傷だ……！）
english: (Toki-chan collapsed... She has terrible wounds...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: トキちゃん！！！
english: Toki-chan!!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……よかった。
生きてたんですね……慎平さん。
english: ...Thank goodness. You're alive... Shinpei-san.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
……ミオの気配を探して……。
こ……ここまで来れた……。
english: ...I searched for Mio's presence... and m-made it this far...

speaker: Mio
japanese: トキコ……何があった？
english: Tokiko... what happened?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
根津さんと凸村さんが……
私を……逃がしてくれた……。
english: Nezu-san and Totsumura-san... they... let me escape...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お願い……。
虎島へ……虎島へ向かって……！！
竜之介さんが……シデと戦ってる……！！
english: Please... Head to Torashima... to Torashima...!! Ryunosuke-san is... fighting Shide...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 竜之介さんを……助けてあげ……て……。
english: Save Ryunosuke-san... please...

speaker: Mio
english: …She's dead…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （トキちゃん……）
english: (Toki-chan...)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん、これがトキコの記憶……。
english: Shin-chan, this is Tokiko's memory...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （シデの攻撃で、ロズが……一瞬で……）
english: (From Shide's attack, Rosencrantz was... in an instant...)

speaker: Mio
japanese:
急ご！
虎島へ……！！
english: Let's hurry! To Torashima...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ん？
これは……。
english: Hm? This is...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（菱形先生の拳銃……！！
　トキちゃんが持ってたのか、まだ一発残ってる……）
english: (Dr. Hishigata's handgun...!! Toki-chan had it. There's still one bullet left...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ハァ……ハァ……。
english: *Pant*... *pant*...

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん！
english: Shin-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （どうする……虎島に行くべきか？）
english: (What do I do... should I go to Torashima?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……よしっ。
english: ...Alright.

japanese: 「行かない」
english: "Don't go"

japanese: 「行こう」
english: "Let's go"

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……行かない！
english: ...I'm not going!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
先生も竜之介さんも
おそらくもう殺されてる。
トキちゃんの記憶からは確かな生死はわからんかった……。
english: Sensei and Ryunosuke-san are probably already dead. I couldn't tell for sure from Toki-chan's memories...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
けど、
それを確認しに行ってる時間がない……！！
english: But I don't have time to go and confirm it...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
確かなんは澪が死んだってことやろ……。
事象の地平線が迫ってる。
急がな澪の死が確定してまうんや……！！
english: The only thing that's certain is that Mio died... The Event Horizon is approaching. If I don't hurry, Mio's death will become fixed...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今ならまだ
「両方」救えるかも知れない……！！
english: Right now, I might still be able to save "both" of them...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今すぐループすれば、
１０時１０分ごろに戻れると思う。
子供らとタカノス山を下りてる所や……。
english: If I loop right now, I think I can return to around 10:10. Right when we were coming down Mt. Takanosu with the kids...

speaker: Mio
japanese: 戻る時間が見えるん！？
english: You can see the time you'll return to!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ……ぼんやりやけどな。
english: Yeah... vaguely, though.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でも、１０時１０分に
ハイネが澪と先生に電話するんは、
もう止められやん。
english: But at 10:10, Haine calling Mio and Sensei can't be stopped anymore.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もっと急いで下山して、
澪たちが畑へ来るのを止めるしかない……！！
english: I have to hurry down the mountain even faster, and stop Mio and the others from coming to the field...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ループしたら爆速でコフネに戻って、
おまえを助ける。
english: Once I loop, I'll rush back to Kofune and save you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
それから速攻で澪と窓に追いついて止める。
戻ってから細かい説明してる時間はない。
english: Then I'll quickly catch up to Mio and Sou and stop them. There won't be time for detailed explanations after I return.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
黙ってついて来い。
澪も南雲先生も、両方助けてみせる。
english: Just follow me without asking questions. I'll save both Mio and Nagumo-sensei.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 時間との勝負……って、ことね。
english: It's a race against time... then.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……じゃ、行ってくる。
english: ...Then, I'm off.

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_08>８度目のＥＮＤ</color>】を入手しました。
english: KEY TIPS[<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_08>8th END</color>] was obtained.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……行こう！
虎島へ。
english: ...Let's go! To Torashima.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（戻るのはまだ早い……！
　少しでも敵の情報を集めてからだ！）
english: (It's too early to go back...! I need to gather as much information on the enemy as possible first!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん？
english: Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あぁ、急ごう！
english: Yeah, let's hurry!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: はぁ……はぁ……はぁ……！
english: *Pant*... *pant*... *pant*...!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 凸村さん、逃げてください！
english: Totsumura-san, please run away!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: で、でもよォ……！
english: B-But...!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
竜之介くんの言う通りですよ。
そんな物騒なものは下ろして、
駐在所に引きこもってなさい……。
english: Ryunosuke-kun is right. Put down that dangerous thing, and hole up in the police box...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
そうすればあなたも
もうちょっとだけ平穏に過ごせるんですよ。
明日の夜までですけど。
english: If you do that, you can spend a little more time in peace. Only until tomorrow night, though.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
あなたも彼女たちの
後を追うことになって良いのですか？
english: Are you fine with following after them?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: お姉ちゃん……根津さん……。
english: Sister... Nezu-san...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
逃げたいけどよ……逃げたいけどさあ！！
そ、そうもいかんやろがよォ……！
正義の味方として……！
english: I want to run... I really do!! B-But I can't just do that...! As a Champion of Justice...!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
やれやれ、
中途半端な正義感が身を滅ぼすって、
どうして学ばないんですかね……？
english: Good grief, why don't you learn that a half-baked sense of justice will destroy you...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……凸村さん、竜之介さん。
無事でしたか……！
english: ...Totsumura-san, Ryunosuke-san. You're safe...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（先生……根津さん……。
　間に合わなかったか……クソッ！！）
english: (Sensei... Nezu-san... I didn't make it in time... damn it!!)

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ようやくおでましですか、慎平くん。
遅かったですねェ……。
english: Finally making your appearance, Shinpei-kun. You're late...

speaker: Shide
japanese: こっちはすっかり楽しませてもらいましたよ。
english: I've been thoroughly entertained over here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english:
Shide…!
…Haine…

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
ふむ……。
朱鷺子の記憶から、ここの顛末をしっておるのか。
english: Hm... So you know what happened here from Tokiko's memories.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん……。
english: Shin-chan…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
わかってる……！
情報を得るだけや、無理はしない。
english: I know...! We're just getting information, we won't push it.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
おやおや、せっかく来たんだから
もっとゆっくり遊んでいけば――
english: My, my, since you came all this way, why don't you stay and play a little longer--

speaker: Shide
japanese: ぐうっ！！？
english: Guh?!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: よそ見しすぎじゃぞ、シデ。
english: You're looking away too much, Shide.

speaker: Shide
japanese: チッ……！
english: Tch…!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
……そういえば、
まだキミがいましたね。
姉弟揃って手癖の悪い……！
english: ...Come to think of it, you were still here. Both sister and brother have such bad habits...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（竜之介さんの攻撃は効いてる！
　……待てよ！？）
english: (Ryunosuke-san's attacks are working! ...Wait a second!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よく見るとシデの鎧が
　少し薄くなっているような……！）
english: (Looking closely, Shide's armor seems to be a little thinner...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（トキちゃんの記憶では
　泥から竜之介さんが
　産まれたように見えた――）
english: (In Toki-chan's memories, it looked like Ryunosuke-san was born from the mud--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そうか……！
　シデの鎧をハッキングして
　実体化の素材にしたということか）
english: (I see...! He hacked Shide's armor and used it as material to materialize)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ということは、
　シデの鎧はこれまでより手薄……！）
english: (Which means, Shide's armor is thinner than before...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （凸村さんにはオレが持ってきた銃を渡そう）
english: (I'll give Totsumura-san the gun I brought.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（他に武器は、竜之介さんのハンマーと
　ミオの包丁……か）
english: (Other weapons are Ryunosuke-san's hammer and Mio's kitchen knife... huh)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（根津さんのライフルと、
　シデの持つ矛のようなもの……）
english: (Nezu-san's rifle, and that spear-like thing Shide has...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……うまくやれれば……！）
english: (...If we can pull this off...!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん……どうする？
english: Shin-chan… what do we do?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ミオ……作戦変更だ。
english: Mio… change of plans.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ここでシデを倒す！
english: ...We're taking down Shide here!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今なら……勝てるかもしれない！）
english: (Right now... we might be able to win!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（勝利を勝ち取ったらループして
　次に活かすか……？
　いや、それは後から考えればいい）
english: (If we secure a victory, should I loop and use it for the next time...? No, I can think about that later.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ミオ、短時間で決着をつけるぞ……！
ループの時間的余裕を残しつつ
今はあいつらを倒すことに専念しろ。
english: Mio, we're settling this quickly...! Leave enough time to loop, but focus on defeating them for now.

speaker: Mio
japanese: わかった。
english: Understood.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さんはこれを使ってください。
english: Please use this, Totsumura-san.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
こ、これは朱鷺子ちゃんに返した拳銃？
や……やったろうやないか……！
english: I-Is this the handgun I returned to Tokiko-chan? I... I'll do it...!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
あくまでここでケリをつけるつもりか。
シデ……。
english: So you're determined to settle this here. Shide...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
私たちに勝てる気でいるなんて。
フカンできてないんとちゃいますか？
english: To think you can beat us. Losing your bird's-eye view?

speaker: Shide
japanese: ならば終わりにしてあげますよ。
english: Then I'll end this for you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ミオ、竜之介さん、凸村さん……！）
english: (Mio, Ryunosuke-san, Totsumura-san...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 行くぞ！！！！
english: Let's go!!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: ッ！

speaker: Shinpei
japanese:
シデ！！
ミオの動きはオトリじゃ！！
english: Shide!! Mio's movements are a decoy!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: ……わかってます！
english: ...I know!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: シデッ！！！
english: Shide!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……うまい！
　ハイネが指示しづらい絶妙な時間差で
　攻撃を仕掛けてる！）
english: (...Nice! He's attacking with a perfect time lag that makes it hard for Haine to give instructions!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 凸村さん！
english: Totsumura-san!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: なっ、なんや！？
english: W-what?!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレたちはハイネをやりましょう！
english: We'll take on Haine!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
け、けどよォ……。
こいつは二発しか装填できやん。
english: B-But... This can only be loaded with two shots.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 少しの間、ハイネを足止めするだけで十分ですから！
english: Just stalling Haine for a little while is enough!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: えええッ！？
english: Eeeeeh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: お願いします！
english: Please!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: わ、わかった！
english: A-Alright!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （頼みましたよ、凸村さん！）
english: (I'm counting on you, Totsumura-san!)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
ハイネ！
おまえの相手はオレじゃーーーーーーー！！
english: Haine! Your opponent is meeeeeeee!!

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: ぬっ！？
english: Nuh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （今だ！）
english: (Now!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ライフルを拾えた！
　こいつで――）
english: (I picked up the rifle! With this--)

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: こざかしいっ……。
english: You insolent...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ミオっ！　ハイネを！
english: Mio! Get Haine!

speaker: Mio
japanese: さようなら、オカアサン。
english: Goodbye, Mother.

speaker: Shinpei
japanese: チィィィィ！　この不良品が！
english: Tchhhhh! You defective product!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （落ち着け、フカンしろ）
english: (Calm down, take a bird's-eye view.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハイネの正面からミオ）
english: (Mio from Haine's front)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （背後から凸村さん）
english: (Totsumura-san from behind)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そして横からはオレ）
english: (And me from the side)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ここからハイネが取る行動は……）
english: (The action Haine will take from here is...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ミオの攻撃をかわすため、後ろ……いや違う）
english: (To dodge Mio's attack, backwards... no, that's not it.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （凸村さんの銃を避けるため、伏せる……いや違う）
english: (To avoid Totsumura-san's gun, duck... no, that's not it.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （残された選択肢は……上、空だ！！）
english: (The remaining option is... up, the sky!!)

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: はえ！？　カラスになった！？
english: Huh!? She turned into a crow!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そう、カラスになって逃げる……）
english: (Right, she'll turn into a crow and escape...)

speaker: Heine
japanese: シデ、わしはいったん引くぞ！
english: Shide, I'm retreating for now!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （あとはオレが仕留めるだけ……）
english: (Then I just need to finish her off...)

speaker: Heine
japanese: ンギッ！！
english: Ngih!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: ハイネ！！？
english: Haine!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: かすっただけか！
english: It just grazed her!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
網代慎平っ！
おまんは絶対に殺すっ！！
english: Shinpei Ajiro! I'll definitely kill you!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （くそっ、逃がしたかっ！）
english: (Damn, I let her get away!)

speaker: Shide
japanese: やれやれ、本当に色々やってくれますねっ。
english: Good grief, you really pull all sorts of stunts, don't you?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: よそ見をしてる余裕なんてあるの？
english: Do you have the luxury to be looking away?

speaker: Shide
japanese: チッ！？
english: Tch!?

speaker: Shide
japanese: ぐぁッッ！！！？
english: Gwahhh!!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （シデの泥がはげた――今だッ！！！！）
english: (Shide's mud flaked off--Now's the time!!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
竜之介さん、ミオ、凸村さんッ！！
誰の攻撃でもいい！
english: Ryunosuke-san, Mio, Totsumura-san!! Any of your attacks will do!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （泥がはげた所に一撃を！）
english: (Land a hit where the mud flaked off!)

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
english: Ugh...! I-Impossible...!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: やった……やったのか？
english: We did it... did we do it?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はぁはぁ……わかりません。
念のためオレがトドメをさしておきます。
english: *Pant, pant*... I don't know. Just in case, I'll deliver the finishing blow.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
いい、慎ちゃん。
それは私がやる。
english: It's fine, Shin-chan. I'll do it.

speaker: Mio
japanese: 殺すの、嫌やろ？
english: You don't want to kill, do you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……悪い、頼む。
english: ...Sorry, please do.

speaker: Mio
japanese: うん。
english: Yeah.

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
いやぁ、慎平くん、あのシデをやれるとは
夢にも思ってなかったで！！
english: Man, Shinpei-kun, I never dreamed we'd be able to take down that Shide!!

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
オレたちホンマモンの
正義の味方やんか！！
english: We're real Champions of Justice!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （南雲先生……根津さん……）
english: (Nagumo-sensei… Nezu-san…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレたちはシデを倒しました）
english: (We defeated Shide)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これならハイネの計画も阻止できるかも
　しれません）
english: (With this, we might be able to stop Haine's plan too.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (But…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪も、窓も、トキちゃんも……、
南雲先生も根津さんも……助けられなかった。
english: Mio, Sou, Toki-chan... Nagumo-sensei and Nezu-san... I couldn't save them.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: お姉ちゃん……。
english: Sister...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
し、慎平くん。
今からループするってのはどうや？
english: S-Shinpei-kun. How about we loop right now?

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese:
弾はないけどよォ、
ミオちゃんか竜之介くんにやってもらうとか……。
english: We don't have any bullets, but maybe we can have Mio-chan or Ryunosuke-kun do it...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 無理ですね……。
english: That's impossible…

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ど、どーして！？
english: W-why!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 思ったより戦いが長引いてしまった。
english: The battle lasted longer than I expected.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
今ループしても、
戦いの最中に戻るだけ……！
english: Even if we loop now, we'll just return to the middle of the battle...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレの……判断ミス、です……。
english: It was my... mistake in judgment...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （みんなにオレはどう謝ればいいんだ……！）
english: (How am I supposed to apologize to everyone...!)

speaker: Mio
japanese: あっ……あああ。
english: Ah... ahhh.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: え？　ミオ？
english: Huh? Mio?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃん……逃げ……て……。
english: Shin-chan... run... away...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: ミ、ミオちゃんが泥に……？
english: M-Mio-chan is turning into mud...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
か、影を刺されたんだ！
でも、誰に……！
english: H-Her shadow was stabbed! But by who...!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
慎平さん気をつけて！
シデがいない！
english: Shinpei-san, be careful! Shide is gone!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh?!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
どれだけ未来が見えても、
その満身創痍の体じゃ避けられないでしょう？
english: No matter how much of the future you can see, you can't dodge with that battered body, can you?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: しまったっ！
english: Damn it!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さん！
english: Ryunosuke-san!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: くそっ、もう体がっ……動かへん……。
english: Damn it, my body... won't move anymore...

speaker: Shide
japanese: 攻略しがいがありましたよ、竜之介くん。
english: You were worth conquering, Ryunosuke-kun.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
english: Ugh… Ah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さん！
english: Ryunosuke-san!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ごめ……お姉ちゃん……ごめん……。
english: Sorry... sister... sorry...

speaker: Tetsu Totsumura
japanese: う、嘘……やん。
english: N-No way...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
クックックックッ。
……話が長くて助かりましたよ。
english: Kukukuku. ...I'm glad the conversation was so long.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
シ、シデ……！？
ど……どうなってる……！？
english: S-Shide...!? W-What's going on...!?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
私の中身は二人……。
それがそもそもの思い違いです。
english: There are two of me inside... That was a misunderstanding from the start.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それはどういうことや！？
english: What does that mean!?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
さて？
ループして、
得意のフカンで考えてみてはどうです？
english: Well? How about looping and thinking about it with your favorite "bird's-eye view"?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
もっとも、
今からループしても
この結末が覆ることはありませんがね。
english: Though, even if you loop from now on, this outcome won't be overturned.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それ、は……。
english: That... is...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
慎平くんがラスボスというわけです。
長かったなァ……。
english: That makes Shinpei-kun the final boss. It's been a long time...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ど……どうすればいいんだ！？！？
　オレと凸村さんだけで……！）
english: (W-What should I do!?!? With just me and Totsumura-san...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だ、ダメだ……頭が回らない……！
　ダメなんだ、もう……！）
english: (I-It's no good... my head isn't working...! It's no good, not anymore...!)

speaker: Shide
japanese:
長かったなァ……。
ようやくグッドエンドにたどり着けそうです。
english: It's been a long time... It looks like we'll finally reach a good ending.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
……ね？
慎平くん……。
english: ...Right? Shinpei-kun...

japanese: 16.最後の夜
english: 16. Last Night

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: 風邪を引くぞ。
english: You'll catch a cold.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
ひづるくんの遺体は、地下に安置している。
彼女の両親に連絡は……。
english: Hizuru-kun's body is resting in the basement. As for contacting her parents...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: まだ駄目です。
english: We can't do that yet.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
……彼女は有名な小説家だったらしいな。
殺されたとなれば全国的なニュースになる。
マスコミが島に大勢押し寄せるだろう。
english: ...She was apparently a famous novelist. If she was murdered, it will become national news. The media will swarm the island in droves.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
胸の刺傷は隠せない。
誰がどう見ても他殺体だ。
english: The stab wound in her chest can't be hidden. Anyone can see it's a homicide.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
隠さなくていいです、これは殺人です。
犯人も判ってる。
でもあと一日だけオレにください。
english: You don't have to hide it, this is murder. We know the culprit too. But please, just give me one more day.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: ああ……わかって――
english: Yeah... I underst--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ありがとうございます。
english: Thank you.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
んっ？
あ……すいません……かぶりました……。
english: Hm? Ah... sorry... I talked over you...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……しゃべりにくいな、これ……。
english: ...It's hard to talk with this on...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
ああ、それと。
シデが二人いると言っていた件についてだが。
english: Ah, also. About the matter of there being two Shides.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
ヤツは肉体を乗りかえて、
３００年以上も存えてきた男だぞ。
english: He's a man who has survived for over 300 years by switching bodies.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
万一事故や病気で死んだり
重傷を負ったりした時のために、
スペアがあってもおかしくない。
english: It wouldn't be strange for him to have a spare, in case he died or got seriously injured from an accident or illness.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: つまり……ハイネは何人も子供を産んでた？
english: So... Haine gave birth to multiple children?

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
いや……そうじゃない。
シデは今までの肉体を「保存」していたが……
english: No... that's not it. Shide was "storing" his past bodies, but...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
先の戦争ですべて焼失した。
昔、私の父からそう聞いたことがある……。
english: They were all burned up in the last war. I heard that from my father a long time ago...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あの写真に写っていた死体は……まだある！？
english: The corpse in that photo... is still around!?

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
そうなるな……ヤツの前の肉体、
雁切巌が死んだのは、４０年前……戦後だ。
english: That would be the case... His previous body, Iwao Karikiri, died 40 years ago... after the war.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
自分の死体を大切に保存するなど、
ナルシシズムの極致と思っていたが……
それが動くならスペアとして使える。
english: I thought carefully preserving one's own corpse was the height of narcissism, but... If it can move, it can be used as a spare.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
保存方法も、どうやって動いているのかも、
見当もつかんがね。
english: I have no idea how they're preserved, or how they're moving, though.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: <color=#GF_TIPS_084>サブアカ</color>……？
english: <color=#GF_TIPS_084>Sub-account</color>…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
菱形先生。
耳ふさいでください……。
english: Dr. Hishigata. Please cover your ears...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
english: ...What?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……落ちましたね、海に。
english: ...It fell, didn't it. Into the sea.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
……キ、キミ。
雷が落ちることを<color=#GF_KEY_2SECOND>なぜわかった</color>！？
english: ...Y-You. <color=#GF_KEY_2SECOND>How did you know</color> the lightning would strike!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（落ちることが事前にわかった……。
　これが竜之介さんの予知能力……）
english: (I knew it would strike beforehand... So this is Ryunosuke-san's precognition...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ありがとうございます……。
　竜之介さん……南雲先生）
english: (Thank you... Ryunosuke-san... Nagumo-sensei.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮だけじゃなく、
　南雲先生を亡くし……ロズも失った）
english: (Not only Ushio, but I lost Nagumo-sensei... and Rosencrantz too.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（根津さんのライフルも、
　潮がコピーしたショットガンも拳銃も……もう、ない）
english: (Nezu-san's rifle, Ushio's copied shotgun and handgun... they're all gone.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
対してシデは健在……。
どうする……？
オレたちだけで……勝ち目はあんのか……。
english: In contrast, Shide is alive and well... What do I do...? Do we have any chance of winning... with just us...

speaker: Mio
japanese: ……そのことなんやけど。
english: ...About that.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ミオ？
english: Mio?

speaker: Mio
japanese: 慎ちゃんのポケット、中に何入ってんの？
english: What's in your pocket, Shin-chan?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ、これ……。
貝殻のネックレスだよ。潮の……。
english: Ah, this... It's a seashell necklace. Ushio's...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
呼びかけても何の反応もないし、
多分……消えた潮のかけらなんやと思う……。
english: There's no reaction when I call out to it, so it's probably... a fragment of the Ushio that disappeared...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
……やっぱり。
だから逃げたんや、ハイネ。
english: ...I knew it. That's why Haine ran away.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Huh...?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
反応ないなんてことないよ、慎ちゃん。
私ら影にはわかった。
めっちゃ怒ってたから……お姉ちゃん。
english: It's not that there's no reaction, Shin-chan. Us shadows could tell. She was super angry... my sister.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
お姉ちゃん、ここにいてるよ。
お姉ちゃんの記憶全部ここに入ってる。
english: Sister is in here. All of her memories are inside this.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
消える直前になんとか記憶だけは
貝に移したんやと思う。
english: I think she managed to transfer just her memories into the shell right before she disappeared.

speaker: Mio
japanese: でも身体はないから……これやと動けやん。
english: But she doesn't have a body... so she can't move like this.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮の記憶がこの中に……。
　……だからハイネは、
　潮が生きてるってカン違いを……）
english: (Ushio's memories are in here... ...So that's why Haine misunderstood and thought Ushio was still alive...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
タカノス山でハイネが退いたのも、
潮のおかげだったのか……。
english: So Haine retreating at Mt. Takanosu was also thanks to Ushio...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
記憶だけになっても、
慎ちゃんを守ったんやね……。
english: Even though she was reduced to just memories, she still protected you, Shin-chan...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これの……貝の記憶は？
スキャンしたんか！？
english: What about this... shell's memories? Did you scan it!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
無理。
他の影には読めやんようにされちゃある。
オカアサンみたい……。
english: Impossible. It's made so that other shadows can't read it. Just like Mother...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
敵の手ェに渡らんようにそうしたんとちゃうかな。
そのデータを読めるんはお姉ちゃんだけ。
でもお姉ちゃんはもう……。
english: I think she did that so it wouldn't fall into enemy hands. The only one who can read that data is my sister. But my sister is already...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Wait a second...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……帰って来る。
english: ...She's coming back.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうなんや……明日っ！！
２４日のお祭りで、
花火が上がる時、あの海岸にっ……！！
english: That's right... tomorrow!! At the festival on the 24th, when the fireworks go off, on that beach...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
まだ何も知らん、最初のあいつが……
帰って来る！！
english: The original her who doesn't know anything yet... will come back!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
……そっか！！
明日のお姉ちゃんに、この貝をスキャンしてもらえば！
english: ...I get it!! If we have tomorrow's sister scan this shell!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああっ！
まちがいない！！
だからあいつはこれを残したんや……！！
english: Yeah! There's no doubt about it!! That's why she left this behind...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮が……復活する！
english: Ushio... will be revived!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 慎ちゃん。
english: Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Yeah.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
雨、上がったね。
何してんの？
english:
The rain has stopped.
What are you doing?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ちょっと練習。
english: Just practicing.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: 練習？
english: Practicing?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: あぁ。ちょっと、な。
english: Yeah. Just a little bit.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（２秒先の予測、
　自在に使いこなせるようにならないと）
english: (Predicting two seconds into the future, I need to be able to use it freely.)

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
そっか……覚えてる？
今朝、出かける前に言うたこと。
english: I see... Do you remember? What I said this morning before we left.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 無事に帰って来たら、話がある……やっけ？
english: If we come back safely, you had something to talk about... right?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
うん。
明日……ほんまにお姉ちゃん帰って来るん？
english: Yeah. Tomorrow... is my sister really coming back?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮が意味もなく、
自分のデータを貝に込めたとは思えん。
english: I can't imagine Ushio putting her data into the shell for no reason.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あいつは消える前、シデをスキャンした……。
きっと何かをつかんだはずや。
english: She scanned Shide before she disappeared... She must have figured something out.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 賭けになるけど、可能性は十分ある……！！
english: It's a gamble, but there's a good possibility...!!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……何か、またいい作戦思いついたって顔やな。
english: ...You look like you've come up with another good plan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
どうかな……あとでみんなに話すよ。
……話ってそれ？
english: We'll see... I'll tell everyone later. ...Is that what you wanted to talk about?

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
え？
や……うん……。
english: Huh? N-... Yeah...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: あの……あのな、慎ちゃん！
english: Um... you know, Shin-chan!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
話があるって言うたやん？
その……。
english: I said I had something to talk about, right? Well...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……なんていうか……。
english: ...How should I put this...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……好き。
english: I like you.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……なん……よ……。
私……慎ちゃんのことっ……。
english: ...I like you... I... like you, Shin-chan...

japanese: 「……ごめん」
english: "…Sorry."

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: M-... Yeah...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……それだけ？
english: ...Is that all?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや……あ……ありがとう……。
english: No... t-thank you...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……もしかして、気付いてた……？
english: ...Did you already know...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Yeah...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あ！　別にその……
へっ……変に思わんといてな！
ただ……言いたかっただけなん……。
english: Ah! It's not like... D-Don't think it's weird, okay! I just... wanted to say it...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
明日死ぬかも知らんやろ、私ら……。
<color=#GF_TIPS_112>この気持ち</color>、慎ちゃんに伝えんまま
死ぬん嫌やってん！
english: We might die tomorrow, you know... I didn't want to die without telling you <color=#GF_TIPS_112>this feeling</color>, Shin-chan!

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
だから……ただ……
伝えたかっただけやから……！！
english: So... I just... I just wanted to tell you...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そっか……。
english: I see...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……うん。
english: ...Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ごめん、澪。
english: ...Sorry, Mio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
澪の気持ちにはこたえられやん……。
おまえはオレの大事な妹やから。
english: I can't return your feelings... Because you're my precious little sister.

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: ...I see...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あーー、スッ……キリしたあぁーーっ！！！！
……これで死んでも後悔ないわ！
english: Ahhh, I feel so much... better!!!! ...Now I won't have any regrets even if I die!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……ごめん。澪。
english: ...Sorry. Mio.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 澪の気持ちには、こたえられやん……。
english: I can't return your feelings...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: オレは……<color=#GF_TIPS_094>潮が好き</color>なんや。
english: I...<color=#GF_TIPS_094>love Ushio</color>.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……うん。
english: ...Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おまえはオレの、大事な妹や。
english: You're my precious little sister.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese: ……うん。
english: ...Yeah.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
ありがと……。
ちゃんと言うてくれて……。
english: Thank you... For telling me properly...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
あーー、スッ……キリしたあぁーーっ！！！！
……これで死んでも後悔ないわ！
english: Ahhh, I feel so much... better!!!! ...Now I won't have any regrets even if I die!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 待ってくれ、澪！
english: Wait, Mio!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: それ以上は……言わんといてくれ。
english: Please... don't say any more.

speaker: Mio Kofune
english: Huh...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
悪い……。
おまえが勇気を振りしぼってんのは、
痛いくらい伝わってる……。
english: Sorry... I can painfully feel how much courage it took for you to say that...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だからこそ……
聞くわけにはいかないんや……。
english: And that's exactly why... I can't listen to it...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん……。
でも、明日は――
english: Shin-chan... But, tomorrow is--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
生きて明日を乗り越えよう。
今のオレはそのことしか考えられやん。
english: Let's survive and overcome tomorrow. Right now, that's the only thing I can think about.

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……そんなん言われたら……そうするしかないやん。
ずるいなァ、慎ちゃん。
english: ...If you say it like that... I have no choice but to agree. You're so unfair, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: すまん……。
english: Sorry...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
……へへ。
ええよ、わかった……。
english: ...Hehe. It's fine, I understand...

speaker: Mio Kofune
japanese:
慎ちゃん……。
明日、頑張ろうね……！
english: Shin-chan... Let's do our best tomorrow...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……おう。
english: ...Yeah.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どう転んでも明日……。
　７月２４日に、すべてが決まる……！）
english: (No matter how things turn out, tomorrow... July 24th, everything will be decided...!)

japanese: 17.希望
english: 17. Hope

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: これからシデたちがどう出てくるかですが……。
english: As for how Shide and the others will make their move...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
シデはオレの力を、
並行世界を観測する力って言いました。
english: Shide said that my power is the ability to observe parallel worlds.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 並行世界？
english: Parallel worlds?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
タイムトラベラーが過去へ遡って、
未来を改変すると時間軸が分岐して……。
english: When a time traveler goes back to the past and alters the future, the timeline branches off...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
トラベラーが元いた世界と並行した、
別の世界が生まれる……って考え方です。
english: And another world is born, parallel to the world the traveler originally came from... That's the concept.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
つまり、オレと澪が死んだ世界と、
助かった世界があるってことやな……。
english: In other words, there's a world where Mio and I died, and a world where we were saved...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
うん。
そして、並行世界は可能性の数だけ無数に存在する。
english: Yeah. And there are an infinite number of parallel worlds, as many as there are possibilities.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
つまり慎平さんが死ぬと、
世界はいくつも「コピペ」されて、
その中の１つの意識だけが移動する……。
english: In other words, when Shinpei-san dies, the world is "copy-pasted" multiple times, and only your consciousness moves to one of them...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
そして、それまでの世界は
なかったことになるというわけですね。
english: And the world up until that point ceases to exist, right?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
本来やったら並行世界は無数に存在するのに、
観測者――つまり慎平の意識がある世界を残して
すべてなくなってしまうわけか。
english: So normally there would be an infinite number of parallel worlds, but all of them disappear except for the one with the observer-- meaning Shinpei's consciousness.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……そこまではわかったが……。
肝心の潮は……？
なんであいつが現れるってわかるんや！？
english: ...I understand that much, but... What about Ushio? How do we know she's going to appear!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい……。
２４日に現れる初期状態の潮を「ウシオ」としますが……。
english: Yes... Let's call the initial state of Ushio that appears on the 24th "Ushio"...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ウシオとは、
３周目の祭りの日に初めて出会いました。
その後の虐殺でオレはループするわけですが――
english: I first met Ushio on the day of the festival in the 3rd loop. After the massacre that followed, I looped, but--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あいつはなぜかオレにくっついて、
意識だけじゃなく、実体を伴って
４周目の世界にやって来ました。
english: For some reason she stuck to me, and came to the 4th loop's world with not just her consciousness, but her physical body as well.

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
そうか……！！
４周目の世界にも元々ウシオが存在していたはず。
そこに、３周目からのウシオもやってきた……。
english: I see...!! Ushio should have originally existed in the 4th loop's world too. And the Ushio from the 3rd loop also arrived there...

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese: その時点で、潮の影は二人存在したのか。
english: At that point, there were two of Ushio's shadows.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうです。
そしてウシオは、７月２４日朝５時の現時点では――
english: That's right. And as for Ushio, at this current time of 5 AM on July 24th--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ハイネから負ったダメージを徐々に回復しつつ、
海のどこかを漂ってるはずなんです。
english: She should be drifting somewhere in the sea, gradually recovering from the damage she took from Haine.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
海水浴の時にしおりちゃんを
守ろうとして受けたダメージやな……。
クソッ……！
english: That's the damage she took trying to protect Shiori-chan while swimming in the sea... Damn it...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレやハイネと同じなら、
あいつはループする時、海を漂う自分に
意識だけ移動するはずですが――
english: If she's like me and Haine, when she loops, only her consciousness should transfer to her body drifting in the sea, but--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そうはなっていない。
english: That's not what's happening.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
だから、この世界には
海を漂う９周目世界のウシオと――
english: So, in this world, there's the Ushio from the 9th loop drifting in the sea, and--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
この貝殻――つまり
オレと一緒にループしてきた３周目世界の「潮」が
同時に存在してることになります。
english: This seashell--meaning the "Ushio" from the 3rd loop who looped with me, existing at the same time.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これはシンペイ――ハイネも、
同じ考え方をしてると考えるべきです……。
english: We should assume that Shinpei--Haine, is also thinking the same thing...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
消える直前、潮はシデの頭を読んだ。
そこでヤツらが、『２４日にウシオが現れる』って
考えてることを知って――
english: Right before she disappeared, Ushio read Shide's mind. There, she learned that they were thinking "Ushio will appear on the 24th"--

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: そこに賭けたんだと……そう思いました。
english: And that's what she bet on... That's what I think.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
おいおい……。
仮定の上の仮定やんけ。
そんなんただの「願望」や。
english: Hey, hey... That's an assumption on top of an assumption. That's just a "wish."

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
潮とのループが始まってから、
初めて「２４日」に到達するんです。
誰も確信はできませんよ。
english: This is the first time we've reached the "24th" since the loops with Ushio started. No one can be certain.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: でも、潮だけはわかってたはずなんです。
english: But Ushio alone should have known.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: なぜそう言い切れる？
english: How can you be so sure?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
さっきまでは願望……。
でも今は、確信してます。
english: Until a moment ago, it was a wish... But now, I'm certain.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: これを見ててください……。
english: Please look at this...

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
あっ！
貝殻が動いてる……！？
english: Ah! The seashell is moving...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
この貝殻をどこへ置いても
わずかやけど「南」に向かって動くんです。
english: No matter where I place this seashell, it moves slightly towards the "south".

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
いつからや！？
こんな……。
english: Since when!? This is...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
朝３時ころに一番ハッキリ動いてて、
今はだいぶ弱くなってる。
english: It moved the most clearly around 3 AM, and now it's gotten a lot weaker.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 上げ潮か……！！
english: The rising tide...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい！
南向きの万年青浜に打ち上げられるには、
南から北への海流が必要です。
english: Yes! To wash up on the south-facing Omoto Beach, a current flowing from south to north is necessary.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
月の引力に引っぱられて、
瀬戸内海の海水が海峡を出たり入ったりするので……。
english: Pulled by the moon's gravity, the seawater of the Seto Inland Sea flows in and out of the strait...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮が満ちる上げ潮の時に、
ちょうどその向きの流れになるんです。
english: During the rising tide when the water comes in, the current flows in exactly that direction.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なるほど……！
つまりウシオは今、大阪湾や瀬戸内海やなく、
紀伊水道におるっちゅうわけやな！
english: I see...! In other words, Ushio is currently in the Kii Channel, not Osaka Bay or the Seto Inland Sea!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そう……。
この貝はウシオに反応してるんや……！！
english: Yes... This shell is reacting to Ushio...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: さっきまで……近くに来てた……。
english: She was close by... until just a little while ago...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
干潮と満潮は一日２回ずつ起こる！
２回目の満潮は夕方６時ころのはずや！！
english: Low and high tides happen twice a day each! The second high tide should be around 6 PM!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
その時にまた……
ウシオはこの島へ近付いて来る……！！
english: At that time... Ushio will approach this island again...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はい……！！
オレがウシオに会ったのは８時すぎやったけど
きっとそれより前に流れ着くんです！
english: Yes...!! I met Ushio after 8 o'clock, but she must wash ashore before then!

speaker: Seidou Hishigata
japanese:
シデらにとってみれば、ただでさえ脅威の潮が
二人になるかも知れないというわけだ……。
english: From Shide's perspective, the already threatening Ushio might become two...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
この不安は見過ごせません……。
おそらく全力で……シデ自らやって来る……！！
english: They can't overlook this concern... Shide will probably come himself... with full force...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でもヤツらは、ウシオの正確な位置をわかってない。
ほんまにウシオが現れるかも半信半疑のはず。
english: But they don't know Ushio's exact location. They must be half-doubting whether Ushio will really appear.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ウシオさんはバグってるから、
気配をつかめやんってハイネが言ってましたね……。
english: Haine said she couldn't sense Ushio-san's presence because she's bugged, right...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
でもこっちには確信がある……！！
この差がオレたちの勝機です！
english: But we have certainty...!! This difference is our chance to win!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
このチャンスを逃せば、
オレたちは潮を完全に失ってしまう。
english: If we miss this chance, we will completely lose Ushio.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 迎えに行っちゃろら……。
english: Let's go get her...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Yeah...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: なんか希望、見えてきたね。
english: I can see some hope now.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おう！
english: Yeah!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
じゃあみんな、
後は手はず通りによろしくお願いします……！！
english: Then everyone, please proceed according to the plan from here on out...!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: もしもし……網代くん？
english: Hello... Ajiro-kun?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
小弓場さん？
ちょっと頼みがあるんだ……。
english: Koyuba-san? I have a little favor to ask...

japanese: 10周目
english: 10th Loop
18. July 24

japanese: 7月24日
english: July 24

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
これからこの神輿がですね、
参道を下って万年青浜へと運ばれて行きます！
english: Now then, this mikoshi will descend the shrine path and be carried to Omoto Beach!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
そこで、ゴミ拾い大会で集めたゴミを
神輿に乗せましてェ……。
あっ、ゴミとはいえ神様の一部ですから！
english: There, we will load the trash collected in the clean-up contest onto the mikoshi... Ah, but even though it's trash, it's a part of the gods!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
そして再び参道を上り、
境内まで戻ってまいります！
english: And then we will ascend the shrine path once more, and return to the shrine grounds!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
この神輿と共にねり歩いてですね、
その後の御海送りを見ますとなんとっ！！
english: If you parade along with this mikoshi, and then watch the Umi-okuri afterwards, surprisingly!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ヒルコ様の御加護で健康運が爆上がり！！！
みなさんふるってご参加ください！
english: Your health luck will skyrocket with Hiruko-sama's divine protection!!! Everyone, please feel free to participate!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
境内から花火もよーーく見えて、
オススメで～～す！！
みなさん私といっしょに長生きしましょーーっ！！！
english: You can also see the fireworks reeeeally well from the shrine grounds, so it's highly recommended~~!! Everyone, let's live a long life together with me!!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: （長生きですか……）
english: (A long life, huh...)

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: （そういえば、明日の事なんて考えてなかったなぁ）
english: (Come to think of it, I hadn't thought about tomorrow at all.)

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese: 衣装キマッてますね、雁切さん！
english: Looking sharp in that outfit, Karikiri-san!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: シンペイくん……。
english: Shinpei-kun…

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese: 今日はがんばってくださいね。
english: Do your best today, okay?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ははっ、ありがとう！
english: Haha, thanks!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
……シンペイくん？
どうしたんです？
english: ...Shinpei-kun? What's wrong?

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese: ウシオ捜索は中止じゃ……！
english: The search for Ushio is canceled!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ……ループしたんですね？
english: ...He looped, didn't he?

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
慎平の「確信」、
潮のことやと思てた……。
潮を二人に増やし、ヒルコ洞に乗り込む気ィやと……！
english: Shinpei's "certainty"... I thought it was about Ushio. That he planned to increase Ushio to two and storm Hiruko Cave...!

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
じゃが違うぞ、ヤツの「確信」は……。
手形の位置を隠したのは……！！
english: But I was wrong, his "certainty" was... The reason he hid the location of the handprint was...!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ハイネ……いったい何を見て来たんです……？
english: Haine... what exactly did you see...?

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese: ヒルコ洞じゃ……。
english: In the Hiruko Cave…

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
ヤツめ……ループを利用して、
潮をわしの喉元に指しよった……！！
english: That bastard... he used the loop to thrust Ushio right at my throat...!!

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
紀伊水道の捜索……。
わしの信号を無視する野良はおらんか。
english: The search of the Kii Channel... Are there any strays ignoring my signal?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ……どういうことです？
english: ...What do you mean?

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
慎平の位置が消えて、一刻ほど経つ。
これをどう見る、シデよ。
english: Shinpei's position has disappeared, and about an hour has passed. What do you make of this, Shide?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ……あの手形を消した？
english: ...He erased that handprint?

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
手形は消せやん……。
アレは慎平の存在そのものにつけた印じゃ。
english: The handprint can't be erased... That is a mark placed on Shinpei's existence itself.

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
じゃが、存在を遮断することはできる。
おまんみたいに、泥の中ならの……。
english: But, his presence can be blocked off. Like you do, inside the mud...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 少々……ヒントを与えすぎましたねェ。
english: I gave him a little... too many hints.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
野良のほとんどをウシオ捜索に出してます。
今ヒルコ洞に突入されれば……。
english: Most of the strays are out searching for Ushio. If they charge into Hiruko Cave now...

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese: いや、まだそれはなかろう。
english: No, it's too early for that.

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
ヤツらは一度、
わしの寝所まで来て「詰み」かけた……。
よほどの確信がない限り、再突入はできない――
english: They came to my sleeping quarters once and were almost "checkmated"... Unless they have absolute certainty, they can't re-enter--

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese: ――と、慎平なら考える。
english: --is what Shinpei would think.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: では、いったい何のために隠れるんです？
english: Then, what on earth are they hiding for?

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese: ここからは憶測じゃが――
english: This is just speculation from here, but--

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
もしも……慎平にくっついてる「潮」にだけは、
紀伊水道を漂う自分の――
「ウシオ」の位置がわかるとしたら、どうじゃ……。
english: What if... only the "Ushio" attached to Shinpei knew the location of her own self drifting in the Kii Channel-- "Ushio"...

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
わしらより先にウシオと接触するため、
わしらにウシオの位置を教えやんように、
自分の位置を隠す……慎平ならそうする。
english: To make contact with Ushio before us, he's hiding his own position so as not to tell us Ushio's location... Shinpei would do that.

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
ウシオを見つけよ……。
ヤツらに先んじて始末するのじゃ……！
english: Find Ushio... We must dispose of her before they do...!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 静かやな……。
english: It's quiet…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
japanese:
ええ……。
もうずっと静かです。
慎平さんの作戦がうまくいってるってことですね。
english: Yes... It's been quiet for a while now. That means Shinpei-san's plan is working.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……ふむ。
english: …Hm.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 左目を手で覆うと竜之介の人格が外に出る、か――
english: Covering the left eye with a hand brings out Ryunosuke's personality, huh--

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……またこうやって話せるとはな。
竜之介。
english: ...To think we could talk like this again. Ryunosuke.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
japanese: 姉は……根津さんに感謝してました……。
english: My sister... was grateful to you, Nezu-san...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: あん？
english: Huh?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
japanese: １４年前に助けてくれたことをです。
english: For saving her 14 years ago.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
あァ……。
……時々な……ひづるから手紙が届いたよ……。
english: Ah... ...Sometimes... I got letters from Hizuru...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
茄子のぬか漬けが上手く出来たとか、
猫を飼い始めたとか……しょうもないことを……。
english: Saying she made good pickled eggplants, or that she started keeping a cat... trivial things...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
書いた本が映画になったて聞いたときは、
腰ぬかしたで……ふふっ。
小説家になってたことを先に言わんかい、ってな……。
english: When I heard the book she wrote became a movie, I was floored... heheh. Like, why didn't you tell me you became a novelist first...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
japanese:
リアルでそれ知ってるの、
根津さんだけでしたよ。
english: You were the only one who knew that in real life, Nezu-san.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
……何じゃアイツは？
照れ屋かよ！
english: ...What was up with her? Was she shy!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
japanese:
根津さんは姉の……
影の話を信じてくれた、唯一の大人やったからです。
english: Because Nezu-san was the only adult... who believed my sister's story about the shadows.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
ふん……おかげで儂まで変人扱いされたわい！
ま……そういうんは慣れちゃあるけどよ。
english: Hmph... thanks to that, even I was treated like a weirdo! Well... I'm used to that sort of thing, though.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
japanese: ……根津さんのことを、信頼してます。
english: ...I trust you, Nezu-san.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
japanese: 姉も、僕も。
english: My sister, and me.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……今さら……言葉らいらん……。
english: ...No need for words... at this point...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
english: It's here...!!
19. Resurrection!

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
シデよ……。
木の葉を隠すなら森の中じゃ……。
english: Shide... If you want to hide a leaf, put it in a forest...

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
慎平は必ず来る、
野良の中に紛れてな……！
english: Shinpei will definitely come, hiding among the strays...!

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
野良どもにおまんの側へ集まるよう言うちゃある。
周りをよう見てみィ……。
群れから外れた野良を探せ……！
english: I've told the strays to gather near you. Look closely around you... Find the stray that's separated from the pack...!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 見つけた……！
english: Found it...!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 一人だけ沖へ離れて行く野良がいる……！
english: There's one stray heading out to sea all alone...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
近い……近いぞ。
貝の反応がはげしくなってる……。
english: She's close... she's close. The shell's reaction is getting stronger...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（何かが近づいてくる……
　潮……じゃない……？）
english: (Something's approaching... Ushio... no...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: …Shide!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
もう気付いたッ！
急げギル！
english: He already noticed! Hurry, Guildenstern!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: アウ！
english: Awooo!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いた……。
english: There she is...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
見っけたッ……！！
今行くからな、潮！！
english: I found you...!! I'm coming right now, Ushio!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
暗……。
何も……見えやん。
english: It's dark... I can't... see anything.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
