どこ……ここ？
私……なにしてたんやっけ？
english: Where... is this? What was I... doing again?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
だれ……？
私を……呼んでんの……。
english: Who...? Who's... calling me...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio!!!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平……？
english: Shinpei…?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なっ……なになに！？
なんなん～～～～～～～～～っ！！？
english: Wh-... what what!? What is thiiiiiiis!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
水中じゃ分が悪い！
ギル！
ウシオをつかまえて、海上に出るぞ！
english: We're at a disadvantage underwater! Guildenstern! Grab Ushio and get above water!

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: アウ！
english: Awooo!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ひゃっ。
english: Eek.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あっ……赤ちゃん！？　でかっ！
なんなんあんた！！
どこの子っ！！？
english: Ah... a baby!? Huge! What are you!! Whose kid are you!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
慎平……？
……なんで……おるん……！
帰ってきたん……？
english: Shinpei...? ...Why... are you here...! Did you come back...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああっ！
迎えにきたんや、おまえをっ！！
english: Yeah! I came to get you!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: そうはさせま――
english: I won't let you--

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 思い……出した……！！
english: I... remember...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平なら、やってくれるて思てたっ！！
english: I knew you would do it, Shinpei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 戻ったな……！！
english: You're back...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……！！
　シデの鎧から大量の野良が！！）
english: (...!! A massive amount of strays from Shide's armor!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮っ！！
掴まれたらあかんぞ！！
english: Ushio!! Don't let them grab you!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
大丈夫っ！
完全完璧――
english: I'm fine! Complete and perfect--

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 大復活じゃあっ！！！！
english: Great resurrection!!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
私の鎧が戻らない……消し飛ばされている！？
野良たちも消滅……。
english: My armor isn't returning... it's being blown away!? The strays are vanishing too...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
あの髪の刃が触れた一瞬で、
すべてのハッキングを
完了したってことですか……。
english: In the instant that hair blade touched, you completed all the hacking...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
……また成長したようですね……。
イレギュラー……。
english: ...It seems you've grown again... Irregular...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ふんっ！
この前はよくも後ろからやってくれたな……！
english: Hmph! You sure got me from behind last time...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 今度こそッ、負けへんで！！！！
english: This time, I won't lose!!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
海で戦っても影は不死身！
でも私ならハッキングできる！
english: Shadows are immortal even if you fight them in the sea! But I can hack them!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そもそもシデに弱点はないけど
泥をハックして鎧を剥がす！！
今度こそヤツを仕留める――
english: Shide doesn't have any weaknesses to begin with, but I'll hack the mud and strip off his armor!! This time I'll finish him off--

speaker: Heine
japanese: ――などと考えておるな……？
english: --Is what you're thinking, right...?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
考えていた展開とは
少し違いましたね……。
english: This is a little different from the development I had in mind...

speaker: Heine
japanese:
おそらく記憶だけ移植して
復活を果たしたのじゃ……！
english: She probably just transplanted her memories and achieved resurrection...!

speaker: Heine
japanese:
あの時、タカノス山で
殺しといたらよかってん！
english: We should've killed her back then on Mt. Takanosu!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
たらればは無意味ですよ。
今をフカンしなければ……。
english: "What ifs" are meaningless. We have to take a bird's-eye view of the present...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: 潮が二人に増えるという最悪ではないのです。
english: It's not the worst-case scenario of Ushio multiplying into two.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
うむ……。
潮……その成長が裏目じゃ。
english: Hmph... Ushio... your growth has backfired.

speaker: Heine
japanese:
海では捕獲しか望めぬと思うとったが、
おかげでこの場で殺してしまえる。
english: I thought I could only hope to capture you in the sea, but thanks to that, I can kill you right here.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
彼女の刃圏まであと数センチ……。
ですが――
english: She's just a few centimeters away from my blade's reach... But--

speaker: Shide
japanese:
私の『<color=#GF_TIPS_115>ヤマビコ</color>』……。
相打ちならこちらは鎧を失うだけで済む……。
english: My "<color=#GF_TIPS_115>Yamabiko</color>"... If it's a mutual strike, I'll only lose my armor...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
来るがいい……。
しかし私の刃はあなたの命に届くのです！
english: Come at me... But my blade will reach your life!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うぉおおぉぉぉぉ！！！
english: Uwoooooo!!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: お姉ちゃん、タンマ。
english: Sister, time out.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: えっ。
english: Huh?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なっ、なんで？
ミオ！？
え～～なんでェェ～～ッ！！？
english: Wh-Why? Mio!? Eeeh~~ whyyyy!!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
なんで邪魔すんの！！
ミオ、手ぇ放せっ！！
あいつ一発なぐらせろーーーっ！！
english: Why are you getting in the way!! Mio, let go!! Let me punch that guy just once!!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
落ち着いて！
暴れやんと、私の記憶を見て！
english: Calm down! Stop thrashing around and look at my memories!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: マ……マジで！
english: S-... Seriously!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そんな作戦……！！
慎平……さっすが……。
english: A plan like that...!! Shinpei... you're amazing...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Shide!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: はい？
english: Yes?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: どっから来たと思う、オレが。
english: Where do you think I came from?

speaker: Shide
japanese: なんですって？
english: Excuse me?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
やっぱりわからんみたいやな。
ギルの中やと手形の位置を隠せるってことや……。
english: Seems you really don't understand. It means I can hide the handprint's position if I'm inside Gil...

speaker: Shide
japanese: まさか……！！
english: It can't be...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: じゃあな。
english: See ya.

speaker: Heine
japanese: 撃たせるな！！
english: Don't let him shoot!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（攻撃が来る！！
　２秒後の未来は――）
english: (An attack is coming!! The future 2 seconds from now is--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （拳銃を破壊される……！）
english: (The handgun will be destroyed...!)

speaker: Shide
japanese: ふんッ！！
english: Hmph!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （シデの狙いはオレを死なせないこと！）
english: (Shide's goal is to not let me die!)

speaker: Shide
japanese:
かわした！？
アホな――！？
english: He dodged!? Impossible--!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よし、２秒のズレにも
　だいぶ慣れてき――）
english: (Alright, I'm getting pretty used to the 2-second delay--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（追撃……！？
　しまった、銃が――）
english: (A follow-up attack...!? Crap, the gun is--)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平ッ！！
english: Shinpei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……すまん……潮！
　オレの首をはねてくれて……
　助かっ……た……！！）
english: (...Sorry... Ushio! Thanks for... cutting my head off... You saved me...!!)

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_09>９度目のＥＮＤ</color>】を入手しました。
english: KEY TIPS[<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_09>9th END</color>] has been acquired.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （行くぞ、ウシオ――）
english: (Let's go, Ushio--)

speaker: (Stage Direction)
japanese: キーＴＩＰＳ【<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_09>９度目のＥＮＤ</color>】を入手しました。
english: KEY TIPS[<color=#GF_KEY_LOOPEND_09>9th END</color>] has been acquired.

japanese: 20.伏魔殿
english: Chapter 20: Temple of Demons

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 静かやな……。
english: It's quiet...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
japanese: ええ、もうずっと静かです。
english: Yes, it's been quiet for a while now.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
こうやってギルん中にいれば
ほんまに手形の信号を隠せんのかな？
english: Can we really hide the handprint's signal by staying inside Gil like this?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
今のところは大丈夫そうやけど、
ぶっつけ本番やからなァ。
……竜之介さんはどう思います？
english: It seems fine for now, but we're doing this with no rehearsal. ...What do you think, Ryunosuke-san?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
japanese:
検証できませんでしたからね……。
信号が消えたらハイネに気づかれるし、
あんまり早いと考察の時間を与えてしまう……。
english: We couldn't verify it, after all... If the signal disappears, Haine will notice, and if we do it too early, it gives them time to think...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
japanese:
今のところは何も起こってませんし、
「２時間前に入る」という慎平さんの判断は、
正しかったんやないでしょうか。
english: Nothing has happened so far, so I think Shinpei-san's decision to "enter two hours prior" was correct.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
うまく隠せたとしても
ギル自体がみつかるってことは？
english: Even if we managed to hide it, what if Gil himself is found?

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ギルの気配は他の野良と変わらんから
野良がおっても不自然じゃないここなら
バレやんはずと慎平さんは言ってました。
english: Shinpei-san said that Gil's presence is the same as other strays, so it shouldn't be discovered here where it's not unnatural for strays to be.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
「バレたら出たとこ勝負」ってな……。
慎重なんか大胆なんか、わからんやっちゃ。
english: "If we're found, we'll just wing it"... I can't tell if he's cautious or bold.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 竜之介さん？
english: Ryunosuke-san?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro (Ryunosuke Minakata)
japanese: ……来た！
english: ...He's here!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 慎平か……戻ったな！？
english: Shinpei... you're back!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ホンマか慎平！？
どうなった！？　潮は！！？
english: Really, Shinpei!? What happened!? Where's Ushio!!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: う……潮ォ！！
english: Ushio…!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: みんな……ただいまっ！！
english: Everyone... I'm back!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: おかえり……！！
english: Welcome back...!!

japanese: 雁切　真砂人
english: Karikiri Masahito

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
このためか……！
手形の位置を隠したのは…………！！
english: So this is why...! He hid the handprint's position...!!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ……ヒルコ洞に急がねばなりませんね。
english: …We must hurry to Hiruko Cave.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 雁切さん！
english: Karikiri-san!

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
こ、小弓場さん？
どうかなさいましたか？
english: K-Koyuba-san? Is something the matter?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あの……ライブについて、
ちょっとご相談したいことがあるんです。
english: Um... regarding the live performance, there's something I'd like to consult with you about.

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese: ……と言いますと？
english: ...Meaning?

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
商工会の方と話していたら
日都ヶ島ＰＲのトークに日都ヶ島の歴史を
入れられないかってことになって……。
english: While I was talking with the Chamber of Commerce, they asked if we could include Hitogashima's history in the Hitogashima PR talk...

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ええっ？
私は聞いてませんけど。
english: Eh? I haven't heard anything about that.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
思っていた以上に
たくさんのファンの人たちが来てくれたので
何かできないかって話してたらそういう流れに。
english: More fans came than we expected, so while we were discussing if there was anything we could do, it went in that direction.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
それで歴史については雁切さんに伺うのが一番だと
言われたんです。
ちょっとだけお時間いただけないでしょうか……？
english: And they said it would be best to ask you about the history, Karikiri-san. Could I have a little bit of your time...?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あー……。
そういうことなら――
english: Ah... If that's the case--

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あ、ちょっとまって！？
いててててててててっ！
english: Ah, wait a minute!? Owowowowowow!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
えっ！？
どうしたんですか！？
english: Eh!? What's wrong!?

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
あいたたたっ！！
小弓場さん、私めっちゃお腹痛いですっ！！
english: Ouch ouch ouch!! Koyuba-san, my stomach hurts so much!!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
だ、大丈夫ですか？
……あっ、私、胃薬持ってるんです！
すぐに持ってくるんで、ここで待ってて――
english: A-Are you okay? ...Ah, I have stomach medicine! I'll go get it right away, so wait here--

speaker: Masahito Karikiri
japanese:
ムリムリムリ、
ちょっとトイレ籠もって来ます！！
イベントの話はまた後で聞きますから！
english: Impossible, impossible, impossible, I'm gonna go hole up in the bathroom for a bit!! I'll hear about the event later!

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ま、待ってください！
english: W-Wait!

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese: 小弓場さん。
english: Koyuba-san.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
あ、網代くん……。
雁切さん、大丈夫かな……？
english: A-Ajiro-kun... I wonder if Karikiri-san is okay...?

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
心配いらんよ。
オレが代わりに聞いとくから、
今はライブのことだけ考えておけばええ。
english: No need to worry. I'll ask him instead, so for now, you just focus on the live performance.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: わ、わかった……。
english: U-Understood...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: ……ふぅ。
english: ...Phew.

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
もう少し足止めしたかったけど……
……これ以上は、危険だよね…………。
english: I wanted to stall him a little longer, but... ...Any more than this would be dangerous...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
網代くんの影……。
見た目はそっくりなのに、
似ても似つかない怖い瞳……。
english: Ajiro-kun's shadow... He looks exactly like him, but has terrifying eyes that don't resemble his at all...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese:
ほんの少し話しただけなのに、
手の震えが止まらない……。
english: Even though we only talked for a little bit, my hands won't stop shaking...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 私にできるのは、これくらいだけど……。
english: This is about all I can do, but...

speaker: Kaori Koyumiba
japanese: 網代くん、がんばって。
english: Ajiro-kun, do your best.

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
バレたかな？
私らの作戦。
english: I wonder if they found out? About our plan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ああ、バレてやな困る。
english: Yeah, it'd be a problem if they didn't.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これでヤツらの最優先は、
確実にオレたちになる。
オレたちを殺すまでは上で虐殺を始められやんはずや。
english: With this, their top priority will definitely be us. They shouldn't be able to start the massacre above until they kill us.

speaker: Guildenstern
japanese: アッ！
english: Ow!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ギルが影の気配を感知……。
２時の方向……２０ｍ先！！
english: Gil detected a shadow's presence... 2 o'clock direction... 20 meters ahead!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
こっちに向かって来る……！
やはりバレていますね！
english: It's coming this way...! We've been found out after all!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: 痛ッ、何かに撃たれました！
english: Ow, I was hit by something!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
針のようなモノ――歯を飛ばしてきた！？
こいつ、影縫いを狙って……！！
english: Something like a needle--it shot its teeth at me!? This guy is aiming for a shadow pin...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: トキコ、大丈夫かァ！？
english: Tokiko, are you okay!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（こうしてギルを中から操作すると
　複雑な命令ができる反面、ギルへのダメージが
　操作主のトキちゃんに伝わってしまう……）
english: (Operating Gil from the inside like this allows for complex commands, but on the other hand, damage to Gil is transmitted to the operator, Toki-chan...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（くそっ！　ギルの中だと真っ暗で、
　外の状況がわからない！
　外に出て応戦するべきか？）
english: (Damn it! It's pitch black inside Gil, and I can't tell what's going on outside! Should I go out and fight back?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
トキちゃん！
私が出て戦う！！
english: Toki-chan! I'll go out and fight!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
平気ですっ！
私が、くい止めます！！
english: I'm fine! I'll hold them off!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
今です！
みんな先に行って！！
ここは私一人で大丈夫ですから！！
english: Now! Everyone, go on ahead!! I'll be fine here by myself!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
はァッ！？
おまえ置いて行けるかよ！！
english: Hah!? Like hell we can leave you behind!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
早よ行けっちゅうてるやろが！！！
こんなとこでモタモタしてる場合かッ！！
english: I'm telling you to hurry up and go!!! Is this the time to be dawdling around!!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……わかった……ありがとう……！！
english: ...Understood... thank you...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese: いえ、お礼を言うんは私の方です。
english: No, I'm the one who should be thanking you.

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
ありがとうございました、慎平さん。
こんな私を、許してくれて。
english: Thank you very much, Shinpei-san. For forgiving someone like me.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: トキコ……死ぬなよ……！！
english: Tokiko... don't die...!!

speaker: Tokiko Hishigata
japanese:
お兄ちゃんこそ、
みんなの足引っ張らんといてよね！
english: You're the one who shouldn't be dragging everyone down, Onii-chan!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 行き……止まり！？
english: A dead... end!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
いや……！！
確かこの先がヒルコの寝所やったぞ！？
english: No...!! I'm pretty sure Hiruko's sleeping quarters are past here!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うん……真っ黒なカベができてる……。
english: Yeah... there's a pitch-black wall.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ただの黒いカベちゃうで。
中の気配がいっこもわからん……
泥のカベや……！！
english: It's not just a black wall. I can't sense any presence inside at all... It's a wall of mud...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: はッ！
english: Hah!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（シデの気配！！
　もうすぐそこまで！！）
english: (Shide's presence!! He's almost here!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平っ！！
english: Shinpei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ああ……。
海と……境内から……
すごいスピードで来る……！！
english: Yeah... From the sea... and the shrine grounds... They're coming at incredible speed...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
どけ！
カベに大穴あけちゃる！
english: Move! I'll blow a huge hole in this wall!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おおっ！？
カベから血ィが！！
english: Ooh!? Blood is coming out of the wall!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: いや、ダメだ……！
english: No, it's no good...!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: 再生しよる……。
english: It's regenerating...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
私がやってみる！
ハッキングすれば――って、痛っ！
english: I'll try! If I hack it--ow!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮！
大丈夫か！？
english: Ushio! Are you okay!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あっぶな……。
逆に……ハッキングし返された……！！
このカベは……ヒルコ自身の立体なんや！
english: That was close... I got hacked back instead...!! This wall is... a 3D manifestation of Hiruko herself!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
くそッ！！
このカベのすぐ向こうに
ヒルコがおるっちゅうのによォ！！
english: Damn it!! Even though Hiruko is right on the other side of this wall!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （カンタンに通してくれるわけないか……）
english: (I guess they wouldn't let us pass so easily...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（時間はない！
　ヒルコを倒すとっておきだが、
　出し惜しみしてる場合じゃない！！）
english: (We don't have time! It's our trump card for defeating Hiruko, but this is no time to be holding back!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
みんな……やるぞ。
爆弾でカベをぶっ飛ばす！
english: Everyone... let's do this. We'll blow the wall away with a bomb!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
ばっ！？
そんなモンどこに！！
english: Wh-!? Where do you have something like that!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: ここにあるで。
english: Right here.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ここに来る前に、
ミオに盗って来てもろたやつがある！
english: Before coming here, I had Mio steal this!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
おお……！
これは打ち上げ花火！！
こんなん隠しもっとったんか！
english: Ooh...! This is a skyrocket firework!! You were hiding something like this!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 火をつけるから、岩裏にかくれろ！
english: I'm going to light it, so hide behind the rock!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: やったか！？
english: Did we do it!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（うっ……この感覚！
　前に潮が言ってた、黒板引っかくみたいな……！）
english: (Ugh... this feeling! Like Ushio said before, like scratching a chalkboard...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ヒルコの気配を感じる……！！
　まちがいない。開通した……！！）
english: (I feel Hiruko's presence...!! No doubt about it. We've broken through...!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 行こか、穴が閉じる前に。
english: Let's go, before the hole closes.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
うへぇ……。
妙な弾力があって気持ち悪ィ……。
english: Ugh... It has a weird elasticity, it feels gross...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……火薬と……
ステーキみたいなニオイする。
english: ...It smells like gunpowder... and steak.

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
やめてくれっ、
ステーキ食えんくなる！！
english: Stop it, I won't be able to eat steak anymore!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ラズベリーとか
ラム酒みたいなニオイもあるな……。
english: It also smells a bit like raspberries and rum...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そんなええモンちゃうわ！！！
english: It's nothing that nice!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……シデが来る！！）
english: (...Shide is coming!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
伏せて！
根津さんッッ！！
english: Get down! Nezu-san!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: こいつを喰らえ！！
english: Eat this!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 穴が閉じるで！！
english: The hole is closing!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 根津さん急いで！！！
english: Nezu-san, hurry!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: ちょっとォ……！
english: Hey... wait a second...!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
拳銃はアカンが……
コイツは効くようやな……！
english: Handguns are no good, but... this seems to work...!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
儂にかまうな！！
進め！！！
english: Don't mind me!! Keep going!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 根津さん！！
english: Nezu-san!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
行け！
穴が閉じきる前に！！！
english: Go! Before the hole completely closes!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
死ぬ気！？
おっちゃん！！
english: You wanna die!? Old man!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
迷った時にはよォ……
未来の自分やったらどうするか考えて決断せえ。
english: When you're lost... think about what your future self would do, and make a decision.

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ほなら、後悔はない。
english: Then, you won't have any regrets.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （未来のオレが……どうするか…………）
english: (What... my future self would do...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ここを頼みます……！！
english: I leave this place to you...!!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: おう……竜之介によろしくな。
english: Yeah... say hi to Ryunosuke for me.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
はいっ！
……行こう、みんな！
english: Yes! ...Let's go, everyone!

japanese: 根津　銀次郎
english: Ginjiro Nezu

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……みっともないのォ……おまえ……。
english: ...You're a disgrace... you know that...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
真砂人……。
それとも巌……おまえか！？
english: Masahito... Or is it Iwao... is that you!?

speaker: Shide
japanese:
……そんなん……どっちでもええやろ……。
銀坊よ……。
english: ...Who cares... which one it is... Gin-boy...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
幼馴染のよしみや……どけ……
おまえの悲鳴は聞きたない……。
english: For the sake of our childhood friendship... move... I don't want to hear your screams...

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese: ……ナメんなよ！
english: ...Don't underestimate me!

speaker: Ginjiro Nezu
japanese:
通りたかったら、
儂を殺してから行かんかい！！！
english: If you want to pass, you'll have to kill me first!!!
21. Final Battle!!

japanese: 網代　慎平
english: Shinpei Ajiro

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: うっ！
english: Ugh!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平っ！？
english: Shinpei!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
あ……頭が割れる……！
ヒルコの気配……！
english: Ah... my head is splitting...! Hiruko's presence...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そっか……！！
慎平も影の気配感じるようになったんやな。
english: I see...!! Shinpei can feel the presence of shadows now too.

speaker: Mio
japanese: オカアサンは影を操る信号をずっと出してる……。
english: Mother is constantly sending out a signal to control shadows...

speaker: Mio
japanese:
私はお姉ちゃんに改造されて操られんくなったら……。
それまで心地よかったオカアサンの声が
ものすごく不快な音に変わった。
english: When I was modified by my sister and stopped being controlled... Mother's voice, which had been comforting until then, turned into an incredibly unpleasant sound.

speaker: Mio
japanese:
私は影やから、
その不快さだけ感覚から消せるけど、
人間の慎ちゃんにはどないもできやん……。
english: Since I'm a shadow, I can erase just that discomfort from my senses, but there's nothing Shin-chan, a human, can do...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そんな！！
english: No way!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: 早よ終わらせよう……。
english: Let's end this quickly...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: う……潮は……大丈夫なんか！？
english: U-Ushio... are you okay!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 平気、私の気配だけに集中して！
english: I'm fine, just focus on my presence!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: な、何を……？
english: Wh-What...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （耳鳴りが……静かに……）
english: (The ringing in my ears... is getting quiet...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 治まった……。
english: It stopped...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
せやろ！？
上手くいって良かった！
english: Right!? I'm glad it worked!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ありがとう……！！
english: Thank you…!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
お姉ちゃんがオカアサンの信号を相殺してる。
……なんでそんなことできんの！？
english: My sister is canceling out Mother's signal. ...How is she able to do that!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 愛やな……。
english: It's love...

speaker: Mio
japanese: はいウザ、殺すよ？
english: Yeah, annoying. Wanna die?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ヒルコの影だ……！
english: It's Hiruko's shadow...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: うん……終わらせよう……！！
english: Yeah... let's end this...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 花火は使ってしもた……。
english: We used up the fireworks...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 平気……。
english: It's fine...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
殴る。
何発でもブン殴って！
私が壁ごとカチ割っちゃあそォ……！！
english: Punch. Punch it as many times as you want! I'll smash it, wall and all...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……ええ作戦や。
でもその前に……ええか……？
english: ...That's a good plan. But before that... you ready...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
竜之介さんが２秒先の動きを視る。
オレの視線を追ってくれ。
english: Ryunosuke-san will foresee movements 2 seconds ahead. Follow my line of sight.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
……髪の毛を超高速で展開してバリアを！！
復活前よりリーチも格段に伸びてる……！！
english: ...Deploying her hair at super speed to create a barrier!! Her reach has grown significantly compared to before her revival...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
シデェェェッ！！
今日こそ決着つけんで！！
english: Shideeeee!! We're settling this today!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 攻撃が全然当たらんっ！？
english: My attacks aren't hitting at all!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（見切られてる！！
　潮の動きが！）
english: (He's seeing right through them!! Ushio's movements!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……いや、視られてる！！）
english: (...No, they're being foreseen!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハイネ！！
　境内からお出ましか！！）
english: (Haine!! So you've come out from the shrine grounds!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……あいつに視られてる限り、
　竜之介さんの２秒予知は決定打にならない……）
english: (...As long as she's foreseeing us, Ryunosuke-san's 2-second precognition won't be a decisive blow...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （予知して伝えても、観測されてかわされる……！！）
english: (Even if he foresees it and tells us, it'll be observed and dodged...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……でも、それでいい！！）
english: (…But that's fine!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮の刃の恐ろしさは海での戦いで
　身をもって知ったはず。
　当たればシデとて致命傷！）
english: (He should have experienced the terror of Ushio's blade firsthand in the battle at sea. If it hits, even Shide will suffer a fatal wound!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だからシデもハイネも、
　オレたちの動きに集中せざるを得ない……！！）
english: (That's why both Shide and Haine have no choice but to focus on our movements...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（そこで気付かれないようにさりげなく、
　ごく自然に……）
english: (So without them noticing, subtly, very naturally...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハイネを、キルゾーンに誘い込む……！！）
english: (I'll lure Haine into the kill zone...!!)

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese: 殺気が駄々洩れじゃぞ……ミオ。
english: Your killing intent is leaking everywhere... Mio.

speaker: Mio
japanese: くッ、躱された……！
english: Ugh, she dodged it...!

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese: 影の位置は全て把握済みじゃ。
english: I have a full grasp of the positions of all shadows.

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese:
岩の裏にもう一人潜んでおるな！
ネイルガンの影の気配でバレバレじゃ！
english: There's another one hiding behind the rock, isn't there! The presence of the nail gun's shadow gives it completely away!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: こっちや！！
english: Over here!!

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
english: Behind--!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: ここが、キルゾーンじゃ……！！
english: This is the kill zone...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（うまくいった……！！
　ハイネを影縫いしたぞ！！）
english: (It worked...!! I've shadow-pinned Haine!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハイネが感知した影の気配……
　それは潮がプリントしたオトリのネイルガン！）
english: (The shadow presence Haine sensed... was a decoy nail gun printed by Ushio!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（窓が持っていたのは、
　影じゃない本物のネイルガンなんだ！
　その気配にハイネは気づけなかった！）
english: (What Sou had was the real nail gun, not a shadow! Haine couldn't notice its presence!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ここまでは全て作戦通り！
　あとは――）
english: (Everything up to here has gone according to plan! Now--)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ミオッ！！
english: Mio!!

speaker: Shinpei (Heine)
japanese: ぅがッ……！？
english: Ugh…!?

speaker: Shide
japanese: ハイネ！！！
english: Haine!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
これでおまえは
オレたちの２秒後の動きを教えられなくなった！
english: Now you can no longer tell him our movements 2 seconds in the future!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
言うたろ……
いつまでも余裕ブッこいてられると思うなよ！
english: I told you... Don't think you can act so high and mighty forever!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
……人間如きが……！！
楽しいなあ！！！！
english: ...A mere human...!! This is fun!!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: ぶッ……。
english: Bgh...

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: やったッ……！！
english: We did it...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮っ！
ハイネをっ！！
english: Ushio! Get Haine!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: わかってる！！
english: Got it!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（巨大な……シデ！？
　もう一人……！！）
english: (A giant... Shide!? Another one...!!)

speaker: Shide
japanese: やってくれましたネェ……！！！！
english: You really did it now...!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮ッ、走れっ！！
ハイネを……ッ！！！！
english: Ushio, run!! Get Haine...!!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: ハァアアアイネェエエエエエエエエエエッ！！！！
english: HAAAAAAINEEEEEE!!!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ハイネ……帰りたいんやろ……？
english: Haine... you want to go home, right...?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
故郷に帰れば、流れる時間がなくて、
あんたは滅びずにすむもんね。
english: If you return to your hometown, there's no flow of time, so you won't have to perish.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
永遠の世界で、家族といっしょに
大好きな人といっしょに、ずっと……。
english: In an eternal world, together with your family and the person you love most, forever...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ずうっと、暮らせたらええよな……。
english: It'd be nice if you could live like that forever...

speaker: Heine
japanese: やめてぇぇえええええええええっ！！！！
english: Stooooooooooop!!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……でも、ゴメン。
私らはわかり合えやん。
english: ...But, sorry. We can't understand each other.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 私らは――
english: We are---

speaker: Shide
japanese:
消えていく……。
泥が……ハイネが私にくれた鎧が……
english: It's disappearing... The mud... the armor Haine gave me...

speaker: Shide
japanese: ……ハ……ハイネッ――
english: ...H-... Haineee--

speaker: Mio
japanese: オカアサンが死ねば……影は消える……。
english: If Mother dies... the shadows will disappear...

speaker: Mio
japanese: バイバイ、慎ちゃん。
english: Bye-bye, Shin-chan.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: ...Ushio!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio…

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……なんでやろ……慎平……。
english: ...I wonder why... Shinpei...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
悪者……やっつけたのに……
これで……終わったのに……。
english: Even though... we beat the bad guys... Even though... it's over now...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 涙……止まらへん…………。
english: My tears... won't stop...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮……その目ェは――
english: Ushio... those eyes are--

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 慎平ェッ！！！
english: Shinpeiiii!!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: まって！！
english: Wait!!

speaker: Mio
japanese:
消えてへん……私も、お姉ちゃんも……！！
オカアサンがまだ生きてる……！！
english: We're not disappearing... neither me, nor my sister...!! Mother is still alive...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: なんやてェ！？
english: What did you say!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
手加減したな……。
お姉ちゃん……。
english: You held back... Sister...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （熱い……右目がっ……！！）
english: (It's hot... my right eye is...!!)

speaker: Ushio
english: Shin... pei...?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレの……右目と……潮の右目から……。
　この気配は――）
english: (From my... right eye and... Ushio's right eye... This presence is--)

speaker: Shide
english: ...W-Wonder...ful...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Shide...!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: そっ……そんな！？
english: Th-... That's impossible!?

speaker: Mio
japanese:
なんでまだ動いてる！？
シデの中身は二人とも確かに殺したのに！！
english: Why is he still moving!? We definitely killed both of the people inside Shide!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……不死身か……。
english: ...Is he immortal...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
あははっ！
マジで詰んだと思いましたよ慎平くん！
english: Ahaha! I really thought it was checkmate, Shinpei-kun!

speaker: Hiruko (Baby)
english: Shi... de...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……シデが腕に抱いてるのは……！）
english: (...What Shide is holding in his arms is...!)

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ハイネ……いや、ヒルコ。
あんたもう、ただのゴミですね……。
english: Haine... no, Hiruko. You're just trash now...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
こんな小さなってもて……
もう回復は絶望的……。
english: You've become so small... Recovery is hopeless now...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
目も壊されて……
もはやこの島の人をみ～～んな喰わせても、
力は戻らへん……。
english: Your eyes were destroyed too... Even if I let you eat e~~veryone on this island, your power won't return...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
いやホンマ、
さっきは心の底からガッカリしたんですよ。
english: No, really, I was disappointed from the bottom of my heart earlier.

speaker: Shide
japanese: ですがどうです……その右目！！
english: But how about that... that right eye!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
それは観測者の右目！！
やはりキミが「卵」……！！
それが今覚醒したんですよ！！！
english: That's the observer's right eye!! You really are the "egg"...!! It has just awakened!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
どんどん成長してる思てましたけど、
そんなキミやからこそ復元できたっちゅうんか。
english: I thought you were growing steadily, but it's exactly because you're like that that you could be restored.

speaker: Shide
japanese:
あっははははははははははっ！
これが愛の力ってヤツですかァ！！
english: Ahahahahahahahahaha! Is this the so-called power of love!!?

speaker: Shide
japanese: キミからその目を奪えば、私の望みはまだ叶う！！！
english: If I take that eye from you, my wish will still come true!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: させへんで……ッ！！
english: I won't let you...!!

speaker: Hiruko (Baby)
japanese: シ……デ……まって……。
english: Shi... de... wait...

speaker: Hiruko (Baby)
japanese:
わしは……まだ……やれる……！
人を……ようさん食べたら、
元気に……なる……から……！！
english: I can... still... do it...! If I eat... a lot of people, I'll get... better...!!

speaker: Hiruko (Baby)
japanese:
元気になって……いっしょに……
帰……ろ……？
english: I'll get better... and we'll... go home... together...?

speaker: Shide
japanese: ……はァ。
english: ...Haa.

speaker: Shide
japanese: もう用済みやねん、あんた。
english: You're already useless.

speaker: Hiruko (Baby)
english: Ah…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんやそれ……！！
ハイネは……おまえの母親やろ……。
english: What's with that...!! Haine is... your mother, right...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
だから？
私は過去には興味はない。
english: So what? I have no interest in the past.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: シデェェェッ！！！！！！！！
english: Shideeeee!!!!!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
おまえ！！
そんでも人間かァッ！！！
english: You!! And you call yourself human!!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
しかしヒルコにはまだ、
生きててもらわんと困る……。
english: But I still need Hiruko to stay alive...

speaker: Shide
japanese:
ヒルコが死ねば、私の鎧も、
せっかく覚醒したウシオちゃんの目も……
消えてまいますからね。
english: If Hiruko dies, my armor, and Ushio-chan's newly awakened eye... will all disappear.

speaker: Shide
japanese: 望み通り、故郷へ連れ帰っちゃあそ……。
english: As you wished, I'll take you back to your hometown...

speaker: Hiruko (Baby)
japanese:
こ……こんな……体で……。
帰っ……た……ら――
english: W-... With a body... like this... If I... go... back--

speaker: Shide
japanese: 来るがいい、観測者よ。
english: Come, Observer.

speaker: Shide
japanese: 決着は<color=#GF_KEY_TOKOYO>あっち</color>でつけましょか。
english: Let's settle this <color=#GF_KEY_TOKOYO>over there</color>.

speaker: Shide
japanese: あっはははははははは！！！！
english: Ahahahahahahahaha!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（竜之介さんっ、全力で飛んでください！！
　オレの体はどうなってもいい……！！
　ヤツを逃がしたくないんです！！）
english: (Ryunosuke-san, jump with all your might!! I don't care what happens to my body...!! I don't want to let him get away!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: シデェェェェーーーーッ！！！！
english: Shideeeeeeee!!!!

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: わ、あっ！？
english: W-Wah!?

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese:
なんやこれェッ！？！？
穴にッ……吸い込まれる！！
english: What is this!!? I'm getting... sucked into the hole!!

speaker: Mio
japanese: 窓くん、つかまって！！
english: Sou-kun, hold on!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
アカン慎平っ！！
引き込まれるっ！！
english: No, Shinpei!! You'll get pulled in!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （オレは弱い……弱すぎる……！！）
english: (I'm weak... too weak...!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: こっからは人は行けやん！
english: Humans can't go past here!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
入ったら出ることも……
死ぬこともできやん、迷子になってまうよっ！！！
english: If you enter, you won't be able to leave... or even die, you'll just get lost!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: こっからは私だけが行くッ！！
english: From here on, I'll go alone!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
アホ！！
もう絶対おまえを一人にするか！！！
english: Idiot!! I'll never leave you alone again!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あっぽけ！！　話聞いてた！？
この強情っぱり！！！
english: Idiot!! Were you listening!? You stubborn fool!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
竜くん！！　聞こえてるやろ！？
慎平の体動かして逃げて！
english: Ryu-kun!! You can hear me, right!? Move Shinpei's body and run!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
……手遅れ……です……。
シデは僕らを逃がさへん。
english: ...It's... too late... Shide won't let us escape.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
ここで見捨てたら……
あの世でお姉ちゃんにどつかれます。
english: If I abandon you here... my sister will beat me up in the afterlife.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 竜くん……！
english: Ryu-kun...!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
決めたんです。
必ず助けるって、お姉ちゃんの約束。
僕がかわりに果たすって……！！
english: I've decided. My sister's promise to definitely save you. I'll fulfill it in her place...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
慎平さんは僕がサポートします！
絶対迷子になんてさせませんっ！！
english: I'll support Shinpei-san! I absolutely won't let him get lost!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……おまえの気配を追いかける。
オレはずっと……潮のそばにおる……！！
english: ...I'll follow your presence. I'll always be... by your side, Ushio...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
オレは潮が好きや。
好きなやつといっしょにおりたい、
何か文句あるか。
english: I love Ushio. I want to be with the person I love, you got a problem with that?

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……あっぽけ……。
english: …Idiot…

speaker: Sou Hishigata
japanese: 慎平ェェーーーーーッ！！！
english: Shinpeiiiiii!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 窓、みんなを頼む……！！
english: Sou, take care of everyone...!!

japanese: 22.ハイネの故郷
english: 22. Haine's Hometown

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ugh...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ここが……ハイネの故郷……）
english: (This is… Haine's hometown…)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……そうだ、潮はどこに！？）
english: (…Right, where's Ushio!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……この先で切れてる。
時間の流れが……。
english: ...It cuts off up ahead. The flow of time...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 菱形先生の言うてた通りや……。
english: Just like Dr. Hishigata said...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ここは時間が……流れてない
淀んでる……って感じだ。
english: Time isn't... flowing here. It feels... stagnant.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
ループしても戻れそうにないな……
死んだら多分……それっきり……。
english: It doesn't seem like we can return even if we loop... If we die, it's probably... game over...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……マズイな…………。
潮ォォーーーッ！！！！
english: ...This is bad... Ushioooooo!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 返事がない……！！
english: No response…!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
掴んでたのにっ……！！
この手で……！！
english: I had a hold of her...!! With this hand...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 慎平さん！
english: Shinpei-san!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 竜之介さん……！
english: Ryunosuke-san…!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 潮さん……こっちに来てるのは確かです。
english: Ushio-san... she definitely came this way.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
潮さんがプリントしたショットガンが、
消えてませんからね……！
english: The shotgun Ushio-san printed hasn't disappeared...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
そうか……！！
５０メートル！！
english: I see...!! 50 meters!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
かすかに気配も感じます。
でも……移動してますね……。
english: I can faintly sense her presence too. But... she's moving...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: おっ……追いかけましょう！！
english: L-... Let's go after her!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
……うッ！？
脚がっ……！
english: ...Ugh!? My legs...!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
慎平さんっ！！
ごめんなさい……僕が飛んだから……！
english: Shinpei-san!! I'm sorry... because I jumped...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: い……いえっ！！

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
全力でシデに追いついてって言うたんはオレです！
南雲先生に比べたら……
こんなん大したことありませんっ。
english: I was the one who told you to catch up to Shide with all your might! Compared to Nagumo-sensei... This is nothing.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
……慎平さん。
僕に体の制御をすべて任せてください！
そしたら痛みを引き受けられます！
english: ...Shinpei-san. Please leave all control of your body to me! Then I can take on the pain!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: でも……それじゃあ竜之介さんが……！！
english: But... then you'll...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
平気です！
僕これでも影ですから！
痛覚のボリュームを下げたらいいだけです！
english: I'll be fine! I'm still a shadow, after all! I just have to lower the volume on my pain receptors!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
……足のケガだけじゃないです。
慎平さんの肉体が崩れ始めてます。
english: ...It's not just the leg injury. Shinpei-san's physical body is starting to break down.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
僕が内側から支えてやんと、
この場所で人である慎平さんは生きられません。
english: If I don't support you from the inside, Shinpei-san, a human, won't be able to survive in this place.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
どうですか？
こっからは僕が動きますよ。
english: How is it? I'll be moving from here on out.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （これ……オレ、意識だけになってる……？）
english: (Am I... just a consciousness now...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なんか……変な気分です……）
english: (It feels... kinda weird...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（体の感覚がマヒして何も感じやんのに……
　思考だけがハッキリしてる……）
english: (My body's senses are paralyzed and I can't feel anything... but my thoughts are crystal clear...)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
普段僕もそうなんですけど、
慣れないと気持ち悪いですよね。
english: I'm usually like this too, but it feels gross if you're not used to it, doesn't it.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（はい……でもまあ……
　フカンするのと同じ要領でいけそうです）
english: (Yes... but well... I think I can manage it the same way I do when I take a bird's-eye view.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それじゃあ、オレの体をよろしくお願いします。
　まずは潮を探しましょう）
english: (Then, please take care of my body. First, let's look for Ushio.)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
そうですね。
ゆっくりしている暇はありません。
english: Right. We don't have time to be taking it easy.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
潮さーーーーん！！
返事してくださーーい！！
english: Ushio-saaaaan!! Please answerrrrrr!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（竜之介さん。
　ここは日都ヶ島なんでしょうか？）
english: (Ryunosuke-san. Is this Hitogashima?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
似てますよね……。
海の向こうに……和歌山本土も見える……。
english: It looks similar, doesn't it... Across the sea... you can even see the Wakayama mainland...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
それと……何か甘いニオイが……。
これって……。
english: Also... there's a sweet smell... Is this...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Mikan oranges...?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
……ここがタカノス山やとして……
こんなに蜜柑の木……生えてましたっけ……。
english: ...Assuming this is Mt. Takanosu... Were there this many mikan trees... growing here...?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 喉……乾いたな……。
english: I'm... thirsty...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……ダメです！！
　竜之介さん！！
　これはヨモツヘグイですよ！！）
english: (...Don't do it!! Ryunosuke-san!! This is Yomotsuhegui!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: はッ！
english: Hah!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: み……蜜柑じゃない……！？
english: It's... not a mikan...!?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
うっ！？
生ぐさい……！
english: Ugh!? It smells like raw meat...!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
黄泉戸喫……。
お姉ちゃんの本に出てくるやつですね？
english: Yomotsuhegui... The thing that appears in my sister's book, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （はい！）
english: (Yes!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あの世の物を食べると、
　現世に戻れなくなる……）
english: (If you eat food from the underworld, you won't be able to return to the living world...)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
どうかしてました僕……
あ……あんなんが美味しそうに見えたなんて……。
english: Something was wrong with me... T-To think something like that looked delicious...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いえ……竜之介さんは影やからこそ……
　なにか影響があるのかも知れません）
english: (No... it might be because you're a shadow, Ryunosuke-san... that it had some kind of effect on you.)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
あの……慎平さん。
ずっと言おうと思てたんですけど。
english: Um... Shinpei-san. I've been meaning to say this for a while.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （何ですか……？）
english: (What is it...?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 僕に敬語使わなくていいですよ！
english: You don't have to use polite speech with me!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Huh?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: だって慎平さんのが年上やないですか！
english: I mean, you're older than me, Shinpei-san!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いやいや！
　竜之介さんは南雲先生と同い年でしょ？
　大先輩ですよ！！）
english: (No, no! You're the same age as Nagumo-sensei, right, Ryunosuke-san? You're my senior!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
いやいやいや！
中３ですから、僕死んだ時！
潮さんなんかすぐ「竜くん！」言うてくれましたよ！
english: No, no, no! I was a 3rd year in middle school when I died! Ushio-san called me "Ryu-kun!" right away!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そりゃ潮がコミュ力おばけなだけで……）
english: (That's just because Ushio is a communication monster...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（オレ体育会系じゃないし、
　そもそも後輩やからって
　なれなれしくできなくて……）
english: (I'm not the sporty type, and I can't just act overly familiar just because someone is my junior...)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 誰にでも敬語なんですか？
english: Do you use polite speech with everyone?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（はい……
　同い年のヤツには大丈夫なんですけど）
english: (Yes... I'm fine with people my own age, though.)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
えーー。じゃあ澪さんは？
タメ口でしたよね？
english: Ehhh. Then what about Mio-san? You spoke casually with her, right?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （それもだいぶ時間かかったんですよ……）
english: (That took a lot of time too...)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ふーーん……なんかくやしいなァ……。
english: Hmmm... I'm kinda frustrated...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ほな僕、こっからタメ口でいくわ！！
english: Then I'll use casual speech from here on out!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
せやから慎平もタメ口でオッケーやで！！
一心同体になったわけやし、仲良うやろら！！
english: So it's okay for you to use casual speech too, Shinpei!! We're of one body and soul now, so let's get along!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（これは……
　敬語はオレの敬意ですから……）
english: (This is... Polite speech is my way of showing respect, so...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（タメ口同士が絶対仲良いわけちゃうと思いますし、
　敬語やからってよそよそしいわけでもないですよ）
english: (I don't think using casual speech means you're definitely close, and just because it's polite speech doesn't mean it's distant.)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
いえ！！！　こういうんはカタチが大事です！！
僕はタメ口でいきま……いくからなっ！！
english: No!!! Form is important for these things!! I'll use casual speech... I'm gonna use it!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ふふっ……）
english: (Hehe...)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: なんかおかしい！？
english: Is something funny!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや、もっと知りたくなりました。
　『竜之介くん』のこと）
english: (No, I just want to know more. About "Ryu-kun".)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ホンマ！？
english: Really!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（待って……何か落ちてる。
　あれは！？）
english: (Wait... something's dropped on the ground. Is that!?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ……ボール？
english: …Ball?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （見覚えがある……）
english: (I recognize it...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あれは……南雲先生の記憶の中で見た、
　ハイネの手毬！！）
english: (That's... the temari I saw in Nagumo-sensei's memory, Haine's temari!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
あ！
手鞠が……！
english: Ah! The temari is...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（傾斜があるわけでもないのに、
　コロコロと……）
english: (Even though there's no slope, it's rolling...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（まるで、
　何かに引き寄せられてるみたいだな……）
english: (It's almost as if it's being drawn to something...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （追いかけましょう！！）
english: (Let's chase after it!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 了解っ！！
english: Roger!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……竜之介さん！
　あの看板見てください！！）
english: (…Ryunosuke-san! Look at that sign!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: これは……店……商？
english: This is... tore... s?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （店商……川早小）
english: (Tore S... Wakayabo Ko)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
いやっ、逆や！
小早川…………商店……！？
english: No, it's backwards! Kobayakawa... Store...!?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: はっ！
english: Hah!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: なっ、何やこいつら！？
english: Wh-What are these guys!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （影……でしょうか？）
english: (Shadows…?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
わからん……。
でも……襲ってくる雰囲気はなさそうや。
english: I don't know... But... they don't seem like they're going to attack.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（手鞠が転がっていきます！
　近いです！！　潮の気配が……！！）
english: (The temari is rolling away! It's close!! Ushio's presence is...!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
english: …Ah!?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 潮さん！！！！
english: Ushio-san!!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
しっかりしろ！！
何があった！？
english: Pull yourself together!! What happened!?

speaker: Ushio
english: Ugh, guh... Shin... pei... Ah... my head is...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
なんだ……！？
潮の影から何かが……！！？
english: What the...!? Something is coming from Ushio's shadow...!!?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: この気配は……ハイネ！！？
english: This presence is... Haine!!?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
ま、まさか……！？
自我を失って、ハイネに戻ろうとしている！？
english: N-No way...!? Is she losing her sense of self and trying to revert to Haine!?

speaker: Ushio
english: Aahhh...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ……そうか……お姉ちゃんが言うてた！！
english: ...I see... my sister said this!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
潮さんの泥は、ハイネから千切れたもの……。
「潮」で上書きされていても、元はハイネの一部！
english: Ushio-san's mud was torn off from Haine... Even if it's overwritten with "Ushio", it's originally a part of Haine!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
いつ潮さんの自我が消滅し、
ハイネが現れてもおかしない……！
english: It wouldn't be strange if Ushio-san's ego disappeared and Haine appeared at any time...!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
その時は……
お姉ちゃんの代わりに、僕が……！！
english: When that happens... I'll do it instead of my sister...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ……慎平、撃つよ！！
english: …Shinpei, I'll shoot!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ウ゛ッ……アアアアッ……！！！！
english: Ugh... Aaaaaah...!!!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
撃つ！！！
いい！？
english: I'm shooting!!! Ready!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
待って、竜之介くん！！
何か言ってる！！
english: Wait, Ryunosuke-kun!! She's saying something!!

speaker: Ushio
english: ...Hah... Hah... I'm... fine...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……もう、平気やから……竜くん……！！
english: ...I'm fine now... Ryu-kun...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
この子は違う……。
竜くんを殺した悪いハイネじゃない！
english: This child is different... She's not the bad Haine who killed Ryu-kun!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
english: Huh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: ……どういうことや！？
english: ...What do you mean!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
１４年前のあの時……
ハイネの自我が分裂したんよ。
english: Back then, 14 years ago... Haine's ego split.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
人間の女の子「<color=#GF_TIPS_022>波稲</color>」と、
「ヒルコ」とに分かれたんや……。
english: It split into the human girl "<color=#GF_TIPS_022>Haine</color>" and "Hiruko"...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
しおりちゃんを殺したのも、
潮を殺したのもこの子じゃない。
english: The one who killed Shiori-chan and Ushio wasn't this child.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 殺したのは「ヒルコ」の方なんよ……！！
english: The one who killed them was "Hiruko"...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ……じゃあ今、潮さんの中におるんは！？
english: ...Then who's inside Ushio-san right now!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
お菓子が大好きな女の子……。
南雲先生の友だち……。
english: A girl who loves sweets... Nagumo-sensei's friend...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ……お姉ちゃんの…………。
english: ...My sister's...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そう……そんで……。
この子は……私……。
english: Yeah... and... This child is... me...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
波稲が話したいって……。
聞いちゃってくれる……？
english: Haine says she wants to talk... Will you listen to her...?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ……はい。
english: …Yes.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ありがと。
english: Thank you.

speaker: Haine
japanese: ……はじめまして……。
english: …Nice to meet you…

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: キミが……。
english: You're...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
怖がらんでええって！！
みんなひづるさんの友だちやから！！
english: You don't have to be scared!! Everyone here is Hizuru-san's friend!!

speaker: Haine
english: …Hm…

speaker: Haine
japanese:
長い夢を見とった……。
あれは潮の記憶……。
何が起きておるのかはわかっとるつもりじゃ……。
english: I was having a long dream... Those were Ushio's memories... I believe I understand what is happening...

speaker: Haine
japanese:
すまぬな慎平……竜之介……。
わしなんかと関わったせいで…………。
english: I'm sorry, Shinpei... Ryunosuke... Because you got involved with someone like me...

speaker: Haine
japanese:
竜之介もひづるも……潮も……
みんな死んでもうた……。
english: Ryunosuke, Hizuru... and Ushio... They all died...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
……キミが謝ることちゃうよ。
僕を食べたんはヒルコやし、
あいつはそういう生き物ってだけ……。
english: ...It's not something you should apologize for. The one who ate me was Hiruko, and that's just the kind of creature she is...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 悪いんは、それを利用してるシデや……！！
english: The bad one is Shide, who's using her...!!

speaker: Haine
japanese: ……戦うんじゃろう？　シデサマと……。
english: ...You're going to fight, right? With Shide-sama...

speaker: Haine
japanese:
ここは『常世』……。
わしらの住む現世よりも上にある世界じゃ……。
english: This is "Tokoyo"... A world that exists above the physical world we live in...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（……上？
　四次元……ってことかな……）
english: (...Above? Does that mean... the fourth dimension...)

speaker: Haine
japanese:
わしにはヒルコ様の記憶の一部が
残されておるさけな……
おまんらに教えてやれることがある。
english: I still have a part of Hiruko-sama's memories left in me... So there are things I can tell you.

speaker: Haine
japanese:
常世では時は前に進まん。
慎平……潮……おまんらやったら見えるじゃろ？
時間の淀みが……。
english: In Tokoyo, time doesn't move forward. Shinpei... Ushio... you two should be able to see it, right? The stagnation of time...

speaker: Ushio
english: Yeah…!!

speaker: Haine
japanese: その目で竜之介を見てみい。
english: Now look at Ryunosuke with those eyes.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
……あ！！
竜くんが……ズレてへん！！
english: ...Ah!! Ryunosuke's body... isn't out of sync!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
ホンマや……。
さっきからフツーにしゃべれてるし……。
english: You're right... He's been talking normally this whole time...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （これがシデの狙いか……！！）
english: (So this is Shide's goal...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（時間の前後がないからループもできやんし、
　「２秒先」もない！！）
english: (Since there's no before or after in time, looping is impossible, and the "next two seconds" don't exist either!!)

speaker: Haine
japanese: ヤツはここで潮の目を奪おうとしておる……。
english: He's trying to steal Ushio's eye here...

speaker: Haine
japanese:
覚醒したその目を持つ者は、
現世よりもひとつ「上」の次元に至る。
english: Whoever possesses that awakened eye will reach a dimension one level "above" the real world.

speaker: Haine
japanese:
そうなれば、
現世すべての時間も空間も、思いのままじゃ。
english: Once that happens, all time and space in the real world will be at his mercy.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: スゴォ！！
english: Whoa!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
いやマジで！？
ぜんぜんそんなんできる感じないけど！？
english: Seriously!? It doesn't feel like I can do anything like that at all!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（３次元の人間が２次元の漫画本を
　簡単に持ったり、ひっくり返したり、
　燃やしたりできるみたいなもんか……）
english: (So it's like how a 3D person can easily hold, flip, or burn a 2D comic book...)

speaker: Haine
japanese:
覚醒したばかりで不安定のようじゃし……。
それにここは常世やからの……。
english: It seems unstable since it's just awakened... Besides, this is Tokoyo...

speaker: Haine
japanese:
その目もここやと普通の目……。
それは現世でこそ真の力を発揮する。
english: That eye is just a normal eye here... It will only show its true power in the real world.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: エンディング……。
english: The ending…

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
シデの中身をスキャンした時に
飛び込んできた思考……。
english: The thought that jumped into my head when I scanned inside Shide...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
あいつは世界を殺すつもり。
ゲームの電源を切るみたいにプツンって。
english: He intends to kill the world. Just *click*, like turning off a game console.

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
その後の世界は無い……
ほんまの……おわり…………。
english: There will be no world after that... The true... end...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 何や！？
english: What!?

speaker: Haine
english: ...Th-This sound is...!!

japanese: 23.空襲警報
english: 23. Air Raid Alert

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （はっ！）
english: (Gasp!)

speaker: ラジオ
japanese:
……敵……爆撃機……。
５群に分かれて……紀伊水道を北上。
english: ...Enemy... bombers... Split into five groups... heading north up the Kii Channel.

speaker: ラジオ
japanese:
――和歌山市のみなさん、
ご健闘をお祈りいたします。
english: —Citizens of Wakayama City, we pray for your safety.

speaker: Haine
japanese: 空襲警報じゃっ！！！
english: It's an air raid alert!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: なんやてェッ！？
english: What did you say!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
皆、私の近くに集まって！！
髪のバリアで護っちゃるから！
english: Everyone, gather around me!! I'll protect you with a barrier of hair!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 潮さん！！
english: Ushio-san!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
伏せてて！
竜くん！！
english: Stay down! Ryunosuke-kun!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮っ！！
　地面に影を落とすな！
　火はマズイッ！！　本体を最小限にしろ！！）
english: (Ushio!! Don't cast a shadow on the ground! Fire is bad!! Minimize your main body!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
平気！！
影は常世では死なんっ！！
こんなん屁でもないっ！！
english: I'm fine!! Shadows don't die in Tokoyo!! This is nothing!!

speaker: Shide
japanese: あっははははははははははは！！
english: Ahahahahahahahahaha!!

speaker: Shide
japanese:
私にはなんにも届きません……
地を這うナメクジ共がどう足掻いてもね。
english: Nothing can reach me... No matter how much you slugs crawling on the ground struggle.

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese:
潮ちゃん……。
キミを黒焦げの達磨にしてから、
その目ェもらおか……。
english: Ushio-chan... Once I turn you into a charred daruma doll, I think I'll take that eye...

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese:
ふふ……手加減せんでも
殺してしまう心配せんでええのは
ラクでええわァ……。
english: Hehe... It's so much easier not having to hold back or worry about accidentally killing you...

speaker: Ushio
english: Ugh...!! Shide...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮！
　さっきの話の続きやけどよォ……）
english: (Ushio! Continuing from what we were talking about earlier...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮の目が、常世じゃ力を発揮せんなら……
　シデは目を奪ってから現世で使うつもりってことやろ？）
english: (If Ushio's eye can't use its power in Tokoyo... That means Shide plans to steal it and use it in the real world, right?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （なら、現世に戻る手段はあるってことやな！？）
english: (Then that means there's a way to return to the real world!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
そっか！
慎平！！
english: I get it! Shinpei!!

speaker: Haine
japanese:
ヒルコ様を消すんじゃ……。
潮が浸食すればできるはず……。
english: We must erase Hiruko... If Ushio hacks her, it should be possible...

speaker: Haine
japanese:
ヒルコ様が消えれば……常世も消える！
さすれば現世に帰れるじゃろう！
english: If Hiruko disappears... Tokoyo will disappear too! Then we should be able to return to the real world!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
上等じゃっ！！
でもどうやる！？
シデははるか上空や……！！
english: Bring it on!! But how!? Shide is way up in the sky...!!

speaker: Haine
japanese:
わしに任せろ……。
この空襲はヒルコ様の記憶……。
english: Leave it to me... This air raid is Hiruko's memory...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 記憶やて！？
english: Memory?!

speaker: Haine
japanese:
常世はヒルコ様の記憶とつながっとる。
この日のことは、
思い出したくない過去のはずじゃがな……。
english: Tokoyo is connected to Hiruko's memories. What happened on this day should be a past she doesn't want to remember...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: シデや……あいつがムリヤリ……！！
english: Shide... he forced it...!!

speaker: Haine
japanese:
潮、わしの合図で飛び出せ。
空襲の日の記憶ならばわしにもある！
english: Ushio, jump out on my signal. I also have memories of the day of the air raid!

speaker: Haine
japanese:
ヒルコ様には及ばぬゆえ消すことはできぬが、
少しの間、記憶を押し留めるくらいのことはできよう。
english: I cannot erase them since I am no match for Hiruko, but I should be able to hold the memories back for a short while.

speaker: Haine
japanese:
ほんの数秒じゃろうが……
わしがシデまで届く……道を作っちゃる！
english: It will only be for a few seconds... But I will create a path... for you to reach Shide!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
english: A path?!

speaker: Haine
japanese: わしを信じてくれるか。
english: Do ya trust me?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
……信じるよ！！
お姉ちゃんの友だちなら、僕らの友だちやから！
english: ...I trust you!! If you're my sister's friend, then you're our friend too!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: さっきは銃向けてごめん。
english: Sorry for pointing my gun at you earlier.

speaker: Haine
english: Ryunosuke…

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: な……慎平！！
english: Hey... Shinpei!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Yeah!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ありがと……！！
english: Thank you...!!

speaker: Haine
japanese: それから、伝えておきたいことがある。
english: Also, there's something I need to tell you.

speaker: Haine
japanese:
シデサマの鎧は、向けられた力を
そっくりそのまま相手に返すことができる。
ヤマビコのように。
english: Shide-sama's armor can return any force directed at it right back at the attacker. Like a yamabiko.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ヤマビコ……。
english: Yamabiko…

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そうか……だから……）
english: (I see... so that's why...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ハッキングを返されたら！？
english: If your hacking gets reflected back at you!?

speaker: Haine
japanese: おまんも致命傷じゃ！
english: That would be a fatal wound for you too.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: そんな！
english: No way!

speaker: Haine
japanese:
シデサマは必ずヤマビコを使てくる。
竜之介の２秒予知を封じた今ならばな……。
english: Shide-sama will definitely use the yamabiko. Especially now that Ryunosuke's two-second foresight is sealed...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（どうすればいい！？
　シデを倒すにはハッキングしかないのに……！）
english: (What should we do!? Hacking is the only way to defeat Shide...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（鎧を消して、中身を殺す。
　「２手」必要や！
　それじゃ鎧を消した直後に潮がやられてまう！！）
english: (Erase the armor, and kill what's inside. We need "two moves"! But then Ushio will be killed right after erasing the armor!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: いや……死なんで私は！！
english: No, I won't die.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (What!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
澪からもろた、アレがあるっ！！
何が起きても２手目で決める！！
english: I have that thing Mio gave me!! No matter what happens, I'll finish it on the second move!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （奥の手ってことか……）
english: (So you have a trump card...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
全部終わらせる！
私の髪が燃え尽きる前に……！！
english: I'll end everything! Before my hair burns out...!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: いつでもええで！
english: I'm ready whenever!

speaker: Haine
japanese: ……うむ！
english: ...Right!

speaker: Haine
japanese: ……今じゃっ！！

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese:
なっ……！？
時間が停まっ――
english: Wha...!? Time stopped—

speaker: Haine
japanese:
頼んだぞ、潮……。
シデサマを止めてくれ。
english: I'm counting on you, Ushio... Stop Shide-sama.

speaker: Haine
japanese:
ヒルコ様を…………もう……
楽にしてやってくれい……。
english: Please... put Hiruko... out of her misery...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮ッ！
　頼んだぞッ！！）
english: (Ushio! We're counting on you!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: まかしときっ！！！！
english: Leave it to me!!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
波稲が止めてくれた<color=#GF_TIPS_059>焼夷弾</color>を足場にして……っ！
シデのいる上空まで……！！
english: Using the <color=#GF_TIPS_059>incendiary bombs</color> Haine stopped as footholds...! All the way up to where Shide is...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
潮さんが上まで……！
くそっ……！！
ここで見てるしかないんか……！
english: Ushio-san is going all the way up...! Damn it...!! Is there nothing I can do but watch from here...!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……目ェ離したらあかんで、竜くん！）
english: (...Don't look away, Ryunosuke-kun!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（目に焼き付けるんや……！！
　あいつは絶対勝つ！！！）
english: (Burn it into your eyes...!! She's definitely going to win!!!)

japanese: ウシオ
english: Ushio

speaker: Ushio
japanese: シデッ！！
english: Shide!!

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese:
そうか……。
波稲を……味方につけましたか……。
english: I see... You've made an ally out of Haine...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（ヒルコの全消去には、直で触れて数分はかかる！！
　シデを倒すのが先決！！）
english: (It'll take a few minutes of direct contact to completely erase Hiruko!! Defeating Shide is the top priority!!)

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese: この高度では、潮ちゃんの平面は捉えられへん……。
english: At this altitude, I can't catch Ushio-chan's plane...

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（速て重っ！！
　機銃の弾丸！！
　私の髪じゃ防ぎ切れやんっ！）
english: (Fast and heavy!! Machine gun bullets!! My hair won't be able to block them all!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（一旦体勢を整える。
　機体の上に着地すれば……！）
english: (I need to stabilize my posture. If I land on the aircraft...!)

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese:
しかし着地させれば……
影が――平面が見えますよ！
english: But if you land... Your shadow—your plane will be visible!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: （戦闘機ごと私の平面爆破する気！？）
english: (He's planning to blow up my plane along with the fighter jet!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（常世じゃ死なんでも、
　バラバラなったら、回復まで時間がかかる！
　その間ァに右目奪われるっ！！）
english: (Even if I can't die in Tokoyo, if I get blown to pieces, it'll take time to recover! He'll steal my right eye in the meantime!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
くッ……！！
足場がもう持たんッ！
なら……！
english: Ugh...!! The foothold won't last any longer! In that case...!

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 刺し違えてもッ、おまえを殺す！！！
english: Even if it costs me my life, I'll kill you!!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（……え？
　なに今の感触！？）
english: (...Huh? What was that feeling just now!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（こいつ……まさか……
　中身が、ない！？）
english: (This guy... could it be... There's nothing inside!?)

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese: ……刺し違えても……？
english: ...Even if it costs you your life...?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（しもた！！
　これじゃ相打ちにならへん！！）
english: (Oh no!! This won't be a mutual kill!!)

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese:
私のヤマビコ……バレてます？
ほら、キミの攻撃が返っていきますよ！
english: You knew about my yamabiko...? Look, your attack is coming right back at you!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
ああッ！
潮さんが自分の攻撃でバラバラに……！
english: Ah! Ushio-san is being blown to pieces by her own attack...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （大丈夫、常夜なら潮は死なない……！）
english: (It's okay, Ushio won't die in Tokoyo...!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（眼もバラバラにされる寸前で
　なんとかキャッチしてた）
english: (She managed to catch her eye right before it was blown to pieces too.)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （そしてシデ、お前は今こう考えてるだろ……）
english: (And Shide, you're probably thinking this right now...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（バラバラになった潮からなら、
　容易く眼を奪える、と……）
english: (That it would be easy to steal her eye from her blown-apart body...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（だが、そうはいかない！
　潮には澪が用意してくれた奥の手がある！）
english: (But that's not going to happen! Ushio has the trump card Mio prepared for her!)

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese:
復活した……！？
……何か食べたな！
おそらく本物の潮の一部！！
english: She regenerated...!? ...She ate something! Probably a part of the real Ushio!!

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese:
ヤマビコを知ってなお
挑んできたのはそれが理由か……！！
english: So that's why you challenged me even knowing about the yamabiko...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: よし、本物の潮の髪の毛を食べて復活した！
english: Alright, she ate a strand of the real Ushio's hair and regenerated!

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese: なにをされた……！？
english: What did you do…!?

speaker: Shide (True Face)
japanese:
Ｂ２９が消えた……！！
今の一瞬の接触で空襲の記憶も消されたのか！！
english: The B-29 disappeared...!! Was the memory of the air raid erased in that split second of contact!?

japanese: 24.ラストバトル
english: 24. Last Battle

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ……空襲が止んだ……。
english: ...The air raid stopped...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （……ど、どうなった！？）
english: (...Wh-What happened!?)

speaker: Haine
japanese:
中身がなかったんじゃ…………。
真砂人でも……巌でもない……。
まさか…………。
english: There was nothing inside... Not Masahito... nor Iwao... Could it be...

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平、聞こえる！？
english: Shinpei, can you hear me!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (…Ushio!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
わかったで！！
シデの本体は現世におる！！
english: I figured it out!! Shide's real body is in the real world!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （現世やて！？）
english: (The real world!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
ヒルコから「外」に向かって、
電波みたいなんが出てる！
english: There's something like a radio wave coming out of Hiruko towards the "outside"!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
さっき触れた時感じたん！
シデは現世からヒルコを通じて、
ラジコンみたいにあの鎧を遠隔操作してるんや！！
english: I felt it when we touched just now! Shide is remotely controlling that armor from the real world through Hiruko, like a toy car!!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
くやしいよ慎平……！
中身がないんやったらどうしようもないっ……！！
english: It's so frustrating, Shinpei...! If there's nothing inside, there's nothing we can do...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （シデの鎧は今どうなってる！？）
english: (What happened to Shide's armor!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……私が消し去った左半身はそのままや！
english: ...The left half I erased is still gone!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（それなら……鎧を全部消しきれば勝てる！！
　ラジコンを消してしまえば、現世から
　常世の邪魔はできやんはず……！！）
english: (In that case... we can win if we completely erase the armor!! If we destroy the remote control, he shouldn't be able to interfere with Tokoyo from the real world...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (…Ushio?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
あかんっ！
意識を失ってる……！！
english: Oh no! She's losing consciousness...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: Ushio!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（潮……！？
　体が……小さくなってる！？）
english: (Ushio...!? Her body... is getting smaller!?)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ハァハァ……ハァハァ……。
english: *Pant, pant*... *Pant, pant*...

speaker: Haine
japanese:
本物とはいえ、
髪の毛数本では回復しきらん……。
姿が赤子に近づいてきとる……重傷じゃ……。
english: Even if it was the real thing, she can't fully recover with just a few strands of hair... Her form is reverting to an infant... she's severely injured...

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: シデ……！
english: Shide!

speaker: Haine
japanese:
潮は……体中の神経と筋肉がズタズタじゃ……
もう戦えやん……！！
english: Ushio's... nerves and muscles all over her body are torn to shreds... She can't fight anymore...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
ち……ちくしょう！！
僕にあいつを消す力があったら……！！
english: D...Damn it!! If only I had the power to erase that guy...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（竜之介くんって……
　シデの鎧に乗り移れたりしますか……？）
english: (Ryunosuke-kun... Can you possess Shide's armor...?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
english: Huh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いや……ムチャか……。
　でも……そのくらいしか思いつかない――）
english: (No... that's crazy... But... that's the only thing I can think of—)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: （……振り返らんといてね、竜くん……）
english: (…Don't look back, Ryunosuke-kun…)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: （私らの心の声は、シデに聞こえてへんから……）
english: (Shide can't hear our inner voices...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（二人共、そのまま聞いて……。
　ショットガンの弾に私の全部を込めて、
　「ハッキング弾」に変える！）
english: (Both of you, just listen... I'm going to put my everything into the shotgun shells and turn them into "hacking rounds"!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ハッキング弾……！！）
english: (Hacking rounds...!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（うん……！！
　でも……そのプリントに２分はかかる……）
english: (Yeah...!! But... it'll take two minutes to print them...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（だからそれまで……
　時間を稼いでほしい……！！）
english: (So until then... I need you to buy me some time...!!)

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
コソコソと……作戦会議ですか？
私も混ぜてくださいよ！
english: Whispering amongst yourselves... having a strategy meeting? Please, let me join in!

speaker: Haine
japanese:
大丈夫じゃ！
シデサマには記憶を読む力も、
変身する力もありゃせん！
english: It's fine! Shide-sama doesn't have the power to read memories, or the power to transform!

speaker: Haine
japanese:
武器を出すんにもすべて、
ヒルコが隣でやっておったことじゃ……！！
english: Even creating weapons, all of it was done by Hiruko by his side...!!

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
変わったな……波稲……。
まさかキミが裏切るとは……。
キツイお仕置きが必要やな……？
english: You've changed... Haine... To think you would betray me... I suppose a harsh punishment is in order...?

speaker: Haine
japanese:
変わったんは……
シデサマの方やないか……！！
english: You're the one who changed... Shide-sama...!!

speaker: Haine
japanese:
ぜんぶ狂ってしもたんじゃ！！
あのクジラが流れ着いた日ィにな！！
english: Everything went crazy!! On the day that whale washed ashore!!

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
私は何も変わってません。
ただ蒙が啓かれたんです。
english: I haven't changed at all. I was simply enlightened.

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese: 生きたいという、おのれの欲望に忠実にあれとね。
english: To be faithful to my own desire to live.

speaker: Haine
japanese:
（……はじめは、ただ一緒にいたかった。
　それだけじゃったのに……）
english: (...At first, I just wanted to be together. That was all...)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
波稲！！
あんなヤツの言うこと、もう聞くな！！
english: Haine!! Don't listen to a word he says anymore!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
あいつは……お姉ちゃんの仇や……！！
仇は……僕らがとるっ！！！！
english: He's... my sister's killer...!! We're going to... avenge her!!!!

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese: 仇討ちですか、いいですね！
english: A quest for revenge? How nice!

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
お互いこれで最後です。
私も楽しみますから、
キミたちもその仇討ちとやら……楽しみましょうね。
english: This is the end for both of us. I'm going to enjoy this, so you should enjoy your little revenge too.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
２分や……慎平……。
２分間だけ本気出す……。
english: Two minutes... Shinpei... I'll go all out for just two minutes...

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（後はもうない！！
　使い切れ！！！　オレの命ッ！！！！）
english: (There's nothing after this!! Use it all up!!! My life!!!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（かまわずつっこんでくる……！
　撃たれても再生しながら……！！）
english: (He's charging right in...! Regenerating even as he gets shot...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（でもそれでいい！！
　このショットガンは、取るに足らんて思わせとけば！）
english: (But that's fine!! As long as I make him think this shotgun is insignificant!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (Ugh—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（よしッ！
　かわせるぞ――）
english: (Alright! I can dodge this—)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（しまった！
　潮を――）
english: (Oh no! Ushio—)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
この野郎ッ！
僕を無視して……！！！
english: You bastard! Ignoring me...!!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
くそ！！
ショットガンじゃ止めれやん！！
english: Crap! The shotgun won't stop him!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （間に合わ――）
english: (I won't make it—)

speaker: Haine
japanese: がはッ……！
english: Gah…!

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
まさかウシオちゃんをかばうとはねえ……。
でも波稲。無駄なことですよ。
キミじゃあ盾にすらならない。
english: To think you would protect Ushio-chan... But Haine. It's useless. You don't even make a good shield.

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: シデェ！！！
english: Shide!!!

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
無駄ですよ。
慎平くん、竜之介くん。
……これ、なーんだ？
english: It's useless. Shinpei-kun, Ryunosuke-kun... ...Guess what this is?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （ま、まさか……）
english: (I-It can't be...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (......Ushio's... right eye!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: 潮ォォォォッ！！！？
english: Ushioooooo!?

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese: これで私もエンディングを迎えられる。
english: This is my ending.

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
キミたちもゆっくり休んでくださいね。
……お疲れ様でした。
english: You all can rest easy now too. ...Good work.

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
潮！！
武器チェンジや！！
english: Ushio, change weapons!

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese: ぐぶッ……！！
english: Guh…!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（南雲先生のスレッジハンマーを
　コピーしておいてもらったのが
　役に立った……！）
english: (Having her copy Nagumo-sensei's sledgehammer beforehand came in handy...!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
ありがとう！
これでまだ戦える！！
english: Thank you! Now we can still fight!!

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese: ……死ねば……それで終わり……。
english: Everything ends if ya die.

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
予知もループもできない。
ふふふ……！！
素晴らしい！　キミらはもうズルくない！
english: No foresight, no looping... Hehehe...!! Wonderful! You two aren't cheating anymore!

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese: やっぱり魔王にも勝ち目がないといけません。
english: After all, the Demon King needs a chance of winning too.

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
ほら！
おまえも何か出したらどうです……。
english: Come on! Why don't you try putting out something too...

speaker: Hiruko (Baby)
japanese:
ア゛ア゛ッ……！！
ギャアアアアアアッ！！
english: Aaargh...!! Gyaaaaaaaah!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（銃剣を出した……！
　近距離と遠距離どちらも気をつけないと……！）
english: (He drew a bayonet...! We need to be careful of both close and long-range attacks...!)

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese: やればできるコォ……！！
english: See, you can do it if you try...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
english: (One minute left...!!)

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
english: Huh…?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（今だ！
　ヤツの背後に回り込んで……！！）
english: (Now! Get behind him...!!)

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
そうか……。
両方右手やから……武器が使いにくっ……！！
english: I see... Since they're both right hands... it's hard to use weapons...!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
english: …Huh!?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ハンマーの攻撃が返って来た！
　これがヤマビコ……！）
english: (The hammer attack was reflected back! So this is the yamabiko...!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: くっ……！
english: Ugh...!

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese: チョロチョロとよう逃げますねえ。
english: You're scurrying around quite a bit, aren't you?

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （シデの左手が……！）
english: (Shide's left hand...!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 再生した！？
english: It regenerated!?

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（右手を素材に左手を作っただけや……
　鎧の総量は……回復してへん……）
english: (He just used his right hand as material to make a left hand... The total amount of armor... hasn't recovered...)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（慎平の言う通り……私の消去は効いてる！！
　がんばれ竜くんっ！！）
english: (Just like Shinpei said... my erasure is working!! You can do it, Ryunosuke-kun!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: はいっ！！
english: Yes!!

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
（攻撃するとヤマビコが返る！
　でも少しでも攻撃の手を緩めたら、
　シデは潮さんに向かう！）
english: (If I attack, the yamabiko will reflect it back! But if I let up on my attacks even a little, Shide will go after Ushio-san!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
（攻めろ！　攻めろ！！　攻め続けろ！！！
　こいつに一呼吸のスキマも与えるな！！）
english: (Attack! Attack!! Keep attacking!!! Don't give him a single second to breathe!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: 今さらこんな弾丸当たるかっ！
english: Like a bullet like this will hit me now!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（竜くんあかんっ！！
　後ろ！！！）
english: (Ryunosuke-kun, look out!! Behind you!!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
（意識を弾丸に移して！！
　僕の背後に！！）
english: (He transferred his consciousness to the bullet!! He's behind me!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（あいつ！！
　体育館の時の私のマネを！！！）
english: (That guy!! He's copying what I did at the gym!!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
まずい！！
体勢が悪っ……！
english: This is bad!! My posture is...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （竜之介さん、しゃがんで！！）
english: (Ryunosuke-san, duck!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （しまっ――）
english: (Oh n—)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: 慎平ェェェッ！！！！？
english: Shinpei!!!!?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: がぼォッ……！

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese: ハイ、必殺の一撃ですね。
english: Yep, a lethal strike.

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
体育館で戦った時、
ウシオちゃんにフェイントをかけられましてね。
アレは悔しかったなァ……。
english: When we fought in the gym, Ushio-chan tricked me with a feint. That was quite frustrating...

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
でも、フェイントが決まると
こうも気持ちが良いものなんですね。
english: But pulling off a successful feint feels incredibly good, doesn't it?

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese: ウシオちゃん、右目は返してもらいますね。
english: Ushio-chan, I'll be taking that right eye back now.

speaker: Ushio
japanese: ……ぐっ！
english: …Guh!

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
japanese:
色々ありましたが、
ハッピーエンドにたどり着けて良かったです。
ね、皆さん。
english: A lot of things happened, but I'm glad we were able to reach a happy ending. Right, everyone?

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
げ……げほっげほっ……！
ガハァッ……！！
english: *Cough... cough, cough*...! Gaha...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（く……くそったれ……！
　オレの、判断……ミス……で……）
english: (D... Damn it...! Because of... my bad... judgment...)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
english: Guh... buh...!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（な、なんとか避けられたけど
　腕が……ッ！）
english: (I-I somehow managed to dodge it, but my arm...!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
……ごめんっ！！！　慎平！！
僕のせいで腕がっ！！！！
english: ...I'm sorry!!! Shinpei!! It's my fault your arm is...!!!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（いえっ！！
　オレの体が運動神経ないせいです！！
　体も硬くてすみません！！！）
english: (No!! It's because my body has no athletic ability!! I'm sorry my body is so stiff!!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: いやそこはあんま関係ない！
english: No, that doesn't really have anything to do with it!

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（二人とも……！！
　言い合ってる場合とちゃうで！！）
english: (Both of you...!! This is no time to be arguing!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（現状をフカンしてるだけやから！！
　大丈夫や潮っ！！）
english: (I'm just taking a bird's-eye view!! I'm fine, Ushio!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （フカンしろ……！　フカンしろ！！）
english: (Take a bird's-eye view...! Take a bird's-eye view!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（薬莢が浮いているのがわかる……！
　さっきシデが撃った弾の……。
　確か……四発……）
english: (I can see the empty shells floating...! From the bullets Shide just fired... Let's see... four of them...)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （それがまだ、１個も地面に落ちてない！？）
english: (And not a single one of them has hit the ground yet!?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（ま……まさか……
　まだ戦い始めてからっ……！？）
english: (C-Could it be... Since we started fighting, it's only been...!?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: ５秒……ってとこや……！！
english: About... five seconds...!!

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（な……長い……。
　これが影の体感時間なんか……）
english: (S-So long... Is this how Shadows perceive time...?)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese: （１秒が遠い……永遠に感じる……！！）
english: (One second is so far away... It feels like an eternity...!!)

speaker: Shinpei Ajiro
japanese:
（あと何手さばけばしのげる？
　ハッキング弾が完成しても、
　肝心の射手が撃てる状態でいられるか！？）
english: (How many more moves do I have to dodge to survive? Even if the hacking rounds are completed, will the shooter even be in any condition to fire!?)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese:
（くそぉ！！　潮さんがせっかく
　腕を半分にしてくれてんのに！！）
english: (Damn it!! Even though Ushio-san went through the trouble of halving his arms!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: （こいつ巧い！！　他の影の比と違う！！！）
english: (This guy is good!! He's on a completely different level from the other Shadows!!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（慎平は体張ってんのやぞっ！！　それやのにっ！
　シデは遠隔から無敵とか最ッ低！！！）
english: (Shinpei is putting his body on the line!! And yet! Shide is just being invincible from a distance, that's the absolute worst!!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese:
（ちくしょう！！
　ちくしょおおっ……！！！）
english: (Damn it!! Damn it all...!!!)

speaker: Ushio
japanese: （私と波稲にはもう……起き上がる力も残ってへん……）
english: (Haine and I... don't even have the strength left to stand up...)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: （弾を撃つんは、僕しかないっ！！）
english: (I'm the only one who can fire the bullets!!)

speaker: Ryunosuke Minakata
japanese: （僕しか……おらんのにっ……！！）
english: (I'm the only one... who can do it...!!)

speaker: Shide (Damaged True Face)
